name: IELTS
source: ECDICT IELTS 大綱（去除基礎詞）+ word-atlas 例句

tr: n. 節目, 節目單, 程序, 綱要, 大綱, 計劃
vi. 安排節目, 編程序
def: n. a system of projects or services intended to meet a public need
n. an announcement of the events that will occur as part of a theatrical or sporting event
n. (computer science) a sequence of instructions that a computer can interpret and execute

ex.en: This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
ex.zh: 這個程序幫我整理所有度假照片。

ex.en: Schools should teach students how to program computers rather than simply how to use existing software.
ex.zh: 學校應教學生如何給計算機編程，而不只是如何使用現有軟件。

col: program a computer｜給計算機編程
words.tip: 英式計算機程序用program；計劃、節目用programme。

tr: n. 發行, 問題, 後果, 流出, 出口, 爭端
vi. 發行, 流出, 造成...結果, 傳下
vt. 使流出, 放出, 發行, 發佈, 發給
def: n. an important question that is in dispute and must be settled
n. one of a series published periodically
n. the act of providing an item for general use or for official purposes (usually in quantity)

ex.en: We discussed the parking issue at our neighbourhood meeting.
ex.zh: 我們在鄰里會議上討論了停車問題。

ex.en: Governments must address the issue of housing affordability to ensure that young adults can live independently.
ex.zh: 政府必須解決住房負擔能力問題，確保年輕人能夠獨立生活。

col: a controversial issue｜有爭議的議題
words.tip: issue 作問題常指需討論的議題，不一定是困難。

tr: n. 社區, 公眾, 共有, 共同體
[經] 公眾, 共有, 社會
def: n. a group of people living in a particular local area
n. common ownership
n. a group of nations having common interests

ex.en: Our community gathers every spring to clean the park.
ex.zh: 我們社區的居民每年春天都會一起清理公園。

ex.en: Public libraries strengthen the local community by providing free learning spaces and opportunities for social interaction.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館提供免費的學習空間和社交機會，從而增強當地社區的凝聚力。

words.tip: 既指同地區居民，也指有共同背景或興趣的群體。

def: n. the supreme effort one can make
n. the person who is most outstanding or excellent; someone who tops all others
n. Canadian physiologist (born in the United States) who assisted F. G. Banting in research leading to the discovery of insulin (1899-1978)

ex.en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 這家麵包店做的麵包是我們街區最好的。

ex.en: Investing in early education may be the best way to reduce inequality over time.
ex.zh: 投資早期教育可能是逐步減少不平等的最佳方式。

col: at its best｜處於最佳狀態
words.tip: best是good和well的最高級；形容詞前通常加the。

tr: vt. 用支索撐住, 取笑, 嘲弄
def: n. an informal term for a youth or man
n. an effigy of Guy Fawkes that is burned on a bonfire on Guy Fawkes Day
n. a cable, wire, or rope that is used to brace something (especially a tent)

ex.en: The guy next door helped carry my groceries.
ex.zh: 隔壁那位小夥子幫我提了買回來的東西。

ex.en: Calling a colleague a guy may sound friendly, but informal vocabulary is usually inappropriate in academic writing.
ex.zh: 稱同事為guy可能顯得親切，但非正式詞彙通常不適合學術寫作。

words.tip: guy屬口語；正式寫作通常用man或person。

tr: a. 經濟上的, 實用的, 節省的
def: a. of or relating to an economy, the system of production and management of material wealth
a. of or relating to the science of economics
s. using the minimum of time or resources necessary for effectiveness

ex.en: The news discussed economic problems affecting local shops.
ex.zh: 新聞討論了影響當地商店的經濟問題。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can support economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.
ex.zh: 投資公共交通能讓勞動者獲得更廣泛的就業機會，從而促進經濟增長。

words.tip: economic指經濟方面的；economical指節約的。

tr: n. 中心, 中心點, 中鋒
a. 中央的, 位在正中的
def: n. an area that is approximately central within some larger region
n. a building dedicated to a particular activity
n. a point equidistant from the ends of a line or the extremities of a figure

tr: n. 位置, 場所, 地點
def: n. the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)
n. physical position in relation to the surroundings
A place where something is built, happens, or once existed.

ex.en: Workers put a fence around the building site.
ex.zh: 工人們在建築工地周圍圍起了圍欄。

ex.en: The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 擬建醫院的選址靠近公共交通，方便居民獲得醫療服務。

words.tip: site指地點或網站；sight指視力或景象，二者同音。

tr: n. 影像, 肖像, 想像, 圖像, 形象, 翻版
vt. 作...的像, 反映, 想像, 象徵
def: n. an iconic mental representation
n. (mathematics) the set of values of the dependent variable for which a function is defined
n. the general impression that something (a person or organization or product) presents to the public

ex.en: The camera captured a sharp image of the bird.
ex.zh: 相機拍下了那隻鳥的清晰影像。

ex.en: Companies increasingly use social media to improve their public image and build stronger relationships with customers.
ex.zh: 企業越來越多地利用社交媒體改善公眾形象，並加強與客戶的聯繫。

words.tip: 既可指具體圖像，也可指個人或機構的公眾形象。

tr: n. 來源, 水源, 根源, 原始資料, 源
def: n. a document (or organization) from which information is obtained
n. anything that provides inspiration for later work
n. a facility where something is available

ex.en: We followed the stream uphill to find its source.
ex.zh: 我們沿著小溪向山上走，尋找它的源頭。

ex.en: Researchers should compare several independent sources before drawing conclusions about the effects of social media.
ex.zh: 研究人員在對社交媒體的影響下結論之前，應比較多個獨立的資料來源。

col: a source of income｜收入來源
a reliable source｜可靠的消息來源
source materials locally｜在當地採購材料
words.tip: 來源常用source of；作動詞可用source…from…。

def: n. a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
A situation that makes it possible to do something.

ex.en: The school trip gave me an opportunity to try climbing.
ex.zh: 學校旅行讓我有機會嘗試攀巖。

ex.en: Public libraries provide an important opportunity for residents to develop skills without paying expensive course fees.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館為居民提供了培養技能的重要機會，無須支付昂貴的課程費用。

col: an opportunity to learn｜學習的機會
words.tip: 常用an opportunity to do，表示做某事的機會。

tr: n. 國會, 會議, 討論會
def: n. the legislature of the United States government
n. a meeting of elected or appointed representatives
n. a national legislative assembly

ex.en: The congress debated the new law late into the night.
ex.zh: 國會就這項新法律辯論到深夜。

ex.en: Delegates at the international congress discussed practical ways to improve access to healthcare in rural communities.
ex.zh: 國際大會的代表們討論了改善農村社區醫療可及性的切實辦法。

col: a national congress｜全國代表大會
a member of Congress｜國會議員
words.tip: 特指美國等國家的國會時，通常大寫Congress。

tr: n. 經濟, 理財, 節約
def: n. the system of production and distribution and consumption
n. the efficient use of resources
n. frugality in the expenditure of money or resources

ex.en: Tourists support the local economy by shopping here.
ex.zh: 遊客在這裡購物，為當地經濟提供支持。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can strengthen the economy while reducing dependence on imported fuels.
ex.zh: 投資可再生能源可以增強經濟實力，同時減少對進口燃料的依賴。

words.tip: economic指經濟的；economical指節省的、划算的。

tr: n. 湧流, 趨勢, 流
a. 流通的, 現在的, 當前的, 流行的
def: n. a flow of electricity through a conductor
n. a steady flow of a fluid (usually from natural causes)
a. occurring in or belonging to the present time

ex.en: My current flat is much closer to work.
ex.zh: 我現在住的公寓離上班的地方近多了。

ex.en: Current policies may need revision as cities face increasing pressure on housing and transport.
ex.zh: 隨著城市住房和交通壓力不斷增加，現行政策可能需要調整。

words.tip: 形容詞指當前的；名詞可指水流或電流。

tr: vt. 包括, 使陷於, 潛心於, 包圍
[醫] 累及, 牽涉, 包含
def: v. connect closely and often incriminatingly
v. engage as a participant
v. contain as a part

ex.en: My new job involves talking to customers all day.
ex.zh: 我的新工作需要整天與顧客交談。

ex.en: Local authorities should involve residents in planning decisions to ensure that new developments meet community needs.
ex.zh: 地方政府應讓居民參與規劃決策，確保新的開發項目滿足社區需求。

col: involve someone in something｜讓某人參與某事
words.tip: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。

def: n. manner of acting or controlling yourself
n. the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances
n. (psychology) the aggregate of the responses or reactions or movements made by an organism in any situation

ex.en: The puppy's calm behavior surprised everyone at the park.
ex.zh: 這隻小狗安靜的表現讓公園裡的每個人都很驚訝。

ex.en: Schools can encourage responsible behavior by giving students meaningful opportunities to participate in decisions affecting their community.
ex.zh: 學校可以讓學生有實質性機會參與影響其社區的決策，以此鼓勵負責任的行為。

words.tip: 美式拼寫；英式為behaviour。通常不可數。

tr: n. 顏色, 面色, 顏料, 外貌
vt. 把...塗上顏色, 粉飾, 使臉紅, 歪曲
def: n. a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect
n. interest and variety and intensity
n. the timbre of a musical sound

tr: n. 串聯, 序列, 連續, 系列, 叢書, 套, 級數, 組
def: n. similar things placed in order or happening one after another
n. a periodical that appears at scheduled times
n. (sports) several contests played successively by the same teams

ex.en: A series of small delays made us miss lunch.
ex.zh: 接連幾次小耽擱讓我們錯過了午飯。

ex.en: The university introduced a series of workshops to help students evaluate information found on social media.
ex.zh: 這所大學推出了一系列研討課，幫助學生評估社交媒體上的信息。

col: a series of events｜一連串事件
a television series｜電視系列節目
words.tip: 單複數同形：a series；two series。

tr: a. 重要的, 有效的, 有含義的, 暗示的, 值得注意的
def: a. important in effect or meaning
s. fairly large
a. too closely correlated to be attributed to chance and therefore indicating a systematic relation

ex.en: Moving closer to work made a significant difference to me.
ex.zh: 搬到工作地點附近對我的生活產生了很大的影響。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet services has a significant impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
ex.zh: 能否獲得可靠的互聯網服務，對偏遠社區的教育機會有重大影響。

col: a significant glance｜意味深長的一瞥
words.tip: 統計上significant指達到顯著性標準，不等於實際影響很大。

tr: n. 反應, 回答, 響應
def: n. a result
n. a phrase recited or sung by the congregation following a versicle by the priest or minister
n. the manner in which an electrical or mechanical device responds to an input signal or a range of input signals

ex.en: I sent an invitation but haven't received a response yet.
ex.zh: 我發出了邀請，但還沒有收到答覆。

ex.en: A rapid response to disease outbreaks can protect vulnerable communities and reduce pressure on local hospitals.
ex.zh: 迅速應對疾病暴發能夠保護脆弱群體，並減輕當地醫院的壓力。

col: in response to｜作為對……的回應
words.tip: response後通常接to，不接of。

tr: n. 因素, 因數, 係數, 基因, 代理人
def: n. anything that contributes causally to a result
n. any of the numbers (or symbols) that form a product when multiplied together
n. an independent variable in statistics

ex.en: Price was the main factor when we chose our sofa.
ex.zh: 我們選沙發時，價格是主要考慮因素。

ex.en: Access to reliable public transport is a key factor in reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 能否使用可靠的公共交通，是減少對私家車依賴的關鍵因素。

col: factor in the cost｜把成本考慮在內
words.tip: 動詞常用factor in，表示把某因素考慮在內。

tr: n. 樹幹, 祖先, 血統, 原料, 備料, 庫存, 牲畜, 股票, 股份, 保留劇目
a. 存貨的, 常備的, 平凡的, 普通的, 股票的, 保留劇目的, 繁殖用的
vt. 裝把手於, 進貨, 備有, 放牧
vi. 出新芽, 備貨, 囤積
def: n. the capital raised by a corporation through the issue of shares entitling holders to an ownership interest (equity)
n. the merchandise that a shop has on hand
n. the handle of a handgun or the butt end of a rifle or shotgun or part of the support of a machine gun or artillery gun

ex.en: The shop has fresh stock arriving early tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 這家店明天一早會有新貨到店。

ex.en: Small retailers often struggle to maintain sufficient stock when transport disruptions delay deliveries from major suppliers.
ex.zh: 當運輸中斷導致主要供應商延遲交貨時，小型零售商往往難以維持充足庫存。

col: stock up on food｜囤積食物
words.tip: 庫存通常不可數；表示不同公司的股票時可用stocks。

tr: n. 事業, 生涯, 成功
[法] 職業, 專業, 履歷
def: n. the particular occupation for which you are trained
n. the general progression of your working or professional life
v. move headlong at high speed

ex.en: My sister hopes to build a career in nursing.
ex.zh: 我姐姐希望在護理行業發展事業。

ex.en: Access to affordable training enables adults to change career and adapt to a rapidly evolving labour market.
ex.zh: 獲得負擔得起的培訓，使成年人能夠轉行並適應快速變化的勞動力市場。

col: pursue a career｜從事某種職業
a career in teaching｜教學生涯
words.tip: career側重長期職業發展，job指具體工作。

tr: n. 人, 個人, 個體
a. 個別的, 個人的, 獨特的
def: n. a single organism
a. being or characteristic of a single thing or person
s. separate and distinct from others of the same kind

ex.en: The teacher gave each child an individual box of crayons.
ex.zh: 老師給每個孩子單獨發了一盒彩色蠟筆。

ex.en: Education systems should recognise individual learning needs rather than expect every student to progress at the same pace.
ex.zh: 教育體系應重視個人的學習需求，而不是指望每個學生都以相同的速度進步。

words.tip: 形容詞強調單個或個人；作可數名詞指一個人或個體。

tr: n. 資源, 財力, 辦法, 策略, 急智, 消遣
def: n. available source of wealth; a new or reserve supply that can be drawn upon when needed
n. a source of aid or support that may be drawn upon when needed
n. the ability to deal resourcefully with unusual problems

ex.en: Our village shares its water resources during dry summers.
ex.zh: 在乾旱的夏季，我們村會共享水資源。

ex.en: Governments should manage natural resources carefully to balance economic development with long-term environmental protection.
ex.zh: 政府應謹慎管理自然資源，以平衡經濟發展與長期環境保護。

words.tip: 資源總稱常用複數resources；動詞意為提供資源。

tr: vt. 識別, 認為...等同於, 確定, 使參與
def: v. recognize as being; establish the identity of someone or something
v. consider (oneself) as similar to somebody else
v. conceive of as united or associated

ex.en: Can you identify the bird sitting on our fence?
ex.zh: 你能認出停在我們圍欄上的那隻鳥嗎？

ex.en: Schools should identify learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support before falling behind.
ex.zh: 學校應儘早發現學習困難，讓學生在落後之前獲得適當的支持。

words.tip: identify with某人指產生共鳴，不是辨認對方。

tr: n. 區域, 地帶, 地區, 領域, 範圍, 區
def: n. the extended spatial location of something
n. a large indefinite location on the surface of the Earth
n. the approximate amount of something (usually used prepositionally as in `in the region of')

ex.en: This region is famous for its apples and cheese.
ex.zh: 這個地區以蘋果和奶酪聞名。

ex.en: Improved transport links could attract more businesses to the region and create jobs for local residents.
ex.zh: 改善交通聯繫可以吸引更多企業進入該地區，併為當地居民創造就業機會。

words.tip: in the region of接金額等，表示“大約”。

tr: a. 周圍的, 環境的
def: a. of or relating to the external conditions or surroundings
a. concerned with the ecological effects of altering the environment
relating to nature or efforts to protect it

ex.en: Our school organised an environmental project to clean the river.
ex.zh: 我們學校組織了一項清理河流的環保活動。

ex.en: Governments should consider the environmental impact of new roads before approving major construction projects.
ex.zh: 政府在批准大型建設項目之前，應考慮新道路對環境的影響。

words.tip: environmental是形容詞，環境本身用environment。

tr: a. 財政的, 金融的
[經] 財政的, 金融的, 財務的
def: a involving financial matters
relating to money or how it is managed

ex.en: We asked for financial advice before buying our first home.
ex.zh: 購買第一套住房前，我們諮詢了理財建議。

ex.en: Financial support for disadvantaged students can improve access to higher education and reduce long-term inequality.
ex.zh: 為弱勢學生提供經濟支持可以增加他們接受高等教育的機會，並減少長期存在的不平等。

col: financial stability｜金融穩定；財務穩定
words.tip: financial側重金錢與財務；economic側重經濟整體。

def: n. a republic in western Europe; the largest country wholly in Europe
n. French writer of sophisticated novels and short stories (1844-1924)
a country in western Europe whose capital is Paris

ex.en: We travelled through France by train last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，我們乘火車遊覽了法國。

ex.en: France attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed transport networks.
ex.zh: 法國憑藉文化遺產、多樣的景觀和發達的交通網絡吸引國際遊客。

words.tip: 國名France首字母大寫，通常不加the。

def: n. the branch of military science dealing with military command and the planning and conduct of a war
a planned approach for achieving a particular goal

ex.en: Our strategy was to save a little every week.
ex.zh: 我們的策略是每週存一點錢。

ex.en: An effective transport strategy should improve public services while reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 有效的交通策略應在改善公共服務的同時減少對私家車的依賴。

col: a strategy for growth｜增長策略
words.tip: 常用a strategy for doing sth表示做某事的策略。

tr: n. 執行部門, 執行委員會, 執行者, 經理主管人員
a. 執行的, 善於執行的, 善於經營的
def: n. a person responsible for the administration of a business
n. persons who administer the law
a. having the function of carrying out plans or orders etc.

ex.en: The executive joined our team for lunch today.
ex.zh: 那位高管今天和我們團隊一起吃了午飯。

ex.en: Senior executives should consider employee wellbeing alongside financial performance when making decisions about company restructuring.
ex.zh: 高管在作出公司重組決策時，應同時考慮員工福祉和財務表現。

words.tip: 名詞可指高管；形容詞常修飾power、board等。

tr: n. 要求, 要求權, 斷言, 權利
vt. 要求, 認領, 主張
vi. 提出要求, 主張, 斷言
def: n. an assertion of a right (as to money or property)
n. an assertion that something is true or factual
n. demand for something as rightful or due

ex.en: He claims he can fix my bike by lunchtime.
ex.zh: 他聲稱能在午飯前修好我的自行車。

ex.en: Some researchers claim that access to green spaces can improve mental health and strengthen community relationships.
ex.zh: 一些研究人員認為，能夠使用綠地有助於改善心理健康並加強社區聯繫。

col: make a claim｜提出說法或索賠要求
words.tip: claim強調某人的說法，不代表已得到證實。

tr: vt. 建立, 確立, 制定
def: v. set up or found
v. set up or lay the groundwork for
v. bring about

ex.en: Our neighbours established a gardening club last spring.
ex.zh: 我們的鄰居去年春天成立了一個園藝俱樂部。

ex.en: Governments should establish clear standards to ensure that new housing is both safe and energy efficient.
ex.zh: 政府應制定明確的標準，確保新建住房既安全又節能。

words.tip: establish是及物動詞，後接機構、制度或事實等。

tr: n. 經營, 支配, 管理
def: n. the act of managing something
n. those in charge of running a business
The work of organising and controlling activities or resources.

ex.en: Good time management leaves me free to relax.
ex.zh: 良好的時間管理讓我有空放鬆。

ex.en: Effective waste management requires cooperation between local authorities, businesses, and residents to reduce pollution and conserve resources.
ex.zh: 有效的廢物管理需要地方政府、企業和居民合作，以減少汙染並節約資源。

words.tip: 指管理工作時不可數；the management可指管理層。

tr: n. 衝擊, 衝突, 影響, 效果
vt. 擠入, 撞擊, 壓緊, 對...發生影響
def: n. the striking of one body against another
n. a forceful consequence; a strong effect
v. press or wedge together; pack together

ex.en: The new playground had a positive impact on our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 新遊樂場給我們社區帶來了積極影響。

ex.en: Governments should assess the environmental impact of major construction projects before allowing work to begin.
ex.zh: 政府應在批准開工之前評估大型建設項目對環境的影響。

col: have an impact on｜對……有影響
words.tip: 名詞重音在前；動詞通常讀/ɪmˈpækt/。

tr: vt. 維持, 維修, 保持, 堅持, 供養, 主張
def: v. state or assert
To keep something at the same level or in existence.
To keep something working well through regular care and repairs.

ex.en: Regular walks help me maintain a healthy weight.
ex.zh: 經常散步幫助我保持健康的體重。

ex.en: Governments must maintain essential public services while responding to growing pressure on national budgets.
ex.zh: 政府必須在應對國家預算壓力不斷增大的同時，維持基本公共服務。

words.tip: maintain後直接接賓語；表示堅持聲稱時可接that從句。

def: n. any instrument or instrumentality used in fighting or hunting
n. a means of persuading or arguing
an object used for fighting or causing physical harm

ex.en: The museum displays an ancient weapon behind thick glass.
ex.zh: 博物館將一件古代兵器陳列在厚玻璃後。

ex.en: Stricter controls on weapon sales may help governments improve public safety and reduce violent crime.
ex.zh: 更嚴格地管控武器銷售可能有助於政府改善公共安全並減少暴力犯罪。

words.tip: 可數名詞；武器的總稱也可用weaponry。

tr: n. 職員, 員工, 受僱人員
def: n. a worker who is hired to perform a job
Someone paid to work for a person or organisation.

ex.en: A new employee showed me around the bakery.
ex.zh: 一位新員工帶我參觀了麵包店。

ex.en: Employers should provide every employee with appropriate training to maintain a safe and productive workplace.
ex.zh: 僱主應為每位員工提供適當培訓，以保持工作場所的安全和高效。

words.tip: employee是僱員，employer是僱主。

tr: a. 文化的, 教養的, 修養的
def: a. of or relating to the arts and manners that a group favors
s. denoting or deriving from or distinctive of the ways of living built up by a group of people
a. of or relating to the shared knowledge and values of a society

ex.en: The festival celebrates the town's rich cultural traditions.
ex.zh: 這個節日頌揚小鎮豐富的文化傳統。

ex.en: Schools can promote cultural understanding by encouraging students to share their family traditions and experiences.
ex.zh: 學校可以鼓勵學生分享家庭傳統和經歷，從而促進文化理解。

words.tip: cultural指文化相關；cultured形容人有修養。

tr: n. 作家, 撰稿者, 抄寫員
def: n. writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)
n. a person who is able to write and has written something
someone who writes books, articles, or other texts

ex.en: The writer filled her notebook while waiting for the train.
ex.zh: 那位作家等火車時，把筆記本寫得滿滿的。

ex.en: A skilled writer can make complex environmental issues accessible to readers without oversimplifying the scientific evidence.
ex.zh: 優秀的作者能讓讀者理解複雜的環境問題，同時不過度簡化科學證據。

words.tip: writer範圍較廣；author常指某部作品的作者。

tr: n. 財產, 所有權, 性質, 屬性
def: n. something owned; any tangible or intangible possession that is owned by someone;
n. a basic or essential attribute shared by all members of a class
n. a construct whereby objects or individuals can be distinguished

ex.en: Please keep your personal property safe while you swim.
ex.zh: 游泳時，請妥善保管個人財物。

ex.en: Understanding the thermal properties of building materials helps architects design homes that require less heating.
ex.zh: 瞭解建築材料的熱學性能，有助於建築師設計供暖需求更低的住宅。

words.tip: 財產義不可數；房產和性質義可數。

tr: n. 原料, 要素, 東西, 材料, 素質, 織品, 廢物, 廢話
def: n. miscellaneous unspecified objects
n. informal terms for personal possessions
n. senseless talk

ex.en: Please move your stuff off the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 請把你的東西從廚房餐桌上拿走。

ex.en: Consumers often buy stuff they rarely use, contributing to household waste and unnecessary resource consumption.
ex.zh: 消費者經常購買很少使用的東西，造成家庭浪費和不必要的資源消耗。

col: stuff a bag with｜用……塞滿袋子
words.tip: 名詞stuff不可數且偏口語；正式寫作宜用具體名詞。

def: n. an isolated fact that is considered separately from the whole
n. a small part that can be considered separately from the whole
n. extended treatment of particulars

ex.en: Please check every detail before you send the invitation.
ex.zh: 發送邀請前，請核對每一處細節。

ex.en: The report details how improved housing conditions can reduce health inequalities among families in urban areas.
ex.zh: 該報告詳細說明了改善住房條件如何減少城市家庭之間的健康差距。

col: pay attention to detail｜注重細節
words.tip: in detail不用複數；聯繫方式用contact details。

def: n. the English royal house (a branch of the Plantagenet line) that reigned from 1461 to 1485; its emblem was a white rose

tr: a. 商業的, 商用的, 商品化的
def: n. a commercially sponsored ad on radio or television
a. connected with or engaged in or sponsored by or used in commerce or commercial enterprises
a. of or relating to commercialism

ex.en: This street has homes above its commercial premises.
ex.zh: 這條街的商業用房上面是住宅。

ex.en: Commercial development can create jobs, but it should not come at the expense of public green spaces.
ex.zh: 商業開發能夠創造就業機會，但不應以犧牲公共綠地為代價。

words.tip: 作名詞指電視或廣播廣告，不泛指所有廣告。

tr: n. 項目, 條款, 一則, 項
def: n. a distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list
n. a whole individual unit; especially when included in a list or collection
r. (used when listing or enumerating items) also

ex.en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
ex.zh: 請把每件商品小心地放進購物袋。

ex.en: Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
ex.zh: 會議議程中的每一項都涉及當地公共交通服務面臨的不同挑戰。

words.tip: item是可數名詞；一件衣物可說an item of clothing。

tr: [醫] 包埋料, 圍模料, 包埋法, 圍模法
def: n. money that is invested with an expectation of profit
n. the commitment of something other than money (time, energy, or effort) to a project with the expectation of some worthwhile result
n. outer layer or covering of an organ or part or organism

ex.en: Buying better tools was a good investment for our bakery.
ex.zh: 購買更好的工具對我們麵包店來說是一筆不錯的投資。

ex.en: Greater public investment in renewable energy could create jobs while reducing dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 加大對可再生能源的公共投資可以創造就業機會，同時減少對化石燃料的依賴。

col: investment in infrastructure｜基礎設施投資
an investment of time｜時間投入
words.tip: 通常搭配in；表示投資行為時常作不可數名詞。

tr: a. 肯定的, 積極的, 有把握的
def: n. the primary form of an adjective or adverb; denotes a quality without qualification, comparison, or relation to increase or diminution
n. a film showing a photographic image whose tones correspond to those of the original subject
a. characterized by or displaying affirmation or acceptance or certainty etc.

ex.en: She stayed positive even when rain spoiled our picnic.
ex.zh: 即使下雨毀了我們的野餐，她仍然保持樂觀。

ex.en: Regular contact with nature can have a positive effect on children's emotional development and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 經常接觸大自然可以對兒童的情緒發展和整體健康產生積極影響。

col: positive result｜陽性結果；良好結果
words.tip: 檢測結果positive指陽性，不一定是好消息。

def: n. a person who uses goods or services
A person who buys goods or services for personal use.

ex.en: As a consumer, I always compare prices before buying.
ex.zh: 作為消費者，我總會在購買前比較價格。

ex.en: Governments should protect consumers by requiring companies to provide accurate information about their products.
ex.zh: 政府應要求企業提供準確的產品信息，以保護消費者。

words.tip: consumer強調消費身份；customer強調與商家的交易關係。

def: n a professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice

tr: a. 專業的, 職業的
def: n. a person engaged in one of the learned professions
n. an athlete who plays for pay
a. engaged in a profession or engaging in as a profession or means of livelihood

ex.en: We hired a professional photographer for our wedding.
ex.zh: 我們為婚禮聘請了一位專業攝影師。

ex.en: Continuous professional development helps teachers adapt their methods to changing student needs and new educational technologies.
ex.zh: 持續的專業發展幫助教師調整教學方法，以適應學生需求的變化和新的教育技術。

words.tip: 與amateur對比強調職業；形容態度時強調專業得體。

tr: n. 任務, 代表團, 使命, 傳教團
def: n. an organization of missionaries in a foreign land sent to carry on religious work
n. an operation that is assigned by a higher headquarters
n. a special assignment that is given to a person or group

tr: n. 選擇權, 挑選, 選項
def: n. the right to buy or sell property at an agreed price; the right is purchased and if it is not exercised by a stated date the money is forfeited
n. one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen
Something you can choose from a range of possibilities.

ex.en: Taking the bus is our cheapest option today.
ex.zh: 今天乘公交車是我們最便宜的選擇。

ex.en: Remote working gives employees the option to live further from expensive city centres without changing jobs.
ex.zh: 遠程辦公讓員工可以選擇住在遠離高房價市中心的地方，而不必換工作。

col: have no option but to｜別無選擇只能
keep your options open｜保留選擇餘地
the option to buy｜購買的選擇權
words.tip: option指可選方案；have no option but to後接動詞原形。

tr: a. 通用的, 全球的, 球形的, 綜合的, 普遍的
def: s. involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope
Involving or affecting the whole world.
Considering all parts of something rather than individual details.

ex.en: Our teacher showed us a map of global temperatures.
ex.zh: 老師給我們看了一張全球氣溫分佈圖。

ex.en: Global cooperation is essential for tackling climate change because environmental damage rarely respects national borders.
ex.zh: 全球合作對於應對氣候變化至關重要，因為環境破壞很少受國界限制。

words.tip: global強調全球範圍；international強調國家之間。

tr: n. 釋放, 發洩, 豁免, 發行, 釋放證書
vt. 釋放, 解除, 放鬆, 豁免, 免除, 發佈, 放棄, 讓與
def: n. merchandise issued for sale or public showing (especially a record or film)
n. a process that liberates or discharges something
n. a device that when pressed will release part of a mechanism

ex.en: We released the butterfly outside after checking its wings.
ex.zh: 檢查過蝴蝶的翅膀後，我們把它放到了室外。

ex.en: Governments should release reliable environmental data so that citizens can evaluate the effectiveness of climate policies.
ex.zh: 政府應公佈可靠的環境數據，讓公民能夠評估氣候政策的成效。

words.tip: release可指釋放，也可指公開發布報告或產品。

tr: a. 批評的, 決定性的, 危險的, 臨界的
[醫] 危象的; 臨界的, 極期的
def: a. marked by a tendency to find and call attention to errors and flaws
a. at or of a point at which a property or phenomenon suffers an abrupt change especially having enough mass to sustain a chain reaction
a. characterized by careful evaluation and judgment

ex.en: Your support was critical when I started my business.
ex.zh: 我創業時，你的支持至關重要。

ex.en: Access to clean water is critical to improving public health in rapidly growing urban communities.
ex.zh: 獲得清潔用水對改善快速發展城市社區的公共衛生至關重要。

col: critical to success｜對成功至關重要
words.tip: critical of表示批評；critical to表示對……至關重要。

tr: n. 回憶, 召回, 撤消
vt. 回想, 回憶, 召回, 撤消, 使恢復
def: n. a request by the manufacturer of a defective product to return the product (as for replacement or repair)
n. a call to return
n. a bugle call that signals troops to return

ex.en: I still recall the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.zh: 我仍然記得祖母廚房裡的氣味。

ex.en: Manufacturers should recall faulty products promptly to protect consumers and maintain public trust in safety standards.
ex.zh: 製造商應及時召回有缺陷的產品，以保護消費者並維持公眾對安全標準的信任。

col: recall a detail｜回想起一個細節
recall doing something｜記得做過某事
words.tip: 表示記得做過某事用 recall doing，不用 to do。

tr: a. 有效的, 有力的, 實際的
def: a. producing or capable of producing an intended result or having a striking effect
s. able to accomplish a purpose; functioning effectively
s. works well as a means or remedy

ex.en: This simple stretch is effective at easing shoulder tension.
ex.zh: 這個簡單的伸展動作能有效緩解肩部緊繃。

ex.en: Effective environmental policies should combine clear regulations with financial incentives that encourage businesses to reduce waste.
ex.zh: 有效的環境政策應將明確的法規與鼓勵企業減少廢棄物的經濟激勵相結合。

col: effective in doing something｜在做某事方面有效
words.tip: effective強調達到效果；efficient強調省時省力。

tr: a. 最初的, 原始的, 有創意的
def: n. something that serves as a model or a basis for making copies
s. preceding all others in time or being as first made or performed
s. (of e.g. information) not secondhand or by way of something intermediary

ex.en: The kitchen still has its original wooden floor.
ex.zh: 廚房仍保留著原來的木地板。

ex.en: Schools should encourage original thinking rather than reward students only for repeating information from textbooks.
ex.zh: 學校應鼓勵獨創性思考，而不是隻獎勵複述課本知識的學生。

words.tip: 可指最初的，也可指原創的；看語境區分。

tr: n. 種, 類, 外形
def: n. (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed
n. a specific kind of something
A biological group whose members can usually breed with one another.

ex.en: Several species of butterfly visit our garden each summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天都有幾種蝴蝶來到我們的花園。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for preventing the extinction of species threatened by human activity.
ex.zh: 保護自然棲息地對於防止受人類活動威脅的物種滅絕至關重要。

words.tip: 單複數同形：one species，many species。

tr: n. 客戶, 顧客, 委託人
[計] 客戶, 客戶機, 客戶機程序
def: n. a person who seeks the advice of a lawyer
someone who pays for professional services
a computer or program using services from a server

ex.en: The designer showed her client three possible kitchen layouts.
ex.zh: 設計師向客戶展示了三種可選的廚房佈局。

ex.en: Maintaining clear communication with each client helps businesses build trust and establish lasting professional relationships.
ex.zh: 與每位客戶保持清晰的溝通有助於企業建立信任，並形成持久的業務關係。

words.tip: client常購買專業服務；customer泛指購買商品或服務的人。

def: n. the work of inquiring into something thoroughly and systematically
a careful effort to discover facts about an event or problem
a systematic study intended to increase knowledge about a subject

ex.en: An investigation revealed why the kitchen ceiling was leaking.
ex.zh: 一項調查查明瞭廚房天花板漏水的原因。

ex.en: An independent investigation into river pollution could help authorities identify its causes and prevent further environmental damage.
ex.zh: 對河流汙染開展獨立調查，可幫助有關部門查明原因並防止環境進一步受損。

words.tip: 調查某事用investigation into；under investigation指正被調查。

def: n the territory occupied by one of the constituent administrative districts of a nation
n the way something is with respect to its main attributes
n the group of people comprising the government of a sovereign state

tr: n. 面孔的一部分(如眼、口等), 特徵, 容貌, 特色, 特寫
vt. 是...的特色, 特寫, 放映
def: n. a prominent attribute or aspect of something
n. the characteristic parts of a person's face: eyes and nose and mouth and chin
n. the principal (full-length) film in a program at a movie theater

ex.en: My favourite feature of this backpack is its hidden pocket.
ex.zh: 這個背包最讓我喜歡的特點是它的隱藏口袋。

ex.en: Public parks are an essential feature of cities that prioritise residents' health and wellbeing.
ex.zh: 在重視居民健康與福祉的城市中，公共公園是一項不可或缺的特色。

words.tip: 作動詞時直接接賓語，不說feature with。

tr: n. 危機, 危險期, 緊要關頭
[醫] 危象; 驟退, 臨界, 極期
def: n. an unstable situation of extreme danger or difficulty
n. a crucial stage or turning point in the course of something
a serious situation requiring urgent decisions or action

ex.en: The broken water pipe caused a crisis at home.
ex.zh: 水管破裂讓家裡陷入了困境。

ex.en: The housing crisis has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
ex.zh: 住房危機迫使許多年輕人推遲搬進自己的住所。

col: in times of crisis｜在危機時期
words.tip: 複數為crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/，注意詞尾發音。

tr: n. 解決, 解答, 溶液
def: n. a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances; frequently (but not necessarily) a liquid solution
n. a statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem
n. a method for solving a problem

ex.en: Adding another shelf was a simple solution to the clutter.
ex.zh: 再加一個架子是解決雜亂問題的簡單辦法。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy offers a long-term solution to the environmental problems caused by fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投資可再生能源為化石燃料造成的環境問題提供了長期解決方案。

col: a solution to a problem｜問題的解決辦法
find a solution｜找到解決辦法
a practical solution｜切實可行的辦法
words.tip: 表示“……的解決辦法”用solution to，不用solution of。

tr: n. 刻度, 衡量, 比例, 比例尺, 數值範圍, 等級, 規模, 天平, 秤, 鱗, 積垢
vt. 依比例決定, 攀登, 測量, 繪製, 刮鱗, 使生垢, 過秤
vi. 剝落, 生水垢, 重量為, 攀登, 衡量
def: n. an ordered reference standard
n. relative magnitude
n. the ratio between the size of something and a representation of it

ex.en: I hadn't realised the scale of your vegetable garden.
ex.zh: 我之前沒意識到你的菜園有這麼大。

ex.en: The scale of plastic pollution demands coordinated action from governments, manufacturers, and consumers worldwide.
ex.zh: 塑料汙染的規模要求世界各地的政府、製造商和消費者協調行動。

col: on a large scale｜大規模地
the scale of the problem｜問題的嚴重程度
words.tip: 表示規模用on a large scale；表示秤通常用複數scales。

tr: n. 縱覽, 視察, 測量, 俯瞰, 調查
vt. 審視, 視察, 俯瞰, 通盤考慮
def: n. a detailed critical inspection
v. consider in a comprehensive way
v. look over carefully or inspect

ex.en: I completed a short survey about our local library.
ex.zh: 我填寫了一份關於本地圖書館的簡短問卷。

ex.en: A recent survey suggests that many commuters would cycle more often if safer routes were available.
ex.zh: 最近一項調查表明，如果有更安全的路線，許多通勤者會更經常騎自行車。

words.tip: 名詞重音在首音節，動詞重音在末音節。

def: n income (at invoice values) received for goods and services over some given period of time
n a particular instance of selling
n the general activity of selling

tr: n. 出席, 面前, 存在, 儀態, 風度
def: n. the state of being present; current existence
n. the immediate proximity of someone or something
n. an invisible spiritual being felt to be nearby

ex.en: Her presence at the concert made her daughter smile.
ex.zh: 她來到音樂會現場，女兒見了露出笑容。

ex.en: The presence of green spaces in urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 城市社區中的綠地可以改善居民的身心健康。

col: in someone's presence｜當著某人的面
words.tip: in someone's presence指當著某人的面。

tr: n. 合約, 婚約, 契約
vt. 使皺縮, 使縮短, 感染, 訂約, 締結
vi. 皺縮, 訂約, 收縮
def: n. a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law
n. (contract bridge) the highest bid becomes the contract setting the number of tricks that the bidder must make
n. a variety of bridge in which the bidder receives points toward game only for the number of tricks he bid

ex.en: Read the contract carefully before you agree to sign it.
ex.zh: 同意簽字之前，要仔細閱讀合同。

ex.en: A clear employment contract protects both workers and employers by defining responsibilities, working hours and payment terms.
ex.zh: 明確的勞動合同通過規定職責、工作時間和薪酬條款，保護員工和僱主雙方的權益。

words.tip: 名詞重音在前；動詞英/kənˈtrækt/，美同。

tr: a. 早先的, 前面的, 過急的
[法] 以前的, 生前的, 前述的
def: s. just preceding something else in time or order
s. too soon or too hasty
happening or existing before the time or thing being discussed

ex.en: The previous tenant left some plants on the balcony.
ex.zh: 上一位租客在陽臺上留下了幾盆植物。

ex.en: Previous studies suggest that regular physical activity can improve concentration and academic performance among school children.
ex.zh: 先前的研究表明，經常運動能提高學齡兒童的專注力和學習成績。

words.tip: previous是形容詞；表示“以前”用副詞previously。

tr: n. 條件, 條款, 費用, 價錢, 關係, 地位, 交誼
def: n status with respect to the relations between people or groups
n the amount of money needed to purchase something
n a word or expression used for some particular thing

tr: n. 容易, 靈巧, 設備
[計] 設施; 設備; 裝備
def: n. a building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry
n. a natural effortlessness
n. something designed and created to serve a particular function and to afford a particular convenience or service

ex.en: The new sports facility has a bright indoor pool.
ex.zh: 這座新體育設施裡有一個明亮的室內泳池。

ex.en: Investing in local healthcare facilities can improve access to essential services for people in rural communities.
ex.zh: 投資當地醫療設施可以讓農村社區居民更容易獲得基本服務。

col: a facility for languages｜語言天賦
words.tip: 泛指配套設施常用複數facilities。

tr: vi. 浮現, 形成, 出現, (事實)顯露
def: v. come out into view, as from concealment
v. become known or apparent
v. come up to the surface of or rise

ex.en: A small rabbit emerged from beneath the garden shed.
ex.zh: 一隻小兔子從花園棚屋底下鑽了出來。

ex.en: New employment opportunities may emerge as governments invest more heavily in renewable energy infrastructure.
ex.zh: 隨著政府加大對可再生能源基礎設施的投資，新的就業機會可能會出現。

col: emerge as a leader｜嶄露頭角成為領導者
words.tip: 不及物動詞；常用emerge from或emerge as。

tr: n. 樣品, 範例, 樣本
def: n. a small part of something intended as representative of the whole
n. all or part of a natural object that is collected and preserved as an example of its class
v. take a sample of

ex.en: The baker offered us a sample of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 麵包師給了我們一小塊新鮮麵包試吃。

ex.en: Researchers collected a representative sample of households to investigate changes in energy consumption across the region.
ex.zh: 研究人員選取了具有代表性的家庭樣本，以調查該地區能源消耗的變化。

col: sample local food｜品嚐當地食物
words.tip: sample強調從整體取出的一部分；example常用於舉例。

tr: a. 附加的, 另外的, 額外的
def: s further or added
Added to what already exists or is available.

ex.en: We need an additional chair for our guest tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚有客人來，我們需要再加一把椅子。

ex.en: Universities should provide additional financial support for students who cannot afford essential learning materials.
ex.zh: 大學應為無力購買必要學習資料的學生提供額外的經濟支持。

words.tip: 通常放在名詞前；additional costs指額外費用。

def: v. march in protest; take part in a demonstration
To show clearly that something is true or exists.
To show someone how something works or is done.

ex.en: These muddy footprints demonstrate that someone entered the kitchen.
ex.zh: 這些泥腳印表明有人進過廚房。

ex.en: Recent studies demonstrate that regular physical activity can improve concentration and support students' mental health.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，經常進行體育活動可以提高注意力，並促進學生的心理健康。

col: demonstrate a commitment to｜體現對……的投入
words.tip: 證明某事常用demonstrate that從句。

tr: vi. 答應, 從事, 交戰
vt. 使忙碌, 僱傭, 預定, 使從事於, 使參加
def: v. ask to represent; of legal counsel
v. get caught
v. carry on (wars, battles, or campaigns)

ex.en: The puppet show engaged even the youngest children.
ex.zh: 這場木偶戲連最小的孩子都吸引住了。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to engage in community activities that develop cooperation and a sense of responsibility.
ex.zh: 學校應鼓勵學生參與社區活動，培養合作能力和責任感。

col: engage with an audience｜與觀眾互動
engage someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
words.tip: 參與活動用engage in；與人互動用engage with。

def: v. declare untrue; contradict
v. refuse to accept or believe
v. refuse to grant, as of a petition or request

ex.en: She denied eating the last piece of cake.
ex.zh: 她否認吃了最後一塊蛋糕。

ex.en: No child should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 任何孩子都不應因為家庭付不起學費而被剝奪受教育的機會。

col: deny doing something｜否認做過某事
deny access to｜不準使用或進入
words.tip: 否認做某事用 deny doing，不用 deny to do。

tr: n. 遠景, 透視感, (觀察問題的)視角, 透視法, 看法, 透視圖
a. 透視的, 透視法的
def: n. the appearance of things relative to one another as determined by their distance from the viewer
A particular way of considering a situation or issue.
A drawing technique that makes objects appear realistically distant.

ex.en: Hearing her story gave me a completely different perspective.
ex.zh: 聽了她的故事，我對事情有了完全不同的看法。

ex.en: Examining urban development from residents' perspective can help planners create more inclusive and accessible public spaces.
ex.zh: 從居民的視角審視城市發展，有助於規劃者打造更具包容性、更加便利的公共空間。

col: from a different perspective｜從不同視角
put things into perspective｜客觀看待事物
a sense of perspective｜透視感；分寸感
words.tip: 從某一視角用from a perspective，不用in。

tr: n. 上下文, 背景, 來龍去脈
def: n. discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation
n. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
The circumstances surrounding an event that help explain it.

ex.en: Her silence made sense once I understood the context.
ex.zh: 瞭解背景後，我就明白她為什麼沉默了。

ex.en: Historical events should be examined in their social context rather than judged solely by contemporary standards.
ex.zh: 研究歷史事件應結合其社會背景，而非僅以當代標準評判。

col: in context｜結合背景；在語境中
words.tip: out of context指脫離語境，常用於斷章取義。

tr: n. 位置, 場所, 特定區域
def: n. a point or extent in space
n. a workplace away from a studio at which some or all of a movie may be made
The place where something is or where something happens.

ex.en: This cafe has a lovely location beside the river.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡館坐落在河邊，位置很不錯。

ex.en: The location of affordable housing strongly influences residents' access to schools, healthcare, and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 保障性住房的位置會顯著影響居民獲得教育、醫療服務和就業機會的便利程度。

words.tip: on location指在攝影棚外實地拍攝。

tr: v. 擴充, 延伸, 伸展, 擴大
def: v. make available; provide
v. reach outward in space
v. expand the influence of

ex.en: We extended our holiday because the weather was so lovely.
ex.zh: 天氣實在太好了，我們便延長了假期。

ex.en: Governments should extend public transport networks to ensure that residents of outer suburbs can access employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 政府應擴大公共交通網絡，確保遠郊居民能夠獲得就業機會。

col: extend a deadline｜延長截止期限
extend a warm welcome｜表示熱烈歡迎
words.tip: extend by接增加量；extend to接新的終點或期限。

tr: n. 地獄, 邪惡勢力, 苦境, 陰間, 毀壞, 訓斥
def: n. any place of pain and turmoil;
n. a cause of difficulty and suffering
n. (Christianity) the abode of Satan and the forces of evil; where sinners suffer eternal punishment

ex.en: The old painting showed flames rising from hell.
ex.zh: 那幅舊畫描繪了從地獄升起的火焰。

ex.en: For residents exposed to constant construction noise, daily life can become hell unless effective regulations are enforced.
ex.zh: 對持續受到施工噪聲影響的居民來說，除非有效執行監管規定，否則日常生活可能變得極其痛苦。

col: go through hell｜經歷極大痛苦
make someone's life hell｜使某人的生活苦不堪言
words.tip: 比喻義語氣強烈；作咒罵或強調語時可能冒犯他人。

tr: a. 聯合的, 團結的, 一致的, 和睦的
[法] 聯合的, 統一的, 一致的
def: a. characterized by unity; being or joined into a single entity
Working together or sharing the same aims and opinions.
Joined together to form a single group or whole.

ex.en: Our neighbours remained united despite disagreements about the garden.
ex.zh: 儘管對花園有不同意見，我們的鄰居們仍然保持團結。

ex.en: A united response from governments and communities is essential for addressing the long-term challenges of climate change.
ex.zh: 政府與社區一致行動，對於應對氣候變化帶來的長期挑戰至關重要。

words.tip: be united in後接共同立場；united front指一致陣線。

tr: n. 否定, 否定語, 負數, 底片
a. 否定的, 消極的, 負的, 陰性的
def: n. a reply of denial
n. a piece of photographic film showing an image with light and shade or colors reversed
a. characterized by or displaying negation or denial or opposition or resistance; having no positive features

ex.en: Her negative comments made me doubt my cooking skills.
ex.zh: 她的負面評價讓我懷疑自己的廚藝。

ex.en: Heavy reliance on private cars can have negative effects on air quality and public health.
ex.zh: 過度依賴私家車可能對空氣質量和公眾健康產生不利影響。

col: test negative for｜檢測結果為陰性
words.tip: 檢測結果為negative指未檢出，並非結果不好。

tr: a. 歷史的, 史實的, 歷史上的
def: a. of or relating to the study of history
s. having once lived or existed or taken place in the real world as distinct from being legendary
connected with history or events in the past

ex.en: We found historical photographs of our street in the library.
ex.zh: 我們在圖書館找到了這條街過去的照片。

ex.en: Historical records help researchers understand how earlier societies responded to environmental change and economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 歷史記錄幫助研究人員瞭解過去的社會如何應對環境變化和經濟不確定性。

words.tip: historical指與歷史有關；historic強調具有歷史意義。

tr: n. 發現, 發現物, 決定, 裁決
[法] 調查結果, 對事實的認定, 判定的要素
def: n. the decision of a court on issues of fact or law
n. something that is found
Information discovered through research or an investigation.

ex.en: The doctor's findings explained why I felt so tired.
ex.zh: 醫生的檢查結果解釋了我為什麼這麼疲倦。

ex.en: The findings indicate that affordable public transport can significantly improve access to employment in disadvantaged areas.
ex.zh: 研究結果表明，價格實惠的公共交通能顯著改善弱勢地區居民的就業機會。

col: publish the findings｜公佈調查結果
a finding of fact｜事實認定
words.tip: 表示研究或調查結果時，常用複數findings。

tr: n. 抓握, 掠奪, 強佔, 東方沿岸帆船
vt. 攫取, 捕獲, 霸佔
def: n. a mechanical device for gripping an object
v. make a grasping or snatching motion with the hand
v. obtain illegally or unscrupulously

ex.en: She grabbed her umbrella and ran towards the bus.
ex.zh: 她抓起雨傘，朝公交車跑去。

ex.en: Public health campaigns often use striking images to grab attention and encourage people to change unhealthy habits.
ex.zh: 公共衛生宣傳常用醒目的圖片吸引注意，鼓勵人們改變不健康的習慣。

col: grab someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
grab a bite｜匆忙吃點東西
words.tip: grab較口語化；過去式grabbed，分詞grabbing。

tr: n. 聯繫, 交際, 熟人, 接觸
def: n. close interaction
n. the act of touching physically
n. the state or condition of touching or of being in immediate proximity

ex.en: Please contact the receptionist if you lose your key.
ex.zh: 如果你丟了鑰匙，請聯繫接待員。

ex.en: Regular contact with family members can reduce loneliness among older people who live alone.
ex.zh: 經常與家人聯繫可以減輕獨居老年人的孤獨感。

col: keep in contact with｜與……保持聯繫
words.tip: 動詞contact直接接人，不加with；名詞後可加with。

tr: n. 民主政治, 民主主義
[法] 民主, 民主政治, 民主政體
def: n. the political orientation of those who favor government by the people or by their elected representatives
n. a political system in which the supreme power lies in a body of citizens who can elect people to represent them
A system of government in which people choose their leaders.

ex.en: Our teacher explained democracy through a classroom vote.
ex.zh: 老師通過一次班級投票向我們解釋了民主。

ex.en: A healthy democracy depends on informed citizens who can access reliable information and participate freely in public debate.
ex.zh: 健全的民主制度依賴於知情的公民，他們能夠獲取可靠信息並自由參與公共討論。

words.tip: 指制度通常不可數；指民主國家可數。

tr: a. 家庭的, 國內的, 馴養的
def: n. a servant who is paid to perform menial tasks around the household
a. of concern to or concerning the internal affairs of a nation
a. of or relating to the home

ex.en: We took a domestic flight to the northern coast.
ex.zh: 我們乘坐國內航班去了北部海岸。

ex.en: Investment in domestic food production can reduce a country's dependence on imports and strengthen its economy.
ex.zh: 投資國內糧食生產可以減少一國對進口的依賴，並增強其經濟實力。

words.tip: 與international相對指國內的；與wild相對指家養的。

tr: a. 社團的, 合夥的, 公司的
[經] 團體的, 法人的, 社團的
def: a. of or belonging to a corporation
s. done by or characteristic of individuals acting together
s. organized and maintained as a legal corporation

ex.en: My sister handles corporate travel for a small company.
ex.zh: 我姐姐為一家小公司安排商務差旅。

ex.en: Greater corporate transparency allows consumers to assess whether businesses genuinely meet their environmental and social commitments.
ex.zh: 提高企業透明度能讓消費者判斷企業是否真正履行了環境和社會承諾。

words.tip: corporate指企業的；cooperative指合作的。

tr: a. 教育的, 教育性的
def: a. relating to the process of education
s. providing knowledge

tr: n. 喜歡的事物, 幸運兒
a. 特別受喜愛的, 喜愛的, 寵愛的, 中意的
def: n. something regarded with special favor or liking
s. appealing to the general public
Liked or preferred more than others

ex.en: This blue sweater is my favorite winter item.
ex.zh: 這件藍色毛衣是我冬天最喜歡的一件衣服。

ex.en: Surveys of children's favorite leisure activities can help local authorities design more appealing public recreation spaces.
ex.zh: 調查兒童最喜歡的休閒活動，有助於地方政府設計更有吸引力的公共休閒空間。

col: a favorite pastime｜最喜愛的消遣
a firm favorite｜一直備受喜愛的人或物
the clear favorite to win｜明顯的奪冠熱門
words.tip: favorite是美式拼寫，英式為favourite；通常不用most修飾。

tr: n. 嵌板, 儀表板, 專題討論小組, 全體陪審員
def: n. sheet that forms a distinct (usually flat and rectangular) section or component of something
n. (law) a group of people summoned for jury service (from whom a jury will be chosen)
n. a group of people gathered for a special purpose as to plan or discuss an issue or judge a contest etc

ex.en: The panel listened carefully as each student presented an idea.
ex.zh: 每位學生陳述想法時，評審小組都認真傾聽。

ex.en: An independent panel should assess the environmental impact of major construction projects before work begins.
ex.zh: 獨立專家組應在重大建設項目開工前評估其環境影響。

col: a panel of experts｜專家小組
words.tip: 專家組用a panel of experts；成員稱panellist。

tr: n. 教學, 學說, 教導
def: n. the profession of a teacher
n. a doctrine that is taught
The work of helping people learn knowledge or skills.

ex.en: Her love of teaching began at a small village school.
ex.zh: 她對教學的熱愛始於一所小鄉村學校。

ex.en: Effective teaching should combine clear explanations with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge independently.
ex.zh: 有效的教學應將清晰的講解與實踐活動結合起來，鼓勵學生獨立運用知識。

col: a career in teaching｜教師職業生涯
words.tip: 指教學時不可數；指教義或學說常用teachings。

tr: a. 地方的, 地域性的
def: a. characteristic of a region
s. related or limited to a particular region
Relating to a particular area within a country or world.

ex.en: The market sells regional cheeses made in nearby villages.
ex.zh: 這個市場出售附近村莊製作的地方特色奶酪。

ex.en: Regional differences in employment opportunities often encourage young adults to move from rural communities to larger cities.
ex.zh: 就業機會的地區差異往往促使年輕人從農村社區遷往大城市。

words.tip: regional範圍通常比local大，比national小。

tr: n. 蹤跡, 痕跡, 一串, 尾部, 小徑, 持槍姿勢
vt. 拖, 尾隨, 追蹤, 落後於, 開出路
vi. 拖曳, 垂下, 落後, 飄出, 蔓生
def: n. a track or mark left by something that has passed
n. a path or track roughly blazed through wild or hilly country
v. move, proceed, or walk draggingly or slowly

ex.en: We followed a narrow trail through the pine forest.
ex.zh: 我們沿著一條狹窄的小徑穿過鬆林。

ex.en: Maintaining walking trails can encourage outdoor recreation while protecting fragile habitats from uncontrolled visitor access.
ex.zh: 維護步行小徑既能鼓勵戶外休閒，也能避免遊客隨意進入脆弱的棲息地。

col: a trail of footprints｜一串腳印
words.tip: trail作名詞可指小徑或痕跡；trail behind指落在後面。

tr: n. 代碼, 密碼, 法規, 法典
def: n. a set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones)
n. a coding system used for transmitting messages requiring brevity or secrecy
n. (computer science) the symbolic arrangement of data or instructions in a computer program or the set of such instructions

ex.en: I forgot the code for my bicycle lock again.
ex.zh: 我又忘了自行車鎖的密碼。

ex.en: Teaching students to write code can strengthen problem-solving skills and prepare them for a changing job market.
ex.zh: 教學生編寫代碼可以增強解決問題的能力，幫助他們適應不斷變化的就業市場。

words.tip: 程序代碼通常不可數；一組密碼可說a code。

def: r. in some unspecified way or manner; or by some unspecified means
r. for some unspecified reason;

tr: n. 陪審團, 評判委員會
def: n. a body of citizens sworn to give a true verdict according to the evidence presented in a court of law
n. a committee appointed to judge a competition
a group that decides facts in a court case

ex.en: The jury listened carefully as the witness described the accident.
ex.zh: 證人描述事故經過時，陪審團認真聆聽。

ex.en: Serving on a jury allows ordinary citizens to participate directly in the administration of justice.
ex.zh: 擔任陪審員讓普通公民能夠直接參與司法工作。

col: serve on a jury｜擔任陪審員
words.tip: jury指整個陪審團；單個陪審員叫juror。

tr: n. 最佳部分, 初期, 全盛期
a. 主要的, 最初的, 根本的
v. 加油啟動, 灌注, 填裝
def: n. a number that has no factor but itself and 1
n. the second canonical hour; about 6 a.m.
n. the time of maturity when power and vigor are greatest

ex.en: Our prime concern is getting everyone home safely tonight.
ex.zh: 我們最關心的是今晚讓所有人安全到家。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is a prime requirement for cities seeking to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 對於希望減少私家車依賴的城市而言，可靠的公共交通是一項首要需求。

col: in your prime｜處於鼎盛時期
words.tip: a prime example指典型例子，不是第一個例子。

tr: n. 變化, 移動, 輪班, 手段, 應急辦法, 移位
vt. 替換, 轉移, 改變, 推卸, 變速
vi. 轉換, 移動, 轉變, 推託, 變速
[計] DOS內部命令:該命令可將批處理參數向左移動一個位置
def: n. an event in which something is displaced without rotation
n. the time period during which you are at work
n. the act of moving from one place to another

ex.en: We shifted the sofa closer to the window.
ex.zh: 我們把沙發往窗邊挪了挪。

ex.en: Governments should shift investment towards public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 政府應將投資轉向公共交通，以緩解交通擁堵和城市空氣汙染。

col: a shift in attitudes｜態度的轉變
words.tip: shift作名詞可指變化，也可指工作班次。

tr: n. 收入, 歲入, 稅收, 稅務局
[經] 歲入, 稅收, 稅務局
def: n the entire amount of income before any deductions are made
n government income due to taxation

tr: vt. 產生, 發生, 導致
def: v. bring into existence
v. produce (energy)
Cause something to exist or happen.

ex.en: Our weekend bake sale generated enough money for new books.
ex.zh: 我們週末的糕點義賣籌到了足夠買新書的錢。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can generate employment while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投資可再生能源可以創造就業機會，同時減少對進口化石燃料的依賴。

words.tip: 及物動詞，可接電力、收入、興趣、想法等賓語。

tr: vt. 計劃, 打算, 建議, 提議, 求(婚)
def: v. make a proposal, declare a plan for something
v. ask (someone) to marry you
Suggest an idea or plan for others to consider.

ex.en: I proposed sharing a taxi to save us money.
ex.zh: 我提議合乘一輛出租車，給大家省點錢。

ex.en: Researchers propose expanding urban green spaces to improve air quality and encourage residents to exercise more regularly.
ex.zh: 研究人員提議擴大城市綠地，以改善空氣質量並鼓勵居民更經常地鍛鍊。

col: propose a solution｜提出解決方案
words.tip: propose doing是提議；propose to do通常是打算。

tr: v. 借, 供應貨款, 借給
def: n. the temporary provision of money (usually at interest)
money borrowed and expected to be paid back
the temporary use of something belonging to someone else

ex.en: We took out a loan to repair the roof.
ex.zh: 我們申請了一筆貸款來修屋頂。

ex.en: Affordable student loans can widen access to university, although repayment may create financial pressure after graduation.
ex.zh: 負擔得起的學生貸款可以擴大大學入學機會，但畢業後的還款可能帶來經濟壓力。

col: take out a loan｜申請貸款
words.tip: loan作動詞意為借出，不是借入。

tr: n. 概念, 觀念, 想法, 打算, 別緻的小東西
[經] 概念, 打算, 想法
def: n. a general inclusive concept
n. an odd or fanciful or capricious idea
n. (usually plural) small personal articles or clothing or sewing items

tr: n. 抓取, 戰利品, 捕獲之物
vt. 抓取, 獲得, 迷住
def: n. the act of forcibly dispossessing an owner of property
n. a process whereby a star or planet holds an object in its gravitational field
n. any process in which an atomic or nuclear system acquires an additional particle

ex.en: Rescuers captured the injured bird and gently examined its wing.
ex.zh: 救援人員捉住那隻受傷的鳥，輕輕檢查了它的翅膀。

ex.en: Wildlife researchers use remote cameras to capture animal behaviour without disturbing natural habitats.
ex.zh: 野生動物研究人員使用遙控攝像機記錄動物行為，避免干擾自然棲息地。

words.tip: 拍攝影像、捕捉氣氛也可用capture。

tr: a. 內在的, 國內的
def: a. happening or arising or located within some limits or especially surface
s. occurring within an institution or community

tr: a. 人種的, 種族的
def: n. a person who is a member of an ethnic group

tr: n. 環境, 背景, 佈景, 鑲嵌, 調整, 沉落, 一副餐具
def: n. the context and environment in which something is set
n. the state of the environment in which a situation exists
n. the physical position of something

ex.en: The lakeside garden provides a peaceful setting for lunch.
ex.zh: 湖邊的花園為午餐提供了寧靜的環境。

ex.en: Children often develop stronger communication skills in a supportive educational setting that encourages cooperation rather than competition.
ex.zh: 在鼓勵合作而非競爭的支持性教育環境中，兒童通常能培養出更強的溝通能力。

words.tip: 環境義常用in a setting；設備設置常用複數settings。

tr: n. 下水, 汽艇, 發射
vt. 使下水, 發射, 發動
vi. 起飛, 下水, 投入, 開始
def: n. a motorboat with an open deck or a half deck
v. propel with force
v. launch for the first time; launch on a maiden voyage

ex.en: Our local bakery launched a new delivery service yesterday.
ex.zh: 我們當地的麵包店昨天推出了新的送貨服務。

ex.en: Schools should launch awareness campaigns to encourage healthier eating habits and reduce food waste among students.
ex.zh: 學校應開展宣傳活動，鼓勵學生養成更健康的飲食習慣，並減少食物浪費。

words.tip: 推出產品、發起活動和發射衛星都可用launch。

tr: n. 範圍, 程度, 區域
def: n. the point or degree to which something extends
n. the distance or area or volume over which something extends
How much something happens or how far it reaches.

ex.en: We only discovered the extent of the leak yesterday.
ex.zh: 我們昨天才發現漏水有多嚴重。

ex.en: The extent to which public transport reduces pollution depends on passenger numbers and energy sources.
ex.zh: 公共交通能在多大程度上減少汙染，取決於乘客數量和能源來源。

col: to some extent｜在某種程度上
the full extent of｜……的全部程度或範圍
to a large extent｜在很大程度上
words.tip: 表示“在某種程度上”用to some extent。

tr: n. 差別, 對比, 對照物
def: n. the opposition or dissimilarity of things that are compared
n. the act of distinguishing by comparing differences
n. the perceptual effect of the juxtaposition of very different colors

tr: [法] 最後, 終究, 總之
def: r. as the end result of a succession or process
in the end, after a series of events
when considering the most important underlying fact

ex.en: We explored several flats but ultimately chose this small house.
ex.zh: 我們看了好幾套公寓，但最終選了這棟小房子。

ex.en: Although technology can support classroom learning, educational success ultimately depends on effective teaching and student engagement.
ex.zh: 雖然技術可以輔助課堂學習，但教育成效歸根結底取決於有效教學和學生參與。

col: ultimately depend on｜歸根結底取決於
words.tip: 強調最終結果或根本因素，不用於列舉中的最後一項。

tr: n. 容量, 能力, 才能, 資格
def: n. capability to perform or produce
n. the amount that can be contained
n. the maximum production possible

ex.en: This small lift has a capacity of six people.
ex.zh: 這部小電梯最多能容納六個人。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can expand electricity generation capacity while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投資可再生能源可以擴大發電能力，同時減少對進口化石燃料的依賴。

col: in a professional capacity｜以專業人士身份
words.tip: 能力用capacity to do；身份用in one's capacity as。

tr: n. 不動產, (人生的)階段, 階層, 財產
[經] 房地產, 遺產, 財產
def: n. everything you own; all of your assets (whether real property or personal property) and liabilities
n. extensive landed property (especially in the country) retained by the owner for his own use
A large area of owned land, often with a large house.

ex.en: We walked past the lake on the old country estate.
ex.zh: 我們步行經過那座古老鄉間莊園裡的湖泊。

ex.en: New housing estates should include green spaces and reliable transport links to nearby employment centres.
ex.zh: 新建住宅區應配備綠地，以及通往附近就業中心的可靠交通連接。

words.tip: real estate指房地產；housing estate指住宅區。

tr: n. 外科, 手術, 手術室, 換球術
def: n. the branch of medical science that treats disease or injury by operative procedures
n. a room where a doctor or dentist can be consulted
Medical treatment involving cutting into the body to repair damage.

ex.en: My uncle is recovering well after knee surgery.
ex.zh: 我叔叔做完膝關節手術後恢復得很好。

ex.en: Advances in medical technology have made many types of surgery safer and reduced patients' recovery times.
ex.zh: 醫療技術的進步提高了多種手術的安全性，並縮短了患者的康復時間。

words.tip: 手術義通常不可數；英式英語中診所義可數。

tr: vt. 估計, 評價, 判斷
def: n. an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth
n. a judgment of the qualities of something or somebody
n. a statement indicating the likely cost of some job

ex.en: We estimate the repairs will take about three days.
ex.zh: 我們估計維修大約需要三天。

ex.en: Researchers estimate that improved public transport could significantly reduce the number of cars entering city centres.
ex.zh: 研究人員估計，改善公共交通可顯著減少進入市中心的汽車數量。

words.tip: 動詞末尾讀/eɪt/；名詞末尾讀/ət/。

def: v. investigate scientifically
v. conduct an inquiry or investigation of
To examine facts carefully to discover what happened or why.

ex.en: A plumber came to investigate the strange noise upstairs.
ex.zh: 一位水管工來查明樓上怪聲的原因。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces affects the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人員正在探究接觸綠地如何影響城市居民的心理健康。

words.tip: 直接接調查對象：investigate the problem，不加into。

tr: n. 移動, 手勢, 動作, 意向, 請求, 提議
def: n. a change of position that does not entail a change of location
n. a state of change
n. a formal proposal for action made to a deliberative assembly for discussion and vote

ex.en: The gentle motion of the boat made me sleepy.
ex.zh: 小船輕輕搖晃，讓我昏昏欲睡。

ex.en: The council passed a motion to improve public transport and reduce traffic in residential areas.
ex.zh: 議會通過了一項動議，旨在改善公共交通並減少住宅區的車流。

words.tip: 動議可用pass或reject；in motion表示在運動中。

def: n. a grammatical category in inflected languages governing the agreement between nouns and pronouns and adjectives; in some languages it is quite arbitrary but in Indo-European languages it is usually based on sex or animateness
Being male, female, or another identity, especially socially and culturally.
A grammatical class of nouns affecting related word forms.

ex.en: The club welcomes everyone, regardless of age or gender.
ex.zh: 這個俱樂部歡迎所有人加入，不論年齡或性別。

ex.en: Policies promoting gender equality can improve access to education and expand employment opportunities across society.
ex.zh: 促進性別平等的政策可以改善受教育機會，並擴大整個社會的就業機會。

words.tip: gender常側重社會性別；sex常側重生理性別。

tr: vt. 解決, 付給, 溶解
def: v. find the solution to (a problem or question) or understand the meaning of
Find an answer to a problem or mystery

ex.en: We solved the puzzle together after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚飯後，我們一起解開了那道謎題。

ex.en: Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通有助於解決快速發展城區的交通問題。

words.tip: solve直接接問題；“溶解”用dissolve。

tr: n. 風景, 山水, 風景畫
def: n. an expanse of scenery that can be seen in a single view
n. painting depicting an expanse of natural scenery
n. a genre of art dealing with the depiction of natural scenery

ex.en: Snow covered the landscape beyond our small wooden cabin.
ex.zh: 白雪覆蓋了我們小木屋外的山野。

ex.en: Large wind farms can alter the rural landscape, although they provide an important source of clean energy.
ex.zh: 大型風電場雖然是重要的清潔能源來源，卻可能改變鄉村景觀。

words.tip: landscape可數，指一片景觀；scenery通常不可數。

tr: vt. 除去, 排除, 剔除, 消除
def: v. kill in large numbers
v. remove from a contest or race
v. remove (an unknown variable) from two or more equations

ex.en: This water filter eliminates unpleasant smells from tap water.
ex.zh: 這個淨水器能去除自來水中的異味。

ex.en: Improved public transport could eliminate the need for many urban residents to own a private car.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以使許多城市居民不再需要擁有私家車。

col: eliminate the need for｜消除對……的需要
eliminate a possibility｜排除一種可能性
be eliminated from a competition｜在比賽中被淘汰
words.tip: 比reduce更徹底，強調完全去除或排除。

tr: n. 政權, 當權期間, 政體, 社會制度, 體制, 情態
def: n the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
n (medicine) a systematic plan for therapy (often including diet)
a government or system of government, especially an authoritarian one

ex.en: The new regime promised to reopen the public library.
ex.zh: 新政權承諾重新開放公共圖書館。

ex.en: An authoritarian regime may restrict public debate, making it harder for citizens to influence government decisions.
ex.zh: 威權政權可能限制公共討論，使公民更難影響政府決策。

words.tip: 指政權時常含貶義；也可指稅制或鍛鍊安排。

tr: n. 易變的事物, 變數, 可變物, 變量
a. 可變的, 不定的, 易變的, 變量的
def: n. something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation
n. a quantity that can assume any of a set of values
n. a symbol (like x or y) that is used in mathematical or logical expressions to represent a variable quantity

ex.en: The weather here is too variable for outdoor plans.
ex.zh: 這裡天氣太多變，不好安排戶外活動。

ex.en: Researchers must control other variables when investigating how class size affects students' progress in primary education.
ex.zh: 研究班級規模如何影響小學生的學習進步時，研究人員必須控制其他變量。

words.tip: 作形容詞指可變的；作可數名詞指變量。

tr: n. 知覺, 感覺, 領悟力, 獲取
def: n. a way of conceiving something
n. the process of perceiving
n. knowledge gained by perceiving
n. a feeling of trust (in someone or something)
n. a state of confident hopefulness that events will be favorable
n. a trustful relationship

ex.en: Practising with friends gave me confidence before the interview.
ex.zh: 和朋友一起練習讓我在面試前有了信心。

ex.en: Supportive feedback can build students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 鼓勵性的反饋可以增強學生的自信，促使他們更積極地參與課堂討論。

col: confidence in someone｜對某人的信任
words.tip: 對某人或某事有信心用confidence in。

tr: n. 覆蓋的範圍, 保險總額, 新聞報導
[化] 可達範圍; 覆蓋度
def: n. the total amount and type of insurance carried
n. the extent to which something is covered
n. the news as presented by reporters for newspapers or radio or television
r to a small degree or extent
r to a moderately sufficient extent or degree
To a limited degree; rather, but not very.

ex.en: I felt somewhat nervous before my first driving lesson.
ex.zh: 第一次上駕駛課之前，我有點緊張。

ex.en: Although online learning offers flexibility, its effectiveness remains somewhat dependent on students' motivation and access to technology.
ex.zh: 儘管在線學習提供了靈活性，其效果仍在一定程度上取決於學生的積極性和技術使用條件。

words.tip: 比a bit正式，常用於緩和判斷或語氣。

tr: n. 授予, 授予物, 允許
vt. 允許, 承認, 授與
def: n. any monetary aid
n. the act of providing a subsidy
n. (law) a transfer of property by deed of conveyance

ex.en: A small grant helped us repair the village playground.
ex.zh: 一筆小額補助金幫助我們修好了村裡的遊樂場。

ex.en: Governments should provide research grants to universities developing affordable technologies for reducing household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 政府應向研發低成本家庭節能技術的大學提供研究撥款。

col: apply for a grant｜申請補助金
take something for granted｜認為某事理所當然
words.tip: grant sb sth可改為grant sth to sb。

tr: a. 工業的, 供工業用的, 工業高度發展的, 產業的
n. 工業工人, 工業股票
def: a. of or relating to or resulting from industry
a. having highly developed industries
s. employed in industry

ex.en: My uncle repairs industrial machines at a nearby factory.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在附近的一家工廠維修工業機器。

ex.en: Stricter controls on industrial waste can protect rivers and improve the health of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 加強對工業廢物的管控可以保護河流，並改善附近社區居民的健康。

words.tip: industrial指工業的；industrious才指勤勞的。

tr: n. 伸展, 張開, 連綿, 一段路, 一段時間
a. 可伸縮的, 彈性的
vt. 伸展, 張開, 曲解, 使過度伸展
def: n. a large and unbroken expanse or distance
n. a straightaway section of a racetrack
n. exercise designed to extend the limbs and muscles to their full extent

tr: n. 冊, 卷, 體積, 容量, 大量, 許多, 份量, 音量
def: n. the amount of 3-dimensional space occupied by an object
n. a publication that is one of a set of several similar publications
n. a relative amount

ex.en: Please turn the volume down while the baby sleeps.
ex.zh: 寶寶睡覺時請把音量調低。

ex.en: The growing volume of household waste highlights the need for better recycling facilities in urban areas.
ex.zh: 不斷增加的生活垃圾量凸顯了城市地區改善回收設施的必要性。

col: a high volume of traffic｜很大的交通流量
turn down the volume｜調低音量
words.tip: volume可指體積、總量或音量；面積用area。

tr: n. 流行, 風尚, 時樣
vt. 形成, 造, 作
def: n. characteristic or habitual practice
n. the latest and most admired style in clothes and cosmetics and behavior
n. consumer goods (especially clothing) in the current mode

ex.en: My sister follows fashion but rarely buys expensive clothes.
ex.zh: 我姐姐關注時尚，但很少買昂貴的衣服。

ex.en: The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.
ex.zh: 時裝行業可以通過生產耐穿的衣服和使用回收材料來減少對環境的影響。

col: in a similar fashion｜以類似的方式
words.tip: 表方式時常用in a ... fashion，語氣較正式。

tr: n. 插入, 介入, 調停
def: n. the act of intervening (as to mediate a dispute, etc.)
n. a policy of intervening in the affairs of other countries

n. (law) a proceeding that permits a person to enter into a lawsuit already in progress; admission of person not an original party to the suit so that person can protect some right or interest that is allegedly affected by the proceedings

tr: vt. 引用, 引證, 表彰
def: n a short note recognizing a source of information or of a quoted passage
v make reference to
v commend

ex.en: Please cite the book you used for your project.
ex.zh: 請註明你做項目時參考的那本書。

ex.en: Researchers often cite access to green spaces as an important factor in improving urban residents' mental health.
ex.zh: 研究人員經常指出，能否方便地使用綠地是改善城市居民心理健康的重要因素。

col: cite as a reason｜列為理由
words.tip: cite是引用；site是地點；sight是視力，三者同音。

tr: n. 進步, 改善, 利用
[醫] 改善, 好轉, 進步
def: n. a change for the better; progress in development
n. the act of improving something
n. a condition superior to an earlier condition

ex.en: Your latest drawing shows a real improvement in shading.
ex.zh: 你最近這幅畫的明暗處理確實有進步。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can bring significant improvements in air quality and reduce travel times for urban residents.
ex.zh: 投資公共交通能顯著改善空氣質量，並縮短城市居民的出行時間。

col: an improvement on｜比…更好的事物
words.tip: 某方面的改善用 in；比原來更好用 an improvement on。

tr: a. 全部的, 全體的, 從頭至尾的, 一切在內的
adv. 從頭到尾, 總的說來
def: n. (usually plural) work clothing consisting of denim trousers (usually with a bib and shoulder straps)
n. a loose protective coverall or smock worn over ordinary clothing for dirty work
s. involving only main features

ex.en: The overall cost includes breakfast and a train ticket.
ex.zh: 總費用包括早餐和一張火車票。

ex.en: Overall, investment in public transport can reduce urban congestion while improving access to employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 總體而言，投資公共交通可以緩解城市擁堵，同時讓人們更方便地獲得就業機會。

words.tip: 形容詞放名詞前；副詞可放句首概括整體情況。

tr: n. 路徑, 途徑, 路線
vt. 確定路線, 按規定路線發送
[計] 傳遞, 路由設定程序
def: v. send documents or materials to appropriate destinations
v. send via a specific route
v. divert in a specified direction

ex.en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我們換了一條路線回家，以避開擁堵。

ex.en: Expanding bus routes to rural communities would improve access to employment and essential public services.
ex.zh: 將公交線路延伸至農村社區，有助於居民獲得就業機會和基本公共服務。

words.tip: 美式也讀 /raʊt/；route 強調行進路線。

tr: n. 要素, 要點, 本質
a. 必要的, 重要的, 本質的
def: s. absolutely necessary; vitally necessary
a. basic and fundamental
a. being or relating to or containing the essence of a plant etc

ex.en: A warm coat is essential for this winter walk.
ex.zh: 這次冬日散步必須穿一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
ex.zh: 獲得清潔飲用水對預防疾病和改善公共衛生至關重要。

col: essential for survival｜生存所必需的
words.tip: 名詞常用複數 essentials，表示必需品或基本要點。

tr: n. 解析, 決心, 堅定, 決定, 決議, 消除, 解答, 分解
def: n. a formal expression by a meeting; agreed to by a vote
n. finding a solution to a problem
n. analysis into clear-cut components
r. only a very short time before
Only just; almost not
No more than a small amount or a particular limit

ex.en: I could barely hear her above the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 雨聲太大，我幾乎聽不清她說話。

ex.en: Many low-income households can barely afford basic necessities, leaving little money for education or preventive healthcare.
ex.zh: 許多低收入家庭勉強負擔得起基本生活必需品，幾乎沒有餘錢用於教育或預防保健。

words.tip: 本身含否定意義，通常不再與not連用。

tr: n. 扇形, 部門, 部分, 函數尺, 象限儀, 段, 區段
[計] 扇面; 扇區; 段; 區段
def: n. a plane figure bounded by two radii and the included arc of a circle
n. a social group that forms part of the society or the economy
n. a particular aspect of life or activity

ex.en: My sister works in the banking sector now.
ex.zh: 我姐姐現在在銀行業工作。

ex.en: Investment in the renewable energy sector can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投資可再生能源行業可以創造就業，同時減少對進口化石燃料的依賴。

words.tip: sector常指經濟中的某個行業，不一定是公司部門。

tr: vt. 強調, 加強語氣, 著重
def: v to stress, single out as important
v give extra weight to (a communication)

tr: n. 才能, 能力, 全體教員, (大學的)系
def: n. one of the inherent cognitive or perceptual powers of the mind
A university division covering a particular group of subjects.
The teaching staff of a university, college, or school.

ex.en: The science faculty has moved into a new building.
ex.zh: 理學院已搬進一棟新樓。

ex.en: Cooperation between the faculty of engineering and local industries can help students develop skills relevant to employment.
ex.zh: 工程學院與當地產業的合作可以幫助學生培養與就業相關的技能。

words.tip: 英式常指大學院系，美式常指全體教員。

tr: a. 慷慨的, 不拘泥的, 寬大的, 自由主義的
def: n. a person who favors a political philosophy of progress and reform and the protection of civil liberties
n. a person who favors an economic theory of laissez-faire and self-regulating markets
s. having political or social views favoring reform and progress

ex.en: My parents are liberal about what clothes I wear.
ex.zh: 父母對我的穿著很開明。

ex.en: A liberal society should protect individual freedoms while encouraging citizens to respect the rights of others.
ex.zh: 自由開放的社會應保護個人自由，同時鼓勵公民尊重他人的權利。

words.tip: 政治含義隨國家而異；也可表示開明或用量充足。

tr: a. 巨大的, 龐大的
def: s. extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree; that a whole civilization should be dependent on technology"- Walter Lippman
extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一個巨大的南瓜佔滿了廚房桌上的籃子。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速發展給住房、交通網絡及其他基本公共服務帶來巨大壓力。

words.tip: 既可形容體積，也可形容壓力、數量或影響很大。

tr: a. 大而重的, 寬大的, 宏偉的
[醫] 大塊的, 整塊的, 大量的
def: s. imposing in size or bulk or solidity
s. being the same substance throughout
s. imposing in scale or scope or degree or power

ex.en: A massive oak tree shades our entire garden.
ex.zh: 一棵巨大的橡樹為我們整個花園遮陰。

ex.en: The transition to renewable energy requires massive investment in infrastructure and training for workers.
ex.zh: 向可再生能源轉型需要在基礎設施和工人培訓方面投入大量資金。

words.tip: 既可形容體積巨大，也可形容投入或變化程度極大。

tr: vt. 投資, 花費, 籠罩, 授予
def: v. make an investment
v. furnish with power or authority; of kings or emperors
v. provide with power and authority

ex.en: My aunt plans to invest in a small bakery.
ex.zh: 我姑姑打算投資一家小麵包店。

ex.en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to improve energy security and reduce dependence on imported fuels.
ex.zh: 政府應投資可再生能源，以提高能源安全並減少對進口燃料的依賴。

words.tip: 常用invest in；投入時間做事可用invest time in doing。

tr: n. 電纜, 海底電報, 纜, 索
vt. 發海底電報, 縛住
def: n. a telegram sent abroad
n. a conductor for transmitting electrical or optical signals or electric power
n. a very strong thick rope made of twisted hemp or steel wire

ex.en: The charging cable was tangled beneath my desk.
ex.zh: 充電線在我的書桌下面纏成了一團。

ex.en: Undersea cable networks carry vast amounts of data, making them essential infrastructure for international communication and trade.
ex.zh: 海底電纜網絡傳輸大量數據，是國際通信和貿易不可或缺的基礎設施。

words.tip: 既可傳電或信號，也可指承重用的鋼纜。

tr: a. 鄉下的, 田園的, 鄉村風味的
[法] 農村的, 鄉村的, 有關農業的
def: a. living in or characteristic of farming or country life
a. of or relating to the countryside as opposed to the city
Relating to the countryside rather than towns or cities.

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet rural village.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在一個安靜的鄉村。

ex.en: Reliable internet access can improve educational opportunities for children living in remote rural areas.
ex.zh: 穩定的互聯網連接可以改善偏遠農村地區兒童的教育機會。

words.tip: rural修飾鄉村事物，urban修飾城市事物。

def: n. law enacted by a legislative body
n. the act of making or enacting laws
n. a parliamentary monarchy in southwestern Europe on the Iberian Peninsula; a former colonial power
a country in southwestern Europe

ex.en: We travelled around Spain by train last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，我們乘火車遊覽了西班牙。

ex.en: Spain attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed tourism infrastructure.
ex.zh: 西班牙憑藉文化遺產、多樣的景觀和完善的旅遊基礎設施吸引國際遊客。

col: travel to Spain｜前往西班牙旅行
words.tip: 國名首字母大寫，前面通常不加the。

def: n. the act of someone who fishes as a diversion
n. the occupation of catching fish for a living
the activity of catching fish for pleasure or food

ex.en: We went fishing by the lake before breakfast.
ex.zh: 早飯前，我們去湖邊釣魚了。

ex.en: Strict limits on commercial fishing can help marine ecosystems recover and support coastal communities in the long term.
ex.zh: 嚴格限制商業捕魚能幫助海洋生態系統恢復，並長期支持沿海社區的生計。

words.tip: 說“去釣魚”用go fishing，不用go to fishing。

def: r. in essence or effect but not in fact
Almost completely, or in every important practical way.
Using computers rather than being physically present.

ex.en: The fridge was virtually empty when we got home.
ex.zh: 我們到家時，冰箱裡幾乎空了。

ex.en: Online courses have made educational resources accessible from virtually any location with an internet connection.
ex.zh: 在線課程使人們幾乎在任何有網絡連接的地方都能獲取教育資源。

words.tip: 常指“幾乎”，不等於表示真實情況的actually。

tr: n. 校園, 大學生活
def: n. a field on which the buildings of a university are situated
the grounds and buildings belonging to a university or college

ex.en: We found a quiet bench near the campus library.
ex.zh: 我們在校園圖書館附近找到了一張安靜的長椅。

ex.en: Providing affordable accommodation on campus can help students spend less time commuting and more time studying.
ex.zh: 提供價格合理的校內住宿可以幫助學生減少通勤時間，增加學習時間。

words.tip: 表示“在校園內”通常用on campus，不加冠詞。

tr: a. 移入的, 移民的
def: n. a person who comes to a country where they were not born in order to settle there

tr: n. 專欄, 圓柱, 縱隊, 列, 柱形物
def: n. a line of units following one after another

n. a vertical glass tube used in column chromatography; a mixture is poured in the top and washed through a stationary substance where components of the mixture are adsorbed selectively to form colored bands
n. a vertical array of numbers or other information

ex.en: Put the prices in the column beside each item.
ex.zh: 把價格填在每件商品旁邊的那一列裡。

ex.en: The newspaper's weekly science column helps readers understand how new discoveries may affect everyday life.
ex.zh: 這家報紙每週的科學專欄幫助讀者瞭解新發現可能如何影響日常生活。

col: a column of figures｜一列數字
words.tip: column 是豎列，row 是橫行；詞尾 n 不發音。

tr: n. 個性, 人格, (團體、地方、國家)特有特性, 名人
def: n. the complex of all the attributes--behavioral, temperamental, emotional and mental--that characterize a unique individual
n. a person of considerable prominence
the qualities that shape how someone thinks, feels, and behaves

ex.en: Her cheerful personality makes everyone feel welcome at dinner.
ex.zh: 她開朗的性格讓每位來吃飯的人都感到受歡迎。

ex.en: Schools should recognise that differences in personality can influence how students participate in group activities.
ex.zh: 學校應認識到，性格差異會影響學生參與集體活動的方式。

words.tip: 指性格時可數；have personality指有個人魅力。

tr: n. 外套, 圍巾, 包裹物, 限制, 約束, 秘密, 換行
vt. 包裝, 卷, 纏繞, 包, 裹, 覆蓋, 遮蔽, 隱藏, 掩護
vi. 纏繞, 穿外衣, 包起來
def: n. cloak that is folded or wrapped around a person
n. a sandwich in which the filling is rolled up in a soft tortilla
v. arrange or fold as a cover or protection

ex.en: She wrapped the birthday present in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 她用鮮黃色的紙包好了生日禮物。

ex.en: Retailers could reduce packaging waste by encouraging customers to wrap gifts in reusable fabric.
ex.zh: 零售商可以鼓勵顧客用可重複使用的布料包裝禮物，以減少包裝廢棄物。

col: wrap something in paper｜用紙包住某物
words.tip: 用wrap A in B表示用材料B包住A。

tr: n. 顯示, 陳列, 炫耀, 顯示器
vt. 陳列, 顯示, 表現, 誇示
def: n. something intended to communicate a particular impression
n. something shown to the public
n. a visual representation of something

ex.en: The bakery displays fresh cakes beside the front window.
ex.zh: 麵包店把新鮮蛋糕陳列在前窗旁。

ex.en: Museums increasingly display everyday objects to illustrate how ordinary people lived in the past.
ex.zh: 博物館越來越多地展示日常物品，以呈現過去普通人的生活方式。

col: a colourful display｜色彩繽紛的陳列
words.tip: on display意為“在展出”，中間不加冠詞。

tr: n. 資產, 有益的東西
def: n. a useful or valuable quality

tr: n. 不景氣, 消沉, 沮喪, 窪地
[醫] 抑鬱[症], 阻抑, 壓低, 凹, 窩, 衰退, 俯角
def: n. a mental state characterized by a pessimistic sense of inadequacy and a despondent lack of activity
n. a long-term economic state characterized by unemployment and low prices and low levels of trade and investment
n. sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy

ex.en: Her doctor recommended regular counselling to help manage depression.
ex.zh: 她的醫生建議定期接受心理諮詢，以幫助緩解抑鬱症。

ex.en: Improving access to mental health services can help people with depression receive timely support and appropriate treatment.
ex.zh: 改善心理健康服務的可及性，可以幫助抑鬱症患者及時獲得支持和適當治療。

words.tip: 抑鬱症不等於短暫心情低落；經濟蕭條常用a depression。

tr: n. 觀察, 注意, 觀測, 觀察力
def: n. the act of making and recording a measurement
n. the act of observing; taking a patient look
n. a remark expressing careful consideration

ex.en: The doctor kept him in hospital overnight for observation.
ex.zh: 醫生讓他留院觀察一晚。

ex.en: Careful observation of children's behaviour helps teachers identify learning difficulties and provide appropriate support at an early stage.
ex.zh: 仔細觀察兒童的行為有助於教師及早發現學習困難，並提供適當支持。

col: make an observation｜發表觀察意見
words.tip: 觀察活動通常不可數；一條觀察意見可數。

tr: n. 付款, 支付的款項(或實物), 償還, 報應, 懲罰
[經] 支付, 繳納, 支付款額
def: n. a sum of money paid or a claim discharged
n. the act of paying money
the act of giving money for something

ex.en: The shop accepts payment by card or cash.
ex.zh: 這家商店接受刷卡或現金付款。

ex.en: Digital payment systems can make everyday transactions more convenient, but they may exclude people without internet access.
ex.zh: 數字支付系統能讓日常交易更便捷，但可能將無法上網的人排除在外。

words.tip: 支付行為通常不可數；一筆款項可用a payment。

tr: n. 進行, 程序, 行動, 訴訟程序, 事項
def: n. (law) the institution of a sequence of steps by which legal judgments are invoked
n. preceding in time
something considered more important than other things
