the right to receive attention or action before others

ex.en: Finding a warm home is our main priority now.
ex.zh: 找到一個溫暖的家是我們現在的首要任務。

ex.en: Governments should give priority to preventive healthcare rather than focus exclusively on treating existing illnesses.
ex.zh: 政府應優先重視預防性醫療，而不是隻關注治療已有疾病。

words.tip: give priority to後接優先考慮的事物。

tr: n. 創造, 創作物, 發明
def: n. the human act of creating
n. an artifact that has been brought into existence by someone
n. the event that occurred at the beginning of something

ex.en: The creation of our garden took several busy weekends.
ex.zh: 我們忙了好幾個週末才建好花園。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can support job creation while helping countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投資可再生能源可以促進就業，同時幫助各國減少對化石燃料的依賴。

col: the creation of wealth｜財富的創造
words.tip: 指創造過程通常不可數；指具體作品時可數。

tr: n. 情緒, 激動, 強烈的情感
def: n. any strong feeling
a strong feeling such as joy, fear, or sadness

ex.en: Her voice shook with emotion when she saw her brother.
ex.zh: 見到哥哥時，她激動得聲音都顫抖了。

ex.en: Teaching children to recognise and manage emotion can improve their relationships and support long-term mental health.
ex.zh: 教孩子識別和管理情緒，可以改善他們的人際關係，並促進長期心理健康。

col: control your emotions｜控制自己的情緒
words.tip: 泛指情感時可不可數；具體的各種情緒常用emotions。

tr: a. 戲劇性的, 生動的
def: a. suitable to or characteristic of drama
s. sensational in appearance or thrilling in effect
a. pertaining to or characteristic of drama

tr: n. 縫隙, 缺口, 間斷, 間距, 通用匯編程序
vt. 打開缺口, 造成縫隙
[計] 通用匯編程序, 圖形應用程序, 間距
def: n. a conspicuous disparity or difference as between two figures
n. a narrow opening
n. a difference (especially an unfortunate difference) between two opinions or two views or two situations

ex.en: The kitten squeezed through a gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 小貓從籬笆的一個缺口鑽了過去。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable education could narrow the gap between wealthy households and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 讓更多人獲得負擔得起的教育，可以縮小富裕家庭與弱勢社區之間的差距。

col: a gap in the fence｜籬笆上的缺口
words.tip: 兩者間的差距用 gap between A and B。

tr: n. 選擇, 選文, 精選品
def: n. an assortment of things from which a choice can be made
The process of choosing someone or something
A range of things available to choose from

ex.en: This little bakery has a wonderful selection of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 這家小麵包店有各種很棒的新鮮麵包可供挑選。

ex.en: Transparent selection procedures can help universities offer places fairly to applicants from a wide range of backgrounds.
ex.zh: 透明的選拔程序有助於大學公平地錄取來自不同背景的申請者。

col: a wide selection of｜種類豐富的
words.tip: 表示挑選過程時通常不可數；一組選項可數。

tr: n. 主動行動, 首創精神, 主動權
a. 自發的, 起始的
def: n readiness to embark on bold new ventures
n the first of a series of actions
s serving to set in motion
n. (medicine) the act of caring for someone (as by medication or remedial training etc.)
Treatment intended to improve physical or mental health.

ex.en: After her injury, regular therapy helped her walk comfortably again.
ex.zh: 受傷後，定期治療幫助她重新自如地行走。

ex.en: Schools that provide access to psychological therapy may better support students experiencing persistent anxiety.
ex.zh: 提供心理治療服務的學校可能更好地支持長期感到焦慮的學生。

words.tip: 泛指治療通常不可數；具體療法可用複數。

tr: n. 遮蓋, 住房供給, 居留(處), 房屋, 裝飾
def: n. structures collectively in which people are housed
n. a protective cover designed to contain or support a mechanical component

tr: a. 存在的, 目前的, 現存的, 現有的
[計] 現成的, 已有的, 現存的
def: s. presently existing
s. existing in something specified
Already present or in use at a particular time.

ex.en: We kept the existing shelves and painted them blue.
ex.zh: 我們保留了原有的架子，並把它們刷成藍色。

ex.en: Governments should improve existing transport networks before investing public money in entirely new infrastructure projects.
ex.zh: 政府應先改善現有交通網絡，再將公共資金投入全新的基礎設施項目。

words.tip: 通常放在名詞前，強調已經存在而非新建或新增。

def: v deem to be
v look at attentively
v connect closely and often incriminatingly

ex.en: I called the hotel regarding our missing suitcase.
ex.zh: 我給酒店打了電話，詢問我們丟失的行李箱一事。

ex.en: Schools should consult parents before making major decisions regarding changes to the curriculum or assessment methods.
ex.zh: 學校在就課程或評估方式的調整作出重大決定之前，應徵求家長意見。

words.tip: regarding直接接名詞，不加to；比about正式。

tr: n. 屑片, 薄片, 碎片
vt. 削, 切, 削成碎片, 使摔倒, 鑿
[計] 孔屑; 組件; 晶片; 芯片
def: n. a triangular wooden float attached to the end of a log line
n. a piece of dried bovine dung
n. a thin crisp slice of potato fried in deep fat

ex.en: The repairer replaced a damaged chip inside my laptop.
ex.zh: 維修人員更換了我筆記本電腦內部一塊損壞的芯片。

ex.en: Demand for advanced chips is increasing as more industries adopt artificial intelligence and automated production systems.
ex.zh: 隨著更多行業採用人工智能和自動化生產系統，對先進芯片的需求正在增長。

col: a chip in a cup｜杯子上的缺口
chip a tooth｜磕掉一小塊牙齒
words.tip: 食物中的chips：英式指薯條，美式通常指薯片。

tr: vt. 感覺, 認知, 理解, 意識到
def: v. to become aware of through the senses
v. become conscious of

tr: n. 層, 產卵雞, 放置者
vt. 分層堆積, 壓植
def: n. single thickness of usually some homogeneous substance
n. a relatively thin sheetlike expanse or region lying over or under another
n. a hen that lays eggs

ex.en: A thin layer of dust covered the shelf.
ex.zh: 架子上覆蓋著薄薄的一層灰塵。

ex.en: Adding an extra layer of insulation can significantly reduce energy consumption in older homes.
ex.zh: 增加一層保溫材料可以顯著降低老舊住宅的能源消耗。

col: a layer of dust｜一層灰塵
words.tip: “一層某物”用a layer of；layer也可作動詞。

tr: n. 計劃的制訂, 策劃, 設計, 規劃
def: n. an act of formulating a program for a definite course of action
n. the act or process of drawing up plans or layouts for some project or enterprise
n. the cognitive process of thinking about what you will do in the event of something happening

tr: n. 部分, 一份, 命運, 嫁妝
def: n something determined in relation to something that includes it
n something less than the whole of a human artifact
n the allotment of some amount by dividing something

ex.en: A large portion of our garden is shaded.
ex.zh: 我們花園裡有很大一部分處於陰涼處。

ex.en: Housing costs consume a substantial portion of household income, particularly in cities with limited affordable accommodation.
ex.zh: 住房開支佔家庭收入的很大一部分，在平價住房有限的城市尤其如此。

col: a large portion of｜……的一大部分
a substantial portion｜相當大的一部分
words.tip: portion可指整體的一部分，也常指一人份食物。

tr: n. 領土, 領地, 版圖, 地區, 活動範圍
def: n. an area of knowledge or interest
n. the geographical area under the jurisdiction of a sovereign state
land controlled by a particular country or authority

ex.en: The island became part of the country's territory.
ex.zh: 這座島成為了該國領土的一部分。

ex.en: As cities expand into wildlife territory, conflicts between humans and native animals may become more frequent.
ex.zh: 隨著城市擴張侵入野生動物的領地，人類與本土動物之間的衝突可能更加頻繁。

col: defend territory｜保衛領土；守衛領地
words.tip: 領土義可不可數；一塊轄區可用a territory。

tr: n. 對手, 敵手, 反對者
a. 敵對的, 反對的, 對面的
def: s. characterized by active hostility

tr: n. 麻煩, 糾紛, 討厭的人
def: v. intrude or enter uninvited
v. make nervous or agitated
v. make confused or perplexed or puzzled

ex.en: Please do not bother your sister while she studies.
ex.zh: 你姐姐學習時，請不要打擾她。

ex.en: Constant notifications can bother students during lessons and reduce their ability to concentrate on complex tasks.
ex.zh: 持續不斷的通知會在課堂上干擾學生，降低他們專注於複雜任務的能力。

col: bother someone with something｜拿某事打擾某人
bother to do something｜費心做某事
a lot of bother｜很多麻煩
words.tip: bother to do常用於否定或疑問，表示費心做。

tr: n. 存款, 挽救, 節約
a. 搭救的, 節約的, 保留的, 補償的
def: s. characterized by thriftiness
a reduction in the money, time, or resources used
money kept rather than spent, usually for future needs

ex.en: Buying a monthly pass gave me a useful saving.
ex.zh: 買月票讓我省下了一筆實用的開支。

ex.en: Investing in efficient heating systems can produce significant energy savings for households over the long term.
ex.zh: 從長遠來看，投資高效供暖系統能顯著降低家庭能耗。

words.tip: 表示積蓄通常用複數savings；節省可用單數。

def: n uncomplimentary terms for a policeman
v take by theft
v take into custody

tr: a. 正式的, 形式的, 禮儀的, 拘於禮節的, 拘謹的
def: a. being in accord with established forms and conventions and requirements (as e.g. of formal dress)
s. characteristic of or befitting a person in authority
a. (of spoken and written language) adhering to traditional standards of correctness and without casual, contracted, and colloquial forms

ex.en: You need a formal invitation to attend the ceremony.
ex.zh: 你需要正式邀請才能出席典禮。

ex.en: Formal education provides essential knowledge, while practical experience helps students apply what they have learned.
ex.zh: 正規教育提供必備知識，而實踐經驗幫助學生運用所學內容。

words.tip: formal不等於former：前者“正式的”，後者“以前的”。

tr: n. 轉變, 轉換, 變遷, 過渡時期, 臨時轉調
def: n. a change from one place or state or subject or stage to another
n. a musical passage moving from one key to another
n. a passage that connects a topic to one that follows

ex.en: A familiar toy eased her transition to nursery.
ex.zh: 一個熟悉的玩具幫助她適應了托兒所生活。

ex.en: The transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy requires sustained investment and careful government planning.
ex.zh: 從化石燃料向可再生能源的轉型需要持續投資和政府的周密規劃。

col: transition from A to B｜從甲到乙的轉變
words.tip: 常用transition from A to B表示兩種狀態間轉變。

tr: n. 抵抗力, 反抗, 耐力, 阻力, 電阻
[化] 抵抗; 抗性; 阻力; 抗藥性; 電阻
def: n. the action of opposing something that you disapprove or disagree with
n. any mechanical force that tends to retard or oppose motion
n. the military action of resisting the enemy's advance

tr: n. 暴露, 揭發, 揭露
[化] 曝光量; 照射; 照射量
def: n. vulnerability to the elements; to the action of heat or cold or wind or rain;
n. the act of subjecting someone to an influencing experience
n. the disclosure of something secret

tr: n. 姿勢, 姿態, 裝模作樣, 偽裝
vi. 擺姿勢, 裝模作樣, 假裝
vt. 使擺好姿勢, 提出, 造成
def: n. a posture assumed by models for photographic or artistic purposes
v. pretend to be someone you are not; sometimes with fraudulent intentions
v. behave affectedly or unnaturally in order to impress others

tr: n. 結合體, 結合, 聯合
def: n. the state of being combined into one body

tr: vi. 決定, 分解, 決心
vt. 使分解, 解析, 解決, 消除, 決心
n. 決定之事, 決心, 堅決
def: v. make clearly visible
v. find the solution
To find a satisfactory solution to a problem or disagreement.

ex.en: We resolved the argument by taking turns cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我們通過輪流做晚飯解決了這場爭執。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential to resolve disputes over shared water resources and prevent future conflicts.
ex.zh: 國際合作對於解決共享水資源爭端和預防未來衝突至關重要。

col: resolve to do something｜決心做某事
strengthen someone's resolve｜堅定某人的決心
words.tip: resolve a problem是解決；resolve to do是決心做。

tr: n. 時期, 局面, 方面, 位相, 相, 階段
vt. 使調整相位, 使定相, 使一致, 逐步執行, 實行
def: n. any distinct time period in a sequence of events
n. (physical chemistry) a distinct state of matter in a system; matter that is identical in chemical composition and physical state and separated from other material by the phase boundary
n. a particular point in the time of a cycle; measured from some arbitrary zero and expressed as an angle

ex.en: The kitchen repairs have entered their final phase.
ex.zh: 廚房維修已進入最後階段。

ex.en: During the initial phase of urban development, planners should prioritise affordable housing and reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 在城市發展的初期階段，規劃者應優先考慮可負擔住房和可靠的公共交通。

col: a phase of development｜發展階段
words.tip: phase in指逐步引入，phase out指逐步淘汰。

def: a on a regular route of a railroad or bus or airline system
a connected to a computer network or accessible by computer
s being in progress now

ex.en: I booked our train tickets online after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚飯後，我在網上訂了我們的火車票。

ex.en: Online courses can widen access to education, especially for learners who live far from universities.
ex.zh: 網絡課程可以擴大受教育的機會，尤其有利於遠離大學的學習者。

words.tip: 既可作形容詞，也可作副詞：shop online。

tr: n. 場合, 時機, 機會, 誘因, 理由
def: n. reason
n. the time of a particular event
n. an opportunity to do something

ex.en: I have met your sister on several occasions.
ex.zh: 我見過你姐姐好幾次。

ex.en: Community festivals provide an occasion for residents from different backgrounds to share traditions and build friendships.
ex.zh: 社區節慶讓不同背景的居民有機會分享傳統、建立友誼。

col: rise to the occasion｜成功應對挑戰
words.tip: 表示“在某次場合”用on，不用in。

tr: adv. 很少地, 罕有地
def: r. not often
Not often; on very few occasions.

ex.en: We rarely eat outside when the weather turns cold.
ex.zh: 天氣轉冷時，我們很少在戶外吃飯。

ex.en: People living in remote villages rarely have easy access to specialist medical services.
ex.zh: 住在偏遠村莊的人很少能方便地獲得專科醫療服務。

words.tip: 通常放實義動詞前、be動詞後；本身有否定意味。

def: n. the act of killing yourself
n. a person who kills himself intentionally
The act of intentionally causing one's own death.

ex.en: Our local centre offers free workshops on suicide prevention.
ex.zh: 我們當地的中心提供免費的自殺預防講習班。

ex.en: Suicide prevention requires accessible mental health services, supportive communities, and responsible reporting in the media.
ex.zh: 自殺預防需要便捷可及的心理健康服務、相互支持的社區以及負責任的媒體報道。

words.tip: 中性表達常用die by suicide，避免汙名化。

tr: a. 很多的, 數目眾多的, 多數的
def: s. amounting to a large indefinite number
Existing in large numbers.

ex.en: Numerous birds gathered around the crumbs on our balcony.
ex.zh: 許多鳥聚在我們陽臺上的麵包屑周圍。

ex.en: Numerous studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 眾多研究表明，能方便地接觸綠地有助於改善城市居民的心理健康。

words.tip: 修飾可數名詞複數，不能直接修飾不可數名詞。

def: n. a branch of knowledge
n. a system of rules of conduct or method of practice;
n. the trait of being well behaved

ex.en: Practising the piano every morning takes patience and discipline.
ex.zh: 每天早晨練鋼琴需要耐心和自律。

ex.en: Universities increasingly encourage collaboration between researchers from different disciplines to address complex environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 大學越來越鼓勵不同學科的研究人員開展合作，以應對複雜的環境挑戰。

col: discipline yourself to do something｜約束自己做某事
words.tip: 表示紀律通常不可數；表示學科時可數。

def: r. in or to another place
in or to another place

ex.en: This café is full, so let's eat elsewhere.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡館坐滿了，我們去別處吃吧。

ex.en: When local housing becomes unaffordable, young workers often move elsewhere in search of better living conditions.
ex.zh: 當本地住房變得難以負擔時，年輕勞動者往往會遷往別處，尋找更好的生活條件。

col: elsewhere in the world｜在世界其他地方
words.tip: 本身是副詞，通常不說in elsewhere或to elsewhere。

def: r in addition; furthermore, their quality is improving"; moreover, mice nested there"
Used to add another fact supporting what was just said.

ex.en: The flat is spacious; moreover, it has a balcony.
ex.zh: 這套公寓很寬敞，而且還有一個陽臺。

ex.en: Public parks provide space for exercise; moreover, they can strengthen community ties by encouraging informal social interaction.
ex.zh: 公共公園提供鍛鍊場所；此外，它們還可通過促進非正式的社交互動來加強社區聯繫。

col: moreover, it is important to｜此外，重要的是要
moreover, there is evidence that｜而且，有證據表明
words.tip: 正式遞進副詞；連接獨立句時，前用句號或分號。

tr: n. 激情, 酷愛, 熱愛, 強烈感情, 耶穌受難(故事)
def: n. a strong feeling or emotion
n. a feeling of strong sexual desire
n. the suffering of Jesus at the Crucifixion

ex.en: Her passion for baking fills our kitchen with delicious smells.
ex.zh: 她對烘焙的熱愛讓我們的廚房總是香氣四溢。

ex.en: Teachers who share their passion for science can inspire students to pursue careers in research.
ex.zh: 教師分享自己對科學的熱愛，能夠激勵學生投身科研事業。

col: a passion for music｜對音樂的熱愛
develop a passion for｜逐漸熱愛
pursue your passion｜追求熱愛之事
words.tip: 表達對某事的熱愛，用a passion for。

tr: n. 工具, 器具, 手段
vt. 實現, 使生效, 執行
def: n. instrumentation (a piece of equipment or tool) used to effect an end
v. apply in a manner consistent with its purpose or design
to put a plan or decision into action

ex.en: Our team will implement the new schedule next week.
ex.zh: 我們團隊下週將實行新的時間表。

ex.en: Governments should implement policies that make public transport more affordable for people on low incomes.
ex.zh: 政府應實施相關政策，讓低收入人群更負擔得起公共交通。

words.tip: 動詞重音在首音節；名詞末音節讀/mənt/。

def: n. (genetics) a segment of DNA that is involved in producing a polypeptide chain; it can include regions preceding and following the coding DNA as well as introns between the exons; it is considered a unit of heredity
A unit of inherited information that influences an organism's characteristics

ex.en: This gene can influence the colour of a cat's fur.
ex.zh: 這種基因會影響貓的毛色。

ex.en: Identifying a gene linked to an inherited disease may help researchers develop more effective treatments.
ex.zh: 識別出與某種遺傳病相關的基因，可能有助於研究人員開發更有效的治療方法。

col: inherit a gene｜遺傳某個基因
words.tip: gene是可數名詞；genetics指遺傳學。

tr: [經] 推銷, 在市場買賣, 銷售
def: n. the commercial processes involved in promoting and selling and distributing a product or service
n. shopping at a market
activities that identify customers' needs and promote products or services

ex.en: My sister handles marketing for a small local bakery.
ex.zh: 我姐姐負責一家本地小麵包店的營銷工作。

ex.en: Effective marketing helps small businesses reach new customers without necessarily spending large amounts on advertising.
ex.zh: 有效的營銷能幫助小企業接觸新客戶，而不一定需要投入大量廣告費。

words.tip: marketing通常不可數，範圍比advertising更廣。

tr: a. 非常的, 強烈的, 緊張的, 熱情的
def: a. possessing or displaying a distinctive feature to a heightened degree
s. (of color) having the highest saturation
very strong or extreme in degree

ex.en: The intense heat made us search for shade.
ex.zh: 酷熱讓我們四處尋找陰涼處。

ex.en: Intense competition for university places can place considerable psychological pressure on students during their final school year.
ex.zh: 大學入學名額的激烈競爭，可能給畢業年級學生帶來相當大的心理壓力。

words.tip: intense 強調程度強烈；intensive 強調密集投入。

def: n. a person or firm that employs workers
A person or organisation that pays people to work.

ex.en: My employer lets me work from home on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我的僱主允許我每週五在家辦公。

ex.en: Employers can improve staff retention by offering fair wages, flexible schedules, and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 僱主可以通過提供公平的薪資、靈活的工作安排和職業發展機會來提高員工留任率。

col: a major employer｜大型用人單位
words.tip: employer是僱主；employee是僱員。

tr: a. 看得見的, 明顯的, 顯然的
def: a. capable of being seen; or open to easy view
s. obvious to the eye
s. present and easily available

ex.en: The mountains were barely visible through the morning mist.
ex.zh: 晨霧中，群山依稀可見。

ex.en: Investment in public transport has brought visible improvements to air quality in several major cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通投資已使幾個大城市的空氣質量得到明顯改善。

col: visible to the naked eye｜肉眼可見的
words.tip: visible to表示對誰可見；別與visual（視覺的）混淆。

def: a. involving competition or competitiveness
s. subscribing to capitalistic competition
s. showing a fighting disposition

ex.en: Our weekend football league has become surprisingly competitive.
ex.zh: 我們的週末足球聯賽變得格外激烈，真讓人意外。

ex.en: In a competitive job market, graduates need practical experience as well as strong academic qualifications.
ex.zh: 在競爭激烈的就業市場中，畢業生既需要實踐經驗，也需要過硬的學歷資質。

col: a competitive market｜競爭激烈的市場
words.tip: 形容人常指好勝；形容價格指有競爭力。

def: v. be in control
v. have dominance or the power to defeat over
v. look down on

tr: n. 遷移, 移動, 傳遞, 轉讓, 轉移, 過戶, 匯兌, 換車
vt. 使轉移, 調轉, 調任, 改變, 傳遞, 轉讓
vi. 轉移, 轉學, 轉職, 換車
def: n. someone who transfers or is transferred from one position to another
n. the act of transfering something from one form to another
n. a ticket that allows a passenger to change conveyances

ex.en: Please transfer the photos from your camera to my laptop.
ex.zh: 請把相機裡的照片傳到我的筆記本電腦上。

ex.en: Governments should support the transfer of clean technology to regions that still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 政府應支持向仍高度依賴化石燃料的地區轉移清潔技術。

words.tip: 名詞重音在首音節；過去式transferred雙寫r。

def: n. the possibility of future success
v. search for something desirable
v. explore for useful or valuable things or substances, such as minerals

ex.en: The prospect of a beach holiday cheered us up.
ex.zh: 想到即將去海邊度假，我們的心情好了起來。

ex.en: Access to vocational training can improve employment prospects for young people in economically disadvantaged regions.
ex.zh: 獲得職業培訓的機會能改善經濟欠發達地區年輕人的就業前景。

col: a realistic prospect｜切實的可能性
words.tip: 前景常用複數prospects；of後可接動名詞。

tr: n. 訴苦, 抱怨, 控訴
def: n. (formerly) a loud cry (or repeated cries) of pain or rage or sorrow
n. an expression of grievance or resentment
n. (civil law) the first pleading of the plaintiff setting out the facts on which the claim for relief is based

ex.en: She made a complaint about the cold soup.
ex.zh: 她投訴湯是涼的。

ex.en: Local authorities should investigate residents' complaints about noise before approving new entertainment venues in residential areas.
ex.zh: 地方政府在批准住宅區內的新娛樂場所前，應調查居民關於噪聲的投訴。

col: a common complaint｜常見病症；常見抱怨
words.tip: complaint是名詞，complain是動詞；投訴某事用about。

tr: vt. 提高, 加強, 增加
def: v. increase
v. make better or more attractive
Improve the quality, value, or appeal of something

ex.en: A little lemon juice enhances the flavour of this soup.
ex.zh: 加一點檸檬汁能讓這道湯的味道更好。

ex.en: Access to green spaces can enhance residents' wellbeing and encourage more active lifestyles in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在擁擠的城市中，便利的綠地資源可以提升居民的幸福感，並鼓勵更積極的生活方式。

col: enhance the quality of｜改善……的質量
enhance someone's reputation｜提升某人的聲譽
words.tip: 強調質量、效果或價值提升，不單指數量增加。

tr: n. 貧窮, 貧困, 缺乏
def: n. the state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions
The condition of lacking money for basic needs.
A serious lack of something needed or valued.

ex.en: The charity helps local families living in poverty.
ex.zh: 這家慈善機構幫助當地生活貧困的家庭。

ex.en: Improving access to education and stable employment can help reduce poverty across both rural and urban communities.
ex.zh: 改善教育機會和穩定就業機會，有助於減少城鄉社區的貧困。

col: a poverty of ideas｜思想貧乏
words.tip: 不可數名詞；“生活貧困”用live in poverty。

tr: vt. 徵(稅), 把...強加於, 以...欺騙
vi. 利用, 欺騙, 施加影響
def: v compel to behave in a certain way
v impose something unpleasant
v impose and collect

ex.en: The library imposed a small fine for my overdue books.
ex.zh: 圖書館因我逾期還書收取了一小筆罰款。

ex.en: Governments may impose higher taxes on sugary drinks to encourage healthier choices and reduce public healthcare costs.
ex.zh: 政府可能對含糖飲料徵收更高的稅，以鼓勵更健康的選擇並降低公共醫療開支。

col: impose one's views on｜把自己的觀點強加於
impose on someone's time｜佔用某人的時間
words.tip: 常用 impose A on B，表示把A強加於B。

tr: [經] 開支, 開銷, 經費
def: n. the act of spending or disbursing money

tr: n. 心情, 氣氛, 生氣, 基調
def: n. verb inflections that express how the action or state is conceived by the speaker
the way someone feels at a particular time
the feeling that a place, event, or artwork creates

ex.en: A short walk usually puts me in a better mood.
ex.zh: 散一小會兒步通常就能讓我的心情好一些。

ex.en: Access to green spaces can improve residents' mood and encourage more positive interactions within urban communities.
ex.zh: 能夠享用綠地可以改善居民心情，促進城市社區內更積極的互動。

col: in the mood for｜有心情做……
words.tip: in the mood for後接名詞；接動詞用to do。

tr: vt. 舉例說明, 作圖解, 闡明
def: v. depict with an illustration
v. supply with illustrations
To make something clear through examples or evidence.

ex.en: She used two jars to illustrate the difference.
ex.zh: 她用兩個罐子來說明其中的區別。

ex.en: These findings illustrate how access to public transport can improve employment opportunities in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 這些研究結果說明，公共交通的可及性如何改善弱勢社區的就業機會。

col: illustrate a point｜說明一個觀點
illustrate the importance of｜說明……的重要性
words.tip: illustrate可用例子說明，不一定涉及圖片。

tr: a. 心理學的, 精神上的, 心靈的
[法] 心理上的, 心理學的
def: s. mental or emotional as opposed to physical in nature
a. of or relating to or determined by psychology
n. a physical condition in which there is a disturbance of normal functioning
n. a disturbance of the peace or of public order
v. bring disorder to

ex.en: A sleep disorder kept him awake most nights.
ex.zh: 睡眠障礙讓他大多數夜晚都無法入睡。

ex.en: Early treatment of anxiety disorders can improve students' wellbeing and help them participate more fully in education.
ex.zh: 儘早治療焦慮障礙能改善學生的身心狀態，幫助他們更充分地參與學習。

words.tip: 疾病義可數；雜亂或騷亂義通常不可數。

tr: vt. 改變, 使多樣化
vi. 變化, 有不同, 違反
def: v. be subject to change in accordance with a variable
v. make something more diverse and varied
To differ or change depending on circumstances.

ex.en: Bus fares vary depending on how far you travel.
ex.zh: 公交車費會隨乘車距離而變化。

ex.en: Access to affordable housing can vary considerably between regions, affecting where young professionals choose to live.
ex.zh: 各地區獲得可負擔住房的機會可能差別很大，從而影響年輕職場人士的居住選擇。

col: vary from place to place｜因地而異
vary your diet｜使飲食多樣化
words.tip: vary from A to B表示範圍；vary in表示某方面不同。

def: n. (statistics) an arrangement of values of a variable showing their observed or theoretical frequency of occurrence
n. the spatial or geographic property of being scattered about over a range, area, or volume
n. the act of distributing or spreading or apportioning

ex.en: Volunteers organised the distribution of warm blankets after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，志願者組織發放了保暖毯。

ex.en: The uneven distribution of medical services leaves many rural communities without adequate access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 醫療服務分佈不均，導致許多農村社區無法獲得充分的醫療保障。

words.tip: 既指分發過程，也指人口等的分佈狀態。

tr: n. 運輸, 輸送, 交通車輛
[經] 運轉, 運輸, 運輸費
def: n. the act of moving something from one location to another
n. the commercial enterprise of moving goods and materials
Moving people or goods, or the systems used for this.

ex.en: We arranged transportation from the airport to our hotel.
ex.zh: 我們安排了從機場到酒店的接送。

ex.en: Reliable public transportation can reduce traffic congestion and make employment opportunities more accessible to people without cars.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通能夠緩解交通擁堵，讓沒有汽車的人更容易獲得就業機會。

words.tip: 美式常用transportation，英式通常用transport。

tr: n. 委任狀, 任官令, 所委職責, 佣金, 犯, 委託, 所託之事
vt. 委任, 委託製作, 使服役
def: n. a fee for services rendered based on a percentage of an amount received or collected or agreed to be paid (as distinguished from a salary)
n. the act of granting authority to undertake certain functions
n. the state of being in good working order and ready for operation

ex.en: The gallery commissioned a local artist to paint our harbour.
ex.zh: 美術館委託一位本地畫家描繪我們的港口。

ex.en: An independent commission should investigate housing conditions before the government introduces new safety regulations for rental properties.
ex.zh: 在政府出臺新的出租房安全法規前，獨立委員會應調查住房狀況。

col: commission a report｜委託撰寫報告
commission a painting｜委託創作畫作
words.tip: 作委員會是可數名詞；作佣金常用不可數形式。

tr: n. 工程學, 工程, 操縱
def: n. the discipline dealing with the art or science of applying scientific knowledge to practical problems
n. a room (as on a ship) in which the engine is located
using science to design and build machines, structures, or systems

ex.en: My cousin studies engineering and builds small robots at home.
ex.zh: 我的表哥學工程，平時在家制作小型機器人。

ex.en: Advances in engineering have enabled cities to build bridges that withstand extreme weather and carry heavier traffic.
ex.zh: 工程技術的進步使城市能夠建造抵禦極端天氣、承載更大交通量的橋梁。

words.tip: 表示學科或技術領域時不可數；engineer可指工程師。

tr: n. 老手, 退伍軍人, 老兵, 老樹
a. 老兵的, 老練的, 經驗豐富的
def: n. a serviceman who has seen considerable active service
n. a person who has served in the armed forces
n. an experienced person who has been through many battles; someone who has given long service

ex.en: Ask Priya; she's a veteran of long camping trips.
ex.zh: 問問普里婭吧，她有豐富的長途露營經驗。

ex.en: A veteran of the teaching profession can offer valuable guidance to colleagues entering challenging classroom environments.
ex.zh: 教學經驗豐富的教師可以為初入充滿挑戰的課堂環境的同事提供寶貴指導。

col: a veteran of｜在……方面經驗豐富的人
words.tip: a veteran of後接領域或經歷；也可前置修飾職業名詞。

def: n. a city in Massachusetts just to the north of Boston; site of Harvard University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology
n. a city in eastern England on the River Cam; site of Cambridge University

tr: n. 投擲, 拋, 搖擺, 震盪, 擲錢幣決定
vt. 投擲, 猛抬, 搖盪, 使不安, 擲錢幣決定
vi. 被到處扔, 搖擺, 顛簸, 輾轉, 擲錢幣決定某事
def: n. an abrupt movement
v. agitate
To throw something lightly or without much care.

ex.en: Could you toss me that cushion from the sofa?
ex.zh: 你能把沙發上的那個靠墊扔給我嗎？

ex.en: Consumers often toss usable items into the bin, increasing waste that could be avoided through repair.
ex.zh: 消費者常把還能用的物品扔進垃圾桶，增加了本可通過維修避免的廢棄物。

words.tip: toss常指輕拋；toss and turn指輾轉反側。

tr: a. 決定性的, 重要的, 嚴厲的
[醫] 十字形的; 決斷的, 定局的
def: a. of extreme importance; vital to the resolution of a crisis
s. having crucial relevance
extremely important to the success or outcome of something

ex.en: Your spare key was crucial when I locked myself out.
ex.zh: 我把自己鎖在門外時，你的備用鑰匙派上了關鍵用場。

ex.en: Access to reliable public transport is crucial for people seeking employment beyond their immediate neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 對於想在居住地附近以外尋找工作的人來說，可靠的公共交通至關重要。

col: crucial to success｜對成功至關重要
words.tip: 比important語氣強；常用be crucial to。

tr: n. 例外, 除外, 異議
def: n. a deliberate act of omission
n. an instance that does not conform to a rule or generalization; the only exception was her last child"
n. grounds for adverse criticism

ex.en: Everyone enjoyed the soup, with the exception of my brother.
ex.zh: 除了我哥哥，大家都很喜歡這道湯。

ex.en: Although public transport is generally affordable, rural communities often represent an exception because services are limited.
ex.zh: 雖然公共交通通常價格低廉，但農村社區往往是例外，因為可用的服務有限。

col: an exception to the rule｜規則的例外
words.tip: 規則的例外用exception to，不用exception of。

def: n. the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required
n. a deficiency or failure in neurological or mental functioning
n. (sports) the score by which a team or individual is losing

ex.en: Our club faces a deficit after buying new equipment.
ex.zh: 購買新設備後，我們俱樂部出現了資金缺口。

ex.en: Governments may reduce a budget deficit by raising taxes, but this can slow economic growth.
ex.zh: 政府可以通過增稅減少預算赤字，但這可能減緩經濟增長。

words.tip: 赤字用deficit；債務用debt，二者不同。

tr: n. 目的, 目標, 宗旨, 賓格, 實物
a. 客觀的, 如實的, 無偏見的, 賓格的
def: n. the lens or system of lenses in a telescope or microscope that is nearest the object being viewed
a. undistorted by emotion or personal bias; based on observable phenomena
a. serving as or indicating the object of a verb or of certain prepositions and used for certain other purposes

ex.en: My main objective is to finish the race.
ex.zh: 我的主要目標是跑完全程。

ex.en: Researchers should remain objective when evaluating evidence about the effects of homework on student achievement.
ex.zh: 研究人員在評估家庭作業對學生成績影響的證據時，應保持客觀。

words.tip: 名詞指目標；形容詞指客觀的，反義詞為subjective。

tr: n. 同盟者, 同盟國, 助手
vt. 使聯盟, 使聯合, 使有關係
def: n. a friendly nation
n. an associate who provides cooperation or assistance
v. become an ally or associate, as by a treaty or marriage

ex.en: My neighbour became an ally in saving the park.
ex.zh: 在保護公園這件事上，我的鄰居成了我的盟友。

ex.en: Local charities can be valuable allies for governments seeking to reduce poverty and improve social inclusion.
ex.zh: 對於致力於減貧和促進社會包容的政府而言，當地慈善機構可以成為重要盟友。

words.tip: 名詞重音通常在前；動詞通常讀/əˈlaɪ/。

tr: vt. 使面對, 對抗, 遭遇, 使對質, 比較
[法] 對證, 使對質, 比較
def: v. oppose, as in hostility or a competition
v. deal with (something unpleasant) head on
v. present somebody with something, usually to accuse or criticize

ex.en: She finally confronted her fear and entered the swimming pool.
ex.zh: 她終於直面恐懼，走進了游泳池。

ex.en: Cities must confront the challenges of an ageing population by improving housing, healthcare, and public transport.
ex.zh: 城市必須通過改善住房、醫療和公共交通來應對人口老齡化的挑戰。

col: confront someone about something｜就某事質問某人
words.tip: 直接接問題；be confronted with表示面臨。

tr: n. 同等的人, 匹敵, 貴族
vi. 凝視, 窺視, 費力地看, 隱現
vt. 與...同等, 封為貴族
def: n. a person who is of equal standing with another in a group
n. a nobleman (duke or marquis or earl or viscount or baron) who is a member of the British peerage
v. look searchingly

ex.en: She peered through the window to see the kitten.
ex.zh: 她透過窗戶仔細看，想看清那隻小貓。

ex.en: Students often gain confidence when they receive constructive feedback from their peers during collaborative classroom activities.
ex.zh: 學生在課堂合作活動中得到同伴的建設性反饋時，往往會增強信心。

words.tip: 名詞常用複數peers；動詞常接through、at或into。

tr: n. 設計者, 謀劃者, 製圖者
def: n. a person who devises plots or intrigues
Someone who plans how something will look or work.
Made by a famous fashion designer, usually expensive.

ex.en: The designer showed us a model of our kitchen.
ex.zh: 設計師給我們看了我們廚房的模型。

ex.en: A skilled designer can make public spaces more accessible to people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 技藝嫻熟的設計師能夠讓行動不便的人更方便地使用公共空間。

words.tip: 作形容詞常置於衣物等名詞前，強調設計師品牌。

tr: n. 退休, 隱居, 撤退
[經] 退休, 退股, (固定資產)報廢
def: n. the state of being retired from one's business or occupation
n. withdrawal from your position or occupation
n. withdrawal for prayer and study and meditation

tr: n. 出版物, 出版, 公佈
def: n. a copy of a printed work offered for distribution
n. the communication of something to the public; making information generally known
n. the business of issuing printed matter for sale or distribution

ex.en: Her first cookbook is ready for publication next month.
ex.zh: 她的第一本食譜已準備好，將於下月出版。

ex.en: The publication of research findings allows other scientists to evaluate the evidence and develop new theories.
ex.zh: 研究成果的發表讓其他科學家能夠評估證據並提出新理論。

col: publication of findings｜研究結果的發表
words.tip: 指出版行為時不可數；指具體出版物時可數。

tr: adv. 逐字地, 按照字面上地, 不誇張地
def: r. in a literal sense
r. (intensifier before a figurative expression) without exaggeration
According to the exact, ordinary meaning of the words.

ex.en: He took my advice literally and bought a bigger plate.
ex.zh: 他按字面理解了我的建議，買了一個更大的盤子。

ex.en: Translating idioms literally can confuse language learners because their meanings often depend on cultural context.
ex.zh: 直譯習語可能讓語言學習者困惑，因為其含義往往取決於文化語境。

col: take something literally｜按字面理解某事
words.tip: 口語可用於誇張；正式寫作宜保留字面或確實義。

tr: n. 大會, 協定, 慣例, 約定
def: n. a large formal assembly
n. something regarded as a normative example
n. (diplomacy) an international agreement

ex.en: By convention, guests wait until everyone is seated before eating.
ex.zh: 按照慣例，客人等所有人落座後才開始用餐。

ex.en: An international convention can strengthen environmental protection by establishing shared responsibilities for participating countries.
ex.zh: 國際公約可以通過確立參與國的共同責任來加強環境保護。

words.tip: 慣例與大會通常可數；by convention意為按慣例。

tr: vt. 擁抱, 互相擁抱, 包含, 收買
def: n. the act of clasping another person in the arms (as in greeting or affection)
n. the state of taking in or encircling
n. a close affectionate and protective acceptance

ex.en: My grandparents have embraced video calls to stay connected.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母欣然接受了用視頻通話保持聯繫的方式。

ex.en: Schools that embrace new technology should also ensure that all students have equal access to digital resources.
ex.zh: 欣然採用新技術的學校也應確保所有學生都能平等獲取數字資源。

col: embrace an opportunity｜欣然把握機會
words.tip: 表示接受時，常接change、idea等抽象名詞。

tr: n. 管理人, 行政官
def: n. someone who administers a business
n. the party appointed by a probate court to distribute the estate of someone who dies without a will or without naming an executor
n. someone who manages a government agency or department

tr: a. 歷史上著名的, 有歷史性的
有歷史意義的；歷史著名的
def: s. belonging to the past; of what is important or famous in the past
s. important in history
Important in history or likely to be remembered in history.

ex.en: We crossed the historic bridge just before sunset.
ex.zh: 我們在日落前走過了那座歷史名橋。

ex.en: Protecting historic buildings helps cities preserve their cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting local businesses.
ex.zh: 保護歷史建築有助於城市保留文化特色，同時吸引遊客並支持當地商業。

col: historic agreement｜具有歷史意義的協議
words.tip: historic強調歷史意義；historical泛指與歷史有關。

tr: n. 元, 雄鹿, 紈絝子弟, 鞍馬, 培克(賭博時的莊家標誌), 鹼水, 自誇, 談話
vi. 馬背突然拱起, 反對, 吹牛, 閒聊
vt. 馬背突然拱起將騎手摔下, 反對, 用鹼水洗
def: n. United States author whose novels drew on her experiences as a missionary in China (1892-1973)
n. mature male of various mammals (especially deer or antelope)
v. to strive with determination

ex.en: I bought this warm scarf for just five bucks.
ex.zh: 我只花了五美元就買到了這條暖和的圍巾。

ex.en: Although shoppers may save a few bucks online, local retailers often provide more personalised advice and support.
ex.zh: 雖然網上購物可能讓顧客省下幾美元，但本地零售商往往提供更貼心的建議和幫助。

col: make a quick buck｜快速撈錢
words.tip: 表示美元時屬口語；pass the buck意為推卸責任。

tr: vt. 綁, 約束, 裝訂, 包紮, 使結合
vi. 凝固, 有約束力
def: n. something that hinders as if with bonds
v. create social or emotional ties
v. make fast; tie or secure, with or as if with a rope

tr: vt. 賜予, 支持, 喜歡, 證實
def: n. an act of gracious kindness
n. an advantage to the benefit of someone or something
n. an inclination to approve

ex.en: Could you do me a favor and water my plants?
ex.zh: 你能幫我個忙，給我的植物澆水嗎？

ex.en: Many residents favor investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 許多居民支持投資公共交通，因為這能緩解擁堵，並讓人們更方便地前往工作地點。

col: do someone a favor｜幫某人一個忙
favor one option over another｜更偏向某個選項
words.tip: favor是美式拼寫，英式為favour；幫忙用do a favor。

def: n. the largest city in Alabama; located in northeastern Alabama
n. a city in central England; 2nd largest English city and an important industrial and transportation center

tr: vt. 安裝, 安置, 使就職
[計] 安裝, 安裝程序; DOS內部命令:安裝常駐程序
def: v. set up for use
v. put into an office or a position
v. place

ex.en: We hired an electrician to install the new ceiling fan.
ex.zh: 我們請了一位電工來安裝新吊扇。

ex.en: Schools need sufficient funding to install reliable internet connections and maintain essential digital equipment.
ex.zh: 學校需要充足的資金來安裝可靠的網絡連接，並維護必要的數字設備。

col: install solar panels｜安裝太陽能板
words.tip: 下載是download；下載後安裝才是install。

tr: a. 初步的, 基本的
[醫] 元素的, 基礎的, 初級的
def: s. easy and not involved or complicated
a. of or pertaining to or characteristic of elementary school or elementary education
s. of or being the essential or basic part

ex.en: This course teaches elementary cooking skills to complete beginners.
ex.zh: 這門課程向零基礎學員教授基本烹飪技巧。

ex.en: Elementary education should develop children's curiosity as well as their ability to read and calculate.
ex.zh: 小學教育不僅應培養兒童的閱讀和計算能力，還應激發他們的好奇心。

words.tip: elementary school主要用於美式英語，英式常用primary school。

def: n. any of a large group of nitrogenous organic compounds that are essential constituents of living cells; consist of polymers of amino acids; essential in the diet of animals for growth and for repair of tissues; can be obtained from meat and eggs and milk and legumes
A nutrient needed for growth and repair of body tissues.

ex.en: These beans add protein to our vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 這些豆子為我們的蔬菜湯增添了蛋白質。

ex.en: A balanced plant-based diet can provide sufficient protein when it includes varied sources such as beans and nuts.
ex.zh: 均衡的植物性飲食如果包含豆類和堅果等多樣化來源，就能提供充足的蛋白質。

col: a source of protein｜蛋白質來源
words.tip: 作營養物質通常不可數；指不同種類時可數。

tr: n. 監牢, 監獄, 拘留所
def: n. a correctional institution used to detain persons who are in the lawful custody of the government (either accused persons awaiting trial or convicted persons serving a sentence)
A place where people are kept as punishment or awaiting trial.
Put someone in jail.

ex.en: The old jail now welcomes visitors as a museum.
ex.zh: 這座舊監獄如今作為博物館接待遊客。

ex.en: Education programmes in jail can help prisoners develop skills and improve their chances of finding work after release.
ex.zh: 監獄中的教育項目能幫助服刑人員培養技能，提高他們獲釋後找到工作的機會。

col: be jailed for fraud｜因詐騙被監禁
words.tip: in jail指在押，不加冠詞；英式舊拼法為gaol。

tr: n. 僱用, 職業, 工作
[經] 職業, 僱用, 職工招請
def: n. the state of being employed or having a job
n. the occupation for which you are paid
n. the act of giving someone a job

ex.en: She found employment at a bakery near her home.
ex.zh: 她在家附近的一家麵包店找到了工作。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can create employment opportunities while helping countries meet their climate targets.
ex.zh: 投資可再生能源可以創造就業機會，同時幫助各國實現氣候目標。

words.tip: 通常不可數；一份工作用a job，不用an employment。

tr: n. 歷史學家, 記事者
def: n. a person who is an authority on history and who studies it and writes about it
Someone who studies or writes about the past.

ex.en: The historian examined an old map under a lamp.
ex.zh: 這位歷史學家在燈下仔細查看一張舊地圖。

ex.en: Historians use a range of sources to explain how industrialisation transformed everyday life in urban communities.
ex.zh: 歷史學家利用多種資料解釋工業化如何改變城市社區的日常生活。

col: a leading historian｜傑出的歷史學家
a historian of science｜科學史學家
words.tip: historian指研究者；historical表示與歷史有關。

tr: vt. 回覆, 恢復, 歸還, 修補, 修復
[計] 還原; DOS外部命令:從備份盤中取回文件
def: v. return to its original or usable and functioning condition
v. give or bring back
v. bring back into original existence, use, function, or position

ex.en: The engineers restored power before our food went bad.
ex.zh: 工程師們在我們的食物變質之前恢復了供電。

ex.en: Planting native trees can help restore damaged ecosystems and provide essential habitats for local wildlife.
ex.zh: 種植本土樹木有助於修復受損的生態系統，併為當地野生動物提供必要的棲息地。

col: restore a historic building｜修復歷史建築
restore something to its owner｜將某物歸還原主
words.tip: restore A to B：使A恢復到B狀態或歸還給B。

tr: n. 重要材料(或事物), 有實際價值的東西
a. 實質上的, 物質的, 有內容的, 結實的
def: s. having a firm basis in reality and being therefore important, meaningful, or considerable
a. having substance or capable of being treated as fact; not imaginary
n. a feeling of liking something or someone good
n. acceptance as satisfactory
n. a message expressing a favorable opinion

ex.en: We need the landlord's approval before painting the kitchen.
ex.zh: 粉刷廚房前，我們需要得到房東的許可。

ex.en: New housing projects should receive approval only when developers demonstrate that adequate transport and public services will be provided.
ex.zh: 開發商只有證明能提供充足的交通和公共服務，新住宅項目才應獲批。

words.tip: approval of常指贊同；approval for常指項目許可。

tr: n. 貝殼, 殼, 外形, 炮彈
vt. 去殼, 脫落, 炮轟
[計] 外殼; DOS內部命令:指定命令行處理程序
def: n. ammunition consisting of a cylindrical metal casing containing an explosive charge and a projectile; fired from a large gun
n. the material that forms the hard outer covering of many animals
n. the hard usually fibrous outer layer of some fruits especially nuts

ex.en: She found a tiny crab inside the empty shell.
ex.zh: 她在空貝殼裡發現了一隻小螃蟹。

ex.en: Rising ocean acidity can weaken the shells of marine animals, threatening their survival and wider ecosystems.
ex.zh: 海洋酸度上升會削弱海洋動物的外殼，威脅其生存以及更廣泛的生態系統。

words.tip: shell作動詞可指剝殼；shell peas是剝豌豆。

def: a. pertaining to biology or to life and living things
a. of parents and children; related by blood

tr: adv. 有效地, 有力地, 實際上
def: r. in actuality or reality or fact
in a way that achieves the intended result
in practice, although not officially or in every detail

ex.en: This simple brush cleans muddy shoes surprisingly effectively.
ex.zh: 這把簡單的刷子清理沾泥的鞋子，效果出奇地好。

ex.en: Schools can reduce waste effectively by encouraging students to reuse materials during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 學校可以鼓勵學生在課堂活動中重複使用材料，從而有效減少浪費。

words.tip: effectively側重效果；efficiently側重效率。

def: n. someone authorized to exercise the powers of sheriff in emergencies
n. an assistant with power to act when his superior is absent
n. a member of the lower chamber of a legislative assembly (such as in France)

ex.en: The manager asked her deputy to lead today's meeting.
ex.zh: 經理讓她的副手主持今天的會議。

ex.en: Appointing a capable deputy allows school leaders to share administrative responsibilities and focus on educational improvement.
ex.zh: 任命一位能幹的副職能讓學校領導分擔行政職責，並專注於教育改進。

words.tip: 常置於職務前，如deputy director；不泛指所有代表。

tr: vt. 保證, 使確信, 弄清楚, 擔保
[法] 確信, 保證, 保障
def: v. inform positively and with certainty and confidence
v. assure somebody of the truth of something with the intention of giving the listener confidence

tr: n. 功用, 有用之物, 實用, 公用事業, 實用程序
a. 實用的, 有多種用途的
def: n. a company that performs a public service; subject to government regulation
n. the quality of being of practical use
n. the service (electric power or water or transportation) provided by a public utility

ex.en: This folding table offers real utility in our tiny kitchen.
ex.zh: 這張摺疊桌在我們的小廚房裡確實很實用。

ex.en: Reliable access to basic utilities is essential for improving public health and supporting economic development in rural communities.
ex.zh: 穩定獲得基本公共服務，對於改善農村社區的公共衛生和支持經濟發展至關重要。

words.tip: “效用”通常不可數；水電燃氣等服務常用utilities。

tr: adv. 然而, 雖然如此
def: r despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
Despite what has just been mentioned.

ex.en: The climb was tiring; nevertheless, we enjoyed the view.
ex.zh: 爬山很累，但我們仍然欣賞到了美景。

ex.en: Public transport improvements require considerable investment; nevertheless, they can reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通需要大量投資，但這能緩解擁堵並改善城市空氣質量。

col: nevertheless remain｜儘管如此仍然保持
words.tip: 是副詞，不是連詞；連接獨立句時可用分號。

tr: [化] 配合劑; 拼料; 成分; 組分
def: n. a component of a mixture or compound
n. food that is a component of a mixture in cooking
one of the foods used to prepare a dish

ex.en: Fresh ginger is the main ingredient in this soup.
ex.zh: 鮮姜是這道湯的主要食材。

ex.en: Public trust is an essential ingredient in the successful implementation of environmental policies.
ex.zh: 公眾信任是成功實施環境政策的必要因素。

words.tip: 是可數名詞；既指烹飪配料，也可比喻必要因素。

tr: n. 樁, 炮烙刑, 木柱, 賭注, 獎金
vt. 打樁, 用樁撐, 下賭注, 資助
def: n. instrument of execution consisting of a vertical post that a victim is tied to for burning
n. the money risked on a gamble
n. a strong wooden or metal post with a point at one end so it can be driven into the ground

ex.en: She bought a small stake in her sister's bakery.
ex.zh: 她購買了姐姐那家麵包店的一小部分股份。

ex.en: Residents have a stake in urban planning because development decisions directly affect their quality of life.
ex.zh: 居民與城市規劃有切身利益關係，因為開發決策會直接影響他們的生活質量。

col: stake your reputation on｜以聲譽賭……
words.tip: have a stake in指有利益關係；at stake指面臨風險。

tr: n. 纖維, 構造, 纖維製品
def: n. a slender and greatly elongated substance capable of being spun into yarn
n. any of several elongated, threadlike cells (especially a muscle fiber or a nerve fiber)
n. a leatherlike material made by compressing layers of paper or cloth

tr: [法] 避難者, 流亡者, 難民
def: n. an exile who flees for safety

tr: a. 合併的, 組成公司的, 一體化的
vt. 吸收, 合併, 使組成公司, 體現
vi. 合併, 混合, 組成公司
def: v. include or contain; have as a component
v. form a corporation
v. unite or merge with something already in existence

tr: vt. 以齒輪連起, 開動, 使適應, 安排
def: n. a toothed wheel that engages another toothed mechanism in order to change the speed or direction of transmitted motion
n. a mechanism for transmitting motion for some specific purpose (as the steering gear of a vehicle)
n. equipment consisting of miscellaneous articles needed for a particular operation or sport etc.

ex.en: We packed our camping gear into the car.
ex.zh: 我們把露營裝備裝進了車裡。

ex.en: Schools should gear their career guidance towards the changing needs of students and the wider labour market.
ex.zh: 學校應使就業指導適應學生及整個勞動力市場不斷變化的需求。

words.tip: 表示裝備時不可數；表示擋位或單個齒輪時可數。

tr: vt. 分配, 指派, 賦值
def: v. give out
v. select something or someone for a specific purpose
v. transfer one's right to

ex.en: The coach assigned each player a partner for practice.
ex.zh: 教練給每位隊員安排了一名訓練搭檔。

ex.en: Teachers should assign tasks that match students' abilities while encouraging them to develop new skills.
ex.zh: 教師應佈置符合學生能力的任務，同時鼓勵他們培養新技能。

col: assign someone to a team｜將某人分配到團隊
words.tip: 常用assign sth to sb，也可用assign sb sth。

def: n. a body serving in an administrative capacity
n. (Christianity) an assembly of theologians and bishops and other representatives of different churches or dioceses that is convened to regulate matters of discipline or doctrine
n. a meeting of people for consultation

ex.en: The local council repaired the playground near our house.
ex.zh: 地方議會修好了我們家附近的遊樂場。

ex.en: The city council should consult residents before approving developments that could affect public green spaces.
ex.zh: 市議會在批准可能影響公共綠地的開發項目之前，應徵詢居民意見。

words.tip: council指議會或委員會；counsel指建議或勸告。

tr: n. (政府提供的)錢和設備, 準備, 供應品, 規定, 條款
vt. 供給...食物及必需品
def: n. a stipulated condition
n. the activity of supplying or providing something
n. a store or supply of something (especially of food or clothing or arms)

ex.en: The campsite fee includes the provision of clean water.
ex.zh: 營地費用包含清潔用水的供應。

ex.en: Improving the provision of affordable childcare can help more parents return to work and increase household income.
ex.zh: 增加可負擔的托育服務，可以幫助更多父母重返職場並提高家庭收入。

words.tip: 表“提供”不可數；表“條款”可數；provisions可指糧食。

tr: n. (非正式)殺人者, 屠殺者, 猛獸, 致死(疾病), 殺手, 止痛藥, 限制器, 瞄準器
[計] 刪除程序; 斷路器
def: n. someone who causes the death of a person or animal
n. a difficulty that is hard to deal with

tr: vi. 成群結隊, 結成一夥
def: n. an association of criminals
n. an organized group of workmen
n. tool consisting of a combination of implements arranged to work together

ex.en: Our whole gang meets at the park on Saturdays.
ex.zh: 我們這群夥伴每週六都在公園碰面。

ex.en: Community programmes can reduce gang membership by offering young people educational support and meaningful employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 社區項目可以通過提供教育支持和有意義的就業機會，減少青少年加入幫派的現象。

col: a gang of workers｜一隊工人
gang up on someone｜結夥欺負某人
words.tip: 指朋友群體時較口語化；正式語境常指犯罪團伙。

tr: n. 索引, 指針, 指數, 指標
vt. 編入索引中, 指出
[計] 下標; 附標; 變址; 索引; 編索引
def: n. a numerical scale used to compare variables with one another or with some reference number
n. a number or ratio (a value on a scale of measurement) derived from a series of observed facts; can reveal relative changes as a function of time
n. an alphabetical listing of names and topics along with page numbers where they are discussed

tr: n. 戲劇, 戲劇藝術
def: n. an episode that is turbulent or highly emotional
n. the literary genre of works intended for the theater
n. the quality of being arresting or highly emotional

ex.en: Our drama group rehearses in the hall every Thursday.
ex.zh: 我們的戲劇小組每週四在大廳排練。

ex.en: Teaching drama in schools can develop students' confidence and encourage them to consider different perspectives.
ex.zh: 在學校教授戲劇可以培養學生的自信，並鼓勵他們從不同角度思考。

words.tip: 戲劇藝術用不可數drama；一部戲劇用a drama。

def: n. the business of drawing public attention to goods and services
The activity or business of promoting products and services.

ex.en: My sister works in advertising and designs colourful posters.
ex.zh: 我姐姐從事廣告工作，設計色彩鮮豔的海報。

ex.en: Advertising can influence consumer choices, which is why campaigns aimed at children require careful regulation.
ex.zh: 廣告會影響消費者的選擇，因此針對兒童的廣告活動需要受到嚴格監管。

words.tip: 通常不可數；一則具體廣告用an advertisement。

tr: n. 生產量, 投資收益
vt. 出產, 給予, 讓出, 放棄, 使屈服
vi. 出產, 屈服, 投降, 倒塌
def: n. an amount of a product
v. be the cause or source of
v. give in, as to influence or pressure

ex.en: Our apple tree yielded three baskets of fruit.
ex.zh: 我們的蘋果樹結出了三籃果實。

ex.en: Investment in agricultural research can yield substantial benefits for food security without expanding farmland.
ex.zh: 對農業研究的投資可以在不擴大耕地的情況下，為糧食安全帶來顯著益處。

words.tip: yield results指產生結果；yield to指向……讓步。

tr: n. 證言, 證據, 聲明
def: n. a solemn statement made under oath
n. an assertion offering firsthand authentication of a fact
n. something that serves as evidence

tr: n. 室, 房間, 槍膛
vt. 裝(彈藥), 把...關在室內
def: n. a natural or artificial enclosed space
n. an enclosed volume in the body
n. a room where a judge transacts business

ex.en: We waited outside the chamber while the council met.
ex.zh: 市議會開會時，我們在會議廳外等候。

ex.en: The upper chamber of parliament reviews proposed laws before they can receive final approval.
ex.zh: 議會上院在法律草案獲得最終批准前對其進行審議。

words.tip: chamber多指專用房間或封閉腔室，不是普通臥室。

tr: n. 合作, 協力, 配合
def: n. joint operation or action
n. the practice of cooperating
the act of working together towards a shared goal

ex.en: Cleaning the shared kitchen requires cooperation from everyone.
ex.zh: 清潔共用廚房需要大家的配合。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential for addressing environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
ex.zh: 應對跨越單個國家邊界的環境問題，國際合作至關重要。

words.tip: 通常不可數；與……合作用in cooperation with。

tr: n. 側面, 輪廓, 傳略
vt. 描繪...輪廓, 寫...的傳略
[計] 提問檔; 剖面圖法; 剖面法
def: n. an analysis (often in graphical form) representing the extent to which something exhibits various characteristics
n. an outline of something (especially a human face as seen from one side)
n. biographical sketch

ex.en: She drew her grandfather's profile with a soft pencil.
ex.zh: 她用軟鉛筆畫出了祖父的側面輪廓。

ex.en: Public exhibitions can raise the profile of local artists and attract visitors to smaller towns.
ex.zh: 公共展覽能提高當地藝術家的知名度，並吸引遊客前往小城鎮。

col: raise the profile of｜提高……的知名度
keep a low profile｜保持低調
words.tip: in profile指呈側面；a high profile指高關注度。

tr: n. 機械, 機構, 結構, 機理, 技巧
[化] 機理; 歷程; 機構
def: n. the atomic process that occurs during a chemical reaction
n. the technical aspects of doing something
n. a natural object resembling a machine in structure or function

ex.en: The club needs a fair mechanism for resolving disputes.
ex.zh: 俱樂部需要一個公平的爭議解決機制。

ex.en: Governments should establish effective monitoring mechanisms to ensure that environmental regulations are consistently enforced across industries.
ex.zh: 政府應建立有效的監督機制，確保各行業始終貫徹執行環境法規。

words.tip: mechanism for doing表示“做某事的機制或辦法”。

tr: n. 處罰, 刑罰, 罰款, 罰球, 報應, 不利結果, 妨礙
def: n. a payment required for not fulfilling a contract
n. the disadvantage or painful consequences of an action or condition
n. (games) a handicap or disadvantage that is imposed on a competitor (or a team) for an infraction of the rules of the game

tr: n. 度假勝地, 手段, 憑藉, 常去之地
def: n. a hotel located in a resort area
a place people visit for holidays and leisure
to use something undesirable because other options have failed

ex.en: We stayed at a quiet resort beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我們住在湖邊一處安靜的度假村。

ex.en: Governments should not resort to cutting education budgets when seeking solutions to short-term financial problems.
ex.zh: 政府在尋求短期財政問題的解決辦法時，不應採取削減教育預算的措施。

col: as a last resort｜作為最後的辦法
words.tip: resort to中to是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

def: a. has little chance of being the case or coming about
Not expected to happen or be true.
Surprising because someone or something does not seem suitable.

ex.en: With such dark clouds, sunshine seems unlikely this afternoon.
ex.zh: 雲層這麼黑，今天下午看來不太可能有陽光。

ex.en: Public transport use is unlikely to increase unless services become more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 除非服務變得更可靠、票價更實惠，否則公共交通的使用量不太可能增加。

col: unlikely to happen｜不太可能發生
an unlikely friendship｜出人意料的友誼
words.tip: 常用be unlikely to do或It is unlikely that。

def: n. the noise made by a short puff of steam (as from an engine)
v. breathe noisily, as when one is exhausted
v. utter while panting, as if out of breath

tr: n. 傳染, 影響, 傳染病
def: n. the pathological state resulting from the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms
n. (phonetics) the alteration of a speech sound under the influence of a neighboring sound
n. (medicine) the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms and their multiplication which can lead to tissue damage and disease

ex.en: The doctor checked my sore throat for signs of infection.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查了我疼痛的喉嚨，看是否有感染跡象。

ex.en: Improved sanitation can reduce the risk of infection, particularly in communities with limited access to clean water.
ex.zh: 改善衛生條件可以降低感染風險，尤其是在難以獲得潔淨水的社區。

words.tip: infection既可指感染過程，也可指一次具體感染。

tr: a. 內閣的, 細木工做的
def: n. a piece of furniture resembling a cupboard with doors and shelves and drawers; for storage or display
n. persons appointed by a head of state to head executive departments of government and act as official advisers
n. a storage compartment for clothes and valuables; usually it has a lock

ex.en: The clean cups are in the cabinet above the sink.
ex.zh: 乾淨杯子放在水槽上方的櫥櫃裡。

ex.en: The cabinet approved a national programme to improve access to affordable housing in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 內閣批准了一項全國性計劃，以增加快速發展城市中可負擔住房的供應。

words.tip: 可指傢俱或內閣；內閣由政府高級部長組成。

tr: vi. 繼續進行, 進行, 開始, 發出, 起訴
[法] 所得, 收入, 收益
def: v. move ahead; travel onward in time or space
v. follow a certain course
Continue an activity or move to its next stage.

ex.en: We can proceed with dinner once everyone arrives.
ex.zh: 等大家都到了，我們就可以繼續安排晚餐了。

ex.en: Local authorities should consult residents before they proceed with major changes to public transport.
ex.zh: 地方政府在繼續推進公共交通重大調整前，應徵詢居民意見。

col: proceed with a plan｜繼續實施計劃
proceed to the next stage｜進入下一階段
words.tip: proceed是動詞；表示收入的名詞是proceeds。

def: n. the act of gambling
v. maintain with or as if with a bet
v. stake on the outcome of an issue

ex.en: I bet you left your keys in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我敢說你把鑰匙落在廚房了。

ex.en: Some investors bet on emerging technologies despite considerable uncertainty about their future commercial success.
ex.zh: 一些投資者押注新興技術，儘管這些技術未來能否取得商業成功仍很不確定。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞通常仍是bet；I bet常表確信。

tr: a. 戰略的, 戰略上的
def: a. relating to or concerned with strategy
s. highly important to or an integral part of a strategy or plan of action especially in war
relating to plans for achieving important long-term goals

ex.en: We made a strategic decision to save before moving.
ex.zh: 我們從長遠考慮，決定先攢錢再搬家。

ex.en: Strategic investment in public transport can reduce congestion and support economic growth over the long term.
ex.zh: 對公共交通進行戰略性投資，可以緩解擁堵並支持長期經濟增長。

words.tip: strategic重整體長遠規劃，tactical重具體戰術。

def: n. a disagreement or argument about something important
n. coming into conflict with
a serious disagreement between people or groups

ex.en: Our neighbours settled their dispute over the garden fence.
ex.zh: 鄰居們解決了他們關於花園圍欄的爭執。

ex.en: Independent experts dispute the claim that building more roads will permanently reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 獨立專家質疑修建更多道路能永久緩解交通擁堵這一說法。

col: a dispute over pay｜薪酬爭議
dispute a claim｜質疑某項說法
words.tip: dispute a claim是質疑說法，不是討論說法。

tr: a. 不平常的, 值得注意的, 顯著的
def: s. unusual or striking
unusual or impressive enough to deserve special attention

ex.en: The injured bird made a remarkable recovery within weeks.
ex.zh: 這隻受傷的鳥在幾週內恢復得出奇地好。

ex.en: Recent advances in renewable energy demonstrate the remarkable potential of technology to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源領域的近期進展表明，技術在減少對化石燃料的依賴方面具有非凡潛力。

words.tip: 表示值得注意，常含讚賞，但不一定只描述好事。

tr: vt. 佔領, 佔(時間、空間等), 住進, 擔任, 使從事, 使全神貫注
[法] 佔領, 佔據, 佔有
def: v. live (in a certain place)
v. occupy the whole of
to fill or use a space, place, or period

ex.en: These old boxes occupy most of our spare room.
ex.zh: 這些舊箱子佔了我們閒置房間的大部分空間。

ex.en: Private cars occupy valuable urban space that could otherwise accommodate parks, cycle lanes, or wider pavements.
ex.zh: 私家車佔用了寶貴的城市空間，而這些空間本可用於建設公園、自行車道或更寬的人行道。

words.tip: 忙於某事可用be occupied with或in doing。

tr: n. 相會, 相遇, 遭遇
vt. 遇見, 邂逅, 會戰
def: n. a casual meeting with a person or thing
meet someone or experience something, especially unexpectedly
an unexpected meeting or experience involving someone or something

ex.en: We encountered a curious fox on our evening walk.
ex.zh: 我們傍晚散步時遇到了一隻好奇的狐狸。

ex.en: Students studying abroad may encounter cultural differences that challenge their assumptions about communication and social behaviour.
ex.zh: 留學生可能遇到文化差異，從而反思自己對溝通和社會行為的原有看法。

words.tip: 動詞直接接賓語；名詞常用an encounter with。

tr: a. 創始的, 遺傳的, 起源的, 遺傳學的
def: a. pertaining to or referring to origin
a. of or relating to the science of genetics
relating to genes or characteristics passed from parents to offspring

ex.en: The doctor explained how genetic factors affect eye colour.
ex.zh: 醫生解釋了遺傳因素如何影響眼睛的顏色。

ex.en: Genetic research may help doctors identify health risks before patients develop any noticeable symptoms.
ex.zh: 基因研究可能幫助醫生在患者出現明顯症狀之前識別健康風險。

words.tip: genetic指基因或遺傳的；genetics是遺傳學。

tr: n. 發言人, 代言者
def: n. a male spokesperson
A man who speaks officially for a group or organisation

ex.en: A spokesman explained why the swimming pool was closed.
ex.zh: 一位男發言人解釋了游泳池關閉的原因。

ex.en: The government spokesman announced that additional funding would support public transport improvements in rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府男發言人宣佈，將追加資金支持農村地區的公共交通改善。

col: a government spokesman｜政府男發言人
a company spokesman｜公司男發言人
words.tip: 特指男性；不強調性別時用spokesperson。

tr: vt. 保持, 保有, 留住, 記得, 付定金聘請
def: v. hold back within
v. allow to remain in a place or position or maintain a property or feature
v. secure and keep for possible future use or application

ex.en: This old house still retains its original wooden doors.
ex.zh: 這座老房子仍保留著原來的木門。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help companies retain experienced employees while improving overall job satisfaction.
ex.zh: 靈活的工作安排能幫助企業留住經驗豐富的員工，同時提高整體工作滿意度。

words.tip: 正式用詞，直接接賓語；記住知識也可用retain。

def: n. a positive motivational influence
something that encourages someone to act or work harder

ex.en: The free lunch gave us an incentive to stay.
ex.zh: 免費午餐讓我們有了留下來的動力。

ex.en: Governments can offer financial incentives to encourage households to install solar panels and reduce energy consumption.
ex.zh: 政府可以提供經濟激勵，鼓勵家庭安裝太陽能板並減少能源消耗。

words.tip: 常用 incentive to do sth，表示做某事的動力。

tr: a. 正確的, 精確的
def: a. conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy
s. (of ideas, images, representations, expressions) characterized by perfect conformity to fact or truth; strictly correct
correct and free from mistakes

ex.en: This kitchen scale is accurate enough for baking bread.
ex.zh: 這臺廚房秤的精度足以用來做麵包。

ex.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 準確的空氣質量信息能幫助居民在充分知情的情況下決定是否進行戶外鍛鍊。

words.tip: accurate強調準確無誤；precise更強調細節精確。

tr: [法] 考慮到, 鑑於, 就...而論
def: adv. At which place; where.
conj. Considering that; it being the case that; since; --
used to introduce a preamble which is the basis of declarations,

tr: n. 擴充, 開展, 膨脹
def: n. the act of increasing (something) in size or volume or quantity or scope
n. a function expressed as a sum or product of terms
n. a discussion that provides additional information

ex.en: The kitchen expansion gave us room for a table.
ex.zh: 廚房擴建後，我們有地方放餐桌了。

ex.en: Rapid urban expansion can threaten nearby farmland unless local authorities introduce effective planning controls.
ex.zh: 如果地方政府不實施有效的規劃管控，快速的城市擴張可能威脅周邊農田。

words.tip: 動詞是expand，名詞拼寫變為expansion。

tr: n. 精華, 精銳, 中堅分子
def: n. a group or class of persons enjoying superior intellectual or social or economic status

tr: a. 奇數的, 古怪的, 剩餘的, 零散的, 各種各樣的, 少量的
n. 奇特的事物, 怪人
[計] 奇數, 奇校驗, 光數據數字轉換器
def: a. not divisible by two
s. not easily explained
s. an indefinite quantity more than that specified

ex.en: There is an odd smell coming from the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱裡傳出一股怪味。

ex.en: It may seem odd that some rapidly growing cities still lack reliable access to clean drinking water.
ex.zh: 一些快速發展的城市仍無法穩定獲得清潔飲用水，這可能顯得令人費解。

words.tip: the odd加單數名詞常表示偶爾的某事。

def: n. the sacred writings of the Christian religions
n. a book regarded as authoritative in its field
the collection of sacred writings used in Christianity

ex.en: She keeps a Bible on the shelf beside her bed.
ex.zh: 她在床邊的架子上放著一本《聖經》。

ex.en: Studying the Bible can help students understand religious references in European literature and visual art.
ex.zh: 研讀《聖經》可以幫助學生理解歐洲文學和視覺藝術中的宗教典故。

words.tip: 指《聖經》時首字母大寫，通常用the Bible。

def: s. difficult to analyze or understand
Having many connected parts and therefore difficult to understand or manage.

ex.en: This recipe is too complicated for a quick lunch.
ex.zh: 這道菜的做法太複雜，不適合趕時間做午飯。

ex.en: Complicated application procedures may discourage eligible students from seeking financial support for their university studies.
ex.zh: 複雜的申請程序可能使符合條件的學生不願申請大學學業資助。

words.tip: 強調複雜難懂；complex也可僅指結構複雜。

tr: n. 長條, 條狀, 帶, 脫衣舞
vt. 脫衣, 被剝去, 剝奪, 拆卸
def: n. a relatively long narrow piece of something
n. artifact consisting of a narrow flat piece of material
n. thin piece of wood or metal

ex.en: Cut the paper into strips for our craft project.
ex.zh: 把紙剪成條，用於我們的手工製作。

ex.en: Planting strips of wildflowers beside farmland can provide habitats for insects and support local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在農田旁種植帶狀野花，可以為昆蟲提供棲息地，並維護當地生物多樣性。

col: strip someone of their rights｜剝奪某人的權利
words.tip: strip的過去式為stripped；剝奪用strip sb of sth。

tr: vt. 解釋, 演出, 翻譯, 理解
def: v. make sense of; assign a meaning to
v. give an interpretation or rendition of
To explain or understand the meaning of something

ex.en: I interpreted her smile as permission to sit down.
ex.zh: 我把她的微笑理解為允許我坐下。

ex.en: Researchers must interpret survey results carefully because cultural differences may influence how participants understand the questions.
ex.zh: 研究人員必須謹慎解讀調查結果，因為文化差異可能影響參與者對問題的理解。

col: interpret something as｜將某事理解為
words.tip: interpret可指口譯；筆譯通常用translate。

tr: vt. 發現, 察覺, 探測
[法] 發現, 查明, 探測
def: v. discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of

tr: n. 推薦, 介紹, 推薦信, 勸告
def: n. something (as a course of action) that is recommended as advisable
n. something that recommends (or expresses commendation of) a person or thing as worthy or desirable
n. any quality or characteristic that gains a person a favorable reception or acceptance or admission

ex.en: On your recommendation, I started taking short evening walks.
ex.zh: 聽了你的建議，我開始在傍晚散一小會兒步。

ex.en: The committee's main recommendation was to improve public transport before introducing higher parking charges in the city centre.
ex.zh: 委員會的主要建議是先改善公共交通，再提高市中心的停車費。

words.tip: recommendation後的that從句常用should或動詞原形。

tr: a. 巨大的, 非常的, 可怕的
def: s extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree; that a whole civilization should be dependent on technology"- Walter Lippman
s extraordinarily good or great; used especially as intensifiers
s extreme in degree or extent or amount or impact

ex.en: Moving that heavy sofa upstairs took a tremendous effort.
ex.zh: 把那張沉重的沙發搬上樓費了極大的力氣。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth places tremendous pressure on housing, transport networks and essential public services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速發展給住房、交通網絡和基本公共服務帶來了巨大壓力。

col: a tremendous achievement｜了不起的成就
words.tip: 常強調程度或數量極大，不只指體積大。

tr: n. 狩獵, 獵狐, 探求
def: n the pursuit and killing or capture of wild animals regarded as a sport
n the activity of looking thoroughly in order to find something or someone
n the work of finding and killing or capturing animals for food or pelts

ex.en: We spotted fresh animal tracks during our hunting trip.
ex.zh: 我們在狩獵途中發現了新鮮的動物足跡。

ex.en: Restrictions on hunting can help protect endangered species and maintain balanced ecosystems in vulnerable natural habitats.
ex.zh: 限制狩獵有助於保護瀕危物種，並維持脆弱自然棲息地的生態平衡。

words.tip: 常作不可數名詞；job hunting指找工作。

tr: n. 日記, 雜誌, 日報
def: n. a periodical dedicated to a particular subject
n. a record book as a physical object
n. the part of the axle contained by a bearing

ex.en: I keep a journal beside my bed every night.
ex.zh: 我每晚都把一本日記放在床邊。

ex.en: Researchers publish their findings in academic journals so that other experts can evaluate the evidence.
ex.zh: 研究人員在學術期刊上發表成果，以便其他專家評估相關證據。

words.tip: journal常指專業期刊；表示私人記錄時近似diary。

tr: [計] 識別, 議定, 明白
def: n. having knowledge of
n. state of elementary or undifferentiated consciousness

tr: n. 甲板, (汽車後部的)行李倉
vt. 裝飾, 打扮, 裝甲板
def: n. any of various platforms built into a vessel
n. street name for a packet of illegal drugs
n. a porch that resembles the deck on a ship

ex.en: We stood on deck and watched dolphins swim past.
ex.zh: 我們站在甲板上，看著海豚遊過。

ex.en: Passengers on the upper deck of sightseeing buses can enjoy clear views of historic buildings.
ex.zh: 觀光巴士上層的乘客可以清楚地欣賞歷史建築。

col: upper deck｜上層甲板；巴士上層
a deck of cards｜一副紙牌
words.tip: 一副紙牌美式常用deck，英式也常用pack。

tr: n. 布里斯托爾(英國西部港口)
def: n. an industrial city and port in southwestern England near the mouth of the River Avon
A city in southwestern England with a historic port.

ex.en: We walked around the harbour in Bristol yesterday.
ex.zh: 我們昨天在布里斯托爾的港口周圍散了步。

ex.en: Bristol provides an interesting example of how historic waterfront areas can be adapted for modern urban life.
ex.zh: 布里斯托爾提供了一個有趣的例子，展示歷史悠久的濱水地區如何適應現代城市生活。

col: central Bristol｜布里斯托爾市中心
the city of Bristol｜布里斯托爾市
words.tip: 重音在首音節；位於英格蘭西南部。

tr: n. 模態, 調式, 樣式, 文體, 狀態, 方式, 風尚
[計] 方式; DOS外部命令:設定各種設備命令
def: n. a particular functioning condition or arrangement
n. any of various fixed orders of the various diatonic notes within an octave
n. the most frequent value of a random variable

ex.en: I switched my phone to silent mode before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚飯前，我把手機調成了靜音模式。

ex.en: Cycling is an environmentally friendly mode of transport that can also improve public health in urban areas.
ex.zh: 騎行是一種環保的交通方式，也能改善城市居民的健康。

words.tip: 方式常用mode of；設備處於某模式用in ... mode。

tr: a. 在前的, 高級的, 先進的, 年老的
[法] 預付的, 預支的, 墊付的
def: s. farther along in physical or mental development
s. comparatively late in a course of development
s. ahead of the times

ex.en: This advanced camera takes clear pictures even at night.
ex.zh: 這臺先進的相機即使在夜間也能拍出清晰的照片。

ex.en: Advanced medical technology can improve patient outcomes, but its high cost may increase inequalities in healthcare access.
ex.zh: 先進的醫療技術可以改善治療效果，但其高昂成本可能加劇醫療服務獲取方面的不平等。

col: at an advanced stage｜處於後期階段
words.tip: advanced表示先進或高級；預先通知用advance notice。

tr: a. 相互的, 共有的
def: s common to or shared by two or more parties
a concerning each of two or more persons or things; especially given or done in return
Felt or done by each person towards the other.

ex.en: Our friendship grew through mutual trust and honest conversations.
ex.zh: 我們的友誼通過相互信任和坦誠交流而加深。

ex.en: Successful international cooperation depends on mutual respect and a willingness to address shared environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 成功的國際合作有賴於相互尊重，以及共同應對環境挑戰的意願。

words.tip: mutual friend是共同朋友，不是彼此的朋友。

tr: n. 遞送, 交付, 分娩, 交貨, 引渡
def: n. the act of delivering or distributing something (as goods or mail)
n. the event of giving birth
n. the voluntary transfer of something (title or possession) from one party to another

ex.en: Our grocery delivery arrived just before we started cooking.
ex.zh: 我們訂購的食品雜貨在開始做飯前剛好送到了。

ex.en: The growing demand for home delivery has increased traffic congestion in many urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 不斷增長的送貨上門需求加劇了許多城市社區的交通擁堵。

words.tip: delivery指遞送服務或過程；deliver是動詞。

tr: n. 理想, 典範, 觀念, 思想, 最後目標
a. 理想的, 完美的, 空想的, 觀念的, 唯心論的
def: n. the idea of something that is perfect; something that one hopes to attain
n. model of excellence or perfection of a kind; one having no equal
s. conforming to an ultimate standard of perfection or excellence; embodying an ideal

ex.en: This quiet corner is ideal for reading after lunch.
ex.zh: 這個安靜的角落最適合午飯後看書。

ex.en: An ideal public transport system would be affordable, reliable, and accessible to residents of all ages.
ex.zh: 理想的公共交通系統應價格合理、運行可靠，並方便各年齡段居民使用。

col: an ideal solution｜理想的解決方案
live up to an ideal｜達到理想標準
words.tip: ideal for後接名詞或動名詞，表示最適合某用途。

tr: adv. 有規則地, 一絲不苟地, 正式地
def: r. in a regular manner
r. having a regular form
r. in a regular way without variation

ex.en: We regularly walk along the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我們經常晚飯後沿著河邊散步。

ex.en: People who exercise regularly are more likely to maintain good physical health as they grow older.
ex.zh: 經常鍛鍊的人隨著年齡增長，更有可能保持良好的身體健康。

words.tip: 可表示經常，也可表示固定間隔；不一定指每天。

tr: n. 工作, 運轉, 勞動
a. 工作的, 勞動的, 經營的, 抽搐的, 運轉的
def: n. a mine or quarry that is being or has been worked
s. actively engaged in paid work
s. adequate for practical use; especially sufficient in strength or numbers to accomplish something

tr: [計] 段落重排, 兩端對齊
def: v. show to be reasonable or provide adequate ground for
v. show to be right by providing justification or proof
v. adjust the spaces between words

ex.en: I cannot justify buying another coat this winter.
ex.zh: 我找不到理由今年冬天再買一件外套。

ex.en: Governments must justify major infrastructure spending by demonstrating clear benefits for the wider community.
ex.zh: 政府必須通過展示對整個社區的明確益處，來證明重大基礎設施支出的合理性。

col: justify a decision｜為決定提供理由
justify the cost｜證明費用合理
justify doing something｜證明做某事合理
words.tip: justify後接名詞或動名詞，不接不定式。

tr: n. 抗議, 反對, 抗議書, 斷言
v. 反對, 抗議, 斷言
def: n. a formal and solemn declaration of objection
n. the act of protesting; a public (often organized) manifestation of dissent
n. the act of making a strong public expression of disagreement and disapproval

ex.en: Residents held a peaceful protest outside the town hall.
ex.zh: 居民在市政廳外舉行了一場和平抗議。

ex.en: Citizens may protest against environmental policies that fail to protect local forests and water supplies.
ex.zh: 公民可能會抗議那些未能保護當地森林和水源的環境政策。

words.tip: 所列為名詞音；動詞英音/prəˈtest/，常接against。

tr: [經] 協議, 協定, 協商
def: n. a written agreement between two states or sovereigns
a formal agreement between countries

ex.en: We heard about the new treaty on the radio.
ex.zh: 我們從廣播中聽說了這項新條約。

ex.en: An international treaty can establish shared environmental standards, but its success depends on effective enforcement.
ex.zh: 國際條約可以確立共同的環境標準，但其成功取決於有效執行。

words.tip: 通常指國家間正式協議，不表示談判過程。

tr: n. 技藝, 手藝, 詭計
def: n. a vehicle designed for navigation in or on water or air or through outer space
n. people who perform a particular kind of skilled work
n. skill in an occupation or trade

ex.en: My neighbour teaches the craft of weaving willow baskets.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居教授用柳條編籃子的手藝。

ex.en: Traditional craft workshops can preserve cultural knowledge while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.
ex.zh: 傳統手工藝作坊既能保存文化知識，也能為農村社區創造就業機會。

col: craft a proposal｜精心擬訂提案
words.tip: 表示船或飛行器時，craft的單複數形式相同。

tr: n. 察看, 洞察力, 見識
[醫] 自知力, 洞察, 頓悟
def: n. a feeling of understanding
n. the clear (and often sudden) understanding of a complex situation
n. grasping the inner nature of things intuitively

ex.en: Helping at the bakery gave me insight into running a business.
ex.zh: 在麵包店幫忙讓我深入瞭解瞭如何經營一家店。

ex.en: Interviews with local residents provide valuable insight into how urban redevelopment affects community relationships and daily routines.
ex.zh: 對當地居民的訪談有助於深入瞭解城市改造如何影響社區關係和日常生活。

words.tip: 常用insight into；泛指理解力時通常不可數。

tr: a. 廣的, 廣泛的, 多方面的
def: s. large in spatial extent or range or scope or quantity
a. of agriculture; increasing productivity by using large areas with minimal outlay and labor
covering many subjects or involving a large amount

ex.en: The storm caused extensive damage to our roof.
ex.zh: 暴風雨使我們家的屋頂大面積受損。

ex.en: Extensive research is needed before governments introduce major changes to the national education system.
ex.zh: 政府對國家教育制度進行重大改革之前，需要開展廣泛研究。

words.tip: 強調範圍廣或數量多；intensive強調集中、強度高。

tr: n. 插曲, 插話, 有趣的事件, 一段情節
[醫] 插話, 插曲, 發作
def: n. a happening that is distinctive in a series of related events
n. a brief section of a literary or dramatic work that forms part of a connected series
n. a part of a broadcast serial

ex.en: We watched the final episode together after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚飯後，我們一起看了最後一集。

ex.en: Each episode of the documentary explores how urban development affects wildlife in different parts of the world.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片每一集都探討城市發展如何影響世界不同地區的野生動物。

col: a brief episode｜一段短暫經歷
words.tip: episode指一集；series指整部系列或連續劇。

tr: a. 相當的, 可觀的, 重要的
def: a. large or relatively large in number or amount or extent or degree
Large in amount, size, or degree.

ex.en: Repairing the roof took considerable time and effort.
ex.zh: 修理屋頂花了相當多的時間和精力。

ex.en: Expanding public transport requires considerable investment, but it can reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 擴大公共交通需要大量投資，但可以緩解擁堵並改善城市空氣質量。

words.tip: considerable指數量或程度大；considerate指體貼的。

tr: a. 更重要的, 較早的, 在先的
n. 小隱修院院長, 大隱修院副院長
def: n. the head of a religious order; in an abbey the prior is next below the abbot
existing or happening before something else

ex.en: You need prior permission to use this room.
ex.zh: 你需要事先獲得許可才能使用這個房間。

ex.en: Applicants with prior experience in community work may adapt more quickly to roles in public services.
ex.zh: 有社區工作經驗的申請者可能更快適應公共服務崗位。

words.tip: prior常放名詞前；prior to相當於before。

tr: n. 有知識者, 知識分子, 憑理智做事者
a. 智力的, 用腦力的, 聰明的
def: n. a person who uses the mind creatively
s. of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind
a. appealing to or using the intellect

ex.en: She enjoys the intellectual challenge of learning a new language.
ex.zh: 她喜歡學習新語言帶來的智力挑戰。

ex.en: Schools should support intellectual development through activities that encourage students to question assumptions and evaluate evidence.
ex.zh: 學校應通過鼓勵學生質疑假設、評估證據的活動來促進智力發展。

words.tip: intellectual強調思維活動；intelligent強調聰明。

tr: vt. 描繪...的特性, 刻劃...的性格
def: v. be characteristic of
To be a typical or distinguishing feature of something.
To describe the main qualities of someone or something.

ex.en: Bright colours and bold patterns characterize her handmade bags.
ex.zh: 鮮豔的色彩和醒目的圖案是她手工包的特色。

ex.en: High housing costs and limited public space characterize many large cities, affecting residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 住房成本高、公共空間有限是許多大城市的特點，影響著居民的生活質量。

col: characterize something as｜將某事物描述為
words.tip: 英式也拼characterise；被動式常接by。

def: n. close fighting during the culmination of a military attack
n. a threatened or attempted physical attack by someone who appears to be able to cause bodily harm if not stopped
n. thoroughbred that won the triple crown in 1946

ex.en: A witness reported the assault to a nearby police officer.
ex.zh: 一名目擊者向附近的警察報告了這起襲擊事件。

ex.en: Better street lighting may reduce the risk of assault and help residents feel safer after dark.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可能降低人身襲擊風險，讓居民在天黑後更有安全感。

col: an assault on someone｜對某人的襲擊
report an assault｜報告襲擊事件
words.tip: 名詞常接on；動詞直接接人，不加介詞。

tr: a. 外部的, 客觀的, 表面的
def: n. outward features
a. happening or arising or located outside or beyond some limits or especially surface
s. coming from the outside

ex.en: The builders painted the external walls pale yellow.
ex.zh: 建築工人把外牆刷成了淡黃色。

ex.en: Universities often rely on external funding to conduct research that cannot be supported by tuition fees alone.
ex.zh: 大學經常依賴外部資金，開展僅靠學費無法支持的研究。

col: for external use only｜僅供外用
words.tip: external與internal相對；藥品上指外用的。

tr: n. 摩擦, 困難, 障礙, 磨損處
vt. 擦, 搓, 摩擦, 惹怒
def: n. the act of rubbing or wiping
v. move over something with pressure
v. cause friction

ex.en: She rubbed her cold hands together beside the heater.
ex.zh: 她在暖氣旁搓著冰冷的雙手。

ex.en: Protective gloves prevent workers from rubbing their skin against rough surfaces when handling heavy materials.
ex.zh: 搬運重物時，防護手套可以避免工人的皮膚與粗糙表面摩擦。

col: give something a rub｜擦一擦某物
words.tip: 過去式rubbed、現在分詞rubbing均雙寫b。

tr: n. 論爭, 辯論, 論戰, 爭論
[法] 論戰, 爭論, 爭吵
def: n. a contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
Strong public disagreement about a particular issue.

ex.en: The plan to close our pool sparked local controversy.
ex.zh: 關閉我們游泳池的計劃在當地引發了爭議。

ex.en: The use of facial recognition in public spaces has generated controversy over privacy and personal freedom.
ex.zh: 在公共場所使用人臉識別技術引發了有關隱私和個人自由的爭議。

col: a subject of controversy｜有爭議的話題
words.tip: 多指公眾對某議題的爭議，不是普通口角。

tr: n. 悲劇, 慘案, 悲劇作品
[法] 慘事, 災難, 不辛
def: n. drama in which the protagonist is overcome by some superior force or circumstance; excites terror or pity
An event causing great suffering, sadness, or loss.
A serious play or story ending in suffering or death.

ex.en: The whole village came together after the tragedy.
ex.zh: 慘劇發生後，全村人團結起來了。

ex.en: Improved road design and stricter safety regulations can help prevent the tragedy of avoidable traffic deaths.
ex.zh: 改進道路設計並加強安全規定，有助於防止本可避免的交通死亡悲劇。

words.tip: 既指現實中的慘事，也指文學悲劇；後者與comedy相對。

tr: vt. 構成, 組成, 任命
def: v. form or compose
To be the parts that form a whole
To be considered a particular thing

ex.en: Vegetables constitute most of the food in our fridge.
ex.zh: 我們冰箱裡的食物大部分是蔬菜。

ex.en: Rising housing costs constitute a major barrier to financial independence for young adults in large cities.
ex.zh: 不斷上漲的住房成本構成了大城市年輕人實現經濟獨立的一大障礙。

col: constitute a committee｜正式成立委員會
words.tip: 表組成時通常以部分作主語，整體作賓語。

def: v. make an alteration to
v. remove the ovaries of
To change, or make something different.

ex.en: Could you alter these trousers so they fit better?
ex.zh: 你能改一下這條褲子，讓它更合身嗎？

ex.en: Rising temperatures may alter rainfall patterns and create serious challenges for farmers in dry regions.
ex.zh: 氣溫上升可能改變降雨模式，給乾旱地區的農民帶來嚴峻挑戰。

words.tip: 可及物也可不及物；altar是“祭壇”，勿混。

tr: n. 皈依者, 改變宗教信仰者
vt. 使改變信仰, 轉換, 兌換, 倒置
def: n. a person who has been converted to another religious or political belief
v. change from one system to another or to a new plan or policy
v. change the nature, purpose, or function of something

ex.en: We converted the spare bedroom into a small office.
ex.zh: 我們把空閒的臥室改成了一間小辦公室。

ex.en: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity, allowing households to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 太陽能電池板將陽光轉化為電能，使家庭能夠減少對化石燃料的依賴。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞重音在前。

tr: a. 卓越的, 顯著的, 突出的, 凸出的
def: s having a quality that thrusts itself into attention
s conspicuous in position or importance
Important, well known, or influential

ex.en: A prominent local artist opened the exhibition yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天，一位當地著名藝術家為展覽揭幕。

ex.en: Universities play a prominent role in developing technologies that support the transition to renewable energy.
ex.zh: 大學在開發支持向可再生能源轉型的技術方面發揮著重要作用。

words.tip: 既可指人物重要知名，也可指位置或外形顯眼。

tr: a. 過了中年的, 稍老的
def: n people who are old collectively
s advanced in years; (`aged' is pronounced as two syllables)
old, especially when describing people

ex.en: An elderly neighbour showed me how to grow tomatoes.
ex.zh: 一位年長的鄰居教我如何種番茄。

ex.en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that elderly residents can remain active and independent.
ex.zh: 城市應提供無障礙公共交通，讓老年居民能夠保持活躍並獨立生活。

words.tip: 指人年老，不指中年；older people通常更中性。

tr: n. 柏林, (軟質)柏林毛線
def: n. capital of Germany located in eastern Germany
n. United States songwriter (born in Russia) who wrote more than 1500 songs and several musical comedies (1888-1989)
