n. a limousine with a glass partition between the front and back seats

tr: n. 片段, 部分, 分節, 段
def: n. one of the parts into which something naturally divides
v. divide into segments
v. divide or split up

ex.en: He offered me a juicy segment of orange.
ex.zh: 他遞給我一瓣多汁的橙子。

ex.en: Companies often segment their customers by age to develop more effective advertising strategies.
ex.zh: 企業常按年齡劃分顧客群體，以制定更有效的廣告策略。

words.tip: 名詞重音在前；動詞讀/seɡˈment/。

tr: a. 令人興奮的, 刺激的
def: a. creating or arousing excitement
s. stimulating interest and discussion
Making someone feel eager, enthusiastic, or thrilled.

ex.en: The final minutes of the match were incredibly exciting.
ex.zh: 比賽最後幾分鐘精彩刺激極了。

ex.en: Advances in renewable energy offer exciting opportunities for young engineers seeking to address global environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 可再生能源的進步為希望應對全球環境挑戰的年輕工程師提供了令人振奮的機會。

words.tip: exciting形容令人興奮的事物；excited形容人的感受。

tr: n. 變更, 變化, 變種, 變奏
[醫] 變異, 變易; 變度
def: n. an instance of change; the rate or magnitude of change
n. an activity that varies from a norm or standard
n. a repetition of a musical theme in which it is modified or embellished

ex.en: This soup is a spicy variation on my grandmother's recipe.
ex.zh: 這道湯是在我祖母的食譜基礎上改成的辣味版本。

ex.en: Seasonal variation in rainfall can significantly affect agricultural productivity, particularly in regions with limited irrigation infrastructure.
ex.zh: 降雨量的季節性變化會顯著影響農業生產力，尤其是在灌溉設施有限的地區。

col: a variation on a theme｜同一主題的變體
words.tip: variation in指某方面的差異；variation on指變體。

tr: n. 激進分子, 詞根, 基礎, 根式, 根
a. 激進的, 根本的, 基本的, 根的
def: n. a person who has radical ideas or opinions
n. (mathematics) a quantity expressed as the root of another quantity
n. a character conveying the lexical meaning of a logogram

ex.en: Turning our garage into a kitchen was a radical change.
ex.zh: 把車庫改成廚房是一次徹底的改變。

ex.en: Reducing dependence on private cars requires radical changes to urban planning and public transport investment.
ex.zh: 減少對私家車的依賴，需要徹底改變城市規劃和公共交通投資方式。

words.tip: radical change指根本性改變，不一定涉及政治。

tr: n. 通訊記者, 通信者
[經] 客戶, 代理商行, 代理銀行
def: n. someone who communicates by means of letters
n. a journalist employed to provide news stories for newspapers or broadcast media
A journalist reporting from a particular place or on a subject.

ex.en: The correspondent reported live from the crowded harbour.
ex.zh: 記者從擁擠的港口進行了現場報道。

ex.en: A foreign correspondent needs cultural knowledge to explain international events accurately to audiences at home.
ex.zh: 駐外記者需要文化知識，才能向國內受眾準確解釋國際事件。

words.tip: 記者義常指駐某地或負責某領域的記者。

tr: n. 船, 容器, 脈管
def: n. a tube in which a body fluid circulates
n. a craft designed for water transportation
n. an object used as a container (especially for liquids)

ex.en: A large fishing vessel sailed slowly into the harbour.
ex.zh: 一艘大型漁船緩緩駛入港口。

ex.en: Commercial vessels can disturb marine ecosystems through underwater noise, fuel leaks, and the introduction of non-native species.
ex.zh: 商船可能通過水下噪聲、燃油洩漏和引入外來物種干擾海洋生態系統。

words.tip: vessel較正式；blood vessel是“血管”，不是船。

tr: n. 宗族, 部落, 一群人
def: n. a social division of (usually preliterate) people
n. a federation (as of American Indians)
n. (biology) a taxonomic category between a genus and a subfamily

ex.en: The guide belongs to a tribe from this valley.
ex.zh: 這位嚮導屬於這個山谷中的一個部族。

ex.en: Development projects should respect the land rights and cultural traditions of local tribes.
ex.zh: 開發項目應尊重當地部族的土地權利和文化傳統。

col: members of a tribe｜部落成員
words.tip: 指特定社群時，宜尊重其自稱，避免泛稱。

tr: n. 草地, 草坪, 上等細麻布
def: n. a field of cultivated and mowed grass
n. the act of eating dinner
The activity of eating a meal

ex.en: We moved the dining table closer to the window.
ex.zh: 我們把餐桌挪到了更靠近窗戶的地方。

ex.en: Shared dining spaces in student accommodation can encourage social interaction and help newcomers develop a sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 學生宿舍中的公共用餐空間能促進社交互動，幫助新入住者建立歸屬感。

words.tip: 也是dine的現在分詞；dining只有一個n。

tr: a. 易受傷害的, 有弱點的, 易受影響的, 脆弱的, 成局的
def: a. susceptible to attack
s. susceptible to criticism or persuasion or temptation
s. capable of being wounded or hurt

ex.en: Young plants are vulnerable to frost on cold nights.
ex.zh: 幼苗在寒冷的夜晚容易遭受霜凍。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide additional support for vulnerable residents during periods of extreme heat.
ex.zh: 在極端高溫期間，地方政府應為易受影響的居民提供額外支持。

words.tip: 常用 vulnerable to，to 後接名詞。

tr: n. 安定, 穩定性, 堅實, 鞏固
def: n. the quality or attribute of being firm and steadfast
n. a stable order (especially of society)
The ability to remain steady and resist unwanted change

ex.en: These wider legs give the table much better stability.
ex.zh: 這些更寬的桌腿讓桌子穩固了許多。

ex.en: Economic stability encourages businesses to invest in new projects and gives households greater confidence about their financial future.
ex.zh: 經濟穩定能鼓勵企業投資新項目，也讓家庭對未來的財務狀況更有信心。

words.tip: 通常不可數；形容詞為stable，反義詞為instability。

tr: a. 前進的, 進行的, 不間斷的
def: s. currently happening
Continuing to happen or develop, rather than being finished.

ex.en: The ongoing repairs mean we cannot use the kitchen.
ex.zh: 維修仍在進行，所以我們沒法使用廚房。

ex.en: Ongoing research into renewable energy is essential for reducing dependence on fossil fuels and limiting environmental damage.
ex.zh: 持續開展可再生能源研究，對減少化石燃料依賴和限制環境損害至關重要。

col: an ongoing investigation｜正在進行的調查
words.tip: 強調尚在持續，不等於即將發生的upcoming。

tr: vt. 承受, 支持, 供養, 繼續, 忍受, 蒙受, 證實, 准許
def: v. supply with necessities and support
v. admit as valid

tr: n. 乘騎用馬, 框, 襯紙, 山
vi. 乘馬, 爬上, 增長
vt. 爬上, 使上馬, 裝上, 裝裱, 安放, 製作...的標本, 設置, 上演
def: n. a mounting consisting of a piece of metal (as in a ring or other jewelry) that holds a gem in place
v. attach to a support
v. fix onto a backing, setting, or support

ex.en: Dirty dishes mounted up while our dishwasher was broken.
ex.zh: 洗碗機壞了，髒碗碟越積越多。

ex.en: As pressure mounts to reduce emissions, governments must expand renewable energy production and improve energy efficiency.
ex.zh: 隨著減排壓力不斷增加，各國政府必須擴大可再生能源生產並提高能源效率。

col: mount on a wall｜安裝在牆上
words.tip: mount可指壓力等上升；mount a campaign指發起運動。

tr: n. 義務, 責任, 約束, 契約, 恩惠, 債務
[經] 待付款, 債務, 義務
def: n. the state of being obligated to do or pay something
n. a personal relation in which one is indebted for a service or favor
n. a legal agreement specifying a payment or action and the penalty for failure to comply

ex.en: You have no obligation to buy anything here.
ex.zh: 你沒有義務在這裡購買任何東西。

ex.en: Employers have a legal obligation to provide safe working conditions and protect employees from preventable harm.
ex.zh: 僱主有法律義務提供安全的工作條件，並保護員工免受可預防的傷害。

words.tip: 常用have an obligation to do，表示有義務做。

tr: n. 手掌, 棕櫚, 勝利
vt. 與...握手, 藏...於掌中
def: n. the inner surface of the hand from the wrist to the base of the fingers
n. a linear unit based on the length or width of the human hand
n. any plant of the family Palmae having an unbranched trunk crowned by large pinnate or palmate leaves

tr: a. 有效率的, 能幹的
def: a. being effective without wasting time or effort or expense
Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.

ex.en: Our new washing machine is quieter and more efficient.
ex.zh: 我們的新洗衣機更安靜，也更節能。

ex.en: An efficient public transport network allows cities to move more people while consuming less energy.
ex.zh: 高效的公共交通網絡使城市能夠以更低的能耗運送更多乘客。

col: efficient use of resources｜高效利用資源
words.tip: efficient強調少浪費；effective強調達到預期效果。

tr: n. 方案, 計劃, 組合, 系統, 圖解, 詭計, 陰謀
v. 計劃, 設計, 圖謀, 策劃
def: n. an elaborate and systematic plan of action
v. form intrigues (for) in an underhand manner
v. devise a system or form a scheme for

tr: v. (使)爆裂, (使)裂開, (使)發出爆裂聲
def: n. a long narrow opening
n. a sudden sharp noise
n. a blemish resulting from a break without complete separation of the parts

ex.en: There's a thin crack across my favourite blue mug.
ex.zh: 我最喜歡的藍色杯子上有一道細細的裂紋。

ex.en: Engineers discovered a crack in the bridge during a routine inspection and recommended immediate repairs.
ex.zh: 工程師在例行檢查中發現橋梁有一道裂縫，並建議立即維修。

col: a crack in the wall｜牆上的裂縫
a loud crack｜響亮的爆裂聲
words.tip: crack常指裂而未碎；shatter強調碎成許多片。

def: n. the number of occurrences within a given time period
n. the ratio of the number of observations in a statistical category to the total number of observations
n. the number of observations in a given statistical category

ex.en: The frequency of buses drops sharply after nine each evening.
ex.zh: 每天晚上九點以後，公交車的班次大幅減少。

ex.en: Researchers are examining whether rising ocean temperatures affect the frequency of severe storms in coastal regions.
ex.zh: 研究人員正在考察海洋溫度上升是否會影響沿海地區強風暴的發生頻率。

col: with increasing frequency｜越來越頻繁地
words.tip: 頻率高低用high或low；發生得多不等於速度快。

tr: n. 銀河, 星系, 一群(顯赫的人物)
def: n. a splendid assemblage (especially of famous people)
n. (astronomy) a collection of star systems; any of the billions of systems each having many stars and nebulae and dust

tr: n. 痕跡, 蹤跡, 微量, 跡線, 韁繩
vt. 追蹤, 回溯, 描繪
def: n. a just detectable amount
n. an indication that something has been present
n. either of two lines that connect a horse's harness to a wagon or other vehicle or to a whiffletree

ex.en: The plumber traced the leak to a cracked pipe.
ex.zh: 水管工查出漏水源於一根開裂的管道。

ex.en: Researchers can trace changes in regional diets by examining food remains discovered at ancient settlements.
ex.zh: 研究人員可以通過檢驗古代聚落遺址中發現的食物殘留，追溯區域飲食的變化。

words.tip: trace A back to B表示“追溯A至B”。

tr: n. 爆發, 激增, 爆炸(聲)
def: n. a violent release of energy caused by a chemical or nuclear reaction
n. the act of exploding or bursting
n. a sudden great increase

ex.en: We heard a distant explosion and saw smoke rising.
ex.zh: 我們聽到遠處傳來爆炸聲，看見煙霧升起。

ex.en: The explosion in online shopping has increased demand for delivery services and created new challenges for urban transport.
ex.zh: 網上購物的激增提高了配送服務需求，也給城市交通帶來了新挑戰。

col: an explosion of anger｜怒氣爆發
words.tip: 表示數量激增時，常用an explosion in加名詞。

def: a. beyond belief or understanding
So surprising that it is difficult to believe
Extremely good, impressive, or great in amount

ex.en: It seems incredible that this tiny seed becomes a tree.
ex.zh: 這粒小小的種子竟能長成大樹，真令人難以置信。

ex.en: Advances in medical technology have brought incredible improvements in the quality of life for many patients.
ex.zh: 醫療技術的進步使許多患者的生活質量得到了驚人的改善。

col: find it incredible｜覺得難以置信
words.tip: incredible可表難以置信，也可口語讚歎“極好”。

tr: n. 嬰兒, 兒童, 初學者
a. 嬰兒的, 幼稚的
def: n a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
a baby or very young child
relating to babies or an early stage of development

ex.en: The infant slept peacefully in her father's arms.
ex.zh: 那個嬰兒在父親懷裡安靜地睡著。

ex.en: Access to clean water and basic healthcare is essential for reducing infant mortality in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 獲得清潔飲水和基本醫療服務，對於降低弱勢社區的嬰兒死亡率至關重要。

words.tip: 比baby正式；infant mortality專指嬰兒死亡率。

def: n. a structure attached to the exterior of a building often forming a covered entrance
A covered area immediately outside a building's entrance.

ex.en: We left our muddy boots on the porch overnight.
ex.zh: 我們把沾滿泥的靴子放在門廊上過了一夜。

ex.en: A shaded porch can reduce indoor temperatures while providing residents with a comfortable outdoor meeting space.
ex.zh: 帶遮陰的門廊既能降低室內溫度，也能為住戶提供舒適的戶外交流空間。

col: sit on the porch｜坐在門廊上
words.tip: 指入口外的有頂空間，不是室內走廊。

tr: vi. 取得資格, 有資格
vt. 使有資格, 使合格, 限定, 限制, 准予
def: v. prove capable or fit; meet requirements
v. pronounce fit or able
v. make more specific

ex.en: Our team needs another win to qualify for the final.
ex.zh: 我們隊還需要再贏一場才能進入決賽。

ex.en: Students from low-income households may qualify for financial support that covers tuition fees and essential living costs.
ex.zh: 低收入家庭的學生可能符合獲得經濟資助的條件，用以支付學費和基本生活開支。

col: qualify for assistance｜符合援助條件
qualify as a teacher｜取得教師資格
words.tip: qualify for接機會或待遇；qualify as接職業。

def: n a public area set aside as a pedestrian walk

n mercantile establishment consisting of a carefully landscaped complex of shops representing leading merchandisers; usually includes restaurants and a convenient parking area; a modern version of the traditional marketplace
a large building or complex containing many shops

ex.en: We spent the rainy afternoon browsing in the mall.
ex.zh: 下雨的下午，我們一直在購物中心閒逛。

ex.en: A new shopping mall may create jobs, but it can also threaten small independent retailers.
ex.zh: 新的購物中心可能創造就業機會，但也可能威脅獨立小零售商的生存。

words.tip: mall常用於美式英語；英式常說shopping centre。

def: v. obtain
v. come from
v. develop or evolve from a latent or potential state

ex.en: I derive great pleasure from growing vegetables on my balcony.
ex.zh: 在陽臺上種菜讓我獲得很大的樂趣。

ex.en: Many coastal communities derive a significant proportion of their income from tourism and fishing.
ex.zh: 許多沿海社區的收入有很大一部分來自旅遊業和漁業。

words.tip: derive A from B指從B獲得A；derive from指源於。

tr: n. 醜聞, 中傷, 恥辱, 反感, 流言蜚語
[法] 醜事, 醜聞, 幹醜事的人
def: n. disgraceful gossip about the private lives of other people
n. a disgraceful event

tr: n. 織物, 布, 結構, 構造, 建築物
[經] 組織, 建築物, 工廠
def: n. artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers
material made by weaving or knitting fibres
the connected parts that form a society or organisation

ex.en: This soft fabric will make a comfortable summer dress.
ex.zh: 這種柔軟的布料做夏季連衣裙會很舒服。

ex.en: Community centres strengthen the social fabric by bringing together residents from different cultural and economic backgrounds.
ex.zh: 社區中心讓不同文化與經濟背景的居民聚在一起，從而鞏固社會紐帶。

words.tip: 泛指布料常不可數；不同種類可用fabrics。

tr: n. 隱私, 隱居, 秘密
def: n. the quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others
n. the condition of being concealed or hidden
Freedom from unwanted access to personal information or private life.

ex.en: Please knock before entering; everyone needs a little privacy.
ex.zh: 進門前請敲門；每個人都需要一點私人空間。

ex.en: Governments should protect individual privacy while allowing researchers to use anonymous data for public health studies.
ex.zh: 政府應保護個人隱私，同時允許研究人員使用匿名數據開展公共衛生研究。

col: in the privacy of your home｜在家中不受打擾地
words.tip: 通常不可數；英美髮音首音節差異明顯。

tr: vt. 競爭, 爭取, 爭辯
def: n. an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants
n. a struggle between rivals
v. to make the subject of dispute, contention, or litigation

ex.en: My cousin won a baking contest with her lemon cake.
ex.zh: 我表姐憑她做的檸檬蛋糕贏得了烘焙比賽。

ex.en: Citizens should have access to affordable legal advice when they wish to contest an official decision.
ex.zh: 公民希望對官方決定提出異議時，應能獲得價格合理的法律諮詢。

col: a close contest｜勢均力敵的比賽
contest a decision｜對決定提出異議
words.tip: 名詞重音在首音節；動詞重音在第二音節。

tr: n. 比例, 比率, 均衡, 部分, 面積
vt. 使成比例, 使均衡
def: n. the quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole
n. magnitude or extent
n. the relation between things (or parts of things) with respect to their comparative quantity, magnitude, or degree

ex.en: A large proportion of my wages goes on rent.
ex.zh: 我的工資很大一部分用來付房租。

ex.en: The proportion of residents using public transport increased after the city introduced cheaper monthly passes.
ex.zh: 該市推出更便宜的月票後，使用公共交通的居民比例上升了。

col: a large proportion of｜很大一部分
words.tip: a proportion of後謂語單複數取決於所指名詞。

tr: n. 指導路線, 方針, 指標
[經] 指導路線, 方針, 準則
def: n. a light line that is used in lettering to help align the letters
Advice or a principle explaining how something should be done.

ex.en: These guidelines explain how to store food safely.
ex.zh: 這些指南說明了如何安全儲存食物。

ex.en: Clear guidelines on data collection can help researchers protect participants while maintaining the quality of their studies.
ex.zh: 明確的數據收集準則可以幫助研究人員在維持研究質量的同時保護參與者。

words.tip: 常用複數guidelines；通常指指導而非強制法規。

tr: n. 定罪, 信服, 堅信
[法] 定罪, 證明有罪, 判罪
def: n. an unshakable belief in something without need for proof or evidence
n. (criminal law) a final judgment of guilty in a criminal case and the punishment that is imposed

tr: n. 維護, 保持, 維修, 生活費用, 堅持, 扶養
def: n. means of maintenance of a family or group

n. the unauthorized interference in a legal action by a person having no interest in it (as by helping one party with money or otherwise to continue the action) so as to obstruct justice or promote unnecessary litigation or unsettle the peace of the community
work needed to keep something in good condition

ex.en: Regular maintenance keeps my old bicycle safe to ride.
ex.zh: 定期保養讓我的舊自行車騎起來依然安全。

ex.en: Governments should budget for the long-term maintenance of public infrastructure rather than focusing solely on new construction.
ex.zh: 政府應為公共基礎設施的長期維護安排預算，而不應只關注新建工程。

col: the maintenance of standards｜標準的維持
words.tip: 通常不可數；拼寫不是maintainance。

tr: a. 器官的, 有機的, 組織的, 根本的
[醫] 器官的, 有生命的, 有機的, 器質的
def: n. a fertilizer that is derived from animal or vegetable matter
a. relating or belonging to the class of chemical compounds having a carbon basis
a. being or relating to or derived from or having properties characteristic of living organisms

ex.en: She buys organic carrots from a nearby farm.
ex.zh: 她從附近的農場購買有機胡蘿蔔。

ex.en: Organic farming can support biodiversity, although its lower yields may require more land for food production.
ex.zh: 有機農業有助於維持生物多樣性，但其較低的產量可能意味著糧食生產需要更多土地。

words.tip: 食品語境指有機生產；化學語境通常指含碳化合物。

tr: n. 神話, 虛構的事, 虛構的人
def: n. a traditional story accepted as history; serves to explain the world view of a people

tr: a. 複雜的, 久經世故的
[法] 尖端的, 高級的, 非常有經驗的
見多識廣的；品位高雅的
def: a. having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire
s. intellectually appealing
highly developed and involving complex methods or technology

ex.en: This sophisticated camera adjusts its settings automatically in low light.
ex.zh: 這臺先進的相機會在光線不足時自動調整設置。

ex.en: Sophisticated monitoring systems allow researchers to detect small changes in air quality across densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 先進的監測系統使研究人員能夠發現人口密集城市中空氣質量的細微變化。

words.tip: 形容設備指精密先進；形容人可指見多識廣。

tr: n. 起立, 持續, 身分
a. 立著的, 不動的, 經常的, 持續的
def: n. social or financial or professional status or reputation
n. an ordered listing of scores or results showing the relative positions of competitors (individuals or teams) in a sporting event
n. the act of assuming or maintaining an erect upright position
n. a tube through which a bullet travels when a gun is fired
n. a cylindrical container that holds liquids
n. a bulging cylindrical shape; hollow with flat ends

ex.en: We collect rainwater in a wooden barrel behind the shed.
ex.zh: 我們用棚屋後面的一個木桶收集雨水。

ex.en: The price of a barrel of oil can influence transport costs throughout the global economy.
ex.zh: 每桶石油的價格能影響整個全球經濟的運輸成本。

col: a barrel of oil｜一桶石油
barrel down the road｜沿路飛馳
words.tip: 複數barrels；一桶石油用a barrel of oil。

tr: n. 會員的資格, 全體會員, 會員數目
[法] 會員資格, 成員資格, 會籍
def: n. the body of members of an organization or group
n. the state of being a member
the status of belonging to a club or organisation

ex.en: My gym membership includes free swimming lessons every weekend.
ex.zh: 我的健身房會員權益包括每個週末的免費游泳課。

ex.en: Affordable membership fees can encourage more residents to use local sports facilities and improve their health.
ex.zh: 價格合理的會員費可以鼓勵更多居民使用當地體育設施，改善健康狀況。

col: renew your membership｜續辦會員資格
words.tip: 表示加入某組織的資格，常用membership of。

tr: [醫] 比, 比率, 比例
def: n. the relative magnitudes of two quantities (usually expressed as a quotient)
A comparison showing the relative sizes of two quantities.

ex.en: Use a higher ratio of vegetables to rice.
ex.zh: 把蔬菜相對於米飯的比例調高一些。

ex.en: A lower ratio of students to teachers may allow schools to provide more individual support in classrooms.
ex.zh: 較低的生師比可能使學校能夠在課堂上提供更多個別輔導。

col: the ratio of A to B｜A與B之比
words.tip: A與B之比用the ratio of A to B，注意順序。

def: n a manner of living that reflects the person's values and attitudes
the habits and activities that shape how someone lives

ex.en: Cycling to work is part of her healthy lifestyle.
ex.zh: 騎車上班是她健康生活方式的一部分。

ex.en: A sedentary lifestyle can increase health risks, particularly among people who spend long hours at desks.
ex.zh: 久坐的生活方式會增加健康風險，尤其是對長時間伏案工作的人而言。

words.tip: 可數名詞：常說lead a healthy lifestyle。

tr: a. 敘述的, 敘事的, 故事體的
def: n. a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program
s. consisting of or characterized by the telling of a story
A description of connected events, real or imagined.

ex.en: Her travel diary contains a lively narrative of the journey.
ex.zh: 她的旅行日記生動地記述了這段旅程。

ex.en: Museums can use personal narratives to help visitors understand how historical events affected the lives of ordinary people.
ex.zh: 博物館可以通過個人敘事，幫助參觀者理解歷史事件如何影響普通人的生活。

words.tip: 作名詞指故事或敘述；作形容詞常修飾結構、技巧。

tr: a. 充分的, 足夠的
def: a. of a quantity that can fulfill a need or requirement but without being abundant
enough to meet a need or achieve a purpose

ex.en: We have sufficient food for everyone at the picnic.
ex.zh: 我們準備了足夠的食物，供參加野餐的每個人享用。

ex.en: Without sufficient funding, local authorities may struggle to maintain essential services for their growing populations.
ex.zh: 如果資金不足，地方政府可能難以為不斷增長的人口維持基本服務。

words.tip: 常用sufficient for或sufficient to do，語氣較正式。

tr: n. 筆劃, 打, 中風, 撫, 摩, 衝程
vt. 劃尾槳, 撫, 摩, 劃去
def: n. (sports) the act of swinging or striking at a ball with a club or racket or bat or cue or hand
n. a sudden loss of consciousness resulting when the rupture or occlusion of a blood vessel leads to oxygen lack in the brain
n. a light touch

ex.en: The cat purred while I stroked its soft fur.
ex.zh: 我輕撫貓咪柔軟的毛，它發出了呼嚕聲。

ex.en: Recognising the early symptoms of a stroke can help patients receive treatment before serious brain damage occurs.
ex.zh: 識別中風的早期症狀，有助於患者在出現嚴重腦損傷前接受治療。

col: a swimming stroke｜游泳划水動作
words.tip: 中風用have a stroke，勿與心臟病發作混淆。

tr: n. 地平線, 眼界, (天)視地平
def: n. the line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet
n. the range of interest or activity that can be anticipated
n. a specific layer or stratum of soil or subsoil in a vertical cross section of land

ex.en: We watched a small boat disappear beyond the horizon.
ex.zh: 我們看著一條小船消失在地平線之外。

ex.en: Studying abroad can broaden students' horizons by exposing them to unfamiliar customs and different approaches to learning.
ex.zh: 留學能讓學生接觸陌生的習俗和不同的學習方式，從而拓寬眼界。

col: on the horizon｜在地平線上；即將發生
beyond the horizon｜在地平線之外
words.tip: 表示眼界通常用複數：broaden your horizons。

tr: n. 激勵, 提示, 提醒物, 提詞, 付款期限
a. 迅速的, 敏捷的, 立刻的, 提詞員的
vt. 激勵, 鼓動, 提示
[計] 提示符; DOS內部命令:設定DOS命令行的提示符
def: n. a cue given to a performer (usually the beginning of the next line to be spoken)
n. (computer science) a symbol that appears on the computer screen to indicate that the computer is ready to receive a command
v. serve as the inciting cause of
n. any female friend
n. a girl or young woman with whom a man is romantically involved

tr: n. 校長, 首長, 本金, 主犯, 資本, 委託人
a. 主要的, 最重要的, 首要的
def: n. the original amount of a debt on which interest is calculated
n. the educator who has executive authority for a school
n. capital as contrasted with the income derived from it

ex.en: Our principal reason for moving was the noisy traffic.
ex.zh: 我們搬家的主要原因是交通噪聲太大。

ex.en: The principal challenge facing urban planners is providing affordable housing without reducing access to green spaces.
ex.zh: 城市規劃者面臨的主要挑戰是提供經濟適用的住房，同時不減少居民享用綠地的機會。

words.tip: principal指“主要的”或“校長”；principle指“原則”。

tr: a. 詳細的, 複雜的
def: s. developed or executed with care and in minute detail
Including many facts or specific pieces of information.

ex.en: She gave me detailed instructions for baking the cake.
ex.zh: 她詳細地告訴了我這個蛋糕的烘焙步驟。

ex.en: Detailed research into commuting patterns can help cities design more efficient public transport systems.
ex.zh: 對通勤模式的詳細研究可以幫助城市設計更高效的公共交通系統。

words.tip: 表示“詳細地”用in detail，不用in detailed。

tr: n. 分配, 功課, 任務, 轉讓, 歸因, 陳述
def: n. a duty that you are assigned to perform (especially in the armed forces)
n. the instrument by which a claim or right or interest or property is transferred from one person to another
n. the act of distributing something to designated places or persons

ex.en: I finished my science assignment before dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我在晚飯前完成了科學作業。

ex.en: A group assignment can help students develop communication skills and learn to share responsibility.
ex.zh: 小組作業可以幫助學生培養溝通能力，並學會共同承擔責任。

col: complete an assignment｜完成作業或任務
words.tip: 指具體作業時可數；homework通常不可數。

tr: n. 工場, 車間, 研討會
[計] 討論會; 專題研究組
def: n. small workplace where handcrafts or manufacturing are done
n. a brief intensive course for a small group; emphasizes problem solving
A session where people learn by discussing and practising together.

ex.en: I made a clay bowl at a pottery workshop.
ex.zh: 我在陶藝工作坊做了一個陶碗。

ex.en: Schools should offer practical workshops that help students develop communication skills through collaborative activities.
ex.zh: 學校應開設實踐工作坊，幫助學生通過合作活動培養溝通能力。

words.tip: 表示學習活動時，通常強調參與和實踐，而非只聽講。

tr: vt. 控告, 起訴, 請求
vi. 提出訴訟, 提出請求
def: n. French writer whose novels described the sordid side of city life (1804-1857)
To take legal action against someone, usually seeking compensation.

ex.en: Our neighbour plans to sue the builder over faulty repairs.
ex.zh: 我們的鄰居打算因維修質量問題起訴那名建築工人。

ex.en: Consumers should have the right to sue companies that knowingly sell unsafe products or conceal serious defects.
ex.zh: 消費者應有權起訴明知產品不安全仍銷售，或隱瞞嚴重缺陷的公司。

col: sue for damages｜起訴要求損害賠償
sue for negligence｜因過失提起訴訟
words.tip: sue someone for something：因某事起訴某人。

tr: vt. 遭受, 經歷, 忍受
[法] 經受, 經歷, 忍受
def: v. pass through
to experience a process, change, or treatment

ex.en: My uncle will undergo knee surgery early next week.
ex.zh: 我叔叔下週初將接受膝蓋手術。

ex.en: Many coastal cities will undergo significant changes as rising sea levels force governments to reconsider urban planning.
ex.zh: 隨著海平面上升迫使政府重新考慮城市規劃，許多沿海城市將經歷重大變化。

col: undergo significant changes｜經歷重大變化
words.tip: 過去式underwent，過去分詞undergone；直接接賓語。

def: n. a show of military force or preparedness
n. a public display of group feelings (usually of a political nature)
n. proof by a process of argument or a series of proposition proving an asserted conclusion

ex.en: The chef gave a demonstration of bread making.
ex.zh: 廚師演示瞭如何製作麵包。

ex.en: A practical demonstration can help students understand scientific principles more effectively than a written explanation alone.
ex.zh: 實際演示比單純的文字講解更能幫助學生理解科學原理。

col: a demonstration of support｜支持的表示
words.tip: 演示如何做某事常用demonstration of。

tr: n. 序列, 續發事件, 順序, 連續
def: n. serial arrangement in which things follow in logical order or a recurrent pattern
n. a following of one thing after another in time
n. film consisting of a succession of related shots that develop a given subject in a movie

ex.en: Arrange these pictures in the correct sequence before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚飯前把這些圖片按正確順序排好。

ex.en: Understanding the sequence of events helps researchers identify the factors that contributed to an environmental disaster.
ex.zh: 瞭解事件發生的先後順序，有助於研究人員找出導致環境災難的因素。

col: a sequence of events｜一連串事件
words.tip: a sequence of後接複數名詞，表示一連串事物。

tr: n. 消費, 消費量, 癆病
def: n. the process of taking food into the body through the mouth (as by eating)
n. (economics) the utilization of economic goods to satisfy needs or in manufacturing
n. the act of consuming something

ex.en: Our electricity consumption rises when we use the heater.
ex.zh: 使用暖氣時，我們的用電量就會上升。

ex.en: Governments can reduce fossil fuel consumption by investing in reliable public transport and renewable energy.
ex.zh: 政府可以通過投資可靠的公共交通和可再生能源，減少化石燃料消耗。

col: fit for human consumption｜適合人類食用
words.tip: 通常不可數；消費的人是consumer，不是consumption。

tr: vt. 主張, 堅稱, 斷言
[法] 宣稱, 斷言, 維護
def: v. state categorically
v. insist on having one's opinions and rights recognized
To state firmly that something is true.

ex.en: He asserted that he had already paid for lunch.
ex.zh: 他堅稱自己已經付過午餐錢了。

ex.en: Some educators assert that regular feedback improves student motivation more effectively than frequent formal examinations.
ex.zh: 一些教育工作者堅稱，定期反饋比頻繁的正式考試更能有效提高學生的學習積極性。

col: assert your rights｜維護自己的權利
assert yourself｜堅定表達自己的立場
words.tip: assert強調堅定表態，不代表已經提供證據。

def: n. small room on a ship or boat where people sleep
n. a small house built of wood; usually in a wooded area
n. the enclosed compartment of an aircraft or spacecraft where passengers are carried

ex.en: We spent the weekend in a cabin beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我們在湖邊的一間小木屋裡度過了週末。

ex.en: Holiday cabins in protected forests should be carefully managed to limit their impact on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 保護林區內的度假小屋應得到妥善管理，以限制其對當地野生動物的影響。

words.tip: 既指陸地上的小屋，也指船艙或飛機客艙。

tr: n. 程度, 坡度, 頂點, 前傾, 傾斜, 投擲, 音高, 螺距, 節距, 攤位, 樹脂, 瀝青
vt. 投, 擲, 向前傾跌, 紮營, 竭力推銷, 為...定調, 定位於, 用瀝青塗
vi. 搭帳篷, 投擲, 向前跌, 猛然摔倒, 墜落, 傾斜
def: n. the property of sound that varies with variation in the frequency of vibration
n. (baseball) the act of throwing a baseball by a pitcher to a batter
n. a vendor's position (especially on the sidewalk)

ex.en: The players ran onto the pitch despite the rain.
ex.zh: 儘管下著雨，球員們還是跑進了球場。

ex.en: Young entrepreneurs often pitch their business ideas to investors who can provide funding and practical guidance.
ex.zh: 年輕創業者經常向能夠提供資金和實用指導的投資者推介商業構想。

words.tip: 球場義常見於英式英語；pitch a tent意為搭帳篷。

def: prep. Against; as, John Doe versus Richard Roe; -- chiefly
used in legal language, and abbreviated to v. or vs.
against an opponent, or compared with another option

ex.en: Tonight's match is our school versus the local college.
ex.zh: 今晚的比賽是我們學校對陣本地學院。

ex.en: The debate over public versus private transport often centres on cost, convenience, and environmental impact.
ex.zh: 關於公共交通與私人交通的討論往往圍繞成本、便利性和環境影響展開。

col: public versus private｜公共與私人之比較
the case of A versus B｜A訴B的案件
the benefits versus the costs｜收益與成本之比較
words.tip: 常縮寫為vs或v，用於比賽、訴訟或兩者比較。

tr: a. 佔優勢的, 支配的
def: n. (music) the fifth note of the diatonic scale
a. exercising influence or control
a. (of genes) producing the same phenotype whether its allele is identical or dissimilar

ex.en: Blue is the dominant colour in our living room.
ex.zh: 藍色是我們客廳的主色調。

ex.en: Private cars remain the dominant form of transport in cities with limited investment in public transport.
ex.zh: 在公共交通投入有限的城市，私家車仍是主要交通方式。

words.tip: dominant是形容詞；dominate是動詞。

tr: n. 遺產, 祖先遺留物, 繼承物
def: n. practices that are handed down from the past by tradition
Traditions, buildings, and values passed down from earlier generations.

ex.en: These old songs are part of our family heritage.
ex.zh: 這些老歌是我們家族傳承的一部分。

ex.en: Protecting cultural heritage can strengthen community identity while attracting visitors who support local businesses.
ex.zh: 保護文化遺產能夠增強社區認同感，同時吸引遊客，支持當地商業。

col: preserve our heritage｜保護我們的遺產
rich heritage｜豐富的歷史文化遺產
words.tip: 多指文化與歷史傳承；個人繼承財產常用inheritance。

tr: a. 裸體的, 無裝飾的, 無保護的, 赤貧的
def: s. having no protecting or concealing cover
s. (of the eye or ear e.g.) without the aid of an optical or acoustical device or instrument
s. devoid of elaboration or diminution or concealment; bare and pure
n. the branch of social science that deals with the production and distribution and consumption of goods and services and their management
The study of how societies produce, distribute, and use resources.
The financial factors affecting whether an activity is practical.

ex.en: My sister studies economics and enjoys discussing food prices.
ex.zh: 我姐姐學經濟學，喜歡討論食品價格。

ex.en: Studying economics helps students understand how government policies influence employment, inflation, and the distribution of wealth.
ex.zh: 學習經濟學有助於學生理解政府政策如何影響就業、通貨膨脹和財富分配。

col: the economics of recycling｜回收利用的經濟可行性
words.tip: 指學科時雖以s結尾，仍接單數謂語。

tr: vt. 預期, 佔先, 加速, 提前使用
[醫] 提前出現, 先期發生
def: v. act in advance of; deal with ahead of time
v. realize beforehand
v. be excited or anxious about
n. a gesture involving the shoulders
v. raise one's shoulders to indicate indifference or resignation
To raise your shoulders to show uncertainty or indifference

ex.en: He shrugged when I asked where the keys were.
ex.zh: 我問鑰匙在哪兒時，他聳了聳肩。

ex.en: Governments should not shrug off public concerns about air pollution, as these directly affect community health.
ex.zh: 政府不應輕視公眾對空氣汙染的擔憂，因為這些問題直接影響社區健康。

col: shrug off criticism｜不把批評當回事
words.tip: 過去式shrugged；shrug off表示不予理會。

tr: a. 合法的, 正當的, 婚生的
vt. 認為正當, 立為嫡嗣, 使合法
def: v. show or affirm to be just and legitimate
v. make (an illegitimate child) legitimate; declare the legitimacy of (someone)
a. of marriages and offspring; recognized as lawful

ex.en: Selling homemade bread is a legitimate business here.
ex.zh: 在這裡，售賣自制麵包是合法的生意。

ex.en: Residents have legitimate concerns about the impact of airport expansion on local air quality.
ex.zh: 居民對機場擴建影響當地空氣質量的擔憂是合理的。

words.tip: 既可指法律允許，也可指理由或擔憂合理。

tr: n. 定方位, 適應, 向東方
def: n. the act of orienting
n. an integrated set of attitudes and beliefs
n. position or alignment relative to points of the compass or other specific directions

ex.en: During orientation, a student guide showed us the library.
ex.zh: 入學指導期間，一位學生嚮導帶我們參觀了圖書館。

ex.en: A comprehensive orientation programme can help international students understand academic expectations and access essential support services.
ex.zh: 全面的入學指導計劃能幫助國際學生了解學業要求，並獲得必要的支持服務。

col: orientation programme｜入學或入職指導計劃
words.tip: 入學指導常用orientation；方位義常用於建築。

tr: n. 脹大, 誇張, 通貨膨脹
def: n. a general and progressive increase in prices
n. (cosmology) a brief exponential expansion of the universe (faster than the speed of light) postulated to have occurred shortly after the big bang
n. the act of filling something with air

ex.en: Inflation means our weekly shopping costs more now.
ex.zh: 通貨膨脹意味著我們現在每週購物花的錢更多了。

ex.en: High inflation can reduce household purchasing power, particularly when wages fail to keep pace with rising prices.
ex.zh: 高通脹會削弱家庭購買力，尤其是在工資跟不上物價上漲時。

col: the rate of inflation｜通貨膨脹率
keep pace with inflation｜跟上通脹
words.tip: 經濟語境指物價普遍上漲，不只某件商品漲價。

tr: n. 串, 叢, 群, 簇
def: v. come together as in a cluster or flock
a group of similar things positioned or occurring close together
to gather closely together or make things gather together

ex.en: A cluster of purple flowers grew beside the gate.
ex.zh: 大門旁長著一簇紫色的花。

ex.en: Technology companies often cluster near universities, where they can recruit skilled graduates and collaborate with researchers.
ex.zh: 科技公司往往聚集在大學附近，便於招聘技能嫻熟的畢業生並與研究人員合作。

words.tip: 強調緊密聚集；a cluster of後常接複數名詞。

tr: a. 依賴的, 從屬的
def: a. relying on or requiring a person or thing for support, supply, or what is needed
s. contingent on something else
a. (of a clause) unable to stand alone syntactically as a complete sentence

ex.en: The young birds are still dependent on their parents.
ex.zh: 這些幼鳥仍然依賴親鳥。

ex.en: Rural communities are often dependent on reliable bus services for access to healthcare, employment, and further education.
ex.zh: 農村社區往往依靠可靠的公交服務來獲得醫療、就業和繼續教育的機會。

words.tip: 常接on；英式名詞“受撫養者”通常拼作dependant。

def: v show in, or as in, a picture
v give a description of
v make a portrait of

ex.en: This painting depicts children playing beside a quiet lake.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪了孩子們在寧靜的湖邊玩耍的情景。

ex.en: Films often depict urban life as exciting, overlooking the isolation that many residents experience in large cities.
ex.zh: 電影常將城市生活描繪得令人興奮，卻忽略了許多大城市居民感受到的孤獨。

col: depict daily life｜描繪日常生活
depict someone as｜將某人描繪成
words.tip: depict A as B：把A描繪成B。

tr: n. 崩潰, 倒塌, 虛脫
vi. 倒塌, 崩潰, 瓦解
def: n. an abrupt failure of function or complete physical exhaustion
n. a natural event caused by something suddenly falling down or caving in
v. break down, literally or metaphorically

ex.en: The old garden shed collapsed during last night's storm.
ex.zh: 昨晚的暴風雨中，花園裡的舊棚屋倒塌了。

ex.en: Poor maintenance can cause bridges to collapse, making regular inspections essential for public safety.
ex.zh: 維護不善可能導致橋梁坍塌，因此定期檢查對公共安全至關重要。

col: collapse from exhaustion｜因筋疲力盡而倒下
the collapse of negotiations｜談判破裂
words.tip: 表示倒塌或崩潰時通常是不及物動詞，不用被動。

tr: n. 抵押, 約束性義務, 抵押借款
vt. 抵押, 以...作擔保, 把...許給
def: n. a conditional conveyance of property as security for the repayment of a loan
v. put up as security or collateral
A property loan secured against the property itself.

ex.en: We finally paid off our mortgage last spring.
ex.zh: 去年春天，我們終於還清了房貸。

ex.en: Rising interest rates can increase mortgage payments, leaving households with less money for other essential expenses.
ex.zh: 利率上升可能增加房貸還款額，讓家庭用於其他必要開支的錢變少。

col: take out a mortgage｜申請住房抵押貸款
pay off a mortgage｜還清房貸
words.tip: mortgage中的t不發音；還清房貸用pay off。

tr: n. 核准, 制裁, 處罰, 約束力
vt. 制定制裁規則, 認可, 核准, 同意
def: n. formal and explicit approval
n. a mechanism of social control for enforcing a society's standards
n. the act of final authorization

ex.en: The club imposed a sanction for breaking its rules.
ex.zh: 俱樂部對違反規定的行為作出了處罰。

ex.en: Economic sanctions may influence government policy, but they can also create hardship for ordinary citizens.
ex.zh: 經濟制裁可能影響政府政策，但也可能給普通民眾帶來困苦。

words.tip: 可指“制裁”或“批准”，含義相反，須看語境。

tr: n. 尺寸, 度量, 度量單位
def: n. the act or process of assigning numbers to phenomena according to a rule
The process of finding the size, amount, or degree of something.
A size or quantity found by measuring something.

ex.en: We took careful measurements before buying the new curtains.
ex.zh: 買新窗簾之前，我們仔細量了尺寸。

ex.en: Accurate measurement of air pollution helps governments assess whether environmental policies are protecting public health.
ex.zh: 準確測量空氣汙染程度有助於政府評估環境政策是否在保護公眾健康。

col: a unit of measurement｜計量單位
words.tip: 指測量過程常不可數；指具體尺寸時可數。

tr: n. 頂點, 最高階層, 最高級會議
a. 政府首腦的, 最高級的
def: n. a meeting of heads of governments
v. reach the summit (of a mountain)
The highest point of a mountain.

ex.en: We reached the snowy summit just before sunrise.
ex.zh: 我們在日出前剛好登上了白雪覆蓋的山頂。

ex.en: At the climate summit, national leaders discussed practical measures to reduce emissions and support vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 在氣候峰會上，各國領導人討論了減少排放和支持脆弱社區的實際措施。

words.tip: 山頂常用the summit of；峰會可用a summit。

tr: n. 可能性, 幾率, 機會, 勝算, 不平等
def: n. the likelihood of a thing occurring rather than not occurring
n. the ratio by which one better's wager is greater than that of another
The likelihood that something will happen.

ex.en: The odds of finding my keys here are low.
ex.zh: 在這裡找到我鑰匙的可能性很小。

ex.en: Access to affordable healthcare can improve the odds of recovery for patients with chronic illnesses.
ex.zh: 獲得負擔得起的醫療服務可以提高慢性病患者康復的可能性。

col: the odds of success｜成功的可能性
against all odds｜儘管困難重重
improve the odds｜提高成功機會
words.tip: odds用複數形式，常接of或that從句。

tr: adv. 按自然規律, 完全地, 實際上, 真正地, 身體上地
def: r. in accord with physical laws
In a way related to the body or physical effort.
In a real, material way rather than virtually or theoretically.

ex.en: After moving those boxes, I felt physically exhausted.
ex.zh: 搬完那些箱子後，我感覺身體疲憊不堪。

ex.en: Physically active children often develop healthier habits that continue into adulthood, reducing their risk of chronic disease.
ex.zh: 經常運動的兒童通常會養成更健康的習慣，並延續至成年，從而降低患慢性病的風險。

words.tip: 強調身體層面時，常與mentally形成對比。

tr: a. 藝術的, 藝術家的, 富有藝術性的
def: a. relating to or characteristic of art or artists
s. satisfying aesthetic standards and sensibilities
Related to art or the creation of art

ex.en: The festival celebrates artistic traditions through music and dance.
ex.zh: 這個節日通過音樂和舞蹈頌揚藝術傳統。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for artistic expression, as creative activities can support emotional development and cultural understanding.
ex.zh: 學校應提供藝術表達的機會，因為創意活動有助於情感發展和文化理解。

words.tip: artistic指藝術或藝術天賦；artificial指人造的。

tr: a. 清楚的, 顯著的, 不同的
def: s. (often followed by `from') not alike; different in nature or quality
a. easy to perceive; especially clearly outlined
s. recognizable; marked

ex.en: The twins have similar faces but distinct personalities.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎長相相似，性格卻不同。

ex.en: Public transport and private cars serve distinct needs, so urban planners should consider both.
ex.zh: 公共交通和私家車滿足不同的需求，因此城市規劃者應兼顧兩者。

col: two distinct groups｜兩個不同的群體
words.tip: distinct from表示“與……不同”；勿混淆為distant。

tr: a. 給人深刻印象的, 威嚴的
令人讚歎的；令人欽佩的
def: a. making a strong or vivid impression
s. producing a strong effect
Causing admiration because of exceptional quality, size, or skill.

ex.en: You made an impressive cake for your first attempt.
ex.zh: 你第一次嘗試就做出了這麼出色的蛋糕。

ex.en: The region has made impressive progress in expanding access to clean water over the past decade.
ex.zh: 過去十年，該地區在擴大清潔用水覆蓋範圍方面取得了顯著進展。

words.tip: 事物令人讚歎用impressive；人感到佩服用impressed。

tr: vt. 描繪, 描寫, 描繪...的肖像
def: v. portray in words
v. make a portrait of
v. represent abstractly, for example in a painting, drawing, or sculpture

ex.en: Her paintings portray village life in warm colours.
ex.zh: 她的畫作用溫暖的色彩描繪了鄉村生活。

ex.en: News reports often portray urban life as stressful, overlooking the social and cultural opportunities cities provide.
ex.zh: 新聞報道常將城市生活描繪為壓力重重，卻忽視了城市提供的社交和文化機會。

col: portray someone as｜將某人描繪為
words.tip: 常用portray A as B，表示把A描繪成B。

tr: a. 適度的, 穩健的, 中等的, 節制的
vt. 節制, 減輕, 使緩和
vi. 變緩和, 主持會議
def: v. preside over
v. make less fast or intense
a. being within reasonable or average limits; not excessive or extreme

ex.en: A moderate amount of exercise helps me sleep better.
ex.zh: 適量運動能讓我睡得更好。

ex.en: Moderate increases in housing density could accommodate urban growth without placing excessive pressure on local infrastructure.
ex.zh: 適度提高住房密度可以滿足城市發展的需求，同時避免給當地基礎設施造成過大壓力。

col: moderate your expectations｜適當降低期望
words.tip: 形容詞末尾讀/ət/，動詞末尾讀/eɪt/。

tr: a. 後來的, 接下去的
def: a. following in time or order

tr: [化] 熬煉; 熱煉; 蒸煮
def: n. the act of preparing something (as food) by the application of heat
The activity of preparing food by heating it.
Intended for use in preparing food.

ex.en: My brother does the cooking while I wash dishes.
ex.zh: 我哥哥做飯，我洗碗。

ex.en: Teaching basic cooking skills at school can help young people develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 在學校教授基本烹飪技能，有助於年輕人養成更健康的飲食習慣。

words.tip: cooking指烹飪活動；cook可指廚師，cooker指炊具。

def: n. any amazing or wonderful occurrence
n. a marvellous event manifesting a supernatural act of a divine agent
An extraordinary event that seems impossible or beyond natural explanation.

ex.en: It was a miracle that the vase survived.
ex.zh: 那個花瓶竟然沒碎，真是個奇蹟。

ex.en: Although new technology can appear to work miracles, lasting environmental progress also requires changes in public behaviour.
ex.zh: 雖然新技術似乎能創造奇蹟，但持久的環境改善也需要公眾行為的改變。

words.tip: work miracles指創造奇蹟，也可誇張表示效果驚人。

tr: n. 旋律, 節奏, 韻律, 勻稱, 張弛節律
def: n. the basic rhythmic unit in a piece of music
n. recurring at regular intervals
n. the arrangement of spoken words alternating stressed and unstressed elements

tr: vt. 超過, 超越, 勝過
def: v. be greater in scope or size than some standard
v. be superior or better than some standard
to be greater than a particular amount, limit, or expectation

ex.en: This suitcase must not exceed the airline's weight limit.
ex.zh: 這個行李箱不得超過航空公司的重量限制。

ex.en: Demand for affordable housing continues to exceed supply in many rapidly growing cities around the world.
ex.zh: 在世界許多快速發展的城市中，經濟適用住房的需求持續超過供應。

words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接數量或限度，不加than。

tr: n. 手跡, 手稿, 正本, 手寫體
[計] 手寫體, 小型程序
def: n. a written version of a play or other dramatic composition; used in preparing for a performance
n. a particular orthography or writing system
v. write a script for

tr: n. 慈悲, 博愛, 慈善團體, 施捨
[法] 寬大, 寬恕, 慈善機關
def: n. a foundation created to promote the public good (not for assistance to any particular individuals)
n. a kindly and lenient attitude toward people
n. an activity or gift that benefits the public at large

ex.en: My sister volunteers at a charity that rescues dogs.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家救助狗的慈善機構做志願者。

ex.en: Local charities can provide essential support, but governments remain responsible for ensuring access to basic services.
ex.zh: 地方慈善機構可以提供重要支持，但政府仍有責任保障基本服務的可及性。

col: donate to charity｜向慈善事業捐款
raise money for charity｜為慈善事業籌款
words.tip: 指機構時可數；指慈善事業或救濟時不可數。

tr: n. 一項戰術, 一條策略
a. 戰術的, 順序的, 排列的
def: n. a plan for attaining a particular goal
A particular action used to achieve a goal.

ex.en: Her tactic was to practise before everyone else arrived.
ex.zh: 她的策略是在其他人到達之前先練習。

ex.en: Offering cheaper public transport is one tactic cities can use to discourage unnecessary car journeys.
ex.zh: 提供更便宜的公共交通是城市減少不必要駕車出行的一種策略。

words.tip: strategy指整體戰略，tactic指具體手段。

tr: vt. 敢於, 冒...的危險
def: n. any venturesome undertaking especially one with an uncertain outcome
n. a commercial undertaking that risks a loss but promises a profit
v. proceed somewhere despite the risk of possible dangers

ex.en: Their latest business venture is a small bakery.
ex.zh: 他們最新的創業項目是一家小麵包店。

ex.en: Public funding can help young entrepreneurs launch ventures that address environmental problems in their communities.
ex.zh: 公共資金可以幫助年輕創業者開展解決社區環境問題的創業項目。

col: venture an opinion｜冒昧發表意見
words.tip: venture本身不等於風險投資；風險資本是venture capital。

tr: n. 頁邊的空白, 邊緣, 界限, 餘裕, 差數, 差額, 保證金
vt. 加邊於, 加旁註於
def: n. the boundary line or the area immediately inside the boundary
n. an amount beyond the minimum necessary
n. the amount of collateral a customer deposits with a broker when borrowing from the broker to buy securities

ex.en: Leave a wide margin for your teacher's comments.
ex.zh: 留出寬一些的頁邊空白，方便老師寫評語。

ex.en: Small retailers often operate on a narrow profit margin, making them particularly vulnerable to rising energy costs.
ex.zh: 小型零售商往往利潤微薄，因此尤其容易受到能源成本上漲的衝擊。

col: a wide margin｜寬闊的頁邊空白；很大的差距
words.tip: by a narrow margin表示以微小差距獲勝等。

tr: n. 追求, 狩獵, 追逐
vt. 追捕, 追逐, 雕刻, 在...上鑲嵌寶石
def: n. United States politician and jurist who served as chief justice of the United States Supreme Court (1808-1873)
n. a rectangular metal frame used in letterpress printing to hold together the pages or columns of composed type that are printed at one time
v. go after with the intent to catch

ex.en: Our puppy chased a leaf across the garden.
ex.zh: 我們的小狗追著一片葉子跑過花園。

ex.en: Many young professionals chase higher salaries rather than seek work that offers lasting satisfaction.
ex.zh: 許多年輕的專業人士追求更高的薪水，而不是尋找能帶來持久滿足感的工作。

words.tip: chase可直接接追趕對象，也可用chase after。

tr: n. 新兵, 新手, 新會員, 補給品
vt. 恢復, 補充, 充實, 徵募
vi. 徵募新兵, 復原, 得到補充
def: n. a recently enlisted soldier
n. any new member or supporter (as in the armed forces)
v. seek to employ

ex.en: The animal shelter is recruiting volunteers for weekend shifts.
ex.zh: 這家動物收容所正在招募週末值班的志願者。

ex.en: Hospitals need to recruit more nurses to meet the growing demand for healthcare services.
ex.zh: 醫院需要招聘更多護士，以滿足日益增長的醫療服務需求。

words.tip: recruit可作動詞或可數名詞；招聘活動用recruitment。

tr: n. 片, 補綴, 碎片, 斑, 傻瓜
vt. 補綴, 掩飾, 拼湊, 平息
def: n. a piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole
n. a short set of commands to correct a bug in a computer program
v. to join or unite the pieces of

tr: a. 記錄的, 記錄用的
def: n. a signal that encodes something (e.g., picture or sound) that has been recorded
n. the act of making a record (especially an audio record)
n. a storage device on which information (sounds or images) have been recorded

ex.en: We listened to a recording of birds during breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐時，我們聽了一段鳥鳴錄音。

ex.en: Access to a lecture recording allows students to review difficult concepts at their own pace.
ex.zh: 能夠獲取講座錄像，讓學生可以按自己的節奏複習難懂的概念。

words.tip: 一段錄音可數；表示錄製過程時通常不可數。

tr: a. 殖民的, 殖民地的
def: n. a resident of a colony
a. of or relating to or characteristic of or inhabiting a colony
a. of animals who live in colonies, such as ants

ex.en: Our guide showed us several buildings from the colonial period.
ex.zh: 導遊帶我們參觀了幾座殖民時期的建築。

ex.en: Colonial rule often reshaped local economies by directing agricultural production towards the needs of distant markets.
ex.zh: 殖民統治常使農業生產轉而滿足遙遠市場的需求，從而重塑當地經濟。

words.tip: colony是殖民地；colonial是對應形容詞。

tr: n. 目的, 緣故, 理由
def: n. a reason for wanting something done
n. Japanese alcoholic beverage made from fermented rice; usually served hot
n. the purpose of achieving or obtaining

ex.en: We kept our voices down for the baby's sake.
ex.zh: 為了不打擾寶寶，我們壓低了聲音。

ex.en: Governments should protect natural habitats for the sake of future generations rather than prioritising short-term profits.
ex.zh: 政府應為子孫後代保護自然棲息地，而不是優先考慮短期利潤。

col: for the sake of clarity｜為表達清楚起見
words.tip: 常用於for the sake of或for someone's sake。

tr: vt. 加強, 增援, 補充
vi. 求援, 得到增援
def: v. make stronger
v. strengthen and support with rewards

tr: vt. 暗示, 提供線索
def: n. evidence that helps to solve a problem
v. roll into a ball
Information that helps you solve a problem or understand something.

ex.en: The muddy footprints gave us a clue about the visitor.
ex.zh: 泥腳印為我們瞭解那位訪客提供了線索。

ex.en: Ancient tools provide valuable clues about how early communities adapted to changes in their natural environment.
ex.zh: 古代工具為研究早期群落如何適應自然環境的變化提供了寶貴線索。

col: not have a clue｜完全不知道
words.tip: a clue to中的to是介詞，後接名詞等。

tr: n. 混亂, 混淆, 無秩序
def: n. disorder resulting from a failure to behave predictably
n. a mental state characterized by a lack of clear and orderly thought and behavior
n. a feeling of embarrassment that leaves you confused

ex.en: He stared at the unfamiliar controls in confusion.
ex.zh: 他困惑地盯著那些陌生的控制裝置。

ex.en: Clear instructions can reduce confusion among patients and help them take their medication safely.
ex.zh: 清晰的說明能減少患者的困惑，幫助他們安全服藥。

words.tip: 人感到困惑用confused；事物令人困惑用confusing。

tr: n. 客套語, 公式, 準則
def: n. a group of symbols that make a mathematical statement
n. a conventionalized statement expressing some fundamental principle
n. a representation of a substance using symbols for its constituent elements

ex.en: Our teacher showed us a formula for calculating area.
ex.zh: 老師給我們講解了一個計算面積的公式。

ex.en: There is no single formula for reducing urban poverty, since local economic conditions vary considerably.
ex.zh: 減少城市貧困沒有統一的方法，因為各地經濟狀況差異很大。

words.tip: 複數可用formulas或formulae；方法常接for。

tr: a. 認知的, 認識的
def: a. of or being or relating to or involving cognition
Related to mental processes such as learning, remembering, and understanding.

ex.en: These puzzles help my grandmother keep her cognitive skills sharp.
ex.zh: 這些益智遊戲幫助我祖母保持敏銳的認知能力。

ex.en: Regular physical activity may support cognitive development in children and help older adults maintain their memory.
ex.zh: 規律的身體活動可能促進兒童認知發展，並幫助老年人保持記憶力。

words.tip: 常修飾ability、development等，側重思維和記憶。

tr: n. 屬性, 標誌, 定語
vt. 把...歸於, 認為...屬於
def: n. an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of an entity
To regard something as caused or created by someone or something.
A quality or feature of a person or thing.

ex.en: She attributes her good health to daily walks.
ex.zh: 她把自己的健康歸功於每天散步。

ex.en: Researchers attribute the decline in local air pollution to stricter controls on industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 研究人員將當地空氣汙染的減少歸因於對工業排放更嚴格的管控。

col: attribute success to｜把成功歸因於
a key attribute｜一個關鍵特徵
words.tip: attribute A to B指把A歸因於B；名詞重音在首音節。

def: n. a passageway through or under something, usually underground (especially one for trains or cars)
v. force a way through
A passage built underground or through a hill.

ex.en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
ex.zh: 火車駛入了山下的一條漆黑隧道。

ex.en: Building a tunnel under the river could reduce traffic congestion and improve connections between neighbouring districts.
ex.zh: 在河底修建隧道可以緩解交通擁堵，並改善相鄰區域之間的交通聯繫。

words.tip: 介詞 through 常表示從隧道內部穿過。

def: n. a person or institution against whom an action is brought in a court of law; the person being sued or accused
A person or organisation facing a legal claim or criminal charge.

ex.en: The defendant sat quietly beside her lawyer in court.
ex.zh: 被告在法庭上安靜地坐在她的律師旁邊。

ex.en: Every defendant should have access to legal advice, regardless of their income or social background.
ex.zh: 每位被告都應能獲得法律諮詢，無論其收入或社會背景如何。

col: the rights of defendants｜被告的權利
words.tip: 被告不等於罪犯；原告plaintiff主要用於民事訴訟。

tr: n. 適合, 合宜, 合理, 恰當, 健康
def: n. the quality of being suitable
n. good physical condition; being in shape or in condition
n. the quality of being qualified

ex.en: Swimming every morning has really improved my fitness.
ex.zh: 每天早晨游泳確實提高了我的體能。

ex.en: Schools can improve children's fitness by providing regular opportunities for enjoyable physical activity throughout the week.
ex.zh: 學校可以在一週內定期提供有趣的體育活動機會，以增強兒童體能。

col: fitness for work｜工作勝任能力
words.tip: 不可數名詞；fitness for表示對某事的適合程度。

tr: n. 墓穴, 墳墓, 終結, 死亡
a. 莊重的, 嚴肅的, 重大的, 低沉的
def: n. death of a person
n. a place for the burial of a corpse (especially beneath the ground and marked by a tombstone)
s. dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises

ex.en: She placed fresh flowers beside her grandfather's grave.
ex.zh: 她把鮮花放在祖父的墳墓旁。

ex.en: The destruction of coastal habitats poses a grave threat to biodiversity and the livelihoods of local communities.
ex.zh: 沿海棲息地的破壞對生物多樣性和當地社區的生計構成嚴重威脅。

col: visit a grave｜掃墓；探訪墓地
words.tip: 作形容詞比serious更正式，常修飾威脅或後果。

tr: n. 加亮區, 精彩場面
vt. 加亮, 使顯著, 以強光照射, 突出
最精彩或最重要的部分
def: n. the most interesting or memorable part
n. an area of lightness in a picture
v. apply a highlighter to one's cheeks or eyebrows in order to make them more prominent

ex.en: The boat ride was the highlight of our holiday.
ex.zh: 乘船遊覽是我們假期中最精彩的部分。

ex.en: Recent studies highlight the importance of accessible green spaces for the physical and mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 近期研究強調，方便到達的綠地對城市居民的身心健康十分重要。

col: highlight a problem｜突出一個問題
highlight the importance of｜強調……的重要性
the highlight of the trip｜旅途中最精彩的部分
words.tip: 作動詞直接接賓語：highlight the problem。

tr: n. 長沙發, 睡椅, 臥榻
def: n. a flat coat of paint or varnish used by artists as a primer
n. a narrow bed on which a patient lies during psychiatric or psychoanalytic treatment
A comfortable seat for two or more people.

ex.en: We curled up on the couch after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚飯後，我們蜷坐在沙發上。

ex.en: Public health advice should be couched in clear language so that everyone can understand it.
ex.zh: 公共衛生建議應以清晰的語言表述，讓每個人都能理解。

col: couched in diplomatic terms｜以委婉措辭表達
words.tip: 動詞常用be couched in，指以某種措辭表達。

tr: [法] 同盟, 聯盟, 聯姻
def: n. the state of being allied or confederated
n. a connection based on kinship or marriage or common interest
n. an organization of people (or countries) involved in a pact or treaty

ex.en: The two clubs formed an alliance to save the pool.
ex.zh: 這兩傢俱樂部結成聯盟，力圖保住游泳池。

ex.en: An international alliance can help countries coordinate their responses to environmental threats that cross national borders.
ex.zh: 國際聯盟可以幫助各國協調應對跨越國界的環境威脅。

words.tip: 常用form an alliance with，表示“與……結盟”。

def: n. a proposal intended to explain certain facts or observations
n. a tentative insight into the natural world; a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena
A proposed explanation that can be tested through research

ex.en: Our experiment tested the hypothesis that plants prefer sunlight.
ex.zh: 我們的實驗檢驗了植物更喜歡陽光這一假設。

ex.en: Researchers tested the hypothesis that regular physical activity improves concentration among children in primary education.
ex.zh: 研究人員檢驗了定期體育活動能改善小學生注意力這一假設。

words.tip: 複數為hypotheses；假說須經證據檢驗。

tr: vt. 組成, 寫作, 作曲, 使平靜
def: v. form the substance of
v. write music
v. put together out of existing material

ex.en: She composed a short tune on her old piano.
ex.zh: 她用自己的舊鋼琴創作了一段短曲。

ex.en: Students who compose their own music can develop creativity while gaining a deeper understanding of musical structure.
ex.zh: 自己作曲的學生既能培養創造力，也能加深對音樂結構的理解。

words.tip: be composed of表示“由……組成”。

tr: n. 傳說, 傳奇文學, 圖例
def: n. a story about mythical or supernatural beings or events
an old popular story that may not be historically true
someone greatly admired for exceptional achievements

ex.en: Grandma told us a legend about a sleeping dragon.
ex.zh: 奶奶給我們講了一個關於沉睡巨龍的傳說。

ex.en: Local legends can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors interested in the history of a region.
ex.zh: 地方傳說既能增強文化認同，也能吸引對當地歷史感興趣的遊客。

col: a living legend｜當世傳奇人物
words.tip: legend可能有歷史原型，不等於已證實的歷史。

tr: vt. 管理, 控制, 調節, 調整, 校準
def: v. fix or adjust the time, amount, degree, or rate of
v. bring into conformity with rules or principles or usage; impose regulations
control an activity through rules or laws

ex.en: This small device helps regulate the temperature indoors.
ex.zh: 這個小裝置有助於調節室內溫度。

ex.en: Governments should regulate industrial emissions to protect public health without placing unnecessary burdens on small businesses.
ex.zh: 政府應監管工業排放，在保護公眾健康的同時，避免給小企業增加不必要的負擔。

col: regulate an industry｜監管一個行業
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語；regulate temperature指調溫。

tr: n. 基準, 模範, 標準, 準則, 平均數
def: n. a standard or model or pattern regarded as typical
a usual situation or accepted standard
an accepted rule for behaviour within a group

ex.en: Working from home is now the norm in our team.
ex.zh: 居家辦公如今已成為我們團隊的常態。

ex.en: Social norms influence how people interact, although acceptable behaviour can vary significantly across cultures.
ex.zh: 社會規範影響人們的交往方式，但不同文化所接受的行為可能差異很大。

words.tip: 表示“常態”常用the norm；行為規範常用複數。

tr: a. 講述的, 敘述的；有關係的, 有關聯的
def: a. being connected either logically or causally or by shared characteristics
a. connected by kinship, common origin, or marriage
connected with something in some way

ex.en: These two problems are related to the same broken pipe.
ex.zh: 這兩個問題都與同一根破裂的管道有關。

ex.en: Many health problems are closely related to poor housing conditions and limited access to nutritious food.
ex.zh: 許多健康問題與惡劣的住房條件及難以獲取營養食物密切相關。

col: related by marriage｜有姻親關係的
words.tip: 常用be related to；to是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

tr: n. 儀式, 典禮, 宗教儀式
a. 儀式的, 依儀式進行的
def: n. any customary observance or practice
n. the prescribed procedure for conducting religious ceremonies
n. stereotyped behavior

tr: vt. 與...戰鬥, 與...鬥爭
def: n. an engagement fought between two military forces
to fight against something harmful
fighting between opposing forces or individuals

ex.en: We opened the windows to combat the afternoon heat.
ex.zh: 我們打開窗戶來抵禦午後的炎熱。

ex.en: Governments can combat air pollution by improving public transport and enforcing stricter limits on industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 政府可以通過改善公共交通和加強工業排放限制的執行來治理空氣汙染。

col: combat climate change｜應對氣候變化
words.tip: 作動詞直接接問題或危害，不必加against。

tr: n. 莖, 幹, 柄, 船首, 血統, 堵塞物
vt. 摘掉莖, 裝柄於, 阻止, 堵住, 逆行
def: n. the tube of a tobacco pipe
v. grow out of, have roots in, originate in
v. cause to point inward

ex.en: She cut the rose stem before filling the vase.
ex.zh: 她先修剪了玫瑰的花莖，再給花瓶加水。

ex.en: Many urban transport problems stem from poor planning rather than a simple shortage of road space.
ex.zh: 許多城市交通問題源於規劃不善，而不只是道路空間不足。

col: stem the flow of｜遏制…的流動
stem the tide of｜遏制…的勢頭
words.tip: “源於”用stem from；大寫STEM指理工科。

tr: n. 商議, 忠告, 法律顧問
def: n a lawyer who pleads cases in court
n something that provides direction or advice as to a decision or course of action
v give advice to

ex.en: I sought my aunt's counsel before accepting the job.
ex.zh: 接受這份工作前，我徵求了姑姑的意見。

ex.en: Schools should employ trained professionals to counsel students who experience anxiety about examinations or future careers.
ex.zh: 學校應聘用受過培訓的專業人士，為因考試或未來職業而焦慮的學生提供諮詢。

col: counsel someone against something｜勸某人不要做某事
words.tip: counsel指忠告或律師；council指委員會。

tr: n. 記錄, 圓木, 日誌, 計程儀
vt. 伐木, 切, 航行
def: n. a segment of the trunk of a tree when stripped of branches
n. a written record of messages sent or received
n. a written record of events on a voyage (of a ship or plane)

ex.en: We sat on a fallen log beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我們坐在湖邊一段倒下的樹幹上。

ex.en: Researchers log changes in water temperature to assess how climate change affects freshwater ecosystems over time.
ex.zh: 研究人員記錄水溫變化，以評估氣候變化長期以來對淡水生態系統的影響。

words.tip: 動詞過去式為logged；log in表示登錄。

tr: n. 回聲, 迴音, 回波
vi. 發回聲, 隨聲附和
vt. 摹仿, 重複, 反射
[計] 回顯; DOS批處理命令:控制MS-DOS命令是否在屏幕上顯示
def: n. the repetition of a sound resulting from reflection of the sound waves
n. (Greek mythology) a nymph who was spurned by Narcissus and pined away until only her voice remained
n. a reply that repeats what has just been said

tr: n. 混合物, 複合詞, 化合物, 院子
a. 複合的, 混合的, 化合的
vi. 化合, 和解, 妥協
vt. 使複合, 使化合
def: n. a whole formed by a union of two or more elements or parts
n. (chemistry) a substance formed by chemical union of two or more elements or ingredients in definite proportion by weight
n. an enclosure of residences and other building (especially in the Orient)

ex.en: Water is a compound made from hydrogen and oxygen.
ex.zh: 水是由氫和氧組成的化合物。

ex.en: Poor public transport can compound the difficulties faced by people seeking employment in rural areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通不便會加重農村地區求職者面臨的困難。

words.tip: 名詞重音在首音節；動詞重音在第二音節。

tr: vt. 綜合, 使完整, 使成整體
a. 完整的, 完全的
def: v. make into a whole or make part of a whole
v. become one; become integrated
v. calculate the integral of; calculate by integration

ex.en: This app integrates my calendar with my shopping list.
ex.zh: 這個應用將我的日曆和購物清單整合在一起。

ex.en: Schools should integrate digital tools into classroom activities while ensuring that all students have equal access.
ex.zh: 學校應將數字工具融入課堂活動，同時確保所有學生都能平等使用。

words.tip: 常用integrate A into B，也可用integrate A with B。

tr: n. 傾斜, 斜坡, 斜率, 扛槍姿勢
vt. 使傾斜, 弄斜, 扛
vi. 傾斜, 走, 逃走
def: n. an elevated geological formation
v. be at an angle

tr: a. 敏銳的, 精細的, 狡猾的, 稀薄的, 靈巧的, 微妙的
def: s. able to make fine distinctions
Small or delicate enough to be difficult to notice
Expressed or achieved indirectly and skilfully

ex.en: The soup has a subtle hint of lemon.
ex.zh: 這湯帶有一絲淡淡的檸檬味。

ex.en: Advertising can exert a subtle influence on consumers by associating products with desirable lifestyles.
ex.zh: 廣告將產品與令人嚮往的生活方式聯繫起來，從而潛移默化地影響消費者。

words.tip: b不發音；常形容難以察覺的差別或影響。

def: n. the act of consuming liquids

tr: a. 中級的, 中等的, 次要的, 第二的, 從屬的, 輔助的
[化] 仲(指CH-3...CH(CH-3)-型支鏈烴基或指二元胺及R-2CHOH型的醇); 第二
def: n. the defensive football players who line up behind the linemen
a. being of second rank or importance or value; not direct or immediate
s. depending on or incidental to what is original or primary

ex.en: My sister starts secondary school after the summer holidays.
ex.zh: 暑假過後，我妹妹就要上中學了。

ex.en: Access to quality secondary education can improve employment prospects for young people in rural communities.
ex.zh: 獲得優質中等教育的機會可以改善農村年輕人的就業前景。

words.tip: 表示“次於”用secondary to，不用secondary than。

tr: a. 實驗的, 根據實驗的
def: a. relating to or based on experiment
s. relying on observation or experiment
s. of the nature of or undergoing an experiment

ex.en: We compared the experimental results over lunch today.
ex.zh: 今天午飯時，我們比較了實驗結果。

ex.en: Experimental evidence suggests that improved classroom ventilation can help students maintain concentration during longer lessons.
ex.zh: 實驗證據表明，改善教室通風有助於學生在較長的課堂中保持專注。

words.tip: experimental指實驗的或試驗性的，不是“有經驗的”。

tr: n. 砰然聲, 猛然, 猛烈的抨擊
vt. 猛然關上, 砰地關上, 猛烈抨擊
vi. 砰地關上, 猛攻
def: n. winning all or all but one of the tricks in bridge
n. the noise made by the forceful impact of two objects
n. a forceful impact that makes a loud noise

ex.en: The wind slammed the window shut during breakfast.
ex.zh: 吃早飯時，風把窗戶砰地吹關了。

ex.en: Environmental groups slammed the proposal because it would allow further construction in protected coastal areas.
ex.zh: 環保組織猛烈抨擊該提案，因為它將允許在受保護的沿海地區繼續施工。

col: slam a proposal｜猛烈抨擊提案
words.tip: 過去式slammed，進行式slamming，均雙寫m。

tr: n. 曲線, 彎曲, 曲線球
def: n. the trace of a point whose direction of motion changes
n. a line on a graph representing data
n. a pitch of a baseball that is thrown with spin so that its path curves as it approaches the batter

ex.en: The driver slowed down as we approached a sharp curve.
ex.zh: 我們接近一個急彎時，司機放慢了車速。

ex.en: Roads that curve around existing woodland can reduce habitat destruction, although they may increase construction costs.
ex.zh: 繞著現有林地修建的彎曲道路可以減少棲息地破壞，但可能增加建設成本。

words.tip: curve可作名詞或動詞；“彎曲的”用curved。

tr: n. 正直, 廉正, 完整
def: n. an undivided or unbroken completeness or totality with nothing wanting
n. moral soundness
the quality of being honest and following strong moral principles

ex.en: She showed integrity by returning the money she found.
ex.zh: 她歸還了撿到的錢，體現了誠實正直的品質。

ex.en: Independent inspections help maintain the structural integrity of bridges and protect the public from preventable accidents.
ex.zh: 獨立檢查有助於保持橋梁結構的完整性，保護公眾免受本可避免的事故傷害。

words.tip: 不可數名詞；既指人的正直，也指結構的完整性。

tr: vt. 給...權利, 取名為, 給予名稱, 叫做
[法] 給...權利, 使有資格, 稱呼
def: v. give the right to
v. give a title to
To give someone the right to have or do something.

ex.en: This ticket entitles you to a free lunch.
ex.zh: 憑這張票，你可以免費享用一頓午餐。

ex.en: Employment laws should entitle all workers to paid leave, regardless of the size of their organisation.
ex.zh: 勞動法應賦予所有勞動者享受帶薪休假的權利，無論其所在機構規模大小。

col: entitle someone to benefits｜使某人有資格享受福利
be entitled to compensation｜有權獲得賠償
be entitled to vote｜有權投票
words.tip: entitle sb to sth或to do sth；常用於被動語態。

tr: n. 實質, 本質, 香精
def: n. any substance possessing to a high degree the predominant properties of a plant or drug or other natural product from which it is extracted
the most important quality that makes something what it is
a concentrated liquid containing a particular flavour or scent

ex.en: For me, the essence of friendship is being there.
ex.zh: 對我來說，友誼的真諦就是陪伴與支持。

ex.en: The essence of sustainable development is meeting present needs without limiting opportunities for future generations.
ex.zh: 可持續發展的本質是滿足當代需求，同時不限制後代的發展機會。

words.tip: in essence 表示“本質上”，用於概括核心觀點。

tr: n. 邏輯, 邏輯學, 推理的方法, 推理, 邏輯性
def: n. the branch of philosophy that analyzes inference
n. reasoned and reasonable judgment
n. the principles that guide reasoning within a given field or situation

ex.en: I understand the logic behind your plan to save money.
ex.zh: 我理解你這個省錢計劃背後的思路。

ex.en: The logic behind investing in public transport is that fewer cars can reduce urban congestion.
ex.zh: 投資公共交通的邏輯是，減少汽車數量可以緩解城市擁堵。

col: the logic behind something｜某事背後的邏輯
words.tip: 通常不可數；the logic behind表示背後的道理。

tr: vt. 除外, 排除, 排斥
def: v. prevent from being included or considered or accepted
v. prevent from entering; shut out
v. lack or fail to include

tr: a. 粗糙的, 刺耳的, 嚴厲的
[法] 粗糙的, 嚴厲的, 苛刻的
def: s. unpleasantly stern
s. disagreeable to the senses
s. unkind or cruel or uncivil

ex.en: His harsh criticism upset everyone at the dinner table.
ex.zh: 他苛刻的批評讓餐桌旁的每個人都很難過。

ex.en: Farmers in regions with harsh climates need reliable irrigation systems to maintain stable food production.
ex.zh: 氣候惡劣地區的農民需要可靠的灌溉系統來維持穩定的糧食生產。

words.tip: 比strict更強調嚴厲得令人不快或難以承受。

tr: a. 秘密的, 空談的
def: n. a small private room for study or prayer
v. confine to a small space, as for intensive work
A cupboard or small enclosed space for storing clothes or belongings

ex.en: I hung my winter coat in the hallway closet.
ex.zh: 我把冬季外套掛進了走廊的壁櫥裡。

ex.en: Small apartments can feel more spacious when residents organise belongings efficiently and make better use of closet space.
ex.zh: 如果住戶高效整理物品，更充分地利用壁櫥空間，小公寓也會顯得更寬敞。

words.tip: 衣物收納義多見於美式英語；英式常用wardrobe。

tr: a. 內部的, 心靈的, 內地的, 內政的
def: a. situated within or suitable for inside a building
s. inside and toward a center
s. of or coming from the middle of a region or country

tr: vt. 零售, 詳述, 傳播
def: n. the selling of goods to consumers; usually in small quantities and not for resale
v. be sold at the retail level
v. sell on the retail market

ex.en: She works in retail and enjoys helping customers.
ex.zh: 她從事零售工作，喜歡幫助顧客。

ex.en: The growth of online retail has changed shopping habits and increased competition for traditional town centre shops.
ex.zh: 網絡零售的發展改變了購物習慣，也讓市中心的傳統商店面臨更激烈的競爭。

words.tip: retail面向消費者零售；wholesale指批發。

def: n gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth
v tell or spread rumors

tr: n. 相反, 背面, 倒退, 挫折, 失敗
a. 反面的, 相反的, 反向的, 顛倒的
vt. 使顛倒, 使逆轉, 使倒退, 使反向
vi. 倒退, 反向, 倒轉, 反轉
def: n. a relation of direct opposition
n. the gears by which the motion of a machine can be reversed
n. an unfortunate happening that hinders or impedes; something that is thwarting or frustrating

ex.en: He reversed the car slowly into the garage.
ex.zh: 他慢慢地把車倒進車庫。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy could help reverse the recent rise in emissions from electricity generation.
ex.zh: 對可再生能源的投資可能有助於扭轉近期發電排放量上升的趨勢。

words.tip: 倒車用reverse；撤銷決定可說reverse a decision。

tr: n. 人性, 人類, 博愛
def: n. the quality of being humane
n. the state of being emotionally aroused and worked up
a feeling of great enthusiasm and eager anticipation
something that creates strong interest or enthusiasm

ex.en: The children jumped with excitement when the puppies arrived.
ex.zh: 小狗到來時，孩子們興奮得跳了起來。

ex.en: Although international sporting events generate excitement, host cities must carefully assess their long-term financial costs.
ex.zh: 雖然國際體育賽事令人振奮，但主辦城市必須仔細評估其長期財務成本。

col: contain your excitement｜抑制興奮之情
words.tip: 表示興奮情緒通常不可數：with excitement。

tr: n. 手肘, 彎頭, 扶手
v. 用手肘推開, 推擠
def: n. hinge joint between the forearm and upper arm and the corresponding joint in the forelimb of a quadruped
n. a sharp bend in a road or river
n. a length of pipe with a sharp bend in it

ex.en: I knocked my elbow against the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 我的胳膊肘撞到了廚房門上。

ex.en: Passengers sometimes elbow their way onto crowded trains, making public transport uncomfortable for others.
ex.zh: 乘客有時用肘推擠著登上擁擠的列車，讓其他人乘車時感到不適。

col: rest your elbows on｜將雙肘擱在……上
elbow your way through｜用肘推擠著穿過
words.tip: elbow作動詞時常指用肘推擠著前進。

tr: a. 致命的, 致死的
adv. 非常, 如死一般地
def: s. causing or capable of causing death
s. of an instrument of certain death
s. extremely poisonous or injurious; producing venom

ex.en: These pretty mushrooms can be deadly if you eat them.
ex.zh: 這些漂亮的蘑菇如果吃下去，可能會致命。

ex.en: Improved access to clean drinking water can prevent deadly diseases in communities with inadequate sanitation.
ex.zh: 讓衛生設施不足的社區更容易獲得清潔飲用水，可以預防致命疾病。

words.tip: 雖以-ly結尾，deadly也常作形容詞，意為致命的。

def: n. a measured portion of medicine taken at any one time
n. the quantity of an active agent (substance or radiation) taken in or absorbed at any one time
v. treat with an agent; add (an agent) to

tr: vt. 開始, 傳授基本知識給
def: n. someone who has been admitted to membership in a scholarly field
n. people who have been introduced to the mysteries of some field or activity
v. take the lead or initiative in; participate in the development of

ex.en: Someone needs to initiate a conversation about the noise.
ex.zh: 得有人先開口談談噪聲問題。

ex.en: Local authorities should initiate programmes that encourage residents to recycle household waste more effectively.
ex.zh: 地方政府應啟動相關項目，鼓勵居民更有效地回收生活垃圾。

words.tip: 作動詞較正式；initiate sb into指使入門。

tr: vt. 為...辯護, 提出...藉口, 托稱, 懇求
def: v. appeal or request earnestly
v. offer as an excuse or plea
v. enter a plea, as in courts of law

tr: n. 市郊住宅區, 郊區, 邊緣
def: n. a residential district located on the outskirts of a city
A mainly residential area outside a city's central part.

ex.en: They moved to a quiet suburb near the river.
ex.zh: 他們搬到了河邊一處安靜的近郊住宅區。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can help residents of distant suburbs reach employment opportunities in the city centre.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以幫助遠郊居民前往市中心就業。

col: live in the suburbs｜住在郊區
a leafy suburb｜綠樹成蔭的郊區
words.tip: 常用in the suburbs；suburb不等於鄉村。

tr: vt. 給與動機, 刺激, 提高...的學習慾望, 促動
[經] 促動, 激發, 激勵
def: v. give an incentive for action
to make someone eager to do something
to provide the reason for someone's actions

ex.en: Training with a friend motivates me to exercise regularly.
ex.zh: 和朋友一起訓練能激勵我堅持鍛鍊。

ex.en: Teachers can motivate students to explore difficult subjects by connecting classroom lessons with everyday experiences.
ex.zh: 教師可以把課堂內容與日常經歷聯繫起來，激勵學生探索難學的科目。

col: motivate someone to do something｜激勵某人做某事
words.tip: 常用motivate sb to do；by後可接動機。

tr: vt. 回報, 給於, 付給, 彙報, 提出, 捨棄, 反映, 表示, 表演, 致使, 執行, 實施
def: n. a substance similar to stucco but exclusively applied to masonry walls
v. cause to become
v. give or supply

ex.en: A cracked screen rendered my old phone unusable.
ex.zh: 屏幕破裂讓我的舊手機無法使用了。

ex.en: Rising sea levels could render some coastal settlements uninhabitable unless governments invest in effective flood protection.
ex.zh: 如果政府不投資建設有效的防洪設施，海平面上升可能使一些沿海聚居地不再適宜居住。

col: render something useless｜使某物失去用途
words.tip: 表“使……”時常用render＋賓語＋形容詞，語氣正式。

tr: adv. 看來似乎, 表面上看來
def: r from appearances alone
In a way that appears true but may not be.

ex.en: The seemingly empty box had a kitten inside.
ex.zh: 那個看似空空的盒子裡藏著一隻小貓。

ex.en: Seemingly minor changes in daily travel habits can significantly reduce a city's overall carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 日常出行習慣中看似微小的改變，可以顯著減少一座城市的總體碳排放。

words.tip: 常置於形容詞前，強調錶象未必等於事實。

tr: n. 透鏡, 鏡頭, 鏡片, 晶狀體
def: n. a transparent optical device used to converge or diverge transmitted light and to form images
n. genus of small erect or climbing herbs with pinnate leaves and small inconspicuous white flowers and small flattened pods: lentils
n. (metaphor) a channel through which something can be seen or understood

ex.en: She carefully wiped the dust off her camera lens.
ex.zh: 她小心地擦去相機鏡頭上的灰塵。

ex.en: A damaged lens in the eye can reduce vision and affect a person's ability to perform everyday tasks.
ex.zh: 眼球晶狀體受損會降低視力，影響一個人完成日常任務的能力。

words.tip: 複數為lenses；隱形眼鏡常用contact lenses。

tr: vt. 強迫, 執行, 堅持
def: v. ensure observance of laws and rules;
v. compel to behave in a certain way
Make sure that people obey a law or rule.

ex.en: The pool staff enforce strict rules about running indoors.
ex.zh: 泳池工作人員嚴格執行禁止在室內奔跑的規定。

ex.en: Governments must enforce environmental regulations consistently if they want industries to reduce pollution and protect public health.
ex.zh: 政府若希望各行業減少汙染、保護公眾健康，就必須始終如一地執行環境法規。

words.tip: enforce後接法律或規定；迫使某人做事用force。

tr: n. 欺騙, 欺詐, 詭計, 騙子
[經] 欺詐, 舞弊, 騙子
def: n. intentional deception resulting in injury to another person
n. something intended to deceive; deliberate trickery intended to gain an advantage
Dishonest behaviour intended to gain money or another advantage.

ex.en: The bank called after spotting possible fraud on my account.
ex.zh: 銀行發現我的賬戶可能涉及詐騙後打來了電話。

ex.en: Stronger consumer protection laws can help prevent online fraud and increase public confidence in digital payments.
ex.zh: 更完善的消費者保護法律有助於防止網絡詐騙，並增強公眾對數字支付的信心。

col: a complete fraud｜徹頭徹尾的騙子
words.tip: 欺詐行為通常不可數；指騙子時用a fraud。

tr: vi. 奮鬥, 鬥爭, 競爭
def: v. maintain or assert
v. be engaged in a fight; carry on a fight
To argue that something is true.

ex.en: I contend that our kitchen needs a bigger table.
ex.zh: 我認為我們的廚房需要一張更大的桌子。

ex.en: Some researchers contend that affordable public transport is more effective than road expansion in reducing urban congestion.
ex.zh: 一些研究者認為，在緩解城市擁堵方面，價格合理的公共交通比擴建道路更有效。

col: contend for the title｜爭奪冠軍
words.tip: contend that表主張；with接困難；for接爭奪目標。

tr: n. 排列, 衣服, 大批, 軍隊
vt. 佈署, 打扮, 排列
def: n. an orderly arrangement
n. an impressive display
n. especially fine or decorative clothing

ex.en: The bakery displayed a colourful array of cakes.
ex.zh: 麵包店陳列著各式各樣、色彩繽紛的蛋糕。

ex.en: Modern universities offer a wide array of courses to meet the demands of a changing labour market.
ex.zh: 現代大學提供廣泛的課程，以滿足不斷變化的勞動力市場需求。

col: a wide array of｜種類繁多的
an impressive array of｜令人讚歎的大批
a solar array｜太陽能電池陣列
words.tip: 常見a wide array of，強調數量多、種類豐富。

tr: vt. 集合, 收集, 裝配
def: v. create by putting components or members together
v. get people together
to join separate parts together to make something

ex.en: We assembled the bookshelf before putting our books away.
ex.zh: 我們先組裝好書架，再把書收好。

ex.en: Manufacturers increasingly use robots to assemble electronic devices, improving consistency while reducing demand for some manual jobs.
ex.zh: 製造商越來越多地使用機器人組裝電子設備，在提高一致性的同時減少了對某些體力崗位的需求。

col: assemble in the hall｜在大廳集合
words.tip: 組裝物品時及物；表示人集合時也可不及物。

tr: a. 不可避免的, 必然的
[法] 不可避免的, 無法規避的, 必然的
def: n. an unavoidable event
a. incapable of being avoided or prevented
s. invariably occurring or appearing

ex.en: With traffic this heavy, a delay seems inevitable.
ex.zh: 交通這麼擁堵，延誤似乎不可避免。

ex.en: Some job losses may be inevitable as factories introduce machines that perform routine tasks more efficiently.
ex.zh: 隨著工廠引入能更高效完成常規任務的機器，一些崗位流失可能難以避免。

words.tip: 常用it is inevitable that…表示“……不可避免”。

tr: n. 怪物, 惡人, 巨物
def: n. an imaginary creature usually having various human and animal parts
n. a cruel wicked and inhuman person
n. (medicine) a grossly malformed and usually nonviable fetus

ex.en: The friendly monster in the cartoon has purple feet.
ex.zh: 動畫片裡那隻友善的怪物長著紫色的腳。

ex.en: Stories about monsters can help children explore their fears within a safe and imaginative setting.
ex.zh: 有關怪物的故事可以幫助兒童在安全且富有想像力的情境中探索自己的恐懼。

words.tip: 形容詞用法較口語化，置於名詞前表示巨大。

tr: vt. 使容易, 促進, 幫助
[法] 使容易, 使便利, 推進
def: v. make easier
v. increase the likelihood of (a response)
make an action or process easier

ex.en: These sliding doors facilitate access for people using wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 這些推拉門方便使用輪椅的人進出。

ex.en: Digital platforms can facilitate collaboration between students in different countries, allowing them to exchange ideas more easily.
ex.zh: 數字平臺可以促進不同國家學生之間的合作，讓他們更容易交流想法。

words.tip: 後接名詞或動名詞，不用facilitate somebody to do。

tr: n. 障礙, 妨害物, 阻礙
def: n. something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted
n. an obstruction that stands in the way (and must be removed or surmounted or circumvented)

tr: n. 裂痕, 破綻, 拉裂, 浪子, 巨浪
vi. 被拉開, 裂開, 猛衝
def: n. an opening made forcibly as by pulling apart
n. a stretch of turbulent water in a river or the sea caused by one current flowing into or across another current
v. move precipitously or violently

ex.en: I ripped my sleeve on a sharp branch yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我的袖子被一根尖樹枝扯破了。

ex.en: Repairing a small rip in clothing instead of replacing it can reduce household waste.
ex.zh: 修補衣物上的小裂口而非換掉整件衣物，可以減少家庭垃圾。

words.tip: rip的過去式和過去分詞均為ripped。

tr: n. 水晶, 水晶裝飾品, 結晶
a. 水晶的, 水晶一樣的, 透明的
水晶玻璃；水晶玻璃製品
def: n. a solid formed by the solidification of a chemical and having a highly regular atomic structure
n. a crystalline element used as a component in various electronic devices
n. a rock formed by the solidification of a substance; has regularly repeating internal structure; external plane faces

ex.en: We examined a salt crystal under the classroom microscope.
ex.zh: 我們用教室裡的顯微鏡觀察了一顆鹽晶體。

ex.en: The structure of a crystal influences its physical properties and determines its suitability for various industrial applications.
ex.zh: 晶體結構影響其物理性質，並決定它是否適合各種工業用途。

col: crystal clear｜清澈透明的；十分清楚的
words.tip: crystal clear既可形容水清澈，也可表示意思十分清楚。

tr: n. 後退, 凹處, 衰退, 歸還
def: n. the state of the economy declines; a widespread decline in the GDP and employment and trade lasting from six months to a year
n. the withdrawal of the clergy and choir from the chancel to the vestry at the end of a church service
n. the act of ceding back

ex.en: During the recession, my uncle struggled to find work.
ex.zh: 經濟衰退期間，我叔叔很難找到工作。

ex.en: Governments may increase public investment during a recession to protect jobs and stimulate consumer demand.
ex.zh: 政府可能在經濟衰退期間增加公共投資，以保障就業並刺激消費需求。

words.tip: 通常指整體經濟衰退，不等於單純價格下跌。

tr: n. 夢魘, 惡夢, 可怕的事物(或情景、人物)
def: n. a situation resembling a terrifying dream
n. a terrifying or deeply upsetting dream
a frightening or deeply unpleasant dream

ex.en: I woke from a nightmare and switched on the lamp.
ex.zh: 我從噩夢中驚醒，打開了燈。

ex.en: Without reliable public transport, commuting can become a nightmare for people living outside major cities.
ex.zh: 如果沒有可靠的公共交通，通勤對住在大城市外圍的人來說可能十分煎熬。

col: logistical nightmare｜組織協調上的大難題
words.tip: 通常作可數名詞；形容詞形式為nightmarish。

tr: n. 檢驗, 檢查, 視察
[醫] 檢查, 視察, 監督, 望診
def: n. a formal or official examination
A careful examination to check condition, quality, or safety.

ex.en: The mechanic found a loose cable during the inspection.
ex.zh: 機械師在檢查時發現了一根鬆動的電纜。

ex.en: Regular inspection of public buildings can identify structural problems before they become serious safety risks.
ex.zh: 定期檢查公共建築可以在結構問題構成嚴重安全風險之前發現它們。

col: carry out an inspection｜進行檢查
words.tip: inspection指檢查過程；檢查某物用of連接。

tr: n. 管理者, 監督者, 指導者, 視導員
def: n. one who supervises or has charge and direction of
A person who oversees other people's work or activities.
An academic who guides a student's research.

ex.en: My supervisor showed me how to use the equipment.
ex.zh: 我的主管教我如何使用這些設備。

ex.en: A supportive supervisor can help new employees develop confidence and adapt to unfamiliar workplace expectations.
ex.zh: 支持員工的主管能幫助新員工建立信心，並適應不熟悉的工作要求。

words.tip: 職場中指主管；英國大學中也常指研究導師。

tr: n. 角鬥場, 舞臺, 場地
[醫] 尿沉渣, 尿沙; 腦沙
def: n. the central area of an ancient Roman amphitheater where contests and spectacles were held; especially an area that was strewn with sand
n. a playing field where sports events take place

tr: n. 漂流物, 漂流, 動向
def: n. a force that moves something along
n. the gradual departure from an intended course due to external influences (as a ship or plane)
