n. a process of linguistic change over a period of time

ex.en: We watched a fallen leaf drift across the pond.
ex.zh: 我們看著一片落葉緩緩漂過池塘。

ex.en: Without affordable housing and stable employment, young residents may gradually drift away from rural communities.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏負擔得起的住房和穩定的工作，年輕居民可能會逐漸離開農村社區。

col: drift off to sleep｜漸漸入睡
words.tip: drift強調隨水、風移動，或缺乏明確方向。

tr: n. 排水溝, 消耗, 排水
vt. 排出, 喝光, 耗盡
def: n. emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it
n. tube inserted into a body cavity (as during surgery) to remove unwanted material
n. a pipe through which liquid is carried away

n. (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants

tr: n. 跳躍, 劇增, 急變, 被越過之物
vi. 跳躍, 突然經過
def: n. a light, self-propelled movement upwards or forwards
n. an abrupt transition
n. the distance leaped (or to be leaped)

tr: n. 領域, 領土, 產業, 範圍
[計] 域, 區域, 支配命令
def: n. territory over which rule or control is exercised
n. (mathematics) the set of values of the independent variable for which a function is defined
a particular area of knowledge, activity, or responsibility

ex.en: Electrical repairs are my brother's domain, not mine.
ex.zh: 電器維修是我哥哥擅長的領域，不是我的。

ex.en: Environmental protection should not be regarded as the exclusive domain of scientists, since public participation is essential.
ex.zh: 環境保護不應被視為科學家獨有的領域，因為公眾參與至關重要。

col: the domain of science｜科學領域
words.tip: 領域義近field；in the public domain指公開可用。

tr: a. 怪異的, 超自然的, 不可思議的
n. 命運, 預言, 符咒
def: s. strikingly odd or unusual; some weird effect of shadow"- Bram Stoker

tr: a. 步行的, 步行用的
def: n the act of traveling by foot
v use one's feet to advance; advance by steps
v accompany or escort

ex.en: Walking to the shops takes about ten minutes.
ex.zh: 步行去商店大約需要十分鐘。

ex.en: Cities can encourage walking by improving pavement quality and creating safer crossings near schools and shopping areas.
ex.zh: 城市可以通過改善人行道質量，並在學校和購物區附近設置更安全的過街設施，鼓勵步行。

words.tip: walking中的l不發音；步行去某地也可用on foot。

tr: vi. 倒垃圾, 傾銷商品
[計] 轉出; 轉儲; 傾卸; 切斷電源
def: n. a piece of land where waste materials are dumped
n. (computer science) a copy of the contents of a computer storage device; sometimes used in debugging programs
n. a place where supplies can be stored
r. from this place
r. from this time
For this reason; as a result

ex.en: The oven broke, hence our cold dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 烤箱壞了，所以今晚我們吃冷餐。

ex.en: Urban populations are growing rapidly; hence, governments need to invest more in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 城市人口正在迅速增長，因此政府需要加大對可靠公共交通的投入。

col: hence the need for｜因此需要
hence the importance of｜由此可見……的重要性
words.tip: 正式用語；表示“因此”時，後面也可直接接名詞短語。

tr: vt. 執行, 實行, 完成, 處死, 製成
def: v. kill as a means of socially sanctioned punishment
v. murder in a planned fashion
v. carry out the legalities of

tr: n. 四肢, 枝幹, 翼, 邊緣
def: n. one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper
n. any of the main branches arising from the trunk or a bough of a tree
n. (astronomy) the circumferential edge of the apparent disc of the sun or the moon or a planet

tr: n. 思想體系, 意識形態, 觀念學, 空論
[醫] 觀念學, 觀念形態
def: n. imaginary or visionary theorization
a system of beliefs shaping political or social views

ex.en: Their political ideology shapes how they discuss everyday problems.
ex.zh: 他們的政治理念影響著他們討論日常問題的方式。

ex.en: Educational policies often reflect the ideology of those in power rather than the needs of learners.
ex.zh: 教育政策往往體現當權者的思想理念，而非學習者的需求。

col: share an ideology｜持有共同理念
words.tip: 指成體系的社會或政治觀念，不是單個想法。

tr: a. 慢性的, 習慣性的
長期存在的；反覆發生的
def: a. being long-lasting and recurrent or characterized by long suffering
s. of long duration
s. habitual

ex.en: Gentle swimming helps her manage her chronic back pain.
ex.zh: 舒緩的游泳運動有助於她控制慢性背痛。

ex.en: Chronic staff shortages can reduce the quality of healthcare and increase pressure on existing medical workers.
ex.zh: 長期人員短缺會降低醫療服務質量，並增加現有醫護人員的壓力。

words.tip: 疾病語境中chronic指慢性，acute指急性。

tr: n. 歸還, 更換, 代替者
def: n. the act of furnishing an equivalent person or thing in the place of another
A person or thing that takes another's place.
The act of putting someone or something in another's place.

ex.en: The shop sent a replacement for my broken kettle.
ex.zh: 商店寄來了一個新水壺，替換我壞掉的那個。

ex.en: The replacement of outdated buses with electric vehicles could improve air quality in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 用電動車輛替換老舊公交車，可以改善人口密集城市的空氣質量。

col: a replacement for｜……的替代者或替換物
words.tip: 替換物常可數；替換這一過程通常不可數。

tr: [法] 創新, 改革, 刷新
def: n a creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation
n the creation of something in the mind
n the act of starting something for the first time; introducing something new

ex.en: Our kitchen encourages innovation, so we often try unusual recipes.
ex.zh: 我們家的廚房鼓勵創新，所以我們經常嘗試新奇的食譜。

ex.en: Public investment in research can encourage innovation and help businesses develop more sustainable production methods.
ex.zh: 公共科研投入可以鼓勵創新，幫助企業開發更可持續的生產方法。

col: a major innovation｜一項重大創新
words.tip: 表示創新過程時不可數；表示具體新成果時可數。

tr: n. 緊張, 拉緊, 張力, 過勞, 扭傷, 血緣, 種, 族, 氣質, 曲調, 旋律, 口吻
vt. 使勞累, 拉緊, 過分使用, 扭傷, 濫用, 曲解, 濾
vi. 盡力, 努力, 緊拉, 彎曲, 被濾出
def: n. (physics) deformation of a physical body under the action of applied forces
n. (psychology) nervousness resulting from mental stress
n. injury to a muscle (often caused by overuse); results in swelling and pain

ex.en: I strained my back while lifting that heavy box.
ex.zh: 我搬那個沉重的箱子時拉傷了背部。

ex.en: Rapid population growth puts considerable strain on public services, particularly housing and healthcare in large cities.
ex.zh: 人口快速增長給公共服務帶來巨大壓力，尤其是大城市的住房和醫療服務。

col: put a strain on｜給……造成壓力
a strain of virus｜一種病毒株
words.tip: strain可指拉傷；sprain主要指關節扭傷。

tr: vt. 管理, 料理, 執行
vi. 執行遺產管理人的職責, 給予幫助
def: v. work in an administrative capacity; supervise or be in charge of
v. perform (a church sacrament) ritually
v. give or apply (medications)

ex.en: The nurse administered the medicine before I went home.
ex.zh: 我回家前，護士給我用了藥。

ex.en: Local authorities administer housing programmes designed to provide affordable accommodation for families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 地方政府負責管理住房項目，為低收入家庭提供負擔得起的住所。

words.tip: 給某人用藥可說administer medicine to someone。

tr: n. 舞蹈演員, 跳舞者
def: n. a performer who dances professionally
n. a person who participates in a social gathering arranged for dancing (as a ball)
someone who dances, especially as a job

ex.en: The dancer spun gracefully across the small stage.
ex.zh: 那位舞者在小舞臺上優雅地旋轉。

ex.en: Professional dancers require regular physical training and adequate rest to maintain performance quality and prevent injuries.
ex.zh: 專業舞蹈演員需要定期體能訓練和充分休息，以保持表演水平並預防受傷。

words.tip: dancer不限定性別，也不一定指職業舞者。

tr: n. 填補, 襯墊, 印色盒, 路
vt. 填補, 走, 誇大
[計] 焊接點; 包裝配/拆卸
def: n. a number of sheets of paper fastened together along one edge
n. the large floating leaf of an aquatic plant (as the water lily)
n. a block of absorbent material saturated with ink; used to transfer ink evenly to a rubber stamp

tr: n. 傳輸, 傳送, 變速器
def: n. the act of sending a message; causing a message to be transmitted
n. communication by means of transmitted signals
n. the gears that transmit power from an automobile engine via the driveshaft to the live axle

ex.en: The mechanic checked the transmission before our long drive.
ex.zh: 在我們長途開車前，修理工檢查了汽車的傳動系統。

ex.en: Improved ventilation in public buildings can reduce the transmission of certain infections and protect vulnerable people.
ex.zh: 改善公共建築的通風可以減少某些傳染病的傳播，並保護易感人群。

words.tip: 動詞是 transmit；過去式 transmitted 雙寫 t。

tr: vt. 觸發, 發射, 引起
def: n. a device that activates or releases or causes something to happen
n. an act that sets in motion some course of events
v. release or pull the trigger on

tr: n. 溢出, 濺出, 摔下, 溢出量, 木片, 小塞子
vt. 使溢出, 使散落, 灑, 使流出, 倒出, 使摔下
vi. 溢出, 湧流, 摔下
def: n. liquid that is spilled
n. the act of allowing a fluid to escape
n. a sudden drop from an upright position

ex.en: I spilled orange juice all over my clean shirt.
ex.zh: 我把橙汁灑得乾淨襯衫上到處都是。

ex.en: Oil spills can damage marine ecosystems and threaten the livelihoods of communities that depend on fishing.
ex.zh: 石油洩漏會破壞海洋生態系統，並威脅依賴捕魚的社區的生計。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞可用spilled或spilt。

tr: n. 殖民地, 移民隊
[醫] 菌(集)落, 菌叢; 移民區
def: n. a body of people who settle far from home but maintain ties with their homeland; inhabitants remain nationals of their home state but are not literally under the home state's system of government
n. a group of organisms of the same type living or growing together
n. one of the 13 British colonies that formed the original states of the United States

ex.en: The island was once a colony of a distant kingdom.
ex.zh: 這座島曾是一個遙遠王國的殖民地。

ex.en: Historical records reveal how trade policies shaped the economy of the colony over several decades.
ex.zh: 歷史記錄揭示了貿易政策如何在數十年間塑造該殖民地的經濟。

words.tip: 既可指殖民地，也可指蟻群、鳥群或菌落。

tr: a. 實際上起作用的, 虛的, 實質的, 有效的, 事實上生效的
虛擬的；通過網絡進行的
def: s. being actually such in almost every respect
s. existing in essence or effect though not in actual fact
Created by computers or experienced through an online connection.

ex.en: We took a virtual tour of the museum yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我們在線上虛擬參觀了那座博物館。

ex.en: Virtual classrooms can widen access to education, although reliable internet connections remain essential for effective participation.
ex.zh: 虛擬課堂能夠擴大教育覆蓋面，但可靠的網絡連接仍是有效參與的必要條件。

col: a virtual monopoly｜事實上的壟斷
words.tip: virtual不只指電腦虛擬，也可表示事實上的、近乎的。

tr: vt. 宣告有罪, 使知罪
def: n. a person serving a sentence in a jail or prison
n. a person who has been convicted of a criminal offense
v. find or declare guilty

ex.en: The former convict now works at a local bakery.
ex.zh: 這名曾經服刑的人現在在當地一家麵包店工作。

ex.en: Education programmes can help a convict develop practical skills and prepare for employment after release from prison.
ex.zh: 教育項目可以幫助服刑人員培養實用技能，為出獄後就業做好準備。

col: a convicted offender｜被定罪的違法者
convict someone of theft｜判某人盜竊罪成立
a former convict｜曾經服刑的人
words.tip: 名詞重音在首音節，動詞在第二音節；定罪用of。

tr: a. 本土的, 國產的, 固有的
def: s originating where it is found
Originating or living naturally in a place, rather than arriving later.

ex.en: These flowers are indigenous to the valley near our village.
ex.zh: 這些花原產於我們村莊附近的山谷。

ex.en: Protecting indigenous languages helps preserve cultural knowledge that has been passed down through many generations.
ex.zh: 保護原住民語言有助於保存世代相傳的文化知識。

col: indigenous to an area｜原產於某地區
words.tip: 常用indigenous to；修飾人群時常將首字母大寫。

tr: n. 顆粒, 粒子, 質點, 極小量
def: n. a body having finite mass and internal structure but negligible dimensions
n. a function word that can be used in English to form phrasal verbs

tr: vt. 修正, 變更, 修飾, 緩和, 減輕
def: v. make less severe or harsh or extreme
v. add a modifier to a constituent
To change something slightly to improve it or suit a purpose.

ex.en: We modified the recipe to use less sugar.
ex.zh: 我們調整了食譜，減少糖的用量。

ex.en: Schools may need to modify their teaching methods to support students with different learning needs.
ex.zh: 學校可能需要調整教學方法，以支持有不同學習需求的學生。

words.tip: 通常指局部調整，不一定是徹底改變。

tr: vt. 推進, 提高, 宣揚, 促進
def: n. the act of giving hope or support to someone
n. the act of giving a push
v. give a boost to; be beneficial to

ex.en: A short walk can boost your energy after lunch.
ex.zh: 午飯後散一小會兒步能讓你更有精神。

ex.en: Investment in reliable public transport can boost local employment and improve access to essential services.
ex.zh: 投資建設可靠的公共交通能促進當地就業，並讓人們更容易獲得基本服務。

col: give something a boost｜推動某事
words.tip: 作及物動詞，直接接銷量、信心等賓語。

tr: n. 緊握, 柄, 握力, 握手方式, 手提包, 掌握, 支配, 控制
vt. 抓緊, 抱住, 吸住, 掌握
vi. 握牢, 有吸引力
def: n. the friction between a body and the surface on which it moves (as between an automobile tire and the road)
n. worker who moves the camera around while a film or television show is being made
n. an intellectual hold or understanding

ex.en: She gripped the railing as the boat rocked gently.
ex.zh: 船輕輕搖晃時，她緊緊抓住欄杆。

ex.en: Large companies maintain a strong grip on the market, making it difficult for smaller businesses to compete.
ex.zh: 大公司牢牢控制著市場，使小企業難以參與競爭。

col: lose your grip｜鬆手；失去控制
a grip on power｜對權力的掌控
words.tip: 過去式gripped、現在分詞gripping均雙寫p。

tr: vt. 在...下面挖, 漸漸破壞, 暗地裡破壞
[法] 暗中破壞, 以陰謀中傷傷害
def: v destroy property or hinder normal operations
v hollow out as if making a cave or opening
To gradually weaken someone's confidence, authority, or something's effectiveness

ex.en: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 不斷的批評會削弱你下廚的信心。

ex.en: A lack of transparency can undermine public trust in institutions and reduce support for important policy changes.
ex.zh: 缺乏透明度可能損害公眾對機構的信任，並減少對重要政策調整的支持。

col: undermine public trust｜損害公眾信任
words.tip: 常搭配confidence、trust，強調逐漸或暗中削弱。

tr: n. 投票, 投票用紙, 抽籤
vt. 投票選出, 拉選票
def: n. a document listing the alternatives that is used in voting
v. vote by ballot
A process of voting, usually in secret.

ex.en: Our club chose its new chair by secret ballot.
ex.zh: 我們俱樂部以無記名投票的方式選出了新主席。

ex.en: A secret ballot allows citizens to express their political preferences without fear of pressure from others.
ex.zh: 無記名投票讓公民能夠表達政治傾向，而不必擔心他人的施壓。

words.tip: ballot側重投票程序或選票；by secret ballot指無記名投票。

tr: a. 聰明的, 智能的, 瞭解的
def: a. having the capacity for thought and reason especially to a high degree
s. possessing sound knowledge
s. endowed with the capacity to reason

ex.en: Our intelligent puppy quickly learned how to open doors.
ex.zh: 我們那隻聰明的小狗很快就學會了開門。

ex.en: Intelligent transport systems can reduce congestion by adjusting traffic signals in response to changing road conditions.
ex.zh: 智能交通系統可以根據道路狀況的變化調整交通信號，從而緩解擁堵。

words.tip: intelligent指聰明的；intelligible指可理解的。

tr: n. 趕, 操縱, 駕駛
a. 推進的, 強勁的, 精力旺盛的
def: n. the act of controlling and steering the movement of a vehicle or animal
s. having the power of driving or impelling
s. acting with vigor

ex.en: Her careful driving made the mountain journey feel safe.
ex.zh: 她開車很謹慎，讓這段山路旅程令人安心。

ex.en: Technological innovation is a driving force behind economic growth, although its benefits are not always shared equally.
ex.zh: 技術創新是經濟增長的推動力，但其收益並不總能得到公平分享。

words.tip: driving force意為推動力；driving也可作drive的現在分詞。

tr: n. 修辭, 修辭學, 雄辯(術)
def: n. using language effectively to please or persuade
n. study of the technique and rules for using language effectively (especially in public speaking)
Impressive language that may lack sincerity or practical substance.

ex.en: We need real help, not more rhetoric about teamwork.
ex.zh: 我們需要實際幫助，而不是更多關於團隊合作的空話。

ex.en: Governments must move beyond environmental rhetoric and introduce measurable policies to reduce industrial pollution.
ex.zh: 政府必須超越環保空談，推出成效可衡量的政策來減少工業汙染。

col: the art of rhetoric｜修辭藝術
words.tip: 是名詞；形容詞為rhetorical，可含貶義。

tr: n. 巨大的熱情, 熱心
def: n. a feeling of excitement
n. a lively interest
Strong interest and excitement about something you enjoy or value.

ex.en: The children showed real enthusiasm for planting their own vegetables.
ex.zh: 孩子們對親手種菜表現出了真切的熱情。

ex.en: Teachers who demonstrate enthusiasm for their subjects can motivate students to explore ideas beyond the classroom.
ex.zh: 教師對所教學科展現熱情，能夠激勵學生在課堂之外探索新想法。

words.tip: 對某事的熱情用enthusiasm for，通常不可數。

tr: vt. 使適應, 調和, 通融, 容納, 向...提供
def: v. provide with something desired or needed
v. have room for; hold without crowding
v. make (one thing) compatible with (another)

tr: n. 荒野, 荒地, 大量
def: n. (politics) a state of disfavor
n. a wooded region in northeastern Virginia near Spotsylvania where bloody but inconclusive battles were fought in the American Civil War
n. a wild and uninhabited area left in its natural condition

tr: n. 命令, 指令, 要求
def: n. a document giving an official instruction or command
n. a territory surrendered by Turkey or Germany after World War I and put under the tutelage of some other European power until they are able to stand by themselves
n. the commission that is given to a government and its policies through an electoral victory

tr: n. 帆布, 畫布, 油畫
def: n. a heavy, closely woven fabric (used for clothing or chairs or sails or tents)
n. an oil painting on canvas fabric
n. the setting for a narrative or fictional or dramatic account

ex.en: She packed her lunch in a sturdy canvas bag.
ex.zh: 她把午飯裝進一個結實的帆布包裡。

ex.en: Painting on canvas allows students to explore colour and texture while developing their creative confidence.
ex.zh: 在畫布上作畫讓學生探索色彩與質感，同時增強創作信心。

words.tip: 帆布作材料時不可數；指一幅油畫時可數。

tr: a. 極深的, 深厚的, 深刻的, 淵博的
def: a. showing intellectual penetration or emotional depth
s. of the greatest intensity; complete
s. coming from deep within one

ex.en: Meeting my childhood teacher filled me with profound gratitude.
ex.zh: 見到兒時的老師讓我心中充滿了深深的感激。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet has had a profound impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
ex.zh: 可靠的互聯網接入對偏遠社區的教育機會產生了深遠影響。

words.tip: 常修飾impact、change、understanding，不指物理深度。

tr: n. 大廳, 休息室, 遊說議員者
vi. 遊說議員, 遊說
def: n. the people who support some common cause or business or principle or sectional interest
n. a group of people who try actively to influence legislation
v. detain in conversation by or as if by holding on to the outer garments of; as for political or economic favors

ex.en: I'll wait in the lobby while you collect your suitcase.
ex.zh: 你去拿行李箱，我在大廳等你。

ex.en: Environmental groups lobby governments to introduce stricter controls on industrial pollution and protect vulnerable ecosystems.
ex.zh: 環保團體遊說政府加強工業汙染管控，保護脆弱的生態系統。

col: lobby for reform｜遊說推動改革
lobby against a proposal｜遊說反對提案
the business lobby｜商業遊說團體
words.tip: 遊說支持用lobby for，反對用lobby against。

tr: n. 特徵, 特性, 一筆, 少許
def: n. a distinguishing feature of your personal nature
A particular quality in someone's character or an organism's nature.

ex.en: Patience is the trait I admire most in my sister.
ex.zh: 耐心是姐姐身上最讓我欣賞的品質。

ex.en: Although some personality traits are inherited, social experiences also influence how individuals behave in different situations.
ex.zh: 雖然某些性格特徵來自遺傳，但社會經歷也會影響個人在不同情境下的行為。

words.tip: trait是可數名詞，常指性格或遺傳特徵。

def: n. a belief (or system of beliefs) accepted as authoritative by some group or school
A belief or set of principles taught by a group.

ex.en: The guide explained the doctrine behind the temple's daily rituals.
ex.zh: 導遊解釋了這座寺廟日常儀式背後的教義。

ex.en: Economic doctrine should be evaluated against practical evidence rather than accepted simply because it has influential supporters.
ex.zh: 經濟學說應該依據實際證據來評估，而不應僅因其支持者有影響力就被接受。

words.tip: 不一定含貶義；可指宗教教義或政治、經濟學說。

tr: a. 真正的, 真實的, 誠懇的
def: a. not fake or counterfeit
s. not pretended; sincerely felt or expressed

tr: vt. 以拇指撥弄, 笨拙地擺弄, 用拇指翻舊, 迅速翻閱, 作搭車手勢
def: n. the thick short innermost digit of the forelimb
n. the part of a glove that provides a covering for the thumb
The short, thick finger on the side of your hand.

ex.en: I accidentally hit my thumb while hanging a picture.
ex.zh: 掛畫時，我不小心砸到了拇指。

ex.en: Many readers thumb through printed magazines before deciding which articles deserve their full attention.
ex.zh: 許多讀者會先快速翻閱紙質雜誌，再決定仔細閱讀哪些文章。

col: a rule of thumb｜經驗法則
words.tip: b不發音；thumb through表示快速翻閱。

tr: a. 排外的, 獨佔的, 唯一的
def: n. a news report that is reported first by one news organization
s. not divided or shared with others
a. excluding much or all; especially all but a particular group or minority

ex.en: Guests have exclusive use of the pool this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午泳池僅供住客使用。

ex.en: Giving one company exclusive rights to public data may restrict competition and discourage innovation.
ex.zh: 授予一家公司公共數據的獨家使用權，可能限制競爭並阻礙創新。

words.tip: exclusive to表示“為……獨有”；exclusive of指不含。

tr: n. 消散, 分散, 散播, 散射, 散佈, 酒館
vi. 散佈, 散播, 消散
vt. 使消散, 使分散, 撒, 散佈, 散播, 散射
def: n. a haphazard distribution in all directions
n. the act of scattering
v. distribute loosely

tr: n. 住宅, 居留, 駐紮, 居住期間
def: n. any address at which you dwell more than temporarily
n. the official house or establishment of an important person (as a sovereign or president)
A house or other place where someone lives.

ex.en: Their new residence overlooks a quiet garden near the river.
ex.zh: 他們的新居俯瞰著河邊一座安靜的花園。

ex.en: Applicants may need to provide proof of residence before they can access certain local services.
ex.zh: 申請人可能需要提供居住證明，才能使用某些地方服務。

words.tip: residence較正式；居民是resident，住宅區用residential。

tr: vt. 懸, 吊, 使懸浮, 暫停, 中止, 推遲
vi. 暫停, 中止, 懸浮, 停止償付債務
def: v. hang freely
v. cause to be held in suspension in a fluid
v. bar temporarily; from school, office, etc.
n. a person's partner in marriage
The person someone is married to.

ex.en: Each employee can bring their spouse to dinner.
ex.zh: 每位員工都可以帶配偶參加晚宴。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees share childcare responsibilities more equally with their spouses.
ex.zh: 靈活的工作安排有助於員工與配偶更平等地分擔育兒責任。

words.tip: 正式用語，指丈夫或妻子，不限定性別。

tr: n. 液體, 分泌液, 流體
a. 流動的, 可改變的
def: n. a substance that is fluid at room temperature and pressure
n. continuous amorphous matter that tends to flow and to conform to the outline of its container: a liquid or a gas
s. subject to change; variable

ex.en: The nurse reminded me to drink plenty of fluids.
ex.zh: 護士提醒我要多喝水等液體。

ex.en: Employment patterns are increasingly fluid, requiring workers to update their skills throughout their professional lives.
ex.zh: 就業模式日益多變，要求勞動者在整個職業生涯中不斷更新技能。

col: a fluid situation｜不斷變化的局勢
words.tip: 日常語境多指液體；科學中的fluid也包括氣體。

tr: vt. 重新開始, 取回, 恢復
n. 摘要, 個人簡歷
def: v. take up or begin anew
v. return to a previous location or condition
v. assume anew

ex.en: We will resume our walk when the rain stops.
ex.zh: 雨停後，我們會繼續散步。

ex.en: Schools can resume normal teaching once damaged buildings have been repaired and essential safety checks are complete.
ex.zh: 受損建築修復且必要的安全檢查完成後，學校便可恢復正常教學。

col: resume normal service｜恢復正常服務
words.tip: 後接名詞或動名詞；名詞résumé意為簡歷。

tr: n. 補償, 賠償金, 工資
def: n. something (such as money) given or received as payment or reparation (as for a service or loss or injury)
n. (psychiatry) a defense mechanism that conceals your undesirable shortcomings by exaggerating desirable behaviors
v. open to public use, as of a highway, park, or building
v. inscribe or address by way of compliment
v. set apart to sacred uses with solemn rites, of a church

tr: n. 皮包, 公文包, 部長職務, 有價證券財產目錄, 藝術代表作選輯
[法] 公文包, 文件夾, 閣員職務
def: n. a large, flat, thin case for carrying loose papers or drawings or maps; usually leather
n. a set of pieces of creative work collected to be shown to potential customers or employers
n. a list of the financial assets held by an individual or a bank or other financial institution

ex.en: She brought her photography portfolio to the interview.
ex.zh: 她帶著自己的攝影作品集去參加面試。

ex.en: A diversified investment portfolio can reduce financial risk, although it cannot guarantee steady returns.
ex.zh: 多元化的投資組合可以降低金融風險，但不能保證穩定的回報。

col: a portfolio of work｜一套作品集
hold a portfolio｜擔任部長職務
words.tip: 求職時常指作品集；金融語境指投資組合。

tr: a. 看不見的, 無形的
[經] 無形的, 表面上看不見的, 未列在公開帳目的
def: a. impossible or nearly impossible to see; imperceptible by the eye
Impossible to see.
Not noticed or acknowledged by other people.

ex.en: The thin fishing line was almost invisible underwater.
ex.zh: 那根細魚線在水下幾乎看不見。

ex.en: Although many air pollutants are invisible, prolonged exposure can seriously damage respiratory health, particularly among children.
ex.zh: 儘管許多空氣汙染物看不見，長期接觸仍可能嚴重損害呼吸系統健康，兒童尤其如此。

col: invisible to the naked eye｜肉眼看不見的
words.tip: invisible指看不見；與看不懂的incomprehensible不同。

tr: n. 諾言, 約會, 婚約, 交戰
def: n. employment for performers or performing groups that lasts for a limited period of time
n. contact by fitting together
n. the act of sharing in the activities of a group

tr: n. 交易, 辦理, 學報, 和解協議
def: n. the act of transacting within or between groups (as carrying on commercial activities)
an act of buying, selling, or exchanging money

ex.en: The cashier gave me a receipt for the transaction.
ex.zh: 收銀員給了我這筆交易的收據。

ex.en: Secure payment systems are essential for protecting personal information during online transactions and maintaining consumer confidence.
ex.zh: 安全的支付系統對於保護線上交易中的個人信息及維持消費者信心至關重要。

words.tip: 通常可數：一筆交易是a transaction。

tr: n. 副本, 複本, 配對物, 相應物
[經] 副本, 正副二份中之一
def: n. a person or thing having the same function or characteristics as another
n. a duplicate copy
Someone or something with a similar role in another setting.

ex.en: Our team leader met her counterpart from another branch.
ex.zh: 我們的組長見了另一家分部擔任相同職務的人。

ex.en: Urban schools often have better access to specialist teachers than their rural counterparts, reinforcing educational inequality.
ex.zh: 城市學校往往比農村同類學校更容易獲得專業師資，這加劇了教育不平等。

col: a foreign counterpart｜國外的對等人員
a rural counterpart｜農村的對應對象
a digital counterpart｜數字化的對應版本
words.tip: 強調在另一地區或機構中角色相當，不是對手。

tr: a. 同一的, 恆等的, 完全相同的
def: s. exactly alike; incapable of being perceived as different
s. being the exact same one; not any other:
a. (of twins) derived from a single egg or ovum

ex.en: We bought identical jackets without knowing about each other's choice.
ex.zh: 我們在不知道對方選擇的情況下，買了完全一樣的夾克。

ex.en: Providing identical resources to every school may not address differences in students' needs or local circumstances.
ex.zh: 向每所學校提供完全相同的資源，未必能解決學生需求或當地情況的差異。

words.tip: 常用 identical to；比 similar 的相似程度更強。

tr: prep. 在其間, 在其中
def: prep. See Amidst.
prep. In the midst or middle of; surrounded or encompassed by;
among.

tr: a. 結構的, 建築的
def: a. relating to or caused by structure, especially political or economic structure
a. relating to or having or characterized by structure
s. affecting or involved in structure or construction; not ornamental elements"

ex.en: The builder found structural damage beneath the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 建築工人在廚房地板下面發現了結構性損壞。

ex.en: Reducing long-term unemployment requires structural changes to the economy rather than temporary financial support alone.
ex.zh: 減少長期失業需要對經濟進行結構性調整，而不能僅靠臨時資金支持。

words.tip: 既可指建築結構，也可指經濟、制度等的結構。

def: v. determine or distinguish the nature of a problem or an illness through a diagnostic analysis
v. subject to a medical analysis
to identify an illness by examining symptoms and test results

ex.en: The doctor diagnosed asthma after checking my breathing.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查我的呼吸情況後，診斷我患有哮喘。

ex.en: New screening technologies can help doctors diagnose certain diseases before serious symptoms appear.
ex.zh: 新的篩查技術可以幫助醫生在嚴重症狀出現前診斷出某些疾病。

words.tip: 診斷某人患病用diagnose someone with某病。

tr: n. 爬行, 匍匐而行, 養魚池
def: n. a very slow movement
n. a swimming stroke; arms are moved alternately overhead accompanied by a flutter kick
n. a slow mode of locomotion on hands and knees or dragging the body

ex.en: The baby crawled across the rug towards her toy.
ex.zh: 寶寶爬過地毯，朝她的玩具爬去。

ex.en: During peak hours, traffic crawls through the city centre, increasing journey times and vehicle emissions.
ex.zh: 高峰時段，車輛在市中心緩慢行駛，增加了出行時間和尾氣排放。

col: crawl on hands and knees｜手腳並用地爬
slow to a crawl｜慢至蝸行
words.tip: 車輛crawl指行駛極慢；爬泳常說front crawl。

tr: conj. 倘若, 以...為條件
def: v give something useful or necessary to
v give what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance
v determine (what is to happen in certain contingencies), especially by including a proviso condition or stipulation

ex.en: You can borrow my bike provided you return it tonight.
ex.zh: 只要你今晚歸還，就可以借我的自行車。

ex.en: Remote working can improve employee satisfaction, provided that organisations offer adequate technical support and clear communication channels.
ex.zh: 只要機構提供充分的技術支持和明確的溝通渠道，遠程辦公就能提高員工滿意度。

words.tip: 連詞provided (that)表示條件；that可省略。

tr: a. 有希望的, 前途有望的
def: s. showing possibility of achievement or excellence
Showing signs of likely future success or improvement.

ex.en: Your first attempt looks promising; keep practising every day.
ex.zh: 你的初次嘗試看起來很有希望；堅持每天練習吧。

ex.en: Solar energy offers a promising solution for remote communities that lack access to reliable electricity.
ex.zh: 太陽能為缺乏可靠電力供應的偏遠社區提供了一種前景可期的解決方案。

col: promising career｜前景光明的職業生涯
promising young artist｜有前途的年輕藝術家
words.tip: 表示有成功的潛力，不等於已經成功。

tr: a. 有意識的, 知覺的, 覺察的
[醫] 有意識的, 清醒的
def: s. intentionally conceived
a. knowing and perceiving; having awareness of surroundings and sensations and thoughts
s. (followed by `of') showing realization or recognition of something

ex.en: I became conscious of someone standing behind me.
ex.zh: 我察覺到有人站在我身後。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly conscious of the environmental impact of their purchases and are choosing more sustainable products.
ex.zh: 消費者越來越意識到購物對環境的影響，並開始選擇更可持續的產品。

col: a conscious effort｜有意識的努力
a conscious decision｜有意作出的決定
words.tip: 意識到某事用be conscious of，勿與conscience混淆。

tr: n. 深坑, 礦井, 果核, 地窖, 深淵, 絕境, 陷阱
vt. 窖藏, 使凹下, 使有麻點, 去...之核, 使留疤痕, 使相鬥, 使競爭
def: n. a sizeable hole (usually in the ground)
n. a concavity in a surface (especially an anatomical depression)
n. an enclosure in which animals are made to fight

ex.en: We dug a shallow pit for the new tree.
ex.zh: 我們挖了一個淺坑，準備栽這棵新樹。

ex.en: Abandoned mining pits can threaten local ecosystems unless restoration projects stabilise the soil and improve water quality.
ex.zh: 廢棄礦坑可能威脅當地生態系統，除非修復項目能穩固土壤並改善水質。

col: a pit stop｜賽車進站檢修
words.tip: 維修區常用the pits；果核義主要用於美式英語。

def: n. the difference between the market value of a property and the claims held against it
n. the ownership interest of shareholders in a corporation
n. lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building
n. the airfoil on the tailplane of an aircraft that makes it ascend or descend
A machine carrying people or goods between floors.

ex.en: We took the elevator because our bags were heavy.
ex.zh: 我們的包很重，所以我們乘了電梯。

ex.en: Installing elevators in older apartment buildings can significantly improve accessibility for elderly residents and people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 在老舊公寓樓中安裝電梯可以顯著方便老年居民和殘障人士出入。

words.tip: 電梯在美式英語中常用elevator，英式常用lift。

tr: n. 追蹤, 追求, 追趕, 娛樂, 職業
def: n. the act of pursuing in an effort to overtake or capture
n. a search for an alternative that meets cognitive criteria
The effort to achieve or obtain something

ex.en: Her pursuit of happiness led her to gardening.
ex.zh: 為了尋找快樂，她開始了園藝活動。

ex.en: The pursuit of economic growth should not come at the expense of environmental protection.
ex.zh: 追求經濟增長不應以犧牲環境保護為代價。

col: the pursuit of knowledge｜對知識的追求
words.tip: 表示追求或追趕通常不可數；消遣活動可數。

tr: a. 有分寸的, 得體的, 大方的
def: s. socially or conventionally correct; refined or virtuous
a. conforming to conventions of sexual behavior
s. decently clothed

ex.en: We finally found a decent flat near the station.
ex.zh: 我們終於在車站附近找到了一套像樣的公寓。

ex.en: Every worker should earn enough to afford decent housing and meet their basic needs.
ex.zh: 每位勞動者都應有足夠的收入，住上像樣的住房並滿足基本需求。

words.tip: 表示質量時是“還不錯”，不等於“極好”。

tr: vt. 支持, 贊同, 背書於, 簽署
def: v. sign as evidence of legal transfer
n. the process in which part of the output of a system is returned to its input in order to regulate its further output
n. response to an inquiry or experiment
comments about performance or work that help someone improve

ex.en: My tutor gave me helpful feedback on my essay.
ex.zh: 導師針對我的作文給了我有用的反饋。

ex.en: Regular feedback enables students to identify weaknesses and develop more effective strategies for independent learning.
ex.zh: 定期反饋能幫助學生髮現薄弱之處，並制定更有效的自主學習策略。

words.tip: 不可數，不說a feedback或feedbacks；用some feedback。

def: r. by that means or because of that
as a result of the action just mentioned

ex.en: She sealed the jar tightly, thereby keeping the biscuits fresh.
ex.zh: 她把罐子封得嚴嚴實實，從而讓餅乾保持新鮮。

ex.en: Cities can expand public transport networks, thereby reducing traffic congestion and improving air quality for residents.
ex.zh: 城市可以擴展公共交通網絡，從而緩解交通擁堵並改善居民呼吸的空氣質量。

col: thereby reducing costs｜從而降低成本
thereby improving efficiency｜從而提高效率
words.tip: 常用逗號加thereby doing，說明前述行為的結果。

tr: n. 指示器, 指示劑, 指標
def: n. a signal for attracting attention
n. a device for showing the operating condition of some system

n. (chemistry) a substance that changes color to indicate the presence of some ion or substance; can be used to indicate the completion of a chemical reaction or (in medicine) to test for a particular reaction

tr: n. 光譜, 範圍, 系列
def: n. an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave
n. a broad range of related objects or values or qualities or ideas or activities
A range of related ideas, qualities, or possibilities

ex.en: Our book club welcomes a wide spectrum of opinions.
ex.zh: 我們的讀書會歡迎各種不同的觀點。

ex.en: Universities should provide support for students across the entire spectrum of academic abilities and social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 大學應為各種學業水平和社會背景的學生提供支持。

col: a broad spectrum of｜廣泛的各種……
across the spectrum｜涵蓋整個範圍
words.tip: 複數可用spectra或spectrums。

def: a. fearless and daring
s. clear and distinct
Willing to take risks or act with confidence.

ex.en: She made a bold decision to open her own bakery.
ex.zh: 她大膽決定開一家自己的麵包店。

ex.en: Governments need bold policies to address housing shortages while protecting green spaces and supporting affordable development.
ex.zh: 政府需要大膽的政策來解決住房短缺，同時保護綠地並支持可負擔住房的開發。

words.tip: in bold表示“用粗體”，常用於排版說明。

tr: n. 專家意見, 專門技術
[法] 專門知識, 專家意見
def: n skillfulness by virtue of possessing special knowledge
Specialist knowledge or skills gained through training and experience.

ex.en: We need your expertise to repair this old clock.
ex.zh: 修理這座舊鐘需要你的專業技能。

ex.en: Universities can support local businesses by sharing their expertise in renewable energy and sustainable manufacturing.
ex.zh: 大學可以通過分享可再生能源和可持續製造領域的專業知識來支持當地企業。

col: draw on expertise｜利用專業知識
words.tip: 不可數；某領域的專長用expertise in。

tr: n. 開端, 開始, 出發, 起動, 開動
def: s. (especially of eyes) bulging or protruding as with fear
s. appropriate to the beginning or start of an event
Relating to the point where something begins

ex.en: We gathered at the starting point before sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出前，我們在起點集合。

ex.en: A fair starting salary can help employers attract talented graduates and improve long-term staff retention.
ex.zh: 公平的起薪可以幫助僱主吸引優秀畢業生，並提高員工的長期留任率。

words.tip: 常見於starting point；也可作start的分詞。

tr: a. 不情願的, 勉強的
[法] 不願的, 勉強的, 難以處理的
def: s. disinclined to become involved
s. not eager
Unwilling or hesitant to do something.

ex.en: He was reluctant to leave his warm bed.
ex.zh: 他不情願離開溫暖的被窩。

ex.en: Many commuters remain reluctant to use public transport when services are infrequent or unreliable.
ex.zh: 當班次稀少或服務不可靠時，許多通勤者仍不願乘坐公共交通。

words.tip: 常用be reluctant to do，表示不願做某事。

tr: adv. 幾乎, 差不多, 事實上
def: r. almost; nearly
r. in a practical manner
Almost completely, or very nearly.

ex.en: The fridge was practically empty when we got home.
ex.zh: 我們到家時，冰箱幾乎空了。

ex.en: Without reliable internet access, participating in online education is practically impossible for students in remote areas.
ex.zh: 沒有可靠的互聯網連接，偏遠地區的學生幾乎無法參與在線教育。

words.tip: 常表示“幾乎”，並不總等於“實際地”。

tr: n. 遊行, 炫耀, 閱兵
v. 遊行, 炫耀, (使)列隊行進
def: n. a ceremonial procession including people marching
n. an extended (often showy) succession of persons or things
n. a visible display

ex.en: Children waved flags as the parade passed our balcony.
ex.zh: 遊行隊伍經過我們的陽臺時，孩子們揮動著旗幟。

ex.en: A cultural parade allows communities to celebrate their traditions and share them with people from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 文化遊行讓各社區能夠慶祝自身傳統，並與不同背景的人分享這些傳統。

col: parade through the streets｜列隊穿過街道
words.tip: parade重在列隊展示；抗議遊行常用march。

def: n. an indirect suggestion
n. a slight indication
v. drop a hint; intimate by a hint

ex.en: Give me a hint about where you hid the gift.
ex.zh: 給我一點提示吧，你把禮物藏在哪裡了？

ex.en: Survey responses hint at growing dissatisfaction with public transport, particularly among commuters living outside city centres.
ex.zh: 調查回復暗示，人們對公共交通的不滿日益加深，住在市中心以外的通勤者尤其如此。

col: give someone a hint｜給某人提示
a hint of lemon｜一絲檸檬味
words.tip: 動詞常用hint at sth或hint that從句。

tr: n. 王國, 領土, 領域
def: n a domain in which something is dominant
n the domain ruled by a king or queen
n a knowledge domain that you are interested in or are communicating about

ex.en: Robots have moved beyond the realm of science fiction.
ex.zh: 機器人已經走出了科幻的領域，成為現實。

ex.en: Advances in artificial intelligence are transforming the realm of education by enabling more personalised learning experiences.
ex.zh: 人工智能的進步正通過提供更個性化的學習體驗來改變教育領域。

col: the realm of science｜科學領域
within the realm of possibility｜在可能的範圍內
beyond the realm of｜超出……的範圍
words.tip: 常用the realm of；表示領域時比area更正式。

def: n. an occurrence of thorough mixing
n. a new word formed by joining two others and combining their meanings
n. the act of blending components together thoroughly

ex.en: Blend the bananas and milk until the mixture is smooth.
ex.zh: 把香蕉和牛奶攪打至順滑。

ex.en: Successful urban developments blend modern facilities with traditional architecture to preserve a city's distinctive character.
ex.zh: 成功的城市開發項目將現代設施與傳統建築融合，以保留城市的獨特風貌。

words.tip: blend A with B表示將兩者融合；blend in指融入。

def: n. a person skilled in a particular type of therapy

tr: a. 領受的, 容易接受的, 感受性強的
n. 領受者, 容納者, 容器
def: n. a person who receives something
a person or organisation that receives something

ex.en: The recipient smiled as she opened the unexpected gift.
ex.zh: 收到禮物的女子打開這份意外的禮物時笑了。

ex.en: Scholarship recipients often gain access to educational opportunities that would otherwise be beyond their financial means.
ex.zh: 獎學金獲得者往往因此得到原本無力負擔的教育機會。

words.tip: 常用recipient of sth；通常指接受者，不指容器。

tr: vt. 削...皮, 剝去...的殼
vi. 蛻皮, 剝落, 脫皮, 脫去衣服
def: n. British politician (1788-1850)
n. the rind of a fruit or vegetable
To remove the outer skin of fruit or vegetables.

ex.en: Could you peel these potatoes while I chop the carrots?
ex.zh: 我切胡蘿蔔時，你能幫忙削這些土豆嗎？

ex.en: Households can compost vegetable peels rather than discard them, reducing the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 家庭可以將蔬菜皮製成堆肥而非丟棄，從而減少送往填埋場的垃圾量。

words.tip: peel作動詞可指削皮，也可指油漆等剝落。

tr: n. 會計學, 帳單, 清帳
def: n. a convincing explanation that reveals basic causes
n. a system that provides quantitative information about finances
n. a bookkeeper's chronological list of related debits and credits of a business; forms part of a ledger of accounts

ex.en: My sister studies accounting and helps with our shop's finances.
ex.zh: 我姐姐學會計，也幫忙處理我們店裡的財務。

ex.en: Accurate accounting enables businesses to monitor costs, meet legal requirements, and make informed financial decisions.
ex.zh: 準確的會計核算使企業能夠監控成本、符合法律要求，並作出有依據的財務決策。

words.tip: 表示會計工作或學科時不可數；會計師是 accountant。

tr: vt. 擲, 彈, 輕擊, 空翻
vi. 用指輕彈, 抽打, 蹦跳
n. 拋, 彈, 筋斗
def: n. hot or cold alcoholic mixed drink containing a beaten egg
n. a sudden, quick movement
n. the act of flipping a coin

tr: [計] 偏流; 偏壓; 偏磁; 偏離
def: n. a partiality that prevents objective consideration of an issue or situation
v. influence in an unfair way
v. cause to be biased

ex.en: The referee showed clear bias towards the home team.
ex.zh: 裁判明顯偏袒主隊。

ex.en: Researchers should select participants carefully to minimise bias and ensure that their findings represent the wider population.
ex.zh: 研究人員應謹慎選擇參與者，以儘量減少偏差，確保研究結果能夠代表更廣泛的人群。

words.tip: bias against 指對……有偏見；in favour of 指偏袒。

def: n. a figure of speech in which an expression is used to refer to something that it does not literally denote in order to suggest a similarity

tr: a. 法庭的, 公正的, 審判上的, 司法的
[法] 司法的, 審判上的, 法官的
def: s. decreed by or proceeding from a court of justice
a. belonging or appropriate to the office of a judge
a. relating to the administration of justice or the function of a judge

ex.en: The lawyer explained the judicial process to our family.
ex.zh: 律師向我們一家解釋了司法程序。

ex.en: An independent judicial system helps protect individual rights and ensures that governments remain accountable.
ex.zh: 獨立的司法體系有助於保護個人權利，並確保政府承擔責任。

words.tip: judicial指司法；judicious指明智、審慎。

tr: n. 實體, 實存物, 存在
def: n. that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)
something that exists independently, especially an organization

ex.en: Our small bakery now operates as a separate entity.
ex.zh: 我們的小麵包店現在作為獨立實體運營。

ex.en: Each university should remain an independent entity while cooperating with other institutions on important research projects.
ex.zh: 各大學在與其他機構合作開展重要研究項目的同時，應保持獨立。

words.tip: 強調獨立存在的單位，常用於機構、法律或商業語境。

tr: a. 外交的, 老練的
[法] 外交的, 外交上的, 文獻上的
def: a. relating to or characteristic of diplomacy
a. using or marked by tact in dealing with sensitive matters or people
relating to official relations between countries

ex.en: You gave a diplomatic answer to that awkward question.
ex.zh: 你對那個尷尬問題的回答很得體。

ex.en: Maintaining diplomatic relations allows countries to resolve disagreements through negotiation rather than allowing tensions to escalate.
ex.zh: 保持外交關係使各國能夠通過談判解決分歧，而不是任由緊張局勢升級。

col: a diplomatic solution｜外交解決方案
words.tip: 既可指國家間外交，也可形容說話處事得體。

def: n. the protruding part of the lower jaw
v. raise oneself while hanging from one's hands until one's chin is level with the support bar
The part of your face below your mouth.

ex.en: He rested his chin on his hand and sighed.
ex.zh: 他用手托著下巴，嘆了口氣。

ex.en: Cyclists should adjust helmet straps beneath the chin to ensure a secure fit during travel.
ex.zh: 騎車者應調節下巴下方的頭盔帶，確保騎行時頭盔佩戴牢固。

col: rest your chin on your hand｜用手托著下巴
words.tip: chin指下巴；jaw指頜部，範圍更廣。

tr: vi. 消失, 不見, 成為零
def: v. become invisible or unnoticeable
v. cease to exist
v. decrease rapidly and disappear

tr: v. 承認, 坦白, 懺悔, 供認
def: v. confess to a punishable or reprehensible deed, usually under pressure
v. confess to God in the presence of a priest, as in the Catholic faith
to admit doing something wrong or illegal

ex.en: I confessed to eating the last slice of cake.
ex.zh: 我坦白自己吃掉了最後一塊蛋糕。

ex.en: Students may be more willing to confess their mistakes when teachers respond calmly and offer constructive guidance.
ex.zh: 如果教師冷靜回應並給予建設性指導，學生可能更願意坦白自己的錯誤。

col: confess to doing something｜坦白做過某事
words.tip: confess to中的to是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

tr: n. 開端者, 在起跑線上的人, 參加賽跑的人, 調度員, 起動機, 酵母
[計] 啟動程序, 啟動器
def: n. an electric motor for starting an engine
n. a contestant in a team sport who is in the game at the beginning
n. the official who signals the beginning of a race or competition

tr: [經] 銀行業, 銀行事務
def: n. engaging in the business of keeping money for savings and checking accounts or for exchange or for issuing loans and credit etc.
n. transacting business with a bank; depositing or withdrawing funds or requesting a loan etc.
v. lessen the authority, dignity, or reputation of
to become smaller or weaker, or make something so
to make someone or something seem less important or valuable

ex.en: The pain in my ankle gradually diminished overnight.
ex.zh: 一夜之間，我腳踝的疼痛逐漸減輕了。

ex.en: Investment in reliable public transport can diminish dependence on private cars and improve air quality in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 投資建設可靠的公共交通可以減少對私家車的依賴，改善擁擠城市的空氣質量。

words.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：信心可diminish，也可被削弱。

tr: n. 阻止, 妨礙, 預防
def: n. the act of preventing
Action taken to stop something unwanted from happening.

ex.en: Regular handwashing is a simple method of infection prevention.
ex.zh: 經常洗手是一種簡單的預防感染的方法。

ex.en: Investment in disease prevention can reduce pressure on hospitals and improve public health over the long term.
ex.zh: 從長遠來看，投資疾病預防能夠減輕醫院壓力並改善公共健康。

words.tip: 通常不可數；動詞搭配為prevent sb from doing。

tr: n. 意圖, 含義, 故意
a. 專心的, 決心的, 熱心的
def: n. the intended meaning of a communication
What someone plans or means to do.
Giving all your attention to something.

ex.en: My intent was to help, not to interrupt you.
ex.zh: 我本意是幫忙，而不是打斷你。

ex.en: Many governments are intent on reducing traffic congestion through investment in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 許多政府決心通過投資可靠的公共交通來減少交通擁堵。

col: with the intent of｜懷著……的目的
intent on doing something｜決意做某事
a statement of intent｜意向聲明
words.tip: intent on後接名詞或動名詞，表示專注或決意。

tr: vt. 使隔離, 使孤立, 使絕緣
def: v. place or set apart
v. obtain in pure form
v. separate (experiences) from the emotions relating to them

ex.en: Heavy snow isolated the village from the nearest town.
ex.zh: 大雪使這個村莊與最近的城鎮隔絕了。

ex.en: Researchers must isolate the effects of income before drawing conclusions about the relationship between education and health.
ex.zh: 研究人員必須單獨釐清收入的影響，才能對教育與健康的關係下結論。

col: isolate someone from｜使某人與……隔離
isolate a variable｜單獨考察一個變量
words.tip: 常用isolate A from B；形容詞是isolated。

tr: n. 肋條肉, 排骨, 砍, 戳記, 商標
vt. 剁碎, 砍, 切擊, 割斷
def: n. the irregular motion of waves (usually caused by wind blowing in a direction opposite to the tide)
n. a small cut of meat including part of a rib
n. a jaw

ex.en: Please chop the carrots while I heat the soup.
ex.zh: 我來熱湯，請你把胡蘿蔔切碎。

ex.en: When communities chop down trees for fuel, they may unintentionally damage habitats and increase soil erosion.
ex.zh: 當社區居民砍樹用作燃料時，他們可能無意中破壞棲息地，加劇水土流失。

words.tip: 過去式chopped，進行式chopping，均雙寫p。

tr: n. 味, 調味香料, 滋味, 香味, 氣味, 風味, 情味, 情趣, 風韻
vt. 給...調味, 給...增添風趣, 加香料, 加味於
def: n the general atmosphere of a place or situation and the effect that it has on people
n (physics) the six kinds of quarks
n the taste experience when a savoury condiment is taken into the mouth

ex.en: Fresh basil gives this soup a lovely flavour.
ex.zh: 新鮮羅勒讓這道湯有了宜人的風味。

ex.en: School cooking lessons can teach children how to improve flavour without adding excessive salt or sugar.
ex.zh: 學校的烹飪課可以教孩子如何在不過量加鹽或糖的情況下提升食物風味。

words.tip: 英式拼寫flavour，美式拼寫flavor。

tr: a. 能生產的, 有生產價值的, 多產的
[醫] 產出性的, 產生性的
def: a. producing or capable of producing (especially abundantly)
s. yielding positive results
achieving a lot or producing useful results

ex.en: I had a productive morning and finished my report.
ex.zh: 我上午效率很高，完成了報告。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees remain productive while balancing professional responsibilities with family commitments.
ex.zh: 靈活的工作安排可以幫助員工兼顧工作職責和家庭義務，同時保持高效。

col: a productive discussion｜富有成效的討論
words.tip: 形容工作或討論有成果；產量或效率用productivity。

tr: n. 詳細目錄, 存貨清單
vt. 列入詳細目錄, 清點存貨
def: n. a detailed list of all the items in stock
n. (accounting) the value of a firm's current assets including raw materials and work in progress and finished goods
n. making an itemized list of merchandise or supplies on hand

ex.en: We made an inventory of everything in the garage.
ex.zh: 我們把車庫裡的所有東西列成了清單。

ex.en: Digital systems help retailers manage inventory more efficiently, reducing waste and preventing shortages of essential products.
ex.zh: 數字系統幫助零售商更高效地管理庫存，減少浪費並防止必需品短缺。

words.tip: 表示庫存時多見於美式英語，英式常用stock。

tr: a. 市的, 市民的, 公民的
[法] 公民的, 市民的, 公民資格的
def: a. of or relating or belonging to a city
relating to a town or city and its administration
relating to citizens and their responsibilities within a community

ex.en: The mayor welcomed visitors outside the new civic centre.
ex.zh: 市長在新市政中心外迎接來訪者。

ex.en: Schools can strengthen civic responsibility by encouraging students to participate in projects that benefit their local communities.
ex.zh: 學校可以鼓勵學生參與造福當地社區的項目，以增強他們的公民責任感。

words.tip: civic強調城市或公民事務；civil還可指民事的、禮貌的。

tr: n. 巨大, 重大, 重要, 大小, 數量, 星等(指星的亮度)
def: n. the property of relative size or extent (whether large or small)
n. relative importance
The size, extent, or importance of something.

ex.en: We only realised the magnitude of the damage at sunrise.
ex.zh: 直到日出時，我們才意識到損壞的嚴重程度。

ex.en: The magnitude of global food waste highlights the need for better storage systems and more responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 全球食物浪費的巨大規模凸顯了改善儲存系統和更負責任地消費的必要性。

col: the magnitude of the problem｜問題的嚴重程度
an earthquake of magnitude six｜六級地震
an order of magnitude｜一個數量級
words.tip: 談規模常用the magnitude of；震級也用此詞。

def: n. a prisoner who is held by one party to insure that another party will meet specified terms
someone held captive to force others to meet demands

ex.en: The hostage returned home safely and hugged her family.
ex.zh: 那名人質平安回家，擁抱了家人。

ex.en: Governments must balance public safety with the need to secure the release of every hostage.
ex.zh: 政府必須兼顧公眾安全與確保每一名人質獲釋的需要。

col: take someone hostage｜劫持某人作人質
hold someone hostage｜扣押某人作人質
words.tip: take或hold someone hostage中，hostage前不加冠詞。

tr: a. 外國的, 相異的
def: v. transfer property or ownership
s. not contained in or deriving from the essential nature of something
s. being or from or characteristic of another place or part of the world

ex.en: The city's constant noise felt alien after our quiet village.
ex.zh: 住慣了安靜的村莊後，城市持續不斷的噪聲讓我們感到很陌生。

ex.en: Teaching methods that seem alien to international students may require careful explanation and additional support from university staff.
ex.zh: 對於國際學生感到陌生的教學方法，大學教職員工可能需要仔細解釋並提供額外支持。

words.tip: 稱外國人為alien有疏離感；通常用foreign national。

tr: n. 相等, 等式, 平衡
[化] 方程式; 等式; 反應式; 公式
def: n. a mathematical statement that two expressions are equal
n. the act of regarding as equal

tr: n. 憤怒, 情緒激動, 狂暴
vi. 大怒, 狂吹, 流行
def: n. a state of extreme anger
n. something that is desired intensely
n. violent state of the elements

ex.en: He shook with rage when he discovered his broken bicycle.
ex.zh: 發現自行車被弄壞後，他氣得渾身發抖。

ex.en: As wildfires rage across dry regions, local authorities must coordinate evacuations and provide temporary accommodation.
ex.zh: 當野火在乾旱地區肆虐時，當地政府必須協調疏散並提供臨時住所。

col: fly into a rage｜勃然大怒
words.tip: rage比anger強烈；all the rage表示“風靡一時”。

def: v. register formally as a participant or member

tr: n. 絆倒, 蹣跚而行, 失足
vt. 使絆倒, 使困惑
vi. 絆倒, 失足, 失策, 犯錯, 蹣跚, 躊躇
def: v. walk unsteadily
v. miss a step and fall or nearly fall
v. encounter by chance

ex.en: I stumbled over a loose stone on the garden path.
ex.zh: 我在花園小路上被一塊鬆動的石頭絆了一下。

ex.en: Students may stumble over unfamiliar words during presentations, but regular practice can improve their confidence.
ex.zh: 學生做展示時可能會在不熟悉的詞上卡殼，但經常練習能增強他們的信心。

col: stumble over a stone｜被石頭絆一下
stumble over words｜說話磕磕巴巴
stumble across something｜偶然發現某物
words.tip: stumble不一定摔倒；stumble across指偶然發現。

def: v. travel in an automobile
a road vehicle with an engine, usually carrying few passengers

ex.en: My grandfather keeps a vintage automobile in his garage.
ex.zh: 我祖父的車庫裡收藏著一輛老式汽車。

ex.en: Growth in automobile ownership has increased pressure on road networks and contributed to urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 汽車保有量的增長加重了道路網絡的壓力，也加劇了城市空氣汙染。

words.tip: 主要用於美式英語，較正式；日常表達通常用car。

tr: vi. 下降, 世代相傳, 屈尊, 襲擊
def: v. move downward and lower, but not necessarily all the way
to move down or go to a lower position

ex.en: We descended the narrow stairs into a cool cellar.
ex.zh: 我們沿著狹窄的樓梯走下去，進入涼爽的地窖。

ex.en: As aircraft descend towards urban airports, their noise can significantly affect the quality of life in nearby communities.
ex.zh: 飛機向城市機場下降時，產生的噪聲會顯著影響周邊社區的生活質量。

col: descend into a valley｜下到山谷
words.tip: 可直接接stairs；表示是……的後裔用be descended from。

tr: n. 潮, 潮汐, 趨勢, 潮流, 漲潮, 高潮
def: n. the periodic rise and fall of the sea level under the gravitational pull of the moon
n. something that may increase or decrease (like the tides of the sea)
n. there are usually two high and two low tides each day

ex.en: At low tide, we walked across the exposed sand.
ex.zh: 退潮時，我們走過露出的沙地。

ex.en: Coastal planners must consider how rising sea levels and high tides could threaten homes and transport infrastructure.
ex.zh: 沿海規劃者必須考慮海平面上升和高潮位可能如何威脅住宅及交通基礎設施。

col: a tide of change｜變革浪潮
words.tip: tide是海水的週期性漲落，wave是單個波浪。

tr: adv. 迅速地, 輕易地, 樂意地
def: r. without much difficulty
Easily and without difficulty or delay.
Willingly and without hesitation.

ex.en: My sister readily agreed to water the plants.
ex.zh: 姐姐欣然答應幫忙給植物澆水。

ex.en: Reliable health information should be readily available to all citizens, regardless of their income or location.
ex.zh: 所有公民都應能方便地獲取可靠的健康信息，不受收入或居住地點限制。

col: readily accessible｜容易接觸或使用的
words.tip: readily available指容易獲得，不是“樂意提供”。

tr: vi. 合作, 協力, 配合
def: v work together on a common enterprise of project
to work together to achieve a shared aim
to help by doing what someone asks

ex.en: We cooperated with our neighbours to clean the shared garden.
ex.zh: 我們和鄰居一起清理了共用花園。

ex.en: Countries must cooperate on climate policy because pollution crosses borders and affects communities far from its source.
ex.zh: 各國必須在氣候政策上合作，因為汙染會跨越國界，影響遠離汙染源的社區。

col: cooperate on a project｜在項目上合作
words.tip: 不及物：與人合作用with，就某事合作用on。

tr: n. 裝備, 工具箱, 成套工具
[計] 成套部件; 成套零件
def: n. a case for containing a set of articles
n. gear consisting of a set of articles or tools for a specified purpose
n. young of any of various fur-bearing animals

ex.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我們在車裡備有一個急救包。

ex.en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
ex.zh: 學校應提供基礎科學實驗套件，讓所有學生都能參與動手實驗。

col: kit someone out｜給某人配齊裝備
words.tip: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示給某人配裝備。

tr: n. 硬件, 五金器具, 零件
def: n. major items of military weaponry (as tanks or missile)
n. instrumentalities (tools or implements) made of metal
n. (computer science) the mechanical, magnetic, electronic, and electrical components making up a computer system

ex.en: The technician replaced some old hardware inside my computer.
ex.zh: 技術員更換了我電腦裡的一些舊硬件。

ex.en: Schools need reliable hardware and regular technical support to make digital learning accessible to all students.
ex.zh: 學校需要可靠的硬件和定期的技術支持，讓所有學生都能參與數字化學習。

words.tip: 不可數名詞；hardware指硬件，software指軟件。

def: n the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required
n an acute insufficiency
a situation in which there is not enough of something

ex.en: A water shortage forced us to take shorter showers.
ex.zh: 缺水迫使我們縮短淋浴時間。

ex.en: A shortage of affordable housing can force essential workers to live far from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 可負擔住房短缺可能迫使關鍵崗位的工作人員住在遠離工作地點的地方。

words.tip: 常用a shortage of；“缺少”也可說be short of。

tr: n. 後面, 背後, 後方
a. 後面的, 背面的, 後方的
vt. 養育, 培養, 飼養, 舉起, 樹立, 栽種
def: n. the back of a military formation or procession
n. the side of an object that is opposite its front
n. the side that goes last or is not normally seen

ex.en: We loaded the bags into the rear of the van.
ex.zh: 我們把包放進了貨車後部。

ex.en: Farmers who rear animals outdoors must provide adequate shelter and maintain high standards of animal welfare.
ex.zh: 在戶外飼養動物的農民必須提供足夠的遮蔽場所，並維持較高的動物福利標準。

words.tip: at the rear of 表位置；rear animals 指飼養。

def: n. preparing or putting through a prescribed procedure
preparing or changing materials through a series of operations
using a computer to organise, change, or analyse information

ex.en: These apples are ready for processing into juice.
ex.zh: 這些蘋果已準備好加工成果汁。

ex.en: Modern food processing can extend shelf life, although some methods reduce the nutritional value of fresh ingredients.
ex.zh: 現代食品加工可以延長保質期，不過某些方法會降低新鮮食材的營養價值。

words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞；processing plant指加工廠。

tr: a. 用言辭的, 言語的, 口頭的, 逐字的, 動詞的
def: s. communicated in the form of words
a. of or relating to or formed from words in general
a. of or relating to or formed from a verb

ex.en: We made a verbal agreement to share the garden.
ex.zh: 我們口頭約定共用這個花園。

ex.en: Employers should confirm verbal agreements in writing to prevent misunderstandings about working hours and responsibilities.
ex.zh: 僱主應以書面形式確認口頭協議，以防對工作時間和職責產生誤解。

words.tip: verbal也指用詞語表達，不總與written對立。

tr: a. 海岸的, 沿海的, 沿岸的
def: a. of or relating to a coast
a. located on or near or bordering on a coast

tr: n. 感情, 感傷, 情操, 情緒, 感想, 意見
def: n. tender, romantic, or nostalgic feeling or emotion

tr: a. 神的, 神聖的, 非凡的
def: v. perceive intuitively or through some inexplicable perceptive powers
v. search by divining, as if with a rod
s. emanating from God

ex.en: The painting shows divine light surrounding a heavenly figure.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪了一位天界人物周圍環繞的神聖光芒。

ex.en: Many ancient societies believed that rulers received divine authority, which helped strengthen their political power.
ex.zh: 許多古代社會認為統治者的權威來自神，這有助於鞏固他們的政治權力。

words.tip: 表示“極好的”時多用於非正式讚美。

def: n. a heavy open wagon usually having two wheels and drawn by an animal
v. transport something in a cart

tr: vt. 向下看, 瞭望, 監督, 偷看到
[法] 監察, 監督, 俯瞰
def: v. watch and direct

tr: n. 靈感, 鼓舞人心的人或物, 妙計, 吸氣
def: n. arousal of the mind to special unusual activity or creativity
n. a product of your creative thinking and work
n. a sudden intuition as part of solving a problem

tr: n. 天才, 天賦, 精神, 神魔
def: n. someone who has exceptional intellectual ability and originality
n. exceptional creative ability
someone with exceptional intelligence or creative ability

ex.en: My sister is a genius at fixing broken toys.
ex.zh: 我姐姐修壞玩具特別有一手。

ex.en: Creative genius often develops when schools allow students to experiment rather than simply memorise facts.
ex.zh: 學校允許學生探索嘗試，而非僅僅記憶知識時，創造天賦往往更容易得到發展。

col: a genius at｜在……方面極有才幹的人
a stroke of genius｜絕妙的主意
words.tip: 指天才人物時可數；指非凡才能時通常不可數。

tr: n. 探索, 尋求, 調查
v. 尋找, 找, 追尋獵物
def: n. the act of searching for something
v. make a search (for)
v. search the trail of (game)

ex.en: Our quest for fresh bread led us across town.
ex.zh: 為了找到新鮮麵包，我們一路穿過了小鎮。

ex.en: The quest for cleaner energy has encouraged governments to invest heavily in new storage technologies.
ex.zh: 對更清潔能源的追求促使各國政府大力投資新型儲能技術。

col: a quest for knowledge｜對知識的追求
embark on a quest｜開始探索
words.tip: 常用名詞結構a quest for；動詞用法較文學化。

tr: a. 天資高的, 有才能的
def: a. endowed with talent or talents
Having a natural ability to do something very well.

ex.en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
ex.zh: 我那位有繪畫天賦的表親畫了這幅漂亮的花園圖。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
ex.zh: 學校應為有才華的學生提供機會，讓他們在標準課程之外發展自己的能力。

col: a talented musician｜有天賦的音樂家
a talented artist｜有才華的藝術家
words.tip: talented強調天賦；skilled強調熟練技能。

tr: n. 被提名者, 被任命者
def: n a politician who is running for public office

tr: a. 堅硬的, 嚴厲的, 呆板的, 生硬的, 剛強的, 強烈的, 粘的, 稠的, 艱難的
n. 死屍, 醉鬼, 鈔票
def: n. an ordinary man
s. not moving or operating freely
s. powerful

tr: n. 摑, 掌擊, 侮辱, 拍擊聲
adv. 正面地, 直接地, 突然地
def: n. a blow from a flat object (as an open hand)
v. hit with something flat, like a paddle or the open hand
Hit someone or something with an open hand.

ex.en: She slapped her knee and laughed at the joke.
ex.zh: 她聽了這個笑話，拍著膝蓋笑了起來。

ex.en: The coach slapped the player's back in celebration, highlighting the supportive atmosphere within the team.
ex.zh: 教練拍了拍球員的背以示慶祝，體現了隊內相互支持的氛圍。

col: slap someone on the back｜拍某人的背
a slap on the wrist｜輕微的懲罰
slap something down｜啪地放下某物
words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞為slapped，須雙寫p。

tr: a. 有毒的, 中毒的
def: a. of or relating to or caused by a toxin or poison

tr: n. 傷心, 憂愁, 悲痛, 不幸, 災難
def: n. intense sorrow caused by loss of a loved one (especially by death)
n. something that causes great unhappiness
Deep sadness, especially after someone you love has died

ex.en: She found comfort in friends during her grief.
ex.zh: 在悲痛中，她從朋友那裡得到了慰藉。

ex.en: Schools should offer counselling to help young people manage grief after the loss of a family member.
ex.zh: 學校應提供心理輔導，幫助年輕人在失去家人後應對悲痛。

words.tip: 表示悲痛時通常不可數，常與失去親人有關。

def: v. give to a charity or good cause
To give money, goods, or blood to help others

ex.en: We donate our spare blankets to the local shelter.
ex.zh: 我們把多餘的毯子捐給當地的收容所。

ex.en: Businesses can reduce food waste by donating surplus products to charities that support vulnerable families.
ex.zh: 企業可以把剩餘食品捐給幫助困難家庭的慈善機構，以減少食物浪費。

col: donate money to charity｜向慈善機構捐款
words.tip: 用donate something to someone，不用雙賓語。

tr: n. 工具, 復滑車, 滑車, 裝備, 扭倒
vt. 固定, 處理, 抓住
def: n. the person who plays that position on a football team
n. (American football) a position on the line of scrimmage
n. (American football) grasping an opposing player with the intention of stopping by throwing to the ground

ex.en: Let's tackle the messy kitchen before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 趁客人還沒到，我們先收拾這亂糟糟的廚房吧。

ex.en: Governments need to tackle housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving access to public transport.
ex.zh: 政府需要通過支持可負擔住房建設和改善公共交通的可及性來應對住房短缺。

words.tip: tackle直接接問題，不加with；強調著手應對。

tr: a. 父母親的, 做雙親的, 作為淵源的
def: a. designating the generation of organisms from which hybrid offspring are produced
a. relating to or characteristic of or befitting a parent

tr: vt. 使冒泡, 滔滔不絕地說
def: n. a hollow globule of gas (e.g., air or carbon dioxide)
n. an impracticable and illusory idea
n. a dome-shaped covering made of transparent glass or plastic

ex.en: A huge soap bubble floated gently above the garden.
ex.zh: 一個巨大的肥皂泡輕輕飄在花園上方。

ex.en: A housing bubble can leave families with heavy debts when property prices suddenly fall.
ex.zh: 當房價突然下跌時，房地產泡沫可能使家庭背上沉重債務。

words.tip: bubble既指氣泡，也可比喻資產價格泡沫。

tr: [化] 靶(恩)(核反應截面單位)
def: n. an outlying farm building for storing grain or animal feed and housing farm animals
n. (physics) a unit of nuclear cross section; the effective circular area that one particle presents to another as a target for an encounter
a large farm building for storing crops or keeping animals

ex.en: We stacked the hay inside the barn before sunset.
ex.zh: 我們在日落前把乾草堆進了穀倉。

ex.en: Converting unused barns into visitor accommodation can provide additional income for farmers in rural communities.
ex.zh: 將閒置穀倉改為遊客住宿設施，可以為農村地區的農民帶來額外收入。

col: store hay in a barn｜把乾草存入穀倉
words.tip: 指農場裡的大型建築，可儲存農作物或飼養牲畜。

tr: vt. 使特殊化, 列舉, 特別指明, 限定...的範圍
vi. 成為專家, 專攻
def: v. become more focus on an area of activity or field of study
v. suit to a special purpose
v. devote oneself to a special area of work

ex.en: The bakery near our house specializes in fresh sourdough bread.
ex.zh: 我們家附近的麵包店專做新鮮的酸麵包。

ex.en: Students who specialize too early may miss opportunities to develop knowledge across a broader range of subjects.
ex.zh: 過早確定專業方向的學生可能錯過拓寬學科知識的機會。

col: specialize in repairing cars｜專門修理汽車
highly specialized skills｜高度專業化的技能
words.tip: 常用specialize in；英式也常拼作specialise。

tr: n. 縫褶, 活力, 鼓聲, 船尾突出部, 食品
vt. 打褶, 捲起, 擠進, 塞, 收藏
def: n. eatables (especially sweets)
n. (sports) a bodily position adopted in some sports (such as diving or skiing) in which the knees are bent and the thighs are drawn close to the chest
n. a narrow flattened pleat or fold that is stitched in place

tr: a. 模糊的, 微弱的, 無力的
vi. 昏倒, 變得微弱
def: n. a spontaneous loss of consciousness caused by insufficient blood to the brain
v. pass out from weakness, physical or emotional distress due to a loss of blood supply to the brain
s. deficient in magnitude; barely perceptible; lacking clarity or brightness or loudness etc

ex.en: A faint light shone through the bedroom curtains.
ex.zh: 一絲微弱的光透過臥室窗簾照了進來。

ex.en: Astronomers use powerful telescopes to detect faint objects that cannot be seen with the naked eye.
ex.zh: 天文學家使用高性能望遠鏡探測肉眼看不見的闇弱天體。

words.tip: feel faint是快要暈倒；faint作動詞才表示昏倒。

tr: n. 責任, 債務, 傾向
[經] 責任, 義務, 負債
def: n. the state of being legally obliged and responsible
n. the quality of being something that holds you back
Legal responsibility for something, especially damage or loss.

ex.en: Our insurance covers liability for damage to neighbouring homes.
ex.zh: 我們的保險承保對鄰居住宅造成損壞所需承擔的責任。

ex.en: Clear rules on legal liability encourage companies to take greater responsibility for the safety of their products.
ex.zh: 明確的法律責任規定能促使企業更加重視其產品的安全性。

words.tip: 責任常不可數；債務常用複數liabilities。

tr: n. 小路, 巷, 弄, 單行道
def: n. a narrow way or road
n. a well-defined track or path; for e.g. swimmers or lines of traffic
a strip of road for one line of vehicles

ex.en: Our bus moved into the lane beside the pavement.
ex.zh: 我們乘坐的公交車駛入了靠近人行道的車道。

ex.en: Dedicated cycle lanes can improve road safety and encourage more residents to travel by bicycle.
ex.zh: 專用自行車道可以改善道路安全，並鼓勵更多居民騎自行車出行。

words.tip: lane指一條車道；整條道路通常用road。

tr: n. 架, 行李架, 飼草架, 擱物架, 痛苦, 折磨, 齒條, 行雲團
vt. 把...放在架上, 在架上製作, 折磨, 使痛苦, 壓榨, 榨取, 猛烈撕拉, 拷問
vi. 變形, 傾斜, (雲)隨風飄, (馬)小步跑
def: n. framework for holding objects
n. rib section of a forequarter of veal or pork or especially lamb or mutton
n. an instrument of torture that stretches or disjoints or mutilates victims
n. the attire worn in a play or at a fancy dress ball
n. unusual or period attire not characteristic of or appropriate to the time and place
n. the prevalent fashion of dress (including accessories and hair style as well as garments)

ex.en: Lena wore a butterfly costume in the school play.
ex.zh: 莉娜在學校話劇裡穿了一套蝴蝶戲服。

ex.en: Traditional costume can express cultural identity and help younger generations understand the history of their communities.
ex.zh: 傳統服飾能夠表達文化認同，並幫助年輕一代理解自己社區的歷史。

words.tip: 指特定角色或文化的服裝，不泛指日常衣服。

tr: n. 法令, 成文法律, 法規, 章程, 條例
[法] 法令, 法規, 成文法
def: n an act passed by a legislative body
s enacted by a legislative body
v. to draw back the lips and reveal the teeth, in a smile, grimace, or snarl
To smile widely, usually showing your teeth.
A broad smile that usually shows the teeth.

ex.en: She grinned when her puppy brought back the ball.
ex.zh: 小狗把球叼回來時，她咧嘴笑了。

ex.en: A friendly grin from a teacher may help nervous students feel more comfortable participating in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 老師一個友善的笑容，可能讓緊張的學生更自在地參與課堂討論。

col: grin at someone｜朝某人咧嘴笑
words.tip: grin比smile更強調咧嘴露齒；過去式為grinned。

tr: [經] 生產率, 生產能力
def: n. (economics) the ratio of the quantity and quality of units produced to the labor per unit of time

tr: n. 錯誤, 蟲, 病菌, 缺陷, 竊聽器, 癖好, 防盜報警器, 雙座小汽車, 要人
vt. 裝防盜報警器, 裝竊聽器, 激怒
def: n. general term for any insect or similar creeping or crawling invertebrate
n. a fault or defect in a computer program, system, or machine
n. a small hidden microphone; for listening secretly

ex.en: A tiny green bug landed on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一隻綠色小蟲落在了我的袖子上。

ex.en: A software bug can disrupt essential services, highlighting the importance of thorough testing before release.
ex.zh: 軟件錯誤可能導致基本服務中斷，這凸顯了發佈前進行全面測試的重要性。

col: fix a bug｜修復程序錯誤
words.tip: 口語中bug可泛指小蟲；技術語境常指程序錯誤。

tr: a. 敵人的, 懷敵意的, 敵對的
def: n. troops belonging to the enemy's military forces
a. characterized by enmity or ill will
a. not belonging to your own country's forces or those of an ally

ex.en: His hostile reply made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 他充滿敵意的回答讓桌邊的每個人都感到不自在。

ex.en: Communities may become hostile to new developments if residents feel excluded from the planning process.
ex.zh: 如果居民覺得自己被排除在規劃過程之外，社區可能會強烈反對新的開發項目。

words.tip: hostile to後接名詞或動名詞，表示敵視或反對。

def: v. become pregnant; undergo conception
to form an idea or imagine something
to become pregnant or cause a baby to begin developing

ex.en: She conceived the idea while walking through the park.
ex.zh: 她在公園散步時想出了這個主意。

ex.en: Urban planners must conceive new ways of accommodating population growth without sacrificing green spaces or affordable housing.
ex.zh: 城市規劃者必須構思新方法，在不犧牲綠地或保障性住房的前提下應對人口增長。

col: conceive an idea｜構思一個主意
words.tip: conceive an idea指構思；conceive of指設想。

tr: a. 疫苗的, 牛痘的
def: n. immunogen consisting of a suspension of weakened or dead pathogenic cells injected in order to stimulate the production of antibodies
a substance that trains the immune system to resist disease

ex.en: The nurse explained how the vaccine helps protect against illness.
ex.zh: 護士解釋了這種疫苗如何幫助預防疾病。

ex.en: Ensuring fair access to vaccines is essential for protecting vulnerable populations and reducing the spread of infectious diseases.
ex.zh: 確保公平獲得疫苗，對保護易受感染人群和減少傳染病傳播至關重要。

words.tip: 接種某病疫苗常用a vaccine against某疾病。

tr: [法] 通敵賣國者, 奸細
def: n. act of working jointly
n. act of cooperating traitorously with an enemy that is occupying your country
Working together with others to achieve a shared goal

ex.en: Our garden makeover was a collaboration between several neighbours.
ex.zh: 我們花園的改造是幾位鄰居合作完成的。

ex.en: Closer collaboration between universities and local businesses can help students develop practical skills before entering the workforce.
ex.zh: 大學與當地企業更緊密的合作可以幫助學生在就業前培養實用技能。

words.tip: 普通語境指合作；通敵義須結合戰爭背景。

tr: n. 巡邏, 巡邏員, 偵察隊
def: n. a detachment used for security or reconnaissance
n. the activity of going around or through an area at regular intervals for security purposes
n. a group that goes through a region at regular intervals for the purpose of security

ex.en: Two guards patrol the park after dark each evening.
ex.zh: 每天傍晚天黑後，兩名警衛都會在公園巡邏。

ex.en: Rangers patrol protected forests to prevent illegal logging and monitor threats to endangered wildlife.
ex.zh: 護林員在受保護的森林中巡邏，以防止非法伐木並監測瀕危野生動物面臨的威脅。

col: border patrol｜邊境巡邏；邊境巡邏隊
words.tip: 過去式patrolled，進行式patrolling，均雙寫l。

tr: n. 揭露, 洩露, 發覺, 默示, 啟示
驚人的發現；被揭露的事
def: n. an enlightening or astonishing disclosure
n. communication of knowledge to man by a divine or supernatural agency
n. the last book of the New Testament; contains visionary descriptions of heaven and of conflicts between good and evil and of the end of the world; attributed to Saint John the Apostle

ex.en: His revelation about the hidden garden surprised us all.
ex.zh: 他透露的那個隱秘花園讓我們都很驚訝。

ex.en: Recent revelations about industrial pollution have increased public pressure for stricter environmental regulations and greater corporate transparency.
ex.zh: 近期披露的工業汙染問題加大了公眾壓力，要求加強環境監管並提高企業透明度。

col: come as a revelation｜令人恍然大悟
words.tip: 具體的新發現可數；指披露這一行為時常不可數。

tr: n. 用力拖拉, 拖運, 強拉, 捕獲量, 拖運距離
vi. 拖, 拉, 改變方向, 改變主意
def: v. draw slowly or heavily
v. transport in a vehicle
v. admit (to a wrongdoing)
v. be willing to concede
v. give over; surrender or relinquish to the physical control of another

ex.en: He finally conceded that my route was much quicker.
ex.zh: 他終於承認我選的路線快得多。

ex.en: Although critics concede that tourism creates jobs, they argue that its environmental costs are often overlooked.
ex.zh: 儘管批評者承認旅遊業創造就業，他們仍認為其環境代價常被忽視。

col: concede a point｜承認對方某點有理
words.tip: 常含原本反對、後來不得不承認的意味。

tr: a. 公開展示的, 驚人的, 壯觀的
n. 奇觀, 驚人之舉, 展覽物
def: n. a lavishly produced performance
s. characteristic of spectacles or drama
extremely impressive to see or experience

ex.en: We watched a spectacular sunset from the hilltop.
ex.zh: 我們在山頂看了一場壯觀的日落。

ex.en: The region's spectacular mountain scenery attracts tourists, creating jobs but also increasing pressure on fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 該地區壯觀的山景吸引著遊客，創造了就業機會，但也加重了脆弱生態系統的壓力。

words.tip: 既可形容壯觀景象，也可修飾growth等抽象名詞。

tr: a. 絕對的, 全然的, 純粹的, 透明的, 峻峭的
vt. 使急轉向, 使偏航
adv. 完全, 全然, 峻峭
def: v. cause to sheer
r. straight up or down without a break
r. directly

tr: a. 免疫的, 免除的, 不受影響的
def: n. a person who is immune to a particular infection
a. relating to the condition of immunity
s. secure against

ex.en: The vet explained that vaccination would make our puppy immune.
ex.zh: 獸醫解釋說，接種疫苗會讓我們的小狗獲得免疫力。

ex.en: Although technology creates new opportunities, no industry is completely immune to the effects of economic change.
ex.zh: 儘管技術創造了新機遇，但沒有哪個行業能完全不受經濟變化的影響。

col: immune to infection｜對感染有免疫力的
immune from prosecution｜免於被起訴的
words.tip: immune to指不受影響；immune from常指獲豁免。

tr: a. 迷人的, 吸引人的, 使人神魂顛倒的
def: v cause to be interested or curious
v to render motionless, as with a fixed stare or by arousing terror or awe
v attract; cause to be enamored

ex.en: The guide told us fascinating stories about the castle.
ex.zh: 導遊給我們講了關於這座城堡的精彩故事。

ex.en: Museum collections offer fascinating insights into how earlier societies adapted to changes in their natural environments.
ex.zh: 博物館藏品讓人們深入瞭解早期社會如何適應自然環境的變化，令人著迷。

words.tip: 事物令人著迷用fascinating；人著迷用fascinated。

tr: a. 異國的, 外來的
n. 外來人, 外來物, 舶來品
def: s. strikingly strange or unusual
Unusual and interesting, especially because of a connection with distant countries.
Originating outside the region where something is now found.

ex.en: The market sells exotic fruits I have never tasted.
ex.zh: 市場裡賣著我從未嘗過的異國水果。

ex.en: Introducing exotic plants into local gardens can threaten native species if their spread is not controlled.
ex.zh: 將外來植物引入當地花園後，若不控制其蔓延，可能會威脅本土物種。

col: exotic destination｜富有異國情調的目的地
words.tip: 生態語境中指非本土的，不一定具有入侵性。

def: n. uncastrated adult male of domestic cattle
n. a large and strong and heavyset man
n. a serious and ludicrous blunder

ex.en: A large bull stood quietly beside the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一頭大公牛靜靜地站在農場門旁。

ex.en: During a bull market, rising share prices may encourage households to invest more of their savings.
ex.zh: 在牛市期間，股價上漲可能促使家庭將更多儲蓄用於投資。

col: take the bull by the horns｜勇敢面對難題
words.tip: 金融中bull指看漲者，與bear（看跌者）相對。

tr: n. 修剪, 夾子, 回形針, 剪下來的東西
vt. 修剪, 痛打, 夾牢, 剪報
def: n. any of various small fasteners used to hold loose articles together
n. an article of jewelry that can be clipped onto a hat or dress
n. the act of clipping or snipping

ex.en: She used a clip to hold her hair back.
ex.zh: 她用夾子把頭髮固定在後面。

ex.en: Teachers can use a short video clip to introduce complex scientific concepts before a classroom discussion.
ex.zh: 教師可以在課堂討論前，用一段短視頻引入複雜的科學概念。

col: clip something onto｜把某物夾在……上
words.tip: 夾在某物上用clip onto；短視頻片段也叫clip。

def: n. the part of the leg between the hip and the knee
The upper part of the leg, above the knee.

ex.en: My thighs ached after cycling up the steep hill.
ex.zh: 騎車爬上陡坡後，我的大腿痠痛。

ex.en: Regular cycling strengthens the thigh muscles and can improve overall fitness without excessive joint strain.
ex.zh: 經常騎自行車能增強大腿肌肉、改善整體體能，又不會給關節帶來過大負擔。

words.tip: 指髖部到膝蓋之間；小腿通常用lower leg。

tr: a. 親密的, 私人的, 秘密的
vt. 暗示, 通知, 告訴
def: v. give to understand
s. marked by close acquaintance, association, or familiarity
s. involved in a sexual relationship

tr: a. 世俗的, 現世的, 長期的
def: a. of or relating to the doctrine that rejects religion and religious considerations
a. of or relating to clergy not bound by monastic vows

tr: a. 嫩的, 柔軟的, 脆弱的, 溫柔的, 親切的, 未成熟的, 微妙的, 棘手的, 審慎的
vt. 使變嫩, 提供, 償還
n. 照料, 看管人, 供應船, 小船, 提出, 償付, 投標
def: n. something that can be used as an official medium of payment
n. car attached to a locomotive to carry fuel and water
n. a boat for communication between ship and shore

ex.en: The carrots were tender enough to mash with a fork.
ex.zh: 胡蘿蔔很軟嫩，用叉子就能壓成泥。

ex.en: Slow cooking makes tougher cuts of meat tender, allowing households to use less expensive ingredients.
ex.zh: 慢燉能使較韌的肉塊變嫩，讓家庭可以選用價格較低的食材。

col: tender to the touch｜一碰就疼
words.tip: 形容食物指嫩；形容身體部位可指一碰就疼。

tr: n. 同謀, 陰謀, 陰謀集團
[法] 陰謀, 通謀, 共謀
def: n. a secret agreement between two or more people to perform an unlawful act
n. a plot to carry out some harmful or illegal act (especially a political plot)
n. a group of conspirators banded together to achieve some harmful or illegal purpose

ex.en: Police uncovered a conspiracy to steal valuable paintings.
ex.zh: 警方發現了一起盜竊珍貴畫作的陰謀。

ex.en: False conspiracy theories can spread rapidly online, weakening public trust in scientific institutions.
ex.zh: 虛假的陰謀論會在網上迅速傳播，削弱公眾對科研機構的信任。

col: conspiracy to commit fraud｜實施詐騙的共謀
words.tip: conspiracy to do sth指密謀做某事。

tr: n. 意外事故, 傷亡, 受害者
def: n. someone injured or killed or captured or missing in a military engagement
n. someone injured or killed in an accident
n. a decrease of military personnel or equipment

ex.en: The ambulance took the casualty to a nearby hospital.
ex.zh: 救護車把傷者送往附近的醫院。

ex.en: Improved building standards can reduce the number of casualties when earthquakes strike densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 當地震襲擊人口稠密的城市地區時，提高建築標準可以減少傷亡人數。

col: a casualty of the recession｜經濟衰退的受害者
words.tip: 包括受傷者和死者，不等於僅指死亡的fatality。

tr: n. 實行, 完成, 執行, 死刑
def: n. putting a condemned person to death
n. (computer science) the process of carrying out an instruction by a computer
n. (law) the completion of a legal instrument (such as a contract or deed) by signing it (and perhaps sealing and delivering it) so that it becomes legally binding and enforceable

ex.en: The picnic plan was simple, but its execution proved tricky.
ex.zh: 野餐計劃很簡單，但實施起來卻不容易。

ex.en: Successful execution of environmental policies requires adequate funding, clear responsibilities, and consistent monitoring by public authorities.
ex.zh: 環境政策的成功實施需要充足的資金、明確的責任以及公共部門持續的監督。

col: execution of a plan｜計劃的執行
stay of execution｜暫緩執行死刑
words.tip: 既可指執行計劃，也可指執行死刑，須看語境。

tr: a. 非常好的, 極端的, 可怕的
def: s. very great or intense
s. causing extreme terror
Extremely good or enjoyable.

ex.en: You did a terrific job fixing that old bicycle.
ex.zh: 你把那輛舊自行車修得真棒。

ex.en: Community gardens offer a terrific opportunity for residents to exercise outdoors while developing stronger social connections.
ex.zh: 社區花園為居民提供了極好的機會，讓他們在戶外鍛鍊的同時建立更緊密的社會聯繫。

words.tip: 常用於口語讚揚；別與terrible“糟糕的”混淆。

def: n. inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli
s. (followed by `with')deeply filled or permeated
A natural tendency to behave without learning or conscious thought.

ex.en: By instinct, the newborn kitten searched for its mother.
ex.zh: 剛出生的小貓本能地尋找媽媽。

ex.en: Although instinct can guide rapid decisions, public health policies should primarily rely on reliable scientific evidence.
ex.zh: 儘管直覺可以引導快速決策，公共衛生政策仍應主要依據可靠的科學證據。

col: trust your instincts｜相信自己的直覺
an instinct for｜對……的天生能力
words.tip: instinct常指先天本能；intuition偏指直覺判斷。

tr: n. 裁決, 判決, 判斷性意見, 定論, 結論
[法] 定論, 判斷, 意見
def: n. (law) the findings of a jury on issues of fact submitted to it for decision; can be used in formulating a judgment
An official court decision about whether someone is guilty.
An opinion or judgment reached after considering something.

ex.en: What is your verdict on my homemade soup?
ex.zh: 你覺得我自己做的湯怎麼樣？

ex.en: A jury should reach its verdict solely on the evidence presented during the trial.
ex.zh: 陪審團應僅依據庭審中呈現的證據作出裁決。

col: a verdict on something｜對某事的評價
words.tip: verdict指裁決；sentence作法律名詞指判處的刑罰。

tr: vt. 操縱, 利用, 操作, 巧妙地處理, 假造
def: v. influence or control shrewdly or deviously
v. hold something in one's hands and move it
v. control (others or oneself) or influence skillfully, usually to one's advantage

ex.en: She tried to manipulate her brother into doing the dishes.
ex.zh: 她試圖用手段讓弟弟去洗碗。

ex.en: Online platforms can manipulate consumer choices by selectively displaying products and controlling access to information.
ex.zh: 網絡平臺可以通過選擇性展示商品和控制信息獲取來操縱消費者的選擇。

col: manipulate someone into doing something｜操縱某人做某事
words.tip: 操縱人做某事用manipulate sb into doing。

def: n an abnormal new mass of tissue that serves no purpose
an abnormal mass of cells growing in the body

ex.en: The doctor explained that the tumour was not cancerous.
ex.zh: 醫生解釋說，這個腫瘤並非惡性的。

ex.en: Early detection of a tumour can improve treatment options, although outcomes depend on its type and location.
ex.zh: 儘早發現腫瘤可增加治療選擇，但療效取決於腫瘤的類型和位置。

words.tip: 英式拼寫tumour，美式tumor；腫瘤不一定是癌。

tr: n. 環, 圈, 彎曲部分, 循環
vt. 使成環, 以圈結, 以環連結
def: n. anything with a round or oval shape (formed by a curve that is closed and does not intersect itself)
n. an inner circle of advisors (especially under President Reagan)
n. the basic pattern of the human fingerprint

ex.en: She made a loop in the rope for hanging plants.
ex.zh: 她把繩子打成一個圈，用來懸掛盆栽。

ex.en: A bus route forming a loop can connect residential areas with schools and local health centres.
ex.zh: 環形公交線路可以將住宅區與學校和當地醫療中心連接起來。

col: a loop of rope｜一個繩圈
words.tip: on a loop指不斷重複，如音樂循環播放。

tr: n. 從業者, 開業者
def: n. someone who practices a learned profession
someone who works in a profession, especially medicine
someone who regularly uses a particular skill or method

ex.en: The nurse suggested speaking to a qualified medical practitioner.
ex.zh: 護士建議諮詢有資質的執業醫師。

ex.en: Experienced practitioners should help design training programmes so that graduates develop skills relevant to their profession.
ex.zh: 經驗豐富的從業者應參與設計培訓課程，讓畢業生掌握與職業相關的技能。

col: experienced practitioner｜經驗豐富的從業者
words.tip: general practitioner指全科醫生，常縮寫為GP。

tr: [經] 補助金, 津貼, 補貼
def: n. a grant paid by a government to an enterprise that benefits the public
Money provided to support activities or keep prices lower.

ex.en: A government subsidy helped us install solar panels at home.
ex.zh: 政府補貼幫助我們在家裡安裝了太陽能板。

ex.en: Targeted subsidies for public transport can make commuting more affordable while encouraging people to use their cars less.
ex.zh: 針對公共交通的定向補貼能降低通勤費用，同時鼓勵人們減少開車。

words.tip: 可數名詞，複數為subsidies；常與for搭配。

tr: vt. 編輯, 編校, 修訂, 剪輯
[計] 編輯; DOS外部命令:該命令是一個用於編輯文本文件的全屏幕編輯程序
def: v. prepare for publication or presentation by correcting, revising, or adapting
v. supervise the publication of
v. cut and assemble the components of

ex.en: I need to edit this video before dinner.
ex.zh: 我需要在晚飯前剪輯好這段視頻。

ex.en: Students should learn to edit their essays carefully, checking both the structure and the accuracy of their arguments.
ex.zh: 學生應學會仔細修改論文，檢查論證的結構與準確性。

words.tip: edit強調修改或剪輯，publish才是出版或發佈。

tr: n. 鞭子, 抽打, 車伕, 攪拌器
vt. 鞭打, 攪拌, 煽動, 召集, 倉促製成
vi. 拍擊, 急走, 抽打
def: n. an instrument with a handle and a flexible lash that is used for whipping
