n. a legislator appointed by the party to enforce discipline
n. a dessert made of sugar and stiffly beaten egg whites or cream and usually flavored with fruit

ex.en: An old leather whip hung beside the stable door.
ex.zh: 馬廄門旁掛著一根舊皮鞭。

ex.en: During practical lessons, culinary students learn to whip cream and prepare healthier alternatives to commercial desserts.
ex.zh: 在實操課上，烹飪專業學生學習打發奶油，並製作比市售甜點更健康的替代品。

col: whip up a meal｜迅速做頓飯
words.tip: whip cream是打發奶油；雙寫p加-ed或-ing。

tr: [經] 優先的, 基礎的, 放在下面的
def: s. located beneath or below
causing or influencing something without being immediately obvious
lying beneath the surface of something

ex.en: The mechanic found the underlying cause of the noise.
ex.zh: 機械師找到了異響的根本原因。

ex.en: Addressing the underlying causes of poverty requires sustained investment in education, healthcare, and secure employment.
ex.zh: 解決貧困的根本原因需要持續投資於教育、醫療和穩定就業。

words.tip: 通常放在名詞前，強調錶面現象背後的原因或基礎。

tr: n. 隔絕, 孤立, 隔離
def: n. a state of separation between persons or groups
n. a feeling of being disliked and alone
n. the act of isolating something; setting something apart from others

ex.en: Weekly visits from neighbours helped reduce her sense of isolation.
ex.zh: 鄰居每週的探望幫助減輕了她的孤獨感。

ex.en: Investment in community centres may reduce social isolation among older residents who live alone.
ex.zh: 投資建設社區中心可能減少獨居老年居民的社會孤立感。

words.tip: in isolation可指獨自，也可指脫離背景單獨考慮。

tr: n. 企業家, 主辦人
def: n. someone who organizes a business venture and assumes the risk for it
someone who starts a business and takes financial risks

ex.en: The young entrepreneur opened a bakery near our station.
ex.zh: 那位年輕創業者在我們車站附近開了一家麵包店。

ex.en: Local governments can support entrepreneurs by simplifying regulations and improving access to affordable loans.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以通過簡化規定、便利獲取低息貸款來支持創業者。

col: a successful entrepreneur｜成功的企業家
words.tip: 強調創辦企業並承擔風險，不泛指經理。

tr: n. 微風, 煤屑, 輕而易舉的事
def: n. a slight wind (usually refreshing)
v. blow gently and lightly
v. to proceed quickly and easily

ex.en: A cool breeze lifted the curtains beside my bed.
ex.zh: 一陣涼風吹起了我床邊的窗簾。

ex.en: Coastal parks offer residents pleasant places to exercise while enjoying the fresh sea breeze.
ex.zh: 沿海公園為居民提供了宜人的鍛鍊場所，讓他們同時享受清新的海風。

col: breeze through an exam｜輕鬆通過考試
words.tip: be a breeze是口語，表示“輕而易舉”。

tr: a. 昂貴的, 奢華的, 費用大的
def: s. having a high price
requiring a large amount of money
causing serious loss, harm or disadvantage

ex.en: Replacing the broken roof proved more costly than expected.
ex.zh: 更換破損的屋頂比預想的花費更高。

ex.en: Delaying investment in flood protection could prove costly for communities exposed to increasingly severe storms.
ex.zh: 對於面臨日益猛烈風暴的社區，推遲防洪投資可能會造成重大損失。

col: a costly mistake｜代價高昂的錯誤
words.tip: 雖以-ly結尾，卻是形容詞；也可指損失慘重。

tr: a. 有野心的, 抱負不凡的, 雄心勃勃的
def: a. having a strong desire for success or achievement
s. requiring full use of your abilities or resources
strongly wanting to achieve success

ex.en: My ambitious sister hopes to run her own bakery.
ex.zh: 我那有抱負的姐姐希望經營自己的麵包店。

ex.en: The city has announced an ambitious plan to replace all diesel buses with electric vehicles within a decade.
ex.zh: 該市宣佈了一項宏大的計劃，要在十年內將所有柴油公交車更換為電動車。

col: ambitious young people｜有抱負的年輕人
words.tip: 形容人指有抱負；形容計劃則強調目標宏大、難度高。

def: r. by reasonable assumption
Probably true, based on what is known or reasonably expected.

ex.en: Her coat is gone, so presumably she has left.
ex.zh: 她的外套不見了，想必她已經離開了。

ex.en: More frequent bus services would presumably encourage commuters to leave their cars at home, reducing urban traffic.
ex.zh: 更頻繁的公交班次想必會鼓勵通勤者不開車出門，從而緩解城市交通擁堵。

words.tip: 表示有依據的推測，不等於certainly的確定語氣。

tr: n. 大都市居民, 都主教, 宗主國的公民
a. 大都市的, 都主教區的, 宗主國的
def: n. in the Eastern Orthodox Church this title is given to a position between bishop and patriarch; equivalent to archbishop in western Christianity
n. a person who lives in a metropolis
a. relating to or characteristic of a metropolis

ex.en: Our metropolitan rail network connects the suburbs to downtown.
ex.zh: 我們的都市鐵路網連接郊區與市中心。

ex.en: Efficient public transport across metropolitan areas can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 覆蓋都市圈的高效公共交通能緩解交通擁堵，並讓人們更便捷地獲得就業機會。

words.tip: 不專指首都；metropolitan area通常包括市區和周邊郊區。

def: n. (film) a gradual transition from one scene to the next; the next scene is gradually superimposed as the former scene fades out
v. become weaker
v. cause to go into a solution

tr: a. 美學的, 審美的, 有美感的
def: n. (philosophy) a philosophical theory as to what is beautiful
a. relating to or dealing with the subject of aesthetics
a. concerning or characterized by an appreciation of beauty or good taste

ex.en: The wooden shelves give this room greater aesthetic appeal.
ex.zh: 這些木架讓這個房間更有美感。

ex.en: Urban planners should consider both the practical function and aesthetic quality of public spaces.
ex.zh: 城市規劃者應同時考慮公共空間的實用功能和審美品質。

words.tip: aesthetic指審美的；aesthetics常指美學。

tr: n. 壓碎, 粉碎, 群眾, 迷戀
vt. 壓破, 征服, 塞, 弄皺, 榨出
vi. 被壓碎, 起皺, 擠
def: n. a dense crowd of people
n. the act of crushing
v. break into small pieces
n. a steep high face of rock
A high, very steep rock face, often beside the sea.

ex.en: We watched seabirds nesting halfway up the cliff.
ex.zh: 我們看著海鳥在懸崖半腰築巢。

ex.en: Coastal erosion can weaken a cliff over time, putting nearby homes and walking routes at risk.
ex.zh: 海岸侵蝕會逐漸削弱懸崖的穩定性，危及附近的住宅和步行路線。

words.tip: cliff強調陡峭巖壁，不泛指山坡。

tr: a. 最小的, 極微的, 最小限度的
def: a. the least possible
very small in amount or as little as possible

ex.en: These plants need minimal care, even during hot weather.
ex.zh: 這些植物即使在炎熱天氣裡也只需極少的照料。

ex.en: Well-designed buildings can maintain comfortable indoor temperatures with minimal energy use, reducing both costs and emissions.
ex.zh: 設計良好的建築能以極低的能耗保持舒適的室內溫度，同時降低成本和排放。

words.tip: minimal 指極少或最低限度，不一定表示完全沒有。

tr: n. 可卡因, 古柯鹼
def: n. a narcotic (alkaloid) extracted from coca leaves; used as a surface anesthetic or taken for pleasure; can become powerfully addictive
A powerful, addictive stimulant drug derived from coca leaves.

ex.en: The nurse explained why cocaine can seriously harm the heart.
ex.zh: 護士解釋了可卡因為何會嚴重損害心臟。

ex.en: Public health programmes should combine education about cocaine with accessible treatment for people experiencing addiction.
ex.zh: 公共衛生項目應將可卡因危害教育與便捷可及的成癮治療相結合。

words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞，指一種強效成癮性毒品。

tr: n. 幻影, 錯覺, 幻想
def: n. an erroneous mental representation
n. something many people believe that is false

tr: a. 姓氏不詳的, 無名的, 無特色的
def: a. having no known name or identity or known source
s. not known or lacking marked individuality
Having a name that is unknown or kept secret.

ex.en: An anonymous donor paid for the children's new playground.
ex.zh: 一位匿名捐贈者出資為孩子們建了新遊樂場。

ex.en: Anonymous surveys can encourage employees to express honest opinions about conditions in their workplace.
ex.zh: 匿名調查能鼓勵員工坦誠表達對工作環境的看法。

words.tip: 匿名是anonymous；保密是confidential，含義不同。

tr: n. 同等物, 等價物, 相等物
a. 相等的, 相當的, 同意義的
def: n. a person or thing equal to another in value or measure or force or effect or significance etc
n. the atomic weight of an element that has the same combining capacity as a given weight of another element; the standard is 8 for oxygen
s. being essentially equal to something

ex.en: This small heater produces heat equivalent to that larger one.
ex.zh: 這臺小取暖器產生的熱量與那臺較大的相當。

ex.en: Employers should recognise overseas qualifications when they are equivalent to those awarded by domestic institutions.
ex.zh: 當海外學歷與本國院校頒發的學歷相當時，僱主應予以認可。

col: the equivalent of｜相當於……的事物
words.tip: 常用equivalent to；相當不代表完全相同。

tr: a. 富有經驗的, 老練的, 熟練的
def: a. having experience; having knowledge or skill from observation or participation
n. an impelling force or strength
n. the product of a body's mass and its velocity

tr: n. 捐贈物, 捐款, 捐贈
[經] 贈品, 捐款, 捐贈
def: n a voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause
n act of giving in common with others for a common purpose especially to a charity
Money or goods given to help a person or organisation.

ex.en: We made a small donation to the animal shelter.
ex.zh: 我們向動物收容所捐了一小筆錢。

ex.en: Regular donations from local businesses enable the charity to provide free meals for vulnerable residents.
ex.zh: 當地企業的定期捐贈使這家慈善機構能夠為弱勢居民提供免費餐食。

words.tip: 常用make a donation to，表示向某方捐贈。

tr: n. 反語, 諷刺, 具有諷刺意味的事
def: n. incongruity between what might be expected and what actually occurs
n. a trope that involves incongruity between what is expected and what occurs
A situation that is strikingly opposite to what is expected.

ex.en: The irony is that our swimming lesson was cancelled by rain.
ex.zh: 諷刺的是，我們的游泳課竟因下雨而取消了。

ex.en: There is considerable irony in promoting environmental awareness through disposable products that create additional waste.
ex.zh: 通過製造更多垃圾的一次性產品來宣傳環保意識，頗具諷刺意味。

col: the irony of the situation｜局面的諷刺之處
a sense of irony｜反諷意識
words.tip: irony不只是巧合，常指結果與預期形成諷刺性反差。

tr: vi. 互相影響, 交互作用
n. 幕間劇, 幕間休息
def: v. act together or towards others or with others
To communicate or do things with other people.
To affect one another when combined or brought together.

ex.en: Our neighbours often interact while their children play outside.
ex.zh: 孩子們在外面玩耍時，我們的鄰居常常互相交流。

ex.en: Group projects encourage students to interact with classmates whose experiences and perspectives differ from their own.
ex.zh: 小組項目鼓勵學生與經歷和觀點不同於自己的同學互動。

col: interact with each other｜相互交流
words.tip: 不及物動詞：與某人互動用interact with someone。

tr: a. 可愛的, 聰明的, 伶俐的
def: s. obviously contrived to charm
Attractive in a sweet or charming way.

ex.en: That cute kitten is sleeping inside my slipper.
ex.zh: 那隻可愛的小貓正睡在我的拖鞋裡。

ex.en: Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.
ex.zh: 廣告常用可愛的動物吸引注意，讓人們對產品產生好感。

words.tip: 偏口語，常形容嬰兒、小動物或討喜的外表。

def: n. the contestant you hope to defeat
v. be the rival of, be in competition with
Someone competing with another for the same goal or advantage.

ex.en: She shook hands with her rival before the race.
ex.zh: 比賽前，她與競爭對手握了手。

ex.en: Smaller companies can rival larger firms by offering personalised services and responding quickly to customer needs.
ex.zh: 小公司可以通過提供個性化服務並迅速回應客戶需求，與大企業相匹敵。

col: a major rival｜主要競爭對手
rival someone in quality｜在質量上與某人匹敵
words.tip: rival作動詞直接接賓語，無需加with。

tr: vi. 堅持, 固執, 持續, 堅稱
def: v. stay behind

tr: n. 車棚, 小屋, 脫落之物, 分水嶺
vt. 使流出, 放射, 脫落, 散發, 擺脫
vi. 流出, 散佈, 脫落
def: n. an outbuilding with a single story; used for shelter or storage
v. get rid of
v. cast off hair, skin, horn, or feathers

tr: a. 收養的, 養育的
vt. 養育, 撫育, 培養, 鼓勵, 抱(希望)
def: n. United States songwriter whose songs embody the sentiment of the South before the American Civil War (1826-1864)
v. promote the growth of
v. bring up under fosterage; of children

ex.en: Shared meals foster closer friendships among our neighbours.
ex.zh: 一起吃飯讓我們鄰里之間的友誼更加深厚。

ex.en: Schools can foster creativity by allowing students to explore problems without prescribing a single solution.
ex.zh: 學校可以讓學生探索問題而不限定唯一解法，以培養創造力。

words.tip: foster常指暫時代養；adopt指依法收養。

tr: n. 濾波器, 過濾器, 濾光器, 過濾嘴, 去塵器
vt. 過濾, 滲透, 走漏
def: n. device that removes something from whatever passes through it
n. an electrical device that alters the frequency spectrum of signals passing through it
v. remove by passing through a filter

ex.en: The water filter needs replacing before we leave.
ex.zh: 我們出發前需要更換淨水濾芯。

ex.en: Modern treatment plants filter wastewater to remove harmful substances before releasing it into local rivers.
ex.zh: 現代汙水處理廠會過濾汙水，去除有害物質後再將其排入當地河流。

col: filter search results｜篩選搜索結果
words.tip: filter out後接被濾除的東西，不是保留下來的。

tr: vt. 使復原, 使和解, 治癒
def: v. get healthy again

tr: n. 生物, 有機體, 社會組織
def: n. a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently
n. a system considered analogous in structure or function to a living body

tr: n. 特許狀, 執照, 憲章
vt. 特許, 發給特許執照
def: n. a document incorporating an institution and specifying its rights; includes the articles of incorporation and the certificate of incorporation
n. a contract to hire or lease transportation
v. grant a charter to
n. permission to do something
v be composed of
v include or contain; have as a component
v form or compose

ex.en: The gift set comprises soap, lotion, and a towel.
ex.zh: 這套禮盒包含香皂、乳液和一條毛巾。

ex.en: The proposed transport network will comprise bus routes and cycle lanes connecting residential areas with employment centres.
ex.zh: 擬建的交通網絡將由連接住宅區與就業中心的公交線路和自行車道組成。

col: comprise several sections｜包含幾個部分
comprise a range of services｜涵蓋一系列服務
words.tip: 最穩妥結構：整體comprises部分，不加of。

tr: n. 放置, 佈置, 工作安排, 編班, 定位球
def: n. the spatial property of the way in which something is placed
n. contact established between applicants and prospective employees
n. the act of putting something in a certain place

ex.en: I learned practical skills during my hospital placement.
ex.zh: 我在醫院實習期間學到了實用技能。

ex.en: Universities should offer work placements so that students can apply classroom knowledge in professional settings.
ex.zh: 大學應提供實習機會，讓學生能夠在職場環境中運用課堂知識。

words.tip: 英式英語中work placement常指課程中的實習。

tr: n. 用具, 配備, 機構
def: n. any cohesive unit such as a military company
n. a set of clothing (with accessories)
A set of clothes worn together for a particular occasion.

ex.en: She chose a bright outfit for her birthday party.
ex.zh: 她為自己的生日聚會挑了一套鮮豔的衣服。

ex.en: Schools should outfit science laboratories with modern equipment so that students can develop practical research skills.
ex.zh: 學校應為科學實驗室配備現代設備，讓學生能夠培養實際研究技能。

col: matching outfit｜搭配協調的全套服裝
outfit something with equipment｜為某物配備設備
words.tip: 一套衣服可說an outfit；動詞常接with。

tr: n. 初步做法, 初步措施, 預試, 預選賽
a. 初步的, 開始的, 預備的
def: n. a minor match preceding the main event
n. something that serves as a preceding event or introduces what follows
s. denoting an action or event preceding or in preparation for something more important; designed to orient or acquaint with a situation before proceeding

tr: a. 總共的, 未打折扣的, 惡劣的, 粗野的
def: n. twelve dozen
n. the entire amount of income before any deductions are made
v. earn before taxes, expenses, etc.

ex.en: My gross pay looks much better than my take-home pay.
ex.zh: 我的稅前工資看起來比實發工資高多了。

ex.en: Gross domestic product measures economic output, but it does not fully reflect citizens' quality of life.
ex.zh: 國內生產總值衡量經濟產出，卻不能全面反映公民的生活質量。

col: gross domestic product｜國內生產總值
words.tip: 財務中gross為扣除前總額，net為淨額。

tr: n. (織物的)密度, (材料等的)結構, 紋理
def: n. the feel of a surface or a fabric
n. the essential quality of something
n. the musical pattern created by parts being played or sung together

ex.en: This blanket has a soft texture that feels lovely.
ex.zh: 這條毯子質地柔軟，摸起來很舒服。

ex.en: The texture of recycled materials can influence whether consumers find sustainable products attractive.
ex.zh: 再生材料的質地會影響消費者是否覺得可持續產品有吸引力。

words.tip: 既可描述材料的觸感，也可描述食物的口感。

tr: [法] 揭發, 揭露, 公開
def: v. disclose to view as by removing a cover
to make previously private or unknown information available

ex.en: The hotel would not disclose any details about its guests.
ex.zh: 這家酒店不願透露住客的任何信息。

ex.en: Companies should disclose how they collect personal data so that consumers can make informed decisions.
ex.zh: 企業應公開其收集個人數據的方式，讓消費者能夠作出知情決定。

col: disclose something to someone｜向某人透露某事
words.tip: 用disclose sth to sb；也可接that從句。

tr: n. 出席, 出席的人數, 照料
[法] 管理, 照料, 資助
def: n. the act of being present (at a meeting or event etc.)
n. the frequency with which a person is present
n. the number of people that are present

ex.en: Our teacher checks attendance at the start of every lesson.
ex.zh: 我們的老師每節課開始時都會點名。

ex.en: Regular school attendance is associated with stronger academic performance and better opportunities for social development.
ex.zh: 按時到校與更好的學業表現及更多社交發展機會相關。

words.tip: attend後直接接活動；attendance後常接at。

tr: vt. 刺激, 激勵, 鼓舞
def: v. act as a stimulant
v. stir the feelings, emotions, or peace of
v. cause to be alert and energetic

ex.en: These colourful puzzles stimulate my daughter's curiosity every morning.
ex.zh: 這些色彩鮮豔的拼圖每天早上都能激發我女兒的好奇心。

ex.en: Lower borrowing costs can stimulate economic growth by encouraging businesses to invest in new equipment.
ex.zh: 降低借貸成本可以鼓勵企業投資新設備，從而促進經濟增長。

col: stimulate the brain｜刺激大腦活動
words.tip: 直接接賓語：stimulate interest表示激發興趣。

tr: n. 標籤, 附屬物, 碎片, 結束語, 口頭禪, 附加語, 渾名, 標記, 標記符
vt. 附以籤條, 尾隨, 添飾, 起渾名, 連接
def: n. a label written or printed on paper, cardboard, or plastic that is attached to something to indicate its owner, nature, price, etc.
n. a label associated with something for the purpose of identification
n. a game in which one child chases the others; the one who is caught becomes the next chaser

ex.en: I checked the tag before washing my new jumper.
ex.zh: 洗新毛衣前，我查看了標籤。

ex.en: Researchers tag marine animals to track their movements and identify habitats that require stronger environmental protection.
ex.zh: 研究人員給海洋動物加上追蹤標記，以追蹤其活動並確定需要加強環境保護的棲息地。

col: tag someone in a photo｜在照片中標記某人
words.tip: 動詞過去式tagged；tag along意為跟著去。

tr: n. 目錄, 大學概況手冊
def: n. a book or pamphlet containing an enumeration of things
n. a complete list of things; usually arranged systematically
An organised list of items, often with descriptions or pictures.

ex.en: I found a sturdy desk in the furniture catalog.
ex.zh: 我在傢俱目錄裡找到了一張結實的書桌。

ex.en: A searchable digital catalog allows researchers to locate historical documents without travelling to distant archives.
ex.zh: 可檢索的數字目錄讓研究人員無需前往遙遠的檔案館就能查找歷史文獻。

words.tip: catalog是常見美式拼寫；英式通常寫catalogue。

tr: n. 艦隊, 港灣, 小河
a. 快速的, 敏捷的, 淺的, 短暫的
vi. 疾馳, 飛逝, 掠過
vt. 消磨, 變換船(或船員)的位置
def: n. group of aircraft operating together under the same ownership
n. group of motor vehicles operating together under the same ownership
n. a group of steamships operating together under the same ownership

ex.en: A fleet of fishing boats returned before sunset.
ex.zh: 一支捕魚船隊在日落前返航了。

ex.en: Replacing the city's ageing bus fleet with electric vehicles could significantly reduce air pollution in residential areas.
ex.zh: 用電動車輛替換該市老舊的公交車隊，可以顯著減少居民區的空氣汙染。

col: a fleet of vehicles｜一支車隊
words.tip: 集合名詞；a fleet of可接船、車輛或飛機。

def: v. force somebody to do something
v. necessitate or exact
to force someone to do something

ex.en: Heavy rain compelled us to cancel our picnic.
ex.zh: 大雨迫使我們取消了野餐。

ex.en: Stricter environmental laws could compel manufacturers to reduce waste and adopt cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 更嚴格的環境法規可能迫使製造商減少廢棄物並採用更清潔的生產方式。

col: compel someone to act｜迫使某人行動
be compelled by circumstances｜為形勢所迫
words.tip: 常用compel sb to do，語氣強且較正式。

tr: vt. 宣佈, 公告, 宣言, 表明, 讚揚
[法] 宣佈, 宣告, 公佈
def: v. declare formally; declare someone to be something; of titles
v. state or announce

tr: n. 徒步旅行, 遠足, 漲價, 提高
vi. 步行, 徒步旅行, 上升
def: n. a long walk usually for exercise or pleasure
v. increase
v. walk a long way, as for pleasure or physical exercise

ex.en: Our weekend hike ended beside a clear mountain lake.
ex.zh: 我們週末的徒步旅行在一片清澈的山間湖泊旁結束。

ex.en: A sharp hike in public transport fares could discourage commuters from choosing buses over private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通票價大幅上漲可能會降低通勤者選擇公交車而非私家車的意願。

words.tip: hike通常指較長的戶外步行，也可指價格猛漲。

tr: n. 氣味, 香味, 香水, 蹤跡, 痕跡, 線索, 嗅覺
vt. 聞出, 嗅, 發覺, 使充滿氣味
vi. 嗅獵, 發出氣味
def: n. an odor left in passing by which a person or animal can be traced
v. catch the scent of; get wind of
A noticeable smell, especially a pleasant one.

ex.en: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味瀰漫了整個廚房。

ex.en: The scent of flowers can attract pollinators, helping many plant species reproduce and maintain healthy ecosystems.
ex.zh: 花香可以吸引傳粉動物，幫助許多植物繁殖，並維持健康的生態系統。

col: follow a scent｜循著氣味追蹤
words.tip: scent常指香味，也指動物追蹤的氣味；c不發音。

tr: n. 堆疊, 堆, 大量, 書庫, 槍架, 煙囪, 堆積, 存貯棧
vt. 堆積, 堆滿, 暗中對...做手腳
def: n. an orderly pile
v. load or cover with stacks
v. arrange in stacks

ex.en: A stack of clean plates stood beside the sink.
ex.zh: 水槽旁放著一摞乾淨的盤子。

ex.en: Libraries increasingly store stacks of older journals off site to create more space for collaborative learning.
ex.zh: 圖書館越來越多地將成摞的舊期刊存放在館外，為協作學習騰出更多空間。

words.tip: stacks of表示“大量”，屬非正式用法。

tr: vt. 把...裝入袋, 洗劫
def: n. a bag made of paper or plastic for holding customer's purchases
n. the quantity contained in a sack
n. any of various light dry strong white wine from Spain and Canary Islands (including sherry)

ex.en: We carried a heavy sack of potatoes into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我們把一大袋沉甸甸的土豆搬進廚房。

ex.en: Employers should not sack workers without explaining the reasons and allowing them to challenge the decision.
ex.zh: 僱主不應在未說明理由、未允許員工提出異議的情況下解僱他們。

col: a sack of potatoes｜一大袋土豆
sack someone for misconduct｜因行為不當解僱某人
words.tip: 表示解僱時常用於英式口語；正式用dismiss。

def: n. (`cease' is a noun only in the phrase `without cease') end
to stop happening or doing something

ex.en: The bells finally ceased ringing just before midnight.
ex.zh: 臨近午夜時，鐘聲終於停了。

ex.en: Factories should cease discharging untreated wastewater into rivers to protect aquatic ecosystems and safeguard public health.
ex.zh: 工廠應停止向河流排放未經處理的廢水，以保護水生生態系統和公眾健康。

words.tip: 較正式；後可接動名詞或to do，均表示停止。

def: v. obtain from someone after their death
v. receive from a predecessor
v. receive by genetic transmission

ex.en: Leila inherited a small cottage from her grandmother.
ex.zh: 萊拉從祖母那裡繼承了一間小屋。

ex.en: Future generations may inherit serious environmental problems unless governments take decisive action to reduce pollution.
ex.zh: 除非各國政府採取果斷措施減少汙染，否則後代可能要接手嚴重的環境問題。

col: inherit a fortune｜繼承鉅額財富
words.tip: 常用inherit sth from sb；遺傳特徵也可用。

tr: a. 汙穢的, 下流的, 險惡的
def: a. offensive or even (of persons) malicious
s. exasperatingly difficult to handle or circumvent
Very unpleasant to experience, taste, smell, or see.

ex.en: A nasty smell came from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 廚房垃圾桶裡散發出一股難聞的氣味。

ex.en: Nasty comments on social media can discourage young people from participating in otherwise valuable online discussions.
ex.zh: 社交媒體上的惡意評論可能使年輕人不願參與原本有價值的網絡討論。

words.tip: 比bad更帶厭惡感；形容人時通常指刻薄、不友善。

tr: a. 理性的, 合理的
def: a. consistent with or based on or using reason
a. capable of being expressed as a quotient of integers
s. having its source in or being guided by the intellect (as distinguished from experience or emotion)

tr: n. 走廊, 側廊, 過道
座位間過道；貨架間通道
def: n. a long narrow passage (as in a cave or woods)
n. passageway between seating areas as in an auditorium or passenger vehicle or between areas of shelves of goods as in stores
n. part of a church divided laterally from the nave proper by rows of pillars or columns

ex.en: Please keep your bag out of the aisle.
ex.zh: 請不要把包放在過道上。

ex.en: Wider supermarket aisles can improve accessibility for wheelchair users and make shopping more comfortable for everyone.
ex.zh: 更寬的超市通道能方便輪椅使用者通行，也能讓所有人購物時更加舒適。

col: walk down the aisle｜沿過道走；結婚
words.tip: s不發音，與isle同音；aisle seat是靠過道座位。

tr: n. 草案, 禮儀, 協議
[計] 協議, 協議列表實用程序
def: n. (computer science) rules determining the format and transmission of data
n. forms of ceremony and etiquette observed by diplomats and heads of state
n. code of correct conduct

tr: adv. 排他地, 僅僅, 專門, 只, 僅, 唯一地, 專有地
def: r without any others being included or involved

tr: n. 地帶, 地區, 地形, 領域, 範圍
def: n. a piece of ground having specific characteristics or military potential

tr: vt. 轉移, 分心, 使發狂
def: v. draw someone's attention away from something
To draw someone's attention away from what they are doing

ex.en: The music distracted me while I was doing homework.
ex.zh: 我做作業時，音樂讓我分心了。

ex.en: Frequent phone notifications can distract employees from complex tasks and reduce their ability to concentrate for long periods.
ex.zh: 頻繁的手機通知會使員工在處理複雜任務時分心，並削弱他們長時間集中注意力的能力。

col: distract someone from｜使某人從……分心
distract attention from｜轉移對……的注意力
words.tip: 常用distract sb from sth或doing sth。

tr: n. 計劃者, 設計者, 安排者
def: n. a person who makes plans
n. a notebook for recording appointments and things to be done, etc.

tr: n. 優點, 功績, 價值, 功過, 真相
def: n. any admirable quality or attribute

tr: n. 大塊, 矮胖的人(或物)
def: n. a substantial amount
A large, thick piece of something.
A substantial part of an amount or whole.

ex.en: She dropped a chunk of cheese into the soup.
ex.zh: 她把一大塊奶酪放進了湯裡。

ex.en: Housing costs consume a large chunk of household income, leaving less money for education and leisure.
ex.zh: 住房開支佔據了家庭收入的很大一部分，使可用於教育和休閒的錢減少了。

col: a chunk of bread｜一大塊麵包
a large chunk of｜很大一部分
manageable chunks｜便於處理的小部分
words.tip: 可指實物的大塊，也可指時間或金錢的一大部分。

tr: n. 移民, 移往, 移動
def: n. the movement of persons from one country or locality to another
n. a group of people migrating together (especially in some given time period)
n. (chemistry) the nonrandom movement of an atom or radical from one place to another within a molecule

ex.en: We watched the birds during their annual autumn migration.
ex.zh: 我們觀察了正在進行一年一度秋季遷徙的鳥兒。

ex.en: Migration from rural areas to cities can increase pressure on housing while providing workers for expanding industries.
ex.zh: 農村人口向城市遷移可能加大住房壓力，同時為不斷擴張的行業提供勞動力。

col: rural-to-urban migration｜農村向城市的人口遷移
words.tip: migration泛指遷移；immigration側重遷入。

tr: vt. 侵入, 擁入, 侵略, 侵襲
[法] 強入, 侵犯, 侵略
def: v. march aggressively into another's territory by military force for the purposes of conquest and occupation
v. occupy in large numbers or live on a host
v. penetrate or assault, in a harmful or injurious way

ex.en: Ants invaded our kitchen after we left cake out.
ex.zh: 我們把蛋糕放在外面後，螞蟻大批湧進了廚房。

ex.en: Some monitoring technologies can invade people's privacy, even when they are introduced to improve public safety.
ex.zh: 某些監控技術即使是為改善公共安全而引入的，也可能侵犯人們的隱私。

col: invade a country｜入侵一個國家
invade someone's privacy｜侵犯某人的隱私
invade personal space｜侵入個人空間
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語；名詞形式是invasion。

tr: n. 刺激, 激勵, 刺激品
def: n any stimulating information or event; acts to arouse action
Something that encourages activity, growth, or change.
Something that causes a physical or mental response.

ex.en: The prize provided a stimulus for her daily practice.
ex.zh: 這個獎項激勵她每天練習。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can provide a powerful stimulus to economic growth while reducing emissions.
ex.zh: 投資可再生能源可以在減少排放的同時，有力地促進經濟增長。

col: a stimulus to growth｜促進增長的因素
respond to a stimulus｜對刺激作出反應
words.tip: 複數是stimuli；stimulus to中的to是介詞。

def: r in like or similar manner
r in addition
r equally

ex.en: I folded my umbrella, and my sister did likewise.
ex.zh: 我收起雨傘，姐姐也照做了。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free internet access; likewise, community centres help residents develop essential digital skills.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館提供免費上網服務；同樣，社區中心也幫助居民培養必要的數字技能。

col: be likewise affected｜同樣受到影響
words.tip: 較正式，常用於連接相似情況；do likewise意為照做。

tr: n. 球, 球面, 球體, 天體, 地球儀, 範圍
vt. 包圍, 使成球體, 放入球內
def: n. a particular environment or walk of life
n. any spherically shaped artifact
n. the geographical area in which one nation is very influential

ex.en: She rolled the clay into a smooth sphere.
ex.zh: 她把黏土揉成了一個光滑的球體。

ex.en: Digital technology has expanded the sphere of education beyond classrooms, allowing students to learn almost anywhere.
ex.zh: 數字技術將教育領域拓展到課堂之外，讓學生幾乎可以在任何地方學習。

words.tip: 球體用sphere，平面上的圓用circle。

tr: vt. 誇口說, 自恃有
def: n. speaking of yourself in superlatives
v. show off
To speak too proudly about your achievements or possessions.

ex.en: He always boasts about how fast he can run.
ex.zh: 他總是吹噓自己跑得有多快。

ex.en: The city boasts an extensive public transport network, making it an attractive destination for sustainable tourism.
ex.zh: 這座城市擁有完善的公共交通網絡，使其成為頗具吸引力的可持續旅遊目的地。

words.tip: 自誇用boast about；表示擁有時直接接賓語。

tr: n. 腳掌, 鞋底, 底部
a. 唯一的, 僅有的, 單獨的, 獨身的
def: n. the underside of footwear or a golf club
n. lean flesh of any of several flatfish
n. the underside of the foot

ex.en: She is the sole owner of this little bakery.
ex.zh: 她是這家小麵包店的唯一所有者。

ex.en: Economic growth should not be the sole measure of a country's progress or public wellbeing.
ex.zh: 經濟增長不應成為衡量國家進步或公眾福祉的唯一標準。

col: the sole of a shoe｜鞋底
words.tip: 表示“唯一的”時通常放名詞前；與 soul 同音。

def: v. make tight or tighter
v. become tight or tighter
To make or become tighter or more firmly fixed.

ex.en: Please tighten the lid before you shake the bottle.
ex.zh: 請先擰緊瓶蓋，再搖瓶子。

ex.en: Governments should tighten safety regulations to ensure that all new housing meets acceptable standards of construction.
ex.zh: 政府應加強安全監管，確保所有新建住房達到合格的建築標準。

words.tip: 可及物也可不及物：tighten a rope；the rope tightens。

tr: n. 名聲, 宣傳, 公開場合
def: n. the quality of being open to public view
Attention given to someone or something by the media.
Activities intended to attract public attention to something.

ex.en: The new bakery received plenty of publicity after opening.
ex.zh: 那家新麵包店開業後獲得了大量媒體關注。

ex.en: Positive publicity can attract visitors to lesser-known destinations, creating employment opportunities for local residents.
ex.zh: 正面宣傳可以吸引遊客前往鮮為人知的目的地，為當地居民創造就業機會。

words.tip: 不可數；不同於advertising，不一定是付費廣告。

tr: n. 有效性, 正確性
def: n. the quality of having legal force or effectiveness

tr: a. 部分的, 偏袒的, 偏愛的
def: s. being or affecting only a part; not total
a. showing favoritism

tr: n. 遵從, 順從, 屈從
def: n acting according to certain accepted standards
n a disposition or tendency to yield to the will of others
n the act of submitting; usually surrendering power to another

ex.en: The inspector checked our kitchen for compliance with hygiene rules.
ex.zh: 檢查員查看了我們的廚房是否符合衛生規定。

ex.en: Regular inspections can improve compliance with environmental regulations and reduce pollution from industrial facilities.
ex.zh: 定期檢查可以促進企業遵守環境法規，減少工業設施造成的汙染。

words.tip: 通常不可數；表示遵守某規定時用compliance with。

tr: adv. 想像上, 看上去像, 被認為是, 恐怕, 按照推測
def: r believed or reputed to be the case
according to what people say, though it may be untrue

ex.en: This shortcut is supposedly quicker, but we keep getting lost.
ex.zh: 據說這條近路更快，可我們一直迷路。

ex.en: Some supposedly environmentally friendly products still require substantial energy to manufacture and transport to consumers.
ex.zh: 一些號稱環保的產品在生產和運送到消費者手中的過程中，仍需消耗大量能源。

words.tip: 常暗示對說法存疑，不表示自己憑空想像。

def: v. keep in mind or convey as a conviction or view
To judge or consider someone or something in a particular way.

ex.en: The inspector deemed our old boiler unsafe to use.
ex.zh: 檢查員認為我們家的舊鍋爐使用起來不安全。

ex.en: Public transport should be deemed an essential service rather than merely a source of profit.
ex.zh: 公共交通應被視為基本服務，而不應僅僅被當作盈利來源。

col: be deemed unsafe｜被認定為不安全
words.tip: 正式用詞，常用deem＋賓語＋形容詞，多見被動式。

tr: vi. 投以一瞥, 閃爍不定
def: n. a brief or incomplete view
n. a vague indication
v. catch a glimpse of or see briefly

ex.en: We caught a glimpse of a fox behind the fence.
ex.zh: 我們瞥見籬笆後面有一隻狐狸。

ex.en: Museum exhibitions offer visitors a glimpse of daily life in societies that existed thousands of years ago.
ex.zh: 博物館展覽讓參觀者得以一窺數千年前社會的日常生活。

col: offer a glimpse into｜讓人略窺
words.tip: glimpse強調短暫看見；glance強調主動匆匆看一眼。

tr: n. 前提, 房屋連地基, 上述各項
vt. 預先提出, 引出, 作為...的前提
def: n. a statement that is assumed to be true and from which a conclusion can be drawn
v. set forth beforehand, often as an explanation
v. take something as preexisting and given

ex.en: Your plan rests on the premise that everyone agrees.
ex.zh: 你的計劃建立在所有人都同意這一前提上。

ex.en: The policy is based on the premise that affordable education improves both individual prospects and national productivity.
ex.zh: 這項政策的前提是，負擔得起的教育能改善個人前景並提高國家生產力。

col: on the premise that｜以……為前提
words.tip: 表示房屋及場地時用複數premises。

def: n. the remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up

tr: n. 農產品, 商品, 有用的物品
[經] 商品, 貨物, 日用品
def: n. articles of commerce
n. a tract of land used for burials

tr: n. 困擾, 煩擾, 煩惱
[法] 折磨, 騷擾, 侵擾
def: n. a feeling of intense annoyance caused by being tormented
n. the act of tormenting by continued persistent attacks and criticism

tr: n. 名望, 名聲, 傳說
def: n. the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed
n. favorable public reputation
The state of being known by many people.

ex.en: Despite her fame, the singer still shops locally.
ex.zh: 儘管很有名，這位歌手仍在附近購物。

ex.en: Although online platforms can bring sudden fame, public attention does not necessarily lead to a sustainable career.
ex.zh: 雖然網絡平臺能讓人一夜成名，但公眾關注並不一定帶來可持續的職業發展。

words.tip: fame通常不可數；形容詞famous常接for。

tr: a. 醒目的, 驚人的, 打擊的, 罷工的
[法] 罷工的, 罷市的, 罷課的
def: n the physical coming together of two or more things
n the act of contacting one thing with another
v deliver a sharp blow, as with the hand, fist, or weapon

ex.en: Her bright scarf makes a striking contrast with her coat.
ex.zh: 她鮮豔的圍巾與外套形成了鮮明對比。

ex.en: The survey revealed striking differences in access to public transport between urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 調查顯示，城鄉社區在公共交通便利程度上存在顯著差異。

words.tip: 表示醒目或顯著，不一定表示令人震驚。

def: n. the probability of a specified outcome
the chance that something will happen

ex.en: Dark clouds increased the likelihood of rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 烏雲增加了今天下午下雨的可能性。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can reduce the likelihood of developing certain health conditions later in life.
ex.zh: 經常進行體育活動可以降低晚年患上某些疾病的可能性。

words.tip: 常用likelihood of doing或likelihood that從句。

tr: n. 通行費, 代價, 鐘聲
vt. 徵收, 敲鐘, 鳴鐘, 勾引, 引誘
def: n. a fee levied for the use of roads or bridges (used for maintenance)
v. ring slowly
v. charge a fee for using

ex.en: We paid a toll before driving across the bridge.
ex.zh: 我們繳了通行費才開車過橋。

ex.en: Long working hours can take a heavy toll on employees' physical health and family relationships.
ex.zh: 長時間工作會嚴重損害員工的身體健康和家庭關係。

col: take a toll on｜對……造成損害
words.tip: take a toll on表示造成損害；death toll指死亡人數。

tr: n. 邊, 輪緣, 框
def: n. the shape of a raised edge of a more or less circular object
n. (basketball) the hoop from which the net is suspended
n. the outer part of a wheel to which the tire is attached

tr: a. 可疑的, 多疑的, 懷疑的
[法] 懷疑的, 令人懷疑的, 可疑的
def: s openly distrustful and unwilling to confide
s not as expected
Making you think something is wrong, dishonest, or illegal.

ex.en: I noticed a suspicious charge on my bank statement.
ex.zh: 我發現銀行賬單上有一筆可疑的扣款。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly suspicious of environmental claims that companies make without providing clear evidence to support them.
ex.zh: 消費者越來越懷疑企業那些缺乏明確證據支持的環保聲明。

col: suspicious of someone｜對某人心存懷疑
words.tip: 事物可疑用suspicious；懷疑某事用suspicious of。

tr: a. 孤立的, 孤零零的
def: s. not close together in time
s. cut off or left behind
s. under forced isolation especially for health reasons

tr: vi. 粘緊, 附著, 緊貼, 堅持
def: n. fruit (especially peach) whose flesh adheres strongly to the pit
v. come or be in close contact with; stick or hold together and resist separation
v. to remain emotionally or intellectually attached

ex.en: The little boy clung to his father's arm.
ex.zh: 小男孩緊緊抱著父親的胳膊。

ex.en: Some organisations cling to outdated practices even when new approaches could improve efficiency and employee satisfaction.
ex.zh: 即使新方法能夠提高效率和員工滿意度，一些機構仍然固守過時的做法。

col: cling to someone｜緊緊抱住某人
cling to power｜不願放棄權力
cling to the hope that｜始終抱著……的希望
words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為clung；常與to搭配。

tr: n. 眨眼, 瞬間, 閃光, 閃爍
def: n. a reflex that closes and opens the eyes rapidly
v. briefly shut the eyes

tr: a. 有資格當選的, 合格的
n. 有資格者, 合格者, 適任者
def: a. qualified for or allowed or worthy of being chosen

tr: n. 鑽進, 跳進, 跳水, 跳水池, 猛跌, 落下, 投入, 開始從事, 盲目投資
vi. 投入, 投身於, 跳進, 陷入, 下降
vt. 使投入, 使插入, 使陷入, 使遭受
def: n. a steep and rapid fall
v. dash violently or with great speed or impetuosity
v. begin with vigor

ex.en: He plunged his muddy boots into a bucket of water.
ex.zh: 他把沾滿泥的靴子猛地浸進一桶水裡。

ex.en: Tourism revenue may plunge when extreme weather forces popular coastal resorts to close during peak season.
ex.zh: 當極端天氣迫使熱門海濱度假區在旺季關閉時，旅遊收入可能驟降。

col: plunge into water｜猛地跳入水中
take the plunge｜下決心冒險嘗試
words.tip: plunge into可指跳入，也可指突然陷入某種狀態。

tr: n. 寒冷, 寒意, 失意
a. 寒冷的, 冷漠的
def: n. coldness due to a cold environment
n. a sensation of cold that often marks the start of an infection and the development of a fever
n. a sudden numbing dread

ex.en: There was a chill in the air this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨空氣中透著一股寒意。

ex.en: Food businesses should chill perishable products promptly to limit bacterial growth and protect public health.
ex.zh: 食品企業應及時冷藏易腐產品，以抑制細菌繁殖並保護公眾健康。

col: a chill in the air｜空氣中的寒意
words.tip: chill指冷卻或冷藏，不一定凍住；chill out是口語“放鬆”。

tr: n. 重振旗鼓, 集合, 群眾集會, 跌停回升
v. 重整旗鼓, 集合, 恢復精神, 團結, 挖苦, 嘲笑
def: n. a large gathering of people intended to arouse enthusiasm
n. the feat of mustering strength for a renewed effort
n. a marked recovery of strength or spirits during an illness

ex.en: Hundreds attended a peaceful rally in the town square.
ex.zh: 數百人參加了鎮廣場上的和平集會。

ex.en: Community leaders rallied support for a public library, arguing that free access to information benefits everyone.
ex.zh: 社區領袖爭取大家支持建設公共圖書館，認為免費獲取信息能讓所有人受益。

col: rally around someone｜團結起來支持某人
words.tip: rally support for表示“為……爭取支持”。

tr: vt. 引導, 駕駛, 航行, 控制
vi. 駕駛, 掌舵, 行駛
n. 駕駛指示, 勸告
def: v. direct the course; determine the direction of travelling
v. direct (oneself) somewhere
To control the direction in which a vehicle moves.

ex.en: She carefully steered the boat away from the rocks.
ex.zh: 她小心地駕駛小船，避開了岩石。

ex.en: Governments can steer investment towards renewable energy by offering financial incentives and establishing clear environmental standards.
ex.zh: 政府可以通過提供經濟激勵和制定明確的環境標準，引導資金投向可再生能源。

words.tip: steer clear of表示避開某人或某事。

tr: n. 出口, 發洩方法, 市場
def: n a place of business for retailing goods
n receptacle providing a place in a wiring system where current can be taken to run electrical devices
n an opening that permits escape or release

ex.en: A new clothing outlet opened near the station yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天車站附近新開了一家服裝店。

ex.en: Community arts programmes provide a valuable outlet for young people to express emotions and develop confidence.
ex.zh: 社區藝術項目為年輕人表達情感、培養自信提供了寶貴的渠道。

col: creative outlet｜發揮創造力的途徑
an outlet for frustration｜宣洩挫敗感的途徑
words.tip: outlet for常指表達渠道；美式英語中也指電源插座。

tr: a. 尚未被人碰過的, 原封不動的, 完整的
def: s. (of a woman) having the hymen unbroken
s. undamaged in any way
Complete and not damaged, altered, or missing any parts

ex.en: The box was crushed, but the cups remained intact.
ex.zh: 盒子被壓壞了，但杯子依然完好無損。

ex.en: Careful restoration allows historic buildings to remain intact while meeting the safety requirements of modern urban life.
ex.zh: 精心修復可以使歷史建築保持完整，同時滿足現代城市生活的安全要求。

words.tip: 常用於remain或leave之後，強調完整且未受損。

tr: vi. 繁榮, 興旺, 茁壯成長
[經] 興旺, 繁榮, 旺盛
def: v. make steady progress; be at the high point in one's career or reach a high point in historical significance or importance
To grow strongly or become successful.

ex.en: These herbs thrive on our sunny kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 這些香草在我們廚房陽光充足的窗臺上長得很旺。

ex.en: Small businesses are more likely to thrive when local governments provide reliable infrastructure and accessible financial support.
ex.zh: 地方政府提供可靠的基礎設施和便利的資金支持時，小企業更有可能蓬勃發展。

col: thrive in warm conditions｜在溫暖環境中茁壯成長
thrive on challenges｜遇到挑戰更有幹勁
a thriving business｜生意興隆的企業
words.tip: 不及物動詞；thrive on表示因某事而更有活力。

tr: a. 精細的, 詳盡的, 精心計劃(或製作)的
vt. 詳細地說明, 用心地製作, 發揮
vi. 變複雜, 作詳細說明
def: v. add details, as to an account or idea; clarify the meaning of and discourse in a learned way, usually in writing
v. produce from basic elements or sources; change into a more developed product
v. work out in detail

ex.en: The cake had elaborate flowers made entirely from icing.
ex.zh: 蛋糕上有完全用糖霜做成的精美花朵。

ex.en: Governments sometimes develop elaborate plans for educational reform without consulting the teachers who will implement them.
ex.zh: 政府有時會制定複雜的教育改革方案，卻不徵詢負責實施這些方案的教師的意見。

col: an elaborate plan｜周密複雜的計劃
elaborate on a point｜詳細闡述某一點
words.tip: 動詞末尾讀/eɪt/；elaborate on表示詳細闡述。

def: n. a variety of bridge in which tricks made in excess of the contract are scored toward game; now generally superseded by contract bridge
n. the public sale of something to the highest bidder
v. sell at an auction

ex.en: My aunt bought this old clock at an auction.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在一次拍賣會上買下了這座舊鐘。

ex.en: Charities often auction donated artwork to raise funds for educational programmes in communities with limited resources.
ex.zh: 慈善機構常拍賣獲捐的藝術品，為資源匱乏社區的教育項目籌款。

words.tip: at auction可不加冠詞；auction off表示拍賣掉。

tr: [醫] 妊娠, 受孕; 概念
def: n. the act of becoming pregnant; fertilization of an ovum by a spermatozoon
an idea or understanding of what something is like
the process in which an egg is fertilised, beginning pregnancy

ex.en: His conception of a perfect holiday involves no phones.
ex.zh: 在他看來，完美的假期是不碰手機的假期。

ex.en: Access to green spaces can broaden children's conception of nature beyond what they learn in classrooms.
ex.zh: 接觸綠地能拓寬兒童對自然的認識，使其不侷限於課堂所學。

col: from conception to completion｜從構思到完成
the moment of conception｜受孕時刻
words.tip: conception of指對事物的理解；也可表示受孕。

tr: [法] 遵守, 承諾, 照做
def: v. act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes

tr: n. 凱旋, 勝利, 歡欣
def: n. the exultation of victory
An important victory or impressive achievement.
Great happiness and pride after achieving success.

ex.en: Winning the local chess tournament was a triumph for Amir.
ex.zh: 贏得當地國際象棋錦標賽對阿米爾來說是一次重大勝利。

ex.en: The successful restoration of the wetland represents a triumph for conservation groups and local residents.
ex.zh: 溼地的成功修復是環保團體和當地居民取得的一項重大成果。

col: a sense of triumph｜勝利的喜悅
words.tip: 作動詞時常用triumph over，表示戰勝。

tr: a. 可比較的, 比得上的
def: a. able to be compared or worthy of comparison
s. conforming in every respect

tr: n. 遠征, 探險隊, 迅速
def: n. a military campaign designed to achieve a specific objective in a foreign country
n. an organized group of people undertaking a journey for a particular purpose
n. a journey organized for a particular purpose

ex.en: We packed warm clothes for our expedition into the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們為進山探險打包了保暖衣物。

ex.en: A scientific expedition to the polar regions collected valuable evidence of changes in sea ice.
ex.zh: 一支前往極地的科學考察隊收集了海冰變化的重要證據。

col: an expedition to Antarctica｜南極考察
words.tip: expedition多指有組織、有特定目的的遠行。

tr: a. 啞的, 不說話的, 無聲音的
def: s. lacking the power of human speech
s. unable to speak because of hereditary deafness
not sensible or intelligent, in informal and often insulting use

ex.en: It was dumb to leave my keys inside again.
ex.zh: 又把鑰匙落在裡面，真是太傻了。

ex.en: Simplified news should improve accessibility without dumbing down complex issues or removing evidence that readers need.
ex.zh: 簡化新聞應提高可讀性，而不應將複雜問題過度簡化或刪去讀者需要的證據。

words.tip: b不發音；指人愚笨有侮辱性，指失語者已過時。

tr: n. 大小, 體積, 大塊, 大多數
vt. 顯得大, 顯得重要
def: n. the property of something that is great in magnitude
n. the property possessed by a large mass
v. stick out or up

ex.en: The bulk of my clothes fit in this suitcase.
ex.zh: 我的大部分衣服都能裝進這個行李箱。

ex.en: The bulk of public transport funding should support reliable services in areas with limited access to employment.
ex.zh: 公共交通資金的大部分應當用於支持就業交通不便地區的可靠運輸服務。

words.tip: the bulk of指大部分；in bulk指大批量。

tr: n. 轉變, 轉換, 改變宗教信仰, 換位法
def: n. an event that results in a transformation
n. a change in the units or form of an expression: "conversion from Fahrenheit to Centigrade"
n. a successful free throw or try for point after a touchdown

tr: n. 贊助人, 顧客, 保護人
[法] 保護人, 庇護人, 贊助人
def: n. a regular customer
n. the proprietor of an inn
n. someone who supports or champions something

ex.en: A local patron paid for the young artist's materials.
ex.zh: 一位當地贊助人出錢為這位年輕藝術家購買了材料。

ex.en: Private patrons can fund experimental art that might otherwise struggle to attract public financial support.
ex.zh: 私人贊助人能夠資助那些可能難以獲得公共資金支持的實驗藝術。

col: patron of the arts｜藝術贊助人
words.tip: patron既指資助者，也可正式地指餐館等的顧客。

tr: a. 市政的, 自治區的, 內政的
def: a. relating or belonging to or characteristic of a municipality
s. of or relating to the government of a municipality
Relating to a town or city and its government.

ex.en: The municipal swimming pool opens early on Saturdays.
ex.zh: 市立游泳池每逢週六很早就開放。

ex.en: Investment in municipal services can improve public health and reduce inequality in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 投資市政服務可以改善快速發展城市的公共衛生狀況，並減少不平等。

words.tip: 強調城鎮政府管理的事務，不等於所有城市事物。

tr: n. 寬容, 忍受, 容忍, 容許量, 公差
def: n. the power or capacity of an organism to tolerate unfavorable environmental conditions
n. the act of tolerating something
n. willingness to recognize and respect the beliefs or practices of others

tr: n. 巡航, 巡弋, 漫遊
v. 巡航, 巡弋, 漫遊
def: n. an ocean trip taken for pleasure
v. drive around aimlessly but ostentatiously and at leisure
v. travel at a moderate speed

ex.en: We took a cruise around the islands last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，我們乘船遊覽了那些島嶼。

ex.en: The growing popularity of cruise holidays has raised concerns about air pollution in coastal cities.
ex.zh: 郵輪度假日益流行，引發了人們對沿海城市空氣汙染的擔憂。

col: go on a cruise｜乘郵輪旅行
words.tip: 作名詞指一次郵輪旅行時可數：a cruise。

def: n. a system of timekeeping that defines the beginning and length and divisions of the year
n. a list or register of events (appointments or social events or court cases etc)
n. a tabular array of the days (usually for one year)

ex.en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
ex.zh: 我在廚房的日曆上標出了週末露營的日子。

ex.en: Schools should publish an annual calendar so families can plan holidays around important educational events.
ex.zh: 學校應公佈年度日程表，方便家庭避開重要教學活動來安排假期。

words.tip: calendar year指一月至十二月，不等於學年。

tr: n. 衝動, 驅使, 刺激, 推動, 衝力, 建議, 脈衝
def: n. the act of applying force suddenly
A sudden strong desire to act without thinking carefully.
A brief electrical signal travelling through a nerve or circuit.

ex.en: I bought this bright yellow umbrella on impulse.
ex.zh: 我一時衝動買了這把亮黃色的傘。

ex.en: Online retailers often encourage consumers to act on impulse by presenting discounts as available for a limited time.
ex.zh: 網絡零售商常將折扣設為限時優惠，以此促使消費者衝動購物。

col: resist the impulse to｜剋制做……的衝動
words.tip: on impulse表示一時衝動；後接動作常用impulse to do。

tr: a. 殘忍的, 野蠻的, 不講理的
def: s. harsh
s. disagreeably direct and precise
Extremely cruel or violent

ex.en: The brutal winter left our garden bare and frozen.
ex.zh: 嚴酷的冬天讓我們的花園光禿禿的，凍成一片。

ex.en: Brutal treatment of prisoners violates human rights and undermines public trust in the justice system.
ex.zh: 殘暴對待囚犯侵犯人權，也損害公眾對司法制度的信任。

words.tip: brutal honesty指直言不諱到令人難以接受。

tr: n. 刺, 戳, 袋子
vt. 戳, 捅, 撥弄, 刺
vi. 戳, 刺, 捅, 搜索, 伸出, 行動散慢
def: n. tall coarse perennial American herb having small white flowers followed by blackish-red berries on long drooping racemes; young fleshy stems are edible; berries and root are poisonous
v. stir by poking
v. make a hole by poking

ex.en: She poked the dough gently to check its softness.
ex.zh: 她輕輕戳了戳麵糰，檢查它是否柔軟。

ex.en: Museum visitors can poke virtual objects on interactive screens to explore scientific concepts through play.
ex.zh: 博物館遊客可以戳點互動屏幕上的虛擬物體，在玩樂中探索科學概念。

col: poke a hole in｜在……上戳洞
words.tip: poke fun at是“取笑”，不是“戳”。

def: v select as an alternative over another

tr: n. 論壇, 公開討論的廣場, 法庭, 討論會
[法] 討論會, 專題討論, 公共論壇
def: n. a public meeting or assembly for open discussion
n. a public facility to meet for open discussion

tr: vi. 往上飛舞, 高聳, 翱翔
def: n. the act of rising upward into the air
v. rise rapidly
v. fly upwards or high in the sky

ex.en: Electricity bills soared during the unusually cold winter.
ex.zh: 在那個異常寒冷的冬天，電費猛漲。

ex.en: Housing prices may soar when population growth exceeds the supply of affordable homes in major cities.
ex.zh: 當人口增長超過大城市經濟適用住房的供應能力時，房價可能飆升。

col: soar to record levels｜飆升至創紀錄水平
words.tip: 表示價格等猛漲時為不及物動詞，不直接接賓語。

tr: n. 移動, 移居, 遷移, 排除, 切除
def: n. the act of removing
n. dismissal from office
The act of taking something away from a place.

ex.en: Stain removal is easier if you act quickly.
ex.zh: 汙漬如果及時處理，就更容易去除。

ex.en: The removal of unnecessary packaging could significantly reduce the amount of household waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 去掉不必要的包裝可以顯著減少送往垃圾填埋場的生活垃圾。

words.tip: 搬家義主要用於英式英語；搬家公司為removal company。

def: n. immunity from arbitrary exercise of authority: political independence
n. personal independence
The freedom or right to make decisions independently.

ex.en: My new manager gives me more autonomy at work.
ex.zh: 我的新經理給了我更多工作自主權。

ex.en: Giving schools greater autonomy may help teachers adapt their lessons to the specific needs of local communities.
ex.zh: 賦予學校更大的自主權，可能有助於教師根據當地社區的具體需求調整課程。

words.tip: 通常不可數；既指地區自治，也指個人或機構自主。

tr: n. 小部分, 破片, 分數
[醫] 部分, 成分, 分散
def: n. a component of a mixture that has been separated by a fractional process
n. a small part or item forming a piece of a whole
n. the quotient of two rational numbers

ex.en: This jacket costs a fraction of the original price.
ex.zh: 這件夾克的售價只是原價的一小部分。

ex.en: Only a small fraction of household waste is recycled in some rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 在一些快速發展的城市，只有少量生活垃圾得到回收利用。

col: a fraction of a second｜極短的一瞬
words.tip: a fraction of常強調佔比極小，不只是一般部分。

tr: n. 門檻, 入口, 開端, 閾
def: n. the starting point for a new state or experience
n. the smallest detectable sensation
the level at which something starts happening or changes

ex.en: My brother has a much higher pain threshold than me.
ex.zh: 我哥哥比我耐疼得多。

ex.en: Raising the income threshold for financial assistance would allow more low-paid workers to receive support.
ex.zh: 提高經濟援助的收入門檻，將使更多低薪勞動者能夠獲得支持。

col: on the threshold of｜即將進入
words.tip: on the threshold of表示即將進入某個新階段。

tr: n. 排氣, 排氣裝置, 廢氣
vt. 抽完, 用盡, 耗盡, 使精疲力盡
def: n. gases ejected from an engine as waste products
n. system consisting of the parts of an engine through which burned gases or steam are discharged
v. wear out completely

ex.en: Carrying those heavy boxes upstairs completely exhausted me.
ex.zh: 把那些沉重的箱子搬上樓讓我筋疲力盡。

ex.en: Intensive farming can exhaust soil nutrients, reducing agricultural productivity and increasing dependence on artificial fertilisers.
ex.zh: 集約化耕作可能耗盡土壤養分，降低農業生產力，並增加對化肥的依賴。

col: exhaust natural resources｜耗盡自然資源
exhaust all possibilities｜嘗試所有可能的辦法
words.tip: exhausted 指人累極了；exhausting 指事物令人疲憊。

tr: n. 異議, 反對, 不喜歡, 缺點, 缺陷, 妨礙, 拒絕之理由
[法] 異議, 反對, 抗議
def: n. the speech act of objecting

n. (law) a procedure whereby a party to a suit says that a particular line of questioning or a particular witness or a piece of evidence or other matter is improper and should not be continued and asks the court to rule on its impropriety or illegality
An expression of opposition, or a reason for opposing something.

ex.en: My only objection is that the tickets cost too much.
ex.zh: 我唯一的反對理由是票價太高。

ex.en: Residents raised an objection to the proposed airport expansion because of its likely impact on noise levels.
ex.zh: 居民對擬議的機場擴建提出異議，因為這可能加劇噪聲。

words.tip: objection to中的to是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

tr: n. 一陣風, 爆炸, 枯萎病
vi. 炸, 猛攻, 猛烈抨擊, 枯萎
def: n. a very long fly ball
n. an explosion (as of dynamite)
v. make a strident sound

tr: vi. 獲勝, 流行, 盛行
def: v. be valid, applicable, or true
v. continue to exist
v. prove superior

ex.en: A relaxed atmosphere prevails in our kitchen on Sundays.
ex.zh: 每逢星期日，我們的廚房裡總洋溢著輕鬆的氣氛。

ex.en: Where traditional attitudes prevail, public education campaigns may be needed to encourage more equal opportunities for women.
ex.zh: 在傳統觀念盛行的地方，可能需要開展公眾教育活動，為女性爭取更平等的機會。

col: prevail upon someone to do｜說服某人做
words.tip: 獲勝用prevail over；說服用prevail upon sb to do。

tr: [法] 否定, 否認, 拒絕接受
def: n. the act of refusing to comply (as with a request)
n. the act of asserting that something alleged is not true
n. (psychiatry) a defense mechanism that denies painful thoughts

tr: n. 碎片, 破片, 片段
[計] 段落; 片段; 分段
def: n. a piece broken off or cut off of something else
n. an incomplete piece
A small piece broken off or separated from something larger.

ex.en: I found a fragment of blue glass beside the gate.
ex.zh: 我在大門旁發現了一塊藍色玻璃碎片。

ex.en: Plastic waste can fragment into tiny particles that enter food chains and threaten marine wildlife.
ex.zh: 塑料垃圾會碎裂成微小顆粒，進入食物鏈並威脅海洋野生動物。

col: a fragment of glass｜一塊玻璃碎片
words.tip: 名詞重音在前；動詞讀/fræɡˈment/，重音在後。

tr: n. 租費, 租金收入
a. 租賃的, 收取租金的
def: n. the act of paying for the use of something (as an apartment or house or car)
a. available to rent or lease
a. of or relating to rent

ex.en: Bike rental includes a helmet and a sturdy lock.
ex.zh: 租自行車還配有頭盔和一把結實的鎖。

ex.en: High rental costs can force young workers to live far from major employment centres.
ex.zh: 高昂的租金可能迫使年輕勞動者住在遠離主要就業中心的地方。

words.tip: 租金常用rent；rental還可指租賃服務或作形容詞。

tr: n. 螺旋, 螺桿, 螺釘, 螺旋槳, 吝嗇鬼
vt. 調節, 扭緊, 旋, 擰, 加強, 壓榨, 勒索
vi. 轉動, 旋, 擰
def: n. a simple machine of the inclined-plane type consisting of a spirally threaded cylindrical rod that engages with a similarly threaded hole
n. a propeller with several angled blades that rotates to push against water or air
n. a fastener with a tapered threaded shank and a slotted head

tr: n. 大學本科生, 大學肄業生
def: n. a university student who has not yet received a first degree
a university student studying for a first degree
relating to study for a first university degree

ex.en: My sister is an undergraduate studying chemistry nearby.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在附近的一所大學讀化學本科。

ex.en: Many undergraduate courses now include practical placements to help students prepare for their future careers.
ex.zh: 如今許多本科課程都包含實習，以幫助學生為未來的職業生涯做好準備。

words.tip: 指正在攻讀首個大學學位的學生，不等於“肄業生”。

def: n. a large and imposing house
A very large, impressive house.

ex.en: An enormous mansion stood behind the tall iron gates.
ex.zh: 高高的鐵門後矗立著一座巨大的宅邸。

ex.en: The historic mansion has been converted into a museum to preserve the region's cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 這座歷史悠久的宅邸已被改建為博物館，以保護當地的文化遺產。

col: a sprawling mansion｜佔地廣闊的豪宅
words.tip: 通常指大型豪宅，不是普通辦公大廈。

tr: vt. 授權, 批准, 委託
[經] 授權, 委任, 認可
def: v. grant authorization or clearance for
To give official permission for someone to do something.

ex.en: Only the manager can authorize a refund this large.
ex.zh: 只有經理才能批准這麼大一筆退款。

ex.en: Local authorities may authorize new housing developments only after assessing their likely effects on traffic and public services.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能只有在評估新住宅開發對交通及公共服務的潛在影響後，才會批准項目。

col: authorize someone to act｜授權某人行事
words.tip: 常用authorize sb to do；英式也寫authorise。

tr: n. 吸引力, 魔力, 符咒
vt. 迷住, 使陶醉, 行魔法
vi. 用符咒, 有魅力
def: n. something believed to bring good luck
n. (physics) one of the six flavors of quark
v. control by magic spells, as by practicing witchcraft

tr: a. 忠誠的, 忠實的, 忠貞的
def: a. steadfast in allegiance or duty
Continuing to support someone or something, even during difficulties.

ex.en: Our loyal dog waits by the door every evening.
ex.zh: 我們忠實的狗每天傍晚都在門邊等候。

ex.en: Companies that treat their employees fairly are more likely to retain a loyal and productive workforce.
ex.zh: 公平對待員工的公司更有可能留住忠誠且高效的員工隊伍。

words.tip: 表示忠於某人或組織，用loyal to，不用loyal with。

def: n. an inflated feeling of pride in your superiority to others
n. (psychoanalysis) the conscious mind
n sound recording consisting of a disk with a continuous groove; used to reproduce music by rotating while a phonograph needle tracks in the groove
n something with a round shape resembling a flat circular plate
n (computer science) a memory device consisting of a flat disk covered with a magnetic coating on which information is stored

tr: n. 雷達, 無線電探測器
def: n. measuring instrument in which the echo of a pulse of microwave radiation is used to detect and locate distant objects
A system using radio waves to locate and track objects.

ex.en: The fishing boat has radar for navigating through fog.
ex.zh: 這艘漁船配有雷達，用於在霧中導航。

ex.en: Modern radar systems allow airports to monitor aircraft movements and maintain safety even in poor visibility.
ex.zh: 現代雷達系統讓機場即使在能見度較差時也能監測飛機動向並保障安全。

words.tip: under the radar比喻未引起注意。

def: n. a facial expression of dislike or displeasure
v. look angry or sullen, wrinkle one's forehead, as if to signal disapproval
n. (physics and chemistry) the simplest structural unit of an element or compound

tr: n. 休息寓所, 撤退, 隱居, 退避
vi. 撤退, 隱退, 向後傾
def: n. (military) withdrawal of troops to a more favorable position to escape the enemy's superior forces or after a defeat
n. a place of privacy; a place affording peace and quiet
n. (military) a signal to begin a withdrawal from a dangerous position

ex.en: We retreated indoors when the rain began falling heavily.
ex.zh: 大雨開始傾盆而下時，我們退回了室內。

ex.en: As glaciers retreat due to rising temperatures, communities downstream face increasing uncertainty about their future water supplies.
ex.zh: 隨著氣溫上升導致冰川退縮，下游社區未來的供水面臨越來越大的不確定性。

words.tip: retreat強調向後撤離；靜養處這一名詞義也常見。

tr: n. 小孩, 年輕人, 少年
[法] 兒童, 少年, 青年
def: n a young person of either sex
A child or young person.

ex.en: A cheerful youngster helped me pick up the apples.
ex.zh: 一個開朗的孩子幫我撿起了那些蘋果。

ex.en: Community sports programmes give youngsters opportunities to develop teamwork skills and build friendships outside school.
ex.zh: 社區體育項目讓青少年有機會培養團隊協作能力，並在校外建立友誼。

col: a group of youngsters｜一群孩子
words.tip: 男女皆可指，語氣較隨意；正式寫作可用young people。

tr: n. 額外補貼, 獎金, 獎賞, 保險費
def: n. payment for insurance
n. the amount that something in scarce supply is valued above its nominal value
n. a prize, bonus, or award given as an inducement to purchase products, enter competitions initiated by business interests, etc.

tr: vt. 注視, 沉思, 盤算
def: v. look at thoughtfully; observe deep in thought
v. consider as a possibility
to think carefully about something for a long time

ex.en: She sat beside the lake, contemplating her next move.
ex.zh: 她坐在湖邊，認真考慮下一步該怎麼辦。

ex.en: Before expanding public transport, planners should contemplate how proposed routes will affect existing communities.
ex.zh: 在擴展公共交通之前，規劃者應仔細考慮擬議線路會如何影響現有社區。

col: contemplate a change｜考慮作出改變
words.tip: 後接名詞或動名詞，不接to do。

tr: vt. 更新, 使現代化
def: n. news that updates your information
v. modernize or bring up to date
v. bring up to date; supply with recent information

ex.en: Please update your address before we send the parcel.
ex.zh: 請在我們寄出包裹前更新你的地址。

ex.en: Governments should regularly update environmental regulations to reflect scientific discoveries and respond to emerging risks.
ex.zh: 政府應定期更新環境法規，以反映科學發現並應對新出現的風險。

col: update someone on something｜告知某人某事的最新情況
words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞重音在前，讀/ˈʌpdeɪt/。

tr: vt. 淹沒, 受打擊, 制服, 壓倒, 使不知所措
[法] 打翻, 傾覆, 覆蓋
使不知所措；使情緒難抑
def: v. overcome, as with emotions or perceptual stimuli
v. charge someone with too many tasks
To affect someone so strongly they cannot cope.

ex.en: I felt overwhelmed by everyone's kindness after the move.
ex.zh: 搬家後，大家的善意讓我感動得不知如何是好。

ex.en: A sudden increase in visitors can overwhelm local infrastructure unless tourism growth is carefully managed.
ex.zh: 如果不謹慎管理旅遊業增長，遊客驟增可能使當地基礎設施不堪重負。

col: be overwhelmed by emotion｜情緒激動得難以自持
overwhelm local services｜使當地服務不堪重負
words.tip: 人感到 overwhelmed；事物令人 overwhelming。

tr: n. 火花, 火星, 閃光, 無線電報務員, 瞬間放電, 活力, 朝氣, 花花公子, 情郎
vi. 閃光, 發火花, 求婚
vt. 發動, 鼓舞, 使有朝氣, 求婚
def: n. a small but noticeable trace of some quality that might become stronger
n. Scottish writer of satirical novels (born in 1918)
n. a small fragment of a burning substance thrown out by burning material or by friction

ex.en: A tiny spark flew out of the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁爐裡飛出了一顆小火星。

ex.en: Investment in public libraries can spark interest in reading and provide valuable learning opportunities for disadvantaged children.
ex.zh: 對公共圖書館的投資可以激發閱讀興趣，併為弱勢兒童提供寶貴的學習機會。

col: a spark of hope｜一絲希望
words.tip: 作動詞可直接接interest、debate等，表示“引發”。

tr: vt. 使疲勞, 使心智衰弱
def: n. temporary loss of strength and energy resulting from hard physical or mental work
n. used of materials (especially metals) in a weakened state caused by long stress
n. (always used with a modifier) boredom resulting from overexposure to something

ex.en: After the long hike, fatigue made my legs shake.
ex.zh: 長途徒步後，我累得雙腿發抖。

ex.en: Persistent fatigue can reduce employees' concentration and increase the likelihood of accidents in the workplace.
ex.zh: 持續疲勞會降低員工的注意力，並增加工作場所發生事故的可能性。

words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞，比tiredness更正式。

tr: vi. 深思, 推測, 投機
def: v. to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds
v. talk over conjecturally, or review in an idle or casual way and with an element of doubt or without sufficient reason to reach a conclusion
v. invest at a risk

ex.en: We can only speculate about what caused the delay.
ex.zh: 我們只能猜測延誤的原因。

ex.en: Researchers speculate that changing work patterns could reduce traffic congestion in major urban centres.
ex.zh: 研究人員推測，工作模式的改變可能緩解大城市中心的交通擁堵。

col: speculate about the cause｜推測原因
words.tip: 推測常接about或that從句；投機領域用in。

tr: v. 傳道, 講道, 說教, 宣講, 鼓吹
def: v. deliver a sermon
v. speak, plead, or argue in favor of
To deliver a religious talk to a group of people.

ex.en: The minister preached about kindness at the morning service.
ex.zh: 牧師在晨間禮拜中以友善為主題講道。

ex.en: Schools should demonstrate respect through everyday practices rather than simply preach the importance of good behaviour.
ex.zh: 學校應通過日常實踐展現尊重，而不應僅僅說教，強調良好行為的重要性。

col: practise what you preach｜身體力行
words.tip: preach to someone常含“對某人說教”的貶義。

tr: n. 白膚碧眼金髮的人
def: n. a person with fair skin and hair
n. a light grayish yellow to near white
a. being or having light colored skin and hair and usually blue or grey eyes

ex.en: His blond hair looked almost white in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 他的金髮在陽光下看起來幾乎是白色的。

ex.en: In discussions of inherited traits, blond hair is often used as an example of human physical variation.
ex.zh: 討論遺傳特徵時，金髮常被用作人類外貌差異的例子。

words.tip: blonde常用於女性；詞義不限定膚色。

tr: vt. 激怒, 惹起, 誘導
[法] 刺激, 煽動, 激怒
def: v. evoke or provoke to appear or occur
v. provide the needed stimulus for
To cause a reaction, feeling, or event.

ex.en: The unexpected ending provoked a lively discussion after dinner.
ex.zh: 那個出人意料的結局引發了晚飯後的一場熱烈討論。

ex.en: Proposals to increase public transport fares often provoke strong criticism from commuters who depend on affordable travel.
ex.zh: 提高公共交通票價的提議常常引發依賴平價出行的通勤者的強烈批評。

col: provoke someone into doing something｜激得某人做某事
words.tip: provoke不只指激怒，也常指引發討論或反應。

def: n. an emotional wound or shock often having long-lasting effects

tr: vi. 離開, 出發, 背離, 違反, 去世
def: v. leave
v. go away or leave
to leave a place, especially to start a journey

ex.en: Our train departs at dawn, so pack your bag tonight.
ex.zh: 我們的火車黎明時出發，所以今晚就收拾好行李吧。

ex.en: Buses that depart regularly from residential areas can reduce commuters' dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 從住宅區定時發車的公交車可以減少通勤者對私家車的依賴。

words.tip: depart from後接出發地，depart for後接目的地。

tr: a. 有磁性的, 有吸引力的, 催眠術的
def: a. of or relating to or caused by magnetism
a. having the properties of a magnet; i.e. of attracting iron or steel
a. capable of being magnetized
n. someone whose occupation involves training in a specific technical process
n. someone known for high skill in some intellectual or artistic technique
a trained worker who operates, maintains, or repairs technical equipment

ex.en: The technician replaced a broken part in our washing machine.
ex.zh: 技師更換了我們洗衣機裡一個損壞的零件。

ex.en: Laboratory technicians play an essential role in medical research by preparing samples and maintaining specialist equipment.
ex.zh: 實驗室技術員通過準備樣本和維護專業設備，在醫學研究中發揮重要作用。

words.tip: technician 側重設備操作維護，不等同於 engineer。

tr: a. 附近的, 鄰近的, 鄰接的
def: v live or be located as a neighbor
v be located near or adjacent to
s having a common boundary or edge; abutting; touching; Massachusetts and Conncecticut"

ex.en: We borrowed a ladder from the neighboring farm.
ex.zh: 我們從鄰近的農場借來了一架梯子。

ex.en: Neighboring countries can reduce environmental damage by coordinating river management and sharing information about industrial pollution.
ex.zh: 鄰國可以通過協調河流管理、共享工業汙染信息來減少環境破壞。

words.tip: 這是美式拼寫；英式為neighbouring，通常放名詞前。

tr: a. 毀滅性的, (非正式)很好的, 引人注目的
def: v cause extensive destruction or ruin utterly
v overwhelm or overpower
s making light of

ex.en: A devastating storm tore the roof off our garage.
ex.zh: 一場破壞力極強的暴風雨掀掉了我們車庫的屋頂。

ex.en: Prolonged drought can have devastating effects on agriculture, threatening food supplies and the livelihoods of rural communities.
ex.zh: 長期乾旱會對農業造成毀滅性影響，威脅糧食供應和農村社區的生計。

col: devastating news｜令人悲痛欲絕的消息
devastating earthquake｜破壞力極強的地震
words.tip: 事物令人悲痛用devastating；人感到悲痛用devastated。

tr: n. 浸, 溼透, 大雨
vt. 使上下溼透, 浸, 吸入, 吸收, 浸洗掉
def: n. the process of becoming softened and saturated as a consequence of being immersed in water (or other liquid)
n. washing something by allowing it to soak
v. submerge in a liquid

tr: vi. 喃喃自語, 作低沉聲
vt. 出怨言, 抱怨地說
def: n. a low continuous indistinct sound; often accompanied by movement of the lips without the production of articulate speech

tr: n. 緞帶, 色帶, 帶狀物
vt. 用絲帶裝飾, 把...撕成條狀
def: n. any long object resembling a thin line
n. a long strip of inked material for making characters on paper with a typewriter
n. notion consisting of a narrow strip of fine material used for trimming

ex.en: She tied a blue ribbon around the gift.
ex.zh: 她在禮物上繫了一條藍色絲帶。

ex.en: During community celebrations, residents decorate public spaces with colourful ribbons to create a welcoming atmosphere.
ex.zh: 社區慶典期間，居民用彩色絲帶裝飾公共空間，營造親切宜人的氛圍。

col: a ribbon of road｜帶狀延伸的道路
words.tip: 通常可數；a ribbon of可形容細長如帶的事物。

tr: n. 水溝, 細長孔, 硬幣投幣口, 縫, 狹槽, 狹通道, 位置, 一檔(廣播節目等)
vt. 開槽於, 把...納入機構
def: n. a position in a grammatical linguistic construction in which a variety of alternative units are interchangeable
n. a small slit (as for inserting a coin or depositing mail)
n. a position in a hierarchy or organization

ex.en: She pushed a coin into the narrow slot.
ex.zh: 她把一枚硬幣塞進了狹窄的投幣口。

ex.en: Offering evening appointment slots could help working adults access essential healthcare services more easily.
ex.zh: 提供晚間預約時段可以讓上班族更方便地獲得基本醫療服務。

col: slot something into place｜把某物插入適當位置
words.tip: slot作動詞常搭配into；不表示“跟蹤”。

tr: a. 連續的, 聯貫的
def: s. in regular succession without gaps
r. in a consecutive manner
following one after another without any interruption

ex.en: It has rained for five consecutive days this week.
ex.zh: 這週已經連續下了五天雨。

ex.en: Several consecutive years of low rainfall have reduced agricultural output and increased pressure on regional water supplies.
ex.zh: 連續數年的降雨偏少導致農業產量下降，並加大了地區供水壓力。

col: for three consecutive years｜連續三年
words.tip: 強調一個接一個、中間無間斷，常修飾天數或次數。

tr: n. 同等的人(或物), 座標
a. 同等的, 並列的
def: n. a number that identifies a position relative to an axis
v. bring into common action, movement, or condition
v. be co-ordinated

tr: n. 暴動, 喧鬧, 放縱
vi. 發動, 暴動, 縱情, 放蕩
def: n. a public act of violence by an unruly mob
v. take part in a riot; disturb the public peace by engaging in a riot
Violent public disorder involving a crowd of people.

ex.en: The shop closed early because a riot broke out nearby.
ex.zh: 附近發生了騷亂，這家店提前關門了。

ex.en: Effective communication between communities and local authorities may help prevent peaceful demonstrations from turning into riots.
ex.zh: 社區與地方政府之間的有效溝通可能有助於防止和平示威演變為暴亂。

col: a riot breaks out｜騷亂爆發
words.tip: riot涉及暴力騷亂，不等於和平的protest。

tr: n. 脊, 山脊, 山脈
def: n. a long narrow natural elevation or striation
n. any long raised strip
n. a long narrow natural elevation on the floor of the ocean

tr: vt. 挫敗, 擊敗, 破壞
a. 無益的, 挫敗的, 挫折的
def: v hinder or prevent (the efforts, plans, or desires) of
v treat cruelly
Make someone annoyed because they cannot achieve what they want.

ex.en: These constant delays frustrate everyone waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 這樣一再延誤，讓所有等公交車的人都很煩躁。

ex.en: Complicated application procedures can frustrate small business owners who need financial support to expand their operations.
ex.zh: 繁瑣的申請程序會讓需要資金支持來擴大經營的小企業主感到沮喪。

words.tip: 人感到沮喪用 frustrated；事情令人沮喪用 frustrating。

tr: n. 經過, 通行, 運輸, 運輸線, 轉變
vt. 運送, 使通過, 經過
def: v. make a passage or journey from one place to another
v. pass across (a sign or house of the zodiac) or pass across (the disk of a celestial body or the meridian of a place)
v. revolve (the telescope of a surveying transit) about its horizontal transverse axis in order to reverse its direction

ex.en: The glasses broke while they were in transit.
ex.zh: 這些玻璃杯在運輸途中破碎了。

ex.en: Investment in public transit can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 投資公共交通可以緩解交通擁堵，並改善發展中城市居民的就業可達性。

words.tip: in transit指運輸途中；public transit多用於美式英語。

tr: n. 研究班, 專題討論會
[經] 討論會, 專家討論會
def: n. any meeting for an exchange of ideas
n. a course offered for a small group of advanced students
A meeting where a group studies or discusses a subject.

ex.en: We discussed our research ideas during the afternoon seminar.
ex.zh: 我們在下午的研討課上討論了各自的研究想法。

ex.en: University seminars encourage students to evaluate different perspectives rather than simply memorise information presented by lecturers.
ex.zh: 大學研討課鼓勵學生評估不同觀點，而不是僅僅記憶講師提供的信息。

col: a seminar on education｜關於教育的研討會
words.tip: seminar強調討論交流；lecture通常以教師講授為主。

def: n. the branch of physics that deals with the emission and effects of electrons and with the use of electronic devices
the study and use of electronic circuits and devices
devices that operate using electronic circuits

ex.en: My sister studies electronics and repairs radios at home.
ex.zh: 姐姐學習電子技術，在家修理收音機。

ex.en: Advances in electronics have enabled hospitals to monitor patients more accurately and provide faster treatment.
ex.zh: 電子技術的進步使醫院能夠更準確地監測患者狀況，並更快地提供治療。

words.tip: 指電子學時雖以s結尾，謂語仍用單數。

tr: a. 密集的, 濃厚的
def: s. permitting little if any light to pass through because of denseness of matter
s. hard to pass through because of dense growth
s. having high relative density or specific gravity

ex.en: Dense fog hid the bridge from our kitchen window.
ex.zh: 濃霧遮住了從我們廚房窗口能看到的那座橋。

ex.en: Dense urban development can reduce travel distances, but it requires careful planning to preserve green spaces.
ex.zh: 高密度城市開發可以縮短出行距離，但需要精心規劃以保留綠地。

words.tip: 形容人愚鈍時有冒犯意味；密集地用densely。

tr: a. 發音清晰的, 口才好的
vt. 明白地說, 以關節連接, 使成為系統的整體
def: v. unite by forming a joint or joints
v. express or state clearly
a. expressing yourself easily or characterized by clear expressive language

ex.en: Our articulate neighbour explained the problem clearly at dinner.
ex.zh: 我們那位善於表達的鄰居在晚餐時把問題解釋得很清楚。

ex.en: Schools should help students articulate their opinions clearly while encouraging them to consider alternative perspectives.
ex.zh: 學校應幫助學生清楚表達自己的觀點，同時鼓勵他們考慮不同的看法。

col: an articulate speaker｜表達清晰的演講者
words.tip: 形容詞詞尾讀/lət/，動詞詞尾讀/leɪt/。

def: n. an actor's line that immediately precedes and serves as a reminder for some action or speech
n. sports implement consisting of a tapering rod used to strike a cue ball in pool or billiards

tr: n. 冒險, 危險, 機會
vt. 冒...的危險, 賭運氣, 使冒危險
def: n. a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune
n. an obstacle on a golf course
Something that could cause harm, damage, or an accident.

ex.en: That loose cable is a hazard near the stairs.
ex.zh: 樓梯旁那根鬆散的電線是個安全隱患。

ex.en: Poorly stored industrial chemicals pose a serious health hazard to workers and residents in nearby communities.
ex.zh: 儲存不當的工業化學品會對工人及附近社區居民造成嚴重的健康威脅。

words.tip: 名詞指危險來源；動詞常見於hazard a guess。

tr: n. 磚瓦, 瓷磚, 瓦片
vt. 鋪以瓦, 鋪以瓷磚
def: n. a flat thin rectangular slab (as of fired clay or rubber or linoleum) used to cover surfaces
n. a thin flat slab of fired clay used for roofing
n. game equipment consisting of a flat thin piece marked with characters and used in board games like Mah-Jong, Scrabble, etc.

ex.en: One blue tile has cracked beside the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 廚房水槽旁的一塊藍色瓷磚裂了。

ex.en: Using locally produced roof tiles can reduce transport emissions and support traditional industries in rural areas.
ex.zh: 使用本地生產的屋頂瓦片可以減少運輸排放，並支持農村地區的傳統產業。

col: tile a bathroom｜給浴室貼瓷磚
words.tip: 可數名詞；作動詞時直接接要鋪磚的表面。

tr: n. 編法, 織法, 編織式樣
vt. 編織, 組合, 編排, 使迂迴前進
vi. 紡織, 迂迴行進
def: n. pattern of weaving or structure of a fabric
v. interlace by or as if by weaving
v. create a piece of cloth by interlacing strands of fabric, such as wool or cotton

ex.en: My aunt taught me to weave a small basket.
ex.zh: 姑姑教我編了一個小籃子。

ex.en: Effective documentaries weave personal stories into broader discussions of social change and public policy.
ex.zh: 優秀的紀錄片將個人故事融入對社會變遷和公共政策的更廣泛討論中。

col: weave through traffic｜在車流中穿梭
weave into a story｜編入故事
words.tip: 編織義過去式 wove，過去分詞 woven。

tr: n. 懇求, 辯解, 抗辯, 訴訟, 請願, 託詞
[法] 抗辯, 申訴案件, 答辯
def: n. (law) a defendant's answer by a factual matter (as distinguished from a demurrer)
n. an answer indicating why a suit should be dismissed
An urgent, emotional request for something.

ex.en: They heard our plea for help and stopped immediately.
ex.zh: 他們聽見我們的求助聲，立刻停了下來。

ex.en: Residents made a plea for better flood protection after repeated storms damaged homes across the region.
ex.zh: 多次暴風雨損壞該地區房屋後，居民懇請加強防洪措施。

col: a plea for help｜懇求幫助
enter a plea｜正式作出答辯
words.tip: plea for後接所求之物；plea to後接請求對象。

def: n. a beam made of wood
n. a post made of wood
wood prepared for building or making things

ex.en: The carpenter stacked the timber beside the workshop.
ex.zh: 木匠把木料堆在了工坊旁邊。

ex.en: Using responsibly sourced timber in construction can reduce environmental damage while supporting sustainable forest management.
ex.zh: 在建築中使用來源負責任的木材，既能減少環境破壞，也能支持可持續森林管理。

col: sustainably sourced timber｜可持續來源的木材
words.tip: 指木材時通常不可數；美式英語常用lumber指加工木料。

tr: n. 門閂, 螺釘, 篩子, 閃電, 意外事件
vt. 閂住, 發射, 脫口而出, 篩, 囫圇吞下
vi. 囫圇吞棗, 射箭, 脫韁, 退出黨派
def: n. a sliding bar in a breech-loading firearm that ejects an empty cartridge and replaces it and closes the breech
n. the part of a lock that is engaged or withdrawn with a key
n. a roll of cloth or wallpaper of a definite length

tr: [醫] 球, 鱗莖, 球莖
def: n. a modified bud consisting of a thickened globular underground stem serving as a reproductive structure
n. a rounded part of a cylindrical instrument (usually at one end)
n. anything with a round shape resembling a teardrop

ex.en: The kitchen bulb failed while I was washing dishes.
ex.zh: 我洗碗時，廚房的燈泡壞了。

ex.en: Replacing traditional bulbs with energy-efficient alternatives can reduce household electricity consumption and lower long-term costs.
ex.zh: 用節能燈泡替換傳統燈泡可以減少家庭用電量，並降低長期成本。

words.tip: 既指燈泡，也指洋蔥、水仙等植物的鱗莖。

tr: n. 講述者, 敘述者
def: n. someone who tells a story
The person or voice telling a story

ex.en: The narrator's gentle voice helped me fall asleep.
ex.zh: 旁白者輕柔的聲音幫助我入睡。

ex.en: An unreliable narrator encourages readers to question events and consider how personal perspectives shape their understanding of reality.
ex.zh: 不可靠的敘述者促使讀者質疑事件，並思考個人視角如何塑造對現實的理解。

words.tip: 敘述者不一定是作者；小說中可由虛構人物擔任。

tr: n. 碼頭, 船塢, 被告席, 尾巴的骨肉部分
vt. 使靠碼頭, 使(船)進港, 剪短
def: n. an enclosure in a court of law where the defendant sits during the trial
n. any of certain coarse weedy plants with long taproots, sometimes used as table greens or in folk medicine
n. a platform where trucks or trains can be loaded or unloaded

tr: n. 艦隊, 水兵, 海景畫
a. 海的, 海產的, 海底的, 船舶的, 海運的
def: n. a member of the United States Marine Corps
n. a soldier who serves both on shipboard and on land
a. of or relating to the sea

ex.en: We watched a documentary about marine life last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚看了一部關於海洋生物的紀錄片。

ex.en: Plastic pollution threatens marine ecosystems and reduces the income of communities that depend on fishing.
ex.zh: 塑料汙染威脅海洋生態系統，並減少依靠捕魚為生的社區的收入。

words.tip: marine側重海洋；海軍的通常用naval。

tr: n. 外交官, 有外交手腕的人
[法] 外交家, 外交官, 有權謀的人
def: n. an official engaged in international negotiations
n. a person who deals tactfully with others
An official who represents their country in relations with other countries.

ex.en: The diplomat welcomed visitors at the embassy this morning.
ex.zh: 這位外交官今天上午在大使館接待了來訪者。

ex.en: Experienced diplomats can help countries resolve disagreements through negotiation rather than allowing tensions to escalate.
ex.zh: 經驗豐富的外交官能幫助各國通過談判解決分歧，避免緊張局勢升級。

words.tip: diplomatic既可指外交的，也可指說話圓通的。

tr: n. 傳染病, 流行病
a. 流行的, 傳染性的
def: n. a widespread outbreak of an infectious disease; many people are infected at the same time
a. (especially of medicine) of disease or anything resembling a disease; attacking or affecting many individuals in a community or a population simultaneously

tr: n. 整齊, 情形, 修剪
vt. 使整齊, 整理, 修剪
vi. 調整, 見風使舵
[計] 庫存管理檢查規則程序
def: n. a state of arrangement or appearance
n. attitude of an aircraft in flight when allowed to take its own orientation
n. cutting down to the desired size or shape

ex.en: I trim the hedge before it blocks our window.
ex.zh: 我會在樹籬擋住窗戶之前修剪它。

ex.en: Local authorities can trim operating costs by improving energy efficiency in public buildings rather than reducing essential services.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以通過提高公共建築的能源效率來削減運營成本，而不是減少基本服務。

words.tip: 過去式trimmed、現在分詞trimming都雙寫m。

tr: a. 致命的, 重大的, 命運註定的, 粗心的, 不幸的
def: a. bringing death
s. controlled or decreed by fate; predetermined
Causing someone's death.

ex.en: These wild mushrooms can be fatal if you eat them.
ex.zh: 這些野生蘑菇吃了可能會致命。

ex.en: Lower speed limits near schools can reduce the risk of fatal accidents involving pedestrians and cyclists.
ex.zh: 降低學校附近的限速可以減少涉及行人和騎車人的致命事故風險。

words.tip: fatal強調致死或導致失敗；fateful指影響重大的。

tr: a. 固有的, 與生俱來的
def: s existing as an essential constituent or characteristic
s in the nature of something though not readily apparent
Existing as a natural or essential part of something.

ex.en: Even simple home repairs come with some inherent risks.
ex.zh: 即使是簡單的家居維修也有一些固有風險。

ex.en: Policymakers must recognise the inherent limitations of economic growth as a measure of social progress and wellbeing.
ex.zh: 政策制定者必須認識到，用經濟增長衡量社會進步和福祉存在固有侷限。

words.tip: 常用inherent in；強調本身具有，而非後來獲得。

def: n. an alloy of copper and tin and sometimes other elements; also any copper-base alloy containing other elements in place of tin
n. a sculpture made of bronze
v. give the color and appearance of bronze to something

ex.en: The small statue is made of solid bronze.
ex.zh: 這尊小雕像是用實心青銅製成的。

ex.en: Ancient tools made from bronze reveal how advances in metalworking transformed agriculture and trade across early societies.
ex.zh: 古代青銅工具揭示了金屬加工技術的進步如何改變早期社會的農業和貿易。

words.tip: bronze是青銅；brass是黃銅；copper是銅。

tr: n. 真空, 空間, 真空吸塵器
a. 真空的, 產生真空的, 利用真空的
def: n. the absence of matter
n. a region that is devoid of matter
n. an electrical home appliance that cleans by suction

ex.en: I vacuum the carpet while my brother dusts the shelves.
ex.zh: 我用吸塵器清掃地毯，弟弟則擦去架子上的灰塵。

ex.en: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum because it needs a medium such as air or water.
ex.zh: 聲音無法在真空中傳播，因為它需要空氣或水等介質。

col: vacuum the carpet｜用吸塵器清掃地毯
words.tip: 表示清掃時可直接作動詞：vacuum the floor。

tr: vi. 聽寫, 口述, 口授
vt. 口述, 使聽寫, 命令
n. 命令, 指揮, 指令
def: n. an authoritative rule
n. a guiding principle
v. say out loud for the purpose of recording

ex.en: Please dictate your message slowly while I write it down.
ex.zh: 請慢慢口述你的留言，我來記下來。

ex.en: Financial pressures often dictate which courses universities offer, potentially limiting opportunities in less profitable subjects.
ex.zh: 財務壓力往往決定大學開設哪些課程，可能限制收益較低學科的學習機會。

words.tip: dictate是口述讓別人寫；“做聽寫”用take dictation。

tr: n. 鉛版, 陳規, 老套
vt. 使用鉛版, 把...印製成盲文, 套用老套, 使一成不變
def: n. a conventional or formulaic conception or image
a fixed, oversimplified belief about a group of people
to judge people using fixed beliefs about their group

ex.en: My grandmother challenges the stereotype that older people dislike technology.
ex.zh: 我的祖母打破了老年人不喜歡科技的刻板印象。

ex.en: Schools should challenge gender stereotypes so that all students feel free to pursue their interests.
ex.zh: 學校應挑戰性別刻板印象，讓所有學生都能自由追求自己的興趣。

col: challenge a stereotype｜挑戰刻板印象
words.tip: 常指對某類人的簡單化看法，不等同於事實。

tr: a. 手的, 手動的, 手工的, 體力的
def: n. a small handbook
a. of or relating to the hands
a. requiring human effort

ex.en: This manual coffee grinder takes some effort to turn.
ex.zh: 這個手動咖啡研磨器轉起來有些費力。

ex.en: Although automation increases productivity, many industries still rely on manual labour for complex tasks.
ex.zh: 儘管自動化提高了生產率，許多行業仍依靠體力勞動來完成複雜任務。

words.tip: 作形容詞指手動或體力的；作名詞指手冊。

tr: a. 海軍的, 軍艦的, 有艦隊的
[法] 海軍的, 軍艦的, 船的
def: a. connected with or belonging to or used in a navy

tr: n. 令人討厭的人, 激浪, 槍膛, 孔
def: n. a person who evokes boredom
n. diameter of a tube or gun barrel
n. a hole or passage made by a drill; usually made for exploratory purposes

ex.en: Long meetings bore me, especially when nobody has anything new.
ex.zh: 冗長的會議讓我厭煩，尤其是大家都沒有新內容可說時。

ex.en: Lessons that rely entirely on memorisation may bore students and discourage them from exploring ideas independently.
ex.zh: 完全依賴記憶的課程可能讓學生感到無聊，並削弱他們獨立探索想法的意願。

col: bore someone to tears｜使某人極其厭煩
a terrible bore｜極其無趣的人或事
words.tip: 人感到無聊用bored；事物令人無聊用boring。

tr: n. 院長, 主持牧師
[法] 外交團長, 學院院長, 教務長
def: n. an administrator in charge of a division of a university or college
n. United States film actor whose moody rebellious roles made him a cult figure (1931-1955)
n. a man who is the senior member of a group
n. a beloved person; used as terms of endearment
s. dearly loved
deeply loved by someone or many people
