ex.en: He carefully repaired his daughter's beloved wooden toy.
ex.zh: 他小心地修好了女兒心愛的木玩具。

ex.en: Public libraries remain beloved community spaces because they offer opportunities for learning and social connection.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館依然是深受喜愛的社區空間，因為它們提供學習和社交的機會。

col: a beloved institution｜深受喜愛的機構
words.tip: 通常作形容詞；作名詞指愛人，語氣較文學化。

tr: vt. 取回, 挽回, 彌補, 恢復, 補償, 回憶, 檢索
n. 取回, 恢復, 救險球
def: v. go for and bring back
v. run after, pick up, and bring to the master

tr: a. 海外的, 國外的
adv. 在海外, 在國外
def: r. in a place across an ocean
in or to a foreign country
located in, coming from, or relating to foreign countries

ex.en: My cousin moved overseas and calls us every weekend.
ex.zh: 我表親搬到了國外，每個週末都給我們打電話。

ex.en: Studying overseas can broaden students' perspectives, although adapting to a different culture often takes time.
ex.zh: 出國留學能拓寬學生的視野，不過適應不同文化往往需要時間。

words.tip: 作副詞前不加to：go overseas；也可修飾名詞。

def: s. conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual

tr: vt. 提名, 任命, 命名
[法] 提名...為候選人, 指定, 推薦
def: v. propose as a candidate for some honor
v. put forward; nominate for appointment to an office or for an honor or position

tr: vt. 設計, 發明, 圖謀, 遺贈給
def: n. a will disposing of real property
n. (law) a gift of real property by will
v. give by will, especially real property

tr: vt. 拋錨停泊, 使固定
def: n. a mechanical device that prevents a vessel from moving
n. a central cohesive source of support and stability
n. a television reporter who coordinates a broadcast to which several correspondents contribute

ex.en: We dropped the anchor beside a quiet island.
ex.zh: 我們在一座寧靜的小島旁拋了錨。

ex.en: Strong community networks can provide an anchor for families adapting to life in unfamiliar cities.
ex.zh: 緊密的社區網絡可以為適應陌生城市生活的家庭提供可靠的依靠。

words.tip: drop anchor指拋錨；weigh anchor指起錨，不是稱重。

tr: n. 細看, 仔細檢查, 監視, 選票檢查
[經] 複查, 評核, 仔細檢查
def: n. a prolonged intense look
Careful examination of something, especially to find faults or problems.

ex.en: The jeweller examined the ring with intense scrutiny.
ex.zh: 珠寶商極其仔細地檢查了那枚戒指。

ex.en: Public spending should be subject to independent scrutiny to ensure that resources are used efficiently and fairly.
ex.zh: 公共支出應接受獨立審查，以確保資源得到高效且公平的使用。

words.tip: 不可數名詞；under scrutiny表示受到嚴格審查。

tr: vt. 鎮壓, 使止住, 禁止, 抑制, 查禁
[法] 鎮壓, 平定, 禁止出版
def: v. to put down by force or authority
v. put out of one's consciousness
v. reduce the incidence or severity of or stop

ex.en: I tried to suppress a sneeze during the concert.
ex.zh: 音樂會期間，我努力忍住了一個噴嚏。

ex.en: Attempts to suppress scientific findings can undermine public trust and delay effective responses to environmental problems.
ex.zh: 試圖隱瞞科學發現會損害公眾信任，並延誤對環境問題的有效應對。

words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接情緒、反應、活動或信息。

tr: n. 榨出物, 精汁, 摘錄, 選段
vt. (費力地)取出, 採掘, 榨取, 摘錄, 吸取
def: v. remove, usually with some force or effort; also used in an abstract sense
v. get despite difficulties or obstacles
v. separate (a metal) from an ore

ex.en: The dentist carefully extracted the damaged tooth this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，牙醫小心地拔掉了那顆壞牙。

ex.en: Researchers extract useful information from large datasets to identify patterns in household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 研究人員從大型數據集中提取有用信息，以識別家庭能源消耗的規律。

col: an extract from a novel｜小說節選
words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞讀/ˈekstrækt/。

tr: a. 加強的, 內涵的, 集中的
def: s. characterized by a high degree or intensity; often used as a combining form
a. tending to give force or emphasis
a. of agriculture; intended to increase productivity of a fixed area by expending more capital and labor

ex.en: I took an intensive swimming course during the holidays.
ex.zh: 假期裡我參加了一個游泳強化課程。

ex.en: Intensive farming can increase food production, but it may also damage soil quality and reduce biodiversity.
ex.zh: 集約化農業可以提高糧食產量，但也可能損害土壤質量並減少生物多樣性。

words.tip: intensive 強調集中投入；intense 強調感受或程度強烈。

tr: [法] 官僚主義, 官僚政治, 官僚機構
def: n. nonelective government officials
n. a government that is administered primarily by bureaus that are staffed with nonelective officials
n. any organization in which action is obstructed by insistence on unnecessary procedures and red tape

ex.en: My aunt works within the city's large bureaucracy.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在這個城市龐大的行政體系內工作。

ex.en: Reducing unnecessary bureaucracy could help small businesses obtain permits more quickly without weakening essential safety standards.
ex.zh: 減少不必要的繁文縟節，能幫助小企業更快取得許可證，同時不削弱必要的安全標準。

col: excessive bureaucracy｜過度繁瑣的行政手續
words.tip: bureaucracy指體制或繁瑣手續；官僚個人是bureaucrat。

tr: n. 滑雪運動, 滑雪術
def: n. a sport in which participants must travel on skis
The activity of moving over snow on skis.

ex.en: We went skiing together during our winter holiday.
ex.zh: 寒假期間，我們一起去滑雪了。

ex.en: Skiing attracts winter tourists to mountain regions, creating seasonal jobs but increasing demand for water.
ex.zh: 滑雪吸引冬季遊客前往山區，創造了季節性工作，但也增加了用水需求。

words.tip: 滑雪用go skiing；滑水需說water skiing。

tr: n. 複雜化, 複雜情況
使情況複雜的因素；難題
def: n. the act or process of complicating
n. a situation or condition that is complex or confused
n. any disease or disorder that occurs during the course of (or because of) another disease

ex.en: A delayed train added another complication to our journey.
ex.zh: 火車晚點又給我們的旅程添了一個麻煩。

ex.en: Regular medical checkups can help detect complications early and improve outcomes for patients with chronic conditions.
ex.zh: 定期體檢有助於及早發現併發症，並改善慢性病患者的治療效果。

col: avoid complications｜避免麻煩或併發症
words.tip: 可指數額外難題，也可指疾病或治療引起的併發症。

tr: n. 特許, 讓步, 認可
[經] 核准, 許可, 特殊(權)
def: n. a contract granting the right to operate a subsidiary business
n. the act of conceding or yielding
n. a point conceded or yielded

ex.en: We made a concession and agreed to leave earlier.
ex.zh: 我們作出讓步，同意早點離開。

ex.en: Offering concessions to students and older people can make public transport more affordable for these groups.
ex.zh: 向學生和老年人提供優惠，可以讓這些群體更負擔得起公共交通費用。

words.tip: make concessions表示讓步；英式英語中也指票價優惠。

def: n. a concave shape whose distinguishing characteristic is that the concavity faces downward
n. a stadium that has a roof
n. a hemispherical roof

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the glass dome above the entrance.
ex.zh: 陽光透過入口上方的玻璃穹頂灑了進來。

ex.en: The museum's central dome allows natural light into the building, reducing the need for artificial lighting during daylight hours.
ex.zh: 博物館中央的穹頂讓自然光進入建築，減少了白天對人工照明的需求。

words.tip: dome是半球形圓頂；domed表示有圓頂的。

tr: a. 不充分的, 不適當的
[法] 不充分的, 不適當的
def: a. lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task
s. not sufficient to meet a need
not enough or not good enough for a particular purpose

ex.en: This tiny heater is inadequate for such a large room.
ex.zh: 這麼大的房間用這個小暖氣，供暖遠遠不夠。

ex.en: Inadequate public transport can prevent rural residents from accessing employment opportunities and essential healthcare services.
ex.zh: 公共交通不足會妨礙農村居民獲得就業機會和必要的醫療服務。

col: inadequate for the task｜不足以勝任任務
words.tip: 常用inadequate for；指數量不足或質量不達標。

tr: a. 編輯的, 主筆的, 社論的
def: a. of or relating to an article stating opinions or giving perspectives
a. relating to or characteristic of an editor

tr: n. 抽屜, 小櫃, 上鎖人
def: n. a fastener that locks or closes
a small cupboard for keeping personal belongings secure

ex.en: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
ex.zh: 我把運動鞋留在健身房的儲物櫃裡了。

ex.en: Providing each student with a locker can reduce the weight of bags carried around school.
ex.zh: 為每位學生配備儲物櫃，可以減輕他們在校園內攜帶的書包重量。

words.tip: locker通常是存放個人物品的小櫃，不指上鎖的人。

tr: n. 常到的地方, 生息地
vt. 常到, 出沒於, 縈繞於
def: n. a frequently visited place
v. follow stealthily or recur constantly and spontaneously to
v. haunt like a ghost; pursue

ex.en: That embarrassing mistake still haunts me before every presentation.
ex.zh: 每次做報告前，那個令人尷尬的錯誤仍會困擾我。

ex.en: The consequences of poor urban planning can haunt communities long after the original decisions are made.
ex.zh: 糟糕的城市規劃所帶來的後果，可能在最初決策作出很久之後仍困擾社區。

col: be haunted by memories｜被回憶困擾
haunt an old house｜在老房子裡出沒
a favourite haunt｜最愛常去的地方
words.tip: 作動詞直接接賓語；be haunted by表示受困擾。

tr: a. 天然的, 未成熟的, 粗糙的, 粗魯的
def: s. not carefully or expertly made
s. conspicuously and tastelessly indecent
s. belonging to an early stage of technical development; characterized by simplicity and (often) crudeness

tr: vt. 喚起, 引起, 召(魂)
def: v call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses)
v evoke or provoke to appear or occur
v deduce (a principle) or construe (a meaning)

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread evokes memories of home.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味喚起了對家的回憶。

ex.en: Traditional music can evoke a strong sense of belonging among people living far from their homeland.
ex.zh: 傳統音樂能在遠離故土的人們心中喚起強烈的歸屬感。

words.tip: 直接接情感、回憶等賓語，不加of。

tr: n. 朋友, 夥伴, 同志, 同謀
def: v. become friends; act friendly towards

tr: n. 血管, 靜脈, 紋理, 氣質, 情緒
vt. 使有脈絡, 像脈絡般分佈於
def: n. a blood vessel that carries blood from the capillaries toward the heart
n. a distinctive style or manner
n. any of the vascular bundles or ribs that form the branching framework of conducting and supporting tissues in a leaf or other plant organ

ex.en: A blue vein was visible beneath his wrist.
ex.zh: 他的手腕皮膚下可以看到一條藍色靜脈。

ex.en: Regular movement helps blood flow through the veins and may reduce health risks associated with prolonged sitting.
ex.zh: 經常活動有助於靜脈血液流動，並可能降低久坐帶來的健康風險。

col: a vein of gold｜一條金礦脈
words.tip: vein指靜脈；artery指動脈，二者不是反義詞。

tr: vt. 交出, 放棄, 使投降, 讓與
n. 交出, 放棄, 投降
def: n. the delivery of a principal into lawful custody
v. give up or agree to forgo to the power or possession of another
v. relinquish possession or control over

ex.en: The soldiers surrendered and walked forward with empty hands.
ex.zh: 士兵們投降了，空著雙手向前走來。

ex.en: Users should not have to surrender control of their personal information to access essential online services.
ex.zh: 用戶不應為了使用必要的在線服務而被迫放棄對個人信息的控制權。

words.tip: surrender to sb指向某人投降；交出物品直接接賓語。

tr: n. 巨湧, 洶湧, 澎湃
vi. 洶湧, 澎湃, 顛簸, 猛衝, 突然放鬆
vt. 使洶湧奔騰, 急放
def: n. a sudden or abrupt strong increase
v. see one's performance improve

tr: n. 註釋, 評論, 說明
[法] 註釋, 評註, 評論
def: n a written explanation or criticism or illustration that is added to a book or other textual material
a spoken description of an event as it happens
an explanation or discussion expressing opinions about something

ex.en: We listened to the football commentary while cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我們一邊做晚飯，一邊聽足球比賽的實況解說。

ex.en: Political commentary can help citizens understand complex policies, but it should be clearly distinguished from factual reporting.
ex.zh: 政治評論可以幫助公民理解複雜政策，但應與事實報道明確區分。

words.tip: commentary常指持續解說或深入評述，不只是單條評論。

tr: a. 帝王的, 宗主國的, 至尊的, 壯麗的
def: n. a small tufted beard worn by Emperor Napoleon III
n. a piece of luggage carried on top of a coach
a. relating to or associated with an empire

ex.en: We admired the golden roof of the imperial palace.
ex.zh: 我們讚歎那座皇宮的金色屋頂。

ex.en: Former imperial capitals often preserve architectural features that reflect their historical wealth and political influence.
ex.zh: 昔日的帝國首都往往保留著體現其歷史財富和政治影響力的建築特色。

words.tip: imperial units指英制單位，與metric units相對。

tr: vi. 盤旋, 翱翔, 徘徊
def: v. be undecided about something; waver between conflicting positions or courses of action
v. move to and fro
v. hang in the air; fly or be suspended above

ex.en: A small helicopter hovered above the empty field.
ex.zh: 一架小型直升機懸停在空曠的田野上方。

ex.en: When unemployment rates hover around current levels, governments may need to invest more in vocational training.
ex.zh: 當失業率在當前水平附近徘徊時，政府可能需要加大職業培訓投入。

col: hover around a level｜在某水平附近波動
words.tip: 核心是停留不去，不等於soar（翱翔）。

tr: n. 製造, (手工)製造業, 製作, 形成, 發展, 要素, 內在因素, 賺頭, 製造物
def: n. (usually plural) the components needed for making or doing something
The process of producing or creating something.
Something that causes someone or something to become successful.

ex.en: We spent the afternoon learning the basics of bread making.
ex.zh: 我們花了一下午學習製作麵包的基礎方法。

ex.en: Involving residents in the making of local policy can increase public trust and improve community outcomes.
ex.zh: 讓居民參與地方政策的制定，可以增強公眾信任並改善社區發展成效。

col: the making of a film｜電影的製作
be the making of someone｜促成某人的成功
have the makings of｜具備成為……的素質
words.tip: 表“潛質”用複數makings：have the makings of。

tr: a. 化石的, 陳腐的, 守舊的
def: n. the remains (or an impression) of a plant or animal that existed in a past geological age and that has been excavated from the soil
a. characteristic of a fossil
Ancient remains or traces of living things preserved in rock.

ex.en: We found a tiny shell fossil inside the rock.
ex.zh: 我們在岩石裡發現了一枚小小的貝殼化石。

ex.en: Fossil evidence helps scientists understand how animals adapted to environmental changes over millions of years.
ex.zh: 化石證據幫助科學家瞭解動物在數百萬年間如何適應環境變化。

words.tip: fossil fuels指煤、石油、天然氣等化石燃料。

tr: a. 能養活的, 能生長發育的
[醫] 有活力的, 有生機的
def: s. capable of life or normal growth and development
Able to work successfully in practice.
Able to survive or develop into a living organism.

ex.en: Sharing a flat seems like a viable option.
ex.zh: 合租公寓似乎是個可行的選擇。

ex.en: Public transport must be affordable and reliable to become a viable alternative to private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通必須價格合理且運行可靠，才能成為私家車的可行替代選擇。

col: viable seeds｜有發芽能力的種子
words.tip: 主要指方案可行；生物學中指能存活或發育。

tr: n. 素描, 草圖, 小品
v. 描繪略圖, 畫素描或速寫
def: n. preliminary drawing for later elaboration
n. a brief literary description
n. short descriptive summary (of events)

tr: vi. 努力, 奮鬥, 鬥爭
def: v. to exert much effort or energy
To try very hard to achieve something.

ex.en: I strive to practise the piano every day.
ex.zh: 我努力做到每天練鋼琴。

ex.en: Governments should strive to provide affordable housing without reducing the quality of public services.
ex.zh: 政府應努力提供可負擔住房，同時不降低公共服務質量。

col: strive towards a goal｜為目標奮鬥
words.tip: 常用strive to do或strive for；過去式常為strove。

tr: n. 疏忽, 忽略, 漏做
vt. 疏忽, 忽視, 不顧
def: n. the state of something that has been unused and neglected
v. leave undone or leave out
v. fail to attend to

tr: n. 傾斜, 傾向, 船篷, 車篷
vt. 使傾斜, 使傾側, 用帆布篷遮蓋
vi. 傾斜, 翹起, 衝, 評擊
def: n. a slight but noticeable partiality
n. the property possessed by a line or surface that departs from the vertical
v. charge with a tilt

tr: a. 中古的, 中世紀的
def: a. relating to or belonging to the Middle Ages
s. as if belonging to the Middle Ages; old-fashioned and unenlightened
relating to European history from about AD 500 to 1500

ex.en: We explored a medieval castle during our weekend trip.
ex.zh: 我們在週末旅行中游覽了一座中世紀城堡。

ex.en: Preserving medieval buildings allows modern communities to understand how earlier generations lived, worked, and organised their societies.
ex.zh: 保護中世紀建築能讓現代社區瞭解前人如何生活、工作及組織社會。

words.tip: 通常指歐洲約公元500至1500年的中世紀。

tr: a. 貨幣的, 金錢的
def: a. relating to or involving money

tr: n. 結, 群, 難題
def: n. a tight cluster of people or things
n. any of various fastenings formed by looping and tying a rope (or cord) upon itself or to another rope or to another object
n. a hard cross-grained round piece of wood in a board where a branch emerged

ex.en: This knot is too tight for me to undo.
ex.zh: 這個結太緊了，我解不開。

ex.en: During outdoor education courses, students learn to tie a secure knot before attempting basic climbing activities.
ex.zh: 在戶外教育課程中，學生先學習打牢固的繩結，再嘗試基礎攀爬活動。

col: a speed of twenty knots｜二十節的速度
words.tip: k不發音；航速的knot是每小時一海里。

def: n. a chemical substance derivable from a mold or bacterium that can kill microorganisms and cure bacterial infections
a. of or relating to antibiotic drugs

tr: vt. 告發, 起訴, 徹底進行, 執行, 從事
vi. 告發, 起訴, 作檢察官
def: v. conduct a prosecution in a court of law
v. bring a criminal action against (in a trial)
v. carry out or participate in an activity; be involved in

tr: vi. 插入, 調停, 干涉
def: v. get involved, so as to alter or hinder an action, or through force or threat of force
v. be placed or located between other things or extend between spaces and events
v. occur between other event or between certain points of time

ex.en: The coach intervened before the argument became more heated.
ex.zh: 教練在爭論進一步升級之前進行了調解。

ex.en: Governments may need to intervene when market competition fails to provide affordable essential services.
ex.zh: 當市場競爭無法提供價格可承受的基本服務時，政府可能需要干預。

col: intervene in a dispute｜介入糾紛
words.tip: 不及物動詞：intervene in sth；不能直接接賓語。

tr: n. 赤熱, 光輝, 熱情, 熱烈, 紅光
vi. 發紅光, 紅光煥發, 發熱, 洋溢, 激動
def: n. a feeling of considerable warmth
n. a steady even light without flames
v. emit a steady even light without flames

ex.en: The last embers glowed softly in the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁爐裡最後的餘燼發出柔和的紅光。

ex.en: The warm glow of street lighting can make public spaces feel safer after dark.
ex.zh: 街燈溫暖的光芒能讓公共空間在天黑後給人更安全的感覺。

col: glow with pride｜因自豪而容光煥發
a healthy glow｜健康紅潤的氣色
words.tip: glow常指持續柔光；flash指短暫閃光。

tr: vt. 具體表達, 使具體化
[經] 合併, 具體化, 具體表現
def: v. represent, as of a character on stage
v. represent or express something abstract in tangible form
To clearly represent an idea, quality, or feeling.

ex.en: These handmade bowls embody my grandmother's patience and care.
ex.zh: 這些手工碗體現了我祖母的耐心與用心。

ex.en: Public buildings should embody the values of inclusion by providing accessible spaces for people with different needs.
ex.zh: 公共建築應為有不同需求的人提供無障礙空間，以體現包容的價值觀。

col: embody an ideal｜體現一種理想
embody the spirit of｜體現……的精神
embody core values｜體現核心價值觀
words.tip: embody是及物動詞，直接接所體現的品質或理念。

tr: n. 襲擊, 突襲, 搜捕
def: n. an attempt by speculators to defraud investors
v. search without warning, make a sudden surprise attack on
v. take over (a company) by buying a controlling interest of its stock

tr: n. 王冠, 王權, 頂點
vt. 使成王, 加冕, 居...之頂
def: n. the Crown (or the reigning monarch) as the symbol of the power and authority of a monarchy
n. the part of a tooth above the gum that is covered with enamel
n. a wreath or garland worn on the head to signify victory

ex.en: The queen wore a golden crown during the ceremony.
ex.zh: 女王在儀式上戴著一頂金色王冠。

ex.en: A royal crown displayed in a museum can reveal historical attitudes towards wealth, authority, and craftsmanship.
ex.zh: 博物館裡展出的王冠可以揭示歷史上人們對財富、權威和工藝的態度。

col: the crown of the head｜頭頂
the crown of a tree｜樹冠
words.tip: be crowned champion意為“被授予冠軍稱號”。

tr: n. 假貨, 欺騙, 詭計
def: n. something that is a counterfeit; not what it seems to be
s. not genuine or real; being an imitation of the genuine article; it's real synthetic fur"

tr: n. 爬, 徐行, 蠕動
vi. 爬, 蔓延, 潛行
躡手躡腳地走；緩慢移動
def: n. someone unpleasantly strange or eccentric
n. a slow longitudinal movement or deformation
n. a pen that is fenced so that young animals can enter but adults cannot

ex.en: I crept upstairs to avoid waking the sleeping baby.
ex.zh: 我躡手躡腳地上樓，以免吵醒熟睡的寶寶。

ex.en: Housing costs can creep up gradually, placing increasing financial pressure on families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 住房成本可能逐漸上漲，給收入有限的家庭帶來越來越大的經濟壓力。

col: give someone the creeps｜使某人毛骨悚然
words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為crept；不一定指爬行。

def: n. the practice of cultivating the land or raising stock
n. agriculture considered as an occupation or way of life
Growing crops or raising animals for food and other products

ex.en: My grandparents earn their living from sheep farming.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母以養羊為生。

ex.en: Sustainable farming can protect soil quality while providing enough food for a growing population.
ex.zh: 可持續農業既能保護土壤質量，也能為不斷增長的人口提供充足的食物。

words.tip: 泛指農業時通常不可數；養殖也可用farming。

tr: n. 組織者, 編制者, 創立者, 組織導體
[醫] 組織導體, 機化中心(胚)
def: n. a person who brings order and organization to an enterprise
n. someone who enlists workers to join a union

tr: n. 藥物, 治療法, 治療, 補救, 賠償
vt. 治療, 補救, 矯正, 改善, 修補, 修繕
def: n. a medicine or therapy that cures disease or relieve pain
v. provide relief for
A treatment or medicine used to relieve an illness.

ex.en: Warm lemon water is her favourite remedy for colds.
ex.zh: 溫檸檬水是她最喜歡的緩解感冒的方法。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable training could help remedy the shortage of skilled workers in rural areas.
ex.zh: 讓更多人獲得負擔得起的培訓，有助於緩解農村地區技術工人短缺的問題。

col: a remedy for｜針對……的療法或辦法
words.tip: 名詞常接for；動詞直接接問題，不加for。

def: n. lack of ability (especially mental ability) to do something
n. lacking the power to perform

tr: n. 打碎, 粉碎, 打碎時嘩啦聲, 猛擊, 扣球, 殺球, 經營失敗, 破產, 硬幣, 假硬幣
a. 非常轟動的, 了不起的
vt. 打碎, 粉碎, 擊潰, 使破產, 使裂變, 使用假硬幣
vi. 碎裂, 猛撞, 破產, 扣球, 殺球
adv. 轟隆一聲, 嘩啦一聲
def: n. a serious collision (especially of motor vehicles)
v. hit hard
v. break into pieces, as by striking or knocking over

tr: n. 手稿, 原稿, 底稿
def: n. the form of a literary work submitted for publication
n. handwritten book or document

tr: n. 道德, 教訓, 品行
def: n. concern with the distinction between good and evil or right and wrong; right or good conduct
Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong
The degree to which an action is right or wrong

ex.en: Our family discussed morality after finding a lost wallet.
ex.zh: 撿到一個錢包後，我們一家討論了道德問題。

ex.en: The morality of animal testing remains controversial, particularly when potential medical benefits conflict with concerns about animal welfare.
ex.zh: 動物實驗是否合乎道德仍有爭議，尤其是在潛在醫療益處與動物福利考量發生衝突時。

col: the morality of an action｜某一行為的道德性
words.tip: moral是形容詞；morality是名詞，常為不可數。

tr: a. 命令的, 託管的
def: n the recipient of a mandate
n a territory surrendered by Turkey or Germany after World War I and put under the tutelage of some other European power until they are able to stand by themselves
s required by rule

ex.en: Wearing a helmet is mandatory at this climbing centre.
ex.zh: 在這家攀巖中心，必須佩戴頭盔。

ex.en: Mandatory safety training can reduce workplace accidents by ensuring that all employees understand potential risks.
ex.zh: 強制性安全培訓能確保所有員工瞭解潛在風險，從而減少工作場所事故。

words.tip: 常用於法規或制度要求；反義詞為optional。

def: v. put together out of artificial or natural components or parts; He manufactured a popular cereal"
v. produce naturally
v. create or produce in a mechanical way

ex.en: The factory manufactures bicycles that fold into small bags.
ex.zh: 這家工廠生產可摺疊後裝入小包的自行車。

ex.en: Companies that manufacture electronic devices should take greater responsibility for recycling their products at the end of use.
ex.zh: 製造電子設備的企業應承擔更多責任，回收使用壽命結束的產品。

words.tip: 多指工廠批量生產；名詞製造商是manufacturer。

tr: n. 暖和, 加溫, 暖熱, 溫暖, (非正式)打, 鞭打
def: s. imparting heat

tr: n. 抓緊, 掌握, 離合器, 一窩小雞
vt. 抓住, 踩汽車離合器踏板
def: n. a tense critical situation
n. a number of birds hatched at the same time
n. a pedal or lever that engages or disengages a rotating shaft and a driving mechanism
n. a mental or physical breakdown
n. a cessation of normal operation
n. an analysis into mutually exclusive categories

tr: vt. 隱藏, 掩蓋, 隱瞞
[法] 隱瞞, 隱匿, 保守秘密
def: v. hold back; keep from being perceived by others
To keep something from being seen
To prevent facts or feelings from becoming known

ex.en: She concealed the birthday present behind a large cushion.
ex.zh: 她把生日禮物藏在一個大靠墊後面。

ex.en: Companies that conceal environmental damage from the public risk losing consumer trust when the truth emerges.
ex.zh: 企業若向公眾隱瞞環境破壞情況，真相曝光時就可能失去消費者的信任。

col: conceal something from someone｜對某人隱瞞某事
words.tip: conceal比hide正式；常用conceal sth from sb。

def: n. American chemist who with Richard Smalley and Harold Kroto discovered fullerenes and opened a new branch of chemistry (born in 1933)
v. form a curl, curve, or kink
v. twist or roll into coils or ringlets

ex.en: The dry leaves curl at the edges in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天，乾枯的葉子邊緣會捲起來。

ex.en: During prolonged droughts, leaves may curl to reduce water loss and protect plants from further damage.
ex.zh: 在持續乾旱期間，葉片可能捲曲，以減少水分流失並保護植物免受進一步損害。

col: curl your hair｜把頭髮捲起來
words.tip: curl up指蜷縮身體，常用於人或動物。

def: n. either of two bean-shaped excretory organs that filter wastes (especially urea) from the blood and excrete them and water in urine
Either of two organs that filter blood and produce urine.

ex.en: The doctor checked his kidneys during a routine examination.
ex.zh: 醫生在常規檢查中檢查了他的腎臟。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should explain how managing blood pressure can help prevent kidney disease.
ex.zh: 公共衛生宣傳應說明控制血壓如何有助於預防腎病。

words.tip: kidney是可數名詞；醫學形容詞renal表示“腎的”。

tr: n. 讀寫能力, 識字, 精通文學
def: n. the ability to read and write
The ability to read and write.
Basic knowledge and skills needed in a particular area.

ex.en: The library offers free literacy classes for local adults.
ex.zh: 圖書館為當地成年人提供免費的讀寫課程。

ex.en: Improving digital literacy helps older adults access essential services and participate more fully in modern society.
ex.zh: 提高數字素養有助於老年人獲取必要服務，更充分地參與現代社會生活。

words.tip: 不可數；digital literacy指數字素養，不只是識字。

def: n. an event (or a course of events) that will inevitably happen in the future
n. the ultimate agency regarded as predetermining the course of events (often personified as a woman)
A future believed to be fixed by forces beyond personal control.

ex.en: She believed it was her destiny to become a musician.
ex.zh: 她相信自己命中註定會成為音樂家。

ex.en: Although family circumstances influence opportunities, education can help individuals shape their own destiny rather than accept existing limitations.
ex.zh: 儘管家庭條件會影響機會，教育仍能幫助個人塑造自己的命運，而非接受現有的限制。

col: shape your own destiny｜塑造自己的命運
fulfil your destiny｜實現命中註定的使命
words.tip: 常指註定的未來；shape your destiny強調主動掌握命運。

tr: n. 獨奏, 獨唱, 單獨表演
a. 單獨的, 獨奏的, 獨唱的
def: n. any activity that is performed alone without assistance
n. a musical composition for one voice or instrument (with or without accompaniment)
n. a flight in which the aircraft pilot is unaccompanied

ex.en: Everyone fell silent when she began her violin solo.
ex.zh: 她開始小提琴獨奏時，所有人都安靜了下來。

ex.en: Solo travel can encourage independence by requiring individuals to manage unfamiliar situations without relying on companions.
ex.zh: 獨自旅行要求人們不依賴同伴處理陌生情況，因此有助於培養獨立性。

words.tip: 可作名詞、形容詞和副詞；獨奏者用soloist。

tr: [法] 會議, 國會, 議院
def: n. a legislative assembly in certain countries
A country's group of representatives that debates and makes laws

ex.en: Our class visited parliament and watched a lively debate.
ex.zh: 我們班參觀了議會，觀看了一場熱烈的辯論。

ex.en: Parliament should examine the long-term environmental consequences of major infrastructure projects before approving public funding.
ex.zh: 議會應在批准公共撥款前，審查重大基礎設施項目的長期環境影響。

words.tip: 特指某國議會時常大寫；英國議員簡稱MP。

tr: n. 開支, 費用, 用光, 消費額
[經] 支出, 費用, 消費
def: n money paid out; an amount spent
n the act of spending money for goods or services
n the act of consuming something

ex.en: We track our monthly expenditure in a small notebook.
ex.zh: 我們用一個小本子記錄每月開支。

ex.en: Higher public expenditure on preventive healthcare could reduce the long-term cost of treating chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 增加預防性醫療的公共支出，可以降低治療慢性病的長期成本。

words.tip: 通常不可數；expenditure on後接花費對象。

tr: n. 獸群, 人群, 牧人
vt. 群集, 使成群, 放牧
def: n. a group of cattle or sheep or other domestic mammals all of the same kind that are herded by humans
n. a group of wild mammals of one species that remain together: antelope or elephants or seals or whales or zebra
v. cause to herd, drive, or crowd together

ex.en: A herd of cows blocked the narrow country road.
ex.zh: 一群奶牛堵住了狹窄的鄉間道路。

ex.en: Protecting migration routes allows herds of wild animals to reach essential sources of food and water.
ex.zh: 保護遷徙路線能讓野生動物群到達重要的食物和水源所在地。

words.tip: 牛、象等成群用herd；羊群、鳥群通常用flock。

tr: n. 探索, 調查, 探針, 探測器
v. 用探針探測, 調查, 探索
def: n. an inquiry into unfamiliar or questionable activities
n. a flexible slender surgical instrument with a blunt end that is used to explore wounds or body cavities
n. an exploratory action or expedition

ex.en: The electrician probed behind the wall for damaged wires.
ex.zh: 電工探查牆後是否有損壞的電線。

ex.en: Independent investigators should probe the causes of industrial accidents to prevent similar incidents in the future.
ex.zh: 獨立調查人員應深入調查工業事故的原因，以防今後發生類似事件。

words.tip: 動詞可直接接調查對象，也可用probe into。

tr: n. 苦惱, 貧困, 痛苦
def: n. psychological suffering
n. a state of adversity (danger or affliction or need)
n. extreme physical pain

ex.en: Her neighbour noticed her distress and offered to help.
ex.zh: 鄰居看出她很難過，便主動提出幫忙。

ex.en: Sudden unemployment can cause considerable distress, particularly for households with limited savings and high housing costs.
ex.zh: 突然失業會引發嚴重的焦慮，對儲蓄有限且住房開支高的家庭尤其如此。

words.tip: distress比一般sadness強烈，也可指危難。

tr: n. 諾言, 保證, 誓言, 抵押, 信物, 保人, 祝願
vt. 許諾, 保證, 使發誓, 抵押, 典當, 舉杯祝...健康
def: n. a deposit of personal property as security for a debt
n. someone accepted for membership but not yet fully admitted to the group
n. a drink in honor of or to the health of a person or event

ex.en: We made a pledge to keep the beach clean.
ex.zh: 我們鄭重承諾保持海灘清潔。

ex.en: Local authorities have pledged to improve public transport and reduce traffic congestion over the next decade.
ex.zh: 地方政府已承諾在未來十年改善公共交通並緩解交通擁堵。

col: pledge to do something｜承諾做某事
words.tip: 比promise更正式；動詞常接to do。

def: v. communicate a disease to
v. contaminate with a disease or microorganism
v. corrupt with ideas or an ideology

ex.en: One sick rabbit can infect the others in its cage.
ex.zh: 一隻生病的兔子可能傳染同籠的其他兔子。

ex.en: Viruses can infect vulnerable patients more easily when hospitals lack effective hygiene measures and adequate ventilation.
ex.zh: 如果醫院缺乏有效的衛生措施和充分的通風，病毒就更容易感染身體脆弱的患者。

col: infect someone with a virus｜使某人感染病毒
words.tip: 常用infect someone with a virus，表示使某人感染病毒。

tr: n. 等級制度, 僧侶統治, 等級體系
[計] 分級結構; 分層結構; 新聞組, 新聞組分層
def: n. a series of ordered groupings of people or things within a system
n. the organization of people at different ranks in an administrative body
A system arranging people or things by rank or importance

ex.en: There is a clear hierarchy among the restaurant staff.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的員工之間有明確的等級關係。

ex.en: A rigid workplace hierarchy may discourage junior employees from sharing ideas that could improve organisational performance.
ex.zh: 僵化的職場等級制度可能使基層員工不願分享有助於改善組織績效的想法。

col: a rigid hierarchy｜嚴格的等級制度
a hierarchy of needs｜需求層次
the top of the hierarchy｜等級體系的頂層
words.tip: 既可指等級結構，也可指組織的最高領導層。

tr: v. 犯罪, 冒犯, 違反, 進攻
def: v cause to feel resentment or indignation
v act in disregard of laws, rules, contracts, or promises
v strike with disgust or revulsion

tr: a. 有同情心的, 合意的, 贊成的
n. 交感神經, 容易感受的人
def: a. of or relating to the sympathetic nervous system
a. expressing or feeling or resulting from sympathy or compassion or friendly fellow feelings; disposed toward
a. (of characters in literature or drama) evoking empathic or sympathetic feelings

ex.en: My manager was sympathetic when I explained my difficulties.
ex.zh: 我說明困難後，經理表示理解。

ex.en: Employers who are sympathetic to carers' needs can improve staff wellbeing by offering flexible working arrangements.
ex.zh: 體諒照護者需求的僱主可以通過提供靈活的工作安排來改善員工福祉。

col: a sympathetic listener｜體貼的傾聽者
sympathetic to a proposal｜贊同一項提議
words.tip: 常接to或towards；不表示“討人喜歡的”。

tr: n. 觀眾, 目擊者, 旁觀者
def: n. a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind)
Someone who watches an event, especially a sporting event.

ex.en: A spectator caught the ball near the fence.
ex.zh: 一名觀眾在圍欄附近接住了球。

ex.en: Major sporting events attract thousands of spectators and can generate substantial income for local businesses.
ex.zh: 大型體育賽事吸引成千上萬的觀眾，並能為當地商家帶來可觀收入。

words.tip: 常指體育賽事現場觀眾；演出觀眾多用audience。

def: n. (astronomy) a relatively small extraterrestrial body consisting of a frozen mass that travels around the sun in a highly elliptical orbit
An icy object orbiting the sun, sometimes showing a bright tail

ex.en: We watched a bright comet through my uncle's telescope.
ex.zh: 我們用叔叔的望遠鏡觀看了一顆明亮的彗星。

ex.en: Studying a comet can provide valuable evidence about the conditions in which our solar system formed.
ex.zh: 研究彗星可以提供有關太陽系形成時環境的重要證據。

words.tip: comet是彗星；meteor是進入大氣後發光的流星。

tr: n. 雞尾酒, 開味品
def: n. a short mixed drink
n. an appetizer served as a first course at a meal

tr: n. 全體, 合唱曲, (女人的)全套服裝
[化] 總體; 整體; 系綜
def: n. a group of musicians playing or singing together
n. a cast other than the principals
n. an assemblage of parts or details (as in a work of art) considered as forming a whole
n. a chemical used to kill pests (as rodents or insects)
A substance used to kill pests that damage crops.

ex.en: The farmer wore protective clothing while spraying pesticide on crops.
ex.zh: 農民向作物噴灑農藥時穿著防護服。

ex.en: Excessive pesticide use can harm beneficial insects and contaminate water sources near agricultural land.
ex.zh: 過量使用農藥可能傷害益蟲，並汙染農田附近的水源。

col: reduce pesticide use｜減少農藥使用
words.tip: pesticide泛指農藥；insecticide專指殺蟲劑。

def: n. a person appointed or elected to represent others
v. transfer power to someone
v. give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person)

tr: vt. 指定, 指明, 稱呼
a. 已選出而未上任的
def: v. assign a name or title to
s. appointed but not yet installed in office
To officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose.

ex.en: We designated one cupboard for all our cleaning supplies.
ex.zh: 我們指定了一個櫥櫃專門存放所有清潔用品。

ex.en: Local authorities should designate more urban land as protected green space to improve residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 地方政府應將更多城市土地劃為受保護的綠地，以改善居民的生活質量。

col: designate an area for｜劃定區域用於
words.tip: designate A as B表示指定或認定A為B。

def: n. a motor hotel
A roadside hotel with convenient parking for guests.

ex.en: We found a quiet motel just outside the town.
ex.zh: 我們在鎮子外找到了一家安靜的汽車旅館。

ex.en: Affordable motels along major roads provide convenient accommodation for travellers exploring rural areas by car.
ex.zh: 主幹道沿線價格實惠的汽車旅館為自駕探索鄉村的旅客提供了便利的住宿。

col: stay at a motel｜住汽車旅館
words.tip: motel主要服務駕車旅客，通常提供便利停車位。

def: n. the length of a straight line passing through the center of a circle and connecting two points on the circumference
n. a straight line connecting the center of a circle with two points on its perimeter (or the center of a sphere with two points on its surface)
a straight line through a circle's centre joining opposite edges

ex.en: The round cake measures thirty centimetres in diameter.
ex.zh: 這個圓蛋糕的直徑是三十釐米。

ex.en: Engineers must calculate the diameter of water pipes carefully to ensure an adequate supply to growing cities.
ex.zh: 工程師必須仔細計算水管直徑，以確保不斷擴張的城市有充足的供水。

words.tip: 直徑是diameter，半徑是radius；尺寸後常接in diameter。

tr: n. 前任, 先輩, 前身
[醫] 初牙, 前輩, 祖先
def: n. one who precedes you in time (as in holding a position or office)
Someone who held a particular position before another person.
Something that existed before and was replaced by something similar.

ex.en: My predecessor left some helpful notes in the desk.
ex.zh: 我的前任在桌子裡留下了一些有用的筆記。

ex.en: The new transport system uses less energy than its predecessor while carrying substantially more passengers.
ex.zh: 新的交通系統比其前身能耗更低，同時運載的乘客大幅增加。

col: a predecessor in office｜職位上的前任
words.tip: 指某職位的前任或事物的前身，不泛指所有前輩。

tr: vt. 引誘, 招致, 歸納出, 感應
def: v. cause to arise
v. cause to do; cause to act in a specified manner
v. cause to occur rapidly

tr: n. 少年, 少年讀物
a. 少年的, 不成熟的, 適於少年的
def: n. a young person, not fully developed
a. of or relating to or characteristic of or appropriate for children or young people

tr: n. 有相互關係的東西, 相關物
def: n. either of two or more related or complementary variables
v. to bear a reciprocal or mutual relation
v. bring into a mutual, complementary, or reciprocal relation

tr: n. 停止, 立定, 休息
vt. 使停止, 使立定
vi. 立定, 停止, 蹣跚, 躊躇, 有缺點
def: v. cause to stop
to stop moving or happening, or make something stop
a stop in movement, activity, or progress

ex.en: The bus halted suddenly when a sheep crossed.
ex.zh: 一隻羊橫穿道路時，公交車突然停了下來。

ex.en: Urgent international cooperation is needed to halt the destruction of habitats and protect species at risk of extinction.
ex.zh: 迫切需要開展國際合作，以阻止棲息地遭到破壞，並保護面臨滅絕風險的物種。

words.tip: 比stop正式；come to a halt表示停下來。

tr: vt. 拷問, 曲解, 折磨, 使彎曲
def: n. unbearable physical pain

n. the deliberate, systematic, or wanton infliction of physical or mental suffering by one or more persons in an attempt to force another person to yield information or to make a confession or for any other reason
v. subject to torture

ex.en: Waiting all afternoon for the results was pure torture.
ex.zh: 整個下午都在等結果，真是煎熬。

ex.en: International agreements prohibit torture and require governments to protect the basic rights of all prisoners.
ex.zh: 國際協議禁止酷刑，並要求各國政府保護所有囚犯的基本權利。

col: subject someone to torture｜使某人遭受酷刑
words.tip: 語氣很強；日常可誇張表達煎熬，不只是普通不適。

tr: n. 放逐, 流放, 被放逐者
vt. 放逐, 流放, 使背井離鄉
def: n. a person who is voluntarily absent from home or country
n. a person who is expelled from home or country by authority
n. the act of expelling a person from their native land

ex.en: After years in exile, she finally returned home.
ex.zh: 流亡多年後，她終於回到了家鄉。

ex.en: Many writers living in exile use literature to preserve cultural traditions and describe their experiences of displacement.
ex.zh: 許多流亡作家通過文學保存文化傳統，並講述他們流離失所的經歷。

col: force someone into exile｜迫使某人流亡
words.tip: in exile表示處於流亡狀態，通常不加冠詞。

tr: n. 吼, 咆哮, 轟鳴
vi. 吼, 大聲說出, 叫喊, 喧鬧
def: n. the sound made by a lion
v. make a loud noise, as of wind, water, or vehicles
v. act or proceed in a riotous, turbulent, or disorderly way

ex.en: The lion roared, and its cubs huddled closer together.
ex.zh: 獅子吼了一聲，幼獅們擠得更緊了。

ex.en: Aircraft engines roar above nearby homes, exposing residents to noise pollution that can affect sleep quality.
ex.zh: 飛機發動機在附近住宅上空轟鳴，使居民遭受可能影響睡眠質量的噪聲汙染。

col: a roar of applause｜雷鳴般的掌聲
the roar of an engine｜發動機的轟鳴聲
words.tip: 既可指獅子吼叫，也可指引擎轟鳴或人群歡呼。

tr: n. 連環漫畫, 喜劇演員, 滑稽的人
a. 滑稽的, 有趣的, 喜劇的
def: a. of or relating to or characteristic of comedy
funny or connected with comedy
a publication telling stories through sequences of pictures

ex.en: His comic dance had everyone laughing at the party.
ex.zh: 他那滑稽的舞蹈逗得聚會上的每個人都笑了。

ex.en: Comic characters can make educational programmes more engaging and help children remember important information.
ex.zh: 滑稽的角色可以讓教育節目更有吸引力，幫助兒童記住重要信息。

words.tip: comic可指喜劇相關；comical側重滑稽可笑。

tr: vt. 使甦醒, 使復興, 使振奮, 回想起, 重播
vi. 甦醒, 復活, 復興, 恢復精神
def: v. be brought back to life, consciousness, or strength
v. restore from a depressed, inactive, or unused state
to become active or popular again, or make something so

ex.en: Our neighbours hope to revive the annual street party.
ex.zh: 我們的鄰居希望恢復一年一度的街頭聚會。

ex.en: Investment in public transport could revive declining town centres by making local businesses more accessible.
ex.zh: 投資公共交通可以讓人們更方便地光顧當地商家，從而振興衰落的城鎮中心。

col: revive interest in｜重新激起對……的興趣
words.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：revive a tradition；hopes revive。

tr: n. 報仇, 復仇, 報復
def: v. take revenge for a perceived wrong

tr: a. 完全跟據經驗的, 經驗主義的
def: a. derived from experiment and observation rather than theory
based on observation or experiments rather than theory alone

ex.en: Our garden trial provided empirical evidence that compost helps plants.
ex.zh: 我們的花園試驗提供了堆肥有益植物的實證依據。

ex.en: Education policies should be supported by empirical research rather than assumptions about how children learn.
ex.zh: 教育政策應以實證研究為依據，而不是依賴對兒童學習方式的假設。

words.tip: 強調觀察或實驗依據，不等於個人經驗之談。

tr: vt. 創始, 發明, 發起
vi. 發源, 發生, 起航
def: v. come into existence; take on form or shape
v. bring into being
v. begin a trip at a certain point, as of a plane, train, bus, etc.

ex.en: This recipe originated in a small coastal village.
ex.zh: 這道菜的做法起源於一個沿海小村莊。

ex.en: Many environmental problems originate from patterns of consumption rather than a lack of available technology.
ex.zh: 許多環境問題源於消費模式，而非缺乏可用技術。

words.tip: 表示起源常接in或from；不要誤當作航行出發。

def: n. qualities that attract by seeming to promise some kind of reward
To attract someone by offering something appealing, sometimes deceptively.
An attraction or object used to draw someone or something closer.

ex.en: We used some cheese to lure the mouse outside.
ex.zh: 我們用一些奶酪把老鼠引到了外面。

ex.en: Large cities often lure young graduates with higher salaries, leaving rural communities with a shortage of skilled workers.
ex.zh: 大城市常以較高薪資吸引年輕畢業生，導致鄉村社區缺乏技術人才。

col: lure someone into doing something｜誘使某人做某事
the lure of wealth｜財富的誘惑
words.tip: 常用lure sb into doing，往往暗含誘騙意味。

tr: vt. 編譯, 編輯, 編纂, 收集
def: v. use a computer program to translate source code written in a particular programming language into computer-readable machine code that can be executed
Collect information from different sources and arrange it together.
Convert computer code into a form a computer can run.

ex.en: We compiled a playlist for our long train journey.
ex.zh: 我們為漫長的火車旅程整理了一份播放列表。

ex.en: Researchers compiled data from several hospitals to examine the relationship between air pollution and childhood asthma.
ex.zh: 研究人員彙總了多家醫院的數據，以研究空氣汙染與兒童哮喘之間的關係。

words.tip: 強調從不同來源收集並整理，不只是寫作。

tr: n. 織布機, 若隱若現的景象
vi. 朦朧地出現, 隱約可見, 可怕地出現
def: n. a textile machine for weaving yarn into a textile
v. come into view indistinctly, often threateningly
v. appear very large or occupy a commanding position

ex.en: A huge ship loomed out of the morning fog.
ex.zh: 一艘巨輪從晨霧中隱約顯現。

ex.en: As water shortages loom, governments must invest in efficient irrigation and encourage households to reduce unnecessary consumption.
ex.zh: 隨著缺水危機逼近，政府必須投資高效灌溉，並鼓勵家庭減少不必要的用水。

col: loom large｜顯得突出而令人擔憂
words.tip: 動詞常帶壓迫或擔憂感；loom large指問題突出。

tr: n. 著名人士, 值得注意之事物
a. 值得注意的, 顯著的
def: n a celebrity who is an inspiration to others
s worthy of notice
s widely known and esteemed

ex.en: Her balcony is notable for its bright yellow flowers.
ex.zh: 她家的陽臺因鮮豔的黃色花朵而引人注目。

ex.en: The city has achieved a notable reduction in air pollution since introducing stricter vehicle standards.
ex.zh: 自實施更嚴格的車輛標準以來，該市的空氣汙染已顯著減少。

col: a notable exception｜值得注意的例外
words.tip: notable for表示因……而出名或引人注意。

tr: n. 手杖, 細長的莖, 藤條
vt. 以杖擊, 以藤編制
def: n. a stick that people can lean on to help them walk
n. a strong slender often flexible stem as of bamboos, reeds, rattans, or sugar cane
n. a stiff switch used to hit students as punishment

ex.en: My grandfather uses a cane on uneven paths.
ex.zh: 爺爺在不平坦的小路上走路時會用手杖。

ex.en: Growing cane for sugar can provide rural employment but requires substantial water resources.
ex.zh: 種植甘蔗製糖可以為農村提供就業機會，但需要大量水資源。

col: walk with a cane｜拄著手杖走路
words.tip: 作“手杖”可數；作“藤材”或“甘蔗”通常不可數。

tr: vt. 打製, 鍛造, 偽造
def: n. furnace consisting of a special hearth where metal is heated before shaping
n. a workplace where metal is worked by heating and hammering
v. create by hammering

tr: a. 分裂的, 中斷的
vt. 使分裂, 使瓦解
def: v. throw into disorder
Prevent an activity or system from continuing normally.

ex.en: Heavy snow could disrupt our train journey tomorrow.
ex.zh: 大雪可能會影響我們明天的火車行程。

ex.en: Frequent power cuts disrupt online learning, particularly in rural communities where reliable internet access is already limited.
ex.zh: 頻繁停電擾亂了在線學習，在本就缺乏可靠網絡的農村社區尤其如此。

words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接活動或系統；不是形容詞。

tr: a. 令人想望的, 可取的
def: a. worth having or seeking or achieving
s. worthy of being chosen especially as a spouse
Worth having or doing because it offers benefits.

ex.en: A balcony makes this small flat much more desirable.
ex.zh: 陽臺讓這套小公寓更令人嚮往。

ex.en: Although economic growth is desirable, governments should also consider its effects on public health and the environment.
ex.zh: 雖然經濟增長值得追求，但政府也應考慮其對公眾健康和環境的影響。

words.tip: desirable指值得擁有；desirous指渴望的。

tr: vt. 宣稱, 主張, 提出, 斷言
[法] 斷言, 指稱, 指證
def: v. report or maintain

tr: a. 顯著的, 特別好的
def: n. long strip of cloth or paper used for decoration or advertising
s. unusually good; outstanding
a long piece of cloth displaying a message or design

ex.en: We hung a colourful banner above the garden gate.
ex.zh: 我們在花園大門上方掛了一條彩色橫幅。

ex.en: Many news websites rely on banner advertising to provide free access to their articles.
ex.zh: 許多新聞網站依靠橫幅廣告收入向讀者免費提供文章。

words.tip: 網頁上的橫幅廣告常稱banner ad。

tr: n. 上升, 造反, 叛亂
a. 上升的, 高漲的, 新興的
def: a. advancing or becoming higher or greater in degree or value or status
s. newly come into prominence

tr: vt. 限制, 使不外出, 禁閉
n. 邊緣, 範圍, 區域
def: v. prevent from leaving or from being removed
v. deprive of freedom; take into confinement
To keep something within particular limits

ex.en: Please confine your muddy boots to the porch.
ex.zh: 請把沾滿泥的靴子放在門廊裡，別帶進屋。

ex.en: Researchers should not confine their investigation to wealthy neighbourhoods when studying access to public transport.
ex.zh: 研究公共交通的可及性時，研究人員不應將調查侷限於富裕社區。

col: confine something to｜將某事物限制在
be confined to bed｜臥床不起
confine oneself to｜使自己侷限於
words.tip: 常用confine A to B，表示將A限制在B內。

tr: a. 正統的, 傳統的, 慣常的
def: a. of or pertaining to or characteristic of Judaism
a. adhering to what is commonly accepted
a. of or relating to or characteristic of the Eastern Orthodox Church

ex.en: We visited an Orthodox church with beautiful painted icons.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了一座裝飾著精美聖像畫的東正教教堂。

ex.en: Preserving Orthodox churches can protect architectural heritage while helping visitors understand the religious traditions of local communities.
ex.zh: 保護東正教教堂既能保存建築遺產，也能幫助遊客瞭解當地社區的宗教傳統。

words.tip: 大寫常指宗教派別；小寫orthodox可指正統的、傳統的。

def: n. a sudden violent spontaneous occurrence (usually of some undesirable condition)
The sudden start of a disease or other harmful event.

ex.en: The flu outbreak kept several children home from school.
ex.zh: 流感爆發讓幾個孩子待在家裡，未能上學。

ex.en: Rapid access to reliable health information can help communities respond effectively to an outbreak of infectious disease.
ex.zh: 及時獲取可靠的健康信息有助於社區有效應對傳染病暴發。

col: the outbreak of war｜戰爭爆發
words.tip: 名詞outbreak寫成一詞；動詞用break out。

tr: n. 管絃樂隊, 樂隊演奏處
def: n. a musical organization consisting of a group of instrumentalists including string players
n. seating on the main floor in a theater
A large group of musicians playing different instruments together.

ex.en: The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
ex.zh: 燈光暗下來時，管絃樂隊開始演奏。

ex.en: Public funding helps the local orchestra offer affordable concerts and introduce classical music to younger audiences.
ex.zh: 公共資助幫助當地管絃樂隊舉辦票價親民的音樂會，並向年輕觀眾介紹古典音樂。

col: conduct an orchestra｜指揮管絃樂隊
play in an orchestra｜在管絃樂隊演奏
words.tip: 指整個樂隊；成員通常演奏絃樂、管樂及打擊樂器。

tr: a. 冷酷的, 堅強的, 殘忍的, 可怕的, 討厭的
def: s. not to be placated or appeased or moved by entreaty
very serious and giving little reason for hope
looking very serious, worried, or determined

ex.en: The flood left a grim scene outside our house.
ex.zh: 洪水過後，我們屋外一片慘淡。

ex.en: Without urgent investment in water infrastructure, the outlook for communities facing prolonged drought remains grim.
ex.zh: 如果不緊急投資供水基礎設施，長期受乾旱影響的社區前景仍然嚴峻。

col: a grim reminder｜令人警醒的提醒
words.tip: 常形容前景、現實或表情，強調沉重而非普通的不悅。

def: n. a small ball with a hole through the middle
v. form into beads, as of water or sweat, for example
v. decorate by sewing beads onto

ex.en: She threaded a blue bead onto the silver wire.
ex.zh: 她把一顆藍色珠子穿到銀色金屬線上。

ex.en: Traditional bead jewellery can provide income for local craftspeople while preserving skills passed down through generations.
ex.zh: 傳統珠飾既能為當地手藝人帶來收入，也能保留代代相傳的技藝。

col: a bead of sweat｜一滴汗珠
words.tip: 液滴義常用a bead of sweat，指一滴汗。

def: n. a shortage of rainfall
n. a prolonged shortage
A long period with little or no rain.

ex.en: The river dried up during the long drought.
ex.zh: 在那場持續很久的乾旱中，河流乾涸了。

ex.en: Prolonged drought can reduce agricultural yields and force rural communities to depend on imported food.
ex.zh: 長期乾旱會降低農業產量，迫使農村社區依賴進口糧食。

words.tip: 讀音押韻於out；不要與draught混淆。

tr: vt. 支撐, 贊成, 鼓勵, 舉起, 堅持
[法] 確認, 贊成, 支持
def: v. stand up for; stick up for; of causes, principles, or ideals
v. support against an opponent
To support and maintain a principle, right, or standard

ex.en: Our coach always tries to uphold fair play.
ex.zh: 我們的教練總是努力維護公平競賽的原則。

ex.en: Independent courts help uphold citizens' rights by ensuring that public authorities act within the law.
ex.zh: 獨立的法院通過確保公共機構依法行事，幫助維護公民權利。

words.tip: 過去式、過去分詞均為upheld；常接權利或裁決。

tr: a. 危險的, 冒險的, 碰運氣的
[法] 危險的, 冒險的, 碰運氣的
def: s. involving risk or danger

tr: n. 證實, 證明, 批准, 確認
def: n. additional proof that something that was believed (some fact or hypothesis or theory) is correct
n. information that confirms or verifies
n. a ceremony held in the synagogue (usually at Pentecost) to admit as adult members of the Jewish community young men and women who have successfully completed a course of study in Judaism

ex.en: The hotel sent confirmation of our booking this morning.
ex.zh: 酒店今天早上發來了我們的預訂確認通知。

ex.en: Independent confirmation of research findings is essential before governments use them to guide public health policy.
ex.zh: 政府利用研究結果指導公共衛生政策之前，必須先對這些結果進行獨立驗證。

words.tip: 常用confirmation of sth；確認某事屬實可接that從句。

tr: vt. 使合併, 使消失, 吞沒
vi. 合併, 漸漸消失
def: v become one
v mix together different elements
v join or combine

ex.en: The two narrow paths merge just beyond the bridge.
ex.zh: 這兩條小路在橋的那一頭匯合。

ex.en: Small businesses may merge to reduce operating costs and compete more effectively with larger companies.
ex.zh: 小企業可能通過合併降低運營成本，從而更有效地與大公司競爭。

col: merge with another company｜與另一家公司合併
merge two departments｜合併兩個部門
words.tip: merge with表示與……合併；merge into表示併入。

tr: n. 軸, 箭桿, 矛, 礦井
def: n. a line that forms the length of an arrow pointer
n. a long rod or pole (especially the handle of an implement or the body of a weapon like a spear or arrow)
n. a vertical passageway through a building (as for an elevator)

ex.en: The lift stopped halfway up the narrow shaft.
ex.zh: 電梯在狹窄井道的中途停了下來。

ex.en: Engineers installed a ventilation shaft to improve air quality throughout the underground transport station.
ex.zh: 工程師安裝了通風井，以改善整個地下交通站點的空氣質量。

col: a shaft of sunlight｜一束陽光
words.tip: 井道用shaft；英式lift shaft對應美式elevator shaft。

tr: n. 磨, 碾, 苦差, 摩擦聲, 用功的學生
vt. 磨擦, 磨碎, 磨光, 折磨, 壓榨
vi. 磨, 磨碎, 苦幹
def: n. the grade of particle fineness to which a substance is ground
n. the act of grinding to a powder or dust
v. dance by rotating the pelvis in an erotically suggestive way, often while in contact with one's partner such that the dancers' legs are interlaced

tr: v. 規定, 指定, 囑咐, 開處方
def: v issue commands or orders for
officially recommend a medicine or treatment as a medical professional
state officially what must be done or how

ex.en: The doctor prescribed eye drops for my sore eyes.
ex.zh: 醫生給我開了眼藥水，治療眼睛疼痛。

ex.en: Doctors should prescribe antibiotics only when necessary to reduce the risk of bacteria developing resistance.
ex.zh: 醫生應僅在必要時開抗生素，以降低細菌產生耐藥性的風險。

words.tip: prescribe是開藥；describe是描述，注意區分。

tr: n. 登記, 掛號, 註冊
[計] 登記; 定位; 對齊; 記錄
def: n. the act of enrolling
n. the body of people (such as students) who register or enroll at the same time
n. a document certifying an act of registering

ex.en: Registration for the swimming course opens on Monday.
ex.zh: 游泳課程將於週一開始報名。

ex.en: Online registration can improve access to public services, provided that support remains available for people without internet access.
ex.zh: 網上登記可以讓公共服務更易獲取，前提是仍為無法上網的人提供幫助。

words.tip: 表示報名或註冊某活動，常用registration for。

tr: n. 禮貌, 謙恭, 好意
[法] 優待, 禮貌, 恩惠
def: n. a courteous or respectful or considerate act
n. a courteous or respectful or considerate remark
n. a courteous manner

ex.en: She treated every guest with courtesy, even when tired.
ex.zh: 即使很累，她也對每位客人彬彬有禮。

ex.en: Showing courtesy towards fellow passengers can make public transport more pleasant and accessible for everyone.
ex.zh: 禮貌對待其他乘客能讓公共交通更加舒適，也更方便所有人使用。

words.tip: courtesy of表示承蒙某方提供或允許使用。

tr: a. 生動的, 輪廓分明的, 繪畫似的, 圖解的
def: n. an image that is generated by a computer
s. written or drawn or engraved
s. describing nudity or sexual activity in graphic detail

ex.en: My cousin studies graphic design and makes colourful posters.
ex.zh: 我表姐學習平面設計，還製作色彩鮮豔的海報。

ex.en: Effective graphic design can make complex health information easier for the general public to understand.
ex.zh: 有效的平面設計可以讓公眾更容易理解複雜的健康信息。

col: a graphic description｜生動詳盡的描述
words.tip: graphic description常指令人不適的詳細描述。

tr: vt. 使移居, 移植, 使遷移
def: n. an operation moving an organ from one organism (the donor) to another (the recipient)
n. the act of removing something from one location and introducing it in another location
v. lift and reset in another soil or situation

ex.en: We transplant the seedlings once their roots are strong.
ex.zh: 等幼苗的根長壯了，我們就進行移栽。

ex.en: Advances in medicine have made it possible to transplant organs successfully and improve patients' quality of life.
ex.zh: 醫學進步使成功移植器官成為可能，並改善了患者的生活質量。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後，名詞重音在前；既可指器官也可指植物。

tr: a. 易爆發的, 爆炸的, 暴躁的
def: n. a chemical substance that undergoes a rapid chemical change (with the production of gas) on being heated or struck
a. serving to explode or characterized by explosion or sudden outburst
s. liable to lead to sudden change or violence

ex.en: These explosive materials must be kept away from heat.
ex.zh: 這些易爆材料必須遠離熱源存放。

ex.en: The explosive growth of online shopping has increased demand for delivery services and created new challenges for urban planners.
ex.zh: 網絡購物的爆發式增長增加了對配送服務的需求，也給城市規劃者帶來了新的挑戰。

words.tip: explosive growth形容激增，並非真正發生爆炸。

tr: vt. 照明, 用燈裝飾, 闡明, 說明, 使燦爛
vi. 照亮, 用燈裝飾
def: v. add embellishments and paintings to (medieval manuscripts)
To shine light on something so it becomes visible
To make a subject or problem easier to understand

ex.en: Small lamps illuminate the garden path after sunset.
ex.zh: 日落後，小燈照亮了花園裡的小徑。

ex.en: Comparing different education systems can illuminate the factors that influence student achievement across diverse social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 比較不同的教育體系，可以闡明影響不同社會背景學生學業表現的因素。

words.tip: 既可指用光照亮，也可指用解釋或證據闡明。

tr: vt. 穿透, 刺穿, 滲透, 看穿, 洞察, 瞭解, 使充溢
vi. 刺入, 看穿, 滲透, 打進
def: v. pass into or through, often by overcoming resistance
v. come to understand
v. make one's way deeper into or through

tr: n. 缺點, 裂紋, 瑕疵, 一陣狂風
[化] 劃痕; 裂縫; 裂紋
def: n. defect or weakness in a person's character
n. an imperfection in a plan or theory or legal document that causes it to fail or that reduces its effectiveness
v. add a flaw or blemish to; make imperfect or defective

ex.en: I noticed a tiny flaw in the glass bowl.
ex.zh: 我發現玻璃碗上有一處小瑕疵。

ex.en: A major flaw in the research design makes its conclusions about student performance less reliable.
ex.zh: 研究設計中的一項重大缺陷降低了其關於學生表現的結論的可靠性。

col: a flaw in the argument｜論證中的漏洞
words.tip: 可數名詞；某物的缺陷常用a flaw in sth。

tr: n. 香檳酒, 香檳酒色
def: n. a white sparkling wine either produced in Champagne or resembling that produced there
n. a region of northeastern France

tr: n. 樂觀主義, 樂觀, 樂天
def: n. the optimistic feeling that all is going to turn out well
n. a general disposition to expect the best in all things
The belief that good things will happen.

ex.en: Her optimism helped us stay cheerful during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間，她的樂觀讓我們保持了好心情。

ex.en: Despite economic uncertainty, many graduates express optimism about their chances of finding meaningful employment.
ex.zh: 儘管經濟形勢不明朗，許多畢業生仍對找到有意義的工作持樂觀態度。

col: optimism about the future｜對未來的樂觀態度
words.tip: 不可數名詞；對某事樂觀常用optimism about。

tr: n. 姿勢, 態度, 情形, 形勢
def: n the arrangement of the body and its limbs
n characteristic way of bearing one's body
n a rationalized mental attitude

ex.en: Adjusting your chair can improve your posture while working.
ex.zh: 調整椅子能改善你工作時的坐姿。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how good posture and regular movement can reduce discomfort during prolonged study.
ex.zh: 學校應教導兒童，良好姿勢和定時活動如何減輕長時間學習帶來的不適。

col: adopt a defensive posture｜採取防禦姿態
words.tip: 名詞常指體態；動詞常含“裝樣子”的貶義。

tr: vt. 使...安心, 向...再保證
[法] 重新保證, 再保險, 使清除疑慮
def: v. cause to feel sure; give reassurance to
v. give or restore confidence in; cause to feel sure or certain

tr: n. 預演, 排演, 練習, 敘述, 複述
[法] 詳述, 列舉事實, 複述
def: n. a practice session in preparation for a public performance (as of a play or speech or concert)
n. (psychology) a form of practice; repetition of information (silently or aloud) in order to keep it in short-term memory
A practice session before a performance or important event.

ex.en: Our final rehearsal finished just before the audience arrived.
ex.zh: 我們的最後一次排練在觀眾到來前剛剛結束。

ex.en: Regular rehearsal helps students develop confidence and teamwork skills before they perform in front of an audience.
ex.zh: 定期排練有助於學生在登臺表演前培養信心和團隊合作能力。

words.tip: 一次排練可數；in rehearsal表示正在排練。

def: n. anything that is cast aside or discarded
n. (cards) the act of throwing out a useless card or of failing to follow suit
n. getting rid something that is regarded as useless or undesirable

tr: a. 預期的, 將來的
def: a. of or concerned with or related to the future
Likely or hoping to become something in the future.

ex.en: The agent showed three prospective buyers around our flat.
ex.zh: 房產中介帶三位潛在買家參觀了我們的公寓。

ex.en: Universities should provide prospective students with clear information about tuition fees, course content, and career opportunities.
ex.zh: 大學應向有意入學的學生提供關於學費、課程內容及就業機會的清晰信息。

words.tip: 常放名詞前；勿與perspective“視角”混淆。

tr: n. 豐富, 充足, 大量
def: n. the property of a more than adequate quantity or supply
n. (physics) the ratio of the number of atoms of a specific isotope of an element to the total number of isotopes present
n. (chemistry) the ratio of the total mass of an element in the earth's crust to the total mass of the earth's crust; expressed as a percentage or in parts per million

ex.en: Our garden produces an abundance of tomatoes every summer.
ex.zh: 我們的花園每年夏天都結出大量番茄。

ex.en: An abundance of natural resources does not necessarily guarantee sustainable economic growth or improved living standards.
ex.zh: 豐富的自然資源並不一定能保證可持續的經濟增長或生活水平的提高。

col: an abundance of wildlife｜豐富的野生動物
words.tip: 常用an abundance of＋名詞，或in abundance。

tr: n. 持續時間, 持續
def: n. the period of time during which something continues
n. the property of enduring or continuing in time
n. continuance in time
n. a state in which all hope is lost or absent
n. the feeling that everything is wrong and nothing will turn out well
v. abandon hope; give up hope; lose heart

ex.en: He felt deep despair when his final application was rejected.
ex.zh: 最後一份申請被拒後，他感到深深的絕望。

ex.en: Long periods of unemployment can lead to despair, highlighting the importance of accessible career advice and emotional support.
ex.zh: 長期失業可能讓人陷入絕望，這凸顯了提供便利的職業諮詢和情感支持的重要性。

col: despair of doing something｜對做成某事不抱希望
words.tip: 名詞通常不可數；動詞常接of，不接直接賓語。

tr: n. 建議, 命題, 主張
vt. 向...提議, 向...提出猥褻的要求
def: n. (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false
n. an offer for a private bargain (especially a request for sexual favors)
n. a task to be dealt with

ex.en: Your proposition sounds sensible, but we need more time.
ex.zh: 你的提議聽起來很合理，但我們還需要些時間。

ex.en: The proposition that smaller classes always improve learning outcomes requires careful evaluation across different educational contexts.
ex.zh: 小班教學總能改善學習效果這一主張，需要結合不同教育背景仔細評估。

col: an attractive proposition｜有吸引力的提議
support a proposition｜支持一項主張
words.tip: 作主張講可接 that 從句；提議常用 proposal。

tr: n. 隨從, 侍者, 出席者
a. 侍候的, 伴隨的, 出席的, 在場的
def: n. someone who waits on or tends to or attends to the needs of another
n. a person who is present and participates in a meeting
s. being present (at meeting or event etc.) "attendant members of the congreation"

ex.en: The flight attendant brought an extra blanket for my daughter.
ex.zh: 乘務員給我女兒又拿來了一條毯子。

ex.en: Cities must consider population growth and its attendant pressures when planning new public transport networks.
ex.zh: 城市在規劃新的公共交通網絡時，必須考慮人口增長及其帶來的壓力。

col: car park attendant｜停車場管理員
words.tip: attendant常指服務人員；參會者通常用attendee。

def: n. murder of a public figure by surprise attack
the deliberate murder of an important person, often for political reasons

ex.en: The museum guide explained how the assassination changed history.
ex.zh: 博物館講解員解釋了那次暗殺如何改變了歷史。

ex.en: The assassination of a political leader can trigger widespread instability and undermine public confidence in government.
ex.zh: 政治領導人遭暗殺可能引發廣泛動盪，並削弱公眾對政府的信心。

words.tip: 通常指針對重要人物、帶政治目的的謀殺。

def: n. manual (or mechanical) carrying or moving or delivering or working with something
n. the action of touching with the hands (or the skillful use of the hands) or by the use of mechanical means
The way someone deals with a situation, task, or person.

ex.en: Her calm handling of the complaint impressed everyone.
ex.zh: 她冷靜處理投訴的表現給大家留下了深刻印象。

ex.en: Effective handling of household waste requires cooperation between local authorities, recycling companies, and residents throughout the community.
ex.zh: 有效處理生活垃圾需要地方政府、回收企業和整個社區的居民共同合作。

words.tip: 表示處理方式時，常用handling of加所處理的事物。

tr: a. 地理(學)的, 地區(性)的
def: a. of or relating to the science of geography
a. determined by geography

tr: [化] 透明度; 透明性; 清晰性
def: n. free from obscurity and easy to understand; the comprehensibility of clear expression
The quality of being clear and easy to understand.
The quality of being easy to see or hear through.

ex.en: I appreciate the clarity of your instructions for this game.
ex.zh: 你把這個遊戲的玩法說明得很清楚，我很喜歡。

ex.en: Greater clarity in public health advice can help people make informed decisions about their daily habits.
ex.zh: 更清晰的公共衛生建議能幫助人們在日常習慣方面作出明智決定。

words.tip: 不可數名詞；clarify是動詞，意為澄清。

tr: [法] 矛盾, 否認, 反駁
def: n. opposition between two conflicting forces or ideas
n. (logic) a statement that is necessarily false
n. the speech act of contradicting someone

ex.en: I noticed a contradiction between his two explanations.
ex.zh: 我注意到他的兩次解釋互相矛盾。

ex.en: There is a clear contradiction between promoting sustainable transport and reducing investment in local bus services.
ex.zh: 提倡可持續交通與減少對當地公交服務的投資之間存在明顯矛盾。

col: a contradiction in terms｜用語上的自相矛盾
words.tip: 常用a contradiction between A and B。

tr: n. 碎片, 粉碎, 落葉, 噴灑
vt. 打碎, 使散開, 粉碎, 破壞
vi. 粉碎, 損壞, 脫落
def: v. break into many pieces
v. damage or destroy
v. cause to break into many pieces

tr: n. 降落, 家系, 侵襲, 血統
[醫] 下降, 世代, 血統
def: n. a movement downward
n. the act of changing your location in a downward direction
n. the kinship relation between an individual and the individual's progenitors

ex.en: The plane began its descent as the coastline appeared.
ex.zh: 海岸線映入眼簾時，飛機開始下降。

ex.en: People of different ethnic descent contribute diverse skills and perspectives to their local communities.
ex.zh: 不同族裔背景的人為當地社區帶來多樣的技能和視角。

words.tip: descent是名詞；動詞用descend，勿混淆decent。

def: n. a sudden involuntary movement
v. to stimulate to action
v. move or jump suddenly, as if in surprise or alarm

ex.en: The sudden knock startled me while I was cooking.
ex.zh: 我做飯時，突然的敲門聲嚇了我一跳。

ex.en: Loud construction noises can startle nearby wildlife and disrupt their feeding patterns during the breeding season.
ex.zh: 繁殖季節，巨大的施工噪聲會驚嚇附近的野生動物，擾亂它們的覓食規律。

words.tip: 強調突然受驚，不等於長期感到害怕。

tr: a. 華麗的, 燦爛的
def: s. dazzlingly beautiful
Extremely beautiful or attractive.
Very pleasant or enjoyable.

ex.en: The garden looks gorgeous in the early morning sunshine.
ex.zh: 花園在清晨的陽光下顯得格外美麗。

ex.en: Although coastal destinations offer gorgeous scenery, uncontrolled tourism can damage the natural environments that attract visitors.
ex.zh: 雖然海濱旅遊地景色迷人，但不加控制的旅遊活動會破壞吸引遊客的自然環境。

words.tip: 語氣比beautiful強，多用於口語中的讚美。

tr: n. 誓約, 誓言, 許願
vi. 起誓, 發誓, 鄭重宣言
vt. 立誓, 起誓要, 鄭重地宣佈
def: n. a solemn pledge (to oneself or to another or to a deity) to do something or to behave in a certain manner
v. make a vow; promise
v. dedicate to a deity by a vow

ex.en: She made a vow to visit her grandmother weekly.
ex.zh: 她鄭重承諾每週都去看望祖母。

ex.en: Local leaders vowed to protect public parks despite growing pressure to develop more housing.
ex.zh: 儘管增加住房建設的壓力越來越大，當地領導人仍承諾保護公共公園。

col: vow to do something｜發誓做某事
words.tip: 動詞常用vow to do或vow that從句。

def: n. one of two divisions of an academic year
n. half a year; a period of 6 months
one of the two main periods of an academic year

ex.en: I'm taking a photography class at college this semester.
ex.zh: 這學期我在大學選修了一門攝影課。

ex.en: Offering work placements during the final semester can help university students move successfully into employment.
ex.zh: 在最後一個學期提供實習機會，有助於大學生順利就業。

words.tip: 通常指一學年兩學期中的一學期，不等於半年。

tr: n. 精密, 精確, 精確度, 精度
a. 精密的, 精確的
def: n the quality of being reproducible in amount or performance

tr: n. 切斷, 切下, 路塹
def: n. a part (sometimes a root or leaf or bud) removed from a plant to propagate a new plant through rooting or grafting
n. a piece cut off from the main part of something
n. the act of diluting something

ex.en: His cutting remark about her cooking spoiled the meal.
ex.zh: 他對她廚藝的尖刻評價破壞了用餐的氣氛。

ex.en: Cutting comments from teachers can discourage students from asking questions and participating actively in class.
ex.zh: 教師尖刻的評論可能使學生不敢提問，也不願積極參與課堂活動。

words.tip: 剪報在英式英語中叫cutting，美式常用clipping。

tr: n. 跌倒, 摔跤, 翻斤斗
vi. 翻倒, 摔倒, 倒塌, 滾動, 翻斤斗, 倉促地行動
vt. 使摔倒, 使滾翻, 弄亂
def: n. an acrobatic feat of rolling or turning end over end
v. fall down, as if collapsing
v. roll over and over, back and forth

tr: a. 精神病學的, 醫精神病的
def: a. relating to or used in or engaged in the practice of psychiatry
n. a pattern of regularly spaced horizontal and vertical lines
n. a perforated or corrugated metal plate used in a storage battery as a conductor and support for the active material
n. an electrode placed between the cathode and anode of a vacuum tube to control the flow of electrons through the tube

tr: vt. 使旋轉, 使轉動, 使輪流
def: v. exchange on a regular basis
v. perform a job or duty on a rotating basis
v. cause to turn on an axis or center

ex.en: Rotate the pot so each side gets some sunlight.
ex.zh: 轉動花盆，讓每一面都能曬到陽光。

ex.en: Some hospitals rotate staff between departments to broaden their experience and improve cooperation across medical teams.
ex.zh: 一些醫院讓員工在不同科室輪崗，以拓寬經驗並改善醫療團隊之間的合作。

words.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：rotate the wheel；the wheel rotates。

def: n. the capital and largest city of Greece; named after Athena (its patron goddess)
n. a town in southeast Ohio
n. a university town in northeast Georgia

tr: n. 照明燈, 反光燈, 聚光燈
def: n. a lamp that produces a strong beam of light to illuminate a restricted area; used to focus attention of a stage performer
v. illuminate with a spotlight, as in the theater
A lamp directing a strong beam onto a small area.

ex.en: A bright spotlight followed the dancer across the stage.
ex.zh: 一道明亮的聚光燈光束隨著舞者移動，照遍舞臺。

ex.en: Recent research has put urban air pollution in the spotlight, prompting calls for stricter vehicle regulations.
ex.zh: 近期研究使城市空氣汙染成為關注焦點，引發了加強車輛監管的呼聲。

col: in the spotlight｜處於公眾關注之下
put the spotlight on｜使成為關注焦點
turn the spotlight on｜將注意力轉向
words.tip: in the spotlight常比喻成為公眾關注的焦點。

tr: a. 華麗的, 高尚的, 宏偉的
def: s characterized by grandeur
Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive.
Exceptionally good or skilfully done.

ex.en: The balcony offers a magnificent view of snowy mountains.
ex.zh: 從陽臺可以欣賞到壯麗的雪山景色。

ex.en: Preserving magnificent historic buildings can strengthen local identity and attract visitors from other regions.
ex.zh: 保護宏偉的歷史建築能增強當地認同感，並吸引其他地區的遊客。

words.tip: 多形容景色、建築或成就，不表示品德高尚。

tr: n. 刮, 擦, 挖, 擦痕, 刮擦聲, 困境
vi. 刮掉, 擦掉, 刮出刺耳聲
vt. 刮, 擦, 擦傷, 挖成, 積蓄
def: n. a harsh noise made by scraping
n. a deep bow with the foot drawn backwards (indicating excessive humility)
v. scratch repeatedly

ex.en: I scraped the ice off the car window.
ex.zh: 我刮掉了車窗上的冰。

ex.en: Restoration workers carefully scrape away damaged paint to reveal the original surfaces of historic buildings.
ex.zh: 修復人員小心颳去破損的油漆，露出歷史建築原有的表面。

col: scrape through an exam｜勉強通過考試
words.tip: scrape off指刮掉；scrape through指勉強通過。

tr: a. 眼睛的, 視覺的, 光學的
[機] 光學上的, 光學的
def: a. of or relating to or involving light or optics
Relating to light or devices that use light.
Relating to sight or the way the eyes work.

ex.en: This optical illusion makes the flat drawing look three-dimensional.
ex.zh: 這種視錯覺讓平面的圖畫看起來像立體的。

ex.en: Optical fibres enable rapid data transmission, supporting the expansion of reliable internet access in remote communities.
ex.zh: 光纖能實現快速數據傳輸，幫助可靠的互聯網服務覆蓋偏遠社區。

words.tip: optical涉及光或視覺；optical illusion指視錯覺。

tr: n. 被掠食者, 犧牲者
def: n. a person who is the aim of an attack (especially a victim of ridicule or exploitation) by some hostile person or influence
n. animal hunted or caught for food
v. profit from in an exploitatory manner

ex.en: The owl watched its prey from a low branch.
ex.zh: 貓頭鷹從一根低矮的樹枝上注視著獵物。

ex.en: When natural prey becomes scarce, some predators move closer to farms in search of food.
ex.zh: 當天然獵物稀缺時，一些捕食者會靠近農場尋找食物。

col: prey on small animals｜捕食小動物
fall prey to fraud｜成為詐騙受害者
words.tip: 名詞通常不可數；動詞常用prey on；勿混pray。

tr: [計] 查帳; 審查; 檢查
def: n. a methodical examination or review of a condition or situation
v. examine carefully for accuracy with the intent of verification
v. attend academic courses without getting credit
n. a lump on the body caused by a blow
v. knock against with force or violence
v. dance erotically or dance with the pelvis thrust forward

tr: a. 奇特的, 罕見的, 特殊的, 特別的
n. 特有財產, 特權
def: s. markedly different from the usual
s. characteristic of one only; distinctive or special
strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way

ex.en: A peculiar smell came from the cupboard under the stairs.
ex.zh: 樓梯下的櫃子裡飄出一股怪味。

ex.en: Some environmental challenges are peculiar to coastal cities, including saltwater intrusion and damage caused by storm surges.
ex.zh: 一些環境挑戰是沿海城市特有的，包括海水入侵和風暴潮造成的破壞。

words.tip: peculiar to表示“……特有的”，不是“奇怪”。

tr: adv. 即, 就是, 換句話說
def: r. as follows

tr: n. 養育, 營養物, 培育
vt. 養育, 供給營養物, 教養
def: n the properties acquired as a consequence of the way you were treated as a child
n helping someone grow up to be an accepted member of the community
v help develop, help grow

tr: a. 狂怒的, 激烈的, 吵鬧的
def: s marked by extreme and violent energy
s marked by extreme anger
s (of the elements) as if showing violent anger

ex.en: Lena was furious when someone scratched her new bicycle.
ex.zh: 有人刮花了莉娜的新自行車，她氣壞了。

ex.en: Residents were furious about the sudden closure of a public park without any community consultation.
ex.zh: 一座公園未經任何社區協商就突然關閉，居民對此十分憤怒。

col: furious with someone｜對某人大發雷霆
furious about something｜因某事極其憤怒
words.tip: 對某人生氣用with，因某事生氣用about。

tr: adv. 無疑, 必定, 確實地
def: r. without doubt; certainly
Certainly true, with no reasonable doubt.

ex.en: This is undoubtedly the warmest coat I have ever owned.
ex.zh: 這無疑是我穿過的最暖和的外套。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water undoubtedly improves public health, particularly in communities with limited medical services.
ex.zh: 獲得清潔飲用水無疑能改善公共健康，尤其是在醫療服務有限的社區。

words.tip: 語氣很肯定；證據不足時宜用probably等弱化表達。

tr: vt. 省略, 刪除, 疏忽, 遺漏
def: v prevent from being included or considered or accepted
v leave undone or leave out
to leave something out, deliberately or accidentally

ex.en: You can omit the chilli if you prefer milder soup.
ex.zh: 如果喜歡清淡些的湯，可以不放辣椒。

ex.en: Reports that omit important evidence may give policymakers an inaccurate picture of the challenges facing local communities.
ex.zh: 遺漏重要證據的報告，可能使政策制定者誤判當地社區面臨的挑戰。

col: omit something from a report｜從報告中刪去某項內容
words.tip: 過去式omitted，進行式omitting，均雙寫t。

tr: n. 蜘蛛, 設圈套者
def: n. predatory arachnid with eight legs, two poison fangs, two feelers, and usually two silk-spinning organs at the back end of the body; they spin silk to make cocoons for eggs or traps for prey
n. a computer program that prowls the internet looking for publicly accessible resources that can be added to a database; the database can then be searched with a search engine
n. a skillet made of cast iron

ex.en: A tiny spider built a web beside our window.
ex.zh: 一隻小蜘蛛在我們窗邊結了網。

ex.en: Although many people fear spiders, these creatures help control insect populations in gardens and agricultural environments.
ex.zh: 雖然許多人害怕蜘蛛，但它們有助於控制花園和農業環境中的昆蟲數量。

words.tip: 蜘蛛有八條腿，不屬於六條腿的昆蟲。

tr: n. 困擾, 困擾人的情緒
def: n. an unhealthy and compulsive preoccupation with something or someone
n the dead body of a human being

tr: n. 確定, 確實的事情
[法] 確定, 肯定, 必然的事
必然發生的事；確定的事
def: n. the state of being certain
n. something that is certain
The state of being completely sure about something.

ex.en: I cannot say with certainty where I left my keys.
ex.zh: 我說不準把鑰匙放在哪裡了。

ex.en: Although climate models continue to improve, scientists cannot predict every regional change with absolute certainty.
ex.zh: 儘管氣候模型不斷改進，科學家仍無法完全確定地預測每一項區域變化。

col: a degree of certainty｜一定程度的把握
words.tip: 表確信通常不可數；a certainty指確定的事。

tr: n. 曲子, 美妙音樂, 曲調
def: n. the perception of pleasant arrangements of musical notes
A sequence of musical sounds forming a recognisable tune.

ex.en: She hummed a gentle melody while watering the plants.
ex.zh: 她一邊給植物澆水，一邊輕聲哼著曲子。

ex.en: A memorable melody can help children recall information, making music a useful tool in early education.
ex.zh: 容易記住的旋律能幫助兒童回憶信息，因此音樂是幼兒教育中的實用工具。

words.tip: melody指可哼唱的旋律；rhythm指節奏。

tr: adv. 完全地, 全然, 絕對
def: r completely and without qualification; used informally as intensifiers
completely, used to strongly emphasise a description

ex.en: I was utterly exhausted after carrying those heavy boxes.
ex.zh: 搬完那些沉重的箱子後，我累得筋疲力盡。

ex.en: Without reliable internet access, some rural students feel utterly excluded from opportunities offered by online education.
ex.zh: 由於缺乏可靠的網絡連接，一些農村學生覺得自己完全無法獲得在線教育提供的機會。

words.tip: 常修飾強烈或負面形容詞，如 impossible、ridiculous。

def: v. foster the growth of
v. prepare for crops
To prepare land for crops or grow plants

ex.en: My grandparents cultivate vegetables in a small garden behind their house.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母在屋後的小菜園裡種菜。

ex.en: Schools should cultivate curiosity by encouraging students to ask questions and explore different solutions to practical problems.
ex.zh: 學校應鼓勵學生提問並探索實際問題的不同解決方法，以培養好奇心。

col: cultivate an interest in｜培養對……的興趣
words.tip: 既可指種植作物，也可指有意識地培養興趣或關係。

tr: a. 奢侈的, 豪華的
def: n. something that is an indulgence rather than a necessity
n. wealth as evidenced by sumptuous living
Great comfort and pleasure involving expensive surroundings or possessions.

ex.en: The hotel offered a taste of luxury for one night.
ex.zh: 這家酒店讓我們體驗了一晚奢華享受。

ex.en: As household incomes rise, goods once considered a luxury often become part of everyday life.
ex.zh: 隨著家庭收入增加，曾被視為奢侈品的商品往往成為日常生活的一部分。

col: afford the luxury of｜有條件享受……
words.tip: 指奢華狀態時不可數；指一項享受時可數。

tr: n. 擴音器, 麥克風
def: n. device for converting sound waves into electrical energy
A device that captures sound for recording or making it louder.

ex.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear.
ex.zh: 請對著麥克風講話，讓大家都能聽見。

ex.en: Using a microphone during lectures can help students hear clearly, particularly in large classrooms with poor acoustics.
ex.zh: 講課時使用麥克風可以幫助學生聽清內容，尤其是在聲學條件較差的大教室裡。

col: speak into a microphone｜對著麥克風講話
words.tip: microphone收音；speaker播放聲音，勿混淆。

tr: n. 丟掉, 處理, 排列, 銷燬, 佈置
def: n. the power to use something or someone
n. the act or means of getting rid of something
n. a kitchen appliance for disposing of garbage

ex.en: The council provides bins for the disposal of batteries.
ex.zh: 市政部門提供專門的回收箱，用於處理廢舊電池。

ex.en: Safe waste disposal is essential for protecting groundwater and reducing health risks in densely populated areas.
ex.zh: 安全處置廢棄物對於保護地下水和降低人口密集地區的健康風險至關重要。

words.tip: at someone's disposal 表示供某人使用或支配。

def: n a field where grass or alfalfa are grown to be made into hay
a field of grass, often containing wildflowers

ex.en: We spread our picnic blanket in a sunny meadow.
ex.zh: 我們在陽光明媚的草地上鋪開了野餐毯。

ex.en: Protecting wildflower meadows helps maintain biodiversity by providing food and shelter for insects and birds.
ex.zh: 保護野花草地能為昆蟲和鳥類提供食物與棲息地，從而有助於維持生物多樣性。

words.tip: meadow多指鄉間草地，不是修剪整齊的lawn。

tr: vt. 藐視, 挑釁, 使落空
def: v. resist or confront with resistance
v. elude, especially in a baffling way
v. challenge
n. the act of extracting ores or coal etc from the earth
n. laying explosive mines in concealed places to destroy enemy personnel and equipment

tr: n. 碎片, 殘餘物, 些微, 片斷, 鐵屑, 吵架
vt. 扔棄, 敲碎, 拆毀
a. 零碎拼湊成的, 廢棄的
def: n. a small piece of something that is left over after the rest has been used
v. make into scrap or refuse

tr: n. 宣告, 說明, 宣佈
def: n. a statement that is emphatic and explicit (spoken or written)
n. (law) unsworn statement that can be admitted in evidence in a legal transaction
n. a statement of taxable goods or of dutiable properties

ex.en: Her declaration that she would quit surprised the whole family.
ex.zh: 她宣佈要辭職，讓全家都吃了一驚。

ex.en: The government's declaration of a climate emergency should be followed by clear policies and measurable environmental targets.
ex.zh: 政府宣佈進入氣候緊急狀態後，應制定明確的政策和可衡量的環境目標。

words.tip: declare是動詞；海關申報用customs declaration。

tr: vt. 注射, 注入, 使入軌
def: v. give an injection to
v. to introduce (a new aspect or element)
v. force or drive (a fluid or gas) into by piercing

ex.en: The nurse will inject the medicine into my arm.
ex.zh: 護士會把藥注射到我的手臂裡。

ex.en: Public investment can inject new energy into declining towns by supporting local businesses and improving transport.
ex.zh: 公共投資可以通過扶持當地企業和改善交通，為衰落的城鎮注入新活力。

col: inject new life into｜為……注入新生機
words.tip: 常用inject A into B：將A注入B。

def: n. a straight line through a body or figure that satisfies certain conditions
n. the main stem or central part about which plant organs or plant parts such as branches are arranged
n. in World War II the alliance of Germany and Italy in 1936 which later included Japan and other nations

ex.en: The globe spins smoothly around its tilted axis.
ex.zh: 這個地球儀繞著傾斜的軸平穩轉動。

ex.en: The horizontal axis represents time, while the vertical axis shows changes in average household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 橫座標軸表示時間，縱座標軸顯示家庭平均能源消耗的變化。

col: rotate on its axis｜繞自身軸線旋轉
words.tip: 複數是 axes /ˈæksiːz/，注意與 axe 的複數區分。

def: s. a grammatical number category referring to two items or units as opposed to one item (singular) or more than two items (plural)
Having two parts, purposes, or aspects.

ex.en: This sofa has a dual purpose: sitting and sleeping.
ex.zh: 這張沙發有兩種用途：坐著休息和睡覺。

ex.en: Many working parents face the dual challenge of earning an income and caring for young children.
ex.zh: 許多在職父母面臨著掙錢和照顧幼兒的雙重挑戰。

words.tip: dual 強調兩部分或雙重功能；勿與 duel（決鬥）混淆。

tr: v. 監督, 管理, 指導
def: v watch and direct
v keep tabs on; keep an eye on; keep under surveillance
watch and guide people to ensure work or activities go properly

ex.en: An adult must supervise the children near the pool.
ex.zh: 孩子們在泳池附近時，必須有成人照看。

ex.en: Experienced nurses should supervise new staff to ensure that patients receive safe and effective care.
ex.zh: 經驗豐富的護士應指導新員工，確保患者獲得安全有效的護理。

words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接人或活動：supervise staff。

tr: n. 盾, 防衛物, 保護者, 屏蔽
vt. 保護, 遮蔽, 屏蔽, 庇護, 擋開, 避開
def: n. a protective covering or structure
n. armor carried on the arm to intercept blows
v. protect, hide, or conceal from danger or harm

ex.en: The worker lowered a clear shield over her face.
ex.zh: 這名工人放下透明面罩，護住臉部。

ex.en: Urban trees can shield pedestrians from intense sunlight while reducing temperatures in densely populated neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 城市樹木能為行人遮擋強烈陽光，同時降低人口密集街區的溫度。

col: shield someone from harm｜保護某人免受傷害
words.tip: 動詞常用shield someone from something。

tr: n. 熱望, 志向, 渴望
[醫] 吸入; 吸[引], 吸引術
def: n. a will to succeed
n. a manner of articulation involving an audible release of breath
A strong hope or ambition to achieve something.

ex.en: Her greatest aspiration is to open a small bakery.
ex.zh: 她最大的願望是開一家小麵包店。

ex.en: Access to affordable higher education can help young people fulfil their aspirations, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 無論家庭收入如何，獲得負擔得起的高等教育都能幫助年輕人實現抱負。

words.tip: 抱負義常用複數；aspiration to do表示做某事的志向。

def: n. a white metallic element that burns with a brilliant light; the fifth most abundant element in the earth's crust; an important component of most plants and animals
A chemical element needed for strong bones and teeth

ex.en: This yoghurt provides calcium for healthy bones and teeth.
ex.zh: 這種酸奶提供有益於骨骼和牙齒健康的鈣。

ex.en: School meals should include adequate sources of calcium to support children's bone development during periods of rapid growth.
ex.zh: 學校膳食應包含充足的鈣來源，以支持兒童快速生長期的骨骼發育。

col: a source of calcium｜鈣的來源
words.tip: 不可數名詞；化學符號為Ca。

def: n. rock fragments and pebbles
v. cover with gravel
small stones used to cover paths or make concrete

ex.en: Gravel crunched beneath our shoes as we approached the cottage.
ex.zh: 我們走近小屋時，腳下的碎石發出嘎吱聲。

ex.en: Gravel paths can allow rainwater to drain into the soil, reducing surface runoff in urban parks.
ex.zh: 碎石小徑可以讓雨水滲入土壤，減少城市公園的地表逕流。

words.tip: 通常不可數；單顆小石子可用a pebble。

tr: n. 紡織品, 紡織業
def: a. of or relating to fabrics or fabric making
cloth made by weaving, knitting, or other fibre processing
relating to cloth or its production

ex.en: The market stall sells colourful textiles for making curtains.
ex.zh: 這個市場攤位出售用來做窗簾的彩色織物。

ex.en: The textile industry can reduce water pollution by adopting cleaner production methods and treating wastewater effectively.
ex.zh: 紡織業可以採用更清潔的生產方式並有效處理廢水，從而減少水汙染。

words.tip: 表示各類紡織品時常用複數textiles。

tr: a. 在先的, 在前的
def: n. an example that is used to justify similar occurrences at a later time
n. a subject mentioned earlier (preceding in time)
s. preceding in time, order, or significance

tr: a. 永恆的, 永遠的, 不滅的
def: s continuing forever or indefinitely
s tiresomely long; seemingly without end
Lasting forever, without an end.
