ex.en: The couple promised eternal love beneath the flowering tree.
ex.zh: 那對情侶在開花的樹下許下了永恆相愛的諾言。

ex.en: Many ancient cultures used monumental architecture to express hopes for eternal life and preserve collective memories.
ex.zh: 許多古代文化通過宏偉建築表達對永生的期盼，並保存集體記憶。

words.tip: eternal強調無終點；eternal complaints可誇張指抱怨不斷。

tr: n. 氏族, 宗族, 集團
def: n group of people related by blood or marriage

tr: a. 極廣大的, 無邊的, 非常好的
def: s unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
Extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: An immense ship blocked our view of the harbour.
ex.zh: 一艘巨輪擋住了我們望向港口的視線。

ex.en: The transition to renewable energy requires immense investment but can deliver substantial environmental and economic benefits.
ex.zh: 向可再生能源轉型需要鉅額投資，但能帶來顯著的環境和經濟效益。

words.tip: 既可形容體積巨大，也可形容壓力、潛力等程度極大。

tr: n. 單腳跳, 跳躍, 舞會, 飛行
vt. 躍過, 跳上, 加蛇麻子於, 服麻醉藥
def: n. the act of hopping; jumping upward or forward (especially on one foot)
n. twining perennials having cordate leaves and flowers arranged in conelike spikes; the dried flowers of this plant are used in brewing to add the characteristic bitter taste to beer
n. an informal dance where popular music is played

ex.en: The little bird hopped across the wet garden path.
ex.zh: 那隻小鳥蹦跳著穿過溼漉漉的花園小徑。

ex.en: Activities that encourage children to hop and balance can support physical development in early education.
ex.zh: 在早期教育中，鼓勵兒童單腳跳和平衡身體的活動有助於身體發育。

col: hop on a bus｜迅速上公交車
words.tip: 過去式hopped，進行式hopping，需雙寫p。

tr: a. 儀器的, 器具的, 可作為手段的
def: a. relating to or designed for or performed on musical instruments
playing an important part in making something happen
performed with musical instruments rather than voices

ex.en: Your advice was instrumental in helping me find work.
ex.zh: 你的建議對我找到工作起了重要作用。

ex.en: Investment in public transport has been instrumental in reducing traffic congestion in several major cities.
ex.zh: 對公共交通的投資在緩解多個大城市的交通擁堵方面起了重要作用。

col: be instrumental in｜在……中起重要作用
words.tip: 表示“起重要作用”時，用 be instrumental in doing。

tr: n. 外殼, 堅硬外皮, 麵包皮
def: n. the outer layer of the Earth
n. a hard outer layer that covers something
n. the trait of being rude and impertinent; inclined to take liberties

ex.en: This fresh bread has a wonderfully crisp crust.
ex.zh: 這條新鮮麵包的外皮特別酥脆。

ex.en: Movements within the Earth's crust can cause earthquakes that severely damage buildings and transport networks.
ex.zh: 地殼內部的運動可能引發地震，嚴重破壞建築物和交通網絡。

words.tip: 地殼用the Earth's crust；麵包皮也用crust。

tr: vi. 喘氣, 喘息, 渴望
def: n. a short labored intake of breath with the mouth open
breathe in suddenly or struggle to breathe
a sudden, short intake of breath

ex.en: We gasped as the whale rose beside our boat.
ex.zh: 鯨魚在船旁浮出水面時，我們驚得倒吸一口氣。

ex.en: Runners may gasp for breath when exercising at high altitudes, where less oxygen is available.
ex.zh: 跑步者在高海拔地區運動時可能會大口喘氣，因為那裡的氧氣較少。

col: let out a gasp｜發出一聲驚歎
words.tip: gasp強調突然吸氣；pant多指連續急促喘氣。

tr: n. 千禧年, 一千年
def: n. a span of 1000 years

n. (New Testament) in Revelations it is foretold that those faithful to Jesus will reign with Jesus over the earth for a thousand years; the meaning of these words have been much debated; some denominations (e.g. Jehovah's Witnesses) expect it to be a thousand years of justice and peace and happiness
n. the 1000th anniversary (or the celebration of it)

ex.en: This ancient tree has survived for over a millennium.
ex.zh: 這棵古樹已經存活了一千多年。

ex.en: Over the past millennium, advances in agriculture have transformed how societies produce food and support growing populations.
ex.zh: 在過去的一千年裡，農業進步改變了社會生產糧食和養活不斷增長的人口的方式。

col: the past millennium｜過去的一千年
the turn of the millennium｜千年之交
words.tip: 注意雙寫l和n；複數常用millennia。

tr: n. 看守者, 監護人, 保護人
def: n a person who cares for persons or property
Someone legally responsible for a child or an adult needing care.
A person or organization that protects something valuable.

ex.en: Her aunt became her legal guardian and cared for her.
ex.zh: 她的姨媽成為她的法定監護人，照顧她的生活。

ex.en: Schools should involve parents or guardians in decisions that significantly affect children's education and emotional wellbeing.
ex.zh: 學校應讓家長或監護人參與對兒童教育和心理健康有重大影響的決策。

col: parent or guardian｜家長或監護人
guardian of tradition｜傳統的守護者
words.tip: 法律語境中指監護人，不一定是孩子的父母。

def: v. send on a course or in a direction different from the planned or intended one
v. withdraw (money) and move into a different location, often secretly and with dishonest intentions

tr: a. 深思的, 體貼的
def: s. having intellectual depth
a. exhibiting or characterized by careful thought
s. acting with or showing thought and good sense

ex.en: It was thoughtful of you to bring an umbrella.
ex.zh: 你帶了傘來，真是考慮周到。

ex.en: Thoughtful urban planning can create public spaces that meet the needs of residents with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 周到的城市規劃能夠打造滿足行動不便居民需求的公共空間。

words.tip: 體貼用thoughtful of someone；thoughtful不一定表示憂慮。

tr: n. 壟斷, 專賣權, 獨佔事業
[經] 壟斷, 專利品, 壟斷(權)獨佔
def: n. (economics) a market in which there are many buyers but only one seller
n. exclusive control or possession of something
n. a board game in which players try to gain a monopoly on real estate as pieces advance around the board according to the throw of a die

ex.en: One company has a monopoly on our island's ferry services.
ex.zh: 一家公司壟斷了我們島上的渡輪服務。

ex.en: Without effective regulation, a monopoly can raise prices and leave consumers with few alternatives.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏有效監管，壟斷企業可能提高價格，讓消費者幾乎別無選擇。

col: have a monopoly on｜壟斷；獨佔
words.tip: 表示對某領域的壟斷，常用monopoly on。

tr: vt. 召喚, 召集, 號召, 振奮, 喚起, 鼓起
def: v. call in an official matter, such as to attend court
v. ask to come
To officially order someone to come or request their presence.

ex.en: The manager summoned everyone to her office after lunch.
ex.zh: 午飯後，經理把所有人召集到她的辦公室。

ex.en: Governments must summon the political will to address environmental problems despite opposition from powerful industries.
ex.zh: 儘管遭到強勢行業的反對，政府仍須拿出解決環境問題的政治決心。

col: summon someone to court｜傳喚某人出庭
words.tip: summon sb to某處；summon up courage指鼓起勇氣。

tr: v. 養育, 引起, 飼養, 繁殖
def: n. a special variety of domesticated animals within a species
n. a special type
v. copulate with a female, used especially of horses

ex.en: These birds usually breed here during the warmer months.
ex.zh: 這些鳥通常在天氣較暖的月份在這裡繁殖。

ex.en: Conservation programmes breed endangered animals in protected environments before releasing them into suitable natural habitats.
ex.zh: 保護項目在受保護的環境中繁育瀕危動物，再將它們放歸適宜的自然棲息地。

col: a breed of dog｜一種犬種
words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為bred；品種breed不同於物種species。

tr: n. 港, 避難所, 安息所
vt. 安置...於港中, 庇護, 入港
def: n. a shelter serving as a place of safety or sanctuary
a safe or peaceful place away from danger or trouble

ex.en: Our little garden is a haven from city noise.
ex.zh: 我們的小花園是遠離城市喧囂的一片寧靜之地。

ex.en: Protected wetlands provide a safe haven for wildlife threatened by habitat loss and urban expansion.
ex.zh: 受保護的溼地為受到棲息地喪失和城市擴張威脅的野生動物提供了安全庇護所。

col: haven for wildlife｜野生動物的庇護所
words.tip: 常用a haven for；注意與heaven（天堂）區分。

tr: n. 保證, 把握, 信心, 保險
[經] 保證, 擔保, 保險
def: n. freedom from doubt; belief in yourself and your abilities
n. a binding commitment to do or give or refrain from something
n. a statement intended to inspire confidence

ex.en: She gave me her assurance that dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 她向我保證晚餐已經準備好了。

ex.en: Residents sought an assurance from the council that the new development would not reduce access to public parks.
ex.zh: 居民要求地方議會保證，新開發項目不會影響公眾前往公園。

words.tip: 表示具體保證時可數；表示自信時通常不可數。

tr: n. 性情古怪的人, 急拉, 肌肉抽搐, 牛肉乾
vi. 痙攣, 急拉, 急推
def: n. a dull stupid fatuous person
n. an abrupt spasmodic movement
n. (mechanics) the rate of change of acceleration

ex.en: The bus jerked forward, making my shopping bag tumble.
ex.zh: 公交車突然向前一衝，我的購物袋隨之翻倒。

ex.en: Poorly maintained trains may jerk unexpectedly, increasing the risk of falls among passengers who are standing.
ex.zh: 維護不善的列車可能突然顛動，增加站立乘客跌倒的風險。

words.tip: 動作強調突然且短促；稱人為a jerk不禮貌。

tr: n. 酒, 液體, 汁, 溶液
def: n. an alcoholic beverage that is distilled rather than fermented
n. a liquid substance that is a solution (or emulsion or suspension) used or obtained in an industrial process
n. the liquid in which vegetables or meat have be cooked

ex.en: The restaurant keeps its liquor in a locked cabinet.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳把烈酒存放在上鎖的櫃子裡。

ex.en: Governments often impose higher taxes on liquor to discourage excessive consumption and protect public health.
ex.zh: 政府常對烈酒徵收較高稅款，以抑制過量飲用並保護公眾健康。

words.tip: 通常指烈酒；liqueur則指利口酒，注意拼寫。

def: v. to declare or affirm solemnly and formally as true
v. say yes to
To state firmly that something is true or supported.

ex.en: Both parents affirmed their support for her career choice.
ex.zh: 父母雙方都明確表示支持她的職業選擇。

ex.en: Schools should affirm the value of cultural diversity by ensuring that teaching materials reflect different backgrounds and experiences.
ex.zh: 學校應確保教材體現不同的背景與經歷，以肯定文化多樣性的價值。

col: affirm support for｜明確表示支持
affirm the value of｜肯定……的價值
words.tip: affirm語氣正式，強調明確肯定；可接that從句。

tr: n. 指距, 全長, 跨距, 一段時間, 小範圍
vt. 以手指測量, 跨越, 架設, 持續
def: n. the complete duration of something
n. the distance or interval between two points
n. a unit of length based on the width of the expanded human hand (usually taken as 9 inches)

ex.en: Our dog has a surprisingly short attention span.
ex.zh: 我們家狗狗能集中注意力的時間短得出奇。

ex.en: The research project will span several decades, allowing scientists to track long-term changes in coastal ecosystems.
ex.zh: 該研究項目將持續數十年，使科學家能夠追蹤沿海生態系統的長期變化。

col: a short time span｜短暫的一段時間
words.tip: span作動詞直接接時間或範圍，無需加介詞。

def: n. United States architect who was the presidentially appointed architect of Washington D.C. (1781-1855)

tr: vi. 逗留, 消磨, 徘徊
def: v. remain present although waning or gradually dying
v. take one's time; proceed slowly
To stay somewhere longer than expected or necessary.

ex.en: We lingered outside the cinema, chatting about the film.
ex.zh: 我們在電影院外遲遲沒有離開，聊著剛看的電影。

ex.en: The effects of prolonged unemployment can linger even after individuals return to stable work.
ex.zh: 長期失業的影響即使在人們重新獲得穩定工作後，也可能持續存在。

col: linger over a meal｜慢慢吃飯不急著離開
linger in the air｜在空氣中久久不散
words.tip: 不及物動詞；linger over表示慢慢享用或細看。

tr: vt. 使安定, 使穩固
def: v. make stable and keep from fluctuating or put into an equilibrium
v. become stable or more stable
make or become steady and less likely to change

ex.en: We used a wooden block to stabilize the table.
ex.zh: 我們用一塊木塊讓桌子保持平穩。

ex.en: Governments may need to stabilize food prices to protect vulnerable households during periods of economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 在經濟不確定時期，政府可能需要穩定食品價格，以保護弱勢家庭。

col: stabilize a patient's condition｜穩定患者病情
words.tip: 可及物也可不及物；英式英語也常拼作stabilise。

tr: v. 庇護, 藏匿, (使)入港停泊
def: n. a place of refuge and comfort and security
v. maintain (a theory, thoughts, or feelings)
v. secretly shelter (as of fugitives or criminals)

tr: n. 悉尼（澳大利亞港市）
def: n. the largest Australian city located in southeastern Australia on the Tasman Sea; state capital of New South Wales; Australia's chief port
r. on the lower or downward side; on the underside of
r. under or below an object or a surface; at a lower place or level; directly beneath
Directly below something, often covered or hidden by it.

ex.en: Your slippers are underneath the chair by the bed.
ex.zh: 你的拖鞋在床邊那把椅子下面。

ex.en: Insulation installed underneath floors can reduce heat loss and improve energy efficiency in older homes.
ex.zh: 在地板下面鋪設保溫材料，可以減少老房屋的熱量流失並提高能源效率。

words.tip: 後接名詞時是介詞；單獨使用時是副詞。

tr: a. 暗淡的, 模糊的
def: v. switch (a car's headlights) from a higher to a lower beam
v. become dim or lusterless
v. make dim or lusterless

ex.en: We ate dinner under a dim kitchen light.
ex.zh: 我們在廚房昏暗的燈光下吃了晚飯。

ex.en: Dim lighting in public spaces can make pedestrians feel unsafe, particularly when walking alone at night.
ex.zh: 公共空間照明昏暗會讓行人感到不安全，尤其是在夜間獨自行走時。

col: take a dim view of｜不贊同
words.tip: 變形雙寫m：dimmer、dimmest、dimmed。

def: n. the forceful insertion of a substance under pressure
n. any solution that is injected (as into the skin)
n. the act of putting a liquid into the body by means of a syringe

ex.en: The nurse gave me an injection in my arm.
ex.zh: 護士在我的手臂上打了一針。

ex.en: An injection of public funding could help local libraries modernise their facilities and expand community services.
ex.zh: 注入公共資金可以幫助當地圖書館更新設施並拓展社區服務。

col: a cash injection｜一筆現金注入
an injection of funding｜資金的注入
words.tip: 注入資金可說an injection of cash，屬於比喻用法。

tr: n. 種植園, 大農場, 植樹造林, 新開墾地
[醫] 栽植(如牙或其他組織的植入、再植和移植)
def: n. an estate where cash crops are grown on a large scale (especially in tropical areas)
n. a newly established colony (especially in the colonization of North America)
A large farm growing crops such as tea, coffee, or cotton.

ex.en: We walked past a tea plantation on the hillside.
ex.zh: 我們從山坡上的一片茶園旁走過。

ex.en: Expanding palm oil plantations can threaten biodiversity when natural forests are cleared to make room for crops.
ex.zh: 為擴大油棕種植園而清除天然森林，可能威脅生物多樣性。

words.tip: 通常指大面積種植單類作物的農場，不是普通花園。

def: a. capable of being foretold
Happening or behaving in a way that can be expected.
Boring because nothing surprising or original happens.

ex.en: The film's predictable ending made us laugh rather than cry.
ex.zh: 這部電影老套的結局讓我們笑了，而不是哭了。

ex.en: A predictable income helps families plan their spending and reduces the stress associated with financial uncertainty.
ex.zh: 可預期的收入有助於家庭規劃支出，並減輕財務不確定性帶來的壓力。

words.tip: 既可表示結果可預料，也可貶指情節老套。

tr: n. 過度, 剩於, 超過, 超額
a. 過量的, 額外的
def: n. a quantity much larger than is needed
n. immoderation as a consequence of going beyond sufficient or permitted limits
s. more than is needed, desired, or required

ex.en: Wipe away the excess paint with a clean cloth.
ex.zh: 用乾淨的布擦去多餘的油漆。

ex.en: Consuming sugar in excess can increase the risk of obesity and other health problems.
ex.zh: 攝入過量糖分會增加肥胖及其他健康問題的風險。

words.tip: in excess指過量；in excess of指超過某數量。

tr: n. 成分, 選民, 構成物
a. 構成的, 組織的, 選舉的
def: n. a member of a constituency; a citizen who is represented in a government by officials for whom he or she votes
n. (grammar) a word or phrase or clause forming part of a larger grammatical construction
s. constitutional in the structure of something (especially your physical makeup)

ex.en: A constituent asked her local representative about the closed library.
ex.zh: 一位選區居民向當地民意代表詢問圖書館關閉的事。

ex.en: Elected representatives should consult their constituents before supporting policies that significantly affect local housing and public transport.
ex.zh: 民選代表在支持對當地住房和公共交通有重大影響的政策之前，應徵詢選區居民的意見。

words.tip: 選民義可含未投票的選區居民；成分義近component。

tr: n. 牛奶公司, 乳品店, 乳牛場
def: n. a farm where dairy products are produced

tr: n. 機智, 智力, 頭腦, 理智, 妙語, 機智的人
def: n. a message whose ingenuity or verbal skill or incongruity has the power to evoke laughter

tr: a. 傳說的, 寓言般的, 難以置信的
def: s. extremely pleasing
s. based on or told of in traditional stories; lacking factual basis or historical validity
s. barely credible

ex.en: We had a fabulous picnic beside the lake yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我們在湖邊度過了一段美妙的野餐時光。

ex.en: Although tourism can generate fabulous wealth, its economic benefits are not always shared fairly among local residents.
ex.zh: 儘管旅遊業能創造鉅額財富，其經濟收益卻並非總能在當地居民之間公平分配。

col: a fabulous time｜極其愉快的時光
words.tip: 表“極好的”多用於非正式語境，語氣較強。

tr: n. 交集, 十字路口, 交叉點
def: n. a point where lines intersect
n. a junction where one street or road crosses another
n. a point or set of points common to two or more geometric configurations

ex.en: Turn left at the intersection beside the bakery.
ex.zh: 在麵包店旁的交叉路口左轉。

ex.en: Installing better lighting at busy intersections can reduce accidents and improve safety for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 在繁忙的交叉路口安裝更好的照明設施，可以減少事故並提高行人的安全性。

col: the intersection of two sets｜兩個集合的交集
words.tip: 道路交叉口常用at an intersection。

def: n. profane or obscene expression usually of surprise or anger
n. a severe affliction
v. utter obscenities or profanities

ex.en: He cursed quietly when his umbrella broke in the rain.
ex.zh: 雨中傘壞了，他低聲咒罵了一句。

ex.en: For isolated communities, unreliable transport can be a curse that limits access to healthcare and employment.
ex.zh: 對偏遠社區而言，不可靠的交通可能成為禍害，限制居民獲得醫療服務和就業機會。

col: curse under one's breath｜低聲咒罵
put a curse on｜對……施加詛咒
a blessing and a curse｜既是福也是禍
words.tip: curse可指咒罵或詛咒；swear也可指發誓。

tr: n. 辭職, 辭呈, 聽從
def: n. acceptance of despair
n. the act of giving up (a claim or office or possession etc.)
n. a formal document giving notice of your intention to resign

ex.en: She handed in her resignation after finding another job.
ex.zh: 她找到另一份工作後提交了辭職信。

ex.en: The resignation of experienced nurses can place additional pressure on hospitals already struggling with staff shortages.
ex.zh: 經驗豐富的護士辭職，會給本已面臨人員短缺的醫院帶來額外壓力。

col: hand in your resignation｜提交辭職信
words.tip: 辭職用resignation；另一義是無奈接受，不是反抗。

tr: a. 悲慘的；痛苦的；卑鄙的
def: s. very unhappy; full of misery
s. characterized by physical misery
Very unhappy or uncomfortable

ex.en: I felt miserable when rain ruined our picnic plans.
ex.zh: 大雨毀了我們的野餐計劃，讓我很難過。

ex.en: Overcrowded housing can create miserable living conditions and negatively affect residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 住房過度擁擠會造成惡劣的生活條件，並損害居民的身心健康。

words.tip: 既可形容人的心情，也可形容天氣或生活條件。

tr: [計] 清洗; 擦除; 抹除; DOS內部命令:從磁盤上刪除一個或多個文件
def: v. remove from memory or existence
v. remove by or as if by rubbing or erasing
v. wipe out digitally or magnetically recorded information

tr: [法] 無知, 不知情, 愚昧
def: n. the lack of knowledge or education
a lack of knowledge or awareness about something

ex.en: My ignorance of local customs led to an awkward moment.
ex.zh: 我不瞭解當地習俗，因此一度陷入尷尬。

ex.en: Public education can reduce ignorance about nutrition and help families make healthier choices on limited budgets.
ex.zh: 公眾教育可以減少營養知識盲區，幫助家庭在預算有限的情況下作出更健康的選擇。

col: in ignorance of｜在不知……的情況下
words.tip: 不可數；常用ignorance of/about表示對某事不瞭解。

def: n. a low area where the land is saturated with water

tr: a. 線的, 直線的, 線狀的
def: a. designating or involving an equation whose terms are of the first degree
a. of or in or along or relating to a line; involving a single dimension
s. (of a leaf shape) long and narrow

tr: n. 崇拜, 禮拜, 尊敬
def: n. the activity of worshipping
n. a feeling of profound love and admiration
v. show devotion to (a deity)

ex.en: They gather for worship in a small village chapel.
ex.zh: 他們聚在村裡的一座小教堂做禮拜。

ex.en: Historic places of worship often serve as important centres of community life and cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 歷史悠久的宗教場所往往是社區生活與文化傳承的重要中心。

col: place of worship｜宗教禮拜場所
freedom of worship｜宗教禮拜自由
words.tip: 英式過去式worshipped，美式通常worshiped。

tr: n. 辯護, 證明正當, 釋罪
def: n. something (such as a fact or circumstance) that shows an action to be reasonable or necessary
n. a statement in explanation of some action or belief
n. the act of defending or explaining or making excuses for by reasoning

ex.en: There is no justification for leaving this mess behind.
ex.zh: 把這裡弄得一團糟卻不收拾，沒有任何正當理由。

ex.en: Governments must provide clear justification for policies that restrict individual freedom in the interests of public safety.
ex.zh: 政府必須為那些以公共安全為由限制個人自由的政策提供明確的合理依據。

col: little justification｜幾乎沒有正當理由
economic justification｜經濟上的合理依據
words.tip: 常接for加名詞或動名詞，說明某事的合理依據。

def: n. a fee paid for instruction (especially for higher education)
money paid for teaching at a school or university
teaching provided to an individual or a small group

ex.en: She works at weekends to help pay her tuition.
ex.zh: 她週末打工，幫助支付自己的學費。

ex.en: Rising university tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from pursuing higher education.
ex.zh: 不斷上漲的大學學費可能使來自弱勢家庭的學生放棄接受高等教育。

words.tip: 不可數；英式談學費常用tuition fees。

tr: a. 毀滅性的, 破壞的, 有害的
def: a. causing destruction or much damage

tr: n. 重複, 背誦, 循環, 複製品, 副本
def: n. the act of doing or performing again
n. the repeated use of the same word or word pattern as a rhetorical device
Doing or saying something again, often several times

ex.en: Through daily repetition, I finally remembered the whole song.
ex.zh: 通過每天反覆練習，我終於記住了整首歌。

ex.en: Regular repetition can help language learners remember new vocabulary, especially when combined with meaningful practice.
ex.zh: 定期重複有助於語言學習者記住新詞彙，尤其是在結合有意義的練習時。

col: learn through repetition｜通過反覆練習學習
words.tip: repetition強調重複；rehearsal指演出前的排練。

def: n. the state of being asleep
n. the suspension of consciousness and decrease in metabolic rate
n. that part of the earnings of a corporation that is distributed to its shareholders; usually paid quarterly
n. a number to be divided by another number
n. a bonus; something extra (especially a share of a surplus)

tr: n. 校訂, 修正, 改樣
vt. 校訂, 修正, 校正
def: v. make revisions in
To study material again in preparation for an examination.
To change something to correct or improve it.

ex.en: I need to revise for my biology exam tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我得複習，準備生物考試。

ex.en: Governments should revise outdated housing policies to ensure that affordable homes remain accessible to young families.
ex.zh: 政府應修訂過時的住房政策，確保年輕家庭仍能獲得負擔得起的住房。

col: revise for an exam｜複習備考
words.tip: 複習義主要用於英式英語；美式常用review。

tr: vt. 令人入神, 使著迷
def: v. to render motionless, as with a fixed stare or by arousing terror or awe
to attract and hold someone's attention very strongly

ex.en: The colourful fish fascinated the children at the aquarium.
ex.zh: 水族館裡色彩斑斕的魚讓孩子們看得入迷。

ex.en: Ancient civilisations continue to fascinate researchers because their achievements reveal remarkable solutions to complex practical problems.
ex.zh: 古代文明仍然令研究者著迷，因為其成就展現瞭解決複雜實際問題的非凡方法。

col: fascinate an audience｜深深吸引觀眾
never cease to fascinate｜始終令人著迷
words.tip: 事物令人著迷用fascinating；人感到著迷用fascinated。

def: n. a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold
A small place serving drinks and light meals.

ex.en: We shared a sandwich at the cafe beside the station.
ex.zh: 我們在車站旁的小餐館分著吃了一份三明治。

ex.en: A neighbourhood cafe can strengthen community ties by providing a welcoming space for residents to meet.
ex.zh: 社區咖啡館可以為居民提供友好的聚會空間，從而加強社區聯繫。

words.tip: 也寫作café；通常提供飲料和簡餐。

tr: n. 宣傳, 宣傳活動
def: n. information that is spread for the purpose of promoting some cause

tr: vt. 用公式表示, 明確敘述, 制訂
[機] 公式化, 公式表示
def: v. prepare according to a formula
to develop a plan, policy, or idea carefully
to express an idea clearly and precisely

ex.en: We need to formulate a plan before moving house.
ex.zh: 搬家之前，我們需要制定一個計劃。

ex.en: Governments should formulate transport policies that reduce congestion while ensuring affordable access for all residents.
ex.zh: 政府應制定交通政策，在緩解擁堵的同時確保所有居民都能負擔出行費用。

words.tip: 比make正式，常搭配plan、policy、hypothesis。

tr: n. 發生, 發生率, 影響, 負擔者, 入射, 傾角
[醫] 入射, 發生率, 發生數
def: n. the relative frequency of occurrence of something
n. the striking of a light beam on a surface

tr: vt. 實踐, 履行, 實行, 完成, 結束, 滿足
def: v put in effect
v fill or meet a want or need
v meet the requirements or expectations of

ex.en: She fulfilled her promise and repaired my bicycle.
ex.zh: 她履行了承諾，修好了我的自行車。

ex.en: Public libraries fulfil an important social role by providing free access to information and learning resources.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館通過免費提供信息和學習資源，發揮著重要的社會作用。

words.tip: 英式fulfil，美式fulfill；過去式均為fulfilled。

tr: n. 樣品, 標本, 試料
def: n. an example regarded as typical of its class
n. a bit of tissue or blood or urine that is taken for diagnostic purposes
An individual animal, plant, or object collected for scientific study.

ex.en: The museum keeps this butterfly specimen behind glass.
ex.zh: 博物館將這件蝴蝶標本保存在玻璃罩內。

ex.en: Researchers examined each plant specimen to assess how prolonged drought had affected its growth.
ex.zh: 研究人員檢查了每份植物樣本，以評估長期乾旱對其生長的影響。

words.tip: specimen多指供研究或檢驗的樣本，不泛指任何例子。

tr: a. 模糊的, 昏暗的, 難解的, 晦澀的, 偏僻的, 微賤的, 無名的
vt. 使變暗, 隱藏, 使變模糊, 使難解
def: v. make less visible or unclear
v. make obscure or unclear
v. reduce a vowel to a neutral one, such as a schwa

ex.en: We found an obscure little museum behind the station.
ex.zh: 我們在車站後面發現了一家鮮為人知的小博物館。

ex.en: Overly technical language can obscure important findings, making scientific research less accessible to the public.
ex.zh: 過於專業的語言可能使重要發現變得難以理解，降低公眾瞭解科研成果的便利程度。

col: an obscure writer｜鮮為人知的作家
words.tip: 作形容詞指無名或難懂；作動詞指遮蔽或掩蓋。

tr: n. 引人羨慕的東西, 景象, 眼鏡, 場面, 公開展示
def: n. something or someone seen (especially a notable or unusual sight)
n. an elaborate and remarkable display on a lavish scale
n. a blunder that makes you look ridiculous; used in the phrase `make a spectacle of' yourself

tr: a. 空間的, 受空間條件限制的, 佔地位的
[醫] 隙的, 間隙的, 腔的; 空間的, 立體的
def: a. pertaining to or involving or having the nature of space
relating to space and the positions of objects within it

ex.en: Building with blocks helps children develop their spatial awareness.
ex.zh: 搭積木有助於孩子培養空間意識。

ex.en: Urban planners examine the spatial distribution of housing to ensure residents can access essential services.
ex.zh: 城市規劃者研究住房的空間分佈，以確保居民能獲得基本服務。

words.tip: spatial指空間關係；spacious指地方寬敞。

def: n. a common nonmetallic element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless inert diatomic gas; constitutes 78 percent of the atmosphere by volume; a constituent of all living tissues
A chemical element forming most of the gas in Earth's air.

ex.en: These beans help add nitrogen to our garden soil.
ex.zh: 這些豆類植物有助於增加我們花園土壤中的氮。

ex.en: Excess nitrogen from agricultural fertilisers can enter rivers, encouraging rapid algae growth and damaging aquatic ecosystems.
ex.zh: 農業肥料中過量的氮可能進入河流，促使藻類迅速生長，破壞水生生態系統。

words.tip: nitrogen是不可數名詞，化學符號為N。

tr: n. 整體, 積分, 整數
a. 固有的, 整體的, 整數的, 積分的
def: n. the result of a mathematical integration; F(x) is the integral of f(x) if dF/dx = f(x)
s. constituting the undiminished entirety; lacking nothing essential especially not damaged
a. of or denoted by an integer

ex.en: Music is an integral part of our family celebrations.
ex.zh: 音樂是我們家庭慶祝活動中不可或缺的一部分。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is integral to sustainable urban development because it reduces dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通對城市可持續發展至關重要，因為它能減少對私家車的依賴。

col: an integral part of｜……不可或缺的一部分
integral to success｜成功所必需的
an integral component｜不可缺少的組成部分
words.tip: 常用an integral part of或be integral to。

tr: n. 教養, 生育, 飼養
[醫] 生育, 繁殖, 育種, 飼養
def: n. elegance by virtue of fineness of manner and expression
n. helping someone grow up to be an accepted member of the community
n. the production of animals or plants by inbreeding or hybridization

ex.en: We avoid disturbing the birds during the breeding season.
ex.zh: 我們在繁殖季節避免打擾鳥類。

ex.en: Selective breeding can improve crop yields, but it may also reduce genetic diversity within agricultural systems.
ex.zh: 選擇性育種能夠提高作物產量，但也可能降低農業系統內的遺傳多樣性。

words.tip: breeding側重繁殖或人工育種；breed作名詞指品種。

tr: n. 插, 戳, 刺, 猛推, 口頭攻擊, 推力
vt. 插入, 猛推, 刺, 戳, 強加, 延伸
vi. 插, 刺, 戳, 延伸, (用力)推
def: n. verbal criticism
v. push forcefully
v. press or force

ex.en: He thrust his hands deep into his coat pockets.
ex.zh: 他猛地把雙手插進大衣口袋深處。

ex.en: The main thrust of the proposal is to improve public transport rather than build additional roads.
ex.zh: 這項提案的重點是改善公共交通，而非增建道路。

col: thrust something into｜把某物猛塞進
the main thrust of｜……的主要重點
words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為thrust；要旨常用the thrust of。

tr: n. 貯水池, 貯藏處, 貯備, 水庫
def: n. a large or extra supply of something
n. lake used to store water for community use
n. tank used for collecting and storing a liquid (as water or oil)
n. an elongated leather strip (or a strip of similar material) for binding things together or holding something in position
n. hanger consisting of a loop of leather suspended from the ceiling of a bus or train; passengers hold onto it
n. a band that goes over the shoulder and supports a garment or bag

ex.en: The strap on my backpack broke near the bus stop.
ex.zh: 快到公交站時，我背包的肩帶斷了。

ex.en: Passengers should strap their luggage securely to prevent injuries when vehicles stop suddenly or travel over uneven roads.
ex.zh: 乘客應把行李綁牢，以免車輛急停或駛過不平路面時造成傷害。

col: strap something down｜用帶子固定某物
words.tip: strap作動詞時，過去式為strapped，現在分詞為strapping。

def: n. an inference that if things agree in some respects they probably agree in others
n. drawing a comparison in order to show a similarity in some respect
A comparison used to explain something through a similar example

ex.en: Her analogy compared our busy kitchen to a train station.
ex.zh: 她把我們忙碌的廚房比作火車站。

ex.en: Teachers often draw an analogy between electrical circuits and flowing water to explain unfamiliar scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 教師常將電路與流水作類比，以解釋學生不熟悉的科學概念。

col: an analogy between｜兩者之間的類比
words.tip: 常用draw an analogy between A and B。

def: n. a person who inhabits a particular place
A person or animal that lives in a particular place.

ex.en: Every inhabitant of the village helped repair the bridge.
ex.zh: 村裡的每一位居民都幫忙修了橋。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth can place pressure on housing and reduce access to green spaces for local inhabitants.
ex.zh: 城市快速擴張可能增加住房壓力，並減少當地居民享用綠地的機會。

col: the inhabitants of a city｜一座城市的居民
words.tip: 常用inhabitants of＋地點；不等於具有公民身份的citizens。

def: v. make more intense, stronger, or more marked
v. become more intense
v. make the chemically affected part of (a negative) denser or more opaque in order produce a stronger contrast between light and dark

ex.en: The rain intensified as we hurried towards the station.
ex.zh: 我們匆忙趕往車站時，雨下得更大了。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may intensify water shortages in regions that already experience long periods of drought.
ex.zh: 氣溫上升可能加劇長期遭受乾旱地區的缺水問題。

words.tip: 可直接接賓語，也可不接：壓力本身也會加劇。

tr: n. 弧, 弧形, 弓形, 弧光
def: n. a continuous portion of a circle

tr: n. 搖擺, 影響力, 支配
vt. 搖動, 支配, 弄歪, 使傾斜, 使動搖, 影響
vi. 搖動, 搖擺, 傾斜, 動搖, 統治, 轉向
def: n. controlling influence
To move slowly from side to side, or cause this movement.
To influence someone's opinion, choice, or decision.

ex.en: The branches swayed gently as we ate outside.
ex.zh: 我們在戶外吃飯時，樹枝輕輕搖曳。

ex.en: Emotional advertising can sway consumers' decisions even when competing products offer better value for money.
ex.zh: 即使競爭產品更划算，情感廣告仍可能左右消費者的決定。

col: sway public opinion｜左右公眾輿論
words.tip: sway既可指身體搖擺，也可指影響觀點或決定。

tr: n. 腐蝕, 沖蝕, 侵蝕
def: n. (geology) the mechanical process of wearing or grinding something down (as by particles washing over it)
n. condition in which the earth's surface is worn away by the action of water and wind
n. a gradual decline of something

ex.en: Heavy rain caused erosion along the muddy river bank.
ex.zh: 大雨使泥濘的河岸遭到了侵蝕。

ex.en: Planting trees can reduce soil erosion because their roots help hold the ground together during heavy rainfall.
ex.zh: 植樹可以減少水土流失，因為樹根有助於在強降雨時固住土壤。

col: erosion of trust｜信任的逐漸削弱
words.tip: 通常不可數；也可比喻信任、權利等逐漸受損。

tr: n. 載貨單, 運貨單, 旅客名單
a. 顯然的, 明白的
vt. 表明, 表現, 證明
def: n. a customs document listing the contents put on a ship or plane
v. record in a ship's manifest
v. reveal its presence or make an appearance

tr: n. 流溢, 面紅, 旺盛, 發燒, 驚飛的鳥, 同花牌
a. 豐足的, 齊平的, 滿盈的, 氾濫的
adv. 齊平地, 直接地
vi. 臉發紅, 奔湧, 旺盛, 驚飛
vt. 淹沒, 沖洗, 使臉紅, 使激動, 使齊平, 使驚飛
def: n. a poker hand with all 5 cards in the same suit
n. a sudden rapid flow (as of water)
v. flow freely

ex.en: Please flush the toilet before you leave the bathroom.
ex.zh: 離開衛生間之前，請衝一下馬桶。

ex.en: Modern buildings can reduce water consumption by using collected rainwater to flush toilets instead of drinking water.
ex.zh: 現代建築可以使用收集的雨水而非飲用水沖廁所，從而減少用水量。

col: flush with the wall｜與牆面齊平
a flush of colour｜一陣紅暈
words.tip: flush with可指與表面齊平，也可指錢充裕。

tr: n. 舔, 少許, 打
vt. 舔, 捲過, 鞭打
def: n. touching with the tongue
v. pass the tongue over
Move your tongue across something, often to taste it.

ex.en: The puppy licked my hand and wagged its tail.
ex.zh: 小狗舔了舔我的手，搖著尾巴。

ex.en: Visitors should not allow wild animals to lick their hands, as close contact may spread infections.
ex.zh: 遊客不應讓野生動物舔自己的手，因為近距離接觸可能傳播感染。

col: lick an ice cream｜舔冰激凌
give something a lick｜舔一下某物
words.tip: lick指用舌頭舔；咬用bite，吸吮用suck。

tr: a. 有勢力的, 強大的, 有力的
def: s. having or showing great strength or force or intensity
r. (Southern regional intensive) very; to a great degree
Very strong, powerful, or large.

ex.en: A mighty oak stood in the middle of the field.
ex.zh: 田野中央矗立著一棵高大的橡樹。

ex.en: Although mighty rivers provide valuable renewable energy, building large dams can seriously disrupt surrounding ecosystems.
ex.zh: 儘管大河能提供寶貴的可再生能源，修建大型水壩仍可能嚴重擾亂周邊生態系統。

words.tip: 形容詞常帶文學色彩；副詞義“很”較口語化。

tr: n. 白痴, 極蠢之人
def: n. a person of subnormal intelligence
An insulting word for someone considered very foolish.

ex.en: I felt like an idiot after losing my keys again.
ex.zh: 再次弄丟鑰匙後，我覺得自己真是個笨蛋。

ex.en: Calling a classmate an idiot can damage their confidence and undermine efforts to create a supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 罵同學是笨蛋會打擊其自信，也會破壞營造互助學習環境的努力。

col: feel like an idiot｜覺得自己很傻
words.tip: 帶侮辱性，不是描述智力障礙的醫學用語。

def: n. an imperfection in a bodily system
n. a failing or deficiency
n. an imperfection in an object or machine

ex.en: A small defect in the kettle caused it to leak.
ex.zh: 水壺上的一處小缺陷導致它漏水。

ex.en: Manufacturers should identify any design defect before a product reaches consumers, particularly when safety is at risk.
ex.zh: 製造商應在產品到達消費者手中前發現設計缺陷，尤其是在涉及安全風險時。

col: defect to the opposition｜轉投反對派
words.tip: 名詞重音在前；動詞讀/dɪˈfekt/。

tr: n. 活瓣, 閥, 活門
v. 裝閥, 用閥調節
def: n. a structure in a hollow organ (like the heart) with a flap to insure one-way flow of fluid through it
n. device in a brass wind instrument for varying the length of the air column to alter the pitch of a tone
n. control consisting of a mechanical device for controlling the flow of a fluid

ex.en: Turn this valve to stop water entering the tank.
ex.zh: 轉動這個閥門，阻止水流入水箱。

ex.en: Replacing damaged heart valves can improve patients' quality of life and reduce the risk of serious complications.
ex.zh: 更換受損的心臟瓣膜可以改善患者的生活質量，並降低嚴重併發症的風險。

words.tip: 工程中指閥門，人體中可指心臟等部位的瓣膜。

tr: n. 請願, 訴狀, 陳情書, 申請, 祈求, 禱文
v. 正式請求, 懇求, 請願
def: v. write a petition for something to somebody; request formally and in writing
A formal written request, often supported by many people's signatures.
To formally ask an authority to do something.

ex.en: Our neighbours signed a petition to save the playground.
ex.zh: 鄰居們在請願書上簽名，希望保住這座遊樂場。

ex.en: Residents submitted a petition asking the council to improve public transport in areas outside the city centre.
ex.zh: 居民提交了請願書，要求市政委員會改善市中心以外地區的公共交通。

col: sign a petition｜在請願書上簽名
petition for reform｜請願要求改革
words.tip: 動詞常用petition somebody to do something。

tr: n. 相符, 通信, 信件
def: n. communication by the exchange of letters
Written communication between people, or the messages they exchange.
A close similarity or connection between two things.

ex.en: She keeps her correspondence with her cousin in a drawer.
ex.zh: 她把與表親的往來信件放在抽屜裡。

ex.en: Historical correspondence can reveal how ordinary families experienced social changes that official records describe only briefly.
ex.zh: 歷史上的往來信件能揭示普通家庭如何經歷官方記錄僅簡略提及的社會變遷。

col: correspondence with someone｜與某人的通信
words.tip: 表示往來信件時不可數；與某人通信用with。

tr: n. 動脈, 幹道, 要道
def: n. a blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the body
n. a major thoroughfare that bears important traffic
A blood vessel carrying blood away from the heart.

ex.en: The doctor explained how blood flows through an artery.
ex.zh: 醫生解釋了血液如何流經動脈。

ex.en: The new railway will become a major transport artery connecting rural communities with regional markets.
ex.zh: 這條新鐵路將成為連接鄉村社區與區域市場的交通大動脈。

words.tip: 動脈將血液送離心臟；靜脈是vein。

tr: n. 靜電, 靜電干擾
a. 靜態的, 靜止的, 固有的, 靜電的
def: n. a crackling or hissing noise caused by electrical interference
n. angry criticism
s. showing little if any change

ex.en: The television picture stayed static while the sound continued.
ex.zh: 電視畫面停住不動了，但聲音還在繼續。

ex.en: Wages have remained static for several years, while housing costs have risen steadily in major cities.
ex.zh: 工資多年來一直沒有變化，而大城市的住房成本卻持續上漲。

words.tip: static強調不動或不變；靜電用static electricity。

tr: a. 低下的, 謙遜的, 粗陋的
vt. 使...卑下, 降低...地位, 貶抑
def: v. cause to be unpretentious
s. low or inferior in station or quality
a. marked by meekness or modesty; not arrogant or prideful

ex.en: Despite winning the prize, she remained humble and thanked everyone.
ex.zh: 儘管獲了獎，她依然謙遜，並向所有人表示感謝。

ex.en: Effective leaders remain humble enough to acknowledge mistakes and learn from colleagues with different backgrounds and experiences.
ex.zh: 優秀的領導者保持謙遜，願意承認錯誤，並向背景和經歷不同的同事學習。

col: in my humble opinion｜依我拙見
words.tip: 謙遜是humble；不要與“羞辱”humiliate混淆。

def: n. an unproved statement put forward as a premise in an argument
A long research paper written for a university degree.
A central claim that someone presents and supports with evidence.

ex.en: Leila spent the weekend checking references for her thesis.
ex.zh: 萊拉整個週末都在核對學位論文的參考文獻。

ex.en: His thesis examines how access to public transport influences employment opportunities in disadvantaged urban communities.
ex.zh: 他的學位論文探討了公共交通的可及性如何影響城市弱勢社區的就業機會。

col: write a thesis｜撰寫學位論文
submit a thesis｜提交學位論文
words.tip: 複數是theses；既可指學位論文，也可指核心論點。

tr: a. 音頻的, 聲音的
def: n. the audible part of a transmitted signal
n. an audible acoustic wave frequency
n. the sound elements of television

tr: n. 調味品, 穿衣, 化妝
def: n. savory dressings for salads; basically of two kinds: either the thin French or vinaigrette type or the creamy mayonnaise type
n. a cloth covering for a wound or sore
n. processes in the conversion of rough hides into leather

tr: a. 宇宙的, 宇宙航行的, 無限的, 有秩序的
def: a. of or from or pertaining to or characteristic of the cosmos or universe
s. inconceivably extended in space or time
v reflect deeply on a subject
to think carefully about something for some time

ex.en: She pondered the menu before ordering vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 她仔細看了看菜單，才點了蔬菜湯。

ex.en: Policymakers must ponder the long-term consequences of replacing public transport services with privately operated alternatives.
ex.zh: 政策制定者必須仔細考慮用私營服務取代公共交通服務的長期後果。

col: ponder a question｜認真思考問題
ponder the implications｜仔細考慮可能的影響
ponder over something｜反覆思量某事
words.tip: 可直接接賓語，也可用ponder on/over。

tr: vt. 告發, 抨擊, 譴責
[法] 譴責, 斥責, 告發
def: v. speak out against
v. announce the termination of, as of treaties
v. give away information about somebody

tr: a. 可信的, 可靠的
def: a. capable of being believed
s. (a common but incorrect usage where `credulous' would be appropriate) credulous
s. appearing to merit belief or acceptance
n. the act of processing used or abandoned materials for use in creating new products
the process of turning waste into materials usable again
waste materials collected to be processed and used again

ex.en: Our building has separate bins for recycling and food waste.
ex.zh: 我們這棟樓分別設有回收物桶和廚餘垃圾桶。

ex.en: Effective recycling programmes require convenient collection services as well as clear public guidance on sorting household waste.
ex.zh: 有效的回收利用計劃既需要便利的收集服務，也需要向公眾明確說明如何分類生活垃圾。

words.tip: 通常不可數；表示回收活動或待回收的物品。

tr: a. 例外的, 異常的, 特別的
def: s. deviating widely from a norm of physical or mental ability; used especially of children below normal in intelligence
far better than usual
unusual and outside normal circumstances

ex.en: The young violinist gave an exceptional performance last night.
ex.zh: 那位年輕的小提琴手昨晚的演奏十分出色。

ex.en: Students with exceptional ability may require additional challenges to remain engaged in classroom learning.
ex.zh: 能力出眾的學生可能需要更有挑戰性的任務，才能持續投入課堂學習。

words.tip: 常指特別優秀；exceptional circumstances指特殊情況。

tr: a. 謹慎的, 小心的, 機警的, 周到的, 唯恐的
def: a. marked by keen caution and watchful prudence

tr: vt. 包紮, 胡亂塞進
def: n. a package of several things tied together for carrying or storing
v. make into a bundle
v. sleep fully clothed in the same bed with one's betrothed

ex.en: He carried a bundle of blankets into the house.
ex.zh: 他抱著一捆毯子走進了屋裡。

ex.en: Offering internet and telephone services as a bundle may reduce costs, but consumers should compare contracts carefully.
ex.zh: 將網絡和電話服務捆綁提供可能降低費用，但消費者應仔細比較合同。

col: a bundle of clothes｜一包衣服
bundle into a car｜匆忙塞進車裡
words.tip: a bundle of後接複數名詞；bundle up也指穿暖。

tr: vt. 使插入, 使嵌入, 使深留腦中
def: v. attach to, as a journalist to a military unit when reporting on a war
to fix something firmly inside a surrounding material
to place digital content within a webpage or document

ex.en: The artist embedded small shells in the wet clay.
ex.zh: 藝術家把小貝殼嵌入溼黏土中。

ex.en: Schools should embed environmental awareness in everyday lessons rather than discuss sustainability only on special occasions.
ex.zh: 學校應將環保意識融入日常課程，而不是隻在特殊場合討論可持續發展。

words.tip: 過去式embedded，分詞embedding均雙寫d。

tr: n. 亞麻布, 亞麻線, 亞麻製品
a. 亞麻布制的, 亞麻的
def: n. a fabric woven with fibers from the flax plant
n. a high-quality paper made of linen fibers or with a linen finish
n. white goods or clothing made with linen cloth

ex.en: I wore a linen shirt on the hot afternoon.
ex.zh: 那個炎熱的下午，我穿了一件亞麻襯衫。

ex.en: Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse towels and change bed linen less frequently.
ex.zh: 酒店可以鼓勵住客重複使用毛巾並降低床上用品的更換頻率，以減少用水量。

col: fresh linen｜乾淨的床單等織物
words.tip: 通常不可數；bed linen不一定由亞麻製成。

tr: vt. 舉起, 提拔, 鼓舞
def: v give a promotion to or assign to a higher position
v raise from a lower to a higher position
v raise in rank or condition

ex.en: The nurse used a pillow to elevate my ankle.
ex.zh: 護士用枕頭墊高了我的腳踝。

ex.en: Access to advanced training can elevate professional standards and improve the quality of public services.
ex.zh: 獲得進階培訓的機會能夠提升專業標準，並改善公共服務質量。

col: elevate someone to a position｜將某人提拔至某職位
words.tip: 及物動詞；elevate A to B可表示將A提升至B。

tr: n. 獎券, 彩票, 運氣
def: n. something that is regarded as a chance event
n. players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots
a game where randomly chosen tickets win prizes

ex.en: My uncle bought a lottery ticket at the shop.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在商店買了一張彩票。

ex.en: Allocating school places by lottery may reduce favouritism, but it can also create uncertainty for families.
ex.zh: 通過抽籤分配學位或許能減少偏袒，卻也可能給家庭帶來不確定性。

words.tip: by lottery指通過抽籤，不一定涉及購買彩票。

def: n a specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee

tr: n. 邊緣, 端, 流蘇, 穗, 初步
vt. 加穗於, 加飾邊於
a. 邊緣的, 附加的
def: n. one of the light or dark bands produced by the interference and diffraction of light
n. a social group holding marginal or extreme views
n. an ornamental border consisting of short lengths of hanging threads or tassels

ex.en: Their cottage stands on the fringe of the forest.
ex.zh: 他們的小屋位於森林邊緣。

ex.en: Affordable housing on the urban fringe often leaves residents dependent on cars for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 城市外圍的經濟適用住房往往使居民的日常出行依賴汽車。

col: on the fringes of society｜在社會邊緣
a fringe of trees｜一圈樹木
words.tip: “劉海”英式用fringe，美式通常用bangs。

tr: n. 樹籬, 障礙, 套頭交易
vt. 用樹籬圍, 套期保值, 妨礙, 兩面下注以防...的損失
vi. 築樹籬, 躲閃, 兩面下注以防損失
a. 樹籬的, 偷偷摸摸的
def: n. a fence formed by a row of closely planted shrubs or bushes
n. any technique designed to reduce or eliminate financial risk; for example, taking two positions that will offset each other if prices change
n. an intentionally noncommittal or ambiguous statement

ex.en: A thick hedge separates our garden from the pavement.
ex.zh: 一道茂密的樹籬將我們的花園與人行道隔開。

ex.en: Some investors purchase gold as a hedge against inflation, although its value can also fluctuate.
ex.zh: 一些投資者購買黃金以防範通貨膨脹，儘管黃金的價值也可能波動。

col: a hedge against inflation｜對沖通脹的手段
hedge your bets｜多方下注以分散風險
words.tip: 金融義常用 a hedge against，表示防範某種風險。

tr: n. 租約, 租期, 租
vt. 出租, 租出, 租得
def: n. property that is leased or rented out or let
n. a contract granting use or occupation of property during a specified time for a specified payment
n. the period of time during which a contract conveying property to a person is in effect

ex.en: We signed a lease for a sunny upstairs flat.
ex.zh: 我們簽下了樓上一套陽光充足的公寓的租約。

ex.en: Small businesses often lease equipment rather than purchase it outright, allowing them to manage initial costs more effectively.
ex.zh: 小企業往往租用設備而非一次性買下，從而更有效地控制初期成本。

words.tip: lease from指租入；lease to指租給別人。

tr: n. 標記, 記號；嘜頭, 分數；檯面標誌
def: n. English businessman who created a retail chain (1888-1964)

tr: n. 低語, 低聲的怨言
vi. 低語, 低聲而言
低語聲；輕柔持續的聲音
def: v. speak softly or indistinctly
v. make complaining remarks or noises under one's breath
To speak in a quiet, gentle voice.

ex.en: She murmured a quiet thank you and smiled.
ex.zh: 她輕聲道了謝，露出微笑。

ex.en: A murmur of concern spread through the audience as the proposed library closures were announced.
ex.zh: 擬議的圖書館關閉計劃公佈時，聽眾中傳出一陣擔憂的低語。

col: a murmur of approval｜低聲贊同
words.tip: 強調輕柔低聲；mutter常帶不滿或含糊的意味。

tr: n. 器械, 用具, 應用
def: n. a device or control that is very useful for a particular job
n. durable goods for home or office use

tr: n. 標準度量, 計量器
vt. 精確計量, 估計
def: n. a measuring instrument for measuring and indicating a quantity such as the thickness of wire or the amount of rain etc.
n. accepted or approved instance or example of a quantity or quality against which others are judged or measured or compared
n. the distance between the rails of a railway or between the wheels of a train

ex.en: I dipped a toe in to gauge the water temperature.
ex.zh: 我把一隻腳趾伸進水裡，試了試水溫。

ex.en: Governments often use household surveys to gauge public satisfaction with healthcare, education, and other essential services.
ex.zh: 政府常通過住戶調查瞭解公眾對醫療、教育及其他基本服務的滿意程度。

col: gauge public opinion｜瞭解公眾意見
words.tip: 讀音同gage；既可用儀器測量，也可憑信息判斷。

def: n. a periodic count of the population
v. conduct a census
an official count of people that collects information about them

ex.en: We completed the census form at our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我們在廚房餐桌旁填好了人口普查表。

ex.en: Census data help governments plan housing, schools and healthcare services according to changing population needs.
ex.zh: 人口普查數據幫助政府根據不斷變化的人口需求規劃住房、學校和醫療服務。

col: conduct a census｜開展人口普查
a national census｜全國人口普查
words.tip: census調查全部人口，sample survey只抽樣。

tr: n. 軍, 隊, 部隊, 兵種
[醫] 對, 團; 體, 物體
def: n. an army unit usually consisting of two or more divisions and their support
n. a body of people associated together
a large military unit or branch with particular duties

ex.en: My cousin joined the medical corps after finishing university.
ex.zh: 我表親大學畢業後加入了軍隊醫療部隊。

ex.en: The diplomatic corps can support international cooperation by maintaining communication between governments during periods of tension.
ex.zh: 外交使團可以在緊張時期維持政府之間的溝通，從而支持國際合作。

words.tip: 單複數拼寫相同；單數不讀ps，複數詞尾讀/z/。

tr: vt. 居住於, 佔據, 棲息
def: v. be present in
To live in a particular place or environment

ex.en: Tiny crabs inhabit the rock pools near our house.
ex.zh: 我們家附近的岩石潮池裡棲息著小螃蟹。

ex.en: Many species that inhabit tropical forests face increasing pressure as agricultural expansion reduces the area of suitable habitat.
ex.zh: 隨著農業擴張使適宜棲息地縮小，許多棲息在熱帶森林中的物種面臨越來越大的壓力。

col: inhabit coastal waters｜棲息於近海水域
densely inhabited areas｜人口密集地區
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接地點，不加in。

def: n. a prescribed number
n. a proportional share assigned to each participant
n. a limitation on imports

ex.en: Our team reached its monthly sales quota yesterday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們團隊昨天下午完成了本月的銷售指標。

ex.en: Fishing quotas can protect marine populations, provided that governments monitor catches and enforce the limits consistently.
ex.zh: 只要政府監測捕撈量並始終嚴格執行限額，捕撈配額就能保護海洋生物種群。

col: meet a quota｜完成配額指標
words.tip: 既可指允許的上限，也可指必須完成的指標。

tr: n. 大步, 步幅, 步態, 進步
v. 邁大步走, 跨過, 跨
def: n. significant progress (especially in the phrase "make strides")
v. walk with long steps
v. cover or traverse by taking long steps

ex.en: Leila strode across the platform to catch her train.
ex.zh: 萊拉大步穿過站臺去趕火車。

ex.en: Many countries have made significant strides in improving access to primary education over recent decades.
ex.zh: 近幾十年來，許多國家在擴大初等教育機會方面取得了顯著進展。

col: stride across a room｜大步穿過房間
make great strides｜取得巨大進展
take something in your stride｜從容應對某事
words.tip: 過去式strode，過去分詞stridden；進展常用strides。

def: n. a passage selected from a larger work
v. take out of a literary work in order to cite or copy

tr: vt. 配音, 輕點, 授予稱號, 擊
n. 一下擊鼓聲, 笨蛋
def: n. the new sounds added by dubbing
v. give a nickname to
v. provide (movies) with a soundtrack of a foreign language

ex.en: They dubbed the cartoon into Spanish for younger viewers.
ex.zh: 他們為這部動畫片配上西班牙語，方便年幼觀眾觀看。

ex.en: Journalists have dubbed the new railway a lifeline for rural communities previously isolated from major employment centres.
ex.zh: 記者將這條新鐵路稱為鄉村社區的生命線，這些社區此前與主要就業中心相隔絕。

words.tip: 過去式dubbed；dub A B表示“稱A為B”。

tr: n. 一致, 調和, 協定
def: n. concurrence of opinion
n. sympathetic compatibility
v. allow to have

ex.en: The two clubs reached an accord over sharing equipment.
ex.zh: 兩傢俱樂部就共用器材達成了協議。

ex.en: An international accord on emissions could encourage countries to adopt cleaner technologies and protect vulnerable ecosystems.
ex.zh: 一項關於排放的國際協議可以鼓勵各國採用更清潔的技術，並保護脆弱的生態系統。

col: accord equal rights｜給予平等權利
words.tip: of your own accord意為自願地，無需別人要求。

tr: n. 吶喊聲, 標語, 口號
def: n a favorite saying of a sect or political group
a short memorable phrase promoting an idea, group, or product

ex.en: Our club chose a catchy slogan for its recycling campaign.
ex.zh: 我們社團為回收利用活動選了一句朗朗上口的口號。

ex.en: An effective environmental slogan can attract attention, but lasting behavioural change usually requires practical support.
ex.zh: 有效的環保口號能夠吸引注意，但持久的行為改變通常需要實際支持。

words.tip: slogan用於宣傳；motto多指座右銘或行為準則。

tr: a. 暴虐的, 極無禮的, 可惡的
def: s grossly offensive to decency or morality; causing horror
s greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation

tr: n. 痛苦, 悲慘, 不幸, 窮困
def: n. a state of ill-being due to affliction or misfortune
n. a feeling of intense unhappiness
great unhappiness or suffering

ex.en: The constant noise made her life a misery.
ex.zh: 持續不斷的噪聲讓她苦不堪言。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable housing can reduce the misery experienced by families living in overcrowded temporary accommodation.
ex.zh: 改善可負擔住房的供應，可以減輕住在擁擠臨時住所中的家庭所承受的痛苦。

col: make someone's life a misery｜使某人苦不堪言
words.tip: 通常不可數；a misery可指令人痛苦的處境。

tr: vt. 使沉溺, 使上癮
n. 入迷的人, 上癮者
def: n. someone who is so ardently devoted to something that it resembles an addiction
n. someone who is physiologically dependent on a substance; abrupt deprivation of the substance produces withdrawal symptoms
v. to cause (someone or oneself) to become dependent (on something, especially a narcotic drug)

tr: a. 邊緣的, 最低限度的, 有旁註的
def: s. producing at a rate that barely covers production costs
very small in amount, effect, or importance
outside the main or central part of something

ex.en: The new tyres made only a marginal difference.
ex.zh: 新輪胎帶來的變化微乎其微。

ex.en: Despite substantial investment, the programme produced only marginal improvements in public transport reliability across the city.
ex.zh: 儘管投入了大量資金，該項目對全市公共交通可靠性的改善仍十分有限。

words.tip: 表示變化時指幅度很小，不是完全沒有變化。

tr: n. 清潔, 掃除, 家畜的胞衣, 掃除出來的垃圾, 大敗, 輸得精光, 除伐, 鉅額利潤
def: n. the act of making something clean

tr: n. 冰雹, 致敬, 歡呼, 招呼
vt. 向...歡呼, 致敬, 招呼, 使象下雹樣落下
def: n. precipitation of ice pellets when there are strong rising air currents
n. many objects thrown forcefully through the air
n. enthusiastic greeting

ex.en: Hail rattled against the windows during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨中，冰雹打在窗戶上，發出噼啪聲。

ex.en: Scientists hailed the new irrigation system as a breakthrough that could help farmers conserve water during droughts.
ex.zh: 科學家稱讚這套新灌溉系統是一項突破，能幫助農民在乾旱期間節約用水。

col: hail a taxi｜招手叫出租車
be hailed as a breakthrough｜被譽為一項突破
words.tip: 下冰雹用it hails；hail A as B指稱讚A為B。

tr: vt. 通知, 通告, 報告
def: v inform (somebody) of something

tr: vt. 使活動, 使激活, 正式建成
def: v. make active or more active
v. make more adsorptive
v. aerate (sewage) so as to favor the growth of organisms that decompose organic matter

ex.en: Press this button to activate the outdoor lights.
ex.zh: 按這個按鈕就能打開室外的燈。

ex.en: Smart sensors can activate ventilation systems automatically when indoor air quality falls below acceptable levels.
ex.zh: 當室內空氣質量降至可接受水平以下時，智能傳感器可以自動啟動通風系統。

words.tip: 強調使設備或系統開始運作；反義詞為deactivate。

tr: vt. 發揮, 運用, 施以影響
[法] 施加, 產生, 行使
def: v. put to use
v. make a great effort at a mental or physical task
To apply force, influence, or authority.

ex.en: You must exert steady pressure to open this lid.
ex.zh: 你得持續用力才能打開這個蓋子。

ex.en: Parents can exert considerable influence on children's eating habits by preparing balanced meals at home.
ex.zh: 父母可以通過在家準備營養均衡的飯菜，對孩子的飲食習慣產生很大影響。

words.tip: 常接pressure、influence；exert oneself意為盡力。

tr: n. 穀類食品, 穀類植物
def: n. grass whose starchy grains are used as food: wheat; rice; rye; oats; maize; buckwheat; millet
n. a breakfast food prepared from grain
a. made of grain or relating to grain or the plants that produce it

ex.en: She poured cold milk over her bowl of cereal.
ex.zh: 她把冷牛奶倒進盛著早餐麥片的碗裡。

ex.en: Farmers may need to grow different cereal crops as changing rainfall patterns affect agricultural production.
ex.zh: 隨著降雨模式變化影響農業生產，農民可能需要種植不同的穀類作物。

col: a bowl of cereal｜一碗麥片
words.tip: 早餐食品泛指時常不可數；指穀物種類可用cereals。

def: n. breaking of hard tissue such as bone
n. the act of cracking something
v. violate or abuse

tr: n. 翻倒, 翻轉, 半圓酥餅, 營業額, 流通, 週轉
def: n. a dish made by folding a piece of pastry over a filling
the total value of a business's sales during a period
the rate at which employees leave and are replaced

ex.en: Our bakery's turnover rose after we started selling sandwiches.
ex.zh: 開始賣三明治後，我們麵包店的營業額提高了。

ex.en: High staff turnover can increase recruitment costs and make it difficult for companies to maintain consistent service.
ex.zh: 員工流動率過高會增加招聘成本，使企業難以維持穩定的服務水平。

col: high turnover｜高流動率；高營業額
words.tip: 營業額不等於利潤；美式英語此義常用revenue。

tr: a. 有感覺的, 敏感的, 明智的
def: a. able to feel or perceive
s. readily perceived by the senses
s. aware intuitively or intellectually of something sensed

ex.en: Taking an umbrella was sensible in this weather.
ex.zh: 這種天氣帶把傘是明智的。

ex.en: Investing in preventive healthcare is a sensible way to reduce pressure on public hospitals over time.
ex.zh: 投資預防性醫療是逐步減輕公立醫院壓力的明智之舉。

words.tip: sensible指明智的；sensitive指敏感的。

tr: n. 大片土地, 地帶, 小冊子
def: n. an extended area of land
n. a system of body parts that together serve some particular purpose
n. a brief treatise on a subject of interest; published in the form of a booklet

ex.en: They bought a small cottage beside a vast tract of woodland.
ex.zh: 他們在一大片林地旁買了一棟小屋。

ex.en: Large tracts of forest must be protected to preserve biodiversity and regulate the global climate.
ex.zh: 必須保護大片森林，以維護生物多樣性並調節全球氣候。

col: a tract of land｜一大片土地
vast tracts of forest｜大片森林
words.tip: 土地義常用a tract of；勿與track“軌道”混淆。

tr: n. 塊, 瘤, 很多, 腫塊, 笨人
vt. 使成塊狀, 混在一起
def: v. put together indiscriminately
A solid piece without a regular shape.
A swelling under the skin or in body tissue.

ex.en: She dropped a lump of clay onto the table.
ex.zh: 她把一團黏土放到了桌子上。

ex.en: Policymakers should not lump all unemployed people together, as their circumstances and support needs vary considerably.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不應把所有失業者一概而論，因為他們的處境和援助需求差異很大。

col: a lump of clay｜一團黏土
a lump sum｜一次性支付的款項
lump together｜不加區別地歸為一類
a lump in your throat｜哽咽感
words.tip: lump together常暗示忽略差異，籠統歸類。

tr: n. 衝突, 撞擊聲, 牴觸
def: n. a state of conflict between persons
n. a state of conflict between colors
v. be incompatible; be or come into conflict

ex.en: My dentist appointment clashes with our weekly team meeting.
ex.zh: 我預約的看牙時間與每週的團隊會議撞期了。

ex.en: A clash between economic priorities and environmental goals can delay decisions about major infrastructure projects.
ex.zh: 經濟優先事項與環境目標之間的衝突可能延誤重大基礎設施項目的決策。

col: a clash of interests｜利益衝突
a clash of cymbals｜鐃鈸撞擊聲
words.tip: clash with可指時間衝突、意見相左或顏色不搭。

def: n. any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk
A warm-blooded animal whose females produce milk for their young.

ex.en: A dolphin is a mammal, even though it lives underwater.
ex.zh: 海豚雖然生活在水下，卻是哺乳動物。

ex.en: Protecting marine mammals requires international cooperation because these animals often migrate across the waters of several countries.
ex.zh: 保護海洋哺乳動物需要國際合作，因為這些動物經常跨越多個國家的水域遷徙。

words.tip: 鯨和海豚也是哺乳動物；不能按棲息地判斷。

tr: vt. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 仿造
def: v. reproduce someone's behavior or looks
v. appear like, as in behavior or appearance
v. make a reproduction or copy of

ex.en: Our little sister loves to imitate animal sounds.
ex.zh: 我們的小妹妹喜歡模仿動物的叫聲。

ex.en: Young children often imitate adult behaviour, so parents play an important role in developing healthy habits.
ex.zh: 幼兒經常模仿成年人的行為，因此父母在培養健康習慣方面發揮著重要作用。

words.tip: 直接接模仿的對象，不加介詞：imitate someone。

tr: n. 結構, 表面配置, 外形, 配置
def: n. an arrangement of parts or elements
n. a silky densely piled fabric with a plain back
s. smooth and soft to sight or hearing or touch or taste
s. resembling velvet in having a smooth soft surface

tr: a. 聲名狼藉的, 臭名昭著的, 眾人皆知的
臭名昭著的；聲名狼藉的
def: s known widely and usually unfavorably;
widely known for something bad or undesirable

ex.en: That road is notorious for its deep potholes.
ex.zh: 那條路因坑窪很深而出了名。

ex.en: Cities notorious for severe air pollution often struggle to attract skilled workers and develop sustainable tourism.
ex.zh: 因嚴重空氣汙染而臭名昭著的城市往往難以吸引技術人才和發展可持續旅遊業。

words.tip: 通常含貶義；著名但非負面用famous，不宜用notorious。

tr: n. 鉛版, 立體照片
a. 立體的, 立體感覺的
def: n. reproducer in which two microphones feed two or more loudspeakers to give a three-dimensional effect to the sound
n. two photographs taken from slightly different angles that appear three-dimensional when viewed together
s of an instrument of certain death
able to cause death

ex.en: Some wild mushrooms contain toxins that can be lethal.
ex.zh: 有些野生蘑菇含有可能致命的毒素。

ex.en: Exposure to lethal concentrations of air pollutants highlights the importance of strict industrial safety regulations.
ex.zh: 接觸致命濃度的空氣汙染物，凸顯了嚴格工業安全法規的重要性。

words.tip: 通常作形容詞；lethal 強調具有致死能力。

tr: vt. 使成為必需, 需要, 使承擔, 遺傳給
def: n. land received by fee tail
n. the act of entailing property; the creation of a fee tail from a fee simple
v. have as a logical consequence

ex.en: This new job entails working some evenings and weekends.
ex.zh: 這份新工作需要在一些晚上和週末上班。

ex.en: Expanding public transport will entail substantial initial costs, although the environmental and social benefits may justify this investment.
ex.zh: 擴建公共交通必然涉及大量前期費用，但其環境和社會效益可能使這項投資值得。

words.tip: 後接名詞或動名詞：entail doing，不接to do。

tr: vi. 打漩, 盤繞, 眩暈
def: n the shape of something rotating rapidly
v turn in a twisting or spinning motion
v flow in a circular current, of liquids

ex.en: Dry leaves swirled around my feet in the wind.
ex.zh: 乾枯的樹葉在風中繞著我的腳打轉。

ex.en: Dust can swirl through urban streets during construction, reducing air quality and causing discomfort for nearby residents.
ex.zh: 施工時，灰塵可能在城市街道中盤旋，降低空氣質量，並讓附近居民感到不適。

col: a swirl of smoke｜一縷盤旋的煙
words.tip: 可作及物或不及物動詞，強調流動中的旋轉。

tr: n. 娛樂, 分心的事物, 分心
[醫] 注意力分散, 內脫位, 牙弓過寬
def: n. mental turmoil
n. an obstacle to attention
n. the act of distracting; drawing someone's attention away from something

ex.en: The television is a distraction when I do homework.
ex.zh: 我做作業時，電視會讓我分心。

ex.en: Reducing digital distractions in classrooms may help students concentrate and engage more deeply with challenging material.
ex.zh: 減少課堂上的數字設備干擾，可能有助於學生集中注意力，更深入地學習有難度的內容。

col: a welcome distraction｜令人愉快的消遣
words.tip: 具體干擾物可數；表示分心狀態時通常不可數。

tr: n. 投擲, 急衝, 嘲弄
vt. 投, 丟下, 拋棄, 使陷入, 揮動, 嘲笑, 掃視
def: n. the act of flinging
v. throw with force or recklessness
v. move in an abrupt or headlong manner

ex.en: He flung his muddy boots into the empty bucket.
ex.zh: 他把沾滿泥的靴子猛地扔進了空桶。

ex.en: During severe storms, powerful winds can fling loose debris across roads, creating serious hazards for drivers and pedestrians.
ex.zh: 在強風暴中，狂風可能將散落的碎物刮到道路上，給司機和行人帶來嚴重危險。

col: fling open a door｜猛地推開門
fling your arms around someone｜張開雙臂抱住某人
fling yourself into something｜全身心投入某事
a final fling｜最後一次盡情享樂
words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為flung，強調動作猛烈。

def: n. any animals kept for use or profit
farm animals kept for food, materials, or work

ex.en: The farmer moved the livestock into a sheltered field.
ex.zh: 農民把牲畜趕進了一塊有遮蔽的田地。

ex.en: Raising livestock requires substantial land and water resources, which can increase pressure on ecosystems in dry regions.
ex.zh: 飼養牲畜需要大量土地和水資源，這可能加劇乾旱地區生態系統的壓力。

words.tip: 集合名詞，不加-s；表示活的農場動物。

tr: v. 漫遊, 閒逛, 徜徉
def: v move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment
To move around freely without a fixed route or destination.

ex.en: We roamed through the market until our feet hurt.
ex.zh: 我們在市場裡閒逛，直到走得腳疼。

ex.en: Protected wildlife corridors allow large animals to roam freely between habitats without crossing busy roads.
ex.zh: 受保護的野生動物廊道讓大型動物無需穿越繁忙道路，就能在棲息地之間自由活動。

words.tip: 可直接接地點，也可用roam around或through。

tr: n. 繼承人, 嗣子, 後嗣
def: n. a person who is entitled by law or by the terms of a will to inherit the estate of another

tr: n. 泡沫, 水沫, 泡沫材料
vi. 起泡沫, 吐白沫
def: n. a mass of small bubbles formed in or on a liquid
n. a lightweight material in cellular form; made by introducing gas bubbles during manufacture
v. become bubbly or frothy or foaming

ex.en: White foam covered my hands as I washed the dishes.
ex.zh: 洗碗時，白色泡沫蓋滿了我的雙手。

ex.en: Manufacturers often use foam packaging to protect fragile goods, although some types are difficult to recycle.
ex.zh: 製造商常用泡沫包裝保護易碎商品，但某些泡沫材料難以回收。

words.tip: foam作泡沫或泡沫材料時通常不可數。

tr: n. 抵消, 把...並列, 旁系, 支管, 用膠印法印
vt. 彌補, 抵消, 膠印
def: n. a plate makes an inked impression on a rubber-blanketed cylinder, which in turn transfers it to the paper
v. compensate for or counterbalance
v. cause (printed matter) to transfer or smear onto another surface

ex.en: My shorter commute offsets the higher rent here.
ex.zh: 通勤時間縮短彌補了這裡租金較高的不足。

ex.en: Planting trees can offset some carbon emissions, but reducing fossil fuel consumption remains essential.
ex.zh: 植樹可以抵消一部分碳排放，但減少化石燃料消耗仍然至關重要。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞仍為offset；現在分詞為offsetting。

tr: a. 禿頭的, 光禿的, 單調的, 赤裸的
def: v. grow bald; lose hair on one's head
s. with no effort to conceal
s. lacking hair on all or most of the scalp

ex.en: My uncle is bald and always wears a hat.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是禿頭，總是戴著帽子。

ex.en: Driving with bald tyres increases the risk of accidents, particularly when roads are wet or icy.
ex.zh: 使用磨光的輪胎駕駛會增加事故風險，尤其是在道路溼滑或結冰時。

words.tip: bald指禿頭；bold指大膽的，注意拼寫和發音。

def: n. an expectation
n. something expected (as on the basis of a norm)
n. anticipating with confidence of fulfillment
a. having or deserving or conferring glory
s. having great beauty and splendor
Deserving great admiration or bringing honour and pride.

ex.en: We spent a glorious afternoon swimming in the lake.
ex.zh: 我們在湖裡游泳，度過了一個美好的下午。

ex.en: Museums should examine difficult historical events as carefully as they celebrate a nation's glorious achievements.
ex.zh: 博物館應像頌揚一個國家的輝煌成就一樣，認真審視艱難的歷史事件。

words.tip: glorious既可指值得榮耀，也可讚美天氣或景色。

tr: a. 脆的, 新鮮的, 活潑的
def: s. (of something seen or heard) clearly defined
s. tender and brittle
s. pleasantly cold and invigorating

ex.en: The apple was crisp and sweet with every bite.
ex.zh: 這個蘋果每咬一口都又脆又甜。

ex.en: Packaging helps keep snacks crisp, but excessive use of plastic creates significant environmental problems.
ex.zh: 包裝有助於保持零食酥脆，但過度使用塑料會造成嚴重的環境問題。

col: a packet of crisps｜一包薯片
words.tip: 薯片英式常用複數crisps，美式說potato chips。

tr: [法] 剝奪, 剝奪, 奪去
def: v. take away possessions from someone
v. keep from having, keeping, or obtaining
v. take away

ex.en: The noisy roadworks deprived us of sleep all week.
ex.zh: 吵鬧的道路施工讓我們整個星期都睡不好。

ex.en: Unequal access to technology can deprive disadvantaged students of valuable opportunities to develop essential digital skills.
ex.zh: 獲取技術資源的機會不平等，可能使弱勢學生失去培養必要數字技能的寶貴機會。

col: deprive someone of something｜剝奪某人的某物
deprive someone of sleep｜使某人無法睡眠
deprive someone of opportunities｜使某人失去機會
words.tip: 固定結構deprive sb of sth，介詞用of。

tr: a. 緊湊的, 緊密的, 簡潔的
vt. 使緊密結合, 壓縮
def: n. a small cosmetics case with a mirror; to be carried in a woman's purse
n. a small and economical car
v. have the property of being packable or of compacting easily

tr: n. 抄本, 副本, 成績單
[法] 法院文本, 官方記錄, 記錄的副本
def: n. something that has been transcribed; a written record (usually typewritten) of dictated or recorded speech
n. a reproduction of a written record (e.g. of a legal or school record)
a written record of words spoken in a conversation or recording

ex.en: I read the transcript while listening to the interview.
ex.zh: 我一邊聽訪談，一邊閱讀文字記錄。

ex.en: Researchers checked each interview transcript carefully before analysing participants' views on public transport services.
ex.zh: 研究人員仔細核對每份訪談記錄後，才分析參與者對公共交通服務的看法。

col: a full transcript｜完整文字記錄
words.tip: transcript可指錄音轉寫稿，也可指學校成績單。

tr: vi. 繁榮, 茂盛, 活躍, 手舞足蹈
n. 揮舞, 炫耀, 茂盛, 興旺, 華麗詞藻
def: n. a showy gesture
n. an ornamental embellishment in writing
n. a display of ornamental speech or language

ex.en: These herbs flourish on our warm, sunny kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 這些香草在我們廚房溫暖、陽光充足的窗臺上長得很旺。

ex.en: Small businesses are more likely to flourish when local governments provide affordable premises and reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 地方政府提供價格合理的經營場所和可靠的公共交通時，小企業更容易蓬勃發展。

col: a flourishing business｜生意興隆的企業
with a flourish｜以誇張的動作
words.tip: 表繁榮時是不及物動詞，不直接接賓語。

tr: n. 用力拉, 拖曳, 苦幹, 掙扎, 繩索
def: n. a sudden abrupt pull
v. pull hard
v. strive and make an effort to reach a goal

tr: vi. 顫抖, 哆嗦, 被打碎
vt. 使迎風飄動, 粉碎
def: v. shake, as from cold
To shake slightly because of cold, fear, or excitement
A brief shaking movement caused by cold or strong emotion

ex.en: I shivered while waiting outside in my thin jacket.
ex.zh: 我穿著單薄的夾克在外面等候，凍得直髮抖。

ex.en: People may shiver when exposed to low temperatures, as muscle movements help the body generate heat.
ex.zh: 人在低溫環境中可能會發抖，因為肌肉運動有助於身體產生熱量。

col: a shiver down your spine｜脊背一陣發涼
words.tip: 常用shiver with cold或fear表示發抖原因。

tr: n. 團結, 團結一致, 共同一致
def: n. a union of interests or purposes or sympathies among members of a group
Unity and mutual support among people with shared interests.

ex.en: Neighbours showed solidarity by repairing the damaged playground together.
ex.zh: 鄰居們一起修復受損的遊樂場，體現了團結精神。

ex.en: Community projects can strengthen social solidarity by bringing residents from different backgrounds together to solve shared problems.
ex.zh: 社區項目能讓不同背景的居民共同解決問題，從而增強社會凝聚力。

words.tip: 常接with，表示與某人或群體團結一致。

tr: vt. 卸下, 放出, 解僱, 拔染, 履行, 放電
n. 卸貨, 流出, 放電
def: n. the sudden giving off of energy
n. the act of venting
n. a substance that is emitted or released

tr: n. 旋轉, 轉彎處, 車削工作
def: n. act of changing in practice or custom
n. a shaving created when something is produced by turning it on a lathe
n. a movement in a new direction

ex.en: Take the next turning after the small bakery.
ex.zh: 過了那家小麵包店，在下一個路口轉彎。

ex.en: Poor visibility at this turning increases the risk of accidents for cyclists and other road users.
ex.zh: 這個轉彎處視野不佳，增加了騎車者和其他道路使用者發生事故的風險。

col: miss a turning｜錯過轉彎路口
a turning on the left｜左側的岔路口
words.tip: 表示岔路口時主要用於英式英語；也是turn的-ing形式。

tr: n. 鞍, 馬鞍, 車座, 鞍狀物
vt. 裝以馬鞍, 使負擔
def: n. a seat for the rider of a horse or camel
n. cut of meat (especially mutton or lamb) consisting of part of the backbone and both loins
n. a piece of leather across the instep of a shoe

ex.en: I lowered the saddle before riding my new bicycle.
ex.zh: 騎新自行車之前，我把車座調低了。

ex.en: Excessive university fees can saddle graduates with debts that limit their career choices for many years.
ex.zh: 過高的大學學費可能讓畢業生揹負債務，多年來限制他們的職業選擇。

col: be saddled with debt｜揹負債務
words.tip: saddle someone with指使某人承擔不想要的負擔。

tr: n. 發生, 事件, 出現
def: n. an instance of something occurring
something that happens, especially something noticeable
the fact of something happening or being present

ex.en: Power cuts are a rare occurrence in our village.
ex.zh: 我們村很少停電。

ex.en: Improved drainage systems can reduce the occurrence of flooding in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 改進排水系統可以減少人口稠密城區的洪澇發生。

col: a frequent occurrence｜經常發生的事
the occurrence of disease｜疾病的發生
words.tip: 事件義可數；發生義不可數；注意雙寫rr。

tr: n. 黨羽, 虔誠信徒, 同黨, 游擊隊員
a. 黨派的, 偏袒的, 效忠的, 獻身的, 盲目推崇的
def: n. a fervent and even militant proponent of something
n. a pike with a long tapering double-edged blade with lateral projections; 16th and 17th centuries
a. devoted to a cause or party

tr: a. 俯伏的, 面向下的, 有...傾向的
[醫] 旋前的, 伏的, 俯的
def: s. having a tendency (to); often used in combination
s. lying face downward
Likely to experience something undesirable or behave a certain way

ex.en: My skin is prone to dryness in cold weather.
ex.zh: 我的皮膚在寒冷天氣裡容易乾燥。

ex.en: Coastal settlements are increasingly prone to flooding as sea levels rise and extreme storms become more frequent.
ex.zh: 隨著海平面上升和極端風暴日益頻繁，沿海居民區越來越容易遭受洪災。

words.tip: prone to後接名詞或動名詞，通常指不好的情況。

tr: n. 水管, 橡皮軟管, 長統襪
def: n. man's close-fitting garment of the 16th and 17th centuries covering the legs and reaching up to the waist; worn with a doublet
n. a flexible pipe for conveying a liquid or gas
v. water with a hose

ex.en: I used the hose to wash my muddy boots.
ex.zh: 我用水管沖洗了沾滿泥的靴子。

ex.en: During periods of drought, restricting garden hose use can help households conserve valuable water supplies.
ex.zh: 在乾旱期間，限制使用花園水管有助於家庭節約寶貴的水資源。

col: hose something down｜用水管徹底沖洗某物
words.tip: hose指柔軟可彎的管子；pipe通常指較硬的管道。

tr: a. 巨大的, 優秀的, 可怕的, 艱難的
def: s. extremely impressive in strength or excellence
s. inspiring fear

tr: n. 英里（1英里約合1609米, mile的複數形式）
def: n a unit of length equal to 1,760 yards or 5,280 feet; exactly 1609.344 meters
n a unit of length used in navigation; exactly 1,852 meters; historically based on the distance spanned by one minute of arc in latitude
n a large distance

tr: vt. 動員, 調動, 使流通
def: v. make ready for action or use
v. get ready for war
v. cause to move around

ex.en: Our neighbours mobilized volunteers to clean the local beach.
ex.zh: 鄰居們動員志願者清理了當地的海灘。

ex.en: Governments must mobilize financial resources and trained staff quickly when natural disasters threaten vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 當自然災害威脅到脆弱社區時，政府必須迅速調動資金和受過培訓的人員。

words.tip: 英式也拼作mobilise；常接資源、支持者或軍隊。

tr: a. 精力充沛的, 元氣旺盛的, 茁壯的, 有力的
def: s. characterized by forceful and energetic action or activity
s. strong and active physically or mentally

tr: n. 平衡, 均衡, 姿勢, 鎮靜, 安靜, 砝碼
vt. 使平衡, 使懸著, 保持...姿勢
vi. 平衡, 懸著, 準備好
def: n. a cgs unit of dynamic viscosity equal to one dyne-second per square centimeter; the viscosity of a fluid in which a force of one dyne per square centimeter maintains a velocity of 1 centimeter per second
n. a state of being balanced in a stable equilibrium
v. be motionless, in suspension

tr: a. 丈夫的, 婚姻的, 夫婦間的
def: a. of or relating to the state of marriage

tr: a. 邪惡的, 墮落的, 品性不端的, 惡毒的, 惡性的, 有錯誤的
def: s (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
s having the nature of vice
s bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure

ex.en: A vicious dog growled behind the tall metal fence.
ex.zh: 一隻兇猛的狗在高高的金屬圍欄後低吼。

ex.en: Vicious comments on social media can damage young people's confidence and discourage participation in online discussions.
ex.zh: 社交媒體上的惡毒評論可能損害年輕人的自信，使他們不願參與網上討論。

words.tip: vicious circle指問題互相加劇的“惡性循環”。

tr: n. 環境, 周圍的事物
def: n the environmental condition
n the area in which something exists or lives
v extend on all sides of simultaneously; encircle

ex.en: We ate lunch in the peaceful surroundings of the garden.
ex.zh: 我們在花園寧靜的環境中吃了午飯。

ex.en: Students may concentrate better in pleasant surroundings, especially when classrooms offer natural light and views of greenery.
ex.zh: 學生在舒適的環境中可能更容易集中注意力，尤其當教室採光自然且窗外有綠植時。

words.tip: 始終用複數形式，作主語時謂語也用複數。

tr: n. 氣味, 臭氣, 香氣, 味道, 跡象, 名譽, 聲譽
def: n the sensation that results when olfactory receptors in the nose are stimulated by particular chemicals in gaseous form
n any property detected by the olfactory system
A noticeable smell, especially an unpleasant one.

ex.en: A strange odour came from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 廚房垃圾桶裡飄出一股怪味。

ex.en: Residents may oppose new waste facilities if they expect unpleasant odours to affect their quality of life.
ex.zh: 如果居民預計難聞的氣味會影響生活質量，他們可能會反對新建垃圾處理設施。

words.tip: 英式拼寫odour，美式odor；常指難聞氣味。

tr: n. 楔子, 楔形物, 起因, 導致分裂的東西
vt. 楔住, 擠進, 楔入
def: n. any shape that is triangular in cross section
n. (golf) an iron with considerable loft and a broad sole
n. something solid that is usable as an inclined plane (shaped like a V) that can be pushed between two things to separate them

ex.en: He slid a wooden wedge under the heavy door.
ex.zh: 他把一個木楔塞到沉重的門下面。

ex.en: Disagreements over resource allocation can drive a wedge between neighbouring communities and weaken regional cooperation.
ex.zh: 資源分配上的分歧可能導致相鄰社區失和，並削弱區域合作。

col: a wedge of cheese｜一塊楔形奶酪
wedge the door open｜用楔子撐住門
drive a wedge between｜使……之間產生隔閡
words.tip: drive a wedge between 比喻挑起隔閡或分裂。

tr: n. 擾亂, 不安, 憂慮
[化] 擾動; 干擾; 失調
def: n. an unhappy and worried mental state
n. a disorderly outburst or tumult
n. the act of disturbing something or someone; setting something in motion

ex.en: The drilling upstairs caused a disturbance during our dinner.
ex.zh: 樓上的鑽孔聲打擾了我們吃晚飯。

ex.en: Construction near protected wetlands can cause significant disturbance to nesting birds, particularly during the breeding season.
ex.zh: 在受保護溼地附近施工可能嚴重干擾築巢的鳥類，尤其是在繁殖季節。

words.tip: disturbance可指安寧被打破，也可指身體功能紊亂。

tr: a. 藥學的, 製藥的, 藥用的, 藥物的, 藥劑師的, 藥師的
n. 藥品, 成藥, 藥劑
def: n. drug or medicine that is prepared or dispensed in pharmacies and used in medical treatment
a. of or relating to pharmacy or pharmacists
a. of or relating to drugs used in medical treatment

ex.en: My sister works in a pharmaceutical research laboratory.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家藥物研究實驗室工作。

ex.en: Pharmaceutical companies should ensure that essential medicines remain affordable for patients in poorer communities.
ex.zh: 製藥公司應確保較貧困社區的患者仍能負擔得起基本藥物。

words.tip: 作名詞常用複數 pharmaceuticals，泛指藥品。

tr: n. 空閒, 閒暇, 悠閒
a. 空閒的, 有閒的
def: n. time available for ease and relaxation
n. freedom to choose a pastime or enjoyable activity
Time when you are free from work or other duties.

ex.en: She spends most of her leisure time in the garden.
ex.zh: 她把大部分閒暇時間都花在花園裡。

ex.en: Public parks provide affordable spaces for leisure, helping urban residents relax and maintain social connections.
ex.zh: 公共公園提供了經濟實惠的休閒空間，幫助城市居民放鬆並維持社交聯繫。

col: at your leisure｜在你方便時；從容地
words.tip: leisure通常不可數；leisure time指閒暇時間。

def: n. a standard or typical example
An early model used to test and develop a product.
To create an early model for testing and improvement.

ex.en: The designer showed us a prototype of her folding chair.
ex.zh: 設計師向我們展示了她設計的摺疊椅樣品。

ex.en: Testing a prototype allows engineers to identify design weaknesses before a product enters mass production.
ex.zh: 測試原型讓工程師能在產品投入大規模生產前發現設計缺陷。

col: a working prototype｜可運行的原型
words.tip: 通常指用於測試改進的早期模型，並非最終產品。

tr: [醫] 贄生物, 贄疣, 增殖體; 生長, 增殖
def: n. all the plant life in a particular region or period
n. the process of growth in plants
n. an abnormal growth or excrescence (especially a warty excrescence on the valves of the heart)

ex.en: Thick vegetation hid the narrow path beside the river.
ex.zh: 茂密的植被遮住了河邊的狹窄小路。

ex.en: Removing natural vegetation increases soil erosion and reduces the capacity of land to absorb heavy rainfall.
ex.zh: 清除天然植被會加劇水土流失，並降低土地吸收強降雨的能力。

words.tip: 不可數名詞，泛指某地區植物，不等於蔬菜。

tr: vt. 發出, 放射, 發表(意見等), 散發, 發行
def: v. expel (gases or odors)
v. give off, send forth, or discharge; as of light, heat, or radiation, vapor, etc.
to release gas, heat, light, or sound

ex.en: These small lamps emit a soft, warm light.
ex.zh: 這些小燈發出柔和溫暖的光。

ex.en: Factories that emit harmful gases should install cleaner technology to reduce their impact on public health.
ex.zh: 排放有害氣體的工廠應安裝更清潔的技術設備，以減少對公眾健康的影響。

col: emit greenhouse gases｜排放溫室氣體
words.tip: 過去式 emitted，進行式 emitting，均雙寫 t。

tr: [法] 藐視, 侮辱, 輕視
def: n. lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
n. a manner that is generally disrespectful and contemptuous
n. open disrespect for a person or thing

ex.en: He showed contempt for my suggestion by laughing.
ex.zh: 他用嘲笑來表示對我建議的輕蔑。

ex.en: When officials treat public concerns with contempt, trust in democratic institutions can decline significantly.
ex.zh: 當官員輕視公眾的關切時，人們對民主制度的信任可能顯著下降。

col: treat someone with contempt｜輕蔑地對待某人
words.tip: contempt for指鄙視某人或某事；通常不可數。

tr: [經] 出借者, 貸方, 貸款人
def: n. someone who lends money or gives credit in business matters
n. detachable compartment of a spacecraft
n. computer circuit consisting of an assembly of electronic components (as of computer hardware)
n. a self-contained component (unit or item) that is used in combination with other components

ex.en: We finished the photography module with an outdoor project.
ex.zh: 我們以一個戶外項目完成了攝影單元的學習。

ex.en: Universities increasingly offer a compulsory module on digital skills to prepare students for changing workplace demands.
ex.zh: 越來越多的大學開設數字技能必修模塊，以幫助學生應對不斷變化的職場需求。

col: complete a module｜完成一個課程單元
words.tip: 課程中的module是獨立單元，通常包含多節課。

def: n. a piece of braid, usually on the sleeve, indicating military rank or length of service
n. a kind or category
n. a narrow marking of a different color or texture from the background

tr: a. 有力的, 有說服力的, 有效的
[醫] 有力的, 有性交能力的
def: s. having great influence
s. having or wielding force or authority
a. having a strong physiological or chemical effect

ex.en: This potent medicine relieved my cough within an hour.
ex.zh: 這種強效藥不到一小時就緩解了我的咳嗽。

ex.en: Public education can be a potent tool for reducing waste and encouraging more sustainable consumption.
ex.zh: 公眾教育可以成為減少浪費和鼓勵更可持續消費的有力工具。

words.tip: 強調效力或影響強，不等於potential“潛在的”。

tr: a. 最初的, 最重要的
def: s. preceding all others in spatial position
s. situated closest to the bow
r. prominently forward

tr: v. 大叫, 呼喊, 大聲叫
def: v. utter aloud; often with surprise, horror, or joy
to say something suddenly and loudly because of strong emotion

ex.en: “What a beautiful rainbow!” she exclaimed, pointing towards the hills.
ex.zh: “多美的彩虹啊！”她指著群山驚歎道。

ex.en: Visitors often exclaim in surprise when museum displays reveal the impressive engineering skills of ancient societies.
ex.zh: 當博物館展品展現古代社會令人讚歎的工程技藝時，參觀者往往驚歎不已。

words.tip: 強調因強烈情緒突然出聲，常用於引述話語。

tr: a. 不利的, 敵對的, 相反的, 逆的
[法] 相反的, 敵對的, 逆的
def: s. contrary to your interests or welfare
s. in an opposing direction
Harmful or making success and progress more difficult.

ex.en: Our ferry was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
ex.zh: 由於天氣惡劣，我們的渡輪航班取消了。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can have adverse effects on residents' sleep and mental health.
ex.zh: 長期接觸交通噪聲可能對居民的睡眠和心理健康產生不良影響。

col: adverse weather conditions｜惡劣天氣狀況
words.tip: adverse指不利的；averse指反感的，常接to。

def: v to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth
v do something to an excessive degree

tr: a. 嫉妒的, 羨慕的, 留心的, 戒備的
因擔心失去愛而吃醋的
def: s. suspicious or unduly suspicious or fearful of being displaced by a rival
unhappy because someone has something you want
upset because someone you love shows interest in another person

ex.en: I felt jealous when my cousin got a bicycle.
ex.zh: 表弟得到一輛自行車時，我心裡很嫉妒。

ex.en: Social media can make users jealous of others whose lives appear more successful or exciting.
ex.zh: 社交媒體可能讓用戶嫉妒那些生活看起來更成功或更精彩的人。

col: a jealous partner｜愛吃醋的伴侶
words.tip: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

tr: n. 牧場, 草地, 牧草
def: n. a field covered with grass or herbage and suitable for grazing by livestock
Land covered with grass where farm animals feed.
To put animals on grassland so they can feed.

ex.en: The cows wandered across the green pasture after sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出後，牛群在綠色的牧草地上漫步。

ex.en: Converting forests into pasture can reduce biodiversity and increase greenhouse gas emissions from land use.
ex.zh: 將森林改為牧場可能減少生物多樣性，並增加土地利用產生的溫室氣體排放。

col: put cattle out to pasture｜把牛趕到牧場放牧
words.tip: pasture強調供牲畜吃草的土地，不是普通草坪。

tr: n. 沼澤, 進退兩難的困境
vt. 淹沒, 擊潰, 清除, 使陷於沼澤
vi. 陷於沼澤, 淹沒
def: n. low land that is seasonally flooded; has more woody plants than a marsh and better drainage than a bog
n. a situation fraught with difficulties and imponderables
v. drench or submerge or be drenched or submerged

tr: n. 掌舵, 操縱, 指導
def: n. the act of setting and holding a course
n. the act of steering a ship

tr: a. 深思熟慮的, 故意的, 從容的
def: s. carefully thought out in advance
Done intentionally rather than by accident.
Slow and careful, rather than hurried.

ex.en: Leaving my phone at home was a deliberate choice.
ex.zh: 把手機留在家裡是我有意做出的選擇。

ex.en: Local authorities should deliberate carefully before approving developments that could permanently damage natural habitats.
ex.zh: 地方政府在批准可能永久破壞自然棲息地的開發項目之前，應仔細斟酌。

col: deliberate on a proposal｜仔細考慮提案
words.tip: 形容詞末尾讀/ət/，動詞末尾讀/eɪt/。

tr: vt. 以餌引誘, 欺負
def: n. anything that serves as an enticement
