n. something used to lure fish or other animals into danger so they can be trapped or killed
v. lure, entice, or entrap with bait

ex.en: We used small pieces of bread as bait.
ex.zh: 我們用小塊麵包作魚餌。

ex.en: Some online advertisements use free gifts as bait to encourage consumers to share their personal information.
ex.zh: 一些網絡廣告用免費禮品作誘餌，誘使消費者分享個人信息。

words.tip: take the bait既可指魚咬鉤，也可比喻中計。

tr: n. 用法, 使用, 習慣, 慣用法, 習慣法
[經] 使用情況, 使用用途, 慣例
def: n. the customary manner in which a language (or a form of a language) is spoken or written
The way or amount that something is used.
The customary way words or phrases are used in language.

ex.en: My phone tracks my daily data usage automatically.
ex.zh: 我的手機會自動記錄我每天的數據使用量。

ex.en: Installing efficient appliances can reduce household energy usage without requiring major changes to everyday routines.
ex.zh: 安裝高效電器可以減少家庭能源使用量，而無需大幅改變日常習慣。

words.tip: usage重在使用量、使用方式或語言慣用法。

tr: a. 悲傷的, 痛的, 引起痛苦的
n. 痛處, 潰瘍, 瘡
def: n. an open skin infection
painful, especially when touched or moved
a painful damaged area on the skin

ex.en: My legs are sore after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很遠的路，我的腿現在痠痛。

ex.en: Office workers may develop sore muscles if they remain seated without taking regular breaks.
ex.zh: 上班族如果久坐而不定時休息，可能會出現肌肉痠痛。

words.tip: sore常修飾身體部位，如a sore throat。

tr: n. 誓約, 誓言, 咒罵
[法] 誓言, 誓約, 宣誓
def: n. a commitment to tell the truth (especially in a court of law); to lie under oath is to become subject to prosecution for perjury
n. a solemn promise, usually invoking a divine witness, regarding your future acts or behavior
A formal promise to tell the truth or fulfil a duty.

ex.en: The witness took an oath before answering any questions.
ex.zh: 證人在回答任何問題之前先宣了誓。

ex.en: Public officials who swear an oath to serve society should remain accountable for their decisions and conduct.
ex.zh: 宣誓為社會服務的公職人員應對自己的決策和行為負責。

words.tip: under oath指已宣誓說真話，常用於法庭語境。

tr: vt. 禁止出入港口, 禁運
def: n. a government order imposing a trade barrier
v. ban the publication of (documents), as for security or copyright reasons
v. prevent commerce

tr: a. 直立的, 豎立的, 筆直的
vt. 使豎立, 使直立, 樹立, 建立
def: a. upright in position or posture
to build something or put it in an upright position
standing straight up rather than bending or lying down

ex.en: We erected our tent beside the lake before sunset.
ex.zh: 日落前，我們在湖邊搭好了帳篷。

ex.en: Local authorities plan to erect temporary shelters for families whose homes were damaged by severe flooding.
ex.zh: 地方政府計劃搭建臨時住所，安置房屋因嚴重洪災受損的家庭。

words.tip: 動詞比 build 正式；形容詞常見於 stand erect。

def: n the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable
n lack of an adequate quantity or number
A lack of enough of something necessary.

ex.en: A blood test revealed that I had an iron deficiency.
ex.zh: 驗血結果顯示我缺鐵。

ex.en: Nutritional deficiency among children can affect physical growth and reduce their ability to concentrate at school.
ex.zh: 兒童營養不足可能影響身體發育，並降低他們在學校集中注意力的能力。

words.tip: 缺某物用deficiency in；具體缺陷常用複數。

tr: 模糊的影像；模糊的記憶
def: n. a hazy or indistinct representation
v. to make less distinct or clear
v. make dim or indistinct

ex.en: Tears blurred my vision as the train pulled away.
ex.zh: 火車駛離時，淚水模糊了我的視線。

ex.en: Working from home can blur the boundary between professional responsibilities and personal life, increasing stress.
ex.zh: 居家辦公可能模糊工作職責與個人生活之間的界限，增加壓力。

col: a blur of colour｜一片模糊的色彩
words.tip: 常指視線或界限模糊；不是“汙點”的常用譯法。

tr: n. 登記, 註冊, 入伍
def: n the act of enrolling
n the body of people (such as students) who register or enroll at the same time

tr: a. 不同的, 雜色的, 各式各樣的
[法] 不同的, 種種的, 變化的
def: a. characterized by variety
s. widely different
s. broken away from sameness or identity or duplication
v. calculate a derivative; take the derivative
v. become different during development
v. become distinct and acquire a different character

ex.en: Can you differentiate these two birds by their songs?
ex.zh: 你能根據鳴叫聲分辨這兩種鳥嗎？

ex.en: Schools should teach students to differentiate between reliable evidence and unsupported claims in online media.
ex.zh: 學校應教學生區分網絡媒體中可靠的證據和缺乏依據的說法。

col: differentiate A from B｜區分甲與乙
words.tip: 常用differentiate between A and B。

tr: n. 連續, 繼承權, 繼位, 演替, 地層次序
[法] 繼承, 繼承權, 繼位
def: n. a group of people or things arranged or following in order
n. the action of following in order
n. (ecology) the gradual and orderly process of change in an ecosystem brought about by the progressive replacement of one community by another until a stable climax is established

tr: n. 剩餘, 零料, 遺蹟
a. 剩餘的, 殘餘的
def: n a small part or portion that remains after the main part no longer exists
n a piece of cloth that is left over after the rest has been used or sold
a small part remaining after most has disappeared or been removed

ex.en: Only a remnant of the old wall still stands.
ex.zh: 那堵舊牆只剩下一小段還立著。

ex.en: Protecting remnants of ancient woodland can preserve habitats that support rare species and maintain local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 保護古老林地的殘存部分，可以保留珍稀物種的棲息地並維護當地生物多樣性。

col: a remnant of the past｜過去的遺存
words.tip: 常用a remnant of；複數remnants強調殘留的各部分。

tr: vt. 膠合, 用水泥塗
def: n. concrete pavement is sometimes referred to as cement
n. a building material that is a powder made of a mixture of calcined limestone and clay; used with water and sand or gravel to make concrete and mortar
n. something that hardens to act as adhesive material

ex.en: The builder mixed cement and water in a bucket.
ex.zh: 建築工人在桶裡攪拌水泥和水。

ex.en: Joint research projects can cement relationships between universities and encourage the exchange of scientific knowledge.
ex.zh: 聯合研究項目可以鞏固大學之間的關係，並促進科學知識的交流。

col: a bag of cement｜一袋水泥
words.tip: cement是水泥；concrete是含水泥、砂石的混凝土。

def: n. an estimation that is too low; an estimate that is less than the true or actual value
v. make too low an estimate of
To judge something as less important, capable, or large than reality

ex.en: We underestimated the traffic and arrived half an hour late.
ex.zh: 我們低估了交通擁堵程度，結果遲到了半小時。

ex.en: Policymakers should not underestimate the long-term effects of poor housing on children's health and educational achievement.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不應低估惡劣住房條件對兒童健康和學業表現的長期影響。

col: underestimate the importance of｜低估……的重要性
words.tip: 動詞末尾讀/ meɪt /，名詞末尾讀/ mət /。

tr: n. 戰利品, 贓物, 獎品, 變質, 次品
vt. 損壞, 破壞, 溺愛
def: n. (usually plural) valuables taken by violence (especially in war)
n. the act of spoiling something by causing damage to it
n. the act of stripping and taking by force

ex.en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
ex.zh: 請別告訴你姐姐，免得破壞這份驚喜。

ex.en: Poorly planned construction can spoil natural landscapes and reduce their appeal to both residents and tourists.
ex.zh: 規劃不當的建設會破壞自然景觀，降低其對居民和遊客的吸引力。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均可用spoiled或spoilt。

tr: [法] 使荒廢, 毀滅, 掠奪
def: v. overwhelm or overpower
To cause very severe damage to a place or thing
To make someone feel extremely upset or shocked

ex.en: The storm devastated the village, leaving many homes damaged.
ex.zh: 暴風雨重創了村莊，許多房屋受損。

ex.en: Prolonged droughts can devastate agricultural communities by destroying crops and reducing the income available to farming households.
ex.zh: 長期乾旱會毀壞莊稼、減少農戶收入，給農業社區帶來沉重打擊。

col: devastate a region｜重創一個地區
devastate the economy｜嚴重破壞經濟
words.tip: 比damage程度重；也可指使人精神上受到重創。

def: n. (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence
A separate condition or requirement in a legal document.
A group of words containing a subject and a verb.

ex.en: One clause in our lease allows us to keep pets.
ex.zh: 我們的租約中有一項條款允許養寵物。

ex.en: Employment contracts should include a clause that clearly defines workers' rights to paid leave and flexible working.
ex.zh: 勞動合同應包含明確規定員工帶薪休假和彈性工作權利的條款。

col: a clause in a contract｜合同中的條款
include a clause｜加入一項條款
words.tip: 語法中clause含主語和謂語；phrase通常不含。

tr: a. 健康的, 強健的, 要用力氣的, 堅定的, 粗野的
def: a. sturdy and strong in form, constitution, or construction
s. strong enough to withstand or overcome intellectual challenges or adversity
s. rough and crude

ex.en: These robust boots survived years of muddy country walks.
ex.zh: 這雙結實的靴子經受住了多年鄉間泥路行走的考驗。

ex.en: Governments need robust evidence before introducing policies that could significantly affect public health and household spending.
ex.zh: 政府在推行可能顯著影響公眾健康和家庭開支的政策前，需要有可靠的證據。

words.tip: 既形容身體或物品結實，也形容證據、系統可靠。

tr: n. 公告, 佈告, 公報
def: n. a brief report (especially an official statement issued for immediate publication or broadcast)
v. make public by bulletin
a short official announcement or report of recent news

ex.en: We heard the weather bulletin during breakfast today.
ex.zh: 今天吃早飯時，我們聽了天氣簡報。

ex.en: Local authorities should issue regular bulletins during severe weather so that residents can make informed safety decisions.
ex.zh: 惡劣天氣期間，地方當局應定期發佈公告，幫助居民在瞭解情況後作出安全決策。

words.tip: 強調簡短、及時的消息；news bulletin常指廣播新聞。

tr: n. 附件, 零件, 附加物, 從犯, 同謀
a. 附屬的, 補充的, 同謀的, 幫兇的, 非主要的, 副的
def: n. clothing that is worn or carried, but not part of your main clothing
n. a supplementary component that improves capability
n. someone who helps another person commit a crime

ex.en: This small camera accessory keeps my photos steady.
ex.zh: 這個小巧的相機配件能讓我拍照時保持穩定。

ex.en: Consumers often replace electronic accessories unnecessarily, increasing waste and demand for raw materials worldwide.
ex.zh: 消費者常常在沒有必要的情況下更換電子配件，增加了廢棄物和全球對原材料的需求。

col: an accessory to a crime｜犯罪的從犯
words.tip: 配件常用複數accessories；從犯後常接to。

tr: vt. 憤恨, 憎惡, 怨恨
def: v. feel bitter or indignant about

tr: n. 階地, 梯田, 房屋之平頂, 陽臺, 沿岸防地, 露臺
vt. 使成梯田, 使成有平臺屋頂
def: n. a level shelf of land interrupting a declivity (with steep slopes above and below)
n. a row of houses built in a similar style and having common dividing walls (or the street on which they face)
v. provide (a house) with a terrace

ex.en: We had breakfast on the terrace overlooking the garden.
ex.zh: 我們在俯瞰花園的露臺上吃了早餐。

ex.en: Farmers maintain each terrace carefully to reduce soil erosion and grow crops on steep mountain slopes.
ex.zh: 農民精心維護每一級梯田，以減少水土流失，並在陡峭的山坡上種植作物。

col: a sunny terrace｜陽光充足的露臺
a terrace of houses｜一排連棟房屋
words.tip: 露臺通常是較大的室外平臺，不等同於balcony。

def: n. uninterrupted connection or union
n. a detailed script used in making a film in order to avoid discontinuities from shot to shot
n. the property of a continuous and connected period of time

tr: a. 瑣碎的, 小規模的, 小氣的, 委瑣的
[經] 小額的, 微小的, 小規模的
def: s. contemptibly narrow in outlook
Too small or unimportant to deserve much attention.
Unkindly concerned with small, unimportant matters.

ex.en: We wasted the afternoon arguing over petty details.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午都浪費在爭論瑣碎細節上了。

ex.en: Investment in youth services may help reduce petty crime by providing constructive activities and support.
ex.zh: 投資青少年服務，為他們提供有益活動和支持，可能有助於減少輕微犯罪。

words.tip: 形容人時常含貶義，指小心眼，不只是小氣。

tr: n. (鋼等的)硬度, 脾氣, 心情, 中和劑, 傾向, 回火
vt. 使回火, 鍛鍊, 調和, 使緩和
def: n. a characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling
n. a disposition to exhibit uncontrolled anger
n. the elasticity and hardness of a metal object; its ability to absorb considerable energy before cracking

ex.en: He lost his temper when the drawer jammed again.
ex.zh: 抽屜又卡住了，他大發脾氣。

ex.en: Governments should temper enthusiasm for new technologies with careful consideration of their potential social consequences.
ex.zh: 政府應認真考慮新技術可能帶來的社會後果，避免一味熱衷於推廣。

col: temper enthusiasm with caution｜以謹慎節制熱情
words.tip: lose your temper 是發脾氣；動詞常用 temper A with B。

tr: n. 花, 花開的狀態, 興旺期
vi. 開花, 興旺, 發展
def: v. develop or come to a promising stage
a flower or mass of flowers on a tree or bush
to produce flowers

ex.en: Pink blossom covered the cherry tree outside our kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房外的櫻桃樹開滿了粉紅色的花。

ex.en: Creative talent can blossom when schools provide supportive teaching and regular opportunities for artistic expression.
ex.zh: 學校提供支持性的教學和經常性的藝術表達機會時，創造性才能便能蓬勃發展。

words.tip: 多指樹木的花；blossom into可比喻成長為。

tr: a. 屬類的, 一般的
def: n. a wine that is a blend of several varieties of grapes with no one grape predominating; a wine that does not carry the name of any specific grape
n. any product that can be sold without a brand name
a. relating to or common to or descriptive of all members of a genus

ex.en: The website sent me a generic reply about delivery.
ex.zh: 網站就配送問題給我發了一封千篇一律的回覆。

ex.en: Generic medicines can reduce healthcare costs while providing the same active ingredients as their branded equivalents.
ex.zh: 仿製藥可以降低醫療費用，同時提供與對應品牌藥相同的活性成分。

words.tip: generic強調非特定；generic medicine通常指仿製藥。

def: s. exerting influence by reason of high status or prestige

tr: [機] 應用的; 應用, 申請
def: a. concerned with concrete problems or data rather than with fundamental principles
v. kill a large number of people indiscriminately
The deliberate killing of many people, especially those unable to defend themselves.
To deliberately kill many people, especially those unable to defend themselves.

ex.en: We visited a memorial to victims of the massacre.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了一座紀念大屠殺遇難者的紀念碑。

ex.en: Teaching about a historical massacre requires sensitivity, reliable evidence, and respect for victims and their communities.
ex.zh: 講授歷史上的大屠殺事件，需要謹慎體察、可靠證據，以及對遇難者及其群體的尊重。

col: a brutal massacre｜殘酷的大屠殺
commemorate a massacre｜紀念大屠殺事件
words.tip: 指大規模殘殺，語氣極重；勿用於一般傷亡事件。

tr: n. 馬刺, 刺激物, 鼓舞
vt. 刺激, 激勵, 用馬刺策(馬)前進
vi. 用馬刺驅馬, 疾馳
def: n. any sharply pointed projection
n. tubular extension at the base of the corolla in some flowers
n. a sharp prod fixed to a rider's heel and used to urge a horse onward

ex.en: Her friend's encouragement spurred her to finish the race.
ex.zh: 朋友的鼓勵激勵她跑完了比賽。

ex.en: Investment in reliable public transport can spur economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.
ex.zh: 投資可靠的公共交通可以讓勞動者接觸到更多就業機會，從而促進經濟增長。

col: spur economic growth｜促進經濟增長
spur someone into action｜促使某人行動
a spur to innovation｜創新的推動力
on the spur of the moment｜一時興起
words.tip: 常用spur sb to do；過去式spurred雙寫r。

tr: n. 渠, 溝渠, 戰壕
vt. 在...開溝, 挖戰壕於, 用戰壕圍住
def: n. a ditch dug as a fortification having a parapet of the excavated earth
n. a long steep-sided depression in the ocean floor
n. any long ditch cut in the ground

ex.en: Workers dug a trench to repair the broken pipe.
ex.zh: 工人們挖了一條溝來修理破裂的管道。

ex.en: Before laying underground cables, engineers must ensure that each trench is stable and safe for workers.
ex.zh: 鋪設地下電纜之前，工程師必須確保每條溝槽穩固，並保障工人安全。

words.tip: 地面上的trench是溝或戰壕，海底的則是海溝。

tr: a. 患精神病的, 極愚蠢的
def: a. afflicted with or characteristic of mental derangement
Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous.
Severely mentally ill; an outdated term except in legal contexts.

ex.en: Driving through that storm would be an insane risk.
ex.zh: 在那場暴風雨中開車會是極不理智的冒險。

ex.en: Critics described the proposal as insane because its enormous costs would outweigh any potential benefits.
ex.zh: 批評者認為這項提案荒唐至極，因為其巨大成本會超過任何潛在收益。

col: an insane risk｜極不理智的冒險
words.tip: 口語可指荒唐；用於精神疾病已過時且可能冒犯。

tr: n. 骨骼, 骨瘦如柴的人, 梗概, 骨幹, 殘骸
a. 骨骼的, 概略的, 基層的, 骨幹的
def: n. something reduced to its minimal form
n. a scandal that is kept secret
n. the internal supporting structure that gives an artifact its shape

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
ex.zh: 我們在博物館看到了一具巨大的恐龍骨架。

ex.en: Studying the skeleton of an ancient animal can reveal how it moved and adapted to its environment.
ex.zh: 研究古代動物的骨骼可以揭示它的運動方式以及它如何適應環境。

col: skeleton staff｜最低限度的工作人員
words.tip: skeleton staff指維持運轉所需的最少人員。

tr: vt. 施以, 加害, 使承受
def: v. impose something unpleasant
to cause someone or something to suffer harm

ex.en: The storm inflicted serious damage on our garden fence.
ex.zh: 暴風雨嚴重損壞了我們花園的圍欄。

ex.en: Unregulated industrial activity can inflict lasting damage on ecosystems and threaten the livelihoods of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 不受監管的工業活動可能對生態系統造成持久破壞，並威脅附近社區居民的生計。

words.tip: 搭配為inflict傷害on對象，不能說inflict sb。

tr: a. 職業的, 軍事佔領的
def: a. of or relating to the activity or business for which you are trained

tr: n. 更新, 革新, 復興, 恢復, 修補, 補充, 繼續, 重訂, 重申, 續借
[經] 更新, 換新, 重申
def: n. the act of renewing
the extension of an agreement or service for another period
the process of making something fresh, strong, or effective again

ex.en: My gym membership is due for renewal next month.
ex.zh: 我的健身房會員資格下個月該續期了。

ex.en: Urban renewal projects should improve public spaces without forcing existing residents to leave their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 城市更新項目應改善公共空間，同時避免迫使現有居民搬離所在社區。

col: up for renewal｜即將需要續期
words.tip: renewal是名詞；renew a subscription表示“續訂”。

def: n a violent disturbance
n violent agitation
n disturbance usually in protest

tr: vi. 移動, 移往, 隨季節而移居
def: v. move from one country or region to another and settle there
v. move periodically or seasonally
to move to another region, seasonally or to live there

ex.en: These birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
ex.zh: 天氣轉冷時，這些鳥會向南遷徙。

ex.en: Many young adults migrate to urban areas because employment opportunities are often limited in rural communities.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人遷居城市，因為農村地區的就業機會往往有限。

words.tip: migrate強調遷移；immigrate移入，emigrate移出。

tr: a. 鋒利的, 敏銳的, 強烈的, 敏捷的, 熱心的, 渴望的
def: n. a funeral lament sung with loud wailing
s. having a sharp cutting edge or point
very interested in something or eager to do it

ex.en: Leila is keen to join our weekend hiking group.
ex.zh: 萊拉很想加入我們的週末徒步小組。

ex.en: Students who are keen on science benefit from practical experiments that connect theory with everyday experience.
ex.zh: 熱愛科學的學生能從將理論與日常經驗相結合的實踐實驗中受益。

col: a keen eye for detail｜敏銳的細節觀察力
words.tip: keen on後接名詞或動名詞；keen to後接動詞原形。

tr: n. 子孫, 後代, 產物
[法] 後輩, 子孫, 後裔
def: n. the immediate descendants of a person
n. something that comes into existence as a result
The children or young of a person, animal, or plant.

ex.en: The mother duck led her offspring safely across the path.
ex.zh: 鴨媽媽帶著小鴨們安全地穿過小路。

ex.en: Many species invest considerable energy in protecting their offspring, which increases the young animals' chances of survival.
ex.zh: 許多物種投入大量精力保護後代，從而提高幼崽的存活機會。

col: protect their offspring｜保護它們的幼崽
words.tip: 單複數同形；談人的子女時比children正式。

tr: vi. 依附, 粘著, 堅持, 追隨, 擁護
def: v. be compatible or in accordance with
v. follow through or carry out a plan without deviation
v. be a devoted follower or supporter

ex.en: Everyone must adhere to the rules in this pool.
ex.zh: 每個人都必須遵守這個游泳池的規定。

ex.en: Researchers must adhere to strict ethical standards when collecting personal information from participants in health studies.
ex.zh: 研究人員在收集健康研究參與者的個人信息時，必須遵守嚴格的倫理標準。

col: adhere to guidelines｜遵循指導原則
adhere to a surface｜黏附於表面
words.tip: 兩種常見義都用adhere to；to是介詞。

tr: n. 柱子, 棟梁, 臺柱, 重要的支持者
def: n. a fundamental principle or practice
n. a prominent supporter
A strong upright structure that supports part of a building.

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain behind a stone pillar.
ex.zh: 我們躲在一根石柱後面避雨。

ex.en: Accessible education is a central pillar of social development because it expands opportunities across generations.
ex.zh: 普及教育是社會發展的核心支柱，因為它能為一代又一代人拓展機會。

col: a central pillar of｜……的核心支柱
a pillar of the community｜社區的中堅人物
words.tip: pillar of可比喻某體系的支柱或群體的中堅。

tr: a. 心神不安的, 不自在的, 不穩定的, 不舒服的
def: a. lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance
s. relating to bodily unease that causes discomfort
Feeling worried or uncomfortable about a situation.

ex.en: I felt uneasy walking through the empty station.
ex.zh: 走過空蕩蕩的車站時，我感到有些不安。

ex.en: Many residents remain uneasy about the proposed factory because its environmental effects have not been fully assessed.
ex.zh: 許多居民仍對擬建工廠感到不安，因為其環境影響尚未得到全面評估。

col: uneasy about something｜對某事感到擔憂
an uneasy truce｜不穩固的停戰
words.tip: uneasy意為不安，不是“不容易”；常接about。

tr: n. 火炮, 炮兵, 炮術
def: n. large but transportable armament
n. an army unit that uses big guns

tr: n. 路面, 人行道, 鋪面路, 鋪路材料
def: n. the paved surface of a thoroughfare
A path beside a road for people to walk on.
The hard surface covering a road or other outdoor area.

ex.en: We walked along the pavement beside the busy road.
ex.zh: 我們沿著繁忙道路旁的人行道走。

ex.en: Wider pavements can improve pedestrian safety and make urban neighbourhoods more accessible for wheelchair users.
ex.zh: 更寬的人行道可以提高行人安全性，並讓輪椅使用者更方便地在城市社區出行。

col: walk on the pavement｜在人行道上走
words.tip: 英式指人行道；美式常指道路的硬質表面。

tr: a. 潮溼的, 多雨的, 感傷的, 含淚的
def: s slightly wet
Slightly wet, rather than dry or soaked.

ex.en: Keep the soil moist until the first leaves appear.
ex.zh: 在第一批葉子長出之前，保持土壤溼潤。

ex.en: A layer of fallen leaves helps keep soil moist, reducing the need for frequent watering.
ex.zh: 一層落葉有助於保持土壤溼潤，減少頻繁澆水的需要。

col: keep something moist｜使某物保持溼潤
words.tip: moist常指適度溼潤；damp常帶潮溼、不舒服之意。

tr: n. 精神力, 智力, 頭腦作用, 心態
def: n. a habitual or characteristic mental attitude that determines how you will interpret and respond to situations

tr: n. 主題, 基調, 動機, 基本圖案
[法] 主旨, 主題, 動機
def: n. a design or figure that consists of recurring shapes or colors, as in architecture or decoration
n. a theme that is repeated or elaborated in a piece of music

tr: n. 爭論, 爭辯, 所持的論點
def: n. a point asserted as part of an argument
n distance travelled per unit time
Speed of movement, including direction in physics.

ex.en: The ball gained velocity as it rolled downhill.
ex.zh: 球向坡下滾動時速度越來越快。

ex.en: Engineers measure the velocity of flowing water to determine whether a site is suitable for generating electricity.
ex.zh: 工程師測量水流速度，以判斷某處是否適合發電。

words.tip: 物理中velocity含方向，speed只表示快慢。

tr: vt. 使和解, 調停, 使和諧, 使一致, 使聽從
def: v. come to terms
To make conflicting ideas, needs, or facts compatible
To restore friendly relations after a disagreement

ex.en: We reconciled our different tastes by choosing a buffet.
ex.zh: 我們選擇了自助餐，兼顧了彼此不同的口味。

ex.en: Governments must reconcile the demand for affordable housing with the need to protect valuable green spaces.
ex.zh: 政府必須協調可負擔住房需求與保護寶貴綠地的需要。

col: reconcile A with B｜使A與B協調
be reconciled with someone｜與某人和解
words.tip: 協調兩者用with；接受現實用reconcile oneself to。

tr: n. 分隔間, 臥車包房, 防水艙隔
def: n. a space into which an area is subdivided
n. a partitioned section, chamber, or separate room within a larger enclosed area
A separate section within a container, vehicle, or building.

ex.en: Keep your keys in the small compartment inside your bag.
ex.zh: 把鑰匙放在包裡的小隔層中。

ex.en: Separate compartments on trains can provide passengers with greater privacy during long journeys.
ex.zh: 火車上的獨立包間能讓乘客在長途旅行中享有更多隱私。

words.tip: 指較大空間內分隔出的部分，如包內隔層。

tr: n. 侮辱, 無禮, 損害
vt. 損害, 侮辱, 攻擊
def: n. a deliberately offensive act or something producing the effect of deliberate disrespect
Say or do something that treats someone with disrespect.
A remark or action that shows disrespect and causes offence.

ex.en: I never meant to insult you with that joke.
ex.zh: 我絕不是有意用那個笑話侮辱你。

ex.en: Public debates become less productive when participants insult their opponents instead of addressing the issues.
ex.zh: 當參與者不討論問題而是侮辱對手時，公開辯論的成效就會降低。

col: add insult to injury｜雪上加霜
words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞讀/ˈɪnsʌlt/，重音在前。

tr: n. 憤怒, 狂暴, 狂怒的人
[醫] 狂亂, 狂暴, 狂怒
def: n. a feeling of intense anger
n. (classical mythology) the hideous snake-haired monsters (usually three in number) who pursued unpunished criminals
An extremely strong feeling of anger.

ex.en: He shook with fury when he discovered the damage.
ex.zh: 發現東西遭到損壞時，他氣得渾身發抖。

ex.en: The sudden closure of the local hospital provoked fury among residents who depended on its services.
ex.zh: 當地醫院突然關閉，激起了依賴其服務的居民的強烈憤怒。

col: the fury of the storm｜風暴的猛烈
words.tip: 比anger語氣強；in a fury表示“勃然大怒”。

tr: vi. 乘船, 著手, 從事, 上飛機
vt. 使上船, 使上飛機, 使從事
def: v. go on board
v. set out on (an enterprise or subject of study)
To begin a project, activity, or course of action

ex.en: We are ready to embark on our kitchen renovation.
ex.zh: 我們準備開始翻修廚房了。

ex.en: Before students embark on professional training, they should consider both their interests and future employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 學生在開始職業培訓前，應兼顧自身興趣和未來就業機會。

col: embark on a project｜著手開展項目
embark on a career｜開始職業生涯
embark on a journey｜踏上旅程
words.tip: 表示著手做某事時，用embark on或upon。

tr: a. 自然的, 自發的, 未經琢磨的
[醫] 自發的, 特發的, 自生的
def: a. happening or arising without apparent external cause
Happening naturally without being planned or deliberately caused
Acting freely on feelings rather than following plans

ex.en: We made a spontaneous trip to the beach yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我們臨時起意，去了一趟海邊。

ex.en: Spontaneous conversations between colleagues can generate creative ideas that formal meetings sometimes fail to produce.
ex.zh: 同事間自發的交談可以激發創意，而正式會議有時反倒做不到。

words.tip: 強調非預先安排，不等於“無意識的”。

tr: a. 苗條的, 纖弱的, 微少的, 微薄的
def: s. being of delicate or slender build
s. very narrow
s. having little width in proportion to the length or height

ex.en: A slender branch bent under the bird's weight.
ex.zh: 一根細長的樹枝被鳥的重量壓彎了。

ex.en: Small businesses often operate with slender profit margins, making them particularly vulnerable to rising energy costs.
ex.zh: 小企業的利潤率往往很低，因此尤其容易受到能源成本上漲的衝擊。

words.tip: 形容身材常含讚美；也可形容機會、優勢很小。

tr: n. 花, 開花, 青春, 鋼塊
vi. 開花, 煥發青春, 茂盛
vt. 使茂盛, 把...軋成鋼坯
def: n. the best time of youth
n. a rosy color (especially in the cheeks) taken as a sign of good health
v. produce or yield flowers

ex.en: The roses bloom beside our kitchen window every summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天，玫瑰都在我們的廚房窗邊盛開。

ex.en: Urban gardens that bloom throughout spring and summer provide valuable food sources for bees and other pollinators.
ex.zh: 春夏持續開花的城市花園為蜜蜂及其他傳粉動物提供了寶貴的食物來源。

words.tip: bloom可作動詞；表示正在開花用in bloom。

tr: n. 周長, 周界, 邊緣
[醫] 周, 周邊, 周界線; 周長; 視野計
def: n. a line enclosing a plane areas
n. the property of being close together
n. the region close around a person or thing
n. a Gestalt principle of organization holding that (other things being equal) objects or events that are near to one another (in space or time) are perceived as belonging together as a unit

ex.en: We chose this flat for its proximity to the park.
ex.zh: 我們選這套公寓是因為它離公園近。

ex.en: Living in close proximity to busy roads may increase residents' exposure to noise and air pollution.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路附近可能使居民更多地接觸噪聲和空氣汙染。

col: in close proximity to｜緊鄰；靠近
words.tip: 常用 proximity to；此處 to 是介詞，後接名詞。

tr: n. 支柱, 曲柄, 支撐, 一對
vt. 緊縛, 支撐, 激勵
def: n. a support that steadies or strengthens something else
n. either of two punctuation marks ({ or }) used to enclose textual material
n. a rope on a square-rigged ship that is used to swing a yard about and secure it

tr: a. 相同的, 協調的
def: v be compatible, similar or consistent; coincide in their characteristics
v provide funds complementary to
v bring two objects, ideas, or people together

tr: vt. 符號化, 用符號表現
vi. 採用象徵, 使用符號
def: v. represent or identify by using a symbol; use symbols

tr: n. 獸群, 鳥群, 一群人, 大量, 棉束
vi. 成群而行, 聚集
def: n. a church congregation guided by a pastor
n. a group of birds
n. a group of sheep or goats

ex.en: A flock of geese landed beside the quiet lake.
ex.zh: 一群鵝落在了寧靜的湖邊。

ex.en: Visitors flock to coastal towns during summer, bringing income but also placing pressure on local infrastructure.
ex.zh: 遊客夏季蜂擁至海濱城鎮，帶來收入的同時，也給當地基礎設施造成壓力。

words.tip: 鳥群、羊群常用flock；牛群通常用herd。

tr: vt. 精煉, 淨化, 使優雅, 使精煉
vi. 被精煉, 被淨化
def: v. treat or prepare so as to put in a usable condition
v. reduce to a fine, unmixed, or pure state; separate from extraneous matter or cleanse from impurities
v. attenuate or reduce in vigor, strength, or validity by polishing or purifying

ex.en: I refined my recipe by adding less sugar.
ex.zh: 我減少了糖的用量，改進了自己的食譜。

ex.en: Schools can refine their teaching methods by collecting regular feedback from students with different learning needs.
ex.zh: 學校可以定期收集有不同學習需求的學生的反饋，以改進教學方法。

words.tip: 既可指完善方法，也可指提純原材料。

tr: a. 揮發性的, 可變的, 不穩定的, 飛行的, 輕快的, 爆炸性的
n. 有翅動物, 揮發物
def: n. a volatile substance; a substance that changes readily from solid or liquid to a vapor
a. evaporating readily at normal temperatures and pressures
s. tending to vary often or widely

ex.en: Fuel prices have been unusually volatile this month.
ex.zh: 這個月燃油價格波動異常劇烈。

ex.en: Volatile food prices make it difficult for low-income households to plan their spending and maintain a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 食品價格波動不定，使低收入家庭難以規劃開支並維持均衡飲食。

words.tip: 既可描述市場波動，也可指情緒易變或物質易揮發。

tr: a. 嚴厲的, 嚴酷的, 嚴格的, 苛刻的, 嚴密的, 精確的
def: s. rigidly accurate; allowing no deviation from a standard
s. demanding strict attention to rules and procedures
extremely careful and thorough

ex.en: The mechanic gave our car a rigorous safety check.
ex.zh: 修車師傅對我們的車進行了細緻的安全檢查。

ex.en: New medical treatments require rigorous testing before they can be widely used in public healthcare.
ex.zh: 新的醫療方法必須經過嚴格測試，才能廣泛用於公共醫療。

words.tip: 研究、測試用它強調嚴謹；訓練、標準強調嚴格。

tr: n. 草皮, 泥炭, 跑馬場
def: n. surface layer of ground containing a mat of grass and grass roots
n. the territory claimed by a juvenile gang as its own
n. range of jurisdiction or influence

tr: a. 強健的, 健全的
[醫] 羊暈倒病, 羊蹣跚病
def: s. substantially made or constructed
Strongly built and not easily damaged or weakened.

ex.en: These sturdy boots keep my feet dry on muddy walks.
ex.zh: 穿著這雙結實的靴子走泥路，我的雙腳也能保持乾爽。

ex.en: Schools in earthquake-prone regions need sturdy buildings that can protect students during periods of intense shaking.
ex.zh: 地震多發地區的學校需要堅固的建築，以便在劇烈震動時保護學生。

words.tip: 常形容鞋、傢俱、建築結實，也可形容人強健。

tr: a. 限定的, 決定性的
def: s. clearly defined or formulated
s. supplying or being a final or conclusive settlement
v. cause to move forward with force

tr: [法] 歪區, 曲解, 纂改
def: v make false by mutilation or addition; as of a message or story
v form into a spiral shape
v twist and press out of shape

ex.en: That edited clip distorts what I actually said.
ex.zh: 那段剪輯過的視頻歪曲了我實際說的話。

ex.en: Selective reporting can distort public understanding of environmental issues and weaken support for necessary reforms.
ex.zh: 選擇性報道可能歪曲公眾對環境問題的理解，並削弱人們對必要改革的支持。

col: distort public perception｜扭曲公眾認知
words.tip: 既可指歪曲事實，也可指圖像、聲音失真。

tr: n. 鏟子, 勺子, 穴, 口, 獨家新聞
vt. 汲取, 舀取, 挖空, 搶先報道
def: n. the quantity a scoop will hold
n. a hollow concave shape made by removing something
n. the shovel or bucket of a dredge or backhoe

tr: n. 無, 全無, 零
def: n a quantity of no importance

tr: [法] 恐嚇, 威脅, 使恐懼
def: v. make timid or fearful
v. to compel or deter by or as if by threats
To frighten someone, often to make them obey

ex.en: The large audience intimidated her before her first performance.
ex.zh: 首次演出前，龐大的觀眾群讓她有些膽怯。

ex.en: Employers should never intimidate workers into accepting unsafe conditions or giving up their legal rights.
ex.zh: 僱主絕不應脅迫員工接受不安全的工作條件或放棄合法權利。

col: intimidate someone into doing something｜脅迫某人做某事
words.tip: intimidate sb into doing sth表示脅迫某人做某事。

tr: n. 邊緣, 邊界, 起始點
vi. 處在邊緣, 接近, 下沉, 趨向
def: n. the limit beyond which something happens or changes
n. a grass border along a road
v. border on; come close to

ex.en: She was on the verge of tears after losing her ring.
ex.zh: 她丟了戒指，幾乎要哭出來了。

ex.en: Several native species are on the verge of extinction because their habitats have been severely damaged.
ex.zh: 幾種本地物種因棲息地遭到嚴重破壞而瀕臨滅絕。

col: on the verge of extinction｜瀕臨滅絕
on the verge of doing something｜即將做某事
verge on the absurd｜近乎荒謬
words.tip: on the verge of後接名詞或動名詞；動詞常接on。

tr: n. 瘟疫, 天罰, 麻煩, 災禍
vt. 折磨, 使苦惱, 使得災禍
def: n. a serious (sometimes fatal) infection of rodents caused by Yersinia pestis and accidentally transmitted to humans by the bite of a flea that has bitten an infected animal
n. any epidemic disease with a high death rate
n. any large scale calamity (especially when thought to be sent by God)

ex.en: The museum has an exhibition about plague in medieval towns.
ex.zh: 博物館有一個關於中世紀城鎮瘟疫的展覽。

ex.en: Poor drainage continues to plague rapidly growing cities, increasing flood risks and threatening the health of local residents.
ex.zh: 排水不良持續困擾著快速發展的城市，增加了洪災風險，並威脅當地居民的健康。

col: an outbreak of plague｜鼠疫暴發
be plagued by problems｜飽受問題困擾
words.tip: 動詞常用be plagued by，表示長期反覆受困擾。

tr: n. 一次所烘的麵包, 一次所制之量, 一組, 批, 成批, 分批
v. 成批, 分批處理
def: n. all the loaves of bread baked at the same time
n. (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent
n. a collection of things or persons to be handled together

ex.en: The first batch of bread is cooling on the counter.
ex.zh: 第一爐麵包正放在臺面上晾涼。

ex.en: Testing each batch of food before distribution helps manufacturers maintain consistent quality and protect public health.
ex.zh: 食品配送前對每一批進行檢測，有助於生產商保持質量穩定並保護公眾健康。

words.tip: batch強調一起生產或處理的一批，常接of。

tr: n. 飾帶, 花邊, 緞帶, 鞋帶
vt. 結帶子, 飾以花邊
def: n. a cord that is drawn through eyelets or around hooks in order to draw together two edges (as of a shoe or garment)
n. a delicate decorative fabric woven in an open web of symmetrical patterns
v. do lacework

tr: vt. 制止, 嚇住, 威懾
def: v. try to prevent; show opposition to
To discourage an action by making it seem difficult or risky.

ex.en: The heavy rain did not deter our determined hikers.
ex.zh: 大雨沒有讓我們堅定的徒步者打退堂鼓。

ex.en: Higher parking fees may deter commuters from driving into city centres during peak hours.
ex.zh: 提高停車費可能使通勤者不願在高峰時段開車進入市中心。

col: deter someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
deter potential customers｜使潛在顧客卻步
words.tip: 用deter sb from doing；過去式為deterred。

tr: vi. 期滿, 呼氣, 斷氣
def: v lose validity
v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
v expel air

ex.en: My passport expires next month, so I must renew it.
ex.zh: 我的護照下個月到期，所以必須換髮。

ex.en: When temporary work permits expire, employees may face uncertainty about their future employment and residence.
ex.zh: 臨時工作許可到期時，僱員的未來就業和居留可能面臨不確定性。

words.tip: 是不及物動詞：合同到期用expires，不用is expired。

tr: a. 毗連的, 鄰近的, 連接的
[機] 相鄰的, 鄰位的, 交界的
def: s. nearest in space or position; immediately adjoining without intervening space
s. having a common boundary or edge; abutting; touching; Massachusetts and Conncecticut"
s. near or close to but not necessarily touching

ex.en: We booked adjacent rooms so the children could stay nearby.
ex.zh: 我們訂了相鄰的房間，孩子們就能住在旁邊。

ex.en: Residents in areas adjacent to the airport often experience high levels of noise pollution.
ex.zh: 機場鄰近地區的居民經常受到嚴重的噪聲汙染。

words.tip: 表示“與……相鄰”用 adjacent to。

tr: vt. 使停止, 扣留, 保留, 拒給
def: v. hold back; refuse to hand over or share
v. retain and refrain from disbursing; of payments

tr: a. 象牙制的, 乳白色的
def: n. a hard smooth ivory colored dentine that makes up most of the tusks of elephants and walruses
v. go with, fall together
v. be the same
to happen at the same time

ex.en: My days off rarely coincide with my sister's.
ex.zh: 我的休息日很少和姐姐的重合。

ex.en: Government investment should coincide with local priorities to ensure that public funds address genuine community needs.
ex.zh: 政府投資應與地方優先事項相一致，以確保公共資金滿足社區的真實需求。

col: coincide with｜與……同時發生；與……相符
words.tip: 不及物動詞，接對象用with，不直接接賓語。

tr: a. 有利益的, 獲利的, 合算的
def: s. producing a sizeable profit
v be greater in scope or size than some standard
v be superior or better than some standard
To go beyond ordinary limits, differences, or expectations.

ex.en: Their friendship transcended the distance between their homes.
ex.zh: 他們的友誼超越了兩地相隔的距離。

ex.en: International cooperation on climate change must transcend national interests to protect the planet for future generations.
ex.zh: 應對氣候變化的國際合作必須超越國家利益，為後代保護地球。

col: transcend cultural differences｜超越文化差異
transcend national interests｜超越國家利益
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語，不加beyond。

tr: n. 抵抗者, 反抗者
a. 抵抗的, 反抗的, 耐...的
def: s. impervious to being affected
Not easily damaged or affected by something.
Unwilling to accept something or agree to a change.

ex.en: These boots are resistant to water and easy to clean.
ex.zh: 這雙靴子防水，而且容易清洗。

ex.en: Some bacteria have become resistant to common antibiotics, making infections more difficult to treat.
ex.zh: 一些細菌已對常用抗生素產生耐藥性，使感染更難治療。

words.tip: 常接to；water-resistant防水程度不及waterproof。

tr: n. 護送者, 護衛者, 護航艦
def: n. the act of accompanying someone or something in order to protect them
n. an attendant who is employed to accompany someone
v. accompany as an escort

ex.en: A staff member escorted us to the waiting room.
ex.zh: 一名工作人員陪同我們去了候診室。

ex.en: Trained volunteers can escort elderly residents to medical appointments, improving access to essential healthcare services.
ex.zh: 受過培訓的志願者可以陪同老年居民就醫，從而改善他們獲得基本醫療服務的機會。

col: escort someone to｜陪同某人前往
a police escort｜警方護送人員
words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞英/ˈeskɔːt/，美/ˈeskɔːrt/。

tr: a. 專注的, 獻身的
def: a. devoted to a cause or ideal or purpose

tr: n. 廄, 停車處, 牧師職位, 貨攤, 託辭, 拖延
vt. 關入廄, 停頓, 推託, 支吾, 使陷於泥中
vi. 被關在廄內, 陷於泥中, 停止, 支吾
def: n. a compartment in a stable where a single animal is confined and fed
n. a booth where articles are displayed for sale
n. a malfunction in the flight of an aircraft in which there is a sudden loss of lift that results in a downward plunge

ex.en: We bought fresh peaches from a small roadside stall.
ex.zh: 我們在路邊的一個小攤買了新鮮桃子。

ex.en: Negotiations may stall if governments cannot agree on how to share the costs of reducing emissions.
ex.zh: 如果各國政府無法就如何分擔減排成本達成一致，談判可能會陷入停滯。

col: stall an engine｜使發動機熄火
words.tip: 作動詞可指發動機熄火，也可指談判等陷入停滯。

tr: vt. 引出, 推導出, 引起
def: v. derive by reason
to cause someone to give information or show a reaction

ex.en: Her unexpected question elicited a smile from the normally quiet guide.
ex.zh: 她出人意料的問題讓平時寡言的導遊露出了笑容。

ex.en: Teachers can use open questions to elicit detailed responses and encourage independent thinking in the classroom.
ex.zh: 教師可以用開放式問題引導學生詳細回答，並鼓勵他們在課堂上獨立思考。

words.tip: 常接response等賓語；勿與illicit（非法的）混淆。

tr: vt. 強制, 施恩惠於, 使感激
def: v. bind by an obligation; cause to be indebted
v. provide a service or favor for someone
Require someone to act because of rules or circumstances

ex.en: The sudden storm obliged us to stay indoors.
ex.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨迫使我們待在室內。

ex.en: Environmental regulations oblige manufacturers to reduce harmful emissions and report their progress to public authorities.
ex.zh: 環境法規要求製造商減少有害排放，並向政府部門報告進展。

col: be obliged to do something｜不得不做某事
words.tip: be obliged to do表示被迫或有義務做某事。

tr: v. 詢問, 問明, 查究
def: v inquire about
v have a wish or desire to know something
v conduct an inquiry or investigation of

tr: n. 半身像, 胸部, 失敗, 毆打
vt. 使爆裂, 使破產
def: n. a sculpture of the head and shoulders of a person
n. an occasion for excessive eating or drinking
a sculpture showing a person's head, shoulders, and upper chest

ex.en: A marble bust stood beside the museum entrance.
ex.zh: 博物館入口旁立著一尊大理石半身像。

ex.en: Displaying a bust of a local artist can help museums connect visitors with their community's cultural history.
ex.zh: 展出當地藝術家的半身像，有助於博物館讓參觀者瞭解所在社區的文化歷史。

col: a marble bust｜大理石半身像
words.tip: 指雕像時是可數名詞，通常只有頭、肩和胸部。

def: v. convey or express a meaning
v. make known with a word or signal
to mean something or be a sign of it

ex.en: These dark clouds usually signify that rain is coming.
ex.zh: 這些烏雲通常意味著快要下雨了。

ex.en: Rising literacy rates may signify improvements in educational access, especially among previously disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 識字率上升可能意味著受教育機會有所改善，尤其是在原本處於弱勢的群體中。

words.tip: signify較正式，常接名詞或that從句。

tr: n. 聲望, 威望, 威信
def: n. a high standing achieved through success or influence or wealth etc.
Respect and admiration gained through achievement, quality, or high status.

ex.en: Winning the award brought considerable prestige to her small bakery.
ex.zh: 獲獎為她的小麵包店帶來了很高的聲譽。

ex.en: Some students choose universities for their international prestige rather than the suitability of individual courses.
ex.zh: 一些學生選擇大學看重的是其國際聲望，而非具體課程是否適合自己。

col: a matter of prestige｜關乎聲望的事
words.tip: prestige不可數；形容詞用prestigious。

tr: n. 飛濺, 汙點, 一點兒, 濺潑聲, 色斑
vi. 濺溼, 濺開, 飛濺
vt. 濺, 潑, 使濺起水, 灑, 使成斑駁狀
def: n. the sound like water splashing
n. a patch of bright color
n. the act of scattering water about haphazardly

ex.en: The dog splashed water all over my trousers.
ex.zh: 那隻狗把水濺得我褲子上到處都是。

ex.en: Vehicles travelling through flooded streets can splash dirty water onto pedestrians and damage nearby shop displays.
ex.zh: 車輛駛過積水街道時，可能把汙水濺到行人身上，並損壞附近商店的陳列品。

col: a splash of colour｜一抹亮色
splash out on｜在……上大筆花錢
words.tip: splash out on是英式口語，指大手筆花錢買某物。

tr: a. 即將來臨的, 逼近的
def: s close in time; about to occur
Expected to happen very soon.

ex.en: The dark clouds made a heavy downpour seem imminent.
ex.zh: 烏雲密佈，眼看就要下大雨了。

ex.en: Coastal communities need reliable warning systems when severe flooding is imminent, allowing residents enough time to evacuate.
ex.zh: 嚴重洪水即將來襲時，沿海社區需要可靠的預警系統，讓居民有足夠時間撤離。

words.tip: 強調即將發生，不等於urgent（需緊急處理）。

tr: n. 箔, 烘托, 襯托
vt. 貼箔於, 襯托, 阻止, 擋開, 挫敗
def: n. a piece of thin and flexible sheet metal
n. anything that serves by contrast to call attention to another thing's good qualities
n. picture consisting of a positive photograph or drawing on a transparent base; viewed with a projector

tr: n. 舉止, 軸承, 忍受, 關係, 意義, 方向, 生育
def: n. relevant relation or interconnection
n. the direction or path along which something moves or along which it lies
n. dignified manner or conduct

tr: n. 抑制, 勒馬繩, 邊石
vt. 抑制, 束縛, 勒住
def: n. an edge between a sidewalk and a roadway consisting of a line of curbstones (usually forming part of a gutter)
n. a horse's bit with an attached chain or strap to check the horse
v. keep to the curb

ex.en: I try to curb my spending by cooking at home.
ex.zh: 我儘量在家做飯，以控制開支。

ex.en: Cities can curb air pollution by improving public transport and encouraging residents to cycle.
ex.zh: 城市可以通過改善公共交通和鼓勵居民騎車來抑制空氣汙染。

col: a curb on emissions｜對排放的限制
words.tip: 作動詞指抑制；路緣石在英式英語中拼作kerb。

tr: a. 暗示的, 含蓄的, 固有的, 絕對的
[經] 不講明的, 含蓄的
def: a. implied though not directly expressed; inherent in the nature of something
s. being without doubt or reserve
Suggested or understood without being directly stated.

ex.en: Her welcoming smile was an implicit invitation to join.
ex.zh: 她熱情的笑容是在默默邀請我們加入。

ex.en: Many workplaces have implicit expectations about overtime, which can make employees reluctant to leave on time.
ex.zh: 許多工作場所對加班有不成文的期待，這可能讓員工不敢準時下班。

col: implicit agreement｜默契；未明說的協議
words.tip: implicit指未明說；explicit指清楚明確。

def: n. the social science that studies the origins and social relationships of human beings
the study of humans, their societies, cultures, and development

ex.en: My cousin studies anthropology and collects stories about family traditions.
ex.zh: 我的表姐學習人類學，並收集有關家庭傳統的故事。

ex.en: Anthropology helps researchers understand how cultural traditions influence attitudes towards health, education, and family life.
ex.zh: 人類學幫助研究者理解文化傳統如何影響人們對健康、教育和家庭生活的態度。

words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞；研究者稱anthropologist。

tr: vt. 克服, 征服, 戰勝
def: v. overcome by conquest
Take control of a country or place by force.
Successfully deal with a fear, difficulty, or challenge.

ex.en: She conquered her fear and climbed onto the diving board.
ex.zh: 她克服了恐懼，爬上了跳板。

ex.en: Throughout history, powerful states have sought to conquer neighbouring territories to gain resources and expand their influence.
ex.zh: 縱觀歷史，強大的國家一直試圖征服鄰近領土，以獲取資源並擴大影響力。

col: conquer a territory｜征服一片領土
conquer a mountain｜征服一座高山
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語：conquer a fear。

tr: vi. 蹲下, 蜷著, 縮著
def: n. the act of bending low with the limbs close to the body
v. bend one's back forward from the waist on down

tr: a. 合成的, 混合成的, 菊科的
n. 合成物, 複合材料, 菊科
def: n. considered the most highly evolved dicotyledonous plants, characterized by florets arranged in dense heads that resemble single flowers
s. consisting of separate interconnected parts
a. of or relating to or belonging to the plant family Compositae

ex.en: Our new garden bench is made from composite material.
ex.zh: 我們的新花園長椅是用複合材料製成的。

ex.en: Lightweight composite materials can reduce fuel consumption by making aircraft lighter without significantly compromising their strength.
ex.zh: 輕質複合材料能夠減輕飛機重量，同時不明顯損害其強度，從而降低燃料消耗。

words.tip: 強調由不同部分組合而成，常修飾material或image。

def: s. available when required or as promised
Planned or expected to happen or appear soon.
Willing to give information or discuss something openly.

ex.en: We bought new walking boots for our forthcoming trip.
ex.zh: 我們為即將到來的旅行買了新徒步靴。

ex.en: The forthcoming report will assess whether investment in public transport has reduced urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 即將發佈的報告將評估公共交通投資是否減少了城市空氣汙染。

col: a forthcoming report｜即將發佈的報告
forthcoming about something｜願意談論某事
no help was forthcoming｜未得到任何幫助
words.tip: 不只表示“即將到來的”，也可指願意透露信息。

tr: n. 寬度, 寬廣, 廣博
def: n. the extent of something from side to side
The distance from one side of something to the other.

ex.en: Check the width of the sofa before buying it.
ex.zh: 買沙發前先確認一下它的寬度。

ex.en: Increasing the width of pavements can improve accessibility for wheelchair users and make walking more comfortable.
ex.zh: 加寬人行道可以方便輪椅使用者通行，也能讓步行更舒適。

words.tip: 形容詞wide，名詞width，動詞widen。

tr: a. 進來的, 剛開始的, 新來的
def: a. arriving at a place or position
a. entering upon a position of office vacated by another

tr: n. （就重大政治或社會問題進行的）全民公決，全民投票
def: n. a legislative act is referred for final approval to a popular vote by the electorate

tr: n. 補足物, 補語, 補數
[計] 補碼; 反相器; 補數
def: n. a word or phrase used to complete a grammatical construction
n. a complete number or quantity
n. number needed to make up a whole force

tr: a. 疲倦的, 萎靡的, 厭倦的, 厭煩的
vt. 使疲倦, 使厭煩
vi. 疲乏, 生厭, 不耐煩
def: v exhaust or get tired through overuse or great strain or stress
v lose interest or become bored with something or somebody
s physically and mentally fatigued

ex.en: The weary hikers rested beside a stream before sunset.
ex.zh: 日落前，疲憊的徒步者們在溪邊休息。

ex.en: Commuters who endure long journeys often arrive home too weary to exercise or spend quality time with family.
ex.zh: 通勤路途漫長的人到家後往往疲憊不堪，無力鍛鍊或好好陪伴家人。

words.tip: weary是疲倦的；wary是警惕的，注意拼寫。

tr: a. 難得的, 稀罕的, 缺乏的
def: a. deficient in quantity or number compared with the demand
not available in large enough amounts to meet demand

ex.en: Fresh vegetables became scarce after snow blocked the roads.
ex.zh: 大雪封路後，新鮮蔬菜變得緊缺。

ex.en: As clean water becomes increasingly scarce, governments must invest in efficient irrigation and better water management systems.
ex.zh: 隨著清潔水源日益短缺，政府必須投資於高效灌溉和更完善的水資源管理系統。

words.tip: scarce指供應不足；rare強調少見，不一定短缺。

tr: n. 包圍, 圍攻, 再三的努力
def: n. the action of an armed force that surrounds a fortified place and isolates it while continuing to attack

tr: n. 似非而是的論點, 自相矛盾的話, 悖論, 怪人怪事
def: n. (logic) a statement that contradicts itself
A statement or situation that seems contradictory but may be true.

ex.en: It seems a paradox that resting helps me accomplish more.
ex.zh: 休息反而能讓我完成更多事情，這似乎很矛盾。

ex.en: Modern technology creates a paradox: people can communicate instantly yet still experience deep social isolation.
ex.zh: 現代技術帶來一種看似矛盾的現象：人們能即時交流，卻仍感到深深的社會孤立。

col: present a paradox｜呈現看似矛盾的情況
words.tip: 強調看似矛盾卻可能成立，不等於普通錯誤。

tr: a. 明確的, 一定的
[法] 明確的, 確切的, 一定的
def: a. precise; explicit and clearly defined
s. known for certain
Clearly decided or known, without uncertainty.

ex.en: We need a definite answer before booking the tickets.
ex.zh: 訂票之前，我們需要一個明確的答覆。

ex.en: Reliable public transport offers definite advantages for cities seeking to reduce congestion and improve air quality.
ex.zh: 對於尋求緩解擁堵和改善空氣質量的城市來說，可靠的公共交通具有明顯優勢。

words.tip: definite是形容詞；definitely是副詞，意為肯定地。

tr: v. 區別, 差別待遇
def: v. recognize or perceive the difference
v. treat differently on the basis of sex or race
v. distinguish

ex.en: Our club does not discriminate against anyone because of age.
ex.zh: 我們的俱樂部不會因年齡而歧視任何人。

ex.en: Employers must not discriminate against applicants on the basis of disability, gender, or cultural background.
ex.zh: 僱主不得基於殘障、性別或文化背景歧視求職者。

col: discriminate on the basis of age｜基於年齡區別對待
words.tip: 歧視某人用against；區分兩者用between。

tr: vt. 移置, 替換, 轉移
def: v. cause to move, usually with force or pressure
v. terminate the employment of; discharge from an office or position
Force people to leave their homes or usual surroundings.

ex.en: The flood displaced several families living near the river.
ex.zh: 洪水使住在河邊的幾戶人家被迫離開家園。

ex.en: Although automation may displace some workers, investment in retraining can help them find alternative employment.
ex.zh: 雖然自動化可能取代部分工人，但投資再培訓可以幫助他們找到其他工作。

words.tip: displace常指被迫遷離；也可指新事物取代舊事物。

tr: a. 領土的, 土地的, 地方的, 區域性的
def: n. nonprofessional soldier member of a territorial military unit
n. a territorial military unit
a. of or relating to a territory
n. low-lying wet land with grassy vegetation; usually is a transition zone between land and water
n. United States painter (1898-1954)
n. New Zealand writer of detective stories (1899-1982)

tr: a. 兩極的, 極地的, 正好相反的, 極性的
def: s. having a pair of equal and opposite charges
a. located at or near or coming from the earth's poles
a. of or existing at or near a geographical pole or within the Arctic or Antarctic Circles

ex.en: We watched a film about animals in polar regions.
ex.zh: 我們看了一部關於極地動物的影片。

ex.en: Rising global temperatures threaten polar ecosystems by reducing the sea ice that many species depend on.
ex.zh: 全球氣溫升高使許多物種賴以生存的海冰減少，威脅著極地生態系統。

col: polar opposites｜截然相反的人或事物
words.tip: polar指兩極地區；polar opposites表示截然相反。

tr: a. 逐漸的, 漸增的
def: n. (Roman Catholic Church) an antiphon (usually from the Book of Psalms) immediately after the epistle at Mass
a. proceeding in small stages
a. (of a topographical gradient) not steep or abrupt

ex.en: There was a gradual improvement in her sleep.
ex.zh: 她的睡眠逐漸改善了。

ex.en: A gradual transition to renewable energy can help communities adapt without causing sudden job losses.
ex.zh: 逐步轉向可再生能源有助於社區適應變化，避免就業崗位驟減。

words.tip: 強調變化緩慢、分階段；副詞形式為gradually。

tr: a. 孤獨的, 獨居的
def: n confinement of a prisoner in isolation from other prisoners
n one who lives in solitude
s characterized by or preferring solitude

ex.en: A solitary walker followed the quiet path through the woods.
ex.zh: 一位獨行者沿著林間幽靜的小路前行。

ex.en: While solitary study allows deep concentration, collaborative learning helps students develop communication skills and consider alternative perspectives.
ex.zh: 獨自學習有助於專注，而合作學習能幫助學生培養溝通能力並考慮不同觀點。

col: a solitary tree｜孤零零的一棵樹
words.tip: solitary強調獨自，不一定像lonely那樣感到寂寞。

def: n. an emblem (a small piece of plastic or cloth or metal) that signifies your status (rank or membership or affiliation etc.)
n. any feature that is regarded as a sign of status (a particular power or quality or rank)
v. put a badge on

ex.en: She pinned her new badge onto her jacket.
ex.zh: 她把新徽章別在了夾克上。

ex.en: Requiring visitors to wear a visible badge can improve security in schools and other public buildings.
ex.zh: 要求訪客佩戴醒目的身份徽章，有助於提高學校及其他公共建築的安全性。

col: a badge of honour｜榮譽的象徵
words.tip: 通常指佩戴的小徽章；獎牌一般用medal。

tr: n. 空虛, 空間, 空白, 空隙, 空虛感
a. 空的, 無效的, 無人的, 沒有的, 無用的
def: n. an empty area or space
v. clear (a room, house, place) of occupants or empty or clear (a place or receptacle) of something
s. containing nothing

tr: n. 天堂, 樂園, 伊甸園
def: n. (Christianity) the abode of righteous souls after death
A place or situation offering great beauty, happiness, or enjoyment
A perfect place of happiness after death in some religions

ex.en: This quiet beach is a paradise for swimmers.
ex.zh: 這片寧靜的海灘是游泳愛好者的樂園。

ex.en: Although tourism can turn remote islands into holiday paradises, uncontrolled development may damage the ecosystems that attract visitors.
ex.zh: 儘管旅遊業能將偏遠島嶼變成度假天堂，無序開發卻可能破壞吸引遊客的生態系統。

col: a paradise for wildlife｜野生動物的樂園
words.tip: a paradise for後接人或動物，表示其理想樂園。

tr: n. 海味, 海鮮, 魚類
def: n. edible fish (broadly including freshwater fish) or shellfish or roe etc
Sea animals, especially shellfish, eaten as food.

ex.en: We bought fresh seafood at the harbour this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我們在港口買了新鮮海鮮。

ex.en: Demand for sustainable seafood has encouraged some fishing communities to adopt methods that cause less damage to marine ecosystems.
ex.zh: 對可持續海產品的需求促使一些漁業社區採用對海洋生態系統破壞較小的捕撈方式。

words.tip: 通常是不可數名詞；一盤海鮮可說a plate of seafood。

tr: n. 嗡嗡聲, 哼聲, 雜聲
vt. 哼, 用哼聲表示
def: n. a humming noise
v. sing with closed lips
v. be noisy with activity

tr: a. 綜合(性)的, 人造的, 合成的
def: n. a compound made artificially by chemical reactions
a. involving or of the nature of synthesis (combining separate elements to form a coherent whole) as opposed to analysis
a. systematic combining of root and modifying elements into single words

tr: vt. 抑制, 阻止, 束縛
[法] 抑制, 遏制, 制止
def: v. keep under control; keep in check
v. to close within bounds, limit or hold back from movement
v. hold back

ex.en: She gently restrained the dog from chasing a squirrel.
ex.zh: 她輕輕拉住狗，不讓它去追松鼠。

ex.en: Governments may use tighter lending rules to restrain excessive borrowing and reduce risks in the housing market.
ex.zh: 政府可以通過收緊貸款規定來遏制過度借貸，降低住房市場風險。

col: restrain someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
words.tip: 常用restrain sb from doing，表示阻止某人做某事。

tr: [化] 飲料(如牛奶、茶、咖啡、啤酒等)
def: n. any liquid suitable for drinking
A drink, such as tea, juice, or coffee.

ex.en: Would you like a hot beverage with your sandwich?
ex.zh: 你想來杯熱飲配三明治嗎？

ex.en: Reducing the consumption of sugary beverages could help lower obesity rates among young people.
ex.zh: 減少含糖飲料的攝入可能有助於降低年輕人的肥胖率。

words.tip: beverage較正式，多用於餐飲或學術語境；日常用drink。

tr: a. 模仿的, 摹擬的
n. 效顰者, 模仿者, 小丑, 仿製品
def: n. someone who mimics (especially an actor or actress)
v. imitate (a person or manner), especially for satirical effect
s. constituting an imitation

ex.en: Our parrot mimics the sound of the doorbell perfectly.
ex.zh: 我們家的鸚鵡把門鈴聲模仿得惟妙惟肖。

ex.en: Engineers increasingly mimic natural structures to develop lighter materials that require less energy to manufacture.
ex.zh: 工程師越來越多地模擬自然結構，以開發製造時耗能更低的輕質材料。

col: mimic someone's voice｜模仿某人的聲音
mimic natural processes｜模擬自然過程
a talented mimic｜有天賦的模仿者
words.tip: 過去式mimicked，進行時mimicking，均加k。

def: n. projectiles to be fired from a gun
n. any nuclear or chemical or biological material that can be used as a weapon of mass destruction
n. information that can be used to attack or defend a claim or argument or viewpoint

tr: vt. 刺穿, 穿透, 打眼於, 洞悉, (聲音)響徹, (亮光)照進, 深深地打動
vi. 刺入, 穿入, 透入, 進入
def: n. 14th President of the United States (1804-1869)
v. cut or make a way through
v. move or affect (a person's emotions or bodily feelings) deeply or sharply

ex.en: Use a fork to pierce the potato before baking.
ex.zh: 烘烤前，用叉子在土豆上扎幾個孔。

ex.en: Powerful artificial lights pierce the darkness around coastal developments, potentially disturbing the behaviour of nesting birds.
ex.zh: 沿海開發區周圍的強烈人造光穿透黑暗，可能干擾築巢鳥類的行為。

words.tip: 打耳洞常說have/get your ears pierced。

tr: vt. 縱情於, 使高興, 放任, 遷就
def: v. give free rein to
v. enjoy to excess

tr: n. 小屋, 門房, 支部, 旅舍, 分會
vi. 臨時住宿, 倒伏, 寄宿, 投宿
vt. 安頓, 容納, 提出, 把...射入, 存放
def: n. English physicist who studied electromagnetic radiation and was a pioneer of radiotelegraphy (1851-1940)
n. small house at the entrance to the grounds of a country mansion; usually occupied by a gatekeeper or gardener
n. a small (rustic) house used as a temporary shelter

tr: a. 暫時的, 臨時的, 間歇的
def: n. the time between one event, process, or period and another
s. serving during an intermediate interval of time
Intended to last until a permanent arrangement is made.

ex.en: Our interim manager will stay until we find a replacement.
ex.zh: 我們的臨時經理會留任，直到我們找到接替者。

ex.en: The council introduced interim housing measures while permanent accommodation was being built for families displaced by flooding.
ex.zh: 在為因洪災失去住所的家庭建造永久住房期間，地方議會推出了臨時住房措施。

words.tip: 形容詞常置於名詞前；in the interim意為在此期間。

tr: [醫] 大氣的; 大氣壓的
def: a. relating to or located in the atmosphere
Relating to the gases surrounding Earth or another planet.
Creating a strong and distinctive mood or feeling.

ex.en: We found an atmospheric café tucked behind the old theatre.
ex.zh: 我們在老劇院後面發現了一家很有氛圍的咖啡館。

ex.en: Changes in atmospheric conditions can affect agricultural production and increase the frequency of extreme weather events.
ex.zh: 大氣狀況的變化會影響農業生產，並增加極端天氣事件發生的頻率。

col: an atmospheric setting｜富有氛圍的環境
words.tip: 修飾pressure指大氣的；修飾場所常指富有氛圍的。

tr: n. 乘公共車輛上下班者, 月季票乘客
def: n. a passenger train that is ridden primarily by passengers who travel regularly from one place to another
n. someone who travels regularly from home in a suburb to work in a city

tr: n. 分期連載作品, 連載小說
a. 連續的, 一連串的, 連載的, 分期償還的
def: n. a serialized set of programs
a. pertaining to or composed in serial technique
a. pertaining to or occurring in or producing a series

tr: 矮小動植物；傳說中矮人
def: n. a person who is markedly small
n. a plant or animal that is atypically small
v. check the growth of

ex.en: The new tower dwarfs every house on our street.
ex.zh: 新建的高塔讓我們街上所有房屋都顯得很矮小。

ex.en: The long-term costs of environmental damage may dwarf the immediate profits generated by industrial expansion.
ex.zh: 環境破壞的長期成本可能遠遠超過工業擴張帶來的眼前利潤。

col: be dwarfed by｜與……相比顯得渺小
words.tip: 動詞常表對比懸殊；名詞指人可能冒犯，應謹慎。

tr: vt. 超越, 凌駕, 勝過
def: v. be or do something to a greater degree
to be greater or better than someone or something

ex.en: Your homemade cakes surpass anything sold at our local bakery.
ex.zh: 你自制的蛋糕比我們附近麵包店賣的任何蛋糕都好。

ex.en: Demand for renewable energy may surpass current forecasts as governments introduce stronger measures to reduce carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 隨著各國政府採取更有力的減碳措施，可再生能源需求可能超過目前的預測。

col: surpass previous levels｜超過以往水平
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語，不加than。

tr: a. 無窮的, 無限的, 極大的
def: a. having no limits or boundaries in time or space or extent or magnitude
a. of verbs; having neither person nor number nor mood (as a participle or gerund or infinitive)
s. total and all-embracing

ex.en: My grandmother seems to have infinite patience with children.
ex.zh: 我奶奶對孩子似乎有無盡的耐心。

ex.en: Economic policies should not assume that the planet provides an infinite supply of natural resources.
ex.zh: 經濟政策不應假定地球能提供無限的自然資源。

words.tip: 通常作形容詞；表示“無窮”常用名詞infinity。

tr: n. 閒聊, 隨筆, 流言, 愛講閒話的人
def: n. a report (often malicious) about the behavior of other people
n. a person given to gossiping and divulging personal information about others

tr: a. 強壯的, 肌肉發達的, 有力的
[醫] 肌的; 肌肉發達的
def: a. of or relating to or consisting of muscle
s. having or suggesting great physical power or force
Having large, strong muscles.

ex.en: The muscular swimmer lifted the heavy box easily.
ex.zh: 那位肌肉發達的游泳運動員輕鬆舉起了沉重的箱子。

ex.en: Regular resistance training can improve muscular strength and help older adults maintain their independence.
ex.zh: 定期進行抗阻訓練可以增強肌肉力量，幫助老年人保持獨立生活的能力。

words.tip: 既可指肌肉發達，也可僅表示與肌肉有關。

tr: vt. 交換, 折償, 減輕
vi. 代償, 經常乘車來往
def: n. a regular journey of some distance to and from your place of work
v. exchange positions without a change in value
v. travel back and forth regularly, as between one's place of work and home

ex.en: I commute by train and usually read a book.
ex.zh: 我坐火車上下班，路上通常會看書。

ex.en: Employees who commute long distances may experience greater stress and have less time for family activities.
ex.zh: 長距離通勤的員工可能承受更大壓力，陪伴家人的時間也更少。

words.tip: 通勤用 commute to work；減刑用 commute a sentence。

tr: a. 有兩邊的, 雙邊的, 雙方的
def: s. having identical parts on each side of an axis
s. affecting or undertaken by two parties
s. having two sides or parts

tr: a. 陰曆的, 月的, 微亮的(指光)
def: a. of or relating to or associated with the moon
Relating to the moon.
Based on the changing phases of the moon.

ex.en: We watched the lunar eclipse from our garden.
ex.zh: 我們在花園裡觀看了月食。

ex.en: Research on lunar rocks helps scientists understand how the moon and the early solar system developed.
ex.zh: 對月球岩石的研究有助於科學家瞭解月球及早期太陽系的演變。

words.tip: lunar指月亮的；solar指太陽的。

tr: n. 不符合, 差異, 不相符之處
def: n. a difference between conflicting facts or claims or opinions
n. an event that departs from expectations
A difference between things that should match.

ex.en: We noticed a discrepancy between the two shopping receipts.
ex.zh: 我們發現兩張購物小票上的內容不一致。

ex.en: The discrepancy between official figures and survey results raises concerns about the accuracy of employment statistics.
ex.zh: 官方數據與調查結果的差異引發了人們對就業統計準確性的擔憂。

words.tip: 常指本應一致卻不符，搭配 between 或 in。

tr: a. 誠實的, 正直的, 真摯的, 純淨的
def: a. open and genuine; not deceitful
Honestly expressing what you really feel or believe

ex.en: Her sincere apology helped us become friends again.
ex.zh: 她真誠的道歉讓我們重新成為了朋友。

ex.en: Sincere efforts to consult local residents can strengthen public trust in major urban development projects.
ex.zh: 真誠徵求當地居民意見的努力，可以增強公眾對重大城市開發項目的信任。

words.tip: sincere強調不虛假；sincerely常用於信件結尾。

tr: n. 中間物, 調停者, 中級
a. 中間的, 中級的
def: n. a substance formed during a chemical process before the desired product is obtained
a. lying between two extremes in time or space or state
Between basic and advanced levels, or between two stages.

ex.en: This swimming class is suitable for intermediate learners.
ex.zh: 這門游泳課適合中級學員。

ex.en: Intermediate language courses should balance grammar instruction with opportunities for meaningful communication outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 中級語言課程應兼顧語法教學與課堂外有實際意義的交流機會。

words.tip: 常指介於beginner與advanced之間的水平。

def: n. an associate who shares a room with you

tr: vt. 使富足, 使肥沃
def: v. make better or improve in quality
v. make wealthy or richer
To improve something by adding value, interest, or experience.

ex.en: These weekend painting classes really enrich my daily life.
ex.zh: 這些週末繪畫課確實豐富了我的日常生活。

ex.en: International exchange programmes can enrich students' education by exposing them to different perspectives and teaching methods.
ex.zh: 國際交流項目能讓學生接觸不同觀點和教學方法，從而豐富他們的教育體驗。

col: enrich people's lives｜豐富人們的生活
words.tip: enrich是及物動詞，常接life、experience或soil。

tr: n. 潛水艇, 海底生物
a. 海中的, 生長在海中的
vi. 在下疾行, 在下滑動
def: n. a submersible warship usually armed with torpedoes
v. move forward or under in a sliding motion
v. throw with an underhand motion

tr: n. 火山口, 環行山, 彈坑
[化] 焊口; 火山石; 弧坑; 焰口
def: n. a faint constellation in the southern hemisphere near Hydra and Corvus
n. a bowl-shaped depression formed by the impact of a meteorite or bomb
n. a long narrow excavation in the earth
n. any small natural waterway
v. forsake

ex.en: Rainwater flowed through the ditch beside our vegetable garden.
ex.zh: 雨水流過我們菜園旁的排水溝。

ex.en: Cities should ditch outdated planning policies that encourage car dependence and invest instead in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 城市應摒棄鼓勵依賴汽車的過時規劃政策，轉而投資可靠的公共交通。

words.tip: 作動詞表示拋棄或放棄時偏口語。

tr: n. 暮光, 曙光, 黎明, 黃昏, 微光, 朦朧狀態
def: n. the time of day immediately following sunset
n. the diffused light from the sky when the sun is below the horizon but its rays are refracted by the atmosphere of the earth
n. a condition of decline following successes

ex.en: We walked home through the park in the twilight.
ex.zh: 我們在暮色中穿過公園走回家。

ex.en: In the twilight of their careers, experienced athletes can support younger competitors through coaching and mentoring.
ex.zh: 在職業生涯的末期，經驗豐富的運動員可以通過訓練和指導來幫助年輕選手。

col: the twilight of a career｜職業生涯的末期
words.tip: 多指日落後的暮光，也可指日出前的微光。

tr: vt. 處理, 排列, 佈置
def: v. give, sell, or transfer to another
v. make receptive or willing towards an action or attitude or belief
v. place or put in a particular order

ex.en: Where can I dispose of these old batteries safely?
ex.zh: 我可以在哪裡安全地處理這些舊電池？

ex.en: Local authorities should provide convenient facilities so residents can dispose of household waste responsibly.
ex.zh: 地方政府應提供便利的設施，讓居民能夠負責任地處理生活垃圾。

col: dispose of unwanted items｜處理不需要的物品
be disposed to agree｜傾向於同意
words.tip: 表示丟棄必須用dispose of，不能直接接物品。

def: v. decree or designate beforehand
to determine someone's future or something's intended purpose

ex.en: Everyone thought the talented young dancer was destined for success.
ex.zh: 大家都覺得這位有天賦的年輕舞者註定會成功。

ex.en: Children from disadvantaged backgrounds are not destined to fail if they receive appropriate educational support and opportunities.
ex.zh: 如果獲得適當的教育支持和機會，弱勢背景的兒童並非註定會失敗。

col: be destined to do｜註定會做
be destined for success｜註定成功
goods destined for export｜預定出口的貨物
words.tip: 幾乎總用被動：be destined for或to do。

tr: a. 回答的, 應答的, 易感應的
def: a. containing or using responses; alternating
a. readily reacting or replying to people or events or stimuli; showing emotion

tr: v. 疏散, 撤出, 排洩
def: v. move out of an unsafe location into safety
v. empty completely
v. move people from their homes or country

tr: vt. 使緊密聯繫, 使附屬, 接納, 收養
vi. 發生聯繫, 參加
def: n. a subordinate or subsidiary associate; a person who is affiliated with another or with an organization
n. a subsidiary or subordinate organization that is affiliated with another organization
v. join in an affiliation

ex.en: Our local cycling club is affiliated with a national organisation.
ex.zh: 我們當地的自行車俱樂部隸屬於一個全國性組織。

ex.en: Small research institutes often affiliate with universities to gain access to specialist equipment and academic expertise.
ex.zh: 小型研究機構常與大學建立隸屬關係，以獲得使用專業設備和藉助學術專長的機會。

col: be affiliated with｜與……有隸屬關係
a local affiliate｜地方附屬機構
words.tip: 名詞詞尾讀 /ət/，動詞詞尾讀 /eɪt/。

def: n. a quick evasive movement
n. a statement that evades the question by cleverness or trickery
v. make a sudden movement in a new direction so as to avoid

ex.en: I dodged a puddle and nearly dropped my shopping.
ex.zh: 我躲開一個水坑，差點把買的東西掉在地上。

ex.en: Public officials who dodge difficult questions may weaken citizens' trust in the institutions they represent.
ex.zh: 公職人員迴避棘手問題，可能會削弱公民對其所代表機構的信任。

words.tip: 可直接接賓語：dodge a question表示迴避問題。

tr: a. 令人驚異的, 了不起的, 不平常的
def: s. being or having the character of a miracle
extremely good or impressive

ex.en: We had a marvelous view of the snowy mountains.
ex.zh: 我們欣賞到了雪山的絕美景色。

ex.en: Public libraries offer a marvelous opportunity for people of all ages to explore new interests.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館為各年齡段的人探索新興趣提供了極好的機會。

words.tip: marvelous為美式拼寫；英式通常寫marvellous。

tr: n. 核心, 核子, 原子核, 起點
def: n. a part of the cell containing DNA and RNA and responsible for growth and reproduction
n. the positively charged dense center of an atom
n. (astronomy) the center of the head of a comet; consists of small solid particles of ice and frozen gas that vaporizes on approaching the sun to form the coma and tail

ex.en: The cell's nucleus looked purple under our classroom microscope.
ex.zh: 在教室的顯微鏡下，這個細胞的細胞核呈紫色。

ex.en: Damage to genetic material in the nucleus can affect how a cell functions and divides.
ex.zh: 細胞核中的遺傳物質受損會影響細胞的功能和分裂。

col: form the nucleus of｜構成……的核心
words.tip: 複數為nuclei；可指細胞核或原子核。

tr: a. (頭髮)亞麻色的, 淡色的, 白膚金髮碧眼的, 白裡透紅的, 白皙的, 淡黃色的
n. 膚色白皙的金髮女人
def: n a person with fair skin and hair
n a light grayish yellow to near white
a being or having light colored skin and hair and usually blue or grey eyes

ex.en: Her blonde hair shone brightly in the afternoon sun.
ex.zh: 她的金髮在午後的陽光下閃閃發亮。

ex.en: Films that repeatedly associate blonde hair with particular personalities can reinforce unfair stereotypes about appearance.
ex.zh: 電影若反覆將金髮與特定性格聯繫起來，可能會強化對外貌的不公平刻板印象。

words.tip: blonde多用於女性；描述男性通常用blond。

tr: n. 旋風, 龍捲風, 大雷雨
def: n. a localized and violently destructive windstorm occurring over land characterized by a funnel-shaped cloud extending toward the ground
a violently rotating column of air reaching down from a cloud

ex.en: We watched the tornado from a safe underground shelter.
ex.zh: 我們在安全的地下避難處觀察那場龍捲風。

ex.en: Effective warning systems can reduce injuries when a tornado approaches a densely populated area.
ex.zh: 當龍捲風接近人口密集地區時，有效的預警系統能夠減少人員受傷。

col: a powerful tornado｜強烈的龍捲風
tornado damage｜龍捲風造成的破壞
words.tip: 複數可寫tornadoes或tornados。

tr: vt. 使一致, 使遵守, 使符合
vi. 一致, 符合, 適應
def: v. be similar, be in line with
to follow rules or meet required standards
to behave as others in a group expect

ex.en: These new helmets conform to the latest safety standards.
ex.zh: 這些新頭盔符合最新的安全標準。

ex.en: Pressure to conform can discourage young people from expressing original ideas or questioning established traditions.
ex.zh: 要求隨大流的壓力可能使年輕人不願表達獨創想法，也不敢質疑既有傳統。

col: pressure to conform｜要求隨大流的壓力
words.tip: 常用conform to rules或standards，不直接接賓語。

def: n. a partially opened flower
n. a swelling on a plant stem consisting of overlapping immature leaves or petals
v. develop buds

ex.en: A tiny green bud appeared on the bare branch.
ex.zh: 光禿禿的樹枝上冒出了一個小小的綠芽。

ex.en: Warmer spring temperatures can cause trees to bud earlier, leaving new growth vulnerable to sudden frost.
ex.zh: 春季氣溫升高會使樹木提前發芽，導致新芽容易受到突發霜凍的損害。

col: nip something in the bud｜將某事扼殺在萌芽中
words.tip: 動詞過去式budded，現在分詞budding，雙寫d。

tr: vt. 抵住, 頂住, 經得起
def: v resist or confront with resistance
v stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
To resist damage or remain strong under pressure

ex.en: These boots can withstand rain, mud, and rough paths.
ex.zh: 這雙靴子經得起雨水、泥濘和崎嶇道路的考驗。

ex.en: Coastal infrastructure must be designed to withstand stronger storms as climate change increases the frequency of extreme weather.
ex.zh: 隨著氣候變化使極端天氣更加頻繁，沿海基礎設施的設計必須能抵禦更強的風暴。

col: withstand extreme temperatures｜耐受極端溫度
words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為withstood；後直接接賓語。

tr: vt. 驅逐, 逐出, 排出, 開除
def: v. force to leave or move out

tr: n. 裝置, 器具, 器官
def: n. equipment designed to serve a specific function
n. (anatomy) a group of body parts that work together to perform a given function

tr: adv. 簡直不, 一定不, 僅僅
def: r only a very short time before
r almost not
Almost not, or only just

ex.en: We could scarcely hear each other above the music.
ex.zh: 音樂聲太大，我們幾乎聽不清彼此說話。

ex.en: Some rural communities have scarcely enough medical staff to provide basic healthcare for their growing populations.
ex.zh: 一些農村社區的醫務人員僅勉強夠為日益增長的人口提供基本醫療服務。

words.tip: 本身含否定意義，不再加not；scarcely…when指剛…就…。

tr: n. 鬆弛, 鬆懈, 淡季, 閒散, 家常褲
a. 鬆弛的, 不流暢的, 疏忽的, 無力的, 呆滯的, 軟弱的, 漏水的
adv. 馬虎地, 緩慢地
vi. 鬆懈, 減弱, 鬆弛
def: n. dust consisting of a mixture of small coal fragments and coal dust and dirt that sifts out when coal is passed over a sieve
n. a stretch of water without current or movement
n. the quality of being loose (not taut)

ex.en: The tent rope was slack after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨過後，帳篷的繩子鬆了。

ex.en: When demand is slack, manufacturers may reduce working hours rather than dismiss experienced employees immediately.
ex.zh: 需求疲軟時，製造商可能會縮短工作時間，而不是立即解僱有經驗的員工。

col: take up the slack｜收緊鬆弛部分；補位
words.tip: slack指鬆弛或懈怠；slacks是寬鬆長褲。

tr: a. 普遍的, 流行的
def: s most frequent or common

tr: n. 奉獻, 獻身, 獻辭
def: n. complete and wholehearted fidelity
n. a ceremony in which something (as a building) is dedicated to some goal or purpose
n. a short message (as in a book or musical work or on a photograph) dedicating it to someone or something

tr: a. 考古學的, 考古學上的
def: a. related to or dealing with or devoted to archaeology

tr: vt. 綁架, 誘拐, 拐騙
[法] 拐帶, 誘拐, 綁架
def: v. take away to an undisclosed location against their will and usually in order to extract a ransom
To take someone away illegally and hold them captive

ex.en: In the film, criminals kidnap a wealthy businessman.
ex.zh: 電影中，犯罪分子綁架了一位富商。

ex.en: International cooperation helps police investigate criminal groups that kidnap people and demand money for their release.
ex.zh: 國際合作有助於警方調查綁架他人並索要贖金的犯罪團伙。

col: kidnap someone for ransom｜綁架某人索取贖金
words.tip: 不限於兒童；常用過去式kidnapped，分詞kidnapping。

tr: a. 有...傾向的, 易於的, 恰當的, 聰明的
[計] 自動數控語言, 自動圖象傳輸, 自動程序控制, 自動程序設計工具
def: s. (usually followed by `to') naturally disposed toward
s. at risk of or subject to experiencing something usually unpleasant
s. mentally quick and resourceful

tr: a. 互相耦合的, 清晰的, 明瞭的，凝聚性的, 連貫的
def: a. marked by an orderly, logical, and aesthetically consistent relation of parts
s. capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner
a. (physics) of waves having a constant phase relation

ex.en: After some practice, he gave a clear, coherent explanation.
ex.zh: 經過一些練習，他給出了清晰而有條理的解釋。

ex.en: A coherent transport policy should connect investment in public services with long-term environmental and economic goals.
ex.zh: 一項協調一致的交通政策應將公共服務投資與長期環境和經濟目標聯繫起來。

col: a coherent argument｜條理清楚的論證
a coherent explanation｜連貫清晰的解釋
a coherent strategy｜協調一致的策略
words.tip: 強調內容邏輯連貫；cohesive更強調各部分銜接緊密。

tr: n. 主要產物, 常用品, 主要要素, 原料, 訂書釘, 鉤環
a. 主要的, 重要的
def: n. a natural fiber (raw cotton, wool, hemp, flax) that can be twisted to form yarn
n. a short U-shaped wire nail for securing cables
n. paper fastener consisting of a short length of U-shaped wire that can fasten papers together

tr: a. 能共處的, 可並立的, 適合的
def: a. able to exist and perform in harmonious or agreeable combination
a. capable of being used with or connected to other devices or components without modification
s. capable of forming a homogeneous mixture that neither separates nor is altered by chemical interaction

ex.en: This charger is compatible with both of our tablets.
ex.zh: 這個充電器兼容我們的兩臺平板電腦。

ex.en: Economic growth can be compatible with environmental protection if governments encourage cleaner production and responsible resource use.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓勵更清潔的生產方式和負責任的資源利用，經濟增長就能與環境保護並行。

words.tip: 固定搭配是compatible with，不用compatible to。

tr: a. 易受影響的, 易感動的, 容許...的
[法] 易感的, 易受影響的, 容許
def: a. (often followed by `of' or `to') yielding readily to or capable of
s. easily impressed emotionally
easily affected or harmed by something

ex.en: These young plants are particularly susceptible to frost damage.
ex.zh: 這些幼苗特別容易遭受霜凍損害。

ex.en: Children may be more susceptible to online advertising because they lack experience in evaluating commercial claims.
ex.zh: 兒童可能更容易受到網絡廣告影響，因為他們缺乏評估商業宣傳的經驗。

words.tip: 常用susceptible to，to後接名詞。

def: n. an expression whose meaning cannot be determined from its context
n. unclearness by virtue of having more than one meaning

tr: a. 無情的, 冷酷的, 殘酷的
def: s not to be placated or appeased or moved by entreaty
s never-ceasing
continuing strongly without stopping or becoming less intense

ex.en: The relentless rain kept us indoors all weekend.
ex.zh: 雨下個不停，我們整個週末都待在屋裡。

ex.en: Relentless pressure to achieve high grades can undermine students' confidence and damage their mental health.
ex.zh: 持續不斷的高分壓力會削弱學生的信心，並損害他們的心理健康。

words.tip: 不限於“無情的”，也常形容雨、壓力等持續不減。

tr: n. 固定(狀態), 固定物, 設備
def: n. an object firmly fixed in place (especially in a household)

tr: v. (使)粉碎, (使)成為碎屑, 瓦解, 崩潰, 敗落
def: v. fall apart
v. break or fall apart into fragments
to break, or make something break, into small pieces

ex.en: The dry biscuit crumbled as I picked it up.
ex.zh: 我拿起那塊幹餅乾時，它碎了。

ex.en: Without regular maintenance, historic buildings may crumble, causing communities to lose an important part of their heritage.
ex.zh: 如果沒有定期維護，歷史建築可能逐漸坍塌，使社區失去重要的文化遺產。

col: crumble under pressure｜在壓力下崩潰
words.tip: 既可指實物碎裂，也可指信心、權力等崩潰。

def: v. guarantee payment on; of checks
v. guarantee as meeting a certain standard
v. declare legally insane

ex.en: An engineer certified that our new boiler was safe.
ex.zh: 一位工程師正式確認我們的新鍋爐是安全的。

ex.en: Independent organisations certify that certain products meet environmental standards, helping consumers make more informed purchasing decisions.
ex.zh: 獨立機構認證某些產品符合環保標準，幫助消費者作出更明智的購買決定。

col: certified organic｜經認證的有機產品
words.tip: 強調正式或權威證明，常用certify that從句。

tr: adv. 定期, 循環, 間歇, 週期, 定期刊行, 期刊
def: r in a sporadic manner

tr: a. 母親的, 母系的, 母方的
[醫] 屬母的, 母的, 母性的
def: a. characteristic of a mother
a. relating to or derived from one's mother

tr: a. 憤世嫉俗的, 諷刺的, 冷嘲的
懷疑他人動機的；憤世嫉俗的
損人利己的；不顧道義的
def: s. believing the worst of human nature and motives; having a sneering disbelief in e.g. selflessness of others
believing people act selfishly rather than honestly or generously
using others selfishly without concern for fairness or honesty

ex.en: Leah is cynical about shops offering supposedly free gifts.
ex.zh: 莉婭對商店所謂的免費贈禮持懷疑態度。

ex.en: Repeatedly broken promises can make citizens cynical about whether political leaders genuinely intend to improve public services.
ex.zh: 一再失信會讓公民懷疑政治領導人是否真心打算改善公共服務。

col: cynical about｜對……的動機持懷疑態度
a cynical attitude｜憤世嫉俗的態度
a cynical attempt｜不顧道義的企圖
words.tip: 常接about，側重懷疑善意，並非單純悲觀。

tr: a. 鈍的, 坦率的, 麻痺的
def: v. make less intense
v. make less sharp
s. having a broad or rounded end

ex.en: This blunt knife cannot even cut a ripe tomato.
ex.zh: 這把鈍刀連熟透的番茄都切不開。

ex.en: Although blunt feedback can feel uncomfortable, it sometimes helps students identify weaknesses in their work.
ex.zh: 雖然直白的反饋可能讓人不舒服，但有時能幫助學生髮現作業中的不足。

words.tip: 形容言語時指直接甚至冒犯，不一定是褒義。

tr: vt. 勝過, 優於, 擅長
def: v. distinguish oneself
n. a feeling of thankfulness and appreciation
A feeling of thankfulness for help or kindness received.

ex.en: She brought fresh flowers to express her gratitude.
ex.zh: 她帶來鮮花表達感激之情。

ex.en: Schools can encourage gratitude by helping students recognise the contributions that others make to their daily lives.
ex.zh: 學校可以幫助學生認識到他人對自己日常生活的貢獻，從而培養感恩之心。

col: gratitude to someone｜對某人的感激
gratitude for something｜對某事的感激
a token of gratitude｜一點謝意
words.tip: 對人感激用to，對某事感激用for；通常不可數。

tr: n. 三倍數, 三個一組
def: n. a base hit at which the batter stops safely at third base
n. a quantity that is three times as great as another
v. increase threefold

ex.en: The hotel charges triple the price during holidays.
ex.zh: 這家酒店在假日期間收取平時三倍的價格。

ex.en: Demand for renewable energy could triple as governments introduce stricter limits on carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 隨著各國政府對碳排放實施更嚴格的限制，可再生能源需求可能增至三倍。

col: triple in size｜規模增至三倍
words.tip: triple表示變為原來的三倍，即增加兩倍。

def: n. any of several complex proteins that are produced by cells and act as catalysts in specific biochemical reactions

tr: n. 圓筒, 圓筒狀物, 汽缸, 柱面
def: n. a solid bounded by a cylindrical surface and two parallel planes (the bases)
n. a surface generated by rotating a parallel line around a fixed line
n. a chamber within which piston moves

tr: a. 在前的, 前面的
[法] 在前的, 在先的, 前面的
def: a. existing or coming before
Happening or appearing before the thing being discussed.

ex.en: I slept badly on the night preceding my interview.
ex.zh: 面試前一晚，我睡得很不好。

ex.en: The survey revealed that household energy consumption had fallen significantly compared with the preceding year.
ex.zh: 調查顯示，與前一年相比，家庭能源消耗已顯著下降。

col: the immediately preceding period｜緊接此前的時期
words.tip: preceding指所談時間或事物之前的，不等於現在之前。

tr: vt. 鋪設, 安排, 鋪滿, 為...鋪路
def: n. a setting with precious stones so closely set that no metal shows
v. cover with a material such as stone or concrete to make suitable for vehicle traffic
To cover ground with stone, concrete, or another hard surface.

ex.en: Workers are paving the narrow path behind our house.
ex.zh: 工人們正在給我們屋後的小路鋪設路面。

ex.en: Local authorities should pave busy pedestrian routes with durable materials that remain safe in wet weather.
ex.zh: 地方政府應使用耐用且在雨天仍能確保安全的材料鋪設繁忙的步行通道。

col: pave the way for｜為……鋪平道路
words.tip: pave the way for比喻“為……創造條件”。

tr: n. 預防, 留心, 警戒
def: n. a precautionary measure warding off impending danger or damage or injury etc.
n. the trait of practicing caution in advance
an action taken to prevent danger, damage, or problems

ex.en: We packed an extra torch as a precaution.
ex.zh: 我們多帶了一個手電筒，以防萬一。

ex.en: Taking basic safety precautions in laboratories can prevent accidents and protect both students and teaching staff.
ex.zh: 在實驗室採取基本安全防範措施，可以預防事故並保護師生。

col: as a precaution｜作為預防措施
a precaution against fire｜防火措施
words.tip: 常用 take precautions；as a precaution 表示以防萬一。

tr: n. 滑動, 滑過, 流水
vi. 滑動, 滑翔, 溜走, 流逝
def: n. the activity of flying a glider
v. move smoothly and effortlessly
v. fly in or as if in a glider plane

ex.en: The swan glided across the pond towards the reeds.
ex.zh: 天鵝平穩地遊過池塘，朝蘆葦叢靠近。

ex.en: Large birds conserve energy by gliding on rising air currents rather than continuously flapping their wings.
ex.zh: 大型鳥類藉助上升氣流滑翔，而不是持續拍打翅膀，以此節省能量。

col: glide through the air｜在空中滑翔
words.tip: 強調移動平穩輕盈；空中滑翔也用glide。

tr: a. 有傳染性的, 易傳染的
def: s. caused by infection or capable of causing infection
a. easily spread; children catch it from their elders"- Bertrand Russell
a. of or relating to infection

ex.en: His infectious laugh soon had everyone at the table smiling.
ex.zh: 他富有感染力的笑聲很快讓桌邊的每個人都笑了起來。

ex.en: Improved sanitation and access to clean water are essential for preventing infectious diseases in densely populated communities.
ex.zh: 改善衛生條件並保障清潔用水，對預防人口密集社區的傳染病至關重要。

words.tip: infectious表示有傳染性；infected表示已被感染。

tr: n. 開始, 攻擊, 進攻
def: n. the beginning or early stages
The beginning of something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: The sudden onset of rain sent us running indoors.
ex.zh: 突然下起雨來，我們趕緊跑進屋裡。

ex.en: Regular physical activity may delay the onset of certain chronic diseases and improve overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 經常進行體育活動可能延緩某些慢性病的發生，並改善整體健康狀況。

col: the onset of symptoms｜症狀的出現
the onset of winter｜冬季的來臨
words.tip: 常用the onset of，多指疾病或不利情況的開始。

tr: adv. 不變化地, 恆定地, 始終如一地
def: r without variation or change, in every case
Always, or on every occasion.

ex.en: My brother invariably falls asleep during long train journeys.
ex.zh: 我哥哥每次坐長途火車都會睡著。

ex.en: In this study, participants with longer commuting times invariably reported having less time for leisure activities.
