ex.zh: 在這項研究中，通勤時間較長的參與者無一例外都表示，自己的休閒時間較少。

words.tip: 比usually語氣更強，表示每次如此，而非通常如此。

def: n. ceramic ware made from clay and baked in a kiln
n. the craft of making earthenware
n. a workshop where clayware is made

ex.en: The market stall displayed pottery in soft earthy colours.
ex.zh: 市場攤位上陳列著色調柔和、帶有泥土色澤的陶器。

ex.en: Traditional pottery can reveal how earlier societies stored food, traded goods, and expressed their cultural identity.
ex.zh: 傳統陶器能夠揭示早期社會如何儲存食物、交易商品以及表達文化身份。

words.tip: 指陶器統稱時不可數；一件用a piece of pottery。

tr: a. 性質的, 質的, 定性的
def: a. involving distinctions based on qualities
a. relating to or involving comparisons based on qualities

tr: n. 無數, 無數的人(或物)
a. 無數的, 種種的
def: n. a large indefinite number

tr: n. 守候, 偵察, 搜索, 偵察員, 偵察機
vi. 守候, 偵察, 巡視, 嘲笑
vt. 偵察, 跟蹤, 發現, 監視, 嘲弄
def: n. a Boy Scout or Girl Scout
n. someone employed to discover and recruit talented persons (especially in the worlds of entertainment or sports)
n. someone who can find paths through unexplored territory

ex.en: A scout watched our team practise after school.
ex.zh: 放學後，一位球探觀看了我們隊的訓練。

ex.en: Sports clubs often scout for talented young players in communities that lack access to professional training facilities.
ex.zh: 體育俱樂部經常到缺乏專業訓練設施的社區尋找有天賦的年輕球員。

col: a talent scout｜星探；人才發掘者
scout out a location｜勘察地點
words.tip: scout for後接尋找的對象；童子軍成員常寫作Scout。

tr: n. 文件夾, 摺紙機, 摺疊式書本, 卷宗
def: n. covering that is folded over to protect the contents
A folded cover used to hold loose papers.
A place on a computer where files are grouped together.

ex.en: Keep your receipts in this folder beside the desk.
ex.zh: 把收據放在桌子旁的這個文件夾裡。

ex.en: Organising digital resources into clearly named folders can help students locate information efficiently during research projects.
ex.zh: 將數字資源整理到命名清晰的文件夾中，可以幫助學生在研究項目中高效查找信息。

col: save files in a folder｜將文件存入文件夾
words.tip: file是文件；folder是存放文件的文件夾。

tr: a. 印刷的, 印好的, 印花樣的
def: v put into print
v write as if with print; not cursive
v make into a print
n. a subset of committee members organized for a specific purpose

tr: a. 貌似真實的, 貌似合理的, 說得煞有其事的
[法] 花言巧語的, 似乎有理的
def: a. apparently reasonable and valid, and truthful
s. given to or characterized by presenting specious arguments
Seeming reasonable or likely to be true

ex.en: His explanation sounded plausible, but I still checked.
ex.zh: 他的解釋聽起來很合理，但我還是核實了一下。

ex.en: Although remote working offers a plausible solution to congestion, its long-term effects require further investigation.
ex.zh: 雖然遠程辦公似乎是緩解擁堵的合理方案，但其長期影響仍需進一步研究。

col: plausible excuse｜聽起來可信的藉口
plausible solution｜看似可行的解決方案
words.tip: 表示聽起來合理，不保證真實，也不一定暗指虛假。

tr: vt. 使困擾, 使煩惱, 折磨
def: v. annoy continually or chronically
v. exhaust by attacking repeatedly
v. have a conference in order to talk something over
v. present
Discuss something with others before making a decision.

ex.en: The coaches conferred quietly before choosing the final team.
ex.zh: 教練們低聲商議後才確定最終的隊伍陣容。

ex.en: Universities often confer honorary degrees on individuals who have made outstanding contributions to science or public service.
ex.zh: 大學常向在科學或公共服務領域作出傑出貢獻的人士授予榮譽學位。

col: confer a degree on someone｜授予某人學位
words.tip: 商議用confer with；授予用confer sth on sb。

tr: a. 熱的, 熱量的, 溫泉的
def: n. rising current of warm air
a. relating to or associated with heat
a. of or relating to a hot spring

ex.en: Our thermal camera shows where heat escapes the house.
ex.zh: 我們的熱成像相機能顯示房屋哪些地方在散熱。

ex.en: Improving thermal insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and make homes more comfortable during winter.
ex.zh: 改善老舊建築的隔熱性能可以減少能源消耗，讓住宅在冬季更加舒適。

words.tip: thermal可指與熱有關，也可指衣物保暖。

tr: vt. 喚醒, 鼓勵, 引起
def: v. call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses)
v. to begin moving, "As the thunder started the sleeping children began to stir"
v. stimulate sexually

ex.en: The locked wooden box aroused my curiosity immediately.
ex.zh: 那個上鎖的木盒立刻引起了我的好奇。

ex.en: Proposals to replace public parks with commercial buildings are likely to arouse strong opposition among local residents.
ex.zh: 用商業建築取代公共公園的提案很可能激起當地居民的強烈反對。

words.tip: arouse 後接賓語；arise 表示“出現”，不接賓語。

tr: n. 矮樹, 灌木, 果汁甜酒
def: n. a low woody perennial plant usually having several major stems
A woody plant with several stems, usually smaller than a tree

ex.en: A small bird was hiding beneath the flowering shrub.
ex.zh: 一隻小鳥躲在開花的灌木下面。

ex.en: Planting native shrubs in urban parks provides shelter for wildlife and can reduce the need for irrigation.
ex.zh: 在城市公園種植本地灌木能為野生動物提供棲息處，還能減少灌溉需求。

words.tip: 可數名詞，指灌木植株；一片灌木可用shrubbery。

tr: vt. 鞏固, 使聯合, 統一
def: v. unite into one
v. make firm or secure; strengthen
v. bring together into a single whole or system

ex.en: I review my notes each evening to consolidate my learning.
ex.zh: 我每晚複習筆記，以鞏固所學內容。

ex.en: Regular practical exercises help students consolidate their knowledge and apply theoretical concepts to unfamiliar situations.
ex.zh: 定期的實踐練習有助於學生鞏固知識，並將理論概念應用於陌生情境。

words.tip: 既可指鞏固已有成果，也可指合併多個部分。

tr: a. 著重, 強調, 重讀, 使受應力
def: s extremely irritating to the nerves
Causing worry or mental strain

ex.en: Moving house was stressful, but our friends helped.
ex.zh: 搬家讓人壓力很大，但朋友們幫了忙。

ex.en: Long commutes can make working life more stressful and leave less time for family activities.
ex.zh: 長時間通勤會增加工作生活的壓力，並減少與家人活動的時間。

col: a stressful situation｜令人緊張的處境
a stressful job｜壓力大的工作
a stressful experience｜令人緊張的經歷
words.tip: stressful形容壓力來源；stressed形容人的感受。

tr: vt. 使惡化, 使增劇, 激怒, 使加劇
def: v. exasperate or irritate

tr: n. 可觸知的東西, 有形資產
a. 可觸摸的, 有實體的, 非相像的, 有形的, 明確的
def: a. perceptible by the senses especially the sense of touch
a. (of especially business assets) having physical substance and intrinsic monetary value

tr: n. 壯舉, 功績, 技藝表演
a. 靈巧的, 合適的, 整潔的
def: n. a notable achievement
An achievement requiring great skill, strength, or courage.

ex.en: Carrying that huge sofa upstairs was quite a feat.
ex.zh: 把那張大沙發搬上樓可真不容易。

ex.en: Building a railway across mountainous terrain remains an impressive feat of engineering, even with modern technology.
ex.zh: 即使有現代技術，在山區修建鐵路仍是一項令人讚歎的工程壯舉。

col: an impressive feat｜令人讚歎的壯舉
a feat of engineering｜工程壯舉
no mean feat｜了不起的成就
words.tip: 與feet同音；no mean feat意為很了不起。

tr: vi. 呻吟, 抱怨, 受壓迫
def: n. an utterance expressing pain or disapproval
v. indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure
n. a militant reformer
s. disposed to warfare or hard-line policies

tr: vi. 居住, 居住(於), 存在(於)
def: v. originate (in)
v. exist or be situated within
To live in a particular place.

ex.en: Small creatures dwell beneath the stones in our garden.
ex.zh: 我們花園的石頭下面住著一些小生物。

ex.en: Rather than dwell on past failures, schools should help students develop practical strategies for future improvement.
ex.zh: 學校不應一味糾結過去的失敗，而應幫助學生制定切實可行的改進策略。

col: dwell on the past｜沉湎於過去
dwell on a problem｜反覆思考一個問題
words.tip: 居住義較正式；dwell on指反覆想著或詳述某事。

tr: n. 火把, 啟發之物
def: n. a light usually carried in the hand; consists of some flammable substance
v. burn maliciously, as by arson
A small electric light carried in the hand.

ex.en: I used a torch to find my missing keys.
ex.zh: 我用手電筒尋找丟失的鑰匙。

ex.en: Hikers should carry a torch and spare batteries when exploring remote areas after sunset.
ex.zh: 徒步者在日落後探索偏遠地區時，應攜帶手電筒和備用電池。

col: switch on a torch｜打開手電筒
a torch beam｜手電筒的光束
words.tip: 手電筒英式叫torch，美式叫flashlight。

tr: vi. 暗藏, 潛伏, 埋伏
def: v. lie in wait, lie in ambush, behave in a sneaky and secretive manner
stay hidden, often waiting to do something
exist unnoticed and potentially cause trouble

ex.en: A cat lurked behind the sofa, watching my shoelaces.
ex.zh: 一隻貓躲在沙發後面，盯著我的鞋帶。

ex.en: Security risks may lurk in outdated software, making regular system updates essential for protecting personal information.
ex.zh: 過時的軟件中可能暗藏安全風險，因此定期更新系統對保護個人信息至關重要。

col: lurk in the shadows｜潛伏在暗處
words.tip: 通常作不及物動詞；可用危險等抽象事物作主語。

tr: a. 有結尾的, (可)結束的
vi. 結束, 終止, 滿期
vt. 使停止, 使結束, 使終止
def: v bring to an end or halt
v have an end, in a temporal, spatial, or quantitative sense; either spatial or metaphorical
v be the end of; be the last or concluding part of

ex.en: We decided to terminate our gym membership last month.
ex.zh: 我們上個月決定終止健身房會員資格。

ex.en: Employers should not terminate contracts without providing clear reasons and allowing workers sufficient time to respond.
ex.zh: 僱主終止合同時，應提供明確理由，並給予員工充足的回應時間。

col: terminate at a station｜在某站終到
words.tip: 正式用詞；可及物或不及物，列車終到用at。

tr: n. 雜亂一團, 混亂, 擁擠
vt. 把...擠在一起, 亂堆, 草率了事, 蜷曲
vi. 擠作一團, 蜷縮
def: n. (informal) a quick private conference
n. a disorganized and densely packed crowd
v. crowd or draw together

ex.en: We huddled under one umbrella until the rain stopped.
ex.zh: 我們擠在同一把傘下，直到雨停。

ex.en: Without adequate shelter, displaced families may huddle together outdoors, increasing their exposure to cold and illness.
ex.zh: 缺乏足夠住所時，流離失所的家庭可能只好在戶外擠作一團，更容易受寒和生病。

col: huddle for warmth｜擠在一起取暖
huddle around a fire｜圍著火堆擠在一起
words.tip: huddle強調緊靠，常為取暖、避險或私下商議。

tr: n. 演習, 調遣, 策略
v. 調遣, 演習, 用計
def: n. a military training exercise
n. a deliberate coordinated movement requiring dexterity and skill
n. a move made to gain a tactical end

tr: n. 鑑定, 查驗, 證明, 試用, 察看, 緩刑
[醫] 審辨, 試驗, 鑑定, 試用, 見習
def: n. a trial period during which your character and abilities are tested to see whether you are suitable for work or for membership
n. a trial period during which an offender has time to redeem himself or herself
n. (law) a way of dealing with offenders without imprisoning them; a defendant found guilty of a crime is released by the court without imprisonment subject to conditions imposed by the court

tr: n. 失事, 殘骸, 破壞
vt. 使失事, 拆毀, 破壞
vi. (船)失事, 營救失事船隻
失事船隻；嚴重損毀的車輛
def: n. something or someone that has suffered ruin or dilapidation
n. a ship that has been destroyed at sea
A ship or vehicle that has been badly damaged.

ex.en: Divers found a shipwreck beside the wreck of a submarine.
ex.zh: 潛水員在一艘潛艇殘骸旁發現了一艘沉船。

ex.en: Poorly planned construction can wreck historic neighbourhoods and permanently reduce their cultural value for future generations.
ex.zh: 規劃不當的建設會毀壞歷史街區，並永久削弱其對後代的文化價值。

col: wreck someone's plans｜打亂某人的計劃
words.tip: wreck可指一艘失事船；wreckage泛指殘骸。

def: n. waste matter carried away in sewers or drains
Wastewater and human waste carried away through drains

ex.en: Untreated sewage flowed into the river after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，未經處理的汙水流入了河裡。

ex.en: Investing in modern sewage treatment facilities is essential for protecting freshwater ecosystems and maintaining public health.
ex.zh: 投資建設現代汙水處理設施，對保護淡水生態系統和維護公共衛生至關重要。

words.tip: 不可數；sewage是汙水，sewer才是下水道。

tr: a. 有名的, 有聲譽的
def: s widely known and esteemed
Widely known and admired for a particular quality or achievement.

ex.en: This small bakery is renowned for its fresh bread.
ex.zh: 這家小麵包店以新鮮麵包聞名。

ex.en: Universities renowned for scientific research often attract international students and encourage cooperation across national borders.
ex.zh: 以科學研究享有盛譽的大學往往吸引國際學生，並促進跨國合作。

words.tip: renowned for接成就或特色；renowned as接身份。

tr: a. 男性的, 陽性的, 有丈夫氣的
def: n. a gender that refers chiefly (but not exclusively) to males or to objects classified as male
a. of grammatical gender
a. associated with men and not with women

ex.en: The jacket gives the outfit a traditionally masculine look.
ex.zh: 這件夾克讓整套穿搭呈現出傳統的男性風格。

ex.en: Ideas about masculine behaviour vary across cultures and can influence the career choices available to young people.
ex.zh: 不同文化對男性行為的觀念各異，並可能影響年輕人可選擇的職業道路。

words.tip: male表示生理性別；masculine多指特徵或語法性別。

tr: n. 碎屑, 麵包屑, 少許
def: n. a very small quantity of something
n. small piece of e.g. bread or cake
v. coat with bread crumbs

ex.en: A crumb fell from my toast onto the table.
ex.zh: 一粒麵包屑從我的吐司上掉到了桌上。

ex.en: Even small food scraps, such as bread crumbs, can attract pests when waste is poorly managed.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾處理不當，即使是麵包屑這樣的小塊食物殘渣，也會招來害蟲。

col: a crumb of comfort｜一絲安慰
words.tip: 可數名詞；表示麵包屑時常用複數crumbs。

tr: n. 性情, 處置, 處理, 佈置
def: n. your usual mood
n. a natural or acquired habit or characteristic tendency in a person or thing
a person's usual mood and way of behaving

ex.en: Her cheerful disposition makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
ex.zh: 她開朗的性格讓陰雨天的早晨也顯得明亮起來。

ex.en: Children with a cautious disposition may benefit from gradual exposure to unfamiliar classroom activities.
ex.zh: 性格謹慎的孩子逐步接觸陌生的課堂活動，可能會從中受益。

col: a disposition to help｜樂於助人的傾向
a disposition towards anxiety｜容易焦慮的傾向
words.tip: 性情義常用單數；a disposition to do表示做某事的傾向。

tr: n. 變應性, 反感, 厭惡
[化] 變態反應; 變應性
def: n. hypersensitivity reaction to a particular allergen; symptoms can vary greatly in intensity
A condition causing illness after contact with a normally harmless substance

ex.en: My brother has an allergy to peanuts and walnuts.
ex.zh: 我哥哥對花生和核桃過敏。

ex.en: Schools should have clear procedures for helping children who experience a severe food allergy reaction.
ex.zh: 學校應制定明確流程，為出現嚴重食物過敏反應的兒童提供幫助。

words.tip: 常用have an allergy to；to後接引起過敏的物質。

tr: v. 連續猛打（尤其指婦女），猛擊
n. 麵糊（食物），擊球員，打擊手
def: n. (baseball) a ballplayer who is batting
n. a liquid or semiliquid mixture, as of flour, eggs, and milk, used in cooking
n. a small narrow pointed missile that is thrown or shot
n. a tapered tuck made in dressmaking
v. run or move very quickly or hastily

ex.en: A squirrel darted across the path ahead of us.
ex.zh: 一隻松鼠在我們前方飛快地穿過小路。

ex.en: When animals dart across busy roads, wildlife crossings can provide safer routes and help protect local populations.
ex.zh: 當動物飛快地穿越繁忙道路時，野生動物通道可以提供更安全的路線，幫助保護當地種群。

col: dart across the road｜飛快地穿過馬路
dart a glance at｜迅速瞥一眼
words.tip: 飛鏢運動用darts；作主語時謂語用單數。

def: n. the loyalty that citizens owe to their country (or subjects to their sovereign)
Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.

ex.en: Despite moving abroad, he kept his allegiance to his hometown club.
ex.zh: 儘管移居國外，他仍忠於家鄉的俱樂部。

ex.en: Political allegiance can influence how voters interpret economic policies and assess the performance of elected officials.
ex.zh: 政治立場上的忠誠會影響選民如何解讀經濟政策，以及如何評價當選官員的表現。

words.tip: 效忠對象用to引出：allegiance to a country。

tr: a. 批發的, 大規模的
adv. 大規模, 照批發方式
vi. 經營批發業, 批發
def: n. the selling of goods to merchants; usually in large quantities for resale to consumers
v. sell in large quantities
r. at a wholesale price

tr: n. 熔合物, 結合, 熔合
[化] 熔融; 熔化; 聚變
def: n. an occurrence that involves the production of a union
n. the merging of adjacent sounds or syllables or words
n. a nuclear reaction in which nuclei combine to form more massive nuclei with the simultaneous release of energy

ex.en: Her cooking is a fusion of different regional styles.
ex.zh: 她的烹飪融合了不同地區的風格。

ex.en: Scientists are investigating nuclear fusion as a potential source of abundant energy with low carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 科學家正在研究核聚變，將其視為一種潛在的、供應充足且碳排放低的能源。

col: a fusion of styles｜多種風格的融合
words.tip: 核聚變用fusion；核裂變用fission，注意區分。

tr: n. 證人, 保證人, 證明者, 憑證, 憑單
def: n. someone who vouches for another or for the correctness of a statement
n. a document that serves as evidence of some expenditure
A document exchangeable for goods, services, or a discount.

ex.en: I used my gift voucher to buy new shoes.
ex.zh: 我用禮品券買了新鞋。

ex.en: Governments can provide training vouchers to help unemployed adults develop skills required by local employers.
ex.zh: 政府可以提供培訓券，幫助失業成年人掌握當地僱主所需的技能。

words.tip: 常用a voucher for；兌換券用redeem a voucher。

def: n. a hand tool for lifting loose material; consists of a curved container or scoop and a handle
n. the quantity a shovel can hold
n. a fire iron consisting of a small shovel used to scoop coals or ashes in a fireplace

ex.en: I used a shovel to clear the snowy path.
ex.zh: 我用鏟子清除了小路上的積雪。

ex.en: Community volunteers shovelled soil into raised beds to create a garden on unused urban land.
ex.zh: 社區志願者把土鏟進高架種植床，在閒置的城市土地上建起花園。

words.tip: 英式過去式為shovelled，美式為shoveled。

tr: n. 小教堂, 禮拜式
def: n. a place of worship that has its own altar

tr: a. 複雜的, 錯綜的, 纏結的, 難懂的
def: s. having many complexly arranged elements; elaborate
n garden consisting of a small cultivated wood without undergrowth

tr: n. 革新, 刷新, 修理
def: n. the act of improving by renewing and restoring
n. the state of being restored to its former good condition
The process of repairing and improving a building or room.

ex.en: We stayed with friends during the renovation of our kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房翻修期間，我們住在朋友家。

ex.en: The renovation of historic buildings can preserve local identity while providing suitable spaces for modern businesses.
ex.zh: 翻修歷史建築既能保留地方特色，也能為現代商業提供合適的空間。

words.tip: 主要指建築翻修；制度革新通常不用此詞。

def: n. United States jurist appointed chief justice of the United States Supreme Court by Richard Nixon (1907-1995)
A flat food patty, often served inside a round bread roll

ex.en: I ordered a bean burger with salad for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐點了一個豆類漢堡配沙拉。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce their environmental impact by offering plant-based burgers alongside traditional meat dishes.
ex.zh: 餐館可以在供應傳統肉類菜餚的同時提供植物基漢堡，以減少對環境的影響。

words.tip: burger也可指肉餅本身，並非都以牛肉製成。

def: n. a straight line connecting two points on a curve
n. a combination of three or more notes that blend harmoniously when sounded together
v. play chords on (a string instrument)
n. a vote that blocks a decision
n. the power or right to prohibit or reject a proposed or intended act (especially the power of a chief executive to reject a bill passed by the legislature)
v. vote against; refuse to endorse; refuse to assent

ex.en: The club president used her veto to stop the purchase.
ex.zh: 俱樂部主席行使否決權，叫停了這次購買。

ex.en: Giving every member a veto can protect minority interests but may also delay urgent collective decisions.
ex.zh: 賦予每位成員否決權可以保護少數群體的利益，但也可能拖延緊迫的集體決策。

words.tip: 複數vetoes；動詞過去式vetoed。

tr: a. 蕭瑟的, 荒涼的, 陰冷的
def: s. unpleasantly cold and damp
offering little hope of improvement or success
cold, bare, and unwelcoming

ex.en: Without enough rain, the farm faces a bleak future.
ex.zh: 如果雨水不足，這座農場的前景就很黯淡。

ex.en: Employment prospects remain bleak in rural areas where traditional industries have declined and investment is limited.
ex.zh: 在傳統產業衰退且投資有限的農村地區，就業前景依然黯淡。

words.tip: 既可描述荒涼陰冷的環境，也可描述無望的前景。

tr: n. 挫折, 退步, 逆流
def: n an unfortunate happening that hinders or impedes; something that is thwarting or frustrating

tr: n. 面紗, 面罩, 藉口, 幕, 帳, 遮蔽物
vt. 戴面紗, 隱藏, 遮蔽, 掩飾
def: n. a membranous covering attached to the immature fruiting body of certain mushrooms
v. to obscure, or conceal with or as if with a veil
a thin piece of material covering the face or head

ex.en: She lifted her veil to take a sip of water.
ex.zh: 她掀起面紗，喝了一小口水。

ex.en: A veil of secrecy around major planning decisions can weaken public trust in local government.
ex.zh: 重大規劃決策被秘密籠罩，會削弱公眾對地方政府的信任。

col: a veil of secrecy｜神秘的掩蓋
thinly veiled criticism｜幾乎不加掩飾的批評
words.tip: a veil of可比喻一層遮掩；veiled也表示含蓄的。

tr: a. 不安靜的, 慌張的, 休息不充分的
[醫] 不安靜的, 不寧的
坐立不安的；難以休息的
def: s. worried and uneasy
s. ceaselessly in motion
a. lacking or not affording physical or mental rest

ex.en: The restless child kept swinging her legs under the table.
ex.zh: 那個坐不住的孩子不停地在桌下晃腿。

ex.en: Students may become restless during lengthy lectures if they have few opportunities to participate actively.
ex.zh: 如果缺少積極參與的機會，學生在長時間的講座中可能會坐立不安。

col: a restless spirit｜不甘安定的性情
words.tip: restless指難以安靜；restful指令人放鬆的。

tr: vt. 用力投擲, 發射, 憤慨地說出, 丟下
def: n. a violent throw
v. throw forcefully
v. utter with force; utter vehemently

tr: vt. 供給, 提供, 裝設
[化] 供應; 供給; 配料
def: v. provide or equip with furniture
put furniture into a room or building
provide someone with something needed, especially information

ex.en: We furnished our flat with second-hand tables and chairs.
ex.zh: 我們用二手桌椅佈置了公寓。

ex.en: Applicants must furnish the university with evidence of their qualifications before their applications can be assessed.
ex.zh: 申請人必須向大學提供學歷或資格證明，學校才能評估其申請。

col: furnish a flat｜為公寓配備傢俱
furnish someone with evidence｜向某人提供證據
words.tip: furnish A with B指向A提供B；提供義較正式。

tr: a. 分析的, 善於分析的, 解析的
def: a using or skilled in using analysis (i.e., separating a whole--intellectual or substantial--into its elemental parts or basic principles)
a of a proposition that is necessarily true independent of fact or experience

tr: a. 空中的, 航空的, 空氣的, 空想的
def: a. existing or living or growing or operating in the air
Happening in the air or done from above the ground.
A device that receives or sends radio or television signals.

ex.en: The aerial photograph showed our house beside the river.
ex.zh: 這張航拍照片拍出了我們河邊的房子。

ex.en: Aerial surveys allow researchers to monitor forest loss across remote regions without disturbing wildlife.
ex.zh: 航空調查讓研究人員能夠監測偏遠地區的森林流失，而不驚擾野生動物。

words.tip: 作“天線”主要用於英式英語；美式常用antenna。

tr: n. 親戚, 同族, 血緣關係, 家族
a. 有親屬關係的, 性質類似的, 同類的
def: n. a person having kinship with another or others
n. group of people related by blood or marriage

tr: a. 中間的, 中央的, 中部的
def: s. used in combination to denote the middle

tr: v. 吃吃地笑, 咯咯地笑
def: n. a foolish or nervous laugh
v. laugh nervously
laugh in a light, often nervous or silly way

ex.en: The children giggled when the puppy chased its tail.
ex.zh: 小狗追著自己的尾巴轉，孩子們咯咯地笑了起來。

ex.en: Young learners may giggle during unfamiliar activities, but this reaction does not necessarily indicate a lack of interest.
ex.zh: 年幼的學習者進行不熟悉的活動時可能會咯咯笑，但這種反應不一定表明他們缺乏興趣。

col: giggle at a joke｜聽到笑話咯咯笑
words.tip: 強調輕輕咯咯笑，可因好玩或緊張；笑某事用at。

tr: n. 關稅, 關稅表, 價格表, 收費表
def: v. charge a tariff
a tax charged on goods entering or leaving a country
a set of charges for a service

ex.en: The new tariff made imported cheese much more expensive.
ex.zh: 新關稅使進口奶酪貴了很多。

ex.en: Although tariffs may protect domestic manufacturers, they can also raise consumer prices and provoke trade disputes.
ex.zh: 關稅雖然可能保護國內製造商，但也可能推高消費價格並引發貿易爭端。

words.tip: 關稅用tariff on goods；複數tariffs常指多項關稅。

def: n. an official report (usually sent in haste)
n. the act of sending off something
n. the property of being prompt and efficient

ex.en: The shop dispatched my new shoes this morning.
ex.zh: 商店今天早上寄出了我的新鞋。

ex.en: Local authorities should dispatch emergency teams quickly when severe flooding threatens homes and essential infrastructure.
ex.zh: 當嚴重洪災威脅住宅和關鍵基礎設施時，地方政府應迅速派出應急隊伍。

words.tip: despatch也是正確拼寫，但dispatch更常見。

def: n. an outward semblance that misrepresents the true nature of something
n. any attire that modifies the appearance in order to conceal the wearer's identity
n. the act of concealing the identity of something by modifying its appearance

ex.en: Nadia disguised herself with a wig and oversized glasses.
ex.zh: 娜迪婭戴上假髮和超大眼鏡，把自己喬裝起來。

ex.en: Attractive packaging can disguise poor product quality, making it harder for consumers to make informed choices.
ex.zh: 精美包裝可能掩蓋產品質量問題，使消費者更難作出明智選擇。

col: disguise yourself as｜把自己裝扮成
disguise the fact that｜掩蓋……的事實
a blessing in disguise｜因禍得福的事
words.tip: disguise oneself as後接所扮角色。

tr: a. 居間的, 間接的
vi. 處於中間, 調解
def: v. occupy an intermediate or middle position or form a connecting link or stage between two others
a. acting through or dependent on an intervening agency
To help opposing sides reach an agreement.

ex.en: Our neighbour offered to mediate when we argued about parking.
ex.zh: 我們因停車問題爭吵時，鄰居主動提出調解。

ex.en: Independent organisations can mediate between employers and workers to resolve disputes before they disrupt essential public services.
ex.zh: 獨立機構可以在僱主與員工之間進行調解，在糾紛影響基本公共服務之前將其解決。

col: mediate between two sides｜在雙方之間調解
mediate a settlement｜調解達成和解
words.tip: mediate側重促成協議；arbitrate可指作出仲裁。

tr: vt. 修改, 改善, 改良
def: v. make amendments to
To change a document, rule, or plan to improve it.

ex.en: Please amend the booking to include one extra guest.
ex.zh: 請修改預訂，增加一位客人。

ex.en: Parliament may amend existing legislation to ensure that remote workers receive the same protections as office employees.
ex.zh: 議會可能修訂現行法律，確保遠程工作者獲得與辦公室員工相同的保護。

words.tip: 常指修改文件或法律；修理實物通常用mend。

def: n. a constitutional monarchy in southeastern Asia on Borneo and the Malay Peninsula; achieved independence from the United Kingdom in 1957
a Southeast Asian country occupying parts of a peninsula and Borneo

ex.en: We explored a rainforest during our holiday in Malaysia.
ex.zh: 我們在馬來西亞度假期間探索了一片熱帶雨林。

ex.en: Tourism in Malaysia creates employment opportunities, but protecting fragile coastal ecosystems remains an important priority.
ex.zh: 馬來西亞的旅遊業創造了就業機會，但保護脆弱的沿海生態系統仍是一項重要任務。

col: travel to Malaysia｜前往馬來西亞旅行
Peninsular Malaysia｜馬來西亞半島地區
words.tip: 國名首字母大寫，通常不加冠詞the。

tr: n. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 贗品
[醫] 模仿, 仿製, 仿製品
def: n. the doctrine that representations of nature or human behavior should be accurate imitations
n. something copied or derived from an original
n. copying (or trying to copy) the actions of someone else

ex.en: His imitation of a sleepy cat made us laugh.
ex.zh: 他模仿睏倦貓咪的樣子逗得我們大笑。

ex.en: Young children acquire many social skills through imitation, making positive adult behaviour especially important in early education.
ex.zh: 幼兒通過模仿習得許多社交技能，因此成人的積極行為在早期教育中尤為重要。

col: learn by imitation｜通過模仿學習
a poor imitation｜拙劣的模仿；劣質仿品
words.tip: 模仿行為通常不可數；一件仿製品用an imitation。

tr: n. 筏, 救生筏, 大量
def: n. a flat float (usually made of logs or planks) that can be used for transport or as a platform for swimmers
v. transport on a raft
v. travel by raft in water

tr: n. 悲嘆, 悔恨, 慟哭, 輓歌, 悼詞
def: n. a cry of sorrow and grief
v. express grief verbally
To express sadness or regret about something.

ex.en: My grandparents often lament the loss of local shops.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母常為附近小店的消失而嘆息。

ex.en: Many residents lament the destruction of historic buildings, arguing that redevelopment weakens the city's cultural identity.
ex.zh: 許多居民為歷史建築遭到拆除而惋惜，認為改建削弱了城市的文化特色。

col: lament the loss of｜為失去……而悲嘆
a lament for｜為……而作的哀歌
words.tip: 較正式；動詞可直接接賓語，也可接that從句。

tr: vt. 點燃, 使灼熱, 使興奮
def: v. cause to start burning; subject to fire or great heat
To start burning or cause something to burn.
To cause a strong feeling or situation to begin.

ex.en: A tiny spark ignited the dry wood in the fireplace.
ex.zh: 一顆小火星點燃了壁爐裡的幹木柴。

ex.en: Practical science lessons can ignite students' curiosity and encourage them to explore unfamiliar ideas independently.
ex.zh: 科學實踐課能夠激發學生的好奇心，鼓勵他們獨立探索陌生的概念。

words.tip: 可及物也可不及物；還可比喻激起興趣或爭論。

tr: v. (使)旋轉, 反覆考慮, 循環出現
def: v. turn on or around an axis or a center

tr: a. 交替的, 輪流的, 間隔的
def: v. go back and forth; swing back and forth between two states or conditions
v. exchange people temporarily to fulfill certain jobs and functions
v. do something in turns

tr: n. 欺凌弱小者, 土霸
vt. 威脅, 恐嚇, 欺負
a. 特好的, 第一流的
def: n. a cruel and brutal fellow
n. a hired thug

tr: vt. 弄汙, 弄髒, 汙染, 毒害
def: v. make radioactive by adding radioactive material
make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful substances

ex.en: Dirty hands can contaminate food while you cook.
ex.zh: 做飯時，不乾淨的手可能會汙染食物。

ex.en: Industrial chemicals can contaminate groundwater, threatening both agricultural production and the health of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 工業化學品可能汙染地下水，威脅農業生產及附近社區居民的健康。

col: contaminated with chemicals｜受到化學品汙染
words.tip: 常用be contaminated with表示被某物汙染。

def: v. limit the range or extent of
v. limit, block, or decrease the action or function of
v. control and refrain from showing; of emotions, desires, impulses, or behavior

ex.en: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of these plants.
ex.zh: 寒冷天氣會抑制這些植物的生長。

ex.en: Fear of making mistakes can inhibit students from participating actively in classroom discussions and collaborative tasks.
ex.zh: 害怕犯錯可能使學生不敢積極參與課堂討論和合作任務。

words.tip: inhibit側重抑制或阻礙；prohibit指明令禁止。

def: n. a solemn pledge of fidelity

tr: n. 違約, 不履行責任, 缺席, 默認值
v. 疏怠職責, 缺席, 拖欠, 默認
[計] 默認; 默認值; 缺省值
def: n. loss due to not showing up
n. act of failing to meet a financial obligation
v. fail to pay up

ex.en: This app uses a dark background by default.
ex.zh: 這個應用默認使用深色背景。

ex.en: Borrowers are more likely to default on their loans when unemployment rises and household incomes fall.
ex.zh: 當失業率上升、家庭收入下降時，借款人更容易拖欠貸款。

col: default on a loan｜拖欠貸款
words.tip: by default 表示默認；拖欠貸款用 default on a loan。

tr: vt. 分散, 傳播, 散開
def: v. to cause to separate and go in different directions
v. move away from each other;
v. separate (light) into spectral rays

ex.en: The crowd began to disperse when the rain started.
ex.zh: 雨一下起來，人群就開始散去。

ex.en: Planting trees can help disperse strong winds and protect exposed farmland from soil erosion.
ex.zh: 植樹有助於分散強風，保護無遮擋的農田免受土壤侵蝕。

words.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：驅散人群或人群散去。

tr: a. 未醉的, 穩重的, 節制的, 嚴肅的, 不誇大的, 合理的, 樸素的
vt. 使醒酒, 使嚴肅
vi. 從醉裡醒來, 變嚴肅
def: v. cause to become sober
a. not affected by a chemical substance (especially alcohol)
Not drunk or affected by alcohol.

ex.en: My uncle stayed sober and drove everyone home safely.
ex.zh: 我叔叔沒有喝醉，開車把大家安全送回了家。

ex.en: A sober assessment of environmental risks is essential before governments approve major construction projects.
ex.zh: 政府批准大型建設項目之前，必須冷靜評估環境風險。

words.tip: sober up表示醒酒；sober也可形容冷靜的判斷。

tr: a. 相當的, 一致的, 通信的
def: s. accompanying
s. similar especially in position or purpose
Matching or directly related to something else

ex.en: Put each coloured lid on its corresponding container.
ex.zh: 把每個彩色蓋子蓋在對應的容器上。

ex.en: A rise in urban population often creates a corresponding increase in demand for public transport.
ex.zh: 城市人口增長往往會使公共交通需求相應增加。

words.tip: 強調相互對應；correspond to表示與……相對應。

tr: n. 小睡, 稍睡, 細毛, 孤注一擲
vt. 使拉毛, 打盹度過, 預測...為獲勝馬
def: n. a soft or fuzzy surface texture
n. sleeping for a short period of time (usually not in bed)
v. take a siesta

ex.en: I took a short nap after lunch on Sunday.
ex.zh: 星期天午飯後，我小睡了一會兒。

ex.en: A brief afternoon nap may improve alertness, but it should not replace adequate sleep at night.
ex.zh: 下午短暫小睡可能提高警覺性，但不應代替充足的夜間睡眠。

col: a power nap｜恢復精力的短睡
words.tip: 動詞變化要雙寫p：napped、napping。

tr: vt. 損害, 減少, 削弱
[法] 損害, 傷害, 減少
def: v. make worse or less effective

tr: a. 狂亂的, 瘋狂的
def: s. excessively agitated; distraught with fear or other violent emotion
Extremely worried or frightened and unable to stay calm
Done very quickly with intense, often uncontrolled activity

ex.en: I grew frantic when I couldn't find my passport.
ex.zh: 找不到護照時，我急得不知所措。

ex.en: The frantic pace of urban life can increase stress and leave residents with little time for relaxation.
ex.zh: 城市生活的緊張節奏會增加壓力，讓居民幾乎沒有時間放鬆。

col: a frantic pace｜緊張忙亂的節奏
frantic with worry｜擔心得心急如焚
words.tip: 強調焦急失控或忙亂，不等於精神失常。

tr: n. 種植, 栽培, 播種, 人工林, 花圃, 苗圃
def: n. the act of fixing firmly in place
n. a collection of plants (trees or shrubs or flowers) in a particular area
n. putting seeds or young plants in the ground to grow

tr: a. 本質的, 原有的, 真正的
def: a. belonging to a thing by its very nature
s. situated within or belonging solely to the organ or body part on which it acts
Belonging naturally to something, rather than coming from outside

ex.en: She values the intrinsic beauty of untreated wood.
ex.zh: 她欣賞未經加工的木材本身的美。

ex.en: Schools should encourage intrinsic motivation by helping students enjoy learning rather than focusing solely on external rewards.
ex.zh: 學校應幫助學生享受學習，培養內在動力，而不是隻關注外部獎勵。

words.tip: intrinsic to表示“……所固有的”。

tr: vt. 開墾, 改造, 感化, 糾正, 回收
def: v. claim back
v. reuse (materials from waste products)
v. make useful again; transform from a useless or uncultivated state

ex.en: I returned to the station to reclaim my suitcase.
ex.zh: 我回到車站取回自己的行李箱。

ex.en: Coastal cities sometimes reclaim land from the sea to create space for housing and transport.
ex.zh: 沿海城市有時通過填海造地，為住房和交通設施騰出空間。

col: reclaim land｜開墾土地；填海造地
words.tip: reclaim強調收回或恢復利用，不只是收集。

tr: n. 下水道, 陰溝, 裁縫師
vt. 用下水道排, 鋪設下水道於
def: n. a waste pipe that carries away sewage or surface water
n. someone who sews
An underground pipe that carries away sewage and wastewater

ex.en: Workers cleared the blocked sewer beneath our street.
ex.zh: 工人疏通了我們街道下面堵塞的下水道。

ex.en: Investment in modern sewer systems can reduce water pollution and improve public health in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 投資建設現代汙水管網可以減少水汙染，改善快速發展城市的公共衛生狀況。

words.tip: sewer是管道，sewage是汙水，sewerage指排汙系統。

tr: a. 可繁殖的, 肥沃的, 生產多的
def: a. capable of reproducing
v. have and exercise
v. handle effectively

tr: vt. 切成厚板, 以平板蓋上
def: n. block consisting of a thick piece of something

tr: a. 及時的, 適時的
def: s. before a time limit expires
s. done or happening at the appropriate or proper time
n. strong feelings of dislike
v. fill with distaste
v. cause aversion in; offend the moral sense of

ex.en: She wrinkled her nose in disgust at the rotten fruit.
ex.zh: 看到腐爛的水果，她厭惡地皺起鼻子。

ex.en: Residents expressed disgust at the illegal dumping of household waste beside the local river.
ex.zh: 居民對在當地河邊非法傾倒生活垃圾的行為表示厭惡。

words.tip: disgusted形容人的感受；disgusting形容令人厭惡的事物。

tr: n. 厄運, 不幸, 法律, 宣告, 判決, 死亡
vt. 命中註定, 判決
def: n. an unpleasant or disastrous destiny
v. make certain of the failure or destruction of

tr: n. 佈局, 陳列, 規劃圖, 頁面佈局, 版面編排
def: n. a plan or design of something that is laid out
n. the act of laying out (as by making plans for something)
the way parts of a space or page are arranged

ex.en: We changed the kitchen layout to create more space.
ex.zh: 我們調整了廚房佈局，騰出了更多空間。

ex.en: A clear website layout helps users find essential information quickly and improves access to public services.
ex.zh: 清晰的網站佈局有助於用戶快速找到關鍵信息，並更方便地使用公共服務。

words.tip: 名詞layout寫成一詞；動詞lay out分開寫。

tr: n. 槓桿, 似槓桿之工具
def: n. a rigid bar pivoted about a fulcrum
n. a simple machine that gives a mechanical advantage when given a fulcrum
n. a flat metal tumbler in a lever lock

ex.en: Pull this lever to raise the seat a little.
ex.zh: 拉這個操縱桿，把座位稍微升高一點。

ex.en: Tax policy can serve as a powerful lever for encouraging businesses to invest in cleaner technologies.
ex.zh: 稅收政策可以成為鼓勵企業投資更清潔技術的有力手段。

col: a lever for change｜推動變革的手段
words.tip: 英式首音節讀/liː/，美式通常讀/lev/。

tr: a. 正直的, 誠實的, 公正的, 垂直的, 豎式的
def: n. a vertical structural member as a post or stake
n. a piano with a vertical sounding board
s. in a vertical position; not sloping

tr: n. 堡壘, 要塞, 易貨站
def: v. gather in, or as if in, a fort, as for protection or defense
v. station (troops) in a fort
A strong building or enclosed place built for military defence.

ex.en: We climbed the hill to explore the old fort.
ex.zh: 我們爬上山去探索那座古老的堡壘。

ex.en: Restoring the coastal fort could attract tourists while preserving an important part of the region's military history.
ex.zh: 修復這座海岸堡壘既能吸引遊客，也能保留該地區重要的軍事歷史遺產。

words.tip: fort側重軍事防禦；castle常兼作貴族住所。

tr: n. 班機, 劃線者, 定期船, 襯裡
[化] 襯墊; 墊帶; 套管
def: n. (baseball) a hit that flies straight out from the batter
n. a piece of cloth that is used as the inside surface of a garment
n. a large commercial ship (especially one that carries passengers on a regular schedule)

tr: a. 次等的, 較差的, 下方的, 下級的
n. 部下, 次品, 下標(符號)
def: n. one of lesser rank or station or quality
a. of or characteristic of low rank or importance
a. of low or inferior quality

ex.en: The cheaper bag felt inferior to the leather one.
ex.zh: 那個便宜包摸起來不如皮包好。

ex.en: Schools in disadvantaged areas should not receive inferior equipment simply because local funding is limited.
ex.zh: 弱勢地區的學校不應僅因當地資金有限就獲得較差的設備。

words.tip: 比較用inferior to，不用than；feel inferior指自卑。

def: n. an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates
n. a turning aside (of your course or attention or concern)
n. an attack calculated to draw enemy defense away from the point of the principal attack

ex.en: The road diversion took us past a beautiful lake.
ex.zh: 道路改道讓我們經過了一個美麗的湖泊。

ex.en: The diversion of public funds away from education could limit opportunities for children in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 將公共資金從教育領域挪作他用，可能會限制弱勢社區兒童的機會。

col: the diversion of funds｜資金轉移
create a diversion｜製造干擾以轉移注意力
a welcome diversion｜令人愉快的消遣
words.tip: 英式英語中可指道路改道；美式常用detour。

tr: n. 子公司, 附件, 輔助者
a. 輔助的, 次要的, 津貼的
def: n an assistant subject to the authority or control of another
n a company that is completely controlled by another company
s functioning in a supporting capacity

tr: a. 忙碌的, 愛管閒事的, 自負的, 固執己見的, 實際的, 務實的, 國事的, 國務的
[法] 閒斷的, 固執己見的, 實用主義的
def: a. of or concerning the theory of pragmatism
Choosing what works in practice rather than following ideals.

ex.en: We took a pragmatic approach and repaired the old sofa.
ex.zh: 我們採取了務實的辦法，把舊沙發修好了。

ex.en: A pragmatic housing policy should balance environmental goals with the immediate needs of local residents.
ex.zh: 務實的住房政策應兼顧環保目標和當地居民的迫切需求。

col: pragmatic solution｜切實可行的解決辦法
words.tip: 強調實際可行和效果，而非理論或理想。

def: s. advanced in complexity or elaboration
s. of education beyond the secondary level

tr: n. 吃草, 放牧, 擦傷, 輕擦
v. (使)吃草, 放牧, 輕擦, 擦傷
def: n. a superficial abrasion
n. the act of grazing
v. break the skin (of a body part) by scraping

ex.en: Sheep graze quietly beside the river every summer morning.
ex.zh: 每個夏日清晨，羊群都在河邊安靜地吃草。

ex.en: Allowing cattle to graze too intensively can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 讓牛群過度放牧會破壞植被，並增加水土流失的風險。

words.tip: 動物吃草可說graze on grass；graze cattle指放牛。

tr: n. 卷軸, 一卷, 紡車, 旋轉, 蹣跚
vt. 卷...於軸上, 繞, 使旋轉
vi. 蹣跚地走, 旋轉, 眩暈, 搖晃, 退縮
def: n. a roll of photographic film holding a series of frames to be projected by a movie projector
n. music composed for dancing a reel
n. winder consisting of a revolving spool with a handle; attached to a fishing rod

ex.en: She wound the loose fishing line onto the reel.
ex.zh: 她把鬆散的釣魚線繞到了卷線輪上。

ex.en: Local businesses continued to reel from the sudden closure of the region's largest factory.
ex.zh: 該地區最大工廠突然關閉，當地企業持續受到嚴重衝擊。

col: a reel of film｜一卷膠片
reel from the shock｜因震驚而不知所措
reel off a list｜一口氣列舉
words.tip: reel from表示受衝擊；reel off表示一口氣說出。

def: v provide physical relief, as from pain
v make easier
to make pain, suffering, or a problem less severe

ex.en: A warm bath helped alleviate the ache in my shoulders.
ex.zh: 洗個熱水澡幫助緩解了我的肩膀痠痛。

ex.en: Expanding affordable housing could alleviate pressure on low-income families and reduce the risk of homelessness.
ex.zh: 增加可負擔住房可以減輕低收入家庭的壓力，並降低無家可歸的風險。

words.tip: 直接接痛苦或問題；表示減輕，不一定徹底消除。

tr: n. 嘲笑, 戲弄, 模仿
a. 假的, 偽造的, 模擬的
vt. 嘲弄, 模仿, 使失望, 欺騙, 挫敗
def: n. the act of mocking or ridiculing
v. treat with contempt
v. imitate with mockery and derision

ex.en: Please don't mock my dancing; I'm still learning.
ex.zh: 請別嘲笑我的舞姿，我還在學呢。

ex.en: Mock interviews allow students to practise explaining their skills before they apply for their first professional positions.
ex.zh: 模擬面試讓學生在申請第一份專業工作前，練習如何介紹自己的技能。

col: mock someone's accent｜嘲笑某人的口音
words.tip: mock作動詞直接接賓語，不加at。

tr: vi. 逐步擴大, 逐步升高, 逐步增強
def: v. increase in extent or intensity

tr: n. 相似處, 類似, 肖像
def: n. similarity in appearance or external or superficial details
similarity between people or things, especially in appearance

ex.en: There is a striking resemblance between the two sisters.
ex.zh: 這兩姐妹長得非常像。

ex.en: Modern housing developments often bear little resemblance to traditional neighbourhoods, particularly in their layout and use of shared space.
ex.zh: 現代住宅開發項目往往與傳統街區大不相同，尤其是在佈局和公共空間的使用方面。

col: a family resemblance｜家族成員間的相像
words.tip: resemblance to後接比較對象；resemble直接接賓語。

tr: vt. 轉開, 避免, 防止
def: v. turn away or aside

tr: n. 洞, 空穴, 腔
def: n. space that is surrounded by something
n. soft decayed area in a tooth; progressive decay can lead to the death of a tooth
n. (anatomy) a natural hollow or sinus within the body

tr: n. 連接詞, 聯合, 結合
def: n. an uninflected function word that serves to conjoin words or phrases or clauses or sentences
n. the grammatical relation between linguistic units (words or phrases or clauses) that are connected by a conjunction
n. (astronomy) apparent meeting or passing of two or more celestial bodies in the same degree of the zodiac

ex.en: Our teacher used coloured cards to explain conjunctions.
ex.zh: 老師用彩色卡片講解連詞。

ex.en: Public transport improvements work best in conjunction with policies that discourage unnecessary car journeys.
ex.zh: 公共交通的改善與減少不必要駕車出行的政策相結合時，效果最佳。

col: in conjunction with｜與……結合；與……共同
words.tip: in conjunction with常表示“與……共同或結合”。

tr: vt. 扣留, 扣押, 耽擱
[法] 拘留, 扣押, 留住
def: v deprive of freedom; take into confinement
v stop or halt
v cause to be slowed down or delayed
n. someone new to a field or activity
someone with little experience in a particular activity

ex.en: As a gardening novice, I often forget to water seedlings.
ex.zh: 作為園藝新手，我常常忘記給幼苗澆水。

ex.en: Structured mentoring can help a novice develop the confidence needed to manage a classroom effectively.
ex.zh: 有系統的指導能幫助新手建立有效管理課堂所需的信心。

words.tip: 表示某方面的新手，常用a novice at/in。

tr: n. 稱讚, 恭維, 敬意
vt. 稱讚, 褒揚, 恭維
def: n. a remark (or act) expressing praise and admiration
v. say something to someone that expresses praise
v. express respect or esteem for

ex.en: Her compliment about my cooking made me smile.
ex.zh: 她對我廚藝的稱讚讓我笑了。

ex.en: Teachers who compliment students on specific improvements can strengthen motivation and encourage continued effort.
ex.zh: 教師若針對學生的具體進步給予表揚，就能增強學習動力，鼓勵他們繼續努力。

col: pay someone a compliment｜稱讚某人
compliment someone on something｜稱讚某人的某方面
words.tip: compliment是讚美；complement是補充、相輔相成。

tr: n. 極大的痛苦, 掙扎
def: n. intense feelings of suffering; acute mental or physical pain
n. a state of acute pain
v engage or hire for work
v hold under a lease or rental agreement; of goods and services
v engage for service under a term of contract
v. become worse or disintegrate

tr: vi. 碰撞, 互撞, 牴觸
def: v. cause to collide
v. crash together with violent impact
to crash into something or each other

ex.en: Two shopping trolleys collided near the busy supermarket entrance.
ex.zh: 兩輛購物車在繁忙的超市入口附近撞到了一起。

ex.en: Economic ambitions often collide with environmental priorities when governments consider approving major infrastructure projects.
ex.zh: 政府考慮批准大型基礎設施項目時，經濟目標往往與環保重點發生衝突。

words.tip: 通常是不及物動詞；與某物相撞用with。

tr: vt. 收割, 收穫, 獲得
vi. 收割, 得到報應
def: v. gather, as of natural products
v. get or derive
to receive results or rewards from previous actions

ex.en: After months of practice, she finally reaped the rewards.
ex.zh: 經過幾個月的練習，她終於收穫了回報。

ex.en: Countries that invest consistently in early education often reap long-term economic and social benefits.
ex.zh: 持續投資幼兒教育的國家往往能獲得長期的經濟和社會效益。

words.tip: 抽象義常搭配benefits或rewards，強調付出後的收穫。

tr: a. 能實行的, 可行的, 適宜的
[法] 可行的, 可執行的, 可完成的
def: s. capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
possible and practical to achieve with available resources

ex.en: Cycling to work is feasible now that I live nearby.
ex.zh: 現在我住得近，騎車上班行得通了。

ex.en: Solar power becomes more economically feasible when installation costs fall and reliable energy storage is available.
ex.zh: 當安裝成本下降且可靠的儲能設施可用時，太陽能在經濟上就更可行。

col: a feasible solution｜可行的解決辦法
a feasible alternative｜可行的替代方案
words.tip: 指條件允許、實際可行，不等於“可信”。

tr: a. 自大的, 傲慢的
def: s. having or showing feelings of unwarranted importance out of overbearing pride

tr: a. 可疑的, 不確定的
def: s. not convinced
feeling uncertain or doubtful about something
probably dishonest, unsafe, or not worth trusting

ex.en: I felt dubious about buying a bicycle without brakes.
ex.zh: 對於買一輛沒有剎車的自行車，我心存疑慮。

ex.en: Consumers should remain dubious about health claims that are not supported by reliable scientific evidence.
ex.zh: 消費者應對沒有可靠科學證據支持的健康功效宣稱保持懷疑。

words.tip: 人感到懷疑用dubious about；事物可疑也可用dubious。

tr: vt. 省略, 繞過, 忽視, 迴避
def: n. a surgically created shunt (usually around a damaged part)
v. avoid something unpleasant or laborious
To go around something or avoid a usual step

ex.en: We took a narrow lane to bypass the village.
ex.zh: 我們走了一條窄路，繞過了村莊。

ex.en: A new bypass could reduce congestion in the town centre but might damage nearby wildlife habitats.
ex.zh: 新建繞城公路可以緩解鎮中心的擁堵，但也可能破壞附近的野生動物棲息地。

col: bypass security checks｜繞過安全檢查
build a bypass｜修建繞城公路
heart bypass surgery｜心臟搭橋手術
words.tip: 作動詞直接接賓語：bypass the town。

tr: abbr. 哲學博士學位（Doctor of Philosophy）
def: d a doctorate usually based on at least 3 years graduate study and a dissertation; the highest degree awarded graduate study

tr: n. 排氣口, 出口, 通風孔, 發洩
vt. 發洩, 排出, 給...開孔
def: n. a hole for the escape of gas or air
n. external opening of urinary or genital system of a lower vertebrate
n. a fissure in the earth's crust (or in the surface of some other planet) through which molten lava and gases erupt

tr: n. 日食, 月食, (地位名譽等的)消失
vt. 引起日食, 引起月食, 使黯然失色
def: n. one celestial body obscures another
v. cause an eclipse of (a celestial body) by intervention
an event when one celestial body blocks another's light

ex.en: We watched the lunar eclipse from our garden last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我們在花園裡觀看了月食。

ex.en: Investment in digital services may eclipse spending on traditional infrastructure as economies become increasingly dependent on technology.
ex.zh: 隨著經濟日益依賴科技，數字服務投資可能超過傳統基礎設施支出。

col: eclipse previous achievements｜使以往成就黯然失色
words.tip: 日食用solar eclipse，月食用lunar eclipse。

tr: n. 危險, 冒...之險, 險境, 險因
vt. 置...於險境, 冒險, 危及
def: n a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune
n a state of danger involving risk
n a venture undertaken without regard to possible loss or injury

ex.en: The sudden storm put the small boat in peril.
ex.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨使小船陷入險境。

ex.en: Coastal communities face increasing peril as rising sea levels threaten their homes and essential infrastructure.
ex.zh: 隨著海平面上升威脅到住宅和關鍵基礎設施，沿海社區面臨的危險日益加劇。

col: put someone in peril｜使某人陷入險境
words.tip: 比danger更正式，常用in peril表示身處險境。

tr: n. 支架, 括弧, 托架
vt. 裝托架, 括入括弧
def: n. a category falling within certain defined limits
n. either of two punctuation marks (`<' or `>') used in computer programming and sometimes used to enclose textual material
n. either of two punctuation marks ([ or ]) used to enclose textual material

tr: n. 青腫, 挫傷, 擦傷
def: n. an injury that doesn't break the skin but results in some discoloration
v. injure the underlying soft tissue or bone of
v. break up into small pieces for food preparation

ex.en: I have a purple bruise on my knee.
ex.zh: 我的膝蓋上有一塊紫色的淤青。

ex.en: Soft fruit can bruise during transport, so producers need packaging that provides adequate protection.
ex.zh: 軟質水果在運輸中容易碰傷，因此生產者需要使用能提供充分保護的包裝。

words.tip: bruise通常不破皮；cut指割破皮膚的傷口。

def: n. flesh of chickens or turkeys or ducks or geese raised for food
Birds such as chickens kept for their meat or eggs.
Meat from farmed birds such as chickens and turkeys.

ex.en: My aunt keeps poultry in a spacious backyard enclosure.
ex.zh: 我阿姨在後院一個寬敞的圍欄裡養家禽。

ex.en: Higher welfare standards for poultry can improve animal health, although they may increase production costs.
ex.zh: 提高家禽福利標準可以改善動物健康，但可能增加生產成本。

words.tip: 不用a poultry；表示一隻家禽可說a chicken等。

tr: v. 為王，為君；當政；統治
n. 為王，為君；當政；統治
def: n. a period during which something or somebody is dominant or powerful
n. the period during which a monarch is sovereign
n. royal authority; the dominion of a monarch

ex.en: This castle was built during a young queen's reign.
ex.zh: 這座城堡建於一位年輕女王在位期間。

ex.en: During the king's reign, investment in public libraries made education more accessible to ordinary citizens.
ex.zh: 在這位國王統治期間，對公共圖書館的投入讓普通民眾更容易獲得教育。

col: during the reign of｜在……統治期間
a long reign｜漫長的統治時期
words.tip: 與rain同音；reign指統治，rein指韁繩。

tr: n. 戰勝, 征服, 戰利品
[法] 征服, 贏得, 獲得
def: n. the act of conquering
n. success in mastering something difficult
the act of taking control of a country by force

ex.en: The castle fell after months of fighting and conquest.
ex.zh: 經過數月的戰鬥與征服，這座城堡陷落了。

ex.en: Military conquest often reshaped trade networks and introduced new languages to regions under foreign rule.
ex.zh: 軍事征服往往重塑貿易網絡，並將新語言帶入受外來統治的地區。

words.tip: 表示征服行為可不可數；指徵服的領土時可數。

tr: n. 期待, 期望的事物, 囑望, 希望, 期望, 預期
def: n an expectation
n something expected (as on the basis of a norm)
A feeling that something pleasant or exciting will happen.

ex.en: The children watched the curtain rise with eager expectancy.
ex.zh: 孩子們滿懷期待地看著幕布升起。

ex.en: Improved sanitation and access to healthcare have increased life expectancy in many parts of the world.
ex.zh: 衛生條件的改善和醫療服務的普及提高了世界許多地區的人均預期壽命。

col: an air of expectancy｜期待的氣氛
words.tip: life expectancy指預期壽命，不等於實際壽命。

def: n. a case with a handle; for carrying papers or files or books

tr: a. 數量的, 定量的
def: a. expressible as a quantity or relating to or susceptible of measurement
a. relating to the measurement of quantity
a. (of verse) having a metric system based on relative duration of syllables

ex.en: Our coach uses quantitative data to track our progress.
ex.zh: 我們的教練用定量數據跟蹤我們的進步。

ex.en: Quantitative research allows policymakers to compare employment trends across regions using consistent statistical measures.
ex.zh: 定量研究使政策制定者能夠使用統一的統計指標，比較不同地區的就業趨勢。

words.tip: quantitative 重數量測量；qualitative 重性質描述。

def: n. a region marking a boundary
n. the edge of a steep place
A point just before something happens, especially something bad.

ex.en: Their little shop was on the brink of closing.
ex.zh: 他們的小店差一點就關門了。

ex.en: Prolonged drought has pushed several rural communities to the brink of a severe food crisis.
ex.zh: 長期乾旱已將幾個農村社區推到嚴重糧食危機的邊緣。

col: on the brink of collapse｜瀕臨崩潰
bring back from the brink｜從危急邊緣挽回
push to the brink｜逼至危急關頭
words.tip: on the brink of後接名詞或動名詞，常指危機。

tr: vi. 向後退, 退卻, 收回, 降低, 減弱
def: v. become faint or more distant

tr: vi. 大量存在, 富於, 充滿
def: v. be abundant or plentiful; exist in large quantities
v. be in a state of movement or action
To exist in large quantities or be very common

ex.en: Wildflowers abound in the fields behind our house each spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天，我們屋後的田野裡都開滿野花。

ex.en: Opportunities for renewable energy development abound in regions with consistent sunshine and strong coastal winds.
ex.zh: 在日照穩定且沿海風力強勁的地區，可再生能源的發展機會十分豐富。

col: abound in wildlife｜野生動物豐富
words.tip: 不及物動詞；某地充滿某物用abound in/with。

def: v. drop sharply
To decrease very quickly and sharply.
To fall suddenly and quickly from a high position.

ex.en: Temperatures plummeted overnight, leaving ice on the garden pond.
ex.zh: 氣溫一夜間驟降，花園池塘結了冰。

ex.en: Demand for private cars could plummet if cities offered reliable, affordable public transport throughout the day.
ex.zh: 如果城市全天提供可靠且價格合理的公共交通，私家車需求可能會大幅下降。

col: plummet to a record low｜跌至歷史最低點
words.tip: 常作不及物動詞；to接終值，by接降幅。

def: n. the most outstanding work of a creative artist or craftsman
n. an outstanding achievement
an exceptionally fine work of art, literature, or skill

ex.en: Everyone stopped to admire the masterpiece above the fireplace.
ex.zh: 大家都停下來欣賞壁爐上方的那幅傑作。

ex.en: Displaying a masterpiece in a public museum allows people from different backgrounds to appreciate artistic achievement.
ex.zh: 在公共博物館展出傑作，能讓不同背景的人欣賞藝術成就。

words.tip: 通常指作品，不用來指才華出眾的人。

tr: vi. 到絕頂, 達於極點, 達到高潮
vt. 使到絕頂, 使達到高潮
def: v. end, especially to reach a final or climactic stage
v. bring to a head or to the highest point
v. reach the highest or most decisive point

ex.en: Weeks of rehearsals culminated in a wonderful evening performance.
ex.zh: 經過數週排練，大家最終獻上了一場精彩的晚間演出。

ex.en: Years of public consultation culminated in a comprehensive transport plan designed to reduce congestion and improve accessibility.
ex.zh: 多年的公眾諮詢最終促成了一項旨在緩解擁堵、改善交通可達性的綜合交通規劃。

col: culminate in success｜最終取得成功
culminate in an agreement｜最終達成協議
culminate in a celebration｜以慶祝活動達到高潮
words.tip: 常用 culminate in＋結果，強調發展後的終點或高潮。

tr: [醫] 引流[法], 導液[法], 排水[設備]
def: n emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it

tr: n. 嚴酷考驗, 痛苦經歷, 煎熬
[法] 神裁判法, 嚴酷的考驗, 痛苦的經驗
def: n. a severe or trying experience

n. a primitive method of determining a person's guilt or innocence by subjecting the accused person to dangerous or painful tests believed to be under divine control; escape was usually taken as a sign of innocence
A difficult or frightening experience that lasts for some time.

ex.en: Getting home through the storm was a real ordeal.
ex.zh: 穿過暴風雨回家真是一次痛苦的經歷。

ex.en: For displaced families, finding secure housing can become a prolonged ordeal without adequate public support.
ex.zh: 對於流離失所的家庭，若缺乏充分的公共支持，尋找安全住房可能成為漫長的煎熬。

col: go through an ordeal｜經歷磨難
a traumatic ordeal｜造成心理創傷的經歷
words.tip: 指令人痛苦或恐懼的經歷，不用於普通的小麻煩。

tr: a. 滑的, 光滑的, 靠不住的, 圓滑的, 不穩固的
[法] 狡猾的, 不可靠的, 不安定的
def: a. causing or tending to cause things to slip or slide
s. not to be trusted

tr: n. 網孔, 網絲, 網眼, 網狀物, 圈套, 陷阱, 齧合
vt. 以網捕捉, 齧合, 使纏住
def: n. the number of openings per linear inch of a screen; measures size of particles
n. the act of interlocking or meshing
v. work together in harmony

tr: v. 辨別, 看清楚, 瞭解
def: v detect with the senses
To notice or recognise something that is difficult to detect.

ex.en: Through the fog, I could barely discern the distant bridge.
ex.zh: 隔著濃霧，我幾乎辨認不出遠處的橋。

ex.en: Without reliable evidence, consumers may find it difficult to discern whether environmental claims are genuinely credible.
ex.zh: 缺乏可靠證據時，消費者可能難以判斷環保宣傳是否真正可信。

words.tip: 較正式，強調費力看出或察覺不明顯的事物。

tr: a. 汙穢的, 邪惡的, 惡臭的, 骯髒的, 惡劣的, 淤塞的
vt. 弄髒, 妨害, 汙衊, 犯規, 淤塞
vi. 腐爛, 犯規, 纏結
adv. 違反規則地, 不正當地
def: n. an act that violates the rules of a sport
v. hit a foul ball
v. commit a foul; break the rules

ex.en: A foul smell drifted from the forgotten rubbish bin.
ex.zh: 一股惡臭從那個被遺忘的垃圾桶裡飄了出來。

ex.en: Untreated industrial waste can foul rivers, threatening aquatic wildlife and the health of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 未經處理的工業廢物會汙染河流，威脅水生野生動物和附近居民的健康。

words.tip: 體育中犯規用commit a foul；惡劣天氣也可用foul。

tr: vt. 使搖擺, 使躊躇, 交錯, 錯開
a. 交錯的, 錯開的
def: v. walk as if unable to control one's movements
v. walk with great difficulty
v. to arrange in a systematic order

ex.en: He staggered backwards as the heavy suitcase swung towards him.
ex.zh: 沉重的行李箱朝他擺來時，他踉蹌著往後退。

ex.en: Employers could stagger working hours to ease congestion and reduce pressure on public transport.
ex.zh: 僱主可以錯開工作時間，以緩解擁堵並減輕公共交通的壓力。

col: stagger to one's feet｜踉蹌著站起來
stagger working hours｜錯開工作時間
words.tip: stagger作動詞；staggering常指驚人之大。

tr: a. 壞的, 邪惡的, 缺德的, 刻毒的, 惡劣的, 淘氣的
def: a. morally bad in principle or practice
Morally very bad and deliberately harmful.
Playfully naughty, often in an amusing way.

ex.en: The wicked queen locked every garden gate in the kingdom.
ex.zh: 邪惡的王后鎖上了王國裡所有花園的大門。

ex.en: Traditional stories often contrast wicked characters with kind heroes to help children understand the consequences of moral choices.
ex.zh: 傳統故事常將邪惡角色與善良主人公作對比，幫助兒童理解道德選擇的後果。

col: a wicked grin｜淘氣的咧嘴笑
a wicked sense of humour｜愛捉弄人的幽默感
words.tip: 通常比bad語氣強；形容笑容時可指淘氣而非邪惡。

tr: n. 裝飾, 點綴品, 教堂用品
def: v. be an ornament to
An object used to make something look more attractive.
To decorate something with attractive objects or details.

ex.en: A small glass ornament sparkled on the wooden shelf.
ex.zh: 木架上的一件小玻璃飾品閃閃發亮。

ex.en: Traditional ornaments displayed in local museums can reveal how earlier communities expressed cultural identity through decorative objects.
ex.zh: 當地博物館展出的傳統飾品，可以揭示過去的社區如何通過裝飾物表達文化認同。

words.tip: 名詞重音在首音節；動詞末音節讀/ment/。

tr: n. 天文臺, 氣象臺, 瞭望臺
def: n. a building designed and equipped to observe astronomical phenomena
n organized opposition to authority; a conflict in which one faction tries to wrest control from another
v come into existence; take on form or shape
v ascend as a sound

ex.en: The museum displays objects from a local uprising.
ex.zh: 博物館展出了當地一次起義留下的物品。

ex.en: Historians argue that food shortages and political exclusion contributed to the uprising against the ruling authorities.
ex.zh: 歷史學家認為，糧食短缺和政治排斥促成了反抗統治當局的起義。

words.tip: 通常指反抗統治者的起義，不用於日常的起床或上升。

tr: n. 忍耐, 忍耐力, 耐性
def: n. the power to withstand hardship or stress
The ability to continue despite tiredness, pain, or difficulty.

ex.en: Swimming every morning has really improved my endurance.
ex.zh: 每天早晨游泳確實增強了我的耐力。

ex.en: Regular physical activity builds endurance and helps people manage the demands of an increasingly sedentary lifestyle.
ex.zh: 經常運動能增強耐力，幫助人們應對日益久坐的生活方式帶來的挑戰。

col: a test of endurance｜耐力考驗
words.tip: 通常不可數，強調在疲勞或困難中堅持的能力。

tr: vt. 強迫, 限制, 關押
def: v hold back
v restrict

tr: n. 捏, 擰, 撮, 少量, 收縮, 擠壓, 夾痛, 苦惱, 逮捕, 指控, 匱乏, 緊急關頭
vt. 捏, 擰, 掐, 擠壓, 修剪, 使困苦, 使萎縮, 節制, 少量加入, 逮捕, 勒索
vi. 收縮, 節省, 擠壓, 引起苦惱
def: n. a painful or straitened circumstance
n. an injury resulting from getting some body part squeezed
n. a squeeze with the fingers

ex.en: Pinch the pastry edges together to seal the pie.
ex.zh: 把麵皮邊緣捏合，將餡餅封好。

ex.en: As food prices rise, families on low incomes increasingly feel the pinch and reduce nonessential spending.
ex.zh: 隨著食品價格上漲，低收入家庭越來越感到經濟拮据，並減少非必要支出。

col: a pinch of salt｜一小撮鹽
feel the pinch｜感到經濟拮据
words.tip: a pinch of表少量；feel the pinch指手頭緊。

tr: a. 有秩序的, 整齊的, 值班的
n. 護理員, 清道夫, 傳令兵, 勤務兵
adv. 依次地, 順序地
def: n. a soldier who serves as an attendant to a superior officer
n. a male hospital attendant who has general duties that do not involve the medical treatment of patients
a. devoid of violence or disruption

ex.en: The children formed an orderly queue outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 孩子們在教室外排起了整齊的隊伍。

ex.en: Clear evacuation procedures help ensure an orderly departure from public buildings during emergencies, reducing the risk of injury.
ex.zh: 明確的疏散程序有助於人們在緊急情況下有序撤離公共建築，降低受傷風險。

words.tip: 雖以-ly結尾，常作形容詞；名詞可指醫院護工。

tr: n. 褲子, 長褲, 短襯褲, 女式運動短褲
def: n underpants worn by women
n the noise made by a short puff of steam (as from an engine)
n (usually in the plural) a garment extending from the waist to the knee or ankle, covering each leg separately

ex.en: These pants have deep pockets for my keys.
ex.zh: 這條褲子的口袋很深，可以裝我的鑰匙。

ex.en: Some schools allow students to wear comfortable pants rather than requiring a traditional formal uniform.
ex.zh: 有些學校允許學生穿舒適的褲子，而不要求穿傳統的正式校服。

col: a pair of pants｜一條褲子；一條內褲
words.tip: 美式指褲子，英式常指內褲；用 a pair of 計數。

tr: n. 小薄片, 扁薄的一層, 火星, 曬魚架子
def: v. form into flakes
v. cover with flakes or as if with flakes
n. the classification of someone or something with respect to its worth
n. a document appraising the value of something (as for insurance or taxation)
n. an expert estimation of the quality, quantity, and other characteristics of someone or something

ex.en: My manager praised my progress during today's performance appraisal.
ex.zh: 經理在今天的績效評估中表揚了我的進步。

ex.en: A thorough appraisal of environmental risks should take place before any major construction project begins.
ex.zh: 任何大型建設項目啟動之前，都應對環境風險進行全面評估。

words.tip: appraisal是評估；別與approval（批准）混淆。

def: n a shelter from danger or hardship
n a hospital for mentally incompetent or unbalanced person
Protection a country gives people escaping danger in another country.

ex.en: Her family sought asylum after fleeing their home country.
ex.zh: 她的家人逃離祖國後尋求庇護。

ex.en: Governments should assess asylum applications fairly while ensuring that vulnerable applicants have access to legal advice.
ex.zh: 政府應公平審理庇護申請，同時確保弱勢申請人能夠獲得法律諮詢。

words.tip: 表示庇護時不可數；指精神病院是過時用法。

tr: [法] 製作經公章證明的謄本, 例證
def: v. be characteristic of
v. clarify by giving an example of
to be a clear example of something

ex.en: Her handmade bowls exemplify the beauty of simple design.
ex.zh: 她手工製作的碗體現了簡約設計之美。

ex.en: These community gardens exemplify how urban residents can improve local biodiversity while producing fresh food.
ex.zh: 這些社區花園展示了城市居民如何在種植新鮮食物的同時改善當地生物多樣性。

col: exemplify a trend｜是某種趨勢的典型
exemplify a principle｜例證某項原則
exemplify the benefits of｜體現…的益處
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接名詞；舉例時也可用be exemplified by。

def: n. a lever that is operated with the foot
v. operate the pedals on a keyboard instrument
a. of or relating to the feet

ex.en: My foot slipped off the pedal in the rain.
ex.zh: 雨中，我的腳從腳蹬上滑了下來。

ex.en: More residents would pedal to work if cities provided safer cycling routes and secure bicycle parking.
ex.zh: 如果城市提供更安全的騎行路線和安全的自行車停車設施，更多居民會騎車上班。

words.tip: 英式過去式常寫pedalled，美式寫pedaled。

tr: a. 巨人般的, 巨大的
def: s. so exceedingly large or extensive as to suggest a giant or mammoth
extremely large in size or amount

ex.en: A gigantic pumpkin filled the entire kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一個巨大的南瓜佔滿了整張餐桌。

ex.en: Building gigantic dams can generate renewable electricity, but it may also destroy habitats and displace local communities.
ex.zh: 修建巨型水壩可以生產可再生電力，但也可能破壞棲息地，迫使當地居民搬遷。

words.tip: 語氣強於big，可形容體積、規模或任務。

tr: n. 全部劇目, 全部技能, 全部節目, 全部作品
def: n. a collection of works (plays, songs, operas, ballets) that an artist or company can perform and do perform for short intervals on a regular schedule
All the pieces a performer or group is prepared to perform.
The range of skills or methods someone can use.

ex.en: The singer added three new songs to her repertoire.
ex.zh: 那位歌手在自己的演唱曲目中加入了三首新歌。

ex.en: Teachers need a broad repertoire of strategies to meet the needs of students with different learning preferences.
ex.zh: 教師需要掌握豐富的教學策略，以滿足學習偏好不同的學生的需求。

col: expand your repertoire｜擴充曲目或技能儲備
a wide repertoire｜豐富的曲目儲備
a repertoire of skills｜一整套技能
words.tip: 不只指演出曲目，也可指某人掌握的全部技能。

tr: n. 臨時解僱, 操作停止, 活動停止期間
def: n. the act of laying off an employee or a work force

tr: n. 奇異事物, 罕見例子
def: v. express astonishment or surprise about something
Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise
To feel great surprise or admiration

ex.en: We marvelled at the tiny bird's beautifully woven nest.
ex.zh: 那隻小鳥精巧編織的巢讓我們驚歎不已。

ex.en: The new bridge is an engineering marvel that connects isolated communities and improves access to essential services.
ex.zh: 這座新橋是一項工程奇蹟，連接了偏遠社區，並讓居民更方便地獲得基本服務。

col: a marvel of nature｜自然奇觀
words.tip: 動詞常接at；英式過去式marvelled，美式marveled。

def: n. an artifact made of hard brittle material produced from nonmetallic minerals by firing at high temperatures
a. of or relating to or made from a ceramic
Made from clay or similar materials hardened by heat.

ex.en: She keeps fresh flowers in a blue ceramic vase.
ex.zh: 她把鮮花插在一個藍色陶瓷花瓶裡。

ex.en: Ceramic tiles are widely used in public buildings because they are durable and relatively easy to clean.
ex.zh: 陶瓷磚耐用且較易清潔，因此廣泛用於公共建築。

words.tip: ceramics可指陶瓷製品，也可指陶藝或陶瓷工藝。

tr: vt. 集合, 召集, 召喚
def: v. meet formally
v make a mathematical calculation or computation
To calculate an amount or result, often using a computer.

ex.en: This app computes the cost of our weekly shopping.
ex.zh: 這個應用程序計算我們每週購物的費用。

ex.en: Researchers compute average temperatures from satellite data to assess long-term changes in the global climate.
ex.zh: 研究人員根據衛星數據計算平均氣溫，以評估全球氣候的長期變化。

words.tip: 比calculate更正式，常用於計算機或數學語境。

tr: n. 會見者, 面談者, 進行面試者
def: n. a person who conducts an interview
v have an ambitious plan or a lofty goal
To strongly want to achieve something important.

ex.en: My younger sister aspires to become a wildlife photographer.
ex.zh: 我妹妹立志成為一名野生動物攝影師。

ex.en: Many young people aspire to careers that offer both financial security and opportunities to contribute to society.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人嚮往既能提供經濟保障，又能讓自己為社會作貢獻的職業。

col: aspire to do something｜立志做某事
aspire to a career in medicine｜立志從醫
words.tip: aspire to do表立志做；aspire to後也可接名詞。

tr: n. 規格, 詳述, 詳細說明書
[計] 規範; 形式說明; 說明; 說明書; 規格
def: n. a detailed description of design criteria for a piece of work
n. naming explicitly
n. (patent law) a document drawn up by the applicant for a patent of invention that provides an explicit and detailed description of the nature and use of an invention

ex.en: Check the specifications before buying a new laptop.
ex.zh: 買新筆記本電腦前，先查看規格參數。

ex.en: Clear building specifications help ensure that new housing meets safety standards and uses energy efficiently.
ex.zh: 明確的建築技術要求有助於確保新住房符合安全標準並高效利用能源。

words.tip: 談產品各項參數常用複數specifications，可簡稱specs。

tr: [化] 乙酰水楊酸; 阿司匹靈; 鄰乙酸基苯甲酸
def: n. the acetylated derivative of salicylic acid; used as an analgesic anti-inflammatory drug (trade names Bayer, Empirin, and St. Joseph) usually taken in tablet form; used as an antipyretic; slows clotting of the blood by poisoning platelets

tr: n. 碼頭, 橋墩, 支框, 防波堤
def: n. a platform built out from the shore into the water and supported by piles; provides access to ships and boats
n. (architecture) a vertical supporting structure (as a portion of wall between two doors or windows)
n. a support for two adjacent bridge spans

tr: n. 鎳, 鎳幣, 五分鎳幣
def: n. a hard malleable ductile silvery metallic element that is resistant to corrosion; used in alloys; occurs in pentlandite and smaltite and garnierite and millerite
n. a United States coin worth one twentieth of a dollar
n. five dollars worth of a drug

ex.en: My skin reacts badly to jewellery containing nickel.
ex.zh: 我的皮膚對含鎳的首飾有嚴重的過敏反應。

ex.en: Growing demand for electric vehicles has increased interest in nickel mining, raising concerns about environmental damage.
ex.zh: 電動汽車需求的增長提高了人們對鎳礦開採的關注，也引發了對環境破壞的擔憂。

words.tip: 指金屬時不可數；指五分硬幣時可數。

tr: n. 裂口, 違背, 破壞, 違反, 突破, 破裂
def: n. a failure to perform some promised act or obligation
n. an opening (especially a gap in a dike or fortification)

tr: n. 把手, 瘤, 旋鈕, 球形突出物
def: n. a circular rounded projection or protuberance
n. a round handle
n. an ornament in the shape of a ball on the hilt of a sword or dagger

tr: n. 平板, 門牌, 筆記簿, 碑, 匾, 藥片
def: n. a slab of stone or wood suitable for bearing an inscription
n. a small flat compressed cake of some substance
a portable computer with a flat touchscreen

ex.en: I use my tablet to watch cooking videos.
ex.zh: 我用平板電腦看烹飪視頻。

ex.en: Providing every student with a tablet may improve access to resources, but teachers still need suitable training.
ex.zh: 為每名學生配備平板電腦可能有助於獲取學習資源，但教師仍需接受適當培訓。

words.tip: tablet既指平板電腦，也指藥片，需看語境。

def: n. a slowly moving mass of ice
n. Hindu discipline aimed at training the consciousness for a state of perfect spiritual insight and tranquility that is achieved through the three paths of actions and knowledge and devotion
n. a system of exercises practiced as part of the Hindu discipline to promote control of the body and mind
A practice combining body positions, controlled breathing, and mental focus.

ex.en: She does yoga on a mat beside the window.
ex.zh: 她在窗邊的墊子上練瑜伽。

ex.en: Offering yoga classes in community centres may help residents manage stress and maintain flexibility.
ex.zh: 在社區中心開設瑜伽課可能有助於居民緩解壓力並保持身體柔韌。

words.tip: 練瑜伽用do或practise yoga，不用play。

def: n. matter that has been deposited by some natural process
v. deposit as a sediment
v. settle as sediment

tr: vi. 蒸發, 失去水分, 消失
vt. 使蒸發, 使脫水, 使消失
def: v. lose or cause to lose liquid by vaporization leaving a more concentrated residue
v. cause to change into a vapor
v. change into a vapor

ex.en: The puddles evaporated quickly in the warm afternoon sun.
ex.zh: 水窪裡的水在溫暖的午後陽光下很快蒸發了。

ex.en: As temperatures rise, water evaporates more rapidly from reservoirs, increasing pressure on supplies in drought-prone regions.
ex.zh: 隨著氣溫升高，水庫中的水蒸發得更快，加劇了易旱地區的供水壓力。

words.tip: 蒸發不一定要沸騰；evaporate也可比喻希望等消失。

tr: vi. 屈從, 屈服, 死
def: v. be fatally overwhelmed

tr: a. 經驗豐富的, 老練的
def: a. aged or processed
s. rendered competent through trial and experience

tr: vt. 模擬, 假裝, 模仿
[法] 偽裝的, 模擬的; 假裝的, 偽裝的, 冒充
def: v. make a pretence of
To reproduce conditions or processes for testing, training, or study.
To pretend to have a feeling or condition.

ex.en: This driving game simulates icy roads surprisingly well.
ex.zh: 這款駕駛遊戲把結冰路面模擬得出奇逼真。

ex.en: Researchers simulate extreme weather conditions to assess how new building materials perform under environmental stress.
ex.zh: 研究人員模擬極端天氣條件，以評估新型建築材料在環境壓力下的表現。

col: simulate an emergency｜模擬緊急情況
simulate the effects of｜模擬……的影響
words.tip: 模擬環境用simulate；刺激發展用stimulate。

tr: n. 陰謀, 複雜的事
vt. 激起...的興趣, 用詭計取得
def: n. a crafty and involved plot to achieve your (usually sinister) ends
n. a clandestine love affair
v. cause to be interested or curious

ex.en: The locked wooden box intrigued everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 那個上鎖的木盒引起了屋裡所有人的好奇。

ex.en: Unexplained archaeological discoveries continue to intrigue researchers and encourage further investigation into the lives of ancient communities.
ex.zh: 尚未得到解釋的考古發現持續引起研究者的興趣，推動他們進一步探索古代社群的生活。

col: a web of intrigue｜錯綜複雜的陰謀
words.tip: 激起興趣時是及物動詞；常用 be intrigued by。

def: n the trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area
n the hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees
n the trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area

tr: a. 粗糙的, 下等的, 粗俗的
def: a. of textures that are rough to the touch or substances consisting of relatively large particles
s. lacking refinement or cultivation or taste
s. of low or inferior quality or value

ex.en: The coarse wool scratched my neck all afternoon.
ex.zh: 那件粗糙的羊毛衣讓我的脖子整個下午都刺癢。

ex.en: Coarse particles in urban air can irritate the lungs and worsen existing respiratory conditions among vulnerable residents.
ex.zh: 城市空氣中的粗顆粒物會刺激肺部，並加重易感居民原有的呼吸系統疾病。

words.tip: 與course同音；coarse形容質地粗或言語粗俗。

tr: n. 觸媒, 接觸劑, 催化劑, 刺激因素, 促進因素
def: n. (chemistry) a substance that initiates or accelerates a chemical reaction without itself being affected
n. something that causes an important event to happen
A person or thing that triggers or accelerates change.

ex.en: That conversation became the catalyst for our neighbourhood cleanup.
ex.zh: 那次談話促成了我們社區的清潔行動。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can act as a catalyst for wider economic growth in disadvantaged regions.
ex.zh: 公共交通投資可以推動欠發達地區更廣泛的經濟增長。

col: a catalyst for change｜變革的推動因素
act as a catalyst｜起推動作用
words.tip: 比喻推動變化時常用a catalyst for。

tr: n. 衣櫥, 衣室, 全部衣服
def: n. a tall piece of furniture that provides storage space for clothes; has a door and rails or hooks for hanging clothes
n. collection of clothing belonging to one person
n. collection of costumes belonging to a theatrical company

ex.en: Her winter coats fill most of the wardrobe.
ex.zh: 她的冬季外套佔了衣櫃的大部分空間。

ex.en: Building a smaller wardrobe with durable clothing can reduce the environmental impact of fashion consumption.
ex.zh: 減少衣物數量並選擇耐穿的服裝，可以降低時尚消費對環境的影響。

words.tip: 既指衣櫃，也可指某人擁有的全部衣物。

tr: n. 脂肪, 獸脂, 油脂, 賄賂
def: n. a thick fatty oil (especially one used to lubricate machinery)
v. lubricate with grease
thick oily material used for lubrication or produced during cooking

ex.en: There was grease on my hands after fixing the bicycle.
ex.zh: 修完自行車後，我的手上沾滿了油汙。

ex.en: Restaurants should prevent cooking grease from entering drains because it can block pipes and increase maintenance costs.
ex.zh: 餐館應防止烹飪油脂流入下水道，因為這會堵塞管道並增加維護費用。

col: grease a baking tin｜給烤模塗油
words.tip: 名詞讀/ɡriːs/；動詞也常讀/ɡriːz/。

tr: n. 航空, 航空學, 飛行術
[法] 航空, 飛行, 飛行術
def: n. the aggregation of a country's military aircraft
n. the operation of aircraft to provide transportation
n. the art of operating aircraft

ex.en: Her interest in aviation began with a flying lesson.
ex.zh: 她對航空的興趣始於一堂飛行課。

ex.en: The aviation industry faces pressure to reduce emissions while meeting growing demand for international travel.
ex.zh: 航空業面臨著既要減少排放，又要滿足不斷增長的國際旅行需求的壓力。

words.tip: 不可數名詞，常指飛行活動或整個航空業。

tr: a. 想像的, 虛構的
富有想像力的；有創意的
def: s. (used of persons or artifacts) marked by independence and creativity in thought or action
able to produce original ideas, or showing this ability

ex.en: My imaginative niece turned empty boxes into a spaceship.
ex.zh: 我那富有想像力的侄女把空盒子變成了一艘宇宙飛船。

ex.en: Schools should encourage imaginative thinking rather than require students to memorise every detail of a textbook.
ex.zh: 學校應鼓勵有創意的思考，而不是要求學生記住課本中的每一個細節。

col: imaginative solution｜有創意的解決方案
words.tip: imaginative指有想像力；imaginary指想像中的。

tr: a. 悲哀的, 可憐的, 感傷的, 差勁的
def: s. inspiring mixed contempt and pity
s. inspiring scornful pity
so poor or ineffective that it deserves strong criticism

ex.en: The broken shower produced only a pathetic trickle.
ex.zh: 壞掉的淋浴器只能流出少得可憐的一點水。

ex.en: Residents described the council's response to repeated flooding as pathetic, demanding immediate investment in better drainage.
ex.zh: 居民認為市政委員會應對反覆洪災的表現差勁，要求立即投資改善排水設施。

words.tip: 常帶強烈貶義，不宜隨意用來形容他人。

def: n. the process of gradually becoming inferior
n. a gradual decrease; as of stored charge or current
n. the organic phenomenon of rotting

ex.en: Fallen leaves decay slowly beneath the trees each winter.
ex.zh: 每到冬天，落葉都會在樹下慢慢腐爛。

ex.en: Urban decay often accelerates when public infrastructure is neglected and businesses move away from residential neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 當公共基礎設施缺乏維護、企業遷離居民區時，城市衰敗往往會加速。

words.tip: 名詞通常不可數；tooth decay指齲齒，不是掉牙。

tr: vt. 保存, 使(能量等)守恆
def: n. fruit preserved by cooking with sugar
v. keep constant through physical or chemical reactions or evolutionary change
v. keep in safety and protect from harm, decay, loss, or destruction

ex.en: We collect rainwater to conserve water in the garden.
ex.zh: 我們收集雨水，以節約花園用水。

ex.en: Governments should encourage efficient farming methods that conserve water without reducing the supply of affordable food.
ex.zh: 政府應鼓勵高效的耕作方式，在節水的同時保障平價食品的供應。

words.tip: conserve強調節約或保護；reserve強調預留。

tr: a. 持久的, 耐用的
def: s. existing for a long time
s. capable of withstanding wear and tear and decay
s. very long lasting

ex.en: These durable boots have survived years of muddy walks.
ex.zh: 這雙耐用的靴子陪我在泥路上走了多年，至今還沒壞。

ex.en: Choosing durable products rather than disposable alternatives can reduce household waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
ex.zh: 選擇耐用品而非一次性替代品，可以減少家庭垃圾並節約寶貴的自然資源。

col: durable solution｜長久有效的解決辦法
words.tip: 耐用品通常用複數名詞durables或durable goods。

tr: n. 新奇, 新鮮, 新奇的事物
def: n. originality by virtue of being new and surprising
the quality of being new, unusual, or unfamiliar
something new or unusual that attracts interest

ex.en: The novelty of sleeping in a tent soon wore off.
ex.zh: 睡帳篷的新鮮感很快就消退了。

ex.en: Although the novelty of new technology attracts consumers, long-term adoption depends on practical benefits and affordability.
ex.zh: 雖然新技術的新穎性會吸引消費者，但長期採用仍取決於實際益處和價格是否可負擔。

col: novelty value｜新奇帶來的吸引力
the novelty wears off｜新鮮感消退
words.tip: 指新奇感時不可數；指新鮮事物或小玩意兒時可數。

tr: n. 著手, 開頭, 最初
def: n the time at which something is supposed to begin
The beginning of an activity, process, or period.

ex.en: We agreed on a budget at the outset.
ex.zh: 我們一開始就商定了預算。

ex.en: Community members should be involved from the outset when local authorities plan major housing developments.
ex.zh: 地方政府規劃大型住宅開發項目時，就應從一開始讓社區成員參與。

words.tip: 常用於at/from the outset，不用於set outset。

tr: a. 戰爭的, 軍事的, 尚武的, 威武的
def: n. Roman poet noted for epigrams (first century BC)
s. of or relating to the armed forces
Related to war, soldiers, or military life.

ex.en: The band played martial music as soldiers marched past.
ex.zh: 士兵列隊走過時，樂隊奏起了軍樂。

ex.en: Although martial arts originated as fighting techniques, many people now practise them for fitness and self-discipline.
ex.zh: 雖然武術起源於格鬥技巧，如今許多人練習武術是為了健身和培養自律。

words.tip: martial是軍事的；marital是婚姻的，勿混。

tr: n. 退學學生, 中途退學
def: n. someone who quits school before graduation
n. someone who withdraws from a social group or environment

tr: vt. 使發芽, 摘去芽
def: n. any new growth of a plant such as a new branch or a bud
n. a newly grown bud (especially from a germinating seed)
v. put forth and grow sprouts or shoots

tr: vt. 增高, 提高, 加強
def: v. become more extreme
v. make more extreme; raise in quantity, degree, or intensity
v. increase the height of

ex.en: The sudden silence only heightened my curiosity about the surprise.
ex.zh: 突然安靜下來，反而讓我更好奇會有什麼驚喜。

ex.en: Repeated droughts may heighten public concern about water shortages and encourage governments to invest in conservation.
ex.zh: 反覆發生的乾旱可能加深公眾對缺水的擔憂，並促使政府投入資金保護水資源。

words.tip: 多用於情緒、意識或效果增強，不常指身高增長。

def: n. any of various organs that synthesize substances needed by the body and release it through ducts or directly into the bloodstream
n. the angular distance between an imaginary line around a heavenly body parallel to its equator and the equator itself
n. freedom from normal restraints in conduct
n. an imaginary line around the Earth parallel to the equator

ex.en: Our geography teacher showed us latitude on a globe.
ex.zh: 地理老師用地球儀給我們講解緯度。

ex.en: Regions at higher latitudes generally experience greater seasonal variations in daylight than those near the equator.
ex.zh: 高緯度地區的日照時長通常比赤道附近地區有更明顯的季節變化。

col: give someone latitude｜給予某人自主權
words.tip: latitude是緯度，longitude是經度。

tr: vi. 渴望, 想念, 懷念, 同情
def: v. have affection for; feel tenderness for
To want something deeply, especially something difficult to obtain

ex.en: After months abroad, she yearned for her mother's cooking.
ex.zh: 在國外待了幾個月後，她十分想念母親做的飯菜。

ex.en: Many urban residents yearn for quieter surroundings, which may explain the growing appeal of rural tourism.
ex.zh: 許多城市居民渴望更安靜的環境，這或許能解釋鄉村旅遊日益增長的吸引力。

words.tip: 用yearn for sth或yearn to do，表達強烈渴望。

def: n. the study and classification of human societies

tr: v. 統一, 使成一體
def: v. become one
To bring separate parts or groups together as one.

ex.en: The neighbourhood festival helped unify our divided community.
ex.zh: 鄰里節慶幫助我們這個存在隔閡的社區團結起來。

ex.en: A shared public transport network could unify the region while improving access to employment.
ex.zh: 共享的公共交通網絡既能將該地區連成一體，也能讓人們更方便地獲得就業機會。

col: unify different groups｜使不同群體團結
words.tip: unify強調把分散部分合成整體，可用於制度或群體。

tr: n. 藥房, 配藥學, 製藥業
[醫] 藥學, 藥劑學, 調劑學, 藥房
def: n. the art and science of preparing and dispensing drugs and medicines,
A shop or hospital department that prepares and supplies medicines.
The study and practice of preparing and supplying medicines.

ex.en: I collected my medicine from the pharmacy after lunch.
ex.zh: 午飯後，我去藥店取了藥。

ex.en: A community pharmacy can improve access to healthcare by offering professional advice close to people's homes.
ex.zh: 社區藥店能在居民家附近提供專業建議，使醫療保健服務更易獲得。

words.tip: 藥店可數，藥劑學不可數；藥劑師是pharmacist。

tr: n. 偶然性, 可能性, 意外事故
[經] 意外事故, 意外開支, 偶然事故
def: n. the state of being contingent on something

tr: n. 螺旋形之物, 螺線
a. 螺旋形的, 盤旋的
vi. 螺旋形下降, 螺旋形上升, 螺旋形行進
def: n. a plane curve traced by a point circling about the center but at increasing distances from the center
n. a continuously accelerating change in the economy
n. ornament consisting of a curve on a plane that winds around a center with an increasing distance from the center

ex.en: The orange peel fell in a spiral onto the plate.
ex.zh: 橙子皮呈螺旋狀落在盤子上。

ex.en: Without adequate housing policies, rental costs may spiral beyond the reach of many low-income families.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏適當的住房政策，租金可能急劇上漲，超出許多低收入家庭的承受範圍。

col: spiral out of control｜急劇惡化至失控
words.tip: 英式過去式spiralled；美式spiraled，雙寫規則不同。

tr: n. 迴旋, 旋轉, 急走, 眩暈
vt. 使旋轉, 使迴旋, 捲走
vi. 迴旋, 旋轉, 急走, 發暈
def: n. confused movement
n. the shape of something rotating rapidly
v. cause to spin

ex.en: Dry leaves whirled around us in the wind.
ex.zh: 乾枯的樹葉在風中繞著我們打轉。

ex.en: As urban life accelerates, many workers become caught in a whirl of meetings and deadlines.
ex.zh: 隨著城市生活節奏加快，許多上班族陷入接連不斷的會議和截止期限之中。

col: a whirl of activity｜一連串忙亂的活動
words.tip: give it a whirl是口語，意為“試一試”。

tr: n. 賣弄風騷的人, 急動, 急扔
vt. 忽然彈出, 輕快擺動, 揮動
vi. 調情, 玩弄, 擺動, 輕率地對待
def: n. playful behavior intended to arouse sexual interest

tr: a. 具有主權的, 至高無上的, 國王的, 完全的
def: n. a nation's ruler or head of state usually by hereditary right
s. greatest in status or authority or power

tr: n. 擺動, 鼓翼, 煩擾
vi. 擺動, 鼓翼, 煩擾
def: n. abnormally rapid beating of the auricles of the heart (especially in a regular rhythm); can result in heart block
v. flap the wings rapidly or fly with flapping movements
Move with quick, light movements, especially through air

ex.en: The curtains fluttered gently beside the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 窗簾在敞開的廚房窗邊輕輕飄動。

ex.en: Butterflies flutter among native flowers in urban gardens, demonstrating how small green spaces can support biodiversity.
ex.zh: 蝴蝶在城市花園的本土花卉間翩翩飛舞，展示了小型綠地如何支持生物多樣性。

col: flutter in the breeze｜在微風中飄動
a flutter of excitement｜一陣激動
words.tip: 強調輕而快的反覆運動，可用於翅膀、布料或心跳。

tr: vt. 招致, 蒙受, 遭遇
[經] 招致, 蒙受, 擔負
def: v. make oneself subject to; bring upon oneself; become liable to
to experience costs or something unpleasant because of your actions

ex.en: Late returns may incur an extra charge at this library.
ex.zh: 在這家圖書館，逾期歸還可能產生額外費用。

ex.en: Businesses may incur substantial costs when replacing outdated equipment, but modern technology can improve productivity over time.
ex.zh: 企業更換過時設備時可能產生大量費用，但現代技術能逐步提高生產效率。

words.tip: 過去式 incurred，現在分詞 incurring，均雙寫 r。

tr: n. 閃爍, 閃光, 顫動
vi. 閃動, 閃爍, 搖動, 撲動翅膀
vt. 使搖曳, 使閃爍
def: n. a momentary flash of light
n. North American woodpecker
v. move back and forth very rapidly

ex.en: The candle flickered when she opened the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 她打開廚房門時，燭光搖曳起來。

ex.en: When streetlights flicker or fail, pedestrians may feel less secure in urban public spaces.
ex.zh: 路燈閃爍不定或熄滅時，行人可能會覺得城市公共空間不夠安全。

col: a flicker of hope｜一絲希望
a flicker of recognition｜一瞬間認出的神情
words.tip: a flicker of 可接 hope 等，表示一絲短暫情感。

tr: n. 厚木板, 支架, 木板製品, 衝浪板, 救急物, 政綱條目
vt. 在...上鋪板, 撂下, 立即付款
def: n. an endorsed policy in the platform of a political party
v. cover with planks
