v. set (something or oneself) down with or as if with a noise

ex.en: We laid a plank across the muddy ditch.
ex.zh: 我們在泥濘的溝上架了一塊厚木板。

ex.en: Investment in affordable housing should be a central plank of any strategy to reduce urban inequality.
ex.zh: 投資可負擔住房應成為任何縮小城市不平等的戰略的核心內容。

col: a central plank of policy｜政策的核心內容
hold a plank｜保持平板支撐
words.tip: a central plank of可比喻政策的核心內容。

tr: n. 火焰, 烈火, 光輝
vt. 使燃燒, 宣佈, 在樹皮上刻痕
def: n. a strong flame that burns brightly
n. a light-colored marking
v. shine brightly and intensively

ex.en: Firefighters rescued the family from the blaze last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚，消防員從大火中救出了這家人。

ex.en: The forest blaze destroyed valuable habitats, highlighting the need for better fire prevention strategies.
ex.zh: 這場森林大火摧毀了珍貴的棲息地，凸顯出改進防火策略的必要性。

col: blaze a trail｜開闢道路；率先探索
words.tip: blaze常指猛烈的大火；flame指火焰。

tr: a. 生理學的, 生理學上的, 生理機能的
[醫] 生理學的, 生理的
def: a. of or relating to the biological study of physiology

tr: n. 板岩, 頁岩, 提名名單, 人選, 記錄, 石板
vt. 鋪石板, 責罵, 痛打
def: n. (formerly) a writing tablet made of slate
n. thin layers of rock used for roofing
n. a fine-grained metamorphic rock that can be split into thin layers

tr: n. 鬆弛, 放鬆, 減輕, 緩和, 休息, 休養
def: n. (physiology) the gradual lengthening of inactive muscle or muscle fibers
n. (physics) the exponential return of a system to equilibrium after a disturbance
n. an occurrence of control or strength weakening

ex.en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
ex.zh: 下班後，我喜歡泡個熱水澡放鬆一下。

ex.en: Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.
ex.zh: 學校應教授放鬆技巧，幫助學生緩解重要考試前的焦慮。

words.tip: 表示放鬆、休息時通常不可數：for relaxation。

def: n something of sentimental value
n a reminder of past events
An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.

ex.en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
ex.zh: 我們買了一隻小木船作為紀念品。

ex.en: Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
ex.zh: 購買當地製作的紀念品可以支持傳統工藝，併為依靠旅遊業的社區帶來收入。

words.tip: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活動的紀念品。

tr: adv. 相反, 逆, 顛倒, 反題, 反
def: r. with the terms of the relation reversed
used to introduce an opposite situation or relationship

ex.en: I love busy cities; conversely, my sister prefers quiet villages.
ex.zh: 我喜歡熱鬧的城市；相反，我姐姐更喜歡安靜的村莊。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can reduce car use; conversely, poor services may encourage greater dependence on private vehicles.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以減少汽車使用；反過來，服務欠佳可能使人們更加依賴私家車。

words.tip: 用於引出相反情況，不是一般性的補充轉折。

tr: n. 就職, 裝設, 分期付款
def: n a part of a broadcast serial
n a part of a published serial
n the act of installing something (as equipment)

tr: n. 鄉愁, 嚮往過去, 懷舊之情
def: n. longing for something past
warm, sometimes sad feelings about happy times in the past

ex.en: That old song fills me with nostalgia for school.
ex.zh: 那首老歌讓我滿懷對學生時代的眷戀。

ex.en: Nostalgia can encourage communities to preserve historic buildings, even when modern developments promise greater convenience.
ex.zh: 即使現代開發項目有望帶來更多便利，懷舊之情也能促使社區保護歷史建築。

col: nostalgia for the past｜對往昔的眷戀
a wave of nostalgia｜一陣懷舊之情
words.tip: 通常不可數；nostalgia for後接懷念的時期或事物。

tr: a. 不平坦的, 不均等的, 奇數的
def: a. not even or uniform as e.g. in shape or texture
s. variable and recurring at irregular intervals
not level, flat, or smooth

ex.en: Watch your step on the uneven stones outside.
ex.zh: 外面的石頭高低不平，走路時要小心。

ex.en: Uneven access to digital technology can widen educational inequalities between urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 獲取數字技術的機會不均等，可能擴大城鄉社區之間的教育差距。

words.tip: 奇數用odd，不用uneven；uneven強調不平或不均。

def: n. a steep descent of the water of a river
Water falling from a height over a steep rock face

ex.en: We could hear the waterfall long before we saw it.
ex.zh: 還沒看見瀑布，我們就遠遠聽到了水聲。

ex.en: Tourism near a waterfall can support local businesses, but visitor facilities should protect the surrounding natural habitat.
ex.zh: 瀑布附近的旅遊業可以帶動當地商業，但遊客設施應保護周圍的自然棲息地。

col: the base of a waterfall｜瀑布底部
a cascading waterfall｜飛流而下的瀑布
words.tip: 可數名詞：一處瀑布用a waterfall。

tr: a. 精緻的, 細膩的, 敏銳的
def: s. intense or sharp
s. lavishly elegant and refined
s. of extreme beauty

ex.en: She keeps an exquisite porcelain bowl on the shelf.
ex.zh: 她把一隻精美的瓷碗放在架子上。

ex.en: Museums preserve exquisite examples of traditional craftsmanship, allowing future generations to appreciate their cultural and artistic value.
ex.zh: 博物館保存傳統工藝的精美作品，讓後代能夠欣賞其文化與藝術價值。

words.tip: 常形容精美工藝；修飾pain時表示極其強烈。

def: v. thrust or throw into
v. enclose or envelop completely, as if by swallowing
to involve someone deeply in an activity or experience

ex.en: On rainy afternoons, I immerse myself in a novel.
ex.zh: 下雨的午後，我會沉浸在小說中。

ex.en: Exchange programmes allow students to immerse themselves in another culture and develop greater independence.
ex.zh: 交流項目讓學生深入體驗另一種文化，並培養更強的獨立性。

col: immerse yourself in｜使自己沉浸於
words.tip: 沉浸於某事用immerse yourself in，注意反身代詞。

def: n. a dark oil consisting mainly of hydrocarbons

tr: n. 飄, 擺動, 拍打, 拍打聲, 片狀垂懸物
v. 拍打, 鼓翼而飛, 飄動
def: n. any broad thin and limber covering attached at one edge; hangs loose or projects freely
n. the motion made by flapping up and down
n. a movable piece of tissue partly connected to the body

ex.en: The ducks flapped their wings and splashed across the pond.
ex.zh: 鴨子們拍打著翅膀，濺著水花遊過池塘。

ex.en: Observing how birds flap their wings can help engineers develop more efficient designs for small flying robots.
ex.zh: 觀察鳥類如何振翅能幫助工程師為小型飛行機器人開發更高效的設計。

col: get in a flap｜陷入慌亂
words.tip: 過去式flapped，進行式flapping，均雙寫p。

def: s. forceful and extreme and rigorous
Extreme or severe, causing a major change

ex.en: We took drastic action and sold our second car.
ex.zh: 我們採取了大刀闊斧的措施，賣掉了家裡的第二輛車。

ex.en: Drastic cuts to public transport funding could leave many low-income households without affordable access to essential services.
ex.zh: 大幅削減公共交通資金，可能讓許多低收入家庭無法以可負擔的費用獲得基本服務。

words.tip: 強調程度大、影響強，不等於表示速度快的rapid。

tr: n. 辭別, 再見, 再會
def: n. an acknowledgment or expression of goodwill at parting
n. the act of departing politely
An act of saying goodbye, especially before a long separation.

ex.en: We gathered at the station for a final farewell.
ex.zh: 我們聚在車站，作最後的告別。

ex.en: A farewell ceremony can help graduating students reflect on their achievements and prepare for future challenges.
ex.zh: 告別儀式可以幫助畢業生回顧自己的成就，併為未來的挑戰做好準備。

words.tip: 比goodbye正式，常用於長久分別或鄭重告別。

tr: n. 漣波, 漣漪, 波紋, 粗鋼梳
vi. 起微波, 起潺潺聲
def: n. a small wave on the surface of a liquid
n. (electronics) an oscillation of small amplitude imposed on top of a steady value
v. stir up (water) so as to form ripples

ex.en: A falling leaf sent ripples across the pond.
ex.zh: 一片落葉在池塘水面上激起了圈圈漣漪。

ex.en: The closure of a major factory can have a ripple effect throughout the local economy.
ex.zh: 一家大型工廠的關閉可能對整個當地經濟產生連鎖影響。

col: ripples on the water｜水面上的漣漪
a ripple of laughter｜一陣輕輕傳開的笑聲
words.tip: ripple比wave小；ripple effect指連鎖效應。

tr: n. 愛國心, 愛國精神, 愛國主義
def: n. love of country and willingness to sacrifice for it
Love for and loyalty to your country.

ex.en: Her patriotism shines through whenever she discusses her country's achievements.
ex.zh: 每當談起祖國的成就，她的愛國之情便溢於言表。

ex.en: Schools can encourage patriotism while also teaching students to respect other nations and understand global responsibilities.
ex.zh: 學校可以培養愛國精神，同時教導學生尊重其他國家並理解全球責任。

col: a sense of patriotism｜愛國情懷
words.tip: 強調愛國情感，不宜直接等同於nationalism民族主義。

def: n. arrival that has been awaited (especially of something momentous)
n. the season including the four Sundays preceding Christmas
The arrival of an important new invention, event, or period

ex.en: The advent of smartphones changed how we take photos.
ex.zh: 智能手機的出現改變了我們拍照的方式。

ex.en: The advent of affordable renewable energy has encouraged governments to reconsider their dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 價格可負擔的可再生能源的出現，促使各國政府重新審視對化石燃料的依賴。

col: with the advent of｜隨著……的到來
since the advent of｜自……出現以來
words.tip: 常用the advent of，指重要新事物的出現。

tr: n. 縫合線, 銜接口, 接縫, 線縫, 傷疤
vt. 縫合, 接合, 焊合, 使留下傷痕
vi. 裂開, 發生裂痕
def: n. joint consisting of a line formed by joining two pieces
n. a stratum of ore or coal thick enough to be mined with profit
v. put together with a seam

tr: vt. 使疏遠, 離間, 轉讓
[法] 轉讓, 讓與, 疏遠
def: v. make withdrawn or isolated or emotionally dissociated
Make someone feel unwelcome or unwilling to support you

ex.en: His constant complaints alienated even his closest friends.
ex.zh: 他不停地抱怨，連最親近的朋友都疏遠了他。

ex.en: Public transport policies may alienate residents if local authorities fail to explain their benefits clearly.
ex.zh: 如果地方政府未能清楚解釋公共交通政策的好處，這些政策可能會失去居民的支持。

col: alienate someone from｜使某人與……疏遠
words.tip: 常指使人疏遠或失去支持，不表示挪用。

tr: n. 叮, 刺痛, 刺激, 諷刺
vt. 叮, 刺痛, 刺激, 使苦惱
def: n. a kind of pain; something as sudden and painful as being stung
n. a painful wound caused by the thrust of an insect's stinger into skin
v. deliver a sting to

ex.en: A bee stung my ankle while I watered the flowers.
ex.zh: 我澆花時，一隻蜜蜂蜇了我的腳踝。

ex.en: Harsh criticism can sting young learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 嚴厲的批評會傷害年幼學習者的感情，使他們不願參與課堂討論。

words.tip: 過去式、過去分詞均為stung；蜇用sting，咬用bite。

tr: a. 懶惰的, 閒散的, 停頓的, 空閒的, 無用的
vi. 無所事事, 閒散, 浪費, 空轉
vt. 虛度, 使閒散, 使空轉
n. 空轉, 空閒時間
def: n. the state of an engine or other mechanism that is idling
v. run disconnected or idle
v. be idle; exist in a changeless situation

ex.en: The sewing machine has sat idle since last winter.
ex.zh: 這臺縫紉機從去年冬天起就一直閒置著。

ex.en: Leaving delivery vehicles idling outside schools contributes to air pollution and exposes children to unnecessary health risks.
ex.zh: 讓送貨車輛在學校外空轉會加重空氣汙染，使兒童面臨不必要的健康風險。

col: an idling engine｜空轉的發動機
words.tip: idle可指人閒著、設備閒置，也可指發動機空轉。

tr: n. 極小之物, 針尖, 立錐之地, 精確位置
vt. 精確地找到, 準確地轟炸, 刺穿, 準確描述, 使突出, 強調
a. 針尖的, 極微的, 精確的, 詳盡的, 精確定位的
def: n. a very brief moment
n. the sharp point of a pin
v. locate exactly

tr: n. 魅力, 迷人的美, 魔法
def: n alluring beauty or charm (often with sex-appeal)
v cast a spell over someone or something; put a hex on someone or something
An exciting attractiveness associated with beauty, wealth, or fame.

ex.en: Her sparkling earrings added glamour to a simple outfit.
ex.zh: 她閃亮的耳環為樸素的衣著增添了華麗氣質。

ex.en: The apparent glamour of careers in entertainment can obscure the financial insecurity many performers experience.
ex.zh: 娛樂行業看似光鮮的職業可能掩蓋許多表演者面臨的經濟不穩定。

col: the glamour of fame｜名聲的光環
Hollywood glamour｜好萊塢式的華麗魅力
words.tip: 通常不可數；美式也寫glamor。

tr: a. 衣衫襤褸的, 參差不齊的, 不協調的, 粗糙的, 刺耳的
def: s. being or dressed in clothes that are worn or torn
s. worn out from stress or strain
s. having an irregular outline

ex.en: He patched the ragged sleeves of his old coat.
ex.zh: 他補好了舊外套上破破爛爛的袖子。

ex.en: Discarded clothing, including ragged garments, can be recycled into insulation rather than sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 廢棄衣物，包括破舊衣服，可以回收製成隔熱材料，而非送往垃圾填埋場。

words.tip: 形容詞ragged讀兩個音節，結尾為/ɪd/。

def: n a distinctive odor that is pleasant
n a pleasingly sweet olfactory property
A pleasant smell, especially from flowers or perfume.

ex.en: The fragrance of fresh roses filled the small kitchen.
ex.zh: 鮮玫瑰的香氣瀰漫在小廚房裡。

ex.en: Some consumers prefer products without added fragrance because scented ingredients can irritate sensitive skin.
ex.zh: 一些消費者偏愛不添加香料的產品，因為芳香成分可能刺激敏感肌膚。

words.tip: fragrance通常指好聞的氣味；smell則可褒可貶。

tr: vi. 聚合, 集中於一點
def: v. be adjacent or come together
v. approach a limit as the number of terms increases without limit
v. move or draw together at a certain location

tr: a. 瑣碎的, 不重要的, 輕微的, 平常的
def: s. concerned with trivialities
having little importance or seriousness

ex.en: We wasted the afternoon arguing over a trivial detail.
ex.zh: 我們為一個無關緊要的細節爭論，浪費了整個下午。

ex.en: Public debates sometimes focus on trivial disagreements rather than the urgent environmental problems affecting future generations.
ex.zh: 公眾討論有時聚焦於瑣碎的分歧，而非影響子孫後代的緊迫環境問題。

words.tip: 指重要性低，不等於容易；trivial matters指瑣事。

def: n. ceramic ware made of a more or less translucent ceramic

tr: vi. 發出嗡嗡聲, 說閒話
vt. 使嗡嗡叫, 散佈
def: n. sound of rapid vibration
n. a confusion of activity and gossip
v. make a buzzing sound

tr: n. 饑荒, 缺乏, 飢餓
def: n. a severe shortage of food (as through crop failure) resulting in violent hunger and starvation and death
a severe shortage of food affecting many people

ex.en: Our community sent food to families affected by famine.
ex.zh: 我們社區向遭受饑荒的家庭運送了食物。

ex.en: Prolonged drought can lead to famine when farming communities lack reliable irrigation systems and emergency food reserves.
ex.zh: 當農業社區缺乏可靠的灌溉系統和應急糧食儲備時，長期乾旱可能導致饑荒。

words.tip: famine指大範圍糧食匱乏；個人飢餓用hunger。

tr: n. 騎腳踏車兜風, 騎腳踏車消遣
def: n. the sport of traveling on a bicycle or motorcycle
The activity of riding a bicycle for transport or exercise.

ex.en: We go cycling beside the river every Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 我們每個星期天早上都沿河騎自行車。

ex.en: Investing in safe cycling routes can encourage commuters to choose healthier and less polluting forms of transport.
ex.zh: 投資建設安全的自行車道可以鼓勵通勤者選擇更健康、汙染更少的交通方式。

words.tip: 表示這項活動時通常不可數；常說go cycling。

tr: n. 水生動物, 水生植物
a. 水生的, 水中的, 水上的
def: n. a plant that lives in or on water
a. relating to or consisting of or being in water
a. operating or living or growing in water
n. a channel for communication between groups

tr: n. 盒式磁帶, 珠寶箱, 暗盒
def: n. a container that holds a magnetic tape used for recording or playing sound or video
a plastic case containing magnetic tape for recording sound

ex.en: We found an old cassette of songs in the cupboard.
ex.zh: 我們在櫃子裡找到了一盒錄著歌曲的舊磁帶。

ex.en: Before digital streaming became widespread, many language learners used cassette recordings to practise listening at home.
ex.zh: 在數字流媒體普及之前，許多語言學習者用盒式磁帶錄音在家練習聽力。

words.tip: 注意重音在第二音節；播放器叫cassette player。

tr: n. 雕刻品, 雕刻, 雕刻術
def: n. a sculpture created by removing material (as wood or ivory or stone) in order to create a desired shape
n. removing parts from hard material to create a desired pattern or shape
n. a device (generally used by carpenters) that holds things firmly together
v. fasten or fix with a clamp
v. impose or inflict forcefully

ex.en: Use a clamp to hold the wood while gluing.
ex.zh: 塗膠時用夾具固定木頭。

ex.en: During laboratory tests, researchers clamp each sample securely to prevent movement from affecting the accuracy of measurements.
ex.zh: 在實驗室測試中，研究人員將每個樣本夾緊固定，防止移動影響測量準確性。

col: clamp something in place｜將某物夾緊固定
clamp down on｜嚴厲打擊；嚴格限制
words.tip: clamp down on是短語動詞，指嚴厲打擊或限制。

def: v be a hindrance or obstacle to
v hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
v put at a disadvantage

ex.en: Heavy snow hindered our journey through the mountains.
ex.zh: 大雪阻礙了我們穿越山區的行程。

ex.en: Limited access to reliable internet can hinder educational progress among students living in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 無法充分使用穩定的互聯網，會阻礙偏遠農村地區學生的學業進步。

words.tip: hinder是使事情更困難，不一定像prevent那樣完全阻止。

tr: n. 航行, 航海, 導航
[經] 航空, 航海, 航船
網站或應用的瀏覽操作
def: n. the guidance of ships or airplanes from place to place
n. ship traffic
Finding and following a route to a destination.

ex.en: We used a compass for navigation during our hike.
ex.zh: 徒步時，我們用指南針辨別方向。

ex.en: Clear website navigation helps users find essential information quickly, making online public services more accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 清晰的網站導航能幫助用戶快速找到重要信息，讓所有人都更方便地使用在線公共服務。

words.tip: 不僅指航海，也用於道路導航和網頁瀏覽。

tr: n. 石膏, 灰泥, 安慰(緩解)用品, 膏藥
vt. 塗以灰泥, 敷以膏藥, 掩飾, 使平服, 徹底擊敗, 減輕, 粘貼
def: n. a mixture of lime or gypsum with sand and water; hardens into a smooth solid; used to cover walls and ceilings
n. a surface of hardened plaster (as on a wall or ceiling)
n. adhesive tape used in dressing wounds

ex.en: Small pieces of plaster fell from the kitchen ceiling.
ex.zh: 小塊灰泥從廚房天花板上掉了下來。

ex.en: Restoring historic buildings often requires skilled workers who can repair damaged plaster without harming original decorative features.
ex.zh: 修復歷史建築往往需要熟練工人，他們能在不損壞原有裝飾的情況下修補受損灰泥。

col: a coat of plaster｜一層灰泥
words.tip: 表灰泥時通常不可數；英式英語中a plaster是創可貼。

def: n. an animating or vital unifying force

tr: n. 綜合, 組織, 綜合體
def: n. the process of producing a chemical compound (usually by the union of simpler chemical compounds)
n. the combination of ideas into a complex whole
The combination of different ideas or elements into a whole.

ex.en: Her room is a synthesis of old and modern styles.
ex.zh: 她的房間融合了古典與現代風格。

ex.en: A synthesis of findings from several studies provides stronger evidence for the benefits of regular exercise.
ex.zh: 綜合多項研究的結果，能為經常鍛鍊的益處提供更有力的證據。

col: a synthesis of ideas｜思想的綜合
words.tip: 複數為syntheses；常用a synthesis of。

tr: n. 傾向, 趨向, 傾斜度, 點頭
def: n. an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others
n. (astronomy) the angle between the plane of the orbit and the plane of the ecliptic stated in degrees
n. (geometry) the angle formed by the x-axis and a given line (measured counterclockwise from the positive half of the x-axis)

tr: a. 包含的, 包括的
def: a. including much or everything; and especially including stated limits
welcoming people of different backgrounds and abilities
including all relevant costs

ex.en: Our inclusive dance class welcomes people of all abilities.
ex.zh: 我們的舞蹈課注重包容，歡迎各種能力水平的人參加。

ex.en: Schools should create inclusive learning environments where students with different needs can participate fully in classroom activities.
ex.zh: 學校應營造包容的學習環境，讓需求不同的學生都能充分參與課堂活動。

words.tip: inclusive of表示“包含”；日期範圍後用它表示首尾均含。

tr: a. 表面的, 膚淺的, 面積的
def: a. concerned with or comprehending only what is apparent or obvious; not deep or penetrating emotionally or intellectually
a. of, affecting, or being on or near the surface
s. of little substance or significance

tr: vt. 裝配, 裝扮, 給船裝帆, 壟斷, 操縱
def: n. gear (including necessary machinery) for a particular enterprise
n. formation of masts, spars, sails, etc., on a vessel
v. arrange the outcome of by means of deceit

ex.en: We could see an oil rig from the beach.
ex.zh: 我們從海灘上能看到一座石油鑽井平臺。

ex.en: Independent observers can help prevent powerful groups from attempting to rig elections in their favour.
ex.zh: 獨立觀察員有助於防止強勢團體試圖操縱選舉，使結果對自己有利。

col: an oil rig｜石油鑽井平臺
rig up equipment｜臨時搭建設備
words.tip: rig作動詞既可指裝配，也可指作弊操縱；注意語境。

tr: n. 遠足, 遊覽圓, 短程旅行
[醫] 移動, 離軌, 逸出
def: n. a journey taken for pleasure
A short journey made for pleasure, often with a group.

ex.en: We packed sandwiches for our excursion to the lake.
ex.zh: 我們為去湖邊的短途旅行準備了三明治。

ex.en: School excursions to nature reserves can deepen students' understanding of local wildlife and conservation.
ex.zh: 學校組織的自然保護區遊覽能加深學生對當地野生生物及其保護的理解。

col: go on an excursion｜去短途旅行
a school excursion｜學校組織的遊覽
words.tip: 常指集體休閒短途旅行，搭配go on。

tr: [法] 職業上的, 天職的
def: a. of or relating to a vocation or occupation; especially providing or undergoing training in special skills
Relating to practical skills and training for a particular job

ex.en: My cousin chose a vocational course in plumbing.
ex.zh: 我表親選了一門管道安裝維修職業課程。

ex.en: Expanding vocational education can help young people develop practical skills that match the needs of local employers.
ex.zh: 擴大職業教育能幫助年輕人掌握符合當地僱主需求的實用技能。

words.tip: 常修飾education、training，強調具體職業技能。

def: n. a melon vine of the genus Cucumis; cultivated from earliest times for its cylindrical green fruit
n. cylindrical green fruit with thin green rind and white flesh eaten as a vegetable; related to melons
A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.

ex.en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
ex.zh: 她把一根黃瓜切成片，加入沙拉。

ex.en: Growing cucumbers in greenhouses can provide a reliable food supply, but heating these structures requires energy.
ex.zh: 在溫室中種植黃瓜可以提供穩定的食物供應，但為這些設施供暖需要消耗能源。

col: as cool as a cucumber｜非常鎮定
words.tip: 通常可數：a cucumber；表示食材時也可不可數。

tr: a. 彎曲的, 歪的, 邪惡的
def: a. having or marked by bends or angles; not straight or aligned
a. not straight; dishonest or immoral or evasive

tr: a. 有義務的, 應負責的, 有...傾向的
[法] 有責任的, 可受處理的, 應受罰的
def: s. subject to legal action
s. (often followed by `to') likely to be affected with
s. held legally responsible

ex.en: These old pipes are liable to burst in winter.
ex.zh: 這些舊水管在冬天很容易爆裂。

ex.en: Employers may be held liable for injuries caused by unsafe conditions in the workplace.
ex.zh: 僱主可能須對工作場所不安全條件造成的傷害承擔法律責任。

col: liable to do something｜很可能做某事
liable for damages｜負有損害賠償責任
be held liable｜被認定負有法律責任
words.tip: liable to後接動詞表可能；liable for表責任。

def: n. a group of countries in special alliance
A group of countries or people acting together for shared aims.

ex.en: The councillors formed a bloc to protect local parks.
ex.zh: 這些議員組成了一個聯盟，以保護當地公園。

ex.en: A regional trading bloc can strengthen members' bargaining power while reducing barriers to trade between participating countries.
ex.zh: 區域貿易集團可以增強成員的議價能力，同時降低參與國之間的貿易壁壘。

words.tip: 與block同音；bloc專指共同採取行動的集團。

tr: n. 側部, 支線, 邊音
a. 側面的, 旁邊的
def: s. situated at or extending to the side
s. lying away from the median and sagittal plane of a body

tr: n. 高地, 高原, (上升後的)穩定水平
[醫] 高原, 平頂, 坪
def: n a relatively flat highland
A large area of flat land higher than surrounding land.
A period when growth or progress stops after an increase.

ex.en: We camped on a grassy plateau above the valley.
ex.zh: 我們在山谷上方一片長滿青草的高原上露營。

ex.en: Language learners often reach a plateau and may need different study methods to make further progress.
ex.zh: 語言學習者常會進入平臺期，可能需要改變學習方法才能繼續進步。

words.tip: 平臺期指增長後趨穩，不表示水平開始下降。

tr: n. 殘殺, 屠殺, 殺戮
vt. 殘殺, 屠殺, 虧本出售
def: n. the killing of animals (as for food)
n. the savage and excessive killing of many people
To kill animals, usually for food

ex.en: The farmer explained why some animals are slaughtered for food.
ex.zh: 農場主解釋了為什麼有些動物會被宰殺供人食用。

ex.en: Strict regulations on how animals are slaughtered can improve welfare standards throughout the food production industry.
ex.zh: 嚴格規範動物屠宰方式，可以提高整個食品生產行業的動物福利標準。

words.tip: 指宰殺動物或殘酷殺戮，語氣強；不用於普通死亡。

tr: n. 回顧, 追憶, 回溯
def: n. contemplation of things past
Consideration of past events, often with a changed understanding.

ex.en: In retrospect, packing extra socks was a brilliant idea.
ex.zh: 現在回想起來，多帶幾雙襪子真是個好主意。

ex.en: In retrospect, investing earlier in public transport could have prevented many of the city's current traffic problems.
ex.zh: 回過頭看，如果早點投資公共交通，本可以避免這座城市目前的許多交通問題。

col: only in retrospect｜只有事後回想才
words.tip: 通常用於固定短語in retrospect，表示事後回想。

def: v. get involved or mixed-up with
mix together while remaining partly distinct
move around a group and talk to different people

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread mingled with roasted coffee.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香氣與烘焙咖啡的香氣交織在一起。

ex.en: Community festivals allow residents from different backgrounds to mingle, helping build trust and a stronger sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 社區節慶讓不同背景的居民有機會交流，有助於建立信任並增強歸屬感。

words.tip: mingle with既可指與某物混合，也可指與人交往。

tr: n. 款待, 親切, 殷勤
def: n kindness in welcoming guests or strangers
Friendly and generous treatment of guests or visitors.
The business of providing accommodation, food, and services to guests.

ex.en: Their warm hospitality made us feel completely at home.
ex.zh: 他們的熱情款待讓我們感到十分自在。

ex.en: The hospitality industry creates employment opportunities, but seasonal demand can make workers' incomes less predictable.
ex.zh: 酒店餐飲服務業創造了就業機會，但季節性需求會使從業者的收入更不穩定。

words.tip: 通常不可數；hospitality industry指酒店餐飲服務業。

tr: n. 命令, 必要的事, 規則, 祈使語氣
a. 命令式的, 急需的, 勢在必行的, 強制的
def: n. some duty that is essential and urgent
a. requiring attention or action
a. relating to verbs in the imperative mood

ex.en: It is imperative to keep this medicine refrigerated.
ex.zh: 這種藥必須冷藏保存。

ex.en: As urban populations grow, it is imperative that governments invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 隨著城市人口增長，政府迫切需要投資建設可靠且價格合理的公共交通。

col: it is imperative that｜……至關重要
imperative to act｜必須採取行動
moral imperative｜道義上必須做的事
words.tip: 常用It is imperative to do或that從句。

tr: a. 漠不關心的, 無重要性的, 中立的
[醫] 中性的, 無作用的, 無親和力的, 淡漠的
def: s. showing no care or concern in attitude or action
s. fairly poor to not very good
s. marked by no especial liking or dislike or preference for one thing over another

ex.en: Our cat remained indifferent to its expensive new toy.
ex.zh: 我們家的貓對昂貴的新玩具仍然毫無興趣。

ex.en: People may appear indifferent to environmental problems when they believe their individual actions cannot make a difference.
ex.zh: 當人們認為個人行動無法帶來改變時，可能會顯得對環境問題漠不關心。

words.tip: 常用be indifferent to；這裡的to是介詞。

tr: n. 溼氣, 潮溼, 溼度
def: n. wetness in the atmosphere
The amount of water vapour in the air

ex.en: The high humidity made my shirt feel damp.
ex.zh: 空氣溼度很高，我的襯衫摸起來潮潮的。

ex.en: High humidity can reduce comfort in classrooms, making effective ventilation particularly important during warmer months.
ex.zh: 高溼度會降低教室的舒適度，因此在較熱的月份，有效通風尤為重要。

words.tip: 通常不可數；溼度高低用high或low。

tr: n. 烈士, 受苦者, 受難者
vt. 使成為烈士, 使受苦
def: n. one who suffers for the sake of principle
n. one who voluntarily suffers death as the penalty for refusing to renounce their religion
v. kill as a martyr

tr: a. 惡兆的, 不吉利的, 預兆的
def: s threatening or foreshadowing evil or tragic developments
s presaging ill fortune
suggesting that something bad or unpleasant may happen

ex.en: Ominous clouds gathered as we hurried back home.
ex.zh: 陰沉得令人不安的烏雲聚攏過來，我們趕忙往家走。

ex.en: The rapid decline in insect populations is an ominous sign for ecosystems that depend on pollination.
ex.zh: 對於依賴授粉的生態系統而言，昆蟲數量迅速下降是一個不祥的徵兆。

col: an ominous silence｜令人不安的寂靜
words.tip: 強調預示壞事將發生，而非壞事已經發生。

def: n. leaping insect; male makes chirping noises by rubbing the forewings together
n. a game played with a ball and bat by two teams of 11 players; teams take turns trying to score runs
v. play cricket

ex.en: We played cricket in the park after lunch.
ex.zh: 午飯後，我們在公園裡打板球。

ex.en: Team sports such as cricket can help young people develop cooperation skills and build lasting friendships.
ex.zh: 板球等團隊運動可以幫助年輕人培養合作能力，建立持久的友誼。

col: a cricket match｜一場板球比賽
words.tip: 指板球運動時不可數；指蟋蟀時可數。

def: v. be false to; be dishonest with
v. cause someone to believe an untruth
to deliberately make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: The seller deceived me about the bicycle's condition.
ex.zh: 賣家在自行車的狀況上欺騙了我。

ex.en: Misleading advertisements can deceive consumers into purchasing products that offer little benefit to their health.
ex.zh: 誤導性廣告可能誘使消費者購買對健康益處甚微的產品。

col: deceive someone into doing something｜騙某人做某事
words.tip: deceive sb into doing sth表示騙某人做某事。

tr: n. 不規則物, 不合規格之物
a. 不規則的, 不整齊的, 不合法的
def: n. merchandise that has imperfections; usually sold at a reduced price without the brand name
a. contrary to rule or accepted order or general practice
s. not occurring at expected times

ex.en: The path was made from stones of irregular shapes.
ex.zh: 這條小路由形狀不規則的石頭鋪成。

ex.en: Working irregular hours can disrupt sleep patterns and make it harder for employees to maintain healthy routines.
ex.zh: 工作時間不固定可能擾亂睡眠規律，使員工更難保持健康的作息。

words.tip: 既可形容形狀，也可形容時間；不規則動詞也用它。

tr: n. 法令, 判決, 天意
def: n. a legally binding command or decision entered on the court record (as if issued by a court or judge)
v. issue a decree
An official order issued by a ruler, government, or court.

ex.en: The new decree means our street stays closed tonight.
ex.zh: 新頒佈的法令意味著今晚我們這條街將繼續封閉。

ex.en: The government issued a decree requiring factories to treat wastewater before releasing it into rivers.
ex.zh: 政府頒佈法令，要求工廠將廢水處理後再排入河流。

words.tip: 動詞可接that從句；名詞指有權威的正式命令。

tr: n. 氣質, 性格, 性情
def: n. excessive emotionalism or irritability and excitability (especially when displayed openly)
n. an adjustment of the intervals (as in tuning a keyboard instrument) so that the scale can be used to play in different keys
a person's usual emotional nature and way of reacting

ex.en: Our new puppy has a gentle temperament and rarely barks.
ex.zh: 我們新養的小狗性情溫順，很少吠叫。

ex.en: A calm temperament helps healthcare professionals communicate effectively with patients during stressful situations in busy hospitals.
ex.zh: 在繁忙醫院的緊張情境下，沉著的性情有助於醫護人員與患者有效溝通。

words.tip: temperament指慣常性情；temper常指脾氣，尤指怒氣。

tr: n. 召集, 集合, 檢閱, 清單, 花名冊, 樣品
vt. 召集, 集合, 應召
def: n. a gathering of military personnel for duty
v. gather or bring together
v. call to duty, military service, jury duty, etc.

ex.en: I finally mustered the courage to ask for help.
ex.zh: 我終於鼓起勇氣尋求幫助。

ex.en: Local authorities must muster sufficient public support before introducing major changes to urban transport systems.
ex.zh: 地方政府在對城市交通系統作出重大調整之前，必須爭取足夠的公眾支持。

words.tip: muster courage指鼓起勇氣；pass muster指合格。

def: n. a large artillery gun that is usually on wheels
n. heavy gun fired from a tank
n. (Middle Ages) a cylindrical piece of armor plate to protect the arm

ex.en: An old cannon stood beside the castle entrance.
ex.zh: 城堡入口旁擺放著一門舊大炮。

ex.en: The introduction of cannon changed military architecture, encouraging the construction of thicker walls and lower defensive structures.
ex.zh: 大炮的引入改變了軍事建築設計，推動了更厚城牆和更低矮防禦工事的建造。

words.tip: 複數可用cannon或cannons；勿與canon混淆。

tr: a. 遺忘的, 健忘的, 不知不覺的
[法] 忘卻的, 健忘的, 不在意的
def: s. (followed by `to' or `of') lacking conscious awareness of

tr: n. 麻醉藥, 鎮靜劑
a. 麻醉的, 催眠的
def: n. a drug that produces numbness or stupor; often taken for pleasure or to reduce pain; extensive use can lead to addiction
a. of or relating to or designating narcotics
s. inducing stupor or narcosis

ex.en: The doctor prescribed a narcotic for severe pain after surgery.
ex.zh: 醫生開了一種麻醉性鎮痛藥，用於緩解術後劇痛。

ex.en: Strict controls on narcotic medicines should prevent misuse without limiting access for patients with severe pain.
ex.zh: 對麻醉性藥品的嚴格管控應防止濫用，同時不妨礙劇痛患者獲得藥物。

words.tip: 醫學常指麻醉性鎮痛藥；法律語境可泛指毒品。

def: n. a large gathering of people
n. the common people generally
A very large number of people or things

ex.en: A multitude of colourful birds gathered around the pond.
ex.zh: 一大群色彩鮮豔的鳥聚集在池塘邊。

ex.en: Urban planners must consider a multitude of factors when designing affordable housing for growing populations.
ex.zh: 城市規劃者為不斷增長的人口設計經濟適用住房時，必須考慮眾多因素。

col: a multitude of factors｜眾多因素
a multitude of options｜大量選擇
words.tip: a multitude of後接複數名詞，表示大量。

def: n. a fabric made by knitting
n. a basic knitting stitch
n. needlework created by interlacing yarn in a series of connected loops using straight eyeless needles or by machine

ex.en: My grandfather knitted a warm scarf for me.
ex.zh: 我爺爺給我織了一條暖和的圍巾。

ex.en: Community groups that knit blankets for local shelters combine practical support with opportunities for social interaction.
ex.zh: 為當地收容所編織毯子的社區團體，將實際援助與社交機會結合起來。

words.tip: k不發音；過去式和過去分詞可用knitted或knit。

def: v. reduce the level of land, as by erosion
v. lower the grade of something; reduce its worth
To reduce the quality or condition of something

ex.en: Strong sunlight can degrade the fabric of outdoor chairs.
ex.zh: 強烈的陽光會損壞戶外椅子的面料。

ex.en: Intensive farming can degrade soil quality, making it harder to grow healthy crops in the future.
ex.zh: 集約化農業可能降低土壤質量，使今後更難種出健康的作物。

col: degrade soil quality｜降低土壤質量
words.tip: 表示質量下降時可及物；化學降解也可不及物。

def: s increasing by successive addition

tr: n. 落後, 囚犯, 遲延, 桶板, 防護套
vi. 落後, 蹣跚, 緩緩而行, 滯後
vt. 落後於, 押往監獄, 加上外套
def: v. hang (back) or fall (behind) in movement, progress, development, etc.
v. throw or pitch at a mark, as with coins
v. cover with lagging to prevent heat loss

ex.en: I always lag behind my sister on steep hills.
ex.zh: 走陡坡時，我總是落在姐姐後面。

ex.en: Investment in rural transport often lags behind urban development, limiting access to jobs and essential services.
ex.zh: 農村交通投資往往落後於城市發展，限制了人們獲得工作和基本服務的機會。

col: a lag in development｜發展滯後
words.tip: 常用lag behind表示落後；過去式為lagged。

tr: n. 側面, 側腹, 脅, 腰窩肉
vt. 攻擊側面, 守側面
def: n. the side of military or naval formation
n. a subfigure consisting of a side of something
n. a cut from the fleshy part of an animal's side between the ribs and the leg

tr: n. 鞭子, 鞭打, 睫毛, 責罵, 諷刺
vt. 鞭打, 擺動, 扎捆, 衝擊, 諷刺, 煽動
vi. 沖洗, 鞭打, 責罵
def: n. leather strip that forms the flexible part of a whip
v. lash or flick about sharply
v. bind with a rope, chain, or cord

ex.en: Heavy rain lashed the windows throughout the night.
ex.zh: 大雨整夜猛烈地拍打著窗戶。

ex.en: As storms lash coastal communities, stronger sea defences become increasingly important for protecting homes and essential infrastructure.
ex.zh: 隨著風暴猛烈襲擊沿海社區，更堅固的海防設施對保護住房和重要基礎設施愈發重要。

col: lash against the windows｜猛烈拍打窗戶
lash out at｜猛烈抨擊；攻擊
words.tip: lash out at可指突然攻擊或猛烈抨擊。

def: n. outlying areas (as of a city or town)
the areas around the outer edge of a town or city

ex.en: Their new house is on the outskirts of town.
ex.zh: 他們的新房子在鎮子邊上。

ex.en: Building affordable homes on the outskirts may reduce housing costs but increase residents' dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 在市郊建設可負擔住房可能降低住房成本，卻會增加居民對私家車的依賴。

col: on the outskirts of｜在……的邊緣地帶
the outskirts of town｜城鎮郊區
words.tip: 固定用複數，常說on the outskirts of a city。

tr: vt. 圍繞, 圈起, 放入封套, 附上
def: v. close in; darkness enclosed him"
v. surround completely
To surround something with a wall, fence, or other barrier.

ex.en: A low stone wall encloses our sunny back garden.
ex.zh: 一道低矮的石牆圍著我們陽光充足的後花園。

ex.en: Applicants should enclose copies of their qualifications when submitting a paper application for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 申請人提交紙質獎學金申請時，應隨附資格證明文件的複印件。

col: enclose a copy｜隨函附上副本
words.tip: 紙質信件隨附用enclose；郵件附件用attach。

tr: vt. 激怒, 使發怒, 使興奮, 使發炎
def: v. excite to an abnormal condition, or chafe or inflame
v. excite to some characteristic action or condition, such as motion, contraction, or nervous impulse, by the application of a stimulus
To make someone feel annoyed or impatient.

ex.en: The constant dripping from the tap really irritates me.
ex.zh: 水龍頭不停滴水，真讓我煩躁。

ex.en: Some household cleaning products contain chemicals that can irritate the skin and cause breathing difficulties.
ex.zh: 某些家用清潔產品含有會刺激皮膚並導致呼吸困難的化學物質。

col: really irritate someone｜著實惹惱某人
words.tip: irritated形容人感到煩躁；irritating形容事物煩人。

tr: vt. 用發光信號發出, 使閃耀, 使張開
def: n. a shape that spreads outward
n. a sudden burst of flame
n. a burst of light used to communicate or illuminate

ex.en: The flames flared as he added another dry branch.
ex.zh: 他又添了一根幹樹枝，火焰頓時旺了起來。

ex.en: Tensions can flare when urban development projects fail to address the concerns of local residents.
ex.zh: 城市開發項目若未能回應當地居民的關切，緊張局勢就可能驟然加劇。

words.tip: flare up可指火勢突然變旺，也指矛盾或病症發作。

tr: n. 岬, 海角, 披肩, 鬥蓬
def: n. a strip of land projecting into a body of water
n. a sleeveless garment like a cloak but shorter
a piece of land extending into the sea

ex.en: We walked around the cape before the tide rose.
ex.zh: 我們在漲潮之前繞著海角走了一圈。

ex.en: The construction of a lighthouse on the cape improved safety for ships approaching the harbour.
ex.zh: 在海角修建燈塔提高了船隻駛近港口時的安全性。

words.tip: cape既可指海角，也可指無袖披風。

tr: vt. 吞食, 揮霍, 吞沒
def: v. destroy completely
v. enjoy avidly
v. eat immoderately

ex.en: After swimming, we devoured the warm bread within minutes.
ex.zh: 游泳後，我們幾分鐘就狼吞虎嚥地吃光了熱麵包。

ex.en: Large infrastructure projects can devour public funds unless spending is carefully monitored throughout construction.
ex.zh: 大型基礎設施項目可能耗費鉅額公共資金，除非在整個施工過程中嚴格監督支出。

col: devour a meal｜狼吞虎嚥地吃飯
words.tip: 比eat語氣強；也可比喻大量閱讀或吞噬資源。

tr: n. 寄生生物, 寄生蟲, 食客
def: n. an animal or plant that lives in or on a host (another animal or plant); it obtains nourishment from the host without benefiting or killing the host
an organism living on or inside another and taking nutrients
someone who takes from others without contributing anything

ex.en: The vet found a parasite in our dog's fur.
ex.zh: 獸醫在我們狗的毛裡發現了一隻寄生蟲。

ex.en: Warmer temperatures may allow certain parasites to spread into regions where they previously could not survive.
ex.zh: 氣溫升高可能使某些寄生生物擴散到此前無法生存的地區。

words.tip: 指人時有強烈貶義；生物學中的宿主叫host。

tr: vt. 放射, 散發, 輻射, 傳播, 廣播
vi. 發光, 輻射, 流露
a. 有射線的, 輻射狀的
def: v. send out rays or waves
v. send out real or metaphoric rays
v. extend or spread outward from a center or focus or inward towards a center

tr: adv. 靠什麼, 如何, 為何, 靠那個, 因此, 由此
def: adv. By which; -- used relatively.
adv. By what; how; -- used interrogatively.
By which a particular result is achieved.

ex.en: We have an arrangement whereby we share the cooking.
ex.zh: 我們有個安排，輪流負責做飯。

ex.en: Schools could introduce a system whereby older students provide academic support to younger pupils after lessons.
ex.zh: 學校可以引入一種制度，讓高年級學生在課後為低年級學生提供學業幫助。

col: a system whereby｜藉以實現某事的制度
a process whereby｜藉以實現某事的過程
an arrangement whereby｜據此實行的安排
words.tip: 正式關係副詞，常接在system等詞後，相當於by which。

tr: n. 槓桿, 窺探, 好奇者
vt. 撬動, 撬開, 費力得到
def: v. to move or force, especially in an effort to get something open
v. be nosey
v. make an uninvited or presumptuous inquiry

ex.en: Please don't pry into my sister's private life.
ex.zh: 請不要打探我姐姐的私生活。

ex.en: Employers should respect personal boundaries rather than pry into matters unrelated to an employee's professional responsibilities.
ex.zh: 僱主應尊重個人界限，而不是打探與員工工作職責無關的事情。

col: pry into someone's affairs｜打探某人的私事
pry open a lid｜撬開蓋子
words.tip: 窺探用pry into；表示撬開時英式常用prise。

tr: n. 名稱, 教派, 面額
[經] 票面金額, 名稱, (度量衡)
def: n. a group of religious congregations having its own organization and a distinctive faith
n. a class of one kind of unit in a system of numbers or measures or weights or money

tr: a. 習慣的, 慣常的
def: s. in accordance with convention or custom

tr: n. 爐格, 爐篦, 爐柵, 火爐, 壁爐, 格柵
vt. 裝格柵於, 磨擦, 軋碎, 磨碎, 使焦急, 觸怒, 使人煩躁, 刺激, 激怒
vt.vi. 擦響, 發出刺耳的尖厲聲
def: n. a frame of iron bars to hold a fire
n. a harsh rasping sound made by scraping something
n. a barrier that has parallel or crossed bars blocking a passage but admitting air

tr: a. 金屬的, 含金屬的, 產生金屬的
有金屬光澤、聲音或味道的
def: n. a fabric made of a yarn that is partly or entirely of metal
n. a yarn made partly or entirely of metal
a. containing or made of or resembling or characteristic of a metal

ex.en: The metallic frame makes this chair surprisingly heavy.
ex.zh: 金屬框架讓這把椅子出乎意料地重。

ex.en: Metallic components can often be recovered from discarded electronics, reducing the need to extract new raw materials.
ex.zh: 廢棄電子產品中的金屬部件通常可以回收，從而減少開採新原材料的需求。

col: a metallic sound｜金屬般的聲音
a metallic finish｜金屬光澤飾面
words.tip: metallic既可指含金屬，也可形容像金屬的光澤或聲音。

tr: vt. 撇取浮沫, 略讀, 掠過
n. 脫脂乳, 擦過, 表層物
def: n. a thin layer covering the surface of a liquid
n. reading or glancing through quickly
v. cause to skip over a surface

tr: n. 直覺, 直覺的知識
def: n. instinctive knowing (without the use of rational processes)
n. an impression that something might be the case

tr: vt. 計算, 總計, 估計, 認為, 猜想
vi. 數, 計算, 估計, 依賴, 料想
def: v. take account of

tr: a. 古怪的, 反常的, 不同圓心的
def: n. a person with an unusual or odd personality
a. not having a common center; not concentric

tr: vt. 無意中聽到, 偷聽
def: v hear, usually without the knowledge of the speakers

tr: a. 親切的, 慈善的
def: a. characterized by charm, good taste, and generosity of spirit
s. disposed to bestow favors
kind and polite, especially when treating others generously

ex.en: Our gracious host brought extra blankets for everyone.
ex.zh: 熱情周到的主人給每個人都拿來了額外的毯子。

ex.en: Public figures who remain gracious towards their critics can encourage more respectful discussion within society.
ex.zh: 公眾人物若能對批評者保持寬厚有禮的態度，就能促進社會中更相互尊重的討論。

col: a gracious host｜熱情有禮的主人
gracious in defeat｜落敗仍有風度
words.tip: gracious重待人有禮；graceful重動作優美。

tr: n. 推翻, 瓦解, 傾覆
vt. 打倒, 推翻, 傾覆
def: n. the termination of a ruler or institution (especially by force)
v. cause the downfall of; of rulers
to remove a ruler or government from power

ex.en: The film follows citizens who overthrow an unfair ruler.
ex.zh: 這部電影講述民眾推翻不公正統治者的故事。

ex.en: Economic hardship can weaken public support for a government and encourage attempts to overthrow it.
ex.zh: 經濟困難可能削弱公眾對政府的支持，並促使人們嘗試推翻它。

col: the overthrow of a ruler｜統治者被推翻
words.tip: 過去式overthrew，過去分詞overthrown。

tr: n. 怨言, 滿腹牢騷
vi. 抱怨, 發牢騷, 發隆隆聲
def: n. a complaint uttered in a low and indistinct tone
v. to utter or emit low dull rumbling sounds
to complain in an annoyed, often quiet way

ex.en: My brother grumbled about washing the dishes again.
ex.zh: 我哥哥抱怨又要洗碗。

ex.en: Although commuters often grumble about delays, many still prefer public transport because it reduces travel costs.
ex.zh: 儘管通勤者經常抱怨延誤，許多人仍更願意乘坐公共交通，因為這能降低出行成本。

col: grumble at someone｜向某人發牢騷
words.tip: 常用grumble about sth，表示抱怨某事。

tr: a. 不介意的, 大意的, 魯莽的, 不顧後果的
[法] 不注意的, 粗心大意的, 魯莽的
def: s marked by defiant disregard for danger or consequences
s characterized by careless unconcern
Ignoring danger or the possible harmful results of an action

ex.en: Cycling downhill without brakes was a reckless thing to do.
ex.zh: 騎著沒有剎車的自行車下坡是一種魯莽的行為。

ex.en: Reckless lending by financial institutions can expose households to debts they have little realistic chance of repaying.
ex.zh: 金融機構不顧風險地放貸，可能讓家庭背上幾乎無力償還的債務。

col: reckless disregard for safety｜對安全的肆意漠視
words.tip: 比careless更強調明知有風險仍不顧後果。

tr: n. 船貨, 運費, 貨運
vt. 裝貨, 使充滿, 以貨運運送, 租(或出租)(船等)
def: n. transporting goods commercially at rates cheaper than express rates
n. the charge for transporting something by common carrier
v. transport commercially as cargo

ex.en: The train carried freight through the valley overnight.
ex.zh: 這列火車連夜運著貨物穿過山谷。

ex.en: Moving more freight by rail could reduce road congestion and lower emissions from heavy vehicles.
ex.zh: 增加鐵路貨運可以緩解道路擁堵，並減少重型車輛的排放。

words.tip: 名詞通常不可數；cargo主要指貨物，不指貨運服務。

def: n. the act of taking revenge (harming someone in retaliation for something harmful that they have done) especially in the next life; I will repay, saith the Lord"--Romans 12:19

tr: vt. 損毀, 損傷, 糟蹋
def: v. make imperfect
n. any of various primates with short tails or no tail at all
v. imitate uncritically and in every aspect
v. run very fast, usually for a short distance

tr: n. 流入, 河口, 彙集
def: n the process of flowing in

tr: n. 障礙, 困難, 不利條件
vt. 加障礙於, 妨礙
def: n. advantage given to a competitor to equalize chances of winning
v. attempt to forecast the winner (especially in a horse race) and assign odds for or against a contestant
v. put at a disadvantage

ex.en: Without a car, the distance became a real handicap.
ex.zh: 沒有車，這段距離成了實實在在的障礙。

ex.en: Limited access to reliable internet can be a serious handicap for students in remote communities.
ex.zh: 對於偏遠社區的學生來說，難以獲得可靠的網絡連接可能是一個嚴重的不利條件。

col: a serious handicap｜嚴重的不利條件
words.tip: 指殘疾或殘疾人士時已過時，宜用disability。

tr: n. 半球, 地球的半面, 大腦半球
def: n. half of the terrestrial globe
n. half of a sphere
n. either half of the cerebrum

ex.en: Australia lies in the southern hemisphere, far from Europe.
ex.zh: 澳大利亞位於南半球，離歐洲很遠。

ex.en: Seasonal differences between the northern and southern hemispheres influence global tourism patterns throughout the year.
ex.zh: 南北半球的季節差異全年都影響著全球旅遊模式。

words.tip: 地理中指地球的一半，也可指大腦半球。

def: n. works for an expert to learn a trade
v. be or work as an apprentice

tr: n. 變化, 突變, 元音變化
def: n. (genetics) any event that changes genetic structure; any alteration in the inherited nucleic acid sequence of the genotype of an organism
n. a change or alteration in form or qualities
A change in the genetic material of an organism.

ex.en: A mutation gave this flower its unusual white petals.
ex.zh: 一次基因突變使這朵花長出了不尋常的白色花瓣。

ex.en: A genetic mutation may increase disease risk, although environmental factors also influence whether symptoms eventually develop.
ex.zh: 基因突變可能增加患病風險，但環境因素也會影響症狀最終是否出現。

words.tip: 指遺傳物質的改變，不一定有害。

tr: n. 搖籃, 發祥地, 孩提時代
vt. 放在搖籃內, 撫育
def: n. a baby bed with sides and rockers
n. birth of a person
v. hold gently and carefully

ex.en: The baby slept peacefully in a wooden cradle.
ex.zh: 寶寶在木搖籃裡安靜地睡著。

ex.en: The region is often described as a cradle of agriculture because of its early farming settlements.
ex.zh: 由於擁有早期的農耕聚落，這一地區常被稱為農業的發源地。

col: the cradle of civilisation｜文明的發源地
cradle a baby｜輕輕抱著嬰兒
words.tip: the cradle of 可比喻某種文明或活動的發源地。

tr: vt. 使化成紙漿, 除去...果肉
def: n. any soft or soggy mass
n. a soft moist part of a fruit
n. a mixture of cellulose fibers

ex.en: I prefer orange juice with plenty of pulp.
ex.zh: 我更喜歡含有豐富果肉的橙汁。

ex.en: Recycling facilities turn used paper into pulp, reducing the demand for fresh wood fibres.
ex.zh: 回收設施將廢紙製成紙漿，從而減少對新木纖維的需求。

col: pulp and paper industry｜製漿造紙業
words.tip: 表示果肉或紙漿時，pulp通常不可數。

tr: a. 廣大的, 寬廣的
def: s very large in expanse or scope
s (of buildings and rooms) having ample space

tr: vi. 滲出, 滲流, 漏
n. 小泉, 水陸兩用吉普車
def: v. pass gradually or leak through or as if through small openings

tr: vt. 珍愛, 懷有, 愛護
def: v be fond of; be attached to

tr: vt. 闡明, 解決, 解開
def: v. become or cause to become undone by separating the fibers or threads of

tr: vt. 偷運, 走私, 私運
def: v. import or export without paying customs duties
To move goods or people secretly and against the rules.

ex.en: Someone tried to smuggle rare birds through the airport.
ex.zh: 有人試圖通過機場偷運珍稀鳥類。

ex.en: Stronger international cooperation is needed to stop criminal groups that smuggle endangered animals across national borders.
ex.zh: 需要加強國際合作，以阻止跨境走私瀕危動物的犯罪團伙。

col: smuggle something into a country｜將某物走私入境
smuggle something across a border｜跨境偷運某物
words.tip: 常用smuggle sth into/out of某地，表示偷運進出。

tr: n. 尋常事, 老生常談, 普通的東西
a. 平凡的, 普通的
def: s. completely ordinary and unremarkable
s. not challenging; dull and lacking excitement
Happening or found often enough to seem ordinary.

ex.en: Electric bikes are commonplace in our neighbourhood now.
ex.zh: 電動自行車如今在我們社區很常見。

ex.en: Remote working has become commonplace in many industries, changing how companies organise their offices.
ex.zh: 遠程辦公在許多行業已變得普遍，改變了企業安排辦公空間的方式。

words.tip: 多指常見到不足為奇，不一定含貶義。

tr: vt. 使看得見, 使具體化, 想像, 設想
def: v. imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind
v. view the outline of by means of an X-ray
v. form a mental picture of something that is invisible or abstract

ex.en: Close your eyes and visualize a quiet sandy beach.
ex.zh: 閉上眼睛，想像一片寧靜的沙灘。

ex.en: Digital models help residents visualize how proposed buildings will change the appearance of their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 數字模型幫助居民想像擬建建築將如何改變社區的面貌。

col: visualize a scene｜想像一個場景
words.tip: 英式也寫visualise；可接名詞或動名詞。

tr: n. 薄荷, 造幣廠, 鉅額
vt. 鑄造, 鑄幣, 製造
def: n. any north temperate plant of the genus Mentha with aromatic leaves and small mauve flowers
n. any member of the mint family of plants
n. the leaves of a mint plant used fresh or candied

ex.en: I added fresh mint to the lemon water.
ex.zh: 我往檸檬水裡加了新鮮薄荷。

ex.en: Growing herbs such as mint in urban gardens can provide fresh ingredients and encourage interest in food production.
ex.zh: 在城市花園中種植薄荷等香草，可以提供新鮮食材，並激發人們對食物生產的興趣。

words.tip: 植物義通常不可數；a mint可指一顆薄荷糖。

tr: adv. 伴隨地, 偶然, 順便
def: r. of a minor or subordinate nature
Used to introduce an additional or loosely related remark
As a secondary result, rather than the main purpose

ex.en: Incidentally, your scarf is still hanging by our door.
ex.zh: 順便說一句，你的圍巾還掛在我們家門邊。

ex.en: Children may learn new vocabulary incidentally while watching educational programmes, even when language learning is not their main goal.
ex.zh: 孩子們看教育節目時，即使主要目的不是學習語言，也可能附帶學到新詞彙。

words.tip: 句首常表示“順便說”；不等於所有語境中的偶然。

tr: a. 錯誤的, 不準確的
def: a. not exact
not completely correct or exact

ex.en: The map was inaccurate, so we missed the turning.
ex.zh: 地圖不準確，所以我們錯過了轉彎處。

ex.en: Inaccurate information online can undermine public trust and lead people to make poorly informed decisions.
ex.zh: 網上的不準確信息可能削弱公眾信任，並導致人們在缺乏可靠信息的情況下作出決定。

words.tip: 指信息或測量不準確；不一定意味著故意造假。

def: v. mark by some ceremony or observation
v. call to remembrance; keep alive the memory of someone or something, as in a ceremony
v. be or provide a memorial to a person or an event

ex.en: We planted a tree to commemorate our grandfather's life.
ex.zh: 我們種了一棵樹，紀念祖父的一生。

ex.en: Public ceremonies commemorate historical events and help younger generations understand the experiences that shaped their communities.
ex.zh: 公共紀念儀式緬懷歷史事件，幫助年輕一代理解塑造其社區的經歷。

words.tip: 直接接紀念對象；不一定含有慶祝的喜悅。

def: n. myths collectively; the body of stories associated with a culture or institution or person
n. the study of myths

tr: a. 同時的, 同時發生的
def: s occurring or operating at the same time
happening or existing at exactly the same time

ex.en: Simultaneous cheers erupted from both sides of the street.
ex.zh: 街道兩邊同時爆發出歡呼聲。

ex.en: Simultaneous investment in public transport and cycling infrastructure can reduce congestion more effectively than isolated measures.
ex.zh: 同時投資公共交通和自行車基礎設施，比採取單一措施更能有效緩解交通擁堵。

words.tip: 強調時間重合；副詞simultaneously表示同時地。

tr: vi. 推遲, 延期, 聽從
vt. 使推遲, 使延期
def: v hold back to a later time
v yield to another's wish or opinion

tr: vt. 比...重, 比...重要, 比...有價值
def: v. be heavier than

tr: a. 猖獗的, 蔓生的, 猛烈的, 躍立作撲擊狀的
def: s. unrestrained and violent
s. rearing on left hind leg with forelegs elevated and head usually in profile
s. (of a plant) having a lush and unchecked growth

ex.en: Rampant weeds have taken over our vegetable patch.
ex.zh: 瘋長的雜草已經佔據了我們的菜地。

ex.en: Where oversight is weak, rampant corruption can undermine public trust and divert resources away from essential services.
ex.zh: 在監管薄弱的地方，猖獗的腐敗會損害公眾信任，並使資源偏離基本公共服務。

words.tip: 常形容腐敗、疾病等失控蔓延；run rampant指肆虐。

tr: n. 碎布條, 細片, 少量
def: n. a tiny or scarcely detectable amount
v. tear into shreds

tr: n. 加熱器, 燈絲, 加熱工
def: n. device that heats water or supplies warmth to a room
a device that heats air, water, or another substance

ex.en: We switched on the heater before the guests arrived.
ex.zh: 客人到來前，我們打開了取暖器。

ex.en: Replacing an inefficient water heater can lower household energy bills and reduce overall electricity consumption.
ex.zh: 更換效率低下的熱水器能降低家庭能源賬單，並減少總體用電量。

words.tip: heater是設備；heating指供暖或供暖系統。

tr: a. 使清爽的, 有精神的, 爽快的
def: v refresh one's memory
v make (to feel) fresh
v become or make oneself fresh again

ex.en: A refreshing breeze blew through the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 一陣清爽的微風從敞開的廚房窗戶吹進來。

ex.en: The documentary offers a refreshing perspective on how older people contribute to their local communities.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片以令人耳目一新的視角展現老年人如何為當地社區作出貢獻。

col: refreshing change｜令人耳目一新的變化
words.tip: refreshing形容事物；refreshed形容人感到精神恢復。

tr: a. 多才多藝的, 萬用的, 萬向的
def: s. having great diversity or variety
s. changeable or inconstant
s. competent in many areas and able to turn with ease from one thing to another

ex.en: This versatile pan works well for soups and stir-fries.
ex.zh: 這個多用途鍋做湯、炒菜都很好用。

ex.en: Employers increasingly value versatile graduates who can adapt to different roles and learn new skills.
ex.zh: 僱主越來越重視能適應不同崗位並學習新技能的多面手畢業生。

col: a versatile performer｜多才多藝的表演者
words.tip: 既可形容人多才多藝，也可形容物用途廣泛。

tr: n. 討厭的東西, 討厭的人, 損害
def: n. (law) a broad legal concept including anything that disturbs the reasonable use of your property or endangers life and health or is offensive

tr: v. 怒吠, 咆哮, 吼
def: n. the sound of growling (as made by animals)

tr: n. 純淨, 純正, 純粹
def: n. being undiluted or unmixed with extraneous material
n. the state of being unsullied by sin or moral wrong; lacking a knowledge of evil
the state of containing no unwanted or harmful substances

ex.en: The jeweller checked the purity of my gold ring.
ex.zh: 珠寶匠檢測了我那枚金戒指的純度。

ex.en: Regular monitoring of water purity is essential for preventing disease and maintaining public confidence in local supplies.
ex.zh: 定期監測水的純淨程度，對於預防疾病和維持公眾對當地供水的信心至關重要。

words.tip: 不可數名詞；表示具體純度常用the purity of。

tr: n. 嘔吐, 嘔吐物, 催吐劑
def: n. the matter ejected in vomiting
n. the reflex act of ejecting the contents of the stomach through the mouth
v. eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth

ex.en: The rough boat ride made several passengers vomit.
ex.zh: 船在航行中劇烈顛簸，導致幾位乘客嘔吐。

ex.en: Patients who vomit repeatedly may become dehydrated and should seek medical advice if symptoms persist.
ex.zh: 反覆嘔吐的患者可能出現脫水，若症狀持續，應諮詢醫生。

words.tip: 名詞指嘔吐物；嘔吐這一過程常用vomiting。

tr: n. 外部, 表面, 外貌
a. 外部的, 外在的, 表面的
def: a. situated in or suitable for the outdoors or outside of a building
The outside surface or appearance of something.
On or relating to the outside of something.

ex.en: They painted the exterior of their house pale blue.
ex.zh: 他們把房子的外牆刷成了淡藍色。

ex.en: Improving a building's exterior can protect it from weather damage while preserving its historical character.
ex.zh: 改善建築外部可以保護它免受天氣損害，同時保留其歷史特色。

col: the exterior of a building｜建築物的外部
words.tip: exterior指外部或外表；interior指內部。

tr: a. 永久的, 不斷的, 無期限的, 沒完沒了的, 四季開花的
[經] 永遠的, 終身的, 持續的
一再發生的；沒完沒了的
def: s continuing forever or indefinitely
s uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing
continuing all the time or lasting forever

ex.en: The dripping tap is a source of perpetual irritation.
ex.zh: 水龍頭不停滴水，讓人一直心煩。

ex.en: The pursuit of perpetual economic growth raises questions about how societies can protect limited natural resources.
ex.zh: 對持續經濟增長的追求引出了社會如何保護有限自然資源的問題。

words.tip: 可指永不停止，也常誇張表示某事沒完沒了。

tr: n. (多面體的)面, 方面, 琢面
def: n. a smooth surface (as of a bone or cut gemstone)
One part or aspect of a complex subject.
A small flat surface on a cut stone.

ex.en: Cooking together revealed a new facet of her personality.
ex.zh: 一起做飯展現了她性格中新的一面。

ex.en: Public transport affects almost every facet of urban life, from employment opportunities to air quality.
ex.zh: 公共交通幾乎影響城市生活的每個方面，從就業機會到空氣質量。

col: a facet of life｜生活的一個方面
words.tip: 常用 a facet of，指複雜事物的一個方面。

tr: vt. 即席創作, 臨時做
def: v. perform without preparation
v. manage in a makeshift way; do with whatever is at hand

tr: vt. 妨礙, 阻礙, 阻止
def: v. be a hindrance or obstacle to
To make movement or progress slower or more difficult.

ex.en: Fallen branches impeded our progress along the narrow path.
ex.zh: 掉落的樹枝阻礙了我們沿著狹窄小路前進。

ex.en: Limited access to reliable internet services can impede educational progress in rural communities and widen existing inequalities.
ex.zh: 難以獲得可靠的互聯網服務可能阻礙農村社區的教育發展，並擴大現有的不平等。

words.tip: 強調使進展困難或緩慢，不一定完全阻止。

tr: vi. 沉澱, 沉降, 平息
def: v. wear off or die down
v. sink to a lower level or form a depression
v. sink down or precipitate
n. part of the perianth that is usually brightly colored

tr: n. 陳腔濫調, 凸印版
def: n a trite or obvious remark

tr: a. 不育的, 貧瘠的
def: n. an uninhabited wilderness that is worthless for cultivation
s. not bearing offspring
s. completely wanting or lacking

ex.en: Only a few bushes grew on the barren hillside.
ex.zh: 貧瘠的山坡上只長著幾叢灌木。

ex.en: Unsustainable farming can turn productive fields into barren land, threatening food security and forcing rural communities to relocate.
ex.zh: 不可持續的耕作方式會使良田變成荒地，威脅糧食安全，並迫使農村社區遷移。

words.tip: barren強調不生長或無產出；bare強調裸露、無遮擋。

tr: n. 鉸鏈, 關鍵, 樞紐
vi. 靠鉸鏈移動, 依...而轉移
def: n. a joint that holds two parts together so that one can swing relative to the other
n. a circumstance upon which subsequent events depend
v. attach with a hinge

ex.en: The rusty hinge squeaks whenever I open the cupboard.
ex.zh: 每次我打開櫥櫃，生鏽的合頁都會吱吱作響。

ex.en: The success of public transport reforms may hinge on reliable funding and sustained support from local residents.
ex.zh: 公共交通改革的成功可能取決於可靠的資金來源和當地居民的持續支持。

words.tip: hinge on 後接名詞或從句，表示“取決於”。

tr: a. 現世的, 世俗的, 宇宙的
def: s. concerned with the world or worldly matters
s. belonging to this earth or world; not ideal or heavenly; yet a mundane wonder of unimagined kind"

tr: a. 意見一致的, 無異議的
def: s in complete agreement
s acting together as a single undiversified whole
agreed on by every person in a group

ex.en: Our family was unanimous about adopting the little cat.
ex.zh: 我們全家一致同意收養那隻小貓。

ex.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision to improve public transport rather than expand the existing road network.
ex.zh: 委員會一致決定改善公共交通，而不是擴建現有道路網。

words.tip: 強調所有人都同意，不是僅指多數人贊成。

tr: n. 智力, 出眾的才華, 知識分子
def: n knowledge and intellectual ability
n the capacity for rational thought or inference or discrimination
n a person who uses the mind creatively

ex.en: Her sharp intellect makes difficult puzzles seem surprisingly easy.
ex.zh: 她思維敏銳，解起難題來顯得格外輕鬆。

ex.en: Education should develop students' intellect while also nurturing creativity, emotional awareness, and the ability to collaborate.
ex.zh: 教育應發展學生的智力，同時培養創造力、情感意識和協作能力。

words.tip: intellect側重理解與推理能力，不等同於知識。

tr: a. 率直的, 完全的, 總共的, 直率的
adv. 完全地, 率直地, 立刻地, 一直向前
一次付清地；完全擁有地
def: s. without reservation or exception
r. without restrictions or stipulations or further payments
r. without reservation or concealment

ex.en: My landlord rejected my request outright, without any discussion.
ex.zh: 房東直接拒絕了我的請求，完全沒有商量。

ex.en: Rather than banning private cars outright, cities could encourage residents to use reliable and affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 城市可以鼓勵居民使用可靠且價格合理的公共交通，而不是全面禁止私家車。

col: an outright lie｜徹頭徹尾的謊言
words.tip: buy outright指一次付清；形容詞常置於名詞前。

tr: vt. 使滴, 使小量流動
def: v. run or flow slowly, as in drops or in an unsteady stream

tr: a. 常年的, 長期的, 反覆的
def: n. (botany) a plant lasting for three seasons or more
a. lasting three seasons or more
s. lasting an indefinitely long time; suggesting self-renewal

tr: n. 重疊, 重複, 部分的同時發生
vt. 重疊, 重複, 與...同時發生
vi. 迭蓋, 部分的同時發生
def: n. a representation of common ground between theories or phenomena
n. the property of partial coincidence in time
v. coincide partially or wholly

ex.en: The curtains overlap slightly in the middle of the window.
ex.zh: 窗簾在窗戶中間略有重疊。

ex.en: University courses often overlap in content, allowing students to explore connections between different academic disciplines.
ex.zh: 大學課程的內容常有重疊，使學生能夠探索不同學科之間的聯繫。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後，名詞在前；過去式overlapped。

tr: a. 荒廢的, 成廢物的, 陳舊的, 老式的
def: s no longer in use
n. someone who has insufficient assets to cover their debts
v. reduce to bankruptcy
s. financially ruined

ex.en: The little furniture shop went bankrupt last winter.
ex.zh: 那家小傢俱店去年冬天破產了。

ex.en: Small businesses may go bankrupt if rising energy costs are combined with a prolonged decline in consumer demand.
ex.zh: 如果能源成本上漲又遇上消費需求長期下降，小企業可能會破產。

col: declare someone bankrupt｜宣告某人破產
words.tip: 常說go bankrupt；名詞“破產”是bankruptcy。

tr: v. 回收利用( recycle的過去式和過去分詞 ); 再利用; 再次應用; 重新使用（概念、方法、玩笑等）
def: v cause to repeat a cycle
v use again after processing
made from waste materials processed for use again

ex.en: This notebook is made entirely from recycled paper.
ex.zh: 這本筆記本完全由再生紙製成。

ex.en: Using recycled materials in construction can reduce demand for natural resources and limit waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 在建築中使用再生材料，可以減少對自然資源的需求，減少送往垃圾填埋場的廢物。

words.tip: recycled 指已回收再製；recyclable 指可回收。

tr: a. 不同的, 有差別的
def: s. differing from a norm or standard
s. exhibiting variation and change
A form that differs slightly from other related forms.

ex.en: This local variant of the soup includes fresh beans.
ex.zh: 這種湯的本地做法加入了新鮮豆子。

ex.en: A genetic variant may affect how individuals respond to certain medicines, making personalised treatment increasingly important.
ex.zh: 某種基因變異可能影響個體對特定藥物的反應，因此個性化治療日益重要。

words.tip: 名詞常用a variant of；形容詞可修飾spelling等。

tr: n. 慟哭, 哀號, 嚎啕, 呼嘯(聲)
vi. 慟哭, 呼嘯, 悲嘆, 哀號, 嚎啕
def: v. cry weakly or softly
to cry loudly in pain, sadness, or distress
a long, high cry or sound expressing distress

ex.en: The baby began to wail when her toy fell.
ex.zh: 玩具掉了，寶寶便放聲大哭起來。

ex.en: Residents heard sirens wailing throughout the night as emergency teams responded to the severe flooding.
ex.zh: 應急隊伍應對嚴重洪災時，居民整夜都聽到警報器的長鳴聲。

col: wail in pain｜痛得大聲哭叫
a piercing wail｜刺耳的哀號聲
the wail of sirens｜警報器的長鳴聲
words.tip: 強調持續而尖厲的哭聲，也可形容警報器長鳴。

tr: vt. 趕上, 突然降臨於, 壓倒, 代替
def: v. catch up with and possibly overtake
To catch up with and move ahead of someone.
To become greater or more successful than someone or something.

ex.en: We waited for a safe gap to overtake the tractor.
ex.zh: 我們等到有安全空隙時才超過那輛拖拉機。

ex.en: Renewable energy could overtake fossil fuels as the main source of electricity in some countries.
ex.zh: 在一些國家，可再生能源可能超越化石燃料，成為主要電力來源。

col: overtake a rival｜超越競爭對手
be overtaken by events｜因局勢變化而失去作用
words.tip: 過去式 overtook，過去分詞 overtaken。

tr: n. 鋪位, 廢話, 逃走
vi. 逃跑, 睡在鋪上
def: n. a long trough for feeding cattle
n. a rough bed (as at a campsite)
n. unacceptable behavior (especially ludicrously false statements)

ex.en: I climbed into the top bunk and fell asleep.
ex.zh: 我爬上上鋪，睡著了。

ex.en: Providing each passenger with a comfortable bunk could make overnight trains more attractive than short flights.
ex.zh: 為每位乘客提供舒適的鋪位，能讓夜間列車比短途航班更有吸引力。

words.tip: top bunk是上鋪；bunk bed指雙層床。

tr: n. 海上救助, 搶救, 打撈, 搶救出來的財物
vt. 海上救助, 搶救, 打撈, 營救
def: n. property or goods saved from damage or destruction
n. the act of saving goods or property that were in danger of damage or destruction
n. the act of rescuing a ship or its crew or its cargo from a shipwreck or a fire

ex.en: We managed to salvage some books after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水過後，我們設法搶救出了一些書。

ex.en: Construction companies can salvage valuable materials from old buildings, reducing waste and demand for new resources.
ex.zh: 建築公司可以從舊建築中回收有價值的材料，減少廢物以及對新資源的需求。

words.tip: 多指搶救財物；救人通常用rescue。

tr: n. 牧羊人, 牧羊犬, 牧師, 保護者
vt. 看守, 領導, 指導, 牧羊
def: n. a clergyman who watches over a group of people
v. watch over like a shepherd, as a teacher of her pupils
v. tend as a shepherd, as of sheep or goats

ex.en: The shepherd led the sheep home before sunset.
ex.zh: 牧羊人在日落前把羊群領回了家。

ex.en: Museum staff shepherd visitors through crowded galleries to ensure that everyone can move safely between exhibits.
ex.zh: 博物館工作人員引導遊客穿過擁擠的展廳，確保所有人都能在展品之間安全通行。

col: a shepherd's hut｜牧羊人的小屋
shepherd visitors through｜引導遊客穿過
words.tip: 作動詞通常及物：shepherd sb into/through某處。

tr: n. 表徵, 記號, 代幣
a. 象徵的, 表意的
def: n. an individual instance of a type of symbol
n. something serving as a sign of something else
n. a metal or plastic disk that can be redeemed or used in designated slot machines

ex.en: I dropped a token into the machine and played.
ex.zh: 我往機器裡投了一枚代幣，開始玩了起來。

ex.en: Critics argue that token environmental measures cannot address the scale of pollution in rapidly expanding cities.
ex.zh: 批評者認為，象徵性的環保措施無法應對快速擴張的城市中如此嚴重的汙染。

col: a token of appreciation｜表達謝意的心意
a token gesture｜象徵性的舉動
a token payment｜象徵性的付款
words.tip: a token of後接情感名詞，表示某種心意。

tr: a. 脆弱的, 虛弱的, 意志薄弱的
n. 少女, 少婦, 燈心草簍
def: n. the weight of a frail (basket) full of raisins or figs; between 50 and 75 pounds
n. a basket for holding dried fruit (especially raisins or figs)
a. physically weak

tr: n. 喇叭, 小號, 喇叭聲
vt. 用喇叭吹出, 吹噓
def: v. proclaim on, or as if on, a trumpet
v. play or blow on the trumpet
v. utter in trumpet-like sounds

ex.en: The musician lifted her trumpet and played a cheerful tune.
ex.zh: 那位樂手舉起小號，吹奏了一支歡快的曲子。

ex.en: Learning the trumpet in a school orchestra can improve students' concentration and ability to cooperate with others.
ex.zh: 在學校管絃樂隊學習小號可以提升學生的專注力及與他人合作的能力。

words.tip: 樂器義是“小號”；動詞可指大肆宣揚。

tr: a. 不可缺少的, 責無旁貸的, 絕對必要的
def: a. not to be dispensed with; essential
s. unavoidable
So important or useful that it cannot be done without

ex.en: My bicycle is indispensable for getting to work.
ex.zh: 我的自行車是我上班不可缺少的交通工具。

ex.en: Reliable internet access has become indispensable for students who depend on digital platforms to complete their coursework.
ex.zh: 對於依靠數字平臺完成課程作業的學生來說，可靠的網絡連接已變得不可或缺。

col: an indispensable tool｜不可缺少的工具
play an indispensable role｜發揮不可或缺的作用
words.tip: 常接to或for；語氣比useful強，表示少不了。

def: n. excessive accumulation of blood or other fluid in a body part
n. excessive crowding
a situation where overcrowding prevents easy movement

ex.en: We left early to avoid congestion near the bridge.
ex.zh: 我們早早出發，以避開橋附近的擁堵。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can ease traffic congestion while reducing air pollution in major cities.
ex.zh: 投資建設可靠的公共交通可以緩解交通擁堵，同時減少大城市的空氣汙染。

words.tip: 通常不可數；traffic congestion指交通擁堵。

tr: n. 叛亂, 反抗, 反感
vi. 叛亂, 反抗, 起義, 厭惡, 反感
vt. 使反感, 使噁心
def: v. make revolution

tr: n. （英）擦靴的僕役；靴子（boot的複數）
def: n footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg
n British term for the luggage compartment in a car
n the swift release of a store of affective force

tr: n. 洗滌, 浸, 洗滌物
def: n the work of cleansing (usually with soap and water)
n garments or white goods that can be cleaned by laundering
v clean with some chemical process

tr: n. 小冊子, 活頁文選
def: n a small book usually having a paper cover
n a brief treatise on a subject of interest; published in the form of a booklet
A thin booklet giving information or arguments about a subject

ex.en: The nurse handed me a pamphlet about healthy eating.
ex.zh: 護士遞給我一本關於健康飲食的小冊子。

ex.en: Public health pamphlets should use clear language and illustrations to explain preventive measures to a broad audience.
ex.zh: 公共衛生宣傳冊應使用清晰的語言和插圖，向廣大受眾解釋預防措施。

col: a pamphlet on health｜健康宣傳冊
words.tip: 通常指介紹專題的薄冊子，比普通書籍篇幅短。

tr: vi. 扣住, 變彎曲, 屈服
def: n. fastener that fastens together two ends of a belt or strap; often has loose prong
v. fasten with a buckle or buckles
v. fold or collapse
n. the distance by which one thing clears another; the space between them
n. permission to proceed
The removal of unwanted objects or material from a place

ex.en: The garden clearance took us most of Saturday.
ex.zh: 清理花園花了我們週六大半天的時間。

ex.en: Large-scale forest clearance can destroy wildlife habitats and increase the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 大規模森林清除會破壞野生動物棲息地，並增加水土流失的風險。

words.tip: clearance sale是清倉促銷；清關用customs clearance。

def: n a native or inhabitant of Scotland

tr: n. 畸形人, 畸形物, 不正常的事物, 反覆無常
a. 奇異的, 反常的
def: n. a person or animal that is markedly unusual or deformed
Very unusual and unexpected
Someone extremely interested in a particular activity or subject

ex.en: A freak hailstorm covered our garden in white ice.
ex.zh: 一場罕見的冰雹把我們的花園蓋上了一層白冰。

ex.en: A freak weather event can expose weaknesses in urban infrastructure and disrupt essential public services.
ex.zh: 異常天氣事件可能暴露城市基礎設施的薄弱環節，並擾亂基本公共服務。

col: a freak accident｜離奇的意外事故
a fitness freak｜健身狂熱愛好者
words.tip: 形容詞通常置於名詞前；動詞常用freak out。

tr: n. 東方人, 亞洲人
a. 東方諸國的, 亞洲的, 東方的
def: n. a member of an Oriental race; the term is regarded as offensive by Asians (especially by Asian Americans)
s. denoting or characteristic of countries of Asia

tr: n. 群, 大群, 蜂群, 分蜂群
vi. 分群, 群集, 聚集一塊, 雲集, 攀
vt. 擠滿, 爬, 攀
def: n. a group of many things in the air or on the ground
A large group of insects moving or gathering together.
Move or gather somewhere in large numbers.

ex.en: A swarm of bees gathered on the apple tree.
ex.zh: 一群蜜蜂聚集在蘋果樹上。

ex.en: Visitors swarm into coastal towns during summer, increasing demand for public transport and waste collection services.
ex.zh: 遊客在夏季湧入沿海城鎮，增加了對公共交通和垃圾收集服務的需求。

col: a swarm of bees｜一群蜜蜂
words.tip: be swarming with表示某處擠滿人或昆蟲。

tr: vt. 溫和, 緩和, 減輕
def: v. make less severe or harsh
To make something harmful, unpleasant, or serious less severe

ex.en: Thick curtains helped mitigate the noise from the street.
ex.zh: 厚窗簾幫助減輕了街上傳來的噪聲。

ex.en: Planting trees in urban areas can mitigate the effects of extreme heat and improve residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 在城市地區植樹可以減輕酷熱的影響，並改善居民的生活質量。

col: mitigate the effects of｜減輕……的影響
mitigate climate change｜緩解氣候變化
mitigating circumstances｜可減輕處罰的情節
words.tip: 正式用詞，直接接風險、損害或影響，不表示徹底消除。

tr: n. 釦子, 鉤, 緊握
def: n. a fastener (as a buckle or hook) that is used to hold two things together
n. the act of grasping
v. hold firmly and tightly

ex.en: She clasped my hand as we crossed the bridge.
ex.zh: 過橋時，她緊緊握住我的手。

ex.en: Young children may clasp a familiar toy during medical appointments because it provides comfort in unfamiliar surroundings.
ex.zh: 幼兒就診時可能會緊抱熟悉的玩具，因為它能在陌生環境中帶來安慰。

col: clasp someone's hand｜緊握某人的手
clasp your hands together｜雙手緊握
words.tip: clasp作動詞強調握緊；作名詞也可指首飾搭扣。

tr: n. 拖, 拖繩, 拖輪
vt. 拖, 拉, 牽引
def: n. the act of hauling something (as a vehicle) by means of a hitch or rope
v. drag behind
To pull a vehicle or boat using another vehicle.

ex.en: A truck towed our broken car to the garage.
ex.zh: 一輛卡車把我們出故障的汽車拖到了修理廠。

ex.en: Local authorities may tow illegally parked vehicles to keep emergency access routes clear in crowded urban areas.
ex.zh: 地方當局可能會拖走違停車輛，以保持擁擠城區的應急通道暢通。

col: give someone a tow｜幫某人拖車
words.tip: 強調車輛或船隻牽引；tow away常指拖走違停車輛。

def: n. sudden reddening of the face (as from embarrassment or guilt or shame or modesty)
v. turn red, as if in embarrassment or shame
v. become rosy or reddish

ex.en: He began to blush when everyone praised his singing.
ex.zh: 大家誇讚他的歌聲時，他開始臉紅了。

ex.en: Students who blush during presentations may benefit from supportive feedback and regular opportunities to practise speaking.
ex.zh: 演講時容易臉紅的學生可能會受益於鼓勵性的反饋和經常練習口頭表達的機會。

words.tip: 動詞通常不及物；使某人臉紅用make someone blush。

tr: vt. 覆以砂礫, 咬牙切齒地說
def: n. a hard coarse-grained siliceous sandstone
v. cover with a grit
v. clench together

ex.en: I shook the grit out of my walking boots.
ex.zh: 我把徒步靴裡的砂礫抖了出來。

ex.en: Although talent matters, students often need grit and consistent support to overcome persistent learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 雖然天賦很重要，但學生往往需要毅力和持續支持才能克服長期的學習困難。

col: grit the roads｜在道路上撒砂礫
words.tip: 砂礫和毅力義均不可數；grit不是通常意義的“研磨”。

tr: vt. 擊退, 保護, 供養
def: v. try to manage without help

tr: n. 百葉窗, 關閉物, 照相機快門, 關閉者
vt. 為...裝百葉窗, 以百葉窗遮閉
def: n. a mechanical device on a camera that opens and closes to control the time of a photographic exposure
n. a hinged blind for a window
v. close with shutters

ex.en: I closed the wooden shutters before the storm arrived.
ex.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，我關上了木製窗板。

ex.en: Photographers use a fast shutter speed to capture moving wildlife clearly without disturbing its natural behaviour.
ex.zh: 攝影師使用較快的快門速度，在不干擾野生動物自然行為的情況下清晰捕捉其動態。

words.tip: 窗板常用複數shutters；快門速度用shutter speed。

tr: a. 可疑的, 疑心的, 不明確的
[法] 懷疑的, 有疑問的, 未確的
def: s. open to doubt or suspicion
s. fraught with uncertainty or doubt
s. unsettled in mind or opinion

ex.en: I was doubtful about buying a second-hand bicycle online.
ex.zh: 我對在網上買二手自行車有些猶豫。

ex.en: It is doubtful whether expanding roads alone can solve traffic congestion in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 僅靠拓寬道路能否解決快速發展城市的交通擁堵問題，尚存疑問。

words.tip: 人作主語常用 doubtful about；也可用 doubtful whether。

def: v look down on with disdain

tr: vt. 使驚愕, 使氣餒
def: v. fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
Shock and disappointment caused by something unexpected and unpleasant.
To make someone feel shocked and disappointed.

ex.en: To my dismay, the cake collapsed in the oven.
ex.zh: 令我沮喪的是，蛋糕在烤箱裡塌了。

ex.en: Residents expressed dismay at plans to replace their local park with a large commercial development.
ex.zh: 對於將當地公園改建成大型商業項目的計劃，居民們表示震驚和失望。

col: to someone's dismay｜令某人沮喪的是
be dismayed at｜對……感到驚愕沮喪
words.tip: 名詞通常不可數；to one's dismay意為令人沮喪的是。

tr: n. 重複的話, 疊句, 副歌
vi. 節制, 避免, 剋制
def: n. the part of a song where a soloist is joined by a group of singers
v. resist doing something
To deliberately stop yourself from doing something.

ex.en: Please refrain from feeding the ducks near the bridge.
ex.zh: 請不要給橋邊的鴨子餵食。

ex.en: Visitors should refrain from touching fragile exhibits so that museums can preserve them for future generations.
ex.zh: 參觀者應避免觸碰易損展品，以便博物館將其保存下來，留給後代。

col: refrain from doing something｜避免做某事
words.tip: 動詞常用refrain from doing，語氣較正式。

tr: a. 大方的, 豐富的, 浪費的
vt. 浪費, 濫用, 慷慨給予
def: v. expend profusely; also used with abstract nouns
s. very generous
s. characterized by extravagance and profusion

ex.en: They prepared a lavish feast for the whole family.
ex.zh: 他們為全家準備了一頓豐盛的大餐。

ex.en: Critics argue that lavish spending on official ceremonies diverts public funds from essential services such as healthcare.
ex.zh: 批評者認為，在官方儀式上大肆花費會擠佔醫療等基本服務的公共資金。

col: a lavish lifestyle｜奢華的生活方式
lavish praise on someone｜大加讚揚某人
lavish attention on someone｜給予某人大量關注
words.tip: 動詞常用lavish sth on sb，表示大量給予。

def: n. large room used mainly for dancing
A large room used for formal social dancing

ex.en: Couples glided across the ballroom beneath a sparkling chandelier.
ex.zh: 一對對舞伴在閃亮的枝形吊燈下滑過舞廳。

ex.en: Restoring the historic ballroom could attract visitors while providing local residents with a valuable space for cultural events.
ex.zh: 修復這座歷史悠久的舞廳可以吸引遊客，同時為當地居民提供寶貴的文化活動場所。

words.tip: ballroom dancing 指交誼舞，不是夜店蹦迪。

tr: a. 尖的, 有尖頂的, 銳利的, 率直的, 顯然的
def: a. having a point
s. direct and obvious in meaning or reference; often unpleasant

tr: n. 旅行者, 朝聖者, 香客
def: n. someone who journeys in foreign lands
n. one of the colonists from England who sailed to America on the Mayflower and founded the colony of Plymouth in New England in 1620
n. someone who journeys to a sacred place as an act of religious devotion

tr: vt. 縮減, 剝奪, 簡略
def: v place restrictions on
v terminate or abbreviate before its intended or proper end or its full extent

tr: n. 聯邦, 聯合, 聯盟
[法] 聯邦, 聯盟, 聯邦政府
def: n. an organization formed by merging several groups or parties
n. the act of constituting a political unity out of a number of separate states or colonies or provinces so that each member retains the management of its internal affairs

tr: n. 食籃, 阻礙物, 食盒
vt. 阻礙, 使困累, 妨礙, 牽制
def: n. a basket usually with a cover
v. prevent the progress or free movement of
to make progress or an activity more difficult

ex.en: Heavy rain hampered our efforts to repair the fence.
ex.zh: 大雨妨礙了我們修理圍欄。

ex.en: Limited access to reliable internet services can hamper economic development in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 可靠互聯網服務的缺乏可能阻礙偏遠農村社區的經濟發展。

words.tip: 動詞後直接接賓語；名詞還可指食品籃或洗衣籃。

tr: n. 素食者, 食草動物
def: n. eater of fruits and grains and nuts; someone who eats no meat or fish or (often) any animal products
A person who does not eat meat or fish.
Containing no meat or fish, or following this diet.

ex.en: My sister became a vegetarian after learning to cook.
ex.zh: 我姐姐學會做飯後成了一名素食者。

ex.en: Providing vegetarian meals in school canteens can accommodate different dietary preferences and reduce environmental impacts.
ex.zh: 學校食堂提供素食可以滿足不同的飲食偏好，並減少對環境的影響。

words.tip: vegetarian不吃肉和魚；vegan還不吃蛋奶等動物產品。

def: n. a ceremonial dinner party for many people
n. a meal that is well prepared and greatly enjoyed

tr: a. 現象的, 能知覺的, 異常的, 顯著的, 驚人的
def: a. of or relating to a phenomenon
s. exceedingly or unbelievably great

tr: n. 平衡, 平靜, 均衡
def: n. a stable situation in which forces cancel one another
n. a sensory system located in structures of the inner ear that registers the orientation of the head
A stable state in which opposing forces or influences balance.

ex.en: The hanging mobile regained equilibrium when I moved one ornament.
ex.zh: 我移動了一個飾物後，懸掛的裝飾架恢復了平衡。

ex.en: Removing a major predator can disturb the equilibrium of an ecosystem and cause unexpected changes in animal populations.
ex.zh: 移除主要捕食者可能破壞生態系統的平衡，並導致動物種群出現意想不到的變化。

words.tip: 通常不可數；常用於經濟、生態或物理中的平衡。

tr: a. 令人難忘的, 壯麗的, 威風的
def: v compel to behave in a certain way
v impose something unpleasant
v impose and collect

tr: [醫] 火山石(一種順勢療法藥)
def: n. rock that in its molten form (as magma) issues from volcanos; lava is what magma is called when it reaches the surface

tr: [醫] 叢, 酒香, 末梢分極
def: n. an arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present
n. a pleasingly sweet olfactory property
A group of flowers arranged together, usually as a gift.

ex.en: She brought a bright bouquet to her grandmother's birthday dinner.
ex.zh: 她帶著一束鮮豔的花來參加祖母的生日晚餐。

ex.en: Choosing a bouquet of locally grown flowers can reduce the environmental impact associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 選擇一束本地種植的鮮花，可以減少長途運輸帶來的環境影響。

col: a bouquet of flowers｜一束鮮花
a bouquet of roses｜一束玫瑰
words.tip: 末尾t不發音；一束花用a bouquet of flowers。

tr: vi. 牛拉貨車, 艱苦跋涉
n. 牛車旅行, 艱苦跋涉
def: n. a journey by ox wagon (especially an organized migration by a group of settlers)
n. any long and difficult trip
v. journey on foot, especially in the mountains

ex.en: Our trek through the forest ended beside a waterfall.
ex.zh: 我們穿越森林的徒步旅程在一處瀑布旁結束。

ex.en: Visitors who trek through remote mountain regions can support local economies by hiring guides and purchasing local supplies.
ex.zh: 在偏遠山區徒步的遊客可以通過僱用嚮導和購買當地物資來支持當地經濟。

col: a mountain trek｜山地徒步旅行
trek through the forest｜徒步穿越森林
go on a trek｜去長途徒步
words.tip: 現代常指艱苦徒步；trekked、trekking要雙寫k。

tr: n. 火爐, 熔爐, 考驗
def: n. an enclosed chamber in which heat is produced to heat buildings, destroy refuse, smelt or refine ores, etc.
An enclosed structure producing intense heat for industrial processes.
A device that heats air or water to warm a building.

ex.en: We watched molten metal pour from the glowing furnace.
ex.zh: 我們看著熔化的金屬從熾熱的熔爐中傾瀉而出。

ex.en: Replacing an inefficient furnace can reduce household energy consumption and lower heating costs during winter.
ex.zh: 更換低效的暖氣爐可以減少家庭能源消耗，並降低冬季取暖費用。

words.tip: 工業語境指熔爐；美式家居語境常指暖氣爐。

tr: n. 色素, 色質, 顏料
def: n. dry coloring material (especially a powder to be mixed with a liquid to produce paint, etc.)
n. any substance whose presence in plant or animal tissues produces a characteristic color
v. acquire pigment; become colored or imbued
n. a subtle difference in meaning or opinion or attitude
a small difference in meaning, feeling, sound, or appearance

ex.en: Her smile added a playful nuance to the apology.
ex.zh: 她的微笑讓這句道歉多了一絲俏皮意味。

ex.en: Language learners need cultural knowledge to recognise nuances that dictionaries may not fully explain.
ex.zh: 語言學習者需要文化知識，才能辨別詞典可能無法充分解釋的細微差別。

col: nuances of meaning｜意義上的細微差別
capture the nuances｜捕捉細微差別
words.tip: 常用複數nuances，指意義、語氣等細微差別。

tr: vt. 根除, 撲滅, 根絕, 消滅
def: v kill in large numbers
v destroy completely, as if down to the roots
To completely remove or destroy something harmful.

ex.en: We removed every root to eradicate weeds from the garden.
ex.zh: 我們清除了每一處草根，以徹底除去花園裡的雜草。

ex.en: International vaccination programmes aim to eradicate infectious diseases by ensuring that vulnerable populations receive adequate protection.
ex.zh: 國際疫苗接種計劃旨在確保易感人群得到充分保護，從而根除傳染病。

words.tip: 強調徹底消除，語氣強於reduce，常用於疾病或貧困。

tr: [計] 增加; 增量; 添加
def: v. enlarge or increase
v. grow or intensify
To increase something by adding to it.

ex.en: She sells homemade jam to augment her income.
ex.zh: 她出售自制果醬來增加收入。

ex.en: Digital resources can augment classroom teaching, but they should not replace meaningful interaction between teachers and students.
ex.zh: 數字資源能增強課堂教學效果，但不應取代師生之間有意義的互動。

col: augment existing resources｜補充現有資源
words.tip: 較正式，通常作及物動詞，強調通過添加來增加。

tr: a. 動人的, 令人同情的
def: n the event of something coming in contact with the body
n the act of putting two things together with no space between them
v make physical contact with, come in contact with

ex.en: Her touching farewell brought tears to my eyes.
ex.zh: 她感人的道別讓我熱淚盈眶。

ex.en: The documentary offers a touching account of volunteers helping older residents overcome loneliness in urban communities.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片動人地講述了志願者幫助城市社區的老年居民克服孤獨的故事。

words.tip: touching形容事情感人；touched形容人受到感動。

tr: n. 保衛, 保護措施, 防護設施
def: v. make safe
v. escort safely
To protect someone or something from harm or loss.

ex.en: These padded covers safeguard the furniture during the move.
ex.zh: 這些加厚護套在搬家時保護傢俱。

ex.en: Governments should introduce stronger regulations to safeguard personal information collected by online services and mobile applications.
ex.zh: 政府應出臺更嚴格的法規，保護在線服務和移動應用收集的個人信息。

col: safeguard personal information｜保護個人信息
a safeguard against fraud｜防範欺詐的措施
words.tip: 動詞常接權益等賓語；名詞常接against表示防範對象。

def: n. an infective disease caused by sporozoan parasites that are transmitted through the bite of an infected Anopheles mosquito; marked by paroxysms of chills and fever

tr: a. 不充分的, 不足的
vt. 減少, 吝嗇, 限制, 藐視, 忽略
def: v. limit in quality or quantity
barely enough, or less than is needed

ex.en: We had scant time to pack before the taxi arrived.
ex.zh: 出租車到達前，我們幾乎沒時間收拾行李。

ex.en: There is scant evidence that longer working hours consistently lead to higher productivity across different industries.
ex.zh: 幾乎沒有證據表明，延長工時能在不同行業中持續帶來更高的生產率。

col: scant regard for｜對……幾乎不重視
words.tip: 強調少到不夠，多用於名詞前，如scant evidence。

tr: v. 賭博, 孤注一擲
def: n. money that is risked for possible monetary gain
n. a risky act or venture
v. take a risk in the hope of a favorable outcome

ex.en: He refuses to gamble because he values his savings.
ex.zh: 他珍惜自己的積蓄，因此拒絕賭博。

ex.en: Relying entirely on tourism is a gamble for regions vulnerable to extreme weather and changing travel patterns.
ex.zh: 對容易受極端天氣和旅遊趨勢變化影響的地區而言，完全依賴旅遊業是一種冒險。

words.tip: gamble on後接所押注或冒險指望的事物。

tr: a. 強烈的, 寒冷而乾燥的, 活潑的
生意興隆的；交易活躍的
def: v. become brisk
s. very active
Quick and energetic.

ex.en: A brisk walk before breakfast always wakes me up.
ex.zh: 早餐前快步走一走，總能讓我清醒起來。

ex.en: Regular brisk walking can improve cardiovascular health without requiring expensive equipment or access to specialist facilities.
ex.zh: 經常快步走能改善心血管健康，無需昂貴的器材或專業設施。

words.tip: brisk walk指輕快有力的快走，不是跑步。

tr: n. 慷慨, 寬大, 禮物
