def: n. payment or reward (especially from a government) for acts such as catching criminals or killing predatory animals or enlisting in the military
n. generosity evidenced by a willingness to give freely
n. a ship of the British navy; in 1789 part of the crew mutinied against their commander William Bligh and set him afloat in an open boat

tr: a. 權威性的, 官方的, 命令式的
[法] 官方的, 當局的, 權威的
def: s. having authority or ascendancy or influence
s. of recognized authority or excellence
s. sanctioned by established authority

ex.en: This gardening guide offers authoritative advice on growing vegetables.
ex.zh: 這本園藝指南提供了種植蔬菜的權威建議。

ex.en: Students should consult authoritative sources when evaluating health claims shared widely through social media platforms.
ex.zh: 學生評估社交媒體平臺上廣泛傳播的健康說法時，應查閱權威資料。

words.tip: 勿混authoritarian：後者指專制的。

def: n. a scientific instrument consisting of displays and an input device that an operator can use to monitor and control a system (especially a computer system)
n. an ornamental scroll-shaped bracket (especially one used to support a wall fixture)
To comfort someone who feels sad or disappointed.

ex.en: Lena tried to console her brother after his team lost.
ex.zh: 弟弟的球隊輸了比賽後，莉娜試著安慰他。

ex.en: Teachers should console disappointed students while helping them develop practical strategies for improving their academic performance.
ex.zh: 教師應安慰失落的學生，同時幫助他們制定切實可行的策略來提高學習成績。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞重音在前，英音/ˈkɒnsəʊl/。

tr: a. 嚴肅的, 鄭重的, 莊嚴的
def: s dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises
s characterized by a firm and humorless belief in the validity of your opinions

tr: n. 舉, 拋, 起伏, 鼓起
vt. 用力舉起, 使舉起, 使鼓起
vi. 拋出, 起伏, 喘息, 凸起
def: n. an upward movement (especially a rhythmical rising and falling)
n. (geology) a horizontal dislocation
n. the act of lifting something with great effort
n. lack of attention and due care
n. willful lack of care and attention
To ignore something or treat it as unimportant.

ex.en: Please disregard my earlier message; the picnic is still happening.
ex.zh: 請忽略我之前的消息，野餐仍會照常舉行。

ex.en: Companies that disregard environmental regulations may reduce short-term costs but create lasting damage to local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 無視環保法規的企業可能降低短期成本，卻會對當地生態系統造成持久損害。

col: complete disregard for｜對……的完全漠視
disregard for safety｜對安全的漠視
words.tip: 動詞直接接賓語；名詞常用disregard for。

tr: vt. 帶獵犬狩獵, 追捕, 激勵, 使追逐
def: n. any of several breeds of dog used for hunting typically having large drooping ears
v. pursue or chase relentlessly
A dog bred to hunt using smell or sight.

ex.en: The hound followed a scent through the wet grass.
ex.zh: 那隻獵犬循著氣味穿過溼漉漉的草地。

ex.en: Journalists should not hound people for interviews, particularly when those individuals have clearly requested privacy.
ex.zh: 記者不應為了採訪而糾纏他人，尤其是在對方已明確要求保護隱私的情況下。

col: a pack of hounds｜一群獵犬
hound someone for answers｜追著某人要答案
hound someone out of office｜逼迫某人離職
words.tip: 作動詞強調反覆糾纏，不只是普通的追趕。

tr: n. 代理, 代理人, 委託書
[經] 代理人, 代表權, 授權書
def: n. a person authorized to act for another
n. a power of attorney document given by shareholders of a corporation authorizing a specific vote on their behalf at a corporate meeting
someone authorised to act or vote for another person

ex.en: My sister acted as my proxy at the meeting.
ex.zh: 我姐姐作為我的代理人參加了會議。

ex.en: Researchers sometimes use household income as a proxy for living standards, although it provides an incomplete picture.
ex.zh: 研究人員有時用家庭收入作為生活水平的替代指標，儘管它無法反映全貌。

col: vote by proxy｜委託代理人投票
act as a proxy｜擔任代理人
words.tip: by proxy指通過代理人；a proxy for可指替代指標。

tr: n. 恐懼, 可怕的人(或事)
a. 可怕的, 可怖的
def: n fearful expectation or anticipation
v be afraid or scared of; be frightened of
s causing fear or dread or terror

ex.en: I dread driving on icy roads after dark.
ex.zh: 我很害怕天黑後在結冰的道路上開車。

ex.en: Many employees dread losing their jobs when new technologies begin to replace familiar tasks in the workplace.
ex.zh: 當新技術開始取代工作中的常規任務時，許多員工擔心失去工作。

col: fill someone with dread｜使某人充滿恐懼
words.tip: 表示害怕做某事通常用 dread doing。

tr: a. 異常的, 單一的
def: n. the form of a word that is used to denote a singleton
s. being a single and separate person or thing
a. composed of one member, set, or kind

tr: n. 線圈, 盤繞, 騷動, 卷
def: n. a structure consisting of something wound in a continuous series of loops
n. a round shape formed by a series of concentric circles (as formed by leaves or flower petals)
n. a transformer that supplies high voltage to spark plugs in a gasoline engine

ex.en: Please coil the rope before putting it away.
ex.zh: 請先把繩子盤好再收起來。

ex.en: Engineers coil long pipes beneath buildings so that heat can be transferred efficiently from the ground.
ex.zh: 工程師在建築物下方盤繞長管道，以便高效地傳遞地下熱量。

col: coil a rope｜把繩子盤起來
a coil of wire｜一卷金屬絲
words.tip: 作動詞可及物或不及物，強調繞成圈或螺旋。

tr: a. 被俘的, 被迷住的
def: n. an animal that is confined
n. a person held in the grip of a strong emotion or passion
s. being in captivity

ex.en: The captive bird spread its wings inside the cage.
ex.zh: 那隻被關著的鳥在籠子裡展開了翅膀。

ex.en: Breeding captive animals can support conservation, but protecting their natural habitats remains essential for long-term survival.
ex.zh: 繁育圈養動物有助於物種保護，但保護其自然棲息地對長期生存仍至關重要。

col: a captive audience｜無法隨意離場的聽眾
words.tip: captive audience指無法隨意離開的聽眾，非著迷者。

tr: a. 明顯的, 公然的, 蓄意的
def: a. open and observable; not secret or hidden

tr: a. 拳曲的, 捲毛的, 彎曲的
def: a. (of hair) having curls or waves
forming curls or curved shapes, especially when describing hair

ex.en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
ex.zh: 她跑上樓時，一頭捲髮隨著步伐上下彈動。

ex.en: Advertising should represent people with diverse appearances, including those with curly hair and different skin tones.
ex.zh: 廣告應展現外貌各異的人，包括捲髮者和不同膚色的人。

words.tip: curly捲曲程度明顯；wavy通常指輕柔的波浪狀。

tr: n. 副本, 複本, 複製品
a. 複製的, 二重的
def: n. a copy that corresponds to an original exactly
v. make or do or perform again
v. make a duplicate or duplicates of

ex.en: I keep a duplicate of the key at home.
ex.zh: 我在家裡留了一把備用鑰匙。

ex.en: Research teams should share their findings to avoid duplicating work and wasting limited public funding.
ex.zh: 研究團隊應共享研究成果，以免重複勞動並浪費有限的公共資金。

words.tip: 名詞、形容詞結尾讀/kət/；動詞讀/keɪt/。

tr: n. 細菌, 種子, 生殖細胞, 根源
[醫] 芽胞, 胚, 胚芽, 病菌
def: n. a small apparently simple structure (as a fertilized egg) from which new tissue can develop into a complete organism

tr: a. 歇斯底里的, 異常興奮的
[醫] 癔病的, 歇斯底里的
def: s. marked by excessive or uncontrollable emotion

tr: vt. 贖回, 挽回, 恢復, 償還, 補償
[經] 履行(契約), 買回, 贖回
def: v. restore the honor or worth of
v. to turn in (vouchers or coupons) and receive something in exchange
v. pay off (loans or promissory notes)

ex.en: You can redeem this voucher for a free lunch.
ex.zh: 你可以用這張代金券兌換一份免費午餐。

ex.en: Retailers increasingly allow customers to redeem loyalty points for products made from recycled materials.
ex.zh: 越來越多的零售商允許顧客用會員積分兌換再生材料製成的產品。

words.tip: redeem A for B 表示用券或積分A兌換B。

tr: n. 漂亮, 別緻的款式
a. 漂亮的, 別緻的
def: n. elegance by virtue of being fashionable
s. elegant and stylish

tr: vi. 伸開手足躺, 爬行, 蔓生, 蔓延
vt. 懶散地伸開, 使蔓生, 使不規則地伸展
n. 伸開手足躺臥姿勢
def: n. an ungainly posture with arms and legs spread about
v. sit or lie with one's limbs spread out
v. go, come, or spread in a rambling or irregular way

ex.en: After the hike, we sprawled on the soft grass.
ex.zh: 徒步結束後，我們四肢舒展地躺在柔軟的草地上。

ex.en: Urban sprawl can increase dependence on private cars and put pressure on surrounding farmland.
ex.zh: 城市無序擴張會增加對私家車的依賴，並給周邊農田帶來壓力。

col: sprawl on the sofa｜攤躺在沙發上
a sprawling city｜向外蔓延的城市
words.tip: 人作主語常指攤坐或攤躺；urban sprawl指城市擴張。

tr: n. 夥伴關係, 共同參與, 團體, 獎學金, 友誼
[經] 合夥關係, 研究員薪金, 研究員基金
研究獎助金；研究員職位
def: n. money granted (by a university or foundation or other agency) for advanced study or research
Funding or a position supporting advanced study or research.
Friendship and support among people with shared interests.

ex.en: My sister won a fellowship to study marine life.
ex.zh: 我姐姐獲得了一項研究海洋生物的獎助金。

ex.en: A research fellowship can enable early-career scientists to investigate environmental problems without facing immediate financial pressure.
ex.zh: 研究獎助金能讓職業生涯初期的科學家研究環境問題，而不必面臨眼前的經濟壓力。

col: research fellowship｜研究獎助金或職位
award a fellowship｜授予研究獎助金
a sense of fellowship｜夥伴情誼
words.tip: 獎助金義通常可數；夥伴情誼義通常不可數。

tr: n. 溢值, 超值, 氾濫
def: n. the occurrence of surplus liquid (as water) exceeding the limit or capacity
v. flow or run over (a limit or brim)
To flow over the edge because a container is too full.

ex.en: The bath overflowed while I was answering the door.
ex.zh: 我去應門時，浴缸裡的水溢了出來。

ex.en: During heavy rainfall, urban drains may overflow and carry polluted water into nearby rivers.
ex.zh: 暴雨期間，城市排水管道可能滿溢，將汙水帶入附近河流。

words.tip: 動詞重音在末音節，名詞重音在首音節。

def: s. very unpleasant

tr: n. 首長, 最高當局
a. 最重要的, 最高的, 至上的
def: s having superior power and influence
more important than anything else

ex.en: Safety is paramount when we take children swimming.
ex.zh: 我們帶孩子游泳時，安全是頭等大事。

ex.en: Protecting patient privacy should be paramount when healthcare providers introduce digital systems for storing medical records.
ex.zh: 醫療服務提供者引入數字化病歷存儲系統時，應將保護患者隱私放在首位。

words.tip: 常用be paramount或of paramount importance。

tr: n. 海綿, 海綿狀的東西
vt. 用海綿擦拭, 吸收掉, 抹掉
vi. 採集海綿, 海綿般吸收
def: n. a porous mass of interlacing fibers that forms the internal skeleton of various marine animals and usable to absorb water or any porous rubber or cellulose product similarly used
n. primitive multicellular marine animal whose porous body is supported by a fibrous skeletal framework; usually occurs in sessile colonies
v. wipe with a sponge, so as to clean or moisten

ex.en: Use a damp sponge to wipe the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 用溼海綿擦一下廚房的桌子。

ex.en: Urban wetlands act like a sponge, absorbing excess rainwater and reducing the risk of flooding.
ex.zh: 城市溼地就像海綿，能吸收多餘的雨水，降低洪澇風險。

col: squeeze out a sponge｜擠幹海綿
sponge something down｜用溼海綿擦洗某物
words.tip: 比喻吸收能力強時，常用like a sponge。

tr: n. 硬紙盒, 紙板箱
def: n. the quantity contained in a carton
n. a box made of cardboard; opens by flaps on top
A container made of cardboard, often used for food or drinks.

ex.en: Please put the milk carton back in the fridge.
ex.zh: 請把牛奶盒放回冰箱。

ex.en: Local recycling schemes should explain how residents can dispose of each type of food carton correctly.
ex.zh: 當地回收項目應說明居民如何正確處理各種食品紙盒。

col: a carton of milk｜一盒牛奶
words.tip: a carton of milk是一盒奶；勿與cartoon混淆。

def: n. a treatise advancing a new point of view resulting from research; usually a requirement for an advanced academic degree
A long research paper written as part of a university degree

ex.en: My sister is writing her dissertation at the library.
ex.zh: 我姐姐正在圖書館寫學位論文。

ex.en: Writing a dissertation requires students to evaluate existing research and develop a clear argument supported by evidence.
ex.zh: 撰寫學位論文要求學生評估已有研究，並提出有證據支持的清晰論點。

col: write a dissertation｜撰寫學位論文
submit a dissertation｜提交學位論文
a dissertation on education｜關於教育的學位論文
words.tip: 主題用on引出；美式常指博士論文，英式範圍較廣。

tr: a. 不透明的, 不傳熱的, 不傳導的, 陰暗的
def: a. not transmitting or reflecting light or radiant energy; impenetrable to sight
s. not clearly understood or expressed

tr: n. 反胃, 暈船, 噁心, 厭惡
def: n. the state that precedes vomiting
n. disgust so strong it makes you feel sick
n. something that is a source of danger
n. a threat or the act of threatening
v. express a threat either by an utterance or a gesture

tr: vi. 支吾, 蹣跚地走
n. 顫抖, 支吾, 躊躇
def: v. be unsure or weak
v. move hesitatingly, as if about to give way

tr: n. 大驚小怪, 小題大作, 忙亂
vi. 無事自擾, 焦急, 焦燥, 忙亂
vt. 使激動, 使煩燥
def: n. an angry disturbance
v. worry unnecessarily or excessively
unnecessary excitement, worry, or activity about something

ex.en: Please don't make a fuss about a little mud.
ex.zh: 只是一點泥巴，別大驚小怪。

ex.en: Some parents fuss over minor mistakes, which may discourage children from trying unfamiliar activities.
ex.zh: 有些家長對小錯誤過分操心，這可能使孩子不敢嘗試陌生的活動。

col: fuss over someone｜對某人過分關照
words.tip: make a fuss指大驚小怪；fuss over指過分操心。

tr: n. 典獄官, 漁獵法監督官, 看守人
[法] 看守人, 監護人, 管理員
def: n. the chief official in charge of a prison
someone responsible for supervising or protecting a place
the person in charge of a prison, especially in America

ex.en: The park warden helped us find the campsite.
ex.zh: 公園管理員幫我們找到了露營地。

ex.en: A wildlife warden can help protect endangered species by monitoring habitats and guiding visitors away from sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 野生動物保護區管理員可以通過監測棲息地、引導遊客遠離生態敏感區來幫助保護瀕危物種。

words.tip: 美式prison warden指監獄長，不是普通獄警。

tr: vt. 使丟臉, 使蒙羞, 屈辱
def: v. cause to feel shame; hurt the pride of
to make someone feel deeply ashamed or foolish

ex.en: Please don't humiliate me in front of my friends.
ex.zh: 請別讓我在朋友面前丟臉。

ex.en: Teachers should correct mistakes constructively rather than humiliate students who struggle with difficult tasks.
ex.zh: 教師應以建設性的方式糾正錯誤，而不是羞辱那些難以完成複雜任務的學生。

col: humiliate someone publicly｜公開羞辱某人
words.tip: 比embarrass語氣更重，強調受辱和尊嚴受損。

tr: a. 多邊的, 多國的
[經] 多邊的, 涉及多方的
def: a. having many parts or sides

tr: a. 熄滅的, 滅絕的, 耗盡的
[法] 消滅了的, 過時的, 無效的
def: a. no longer in existence; lost or especially having died out leaving no living representatives
a. (of e.g. volcanos) permanently inactive
s. being out or having grown cold

ex.en: My little cousin asked why dinosaurs became extinct.
ex.zh: 我的小表弟問恐龍為什麼滅絕了。

ex.en: Without stronger habitat protection, many endangered species could become extinct within the next few decades.
ex.zh: 如果不加強棲息地保護，許多瀕危物種可能在未來幾十年內滅絕。

words.tip: extinct指已滅絕；endangered指瀕危，尚未滅絕。

tr: n. 動力, 推動力, 動量
[醫] 衝動, 動能, 起始(病)
def: n a force that moves something along
n the act of applying force suddenly

tr: a. 單方面的, 單邊的, 片面的
def: a. involving only one part or side
s. tracing descent from either the paternal or the maternal line only

tr: n. 教化, 培養, 耕作
def: n. socialization through training and education to develop one's mind or manners
n. (agriculture) production of food by preparing the land to grow crops (especially on a large scale)
n. the process of fostering the growth of something

tr: n. 腸, 內臟, 內部
def: n the part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus

tr: a. 顯著的, 顯眼的, 出眾的
def: a. obvious to the eye or mind
easy to notice because of being unusual or different

ex.en: Her yellow umbrella was conspicuous among the black ones.
ex.zh: 在一片黑色雨傘中，她的黃色雨傘格外顯眼。

ex.en: Conspicuous consumption can encourage unnecessary spending as people seek to display their wealth through expensive possessions.
ex.zh: 炫耀性消費可能助長不必要的開支，因為人們試圖通過昂貴物品展示財富。

col: conspicuous by its absence｜因缺失而格外引人注意
words.tip: 強調容易被注意到，不一定表示重要。

tr: a. 無情的, 殘忍的, 毫不留情的, 徹底的
def: s without mercy or pity
Determined to succeed without caring about harm caused to others.

ex.en: The ruthless landlord evicted the family without any warning.
ex.zh: 那個冷酷無情的房東毫無預警地趕走了這家人。

ex.en: Ruthless competition may encourage companies to cut labour costs at the expense of employee welfare.
ex.zh: 殘酷的競爭可能促使企業以犧牲員工福利為代價來削減用工成本。

col: a ruthless leader｜冷酷無情的領導者
words.tip: 比strict更強，強調為達目的而不顧他人感受或利益。

tr: n. 被剝奪法律保護的人, 罪犯
vt. 使...失去法律保護, 將...逐出社會, 宣告非法, 取締
def: v. declare illegal; outlaw
to make an activity illegal
a criminal who lives outside the law

ex.en: The new rules outlaw dumping rubbish beside the river.
ex.zh: 新規定禁止在河邊傾倒垃圾。

ex.en: Governments should outlaw the sale of products made from endangered species to discourage illegal hunting.
ex.zh: 政府應禁止銷售用瀕危物種製成的產品，以遏制非法捕獵。

col: outlaw a practice｜禁止某種做法
outlaw discrimination｜宣佈歧視行為非法
a notorious outlaw｜臭名昭著的逃犯
words.tip: 作動詞時直接接被禁止的行為或事物。

tr: vt. 使跛, 使成殘廢, 削弱
def: n. someone who is unable to walk normally because of an injury or disability to the legs or back
v. deprive of strength or efficiency; make useless or worthless
v. deprive of the use of a limb, especially a leg

ex.en: The power cut crippled our heating system all evening.
ex.zh: 停電讓我們的供暖系統癱瘓了整整一個晚上。

ex.en: A prolonged drought can cripple agricultural production, reducing rural incomes and increasing food prices across the country.
ex.zh: 長期乾旱可能重創農業生產，降低農村收入，並推高全國食品價格。

words.tip: 名詞指人有冒犯性；動詞常指經濟或系統受重創。

tr: n. 動搖, 躊躇, 揮動者
vi. 搖擺, 顫抖, 擺動, 搖曳, 猶豫
def: n. someone who communicates by waving
n. the act of moving back and forth
v. sway to and fro

tr: n. 半徑, 範圍, 輻射光線
def: n. the length of a line segment between the center and circumference of a circle or sphere
n. a straight line from the center to the perimeter of a circle (or from the center to the surface of a sphere)
n. a circular region whose area is indicated by the length of its radius
v. expel from a community or group
v. ban from a place of residence, as for punishment
v. expel, as if by official decree

tr: n. 預言, 預言能力
def: n. knowledge of the future (usually said to be obtained from a divine source)
n. a prediction uttered under divine inspiration
a statement about the future, often claiming supernatural knowledge

ex.en: In the story, an ancient prophecy finally came true.
ex.zh: 故事中，一個古老的預言終於應驗了。

ex.en: Low expectations can become a self-fulfilling prophecy when students receive less encouragement and fewer opportunities to improve.
ex.zh: 當學生得到的鼓勵和進步機會更少時，低期望可能成為自我實現的預言。

col: a self-fulfilling prophecy｜自我實現的預言
the gift of prophecy｜預言天賦
words.tip: prophecy是名詞；動詞prophesy詞尾讀/saɪ/。

tr: vt. 使同化, 吸收, 使相擬, 把...比作
vi. 被吸收, 被同化
def: v. become similar to one's environment
v. make similar
v. take (gas, light or heat) into a solution

ex.en: I need time to assimilate everything we learned today.
ex.zh: 我需要時間消化今天所學的所有內容。

ex.en: Students assimilate new information more effectively when teachers connect unfamiliar concepts with examples from everyday life.
ex.zh: 教師將陌生概念與日常生活中的例子聯繫起來時，學生能更有效地吸收新知識。

words.tip: 知識可直接作賓語；融入群體常用into。

tr: n. 升高, 起重機, 推動
v. 升起, 升高, 舉起
def: n. lifting device for raising heavy or cumbersome objects
v. raise or haul up with or as if with mechanical help
v. move from one place to another by lifting

ex.en: We hoisted the heavy suitcase onto the luggage rack.
ex.zh: 我們把沉重的行李箱抬上了行李架。

ex.en: Construction workers use specialised equipment to hoist heavy materials safely, reducing physical strain and workplace injuries.
ex.zh: 建築工人使用專用設備安全吊起重物，以減輕身體負擔並減少工傷。

words.tip: 強調費力抬起或藉助繩索、機械吊起。

tr: n. 纏結, 糾結的一團, 困惑, 糾紛, 混亂
vi. 纏結, 亂作一團
def: n. a twisted and tangled mass that is highly interwoven
n. something jumbled or confused
A twisted mass of threads, hair, or similar things

ex.en: My headphones were buried in a tangle of cables.
ex.zh: 我的耳機埋在一團纏結的線纜裡。

ex.en: Small businesses often face a tangle of regulations that makes expansion costly and time-consuming.
ex.zh: 小企業常面臨錯綜複雜的法規，使業務擴張既費錢又費時。

col: a tangle of wires｜纏成一團的電線
a tangle of regulations｜錯綜複雜的法規
words.tip: a tangle of既可指實物纏結，也可指複雜困局。

def: s. having a sharply uneven surface or outline

tr: vt. 延長, 拖延, 拖長
def: v. lengthen in time; cause to be or last longer
v. lengthen or extend in duration or space

tr: vt. 放棄, 撤回, 停止, 鬆開, 讓與
[法] 讓與, 把...交給, 放棄
def: v part with a possession or right
v do without or cease to hold or adhere to
v turn away from; give up

ex.en: She reluctantly relinquished her seat beside the window.
ex.zh: 她不情願地讓出了靠窗的座位。

ex.en: National governments may be reluctant to relinquish control over energy policy to international organisations.
ex.zh: 各國政府可能不願將能源政策的控制權交給國際組織。

col: relinquish a claim｜放棄權利主張
words.tip: 正式及物動詞，直接接control、power、rights等。

def: v take the first step or steps in carrying out an action
v set in motion, cause to start
v get off the ground

ex.en: The evening concert will commence after a short welcome.
ex.zh: 簡短的歡迎致辭後，晚間音樂會將開始。

ex.en: Construction of the new railway will commence once the environmental assessment has been completed.
ex.zh: 環境評估完成後，新鐵路的建設將啟動。

words.tip: 比start正式；可接名詞或動名詞。

tr: n. 理解, 憂懼, 逮捕
def: n. fearful expectation or anticipation
n. painful expectation
n. the act of apprehending (especially apprehending a criminal)

ex.en: She felt some apprehension before her first driving lesson.
ex.zh: 上第一節駕駛課之前，她有些忐忑。

ex.en: Public apprehension about new technologies may decrease when governments explain potential risks and introduce clear safety standards.
ex.zh: 當政府解釋潛在風險並制定明確的安全標準時，公眾對新技術的憂慮可能會減輕。

words.tip: 常指對未來的擔憂，常接about；逮捕義較正式。

tr: vt. 使麻痺, 使癱瘓, 使無力, 使氣餒, 終止
def: v make powerless and unable to function
v cause to be paralyzed and immobile
to cause someone to lose the ability to move

ex.en: The injury paralysed his legs, but his arms remained strong.
ex.zh: 這次受傷使他的雙腿癱瘓，但他的雙臂仍然有力。

ex.en: Severe flooding can paralyse urban transport systems, preventing essential workers from reaching hospitals and other services.
ex.zh: 嚴重洪災可能使城市交通系統癱瘓，導致關鍵崗位人員無法到達醫院和其他服務機構。

col: be paralysed by fear｜嚇得動彈不得
be partially paralysed｜部分身體癱瘓
words.tip: 英式拼寫為paralyse，美式為paralyze。

tr: vt. 推翻, 無視, 對...有最後發言權, 制服, 踐踏, 奔越過
[經] 代理佣金, 代銷佣金
def: n. a manually operated device to correct the operation of an automatic device
v. prevail over
v. counteract the normal operation of (an automatic gear shift in a vehicle)

tr: n. 刻痕, 等級, 峽谷
vt. 刻凹痕, 用刻痕計算, 贏得
def: n. a V-shaped indentation
n. a V-shaped or U-shaped indentation carved or scratched into a surface
n. a small cut

tr: a. 注意的, 留心的
def: a. (often followed by `to') giving care or attention
listening or watching carefully
taking care to notice and meet someone's needs

ex.en: The children were attentive as their grandmother explained the game.
ex.zh: 祖母講解遊戲規則時，孩子們聽得很專心。

ex.en: Teachers who are attentive to individual learning needs can help students participate more confidently in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 關注個體學習需求的教師能幫助學生更自信地參與課堂討論。

words.tip: attentive to後接關注的對象；也可形容服務周到。

tr: vi. 毀滅, 喪生, 凋謝, 頹喪, 死亡, 腐爛
vt. 毀壞, 使麻木, 使喪生, 耗盡
def: v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
To die or be destroyed, especially in harsh conditions.
To decay or lose strength and flexibility over time.

ex.en: These delicate plants will perish if left outside tonight.
ex.zh: 這些嬌嫩的植物如果今晚放在外面，就會凍死。

ex.en: Without effective habitat protection, many vulnerable species may perish as temperatures rise and food sources disappear.
ex.zh: 如果沒有有效的棲息地保護，隨著氣溫上升和食物來源消失，許多脆弱物種可能滅絕。

col: perish in a fire｜在火災中喪生
words.tip: 通常是不及物動詞；英式英語也用於橡膠等老化。

tr: n. 附近, 鄰近, 附近地區, 近處
[法] 附近, 鄰近, 附近地區
def: n. a surrounding or nearby region
The area near a particular place.

ex.en: There are several quiet cafés in the vicinity.
ex.zh: 附近有幾家安靜的咖啡館。

ex.en: Building new housing in the vicinity of railway stations can reduce car dependence and shorten daily commutes.
ex.zh: 在火車站周邊新建住房，可以減少對汽車的依賴並縮短日常通勤時間。

words.tip: 常用in the vicinity of，比near更正式。

def: n. a song of devotion or loyalty (as to a nation or school)
A song expressing loyalty to a country or group
A religious song sung by a choir

ex.en: The crowd stood proudly as the national anthem began.
ex.zh: 國歌響起時，人群自豪地站了起來。

ex.en: Singing a national anthem at international sporting events can strengthen a shared sense of identity.
ex.zh: 在國際體育賽事上唱國歌可以增強共同的身份認同感。

col: the national anthem plays｜國歌奏響
words.tip: national anthem指國歌；宗教語境中可指合唱讚美詩。

tr: n. 虛榮心, 虛無, 自負, 空虛, 時髦的小擺飾
def: n. the quality of being valueless or futile

tr: a. 柔軟的, 無力的, 軟弱的
def: v. walk impeded by some physical limitation or injury
v. proceed slowly or with difficulty
s. not firm

ex.en: I had to limp home after twisting my ankle.
ex.zh: 扭傷腳踝後，我只好一瘸一拐地走回家。

ex.en: Athletes who continue to limp after an injury should receive professional assessment before returning to competitive sport.
ex.zh: 受傷後仍然跛行的運動員應先接受專業評估，再重返競技運動。

col: walk with a limp｜一瘸一拐地走
words.tip: 作動詞指跛行；作形容詞指無力或軟塌塌。

tr: a. 旅行的, 旅行用的, 移動的
def: n the act of going from one place to another
v change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically
v undertake a journey or trip
v. lessen the strength or flavor of a solution or mixture
To make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid.
To reduce the strength, quality, or influence of something.

ex.en: Dilute the juice with water before giving it to children.
ex.zh: 給孩子喝果汁前，先加水稀釋。

ex.en: Excessive commercial involvement may dilute the educational value of programmes designed for young television viewers.
ex.zh: 過多的商業介入可能削弱面向青少年觀眾的電視節目的教育價值。

words.tip: dilute A with B表示用液體B稀釋A。

def: n. a cloth pad or dressing (with or without medication) applied firmly to some part of the body (to relieve discomfort or reduce fever)
v. make more compact by or as if by pressing
v. squeeze or press together

ex.en: She compressed the blankets into a small storage bag.
ex.zh: 她把毯子壓緊，裝進了一個小收納袋。

ex.en: Digital tools can compress large files, allowing students with limited internet access to download educational materials more easily.
ex.zh: 數字工具可以壓縮大文件，讓網絡條件有限的學生更方便地下載學習資料。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞“敷布”重音在前。

tr: a. 不免一死的, 人類的, 臨終的
def: a. subject to death
s. unrelenting and deadly
unable to live forever

ex.en: Even the strongest heroes in this story are mortal.
ex.zh: 這個故事裡，即使最強大的英雄也終有一死。

ex.en: Recognising that we are mortal can encourage healthier habits and a greater appreciation of everyday life.
ex.zh: 認識到生命終有盡頭，可以促使我們養成更健康的習慣，更加珍惜日常生活。

words.tip: mortal指凡人；死亡率用mortality，不用mortal。

tr: vi. 上升, 追溯, 登高
def: v. travel up, "We ascended the mountain"
v. go back in order of genealogical succession
v. become king or queen

ex.en: We watched the balloon ascend slowly into the clear sky.
ex.zh: 我們看著氣球緩緩升上晴朗的天空。

ex.en: As hikers ascend the mountain, they encounter distinct vegetation zones shaped by changing temperatures and moisture levels.
ex.zh: 徒步者登山時，會遇到由溫度和溼度變化形成的不同植被帶。

col: ascend to the summit｜登上頂峰
words.tip: 較正式；ascend the stairs中不加up。

tr: n. 免稅者, 被免除義務者
def: v. grant relief or an exemption from a rule or requirement to
a. (of persons) freed from or not subject to an obligation or liability (as e.g. taxes) to which others or other things are subject
Not required to follow a rule or fulfil an obligation.

ex.en: Children under five are exempt from the entrance fee.
ex.zh: 五歲以下兒童免門票。

ex.en: Governments could exempt small businesses from certain taxes to encourage investment and support local employment.
ex.zh: 政府可以免除小企業的某些稅款，以鼓勵投資並支持當地就業。

words.tip: 固定搭配：be exempt from；exempt sb from。

tr: [化] 紫外線的; 紫外線
def: n. radiation lying in the ultraviolet range; wave lengths shorter than light but longer than X rays
s. having or employing wavelengths shorter than light but longer than X-rays; lying outside the visible spectrum at its violet end
Describing invisible radiation with wavelengths shorter than visible violet light.

ex.en: These sunglasses protect your eyes from harmful ultraviolet rays.
ex.zh: 這副太陽鏡能保護眼睛免受有害紫外線的傷害。

ex.en: Excessive exposure to ultraviolet radiation increases the risk of skin damage, making sun protection essential.
ex.zh: 過度暴露於紫外線輻射會增加皮膚受損的風險，因此防曬至關重要。

words.tip: 常縮寫為UV；紫外線本身肉眼不可見。

def: v. branch out in a twiglike manner
a small, thin branch of a tree or bush
to suddenly understand or notice something

ex.en: A sparrow carried a twig back to its nest.
ex.zh: 一隻麻雀銜著一根細枝飛回了巢裡。

ex.en: Leaving fallen twigs on forest floors provides shelter for insects and supports the natural recycling of nutrients.
ex.zh: 將掉落的細枝留在林地上能為昆蟲提供庇護，並促進養分的自然循環。

words.tip: 動詞義為英式非正式用法；過去式twigged。

tr: n. 盛會, 遊行, 虛飾, 露天表演
def: n. an elaborate representation of scenes from history etc; usually involves a parade with rich costumes
n. a rich and spectacular ceremony

tr: vi. 跟著發生, 繼起
def: v issue or terminate (in a specified way, state, etc.); end
To happen after something, often as its result.

ex.en: A lively discussion ensued after dinner at our house.
ex.zh: 晚飯後，我們家展開了一場熱烈的討論。

ex.en: If public services fail to meet growing demand, widespread dissatisfaction may ensue among local residents.
ex.zh: 如果公共服務無法滿足不斷增長的需求，當地居民可能隨之產生普遍的不滿。

col: a debate ensues｜隨後展開辯論
words.tip: 正式用語，不及物；不表示“追求”。

def: n. violent and needless disturbance

tr: 會說兩種語言的；雙語的
熟練使用兩種語言的人
def: n. a person who speaks two languages fluently
s. using or knowing two languages
Able to use two languages, or involving two languages.

ex.en: Our bilingual neighbour speaks both English and Chinese fluently.
ex.zh: 我們的鄰居精通雙語，英語和中文都說得很流利。

ex.en: Bilingual education can help children maintain their cultural identity while developing skills for an increasingly connected world.
ex.zh: 雙語教育有助於孩子保持文化認同，同時培養適應日益互聯世界所需的技能。

words.tip: 表示精通哪兩種語言，可用bilingual in A and B。

tr: v. (巧妙地)逃脫, 規避, 逃避
def: v. practice evasion
v. use cunning or deceit to escape or avoid

tr: [法] 推論, 推理, 推斷
def: n. the reasoning involved in drawing a conclusion or making a logical judgment on the basis of circumstantial evidence and prior conclusions rather than on the basis of direct observation
A conclusion reached from evidence rather than direct statements.

ex.en: Her muddy boots supported my inference about her morning walk.
ex.zh: 她沾滿泥的靴子印證了我關於她早晨散過步的推斷。

ex.en: Researchers should avoid drawing a firm inference from a small sample without considering alternative explanations.
ex.zh: 研究人員應避免在未考慮其他解釋的情況下，根據小樣本作出確定的推斷。

col: inference from evidence｜基於證據的推斷
words.tip: 常用draw an inference from，指根據證據推斷。

def: n. a thief who steals from someone by threatening violence

tr: n. 君主政體, 君主國, 君主政治
[法] 君主政體, 君主制度, 君主國
def: n. an autocracy governed by a monarch who usually inherits the authority

tr: n. 新陳代謝, 變態
def: n. the organic processes (in a cell or organism) that are necessary for life

tr: vt. 放大, 擴大, 讚美, 誇大
def: v. increase in size, volume or significance
To make something appear larger, especially through a lens.
To make something seem more important or become more serious.

ex.en: This lens magnifies tiny insects so we can examine them.
ex.zh: 這個鏡頭能放大小昆蟲，方便我們觀察。

ex.en: Social media can magnify public concerns by repeatedly exposing users to dramatic accounts of rare events.
ex.zh: 社交媒體反覆向用戶展示對罕見事件的誇張描述，可能放大公眾的擔憂。

words.tip: 既可指視覺放大，也可指誇大問題或加劇影響。

tr: [法] 查明, 弄清, 確定
def: v. learn or discover with certainty
n. the area of a theater or concert hall where the audience sits
a large room or building for an audience
the part of a theatre where the audience sits

ex.en: Families filled the auditorium for the school concert.
ex.zh: 家長們坐滿了禮堂，觀看學校音樂會。

ex.en: A modern auditorium allows the university to host public lectures and strengthen links with the local community.
ex.zh: 現代化的禮堂讓大學能夠舉辦公開講座，並加強與當地社區的聯繫。

words.tip: 可指整座禮堂，也可專指劇院的觀眾席。

def: v. turn from a straight course, fixed direction, or line of interest
v. turn aside and away from an initial or intended course

tr: [法] 挑戰, 藐視, 違抗
def: n. intentionally contemptuous behavior or attitude
n. a hostile challenge
n. a defiant act

tr: a. 發光的, 明亮的
def: s softly bright or radiant

tr: n. 修剪, 剪下的東西, 大剪刀, 切變, 剪切機, 切
vt. 修剪, 割, 剝奪, 橫越, 削剪
vi. 剪, 修剪, 剪羊毛, 切斷
def: n. (physics) a deformation of an object in which parallel planes remain parallel but are shifted in a direction parallel to themselves
n. a large edge tool that cuts sheet metal by passing a blade through it
v. cut with shears

tr: vt. 增強, 放大, 擴大, 詳述
def: v. increase the volume of
to make a sound or electrical signal stronger
to increase the strength or effect of something

ex.en: This small speaker amplifies music from my phone.
ex.zh: 這個小音箱把我手機播放的音樂放大了。

ex.en: Social media can amplify public concerns about pollution, encouraging local authorities to respond more quickly.
ex.zh: 社交媒體能夠放大公眾對汙染的擔憂，促使地方政府更迅速地回應。

words.tip: 既可放大實際聲音，也可增強影響或情緒。

tr: a. 高的, 傲慢的, 崇高的, 高級的, 玄虛的
def: s of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
s of imposing height; especially standing out above others
s having or displaying great dignity or nobility

ex.en: She has lofty ambitions but works hard every day.
ex.zh: 她志向遠大，同時每天都在努力。

ex.en: Governments often announce lofty goals for reducing inequality, but meaningful progress requires sustained investment and practical policies.
ex.zh: 政府常常宣佈減少不平等的宏大目標，但實質性進展需要持續投入和切實可行的政策。

words.tip: 修飾理想時可表讚許，也可暗示目標過高、不切實際。

tr: n. 門廳, 入門大堂
def: n a large entrance or reception room or area

tr: n. 臭氣, 煙, 激怒
def: v. be mad, angry, or furious
v. emit a cloud of fine particles
To feel or express strong anger.

ex.en: He fumed when muddy shoes stained his clean carpet.
ex.zh: 泥鞋弄髒了他乾淨的地毯，他氣壞了。

ex.en: Exposure to exhaust fumes can worsen respiratory conditions, particularly among children living near busy roads.
ex.zh: 接觸汽車尾氣可能加重呼吸系統疾病，尤其會影響住在繁忙道路附近的兒童。

col: fume over something｜為某事大發脾氣
words.tip: 表示煙氣通常用複數fumes；動詞常指十分惱怒。

tr: n. 正當理由, 授權, 擔保, 保證, 根據
[經] 保單, 擔保書, 保證書
def: n a written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications
A written promise to repair or replace faulty goods within conditions.

ex.en: The shop repaired my camera because it was under warranty.
ex.zh: 因為相機還在保修期內，商店為我修好了它。

ex.en: A longer warranty may encourage consumers to choose durable appliances rather than cheaper products that require frequent replacement.
ex.zh: 更長的保修期可能促使消費者選擇耐用電器，而不是需要頻繁更換的廉價產品。

col: a manufacturer's warranty｜製造商保修承諾
words.tip: 在保修期內用under warranty，不用in warranty。

tr: a. 地球的, 陸生的, 陸地的, 人間的
def: a. operating or living or growing on land
living on or relating to land rather than water
relating to Earth rather than other planets

ex.en: Unlike fish, terrestrial animals spend their lives on land.
ex.zh: 與魚類不同，陸生動物在陸地上生活。

ex.en: Protecting terrestrial habitats is essential because many species cannot survive outside their original ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保護陸地棲息地至關重要，因為許多物種離開原有生態系統就無法生存。

words.tip: 陸生義與aquatic（水生的）相對。

tr: vt. 瀰漫, 滲透, 充滿, 影響, 感染
def: v. spread or diffuse through
Spread throughout a place, group, or situation.
Pass into or through the tiny spaces in a material.

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread permeated the entire house.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味瀰漫了整棟房子。

ex.en: Digital technology now permeates almost every aspect of education, changing how students access information and collaborate with others.
ex.zh: 數字技術如今滲透到教育的幾乎各個方面，改變了學生獲取信息和與他人合作的方式。

col: permeate every aspect of｜滲透……的各個方面
words.tip: 可直接接賓語；氣味瀰漫房間無需加介詞。

tr: a. 海的, 海上的, 海事的, 沿海的, 海員的
[經] 海事的, 海上的, 海員的
def: s. bordering on or living or characteristic of those near the sea

tr: n. 課稅, 徵稅, 抽稅, 稅款, 估定的稅額
[經] 徵稅, 納稅, 稅制
def: n. the imposition of taxes; the practice of the government in levying taxes on the subjects of a state
The system or process of collecting money through taxes.

ex.en: Taxation helps pay for our local schools and roads.
ex.zh: 稅收為我們當地的學校和道路提供資金。

ex.en: Progressive taxation can reduce income inequality by requiring wealthier citizens to contribute a larger proportion of their earnings.
ex.zh: 累進稅制要求較富裕的公民繳納更高比例的收入，有助於縮小收入差距。

words.tip: taxation通常不可數，側重徵稅制度或過程。

def: v. inform
Give someone knowledge of or familiarity with something.

ex.en: Please acquaint yourself with the kitchen before you start cooking.
ex.zh: 開始做飯前，請先熟悉一下廚房。

ex.en: Universities should acquaint new students with available support services to help them adjust to campus life.
ex.zh: 大學應讓新生了解可用的支持服務，幫助他們適應校園生活。

words.tip: 較正式，常用acquaint sb/oneself with sth。

def: v. cause great unhappiness for; distress
v. cause physical pain or suffering in
Cause someone or something serious suffering or difficulty

ex.en: Seasonal allergies afflict my brother whenever the flowers bloom.
ex.zh: 每到鮮花盛開時，季節性過敏就讓我的哥哥備受困擾。

ex.en: Water shortages continue to afflict rural communities, limiting agricultural production and increasing the burden on local families.
ex.zh: 缺水問題持續困擾農村社區，限制農業生產，並加重當地家庭的負擔。

words.tip: 常用被動be afflicted with，後接疾病或困境。

def: n. vegetation (such as young shoots, twigs, and leaves) that is suitable for animals to eat
n. reading superficially or at random
n. the act of feeding by continual nibbling
n. a district of a city marked by poverty and inferior living conditions
v. spend time at a lower socio-economic level than one's own, motivated by curiosity or desire for adventure; usage considered condescending and insensitive
a poor urban area with overcrowded housing in bad condition

ex.en: Their family shared a small room in a crowded slum.
ex.zh: 他們一家擠住在擁擠貧民窟裡的一間小屋中。

ex.en: Improving sanitation and access to clean water can significantly reduce disease in densely populated slums.
ex.zh: 改善衛生設施和清潔水源的獲取條件，可以顯著減少人口密集的貧民窟中的疾病。

words.tip: 指居住條件差的城區，不等於所有低收入社區。

tr: n. 越過, 橫貫, 橫斷物, 屏障, 否認, 反駁
vt. 橫過, 穿過, 經過, 詳細研究, 反對, 在...來回移動
vi. 橫越, 橫斷, 旋轉, 來回移動
a. 橫亙的, 橫貫的
def: v. travel across or pass over
v. deny formally (an allegation of fact by the opposing party) in a legal suit
To travel across or through an area.

ex.en: We traversed the snowy valley before reaching the mountain hut.
ex.zh: 我們穿過積雪覆蓋的山谷，才到達山間小屋。

ex.en: New railway routes traverse remote regions, connecting isolated communities with essential services and larger markets.
ex.zh: 新鐵路線路穿越偏遠地區，讓孤立的社區能夠獲得基本服務並進入更大的市場。

col: traverse rough terrain｜穿越崎嶇地形
words.tip: 正式用詞，直接接地點賓語：traverse the desert。

tr: n. 溫度計, 體溫計
def: n. measuring instrument for measuring temperature
An instrument used to measure temperature.

ex.en: She placed the thermometer gently under her son's tongue.
ex.zh: 她輕輕地把體溫計放在兒子的舌下。

ex.en: Accurate thermometers help researchers monitor temperature changes in natural habitats affected by global warming.
ex.zh: 精確的溫度計幫助研究人員監測受全球變暖影響的自然棲息地的溫度變化。

col: read a thermometer｜讀取溫度計示數
words.tip: 重音在第二音節；測體溫常用take someone's temperature。

def: n lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
n a communication that indicates lack of respect by patronizing the recipient
v look down on with disdain

tr: vi. 振動, 顫動, 激動, 搖擺, 躊躇
vt. 使顫動, 使振動, 使擺動
def: v. shake, quiver, or throb; move back and forth rapidly, usually in an uncontrolled manner
To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.

ex.en: My phone vibrated against the keys in my pocket.
ex.zh: 手機在口袋裡振動，碰得鑰匙直響。

ex.en: Heavy traffic can cause nearby buildings to vibrate, affecting residents' comfort and potentially damaging older structures.
ex.zh: 繁忙的交通會使附近建築物振動，影響居民的舒適度，並可能損壞老舊建築。

words.tip: 指快速、小幅度振動，不等於大幅搖擺。

tr: a. 有限的, 有窮的, 限定的
def: a. bounded or limited in magnitude or spatial or temporal extent
a. of verbs; relating to forms of the verb that are limited in time by a tense and (usually) show agreement with number and person
Having a limit in size, amount, or duration

ex.en: Our holiday budget is finite, so choose carefully.
ex.zh: 我們的度假預算有限，所以要仔細選擇。

ex.en: Governments must recognise that natural resources are finite and encourage industries to reduce unnecessary consumption.
ex.zh: 政府必須認識到自然資源是有限的，並鼓勵各行業減少不必要的消耗。

words.tip: 讀音重音在首音節；勿按finish的元音讀。

tr: vt. 給予, 傳授, 告知
def: v. transmit (knowledge or skills)
v. transmit or serve as the medium for transmission
To communicate knowledge, information, or skills to someone

ex.en: My grandmother loves to impart her gardening knowledge.
ex.zh: 我奶奶很喜歡傳授她的園藝知識。

ex.en: Schools should impart practical skills that enable young people to manage their finances independently.
ex.zh: 學校應傳授實用技能，使年輕人能夠獨立管理個人財務。

words.tip: 常用impart sth to sb，意為把某事傳授給某人。

def: n. rescue equipment consisting of a device that fills with air and retards your fall
Equipment that slows a fall through the air
To jump or drop something from aircraft using a parachute

ex.en: Her parachute opened smoothly above the green fields.
ex.zh: 她的降落傘在綠色田野上空順利張開。

ex.en: Rescue teams used parachutes to deliver essential supplies to villages isolated by severe flooding.
ex.zh: 救援隊利用降落傘向被嚴重洪災隔絕的村莊投送必需物資。

words.tip: 作動詞時，既可指人跳傘，也可指空投物資。

def: n. distance measured in miles
n. the ratio of the number of miles traveled to the number of gallons of gasoline burned
n. a travel allowance at a given rate per mile traveled

ex.en: This used car has surprisingly low mileage for its age.
ex.zh: 這輛二手車以它的車齡來說，行駛里程少得令人意外。

ex.en: Vehicles with better fuel mileage can lower household transport costs and reduce demand for fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 燃油行駛效率更高的車輛可以降低家庭交通開支，並減少對化石燃料的需求。

col: get mileage out of｜從……中獲益
words.tip: low mileage指跑得少；good mileage通常指省油。

tr: n. 信任狀, 國書, 文件, 身份證明, 證書
[法] 信用證, 國書, 證書
def: n a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts
n a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts

tr: vt. 逐出, 罷黜, 剝奪, 驅逐
[法] 驅逐, 剝奪, 免職
def: v. remove from a position or office
v. remove and replace
To force someone out of a position or place.

ex.en: Club members voted to oust their unpopular chair.
ex.zh: 俱樂部成員投票罷免了不受歡迎的主席。

ex.en: Shareholders may seek to oust company directors who repeatedly fail to meet environmental commitments or financial targets.
ex.zh: 股東可能尋求罷免那些屢次未能履行環保承諾或實現財務目標的公司董事。

col: oust someone from office｜將某人趕下臺
be ousted as chair｜被罷免主席職務
words.tip: 常用oust someone from office，強調被迫離職。

tr: n. 分割, 隔離物, 隔牆, 財產分割
vt. 區分, 瓜分, 隔開, 分割
def: n. a vertical structure that divides or separates (as a wall divides one room from another)
n. (computer science) the part of a hard disk that is dedicated to a particular operating system or application and accessed as a single unit
n. (anatomy) a structure that separates areas in an organism

ex.en: A wooden partition separates our kitchen from the dining area.
ex.zh: 一道木隔板將我們的廚房與用餐區隔開。

ex.en: Movable partitions allow schools to adapt classroom spaces for group discussions, independent study, and larger community events.
ex.zh: 可移動隔牆讓學校能夠調整教室空間，以滿足小組討論、自主學習和較大型社區活動的需要。

col: the partition of a country｜國家的分治
words.tip: partition off指隔出空間，如隔出一間辦公室。

tr: vt. 毀壞, 破壞, 粉碎
def: v. destroy completely
v. defeat soundly
To completely destroy a building or other structure.

ex.en: Workers demolished the old garage behind our house.
ex.zh: 工人拆除了我們房子後面的舊車庫。

ex.en: Cities should consider restoring historic buildings rather than demolishing them to make space for new developments.
ex.zh: 城市應考慮修復歷史建築，而不是將其拆除以騰出空間進行新開發。

col: demolish an argument｜徹底駁倒論點
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語；也可指徹底駁倒論點。

tr: n. 船岸之間的水區, 錨地, 臥鋪
def: n. a bed on a ship or train; usually in tiers
v. provide with a berth

tr: n. 髓, 骨髓, 精華, 活力, 配偶
def: n. the fatty network of connective tissue that fills the cavities of bones
n. any of various squash plants grown for their elongated fruit with smooth dark green skin and whitish flesh
n. very tender and very nutritious tissue from marrowbones

tr: n. 一針, 疼痛, 針法, 碎布條, 針腳
v. 縫, 縫合, 裝訂
def: n. a link or loop or knot made by an implement in knitting, crocheting, embroidery, or sewing
n. a sharp spasm of pain in the side resulting from running
a loop of thread holding fabric or a wound together

ex.en: A few neat stitches fixed the hole in my sleeve.
ex.zh: 整齊地縫上幾針，我袖子上的破洞就補好了。

ex.en: Teaching students to stitch torn clothing could reduce textile waste and encourage more sustainable consumption habits.
ex.zh: 教學生縫補破損衣物可以減少紡織品浪費，並鼓勵更可持續的消費習慣。

words.tip: get a stitch指運動時岔氣，不是“縫一針”。

def: v. be a sign or indication of
v. have as a meaning
To represent or indicate something.

ex.en: On this map, blue lines denote rivers and streams.
ex.zh: 在這張地圖上，藍色線條表示河流和溪流。

ex.en: In scientific diagrams, different colours often denote distinct materials, allowing readers to interpret complex structures more easily.
ex.zh: 在科學示意圖中，不同顏色通常代表不同材料，便於讀者理解複雜結構。

col: denote a category｜表示一個類別
words.tip: 常用於符號、顏色或詞語表示某種含義。

tr: a. 各種各樣的, 分類的
def: s. consisting of a haphazard assortment of different kinds
s. of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity
n. the rate at which energy is drawn from a source that produces a flow of electricity in a circuit; expressed in volts
v. feel grief
v. cause to feel sorrow
To feel deep sadness, especially after someone's death

ex.en: We still grieve for our cat, who died last spring.
ex.zh: 我們仍在為去年春天去世的貓難過。

ex.en: Employers should offer compassionate leave so that workers have time to grieve after losing a family member.
ex.zh: 僱主應提供喪假，讓員工在失去家人後有時間哀悼。

col: grieve over a loss｜為失去而悲傷
words.tip: grieve for常接逝者；grieve over常接損失或不幸。

tr: n. 標題, 起始字, 方向
def: n. a line of text serving to indicate what the passage below it is about
words introducing the subject of a document or section
the direction in which a ship or aircraft travels

ex.en: Write a clear heading at the top of your page.
ex.zh: 在頁面頂部寫一個清晰的標題。

ex.en: Clear headings help readers locate relevant information quickly, making lengthy academic reports easier to navigate and understand.
ex.zh: 清晰的小標題幫助讀者快速找到相關信息，讓長篇學術報告更便於查閱和理解。

words.tip: heading常指章節標題；headline多指新聞標題。

tr: n. 馬具, 挽具狀帶子, 甲冑
vt. 給...上挽具, 駕馭, 披上甲冑, 利用...以產生動力
def: n. a support consisting of an arrangement of straps for holding something to the body (especially one supporting a person suspended from a parachute)
n. stable gear consisting of an arrangement of leather straps fitted to a draft animal so that it can be attached to and pull a cart
v. put a harness

tr: vt. 散失, 驅散, 浪費
def: v. live a life of pleasure, especially with respect to alcoholic consumption
To gradually disappear or cause something to spread and disappear.
To waste money, energy, or resources through careless use.

ex.en: The morning mist began to dissipate as sunlight warmed the valley.
ex.zh: 陽光溫暖了山谷，晨霧開始消散。

ex.en: Urban green spaces help dissipate heat, reducing the discomfort caused by high temperatures in densely populated areas.
ex.zh: 城市綠地有助於散熱，減輕人口密集地區高溫帶來的不適。

words.tip: 可及物也可不及物：霧自行消散或風使霧消散。

tr: a. 下級的, 次要的, 附屬的
vt. 使居下位, 使服從
def: n. an assistant subject to the authority or control of another
v. rank or order as less important or consider of less value
v. make subordinate, dependent, or subservient

ex.en: She accepted a subordinate role on the project.
ex.zh: 她接受了在這個項目中擔任輔助角色。

ex.en: In effective organisations, subordinate staff should feel comfortable raising concerns with senior managers without fear.
ex.zh: 在運作良好的組織中，下級員工應能放心地向高級管理人員提出疑慮。

words.tip: 表示“從屬於”用subordinate to，不用than。

def: n. something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings
v. swell or protrude outwards
v. bulge out; form a bulge outward, or be so full as to appear to bulge
n. any compound of oxygen with another element or a radical
A compound consisting of oxygen and another chemical element.

ex.en: This sunscreen contains zinc oxide to protect your skin.
ex.zh: 這款防曬霜含有氧化鋅，可以保護皮膚。

ex.en: Nitrogen oxides released by vehicle engines contribute to air pollution and can damage human health.
ex.zh: 汽車發動機排放的氮氧化物會造成空氣汙染，並可能損害人體健康。

words.tip: oxide為氧化物統稱，dioxide指二氧化物。

tr: n. 採石場, 方形石, 獵物, 被追求物, 來源
vt. 挖出, 努力挖掘
def: v. extract (something such as stones) from or as if from a quarry
A large open pit where stone is dug from the ground.
To dig stone out of the ground.

ex.en: Huge trucks carried pale stone out of the quarry.
ex.zh: 巨型卡車把淺色石料運出了採石場。

ex.en: Restoring an abandoned quarry can create valuable wildlife habitats while reducing risks to nearby communities.
ex.zh: 修復廢棄採石場可以創造寶貴的野生動物棲息地，同時降低周邊社區面臨的風險。

words.tip: 採石場義可數；獵物義常用單數形式。

tr: a. 淫穢的, 猥褻的, 討人厭的, 可憎的
[法] 猥褻的, 海洋的, 汙穢的
多得離譜的；令人憤慨的
def: s. designed to incite to indecency or lust
offensively sexual in a way considered unacceptable
so excessive or unfair that it causes moral outrage

ex.en: The moderator removed an obscene comment from the chat.
ex.zh: 管理員從聊天中刪除了一條淫穢評論。

ex.en: Critics argue that obscene executive bonuses are difficult to justify when ordinary workers face wage cuts.
ex.zh: 批評者認為，普通工人面臨降薪時，高管高得離譜的獎金難以合理解釋。

col: an obscene amount of money｜多得離譜的一筆錢
words.tip: 比rude語氣強；也可批評金錢或數量多得離譜。

tr: a. 狂暴的, 騷亂的, 紊亂的
def: s characterized by unrest or disorder or insubordination
s (of a liquid) agitated vigorously; in a state of turbulence
Full of conflict, uncertainty, or sudden disruptive changes.

ex.en: After a turbulent week, our family needed a quiet evening.
ex.zh: 經歷了動盪的一週後，我們一家需要一個安靜的夜晚。

ex.en: During turbulent economic periods, governments may increase public spending to protect jobs and support vulnerable households.
ex.zh: 在經濟動盪時期，政府可能增加公共支出，以保障就業並支持脆弱家庭。

words.tip: 既形容社會局勢動盪，也形容水流或氣流紊亂。

def: n. any animal or plant material used to fertilize land especially animal excreta usually with litter material
v. spread manure, as for fertilization
Animal waste used to improve soil and help plants grow.

ex.en: The farmer spread manure around the young apple trees.
ex.zh: 農民在幼小的蘋果樹周圍撒上糞肥。

ex.en: Using manure can improve soil fertility, but excessive application may pollute nearby rivers and groundwater.
ex.zh: 施用糞肥可以提高土壤肥力，但過量施用可能汙染附近河流和地下水。

words.tip: 名詞通常不可數；fertilizer泛指肥料，範圍更廣。

tr: vt. 使惡化, 使更嚴重, 加重
def: v make worse
v exasperate or irritate

tr: n. 斗篷, 罩子, 披風
def: n. the cloak as a symbol of authority
n. United States baseball player (1931-1997)
n. the layer of the earth between the crust and the core

ex.en: A mantle of snow covered the garden overnight.
ex.zh: 一夜之間，花園披上了一層白雪。

ex.en: Younger researchers must take on the mantle of leadership as experienced scientists retire from their positions.
ex.zh: 隨著資深科學家退休，年輕研究人員必須承擔起領導職責。

col: a mantle of snow｜一層積雪
assume the mantle of｜承擔……的職責
words.tip: mantle也可指披風；壁爐架通常拼作mantel。

tr: n. 流出, 漲潮, 變遷
def: n. the rate of flow of energy or particles across a given surface
n. a flow or discharge
n. a substance added to molten metals to bond with impurities that can then be readily removed

tr: a. 抑沉的, 憂悶的, 黑暗的, 悲觀的
def: s. filled with melancholy and despondency
prep. Alt. of Amid
Surrounded by something, or during a particular situation

ex.en: We found a quiet bench amidst the flowering trees.
ex.zh: 我們在開花的樹叢中找到了一張安靜的長椅。

ex.en: Amidst growing concerns about air quality, several cities have expanded their networks of protected cycle lanes.
ex.zh: 隨著人們日益擔憂空氣質量，一些城市擴大了設有隔離設施的自行車道網絡。

col: amidst uncertainty｜在不確定的局勢中
amidst growing concerns｜在日益加劇的擔憂中
words.tip: 與amid同義，語氣較正式；後接名詞或名詞短語。

tr: a. 不連續的, 離散的
def: s. constituting a separate entity or part
Separate and distinct rather than joined or continuous.

ex.en: We divided the project into three discrete tasks.
ex.zh: 我們把這個項目分成了三項獨立的任務。

ex.en: Researchers classified participants into discrete groups to compare the effects of different teaching methods.
ex.zh: 研究人員將參與者分成不同的組，以比較不同教學方法的效果。

words.tip: 勿混 discreet（謹慎的）；兩詞讀音相同。

tr: n. 附件, 圍牆, 圍繞
def: n. a structure consisting of an area that has been enclosed for some purpose
n. the act of enclosing something inside something else
n. a naturally enclosed space

ex.en: The goats rested in their enclosure beside the barn.
ex.zh: 山羊在穀倉旁的圍欄裡休息。

ex.en: Wildlife parks should provide each enclosure with enough space for animals to display natural behaviour.
ex.zh: 野生動物園應為每個圍場提供足夠空間，讓動物展現自然行為。

words.tip: 紙質信函附件可用enclosure；郵件附件用attachment。

tr: vt. 妨礙, 干擾, 調戲
[法] 調戲, 作弄, 惡意干涉
def: v. harass or assault sexually; make indecent advances to
To subject someone to unwanted sexual touching or behaviour.
To bother or attack someone, especially in older usage.

ex.en: The club bans anyone who tries to molest guests.
ex.zh: 這傢俱樂部禁止任何企圖猥褻賓客的人進入。

ex.en: Public transport authorities should provide clear reporting procedures for passengers targeted by individuals who molest others.
ex.zh: 公共交通管理部門應為遭到猥褻的乘客提供明確的舉報流程。

words.tip: 現代英語多指性猥褻，勿用於普通的打擾。

tr: a. 指示的, 象徵的, 表示...的
def: a. relating to the mood of verbs that is used simple in declarative statements
s. (usually followed by `of') pointing out or revealing clearly
Showing that something exists or is likely to be true.

ex.en: These dark clouds are indicative of an approaching storm.
ex.zh: 這些烏雲預示著暴風雨即將到來。

ex.en: Rising demand for public transport may be indicative of changing attitudes towards car ownership in urban areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通需求的上升可能表明，城市居民對擁有私家車的態度正在改變。

words.tip: 常用be indicative of，表示“是……的跡象”。

tr: vt. 把電視節目錄在錄像磁帶上
def: n. a video recording made on magnetic tape
n. a relatively wide magnetic tape for use in recording visual images and associated sound
v. record on videotape

ex.en: We found an old videotape of our family picnic.
ex.zh: 我們找到了一盤記錄家庭野餐的舊錄像帶。

ex.en: Libraries can preserve recordings stored on videotape by converting them into digital formats for future generations.
ex.zh: 圖書館可以將錄像帶上的影像轉成數字格式，為後代保存這些記錄。

col: an old videotape｜一盤舊錄像帶
videotape a performance｜用錄像帶錄製演出
words.tip: 指磁帶錄像；現代數字錄像通常用video或record。

tr: a. 相關的, 中肯的, 切題的
def: s. having precise or logical relevance to the matter at hand
directly related to the matter being discussed

ex.en: Lena asked a pertinent question about the repair costs.
ex.zh: 莉娜問了一個關於維修費用的切題問題。

ex.en: Evidence about local air quality is particularly pertinent to discussions of expanding public transport networks.
ex.zh: 有關當地空氣質量的證據與擴大公共交通網絡的討論尤其相關。

words.tip: 常用pertinent to表示與某事相關，語體較正式。

tr: n. 專橫, 放肆, 假定, 推測
[法] 假定, 推測, 設想
def: n. (law) an inference of the truth of a fact from other facts proved or admitted or judicially noticed
n. audacious (even arrogant) behavior that you have no right to
n. a kind of discourtesy in the form of an act of presuming

tr: vt. 捐贈, 捐助, 賦予
[法] 贈送財產給, 分給寡婦一份遺產, 授與
def: v. give qualities or abilities to
v. furnish with an endowment
give money to support an institution or position permanently

ex.en: Her family endowed a scholarship at the local college.
ex.zh: 她的家人在當地學院捐資設立了一項獎學金。

ex.en: Private donations can endow research centres that investigate long-term solutions to urgent public health problems.
ex.zh: 私人捐款可以資助研究中心，為緊迫的公共衛生問題探索長期解決方案。

col: endow a scholarship｜捐資設立獎學金
endow a chair｜捐資設立教授席位
words.tip: be endowed with常指天生具備某種才能或品質。

tr: n. 球拍, 喧鬧, 雜亂無章
def: n. a loud and disturbing noise
n. an illegal enterprise (such as extortion or fraud or drug peddling or prostitution) carried on for profit
n. a sports implement (usually consisting of a handle and an oval frame with a tightly interlaced network of strings) used to strike a ball (or shuttlecock) in various games

ex.en: I left my tennis racket beside the court.
ex.zh: 我把網球拍落在球場邊了。

ex.en: Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.
ex.zh: 提供球拍等基本器材，可以讓更多孩子參與學校體育活動。

words.tip: 球拍也可拼作racquet；喧鬧聲只用racket。

tr: n. 職業, 天命, 天職, 才能, 行業
[法] 行業, 職業, 職業上的才能
def: n the particular occupation for which you are trained
n a body of people doing the same kind of work
work you feel strongly suited or called to do

ex.en: Caring for injured animals became her vocation early in life.
ex.zh: 照顧受傷動物很早就成為她立志從事的事業。

ex.en: Career guidance should help young people discover a vocation that matches their abilities and values.
ex.zh: 職業指導應幫助年輕人找到符合自身能力和價值觀的志業。

col: find one's vocation｜找到自己的志業
a sense of vocation｜職業使命感
a vocation for teaching｜從事教學的志向
words.tip: 常含使命感或天職之意；勿與vacation（假期）混淆。

tr: a. 不新鮮的, 陳腐的, 疲憊的, 陳舊的
vi. 變陳舊, 走味, 失時效, 撒尿
def: v. urinate, of cattle and horses
a. lacking freshness, palatability, or showing deterioration from age
No longer fresh, especially when describing bread or air.

ex.en: This bread is stale, so I'll use it for breadcrumbs.
ex.zh: 這麵包不新鮮了，我就拿它做麵包屑吧。

ex.en: Teaching methods can become stale when educators lack opportunities to exchange ideas and develop new skills.
ex.zh: 如果教育工作者缺乏交流想法和培養新技能的機會，教學方法就可能變得陳舊乏味。

words.tip: stale指失去新鮮感；rotten指已腐爛。

tr: a. 公平的, 公正的
[法] 公平的, 公正的, 平衡法的
def: a. fair to all parties as dictated by reason and conscience
fair to everyone involved, taking their different circumstances into account

ex.en: We agreed on an equitable division of household chores.
ex.zh: 我們商定了公平合理的家務分工。

ex.en: An equitable funding system would direct more resources towards schools serving disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 公平合理的撥款制度會將更多資源投向服務弱勢社區的學校。

words.tip: equitable強調按情況公平，不一定是equal的均等。

tr: n. 煩躁, 磨損, 焦急, 網狀飾物
vi. 煩惱, 不滿, 磨損
vt. 使煩惱, 腐蝕, 使磨損, 使起波紋
def: n. agitation resulting from active worry
n. an ornamental pattern consisting of repeated vertical and horizontal lines (often in relief)
n. a small bar of metal across the fingerboard of a musical instrument; when the string is stopped by a finger at the metal bar it will produce a note of the desired pitch

tr: vt. 奉承, 阿諛, 使高興
def: v. praise somewhat dishonestly
Praise someone, often insincerely, to gain their favour.
Make someone feel pleased or honoured through attention or praise.

ex.en: That blue jacket really flatters you in this light.
ex.zh: 在這樣的光線下，那件藍色夾克真的很襯你。

ex.en: Advertisements often flatter consumers by suggesting that choosing a particular product demonstrates intelligence or good taste.
ex.zh: 廣告常常暗示選擇某種產品代表聰明或品位好，以此討好消費者。

col: flatter someone's ego｜滿足某人的虛榮心
words.tip: be flattered常指受寵若驚，不一定含貶義。

tr: n. 任務, 差使, 使命
def: n. a short trip that is taken in the performance of a necessary task or mission
A short trip to buy, collect, or deliver something

ex.en: I ran an errand before meeting you for lunch.
ex.zh: 和你見面吃午飯前，我出去辦了點事。

ex.en: Reliable neighbourhood transport helps older residents run errands independently and maintain regular contact with their communities.
ex.zh: 可靠的社區交通能幫助老年居民獨立外出辦事，並與社區保持日常聯繫。

col: send someone on an errand｜派某人跑腿
a quick errand｜很快能辦完的差事
words.tip: 通常指外出辦小事；常搭配run errands。

tr: n. 過失, 流逝, 失效
vi. 犯錯, 墮落, 減退, 消失, 流逝
def: n. a break or intermission in the occurrence of something
v. end, at least for a long time
v. drop to a lower level, as in one's morals or standards

ex.en: A brief lapse in concentration made me miss my stop.
ex.zh: 我一時走神，坐過了站。

ex.en: Even a minor lapse in judgment can undermine public confidence in the management of essential services.
ex.zh: 即使是輕微的判斷失誤，也可能削弱公眾對基本公共服務管理的信心。

col: a lapse in concentration｜一時走神
a lapse of judgment｜判斷失誤
let a policy lapse｜任保單到期失效
words.tip: 失誤常用a lapse in；時間間隔用a lapse of。

tr: n. 精神病學, 精神病治療
def: n. the branch of medicine dealing with the diagnosis and treatment of mental disorders
the medical study and treatment of mental illnesses

ex.en: My sister chose psychiatry after finishing her medical degree.
ex.zh: 我姐姐獲得醫學學位後選擇了精神科專業。

ex.en: Greater investment in psychiatry could improve access to specialist care for people with severe mental illnesses.
ex.zh: 增加對精神科醫療的投入，可以讓重度精神疾病患者更容易獲得專科治療。

col: a career in psychiatry｜精神科職業生涯
words.tip: 詞首p不發音；精神科醫生通常有醫學資質。

tr: n. 叛逆者, 叛國者
[法] 叛徒, 叛逆, 背信者
def: n. someone who betrays his country by committing treason

tr: n. 曳, 牽引, 牽引力
def: n. (orthopedics) the act of pulling on a bone or limb (as in a fracture) to relieve pressure or align parts in a special way during healing

tr: n. 麻痺, 停頓, 癱瘓
def: n. loss of the ability to move a body part
loss of the ability to move part or all of the body
a state in which action or progress becomes impossible

ex.en: The injury caused temporary paralysis in his left leg.
ex.zh: 這次受傷導致他的左腿暫時癱瘓。

ex.en: Political disagreements can lead to administrative paralysis, delaying essential decisions on housing and public transport.
ex.zh: 政治分歧可能導致行政停滯，延誤有關住房和公共交通的重要決策。

words.tip: 既指身體癱瘓，也可比喻機構或決策陷入停滯。

tr: n. 速度, 節奏, 進行速度, (棋的)一著
def: n. (music) the speed at which a composition is to be played
n. the rate of some repeating event
The speed at which music is played.

ex.en: The drummer increased the tempo, and everyone danced faster.
ex.zh: 鼓手加快了節奏，大家也跳得更快了。

ex.en: The tempo of urban life has accelerated as digital services make daily tasks increasingly immediate.
ex.zh: 隨著數字服務讓日常事務的處理越來越即時，城市生活節奏也加快了。

col: the tempo of life｜生活節奏
words.tip: 指音樂的快慢，不等於表示節奏型的rhythm。

tr: n. 減少, 衰微, 敗落, 虧缺, 月虧
vi. 變小, 虧缺, 衰落, 消逝, 退潮
def: v. become smaller
v. decrease in phase
gradually become weaker, smaller, or less important

ex.en: My enthusiasm waned after another hour in the queue.
ex.zh: 又排了一個小時的隊後，我的熱情消退了。

ex.en: Public support for environmental policies may wane if their financial costs are distributed unfairly.
ex.zh: 如果環保政策的經濟成本分擔不公，公眾對這些政策的支持可能會減弱。

words.tip: 動詞通常不及物；on the wane表示正在衰退。

tr: n. 柳樹, 柳木製品
a. 柳樹的, 柳木製的
def: n. any of numerous deciduous trees and shrubs of the genus Salix
n. a textile machine having a system of revolving spikes for opening and cleaning raw textile fibers

tr: a. 原始的, 土著的
n. 土著居民, 土生生物
def: a. of or pertaining to members of the indigenous people of Australia
s. having existed from the beginning; in an earliest or original stage or state
Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region

ex.en: The exhibition celebrates aboriginal cultures from several different regions.
ex.zh: 這個展覽展示並讚頌了幾個不同地區的原住民文化。

ex.en: Protecting aboriginal languages requires sustained funding and close cooperation with the communities that speak them.
ex.zh: 保護原住民語言需要持續的資金支持，並與使用這些語言的社區密切合作。

col: Aboriginal culture｜澳大利亞原住民文化
Aboriginal communities｜澳大利亞原住民社區
words.tip: 指澳大利亞原住民時首字母大寫；避免單獨作名詞稱人。

tr: n. 看門狗, 監察人
[化] 監控設備; 監視器
def: n. a guardian or defender against theft or illegal practices or waste
n. a dog trained to guard property

tr: a. 不動的, 靜止的, 不變的, 固定的, 停留的
[計] 定常, 定態, 固定的
def: s. standing still
s. not capable of being moved
Not moving or changing position.

ex.en: Our bus remained stationary while passengers climbed aboard.
ex.zh: 乘客上車時，我們的公交車一直停著沒動。

ex.en: Stationary vehicles with running engines contribute to urban air pollution without providing any transport benefit.
ex.zh: 停著卻未熄火的車輛加劇了城市空氣汙染，卻沒有發揮任何運輸作用。

words.tip: stationary指靜止的；stationery指文具，讀音相同。

tr: n. 外圍, 邊緣地區, 圓周
def: n. the outside boundary or surface of something
n. a man who is a respected leader in national or international affairs
an experienced male political leader respected for wisdom and judgement

ex.en: The retired statesman spoke calmly to the gathered crowd.
ex.zh: 這位退休的資深政治家平靜地向聚集的人群講話。

ex.en: A respected statesman can help resolve international disputes by encouraging dialogue and building trust between governments.
ex.zh: 一位受尊敬的資深政治家可以通過鼓勵對話、建立政府間信任，幫助解決國際爭端。

words.tip: 通常含褒義，不宜譯作貶義的“政客”；女性用 stateswoman。

tr: n. 興趣, 熱情, 風味, 熱心
def: v. add herbs or spices to

tr: a. 無價的, 價值無法衡量的
def: s. having incalculable monetary, intellectual, or spiritual worth
Extremely useful or valuable.

ex.en: Your advice was invaluable when I bought my first bicycle.
ex.zh: 我買第一輛自行車時，你的建議幫了大忙。

ex.en: Practical work experience provides students with invaluable insights into the skills employers expect from new graduates.
ex.zh: 實際工作經驗能幫助學生深入瞭解僱主對新畢業生技能的期望，這種瞭解十分寶貴。

col: an invaluable resource｜極有用的資源
words.tip: invaluable意為極寶貴，不是沒有價值。

tr: a. 半透明的, 透明的
def: s. allowing light to pass through diffusely
Allowing light through, but not a clear view of objects.

ex.en: Soft sunlight came through the translucent bathroom window.
ex.zh: 柔和的陽光透過浴室的半透明窗戶照進來。

ex.en: Translucent panels allow natural light into offices while maintaining privacy for people working inside.
ex.zh: 半透明板材讓自然光進入辦公室，同時保護室內工作人員的隱私。

words.tip: 與transparent不同：能透光，但看不清後面的物體。

tr: n. 試穿, 試衣, 裝配, 裝置
def: n. a small and often standardized accessory to a larger system
n. putting clothes on to see whether they fit
s. in harmony with the spirit of particular persons or occasion

ex.en: Flowers seemed a fitting gift for our gardening teacher.
ex.zh: 送鮮花給我們的園藝老師似乎很合適。

ex.en: A public library would be a fitting memorial to someone who dedicated their life to education.
ex.zh: 對於一位畢生奉獻教育的人，公共圖書館會是恰當的紀念設施。

col: a fitting tribute｜恰如其分的致敬
words.tip: 形容詞強調場合上恰當；衣服合身通常用fit。

tr: a. 不穩定的, 不安的, 危險的
def: s. affording no ease or reassurance
s. not secure; beset with difficulties
not securely positioned and likely to fall

ex.en: The ladder looked precarious on the wet, uneven ground.
ex.zh: 梯子架在溼滑不平的地面上，看起來搖搖欲墜。

ex.en: Workers on short-term contracts often face precarious financial circumstances, making it difficult to plan for the future.
ex.zh: 短期合同工往往面臨不穩定的經濟狀況，難以規劃未來。

col: a precarious position｜岌岌可危的處境
a precarious balance｜不穩固的平衡
precarious finances｜不穩定的財務狀況
words.tip: 不僅表示“不穩定”，還暗含隨時出問題的風險。

tr: n. 馬賽克, 鑲嵌細工, 鑲嵌工藝
a. 馬賽克的, 鑲嵌細工的, 拼花的
def: n. art consisting of a design made of small pieces of colored stone or glass
n. viral disease in solanaceous plants (tomatoes, potatoes, tobacco) resulting in mottling and often shriveling of the leaves
n. a freeware browser

tr: n. 雪崩, 山崩, 大量
def: n. a slide of large masses of snow and ice and mud down a mountain
n. a sudden appearance of an overwhelming number of things
v. gather into a huge mass and roll down a mountain, of snow

ex.en: The mountain road was closed after an avalanche overnight.
ex.zh: 夜裡發生雪崩後，那條山路被封閉了。

ex.en: Mountain communities need reliable warning systems to reduce the risks that avalanches pose to residents and visitors.
ex.zh: 山區社區需要可靠的預警系統，以降低雪崩對居民和遊客構成的風險。

col: an avalanche of complaints｜大量湧來的投訴
words.tip: an avalanche of後接複數或不可數名詞，表示大量湧來。

tr: a. 數字的, 數值的, 以數字表示的, 擅長於計數的
[經] 數字的, 用數字表示的
def: a. relating to or having ability to think in or work with numbers
Relating to numbers or expressed using numbers.

ex.en: Please arrange these raffle tickets in numerical order.
ex.zh: 請把這些抽獎券按號碼順序排列。

ex.en: Researchers need reliable numerical data to assess whether public transport investments have reduced traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 研究人員需要可靠的數值數據，以評估公共交通投資是否緩解了交通擁堵。

words.tip: numerical指數字相關；numerous指數量多。

tr: [經] 息票, 利息單, 聯票
def: n. a negotiable certificate that can be detached and redeemed as needed
n. a test sample of some substance
A ticket or code giving a discount or free item.

ex.en: This coupon gives us a discount on fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 用這張優惠券買新鮮蔬菜可以打折。

ex.en: Although discount coupons help households save money, they may also encourage consumers to buy unnecessary products.
ex.zh: 雖然優惠券能幫助家庭省錢，但它們也可能促使消費者購買不必要的商品。

words.tip: coupon多指折扣券；voucher也常指預付代金券。

tr: a. 偷懶的, 懶惰的, 遲鈍的
行動遲緩的；無精打采的
def: s. moving slowly
moving or responding slowly, often from lack of energy
growing or operating more slowly than expected

ex.en: I felt sluggish after eating such a large lunch.
ex.zh: 午飯吃得太多，我感覺懶洋洋的。

ex.en: Sluggish economic growth can discourage investment and limit employment opportunities for recent university graduates.
ex.zh: 經濟增長乏力會抑制投資，並限制大學應屆畢業生的就業機會。

words.tip: 既形容人沒精神，也形容經濟或系統運轉慢。

def: n. the act of groping; and instance of groping
v. feel about uncertainly or blindly
v. search blindly or uncertainly
n. a minute life form (especially a disease-causing bacterium); the term is not in technical use
A living organism too small to see without a microscope

ex.en: Some microbes help turn fresh milk into thick yoghurt.
ex.zh: 有些微生物能幫助把鮮奶變成濃稠的酸奶。

ex.en: Soil microbes play an essential role in recycling nutrients and maintaining the fertility of agricultural land.
ex.zh: 土壤微生物在養分循環和維持農田肥力方面發揮著關鍵作用。

words.tip: 不只指細菌，也不一定有害；germ常指病菌。

tr: n. 記號, 符號表示法, 註釋
def: n. a technical system of symbols used to represent special things
n. the activity of representing something by a special system of marks or characters

tr: n. 突然一陣, 趣味, 愛好
def: n. a strong current of air

tr: n. 尾部, 船尾, 臀
a. 嚴厲的, 嚴格的, 堅定的, 堅決的
def: n. the rear part of a ship
n. United States concert violinist (born in Russia in 1920)
s. severe and unremitting in making demands

ex.en: Dad gave us a stern look across the table.
ex.zh: 爸爸隔著桌子嚴厲地看了我們一眼。

ex.en: Schools should combine stern warnings about bullying with practical support for students who experience it.
ex.zh: 學校既應嚴正警告欺凌行為，也應為遭受欺凌的學生提供實際支持。

words.tip: 形容詞指態度嚴厲；作名詞指船尾，與bow相對。

tr: v. 挖空, 挖出, 鑿通
def: v. recover through digging
v. find by digging in the ground
v. form by hollowing

ex.en: Workers excavated a deep hole for our new pool.
ex.zh: 工人們為我們的新游泳池挖了一個深坑。

ex.en: Archaeologists excavate ancient settlements to discover how earlier communities adapted to environmental changes and developed farming techniques.
ex.zh: 考古學家發掘古代聚落，以瞭解早期群體如何適應環境變化並發展耕作技術。

col: excavate ancient remains｜發掘古代遺存
words.tip: excavate可用於工程挖掘，也可用於考古發掘。

tr: a. 公尺的, 公制的, 計量的
[醫] 測量的, 米制的, 公制的
def: a. based on the meter as a standard of measurement
Using measurement units such as metres, litres, and grams.
A measurement used to judge performance, quality, or progress.

ex.en: This kitchen scale uses metric units for every ingredient.
ex.zh: 這個廚房秤用公制單位稱量每種食材。

ex.en: Although income is a useful metric, it cannot fully capture a population's quality of life.
ex.zh: 儘管收入是一項有用的衡量指標，但它無法全面反映人口的生活質量。

words.tip: 形容詞指公制的；名詞指指標，常用複數。

def: n. large voracious aquatic reptile having a long snout with massive jaws and sharp teeth and a body covered with bony plates; of sluggish tropical waters
a large reptile with tough skin, long jaws and tail

ex.en: We watched a crocodile slide into the river.
ex.zh: 我們看著一條鱷魚滑入河中。

ex.en: Wetland conservation protects crocodile habitats while also supporting the fish and birds that depend on these ecosystems.
ex.zh: 溼地保護既能保護鱷魚的棲息地，也有利於依賴這些生態系統的魚類和鳥類。

col: crocodile tears｜假慈悲；虛假的眼淚
words.tip: alligator指短吻鱷，與crocodile並非同一種動物。

tr: n. 忠實, 誠實, 忠誠, 保真度
def: n. accuracy with which an electronic system reproduces the sound or image of its input signal
n. the quality of being faithful
continued loyalty to a person, belief, or duty

ex.en: The couple promised lifelong fidelity during their wedding.
ex.zh: 這對伴侶在婚禮上許諾終身忠於彼此。

ex.en: Digital archives must maintain the fidelity of original recordings so that researchers can study them accurately.
ex.zh: 數字檔案必須保持原始錄音的保真度，以便研究人員準確地開展研究。

col: fidelity to the original｜忠實於原作
words.tip: 忠於某人或原則用fidelity to；通常不可數。

tr: [化] 對稱; 對稱性; 對稱現象
def: n. (mathematics) an attribute of a shape or relation; exact reflection of form on opposite sides of a dividing line or plane
n. balance among the parts of something
The matching arrangement of parts on opposite sides.

ex.en: The butterfly's open wings show beautiful symmetry in the sunlight.
ex.zh: 陽光下，蝴蝶展開的雙翅呈現出優美的對稱性。

ex.en: Architects often use symmetry to create buildings that appear balanced and visually pleasing to visitors.
ex.zh: 建築師常利用對稱性，使建築在參觀者眼中顯得平衡而美觀。

words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞；形容詞是symmetrical。

def: v. read with difficulty
work out the meaning of unclear writing or coded information

ex.en: Can you decipher the handwriting on this old postcard?
ex.zh: 你能辨認出這張舊明信片上的字跡嗎？

ex.en: Researchers used advanced imaging techniques to decipher damaged manuscripts and gain insights into ancient societies.
ex.zh: 研究人員運用先進成像技術解讀受損手稿，深入瞭解古代社會。

words.tip: 只作動詞；既可指破譯密碼，也可指辨認潦草字跡。

def: v use up (resources or materials)
to greatly reduce the amount of something available

ex.en: Running several apps at once can deplete your battery.
ex.zh: 同時運行多個應用程序會大量消耗電池電量。

ex.en: Intensive farming can deplete soil nutrients, making future food production more difficult and expensive.
ex.zh: 集約化農業可能大量消耗土壤養分，使未來的糧食生產更加困難、成本更高。

col: deplete energy reserves｜消耗能量儲備
words.tip: 強調存量大幅減少，不一定完全耗盡。

tr: a. 乖張的, 故意作對的, 有悖常情的, 執迷不悟的, 歪曲的, 錯誤的, 不正當的
[法] 邪惡的, 罪惡的:墮落的, 不合法的
事與願違的；適得其反的
def: s. marked by a disposition to oppose and contradict
Deliberately contrary to what is reasonable, expected, or wanted.
Producing effects opposite to those intended or considered desirable.

ex.en: He took perverse pleasure in disagreeing with every suggestion.
ex.zh: 他以反對每一個建議為樂，這種樂趣令人費解。

ex.en: Poorly designed subsidies can create perverse incentives, encouraging companies to increase pollution rather than invest in cleaner production.
ex.zh: 設計不當的補貼可能產生反向激勵，鼓勵企業增加汙染，而不是投資更清潔的生產方式。

words.tip: 不泛指不正當；常指故意作對或結果適得其反。

tr: n. 精通, 熟練, 精練
def: n. the quality of having great facility and competence
n. skillfulness in the command of fundamentals deriving from practice and familiarity
A high level of skill or ability in something.

ex.en: Her proficiency in French helped us order dinner easily.
ex.zh: 她熟練掌握法語，讓我們輕鬆點好了晚餐。

ex.en: Universities often require evidence of English proficiency to ensure students can participate fully in academic discussions.
ex.zh: 大學通常要求提供英語能力證明，以確保學生能夠充分參與學術討論。

col: proficiency in English｜英語熟練程度
words.tip: 常用proficiency in接語言、學科或技能。

tr: n. 光束, 微光, 反光
vi. 閃爍, 隱約地閃現
vt. 使發微光, 使閃爍
def: n. an appearance of reflected light
n. a flash of light (especially reflected light)
v. shine brightly, like a star or a light

tr: a. 易碎的, 脆弱的, 易壞的
[機] 脆的, 脆性的, 易碎的
def: n. caramelized sugar cooled in thin sheets
s. having little elasticity; hence easily cracked or fractured or snapped
s. lacking warmth and generosity of spirit

tr: a. 熟練的, 老練的, 巧妙的
def: s. having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
Very skilled at doing something.
Someone who is highly skilled in a particular activity.

ex.en: My sister is adept at fixing old bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姐姐很擅長修理舊自行車。

ex.en: Teachers who are adept at using digital tools can adapt lessons to meet a wider range of learning needs.
ex.zh: 擅長使用數字工具的教師能夠調整課程，以滿足更多樣的學習需求。

col: adept at solving problems｜善於解決問題
words.tip: 常用be adept at doing，表示擅長做某事。

tr: a. 舊式的, 落伍的, 過時的
def: s. old; no longer valid or fashionable
No longer useful or suitable because things have changed.

ex.en: This outdated map doesn't show the new train station.
ex.zh: 這張過時的地圖沒有標出新火車站。

ex.en: Hospitals need adequate funding to replace outdated equipment and provide safer, more effective treatment for patients.
ex.zh: 醫院需要充足的資金來更換陳舊設備，為患者提供更安全、更有效的治療。

words.tip: 強調因時代變化而不再適用，不只是年代久遠。

tr: vt. 迫使, 使成為必需, 需要
def: v. require as useful, just, or proper
v. cause to be a concomitant

tr: n. 沉澱物, 凝結物, 結果
vt. 猛拋, 使陷入, 促成, 使沉澱
a. 突然的, 猛地落下的, 輕率的
def: n. a precipitated solid substance in suspension or after settling or filtering
v. bring about abruptly
v. separate as a fine suspension of solid particles

ex.en: A broken pipe precipitated an emergency visit from the plumber.
ex.zh: 水管破裂，水管工因此緊急上門維修。

ex.en: A sharp increase in food prices could precipitate a wider economic crisis in vulnerable regions.
ex.zh: 食品價格大幅上漲可能在脆弱地區引發更廣泛的經濟危機。

words.tip: 動詞末尾讀/teɪt/，名詞、形容詞讀/tət/。

tr: vt. 減去, 扣掉, 減少
def: v. make a subtraction
v. take off or away
to take one number or amount away from another

ex.en: Subtract the delivery charge to find the original price.
ex.zh: 減去運費，就能算出原價。

ex.en: Researchers subtract production costs from total revenue to calculate the profit generated by each farming method.
ex.zh: 研究人員從總收入中減去生產成本，計算每種耕作方式帶來的利潤。

words.tip: subtract A from B 表示用B減去A。

tr: vt. 滋養, 使健壯, 懷有
def: v. provide with nourishment
to provide what a living thing needs to grow healthily
to support the growth of a feeling or idea

ex.en: These simple meals nourish us after long working days.
ex.zh: 忙碌一整天后，這些簡單的飯菜為我們補充營養。

ex.en: Schools can nourish children's curiosity by encouraging questions and providing opportunities for independent exploration.
ex.zh: 學校可以通過鼓勵提問和提供自主探索的機會來培養兒童的好奇心。

words.tip: 既可指提供營養，也可比喻培養希望、好奇心等。

def: a. stimulating or exalting to the spirit

tr: n. 鏽, 生鏽, 衰退
def: n. a red or brown oxide coating on iron or steel caused by the action of oxygen and moisture
n. a plant disease that produces a reddish-brown discoloration of leaves and stems; caused by various rust fungi
n. the formation of reddish-brown ferric oxides on iron by low-temperature oxidation in the presence of water

ex.en: Orange rust covered the chain of my old bicycle.
ex.zh: 我那輛舊自行車的鏈條上佈滿了橙色鐵鏽。

ex.en: Regular maintenance prevents steel bridges from rusting and reduces the long-term cost of infrastructure repairs.
ex.zh: 定期養護可防止鋼橋生鏽，並降低基礎設施維修的長期成本。

words.tip: 技能生疏常用rusty：My French is rusty。

def: v. protect from heat, cold, or noise by surrounding with insulating material
n. a collection of selected literary passages

tr: n. 空, 空白, 空缺, 空虛, 空閒
def: n. being unoccupied
A job or position available for someone to fill.
A room available for someone to stay in.

ex.en: The local library has a vacancy for an assistant.
ex.zh: 當地的圖書館有一個助理職位空缺。

ex.en: Despite rising unemployment, many employers report difficulty filling vacancies that require advanced technical skills.
ex.zh: 儘管失業率上升，許多僱主仍表示難以填補需要高級技術技能的職位空缺。

words.tip: 職位、客房空缺均可數；複數為vacancies。

tr: n. 聽, 聽力, 試聽
def: n. a test of the suitability of a performer
v. perform in order to get a role
A short performance to show suitability for a performing role.

ex.en: Lena practised her song before the audition yesterday.
ex.zh: 莉娜昨天在試音前練習了她的歌曲。

ex.en: Open auditions can help local theatres discover talented performers who lack professional training or industry connections.
ex.zh: 公開試演能幫助地方劇院發現缺乏專業訓練或行業人脈的優秀表演者。

col: audition for a role｜為某個角色試鏡
words.tip: 現代常用義是試演、試鏡，不是一般的聽力。

tr: n. 計劃人, 發起人, 規劃人, 放映機, 映畫器, 幻燈機, 幻燈, 探照燈, 發射器
def: n. an optical device for projecting a beam of light
n. an optical instrument that projects an enlarged image onto a screen

tr: a. 雄辯的, 有口才的, 有說服力的
def: s. expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
Expressing ideas clearly, powerfully, and beautifully.
Clearly expressing a feeling or meaning without words.

ex.en: Her eloquent speech moved everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 她那富有感染力的演講打動了屋裡的每個人。

ex.en: The speaker offered an eloquent defence of public libraries as essential spaces for lifelong learning.
ex.zh: 演講者有力地論證了公共圖書館作為終身學習重要場所的價值。

col: an eloquent speaker｜能言善辯的演講者
an eloquent silence｜意味深長的沉默
words.tip: 不只形容口才，也可形容傳達深意的眼神或沉默。

tr: n. 上升, 提高, 攀登, 上坡路
def: n. an upward slope or grade (as in a road)
the act of climbing or moving upwards
a rise to a higher position, rank, or level

ex.en: We began our ascent just as the sun rose.
ex.zh: 太陽剛升起，我們就開始攀登。

ex.en: The rapid ascent of renewable energy reflects both technological progress and stronger public support for environmental protection.
ex.zh: 可再生能源的迅速崛起既反映了技術進步，也體現了公眾對環境保護更有力的支持。

col: a steep ascent｜陡峭的上坡路
words.tip: ascent指上升；同音詞assent指同意。

def: n. a resort town in east central Florida
n. the capital of Victoria state and 2nd largest Australian city; a financial and commercial center

tr: n. 綠洲, 舒適的地方
[醫] 綠洲(沙漠中), 健島(病變區中的健康組織)
def: n. a fertile tract in a desert (where the water table approaches the surface)
A place in a desert where water and plants are found.
A peaceful, pleasant place surrounded by something difficult or unpleasant.

ex.en: After hours of walking, we reached a small oasis.
ex.zh: 步行數小時後，我們到達了一片小綠洲。

ex.en: Public gardens provide an oasis of calm for residents living in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 公共花園為生活在人口密集城區的居民提供了一方寧靜之地。

col: an oasis of calm｜寧靜之地
words.tip: 複數為oases；也可比喻喧囂中的寧靜之地。

tr: n. 水族館, 養魚池, 水草缸
def: n. a tank or pool or bowl filled with water for keeping live fish and underwater animals
A water-filled container for keeping fish and other aquatic animals
A public building where people can see aquatic animals

ex.en: Two orange fish swim among plants in our aquarium.
ex.zh: 兩條橙色的魚在我們魚缸裡的水草間遊動。

ex.en: A well-managed aquarium can teach visitors about marine ecosystems and encourage greater concern for ocean conservation.
ex.zh: 管理良好的水族館可以讓遊客瞭解海洋生態系統，並促使他們更加關注海洋保護。

words.tip: 既指家中的魚缸，也指供公眾參觀的水族館。

tr: n. 不幸, 災禍, 壞運氣
[法] 不幸事故, 不幸, 災禍
def: n. unnecessary and unforeseen trouble resulting from an unfortunate event
n. an unfortunate state resulting from unfavorable outcomes
bad luck or an unlucky event that causes difficulty

ex.en: We had the misfortune to miss the last train.
ex.zh: 我們很不巧，錯過了末班火車。

ex.en: Strong community networks can help families recover from financial misfortune without becoming isolated from society.
ex.zh: 緊密的社區互助網絡能幫助家庭擺脫經濟困境，同時避免與社會隔絕。

col: have the misfortune to do｜不幸做了某事
a series of misfortunes｜一連串不幸
words.tip: 表示厄運時不可數；表示具體不幸事件時可數。

tr: a. 有效的, 顯著的, 顯露內心活動的
def: n. informing by words

tr: a. 巨大的, 畸形的, 怪異的
[法] 巨大的, 異形的, 畸形的:荒誕的
def: s. abnormally large
n. a mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined
n. a monetary subunit in Denmark and Norway and Sweden; 100 ore equal 1 krona
rock containing metal or other valuable substances that can be extracted

ex.en: The truck carried iron ore down the dusty road.
ex.zh: 卡車沿著塵土飛揚的道路運送鐵礦石。

ex.en: Extracting metals from ore requires substantial energy and can cause serious damage to surrounding ecosystems.
ex.zh: 從礦石中提取金屬需要大量能源，並可能嚴重破壞周邊生態系統。

col: extract metal from ore｜從礦石中提取金屬
words.tip: ore是含有可提取物質的礦石，不等於metal。

tr: n. 獨白, 獨腳戲, 獨白場面, (非正式)(貶)滔滔不絕的話
def: n. a long utterance by one person (especially one that prevents others from participating in the conversation)
n. a (usually long) dramatic speech by a single actor
A long speech delivered by one character in a performance.

ex.en: The actor practised her monologue alone in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 那位演員獨自在廚房裡練習她的獨白。

ex.en: A dramatic monologue can reveal a character's inner conflicts more directly than dialogue between several speakers.
ex.zh: 與多個角色之間的對話相比，戲劇獨白能夠更直接地展現人物的內心衝突。

col: deliver a monologue｜表演一段獨白
words.tip: 獨白可對觀眾說，不一定是角色自言自語。

tr: n. 不和, 封地, 爭執
vi. 長期不和, 擦亮
def: n. a bitter quarrel between two parties
v. carry out a feud
A bitter disagreement continuing for a long time.

ex.en: The neighbours ended their feud over the garden fence.
ex.zh: 鄰居們結束了圍繞花園圍欄的長期爭執。

ex.en: A long-running feud between community leaders can prevent cooperation on projects that would benefit local residents.
ex.zh: 社區領導人之間的長期不和可能阻礙那些有益於當地居民的項目合作。

col: feud with someone｜與某人長期不和
words.tip: 強調持續很久的敵對或爭執，而非一次口角。
