def: s. (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves

tr: n. 小尖塔, 尖峰, 高峰, 極點
vt. 造小尖塔, 置於尖頂上
def: n. (architecture) a slender upright spire at the top of a buttress of tower
n. a lofty peak
v. surmount with a pinnacle

ex.en: Winning the tournament was the pinnacle of her career.
ex.zh: 贏得那場錦標賽是她職業生涯的巔峰。

ex.en: For many researchers, international recognition represents the pinnacle of a career devoted to scientific discovery.
ex.zh: 對許多研究人員而言，獲得國際認可代表著獻身科學探索的職業生涯達到頂峰。

col: the pinnacle of success｜成功的巔峰
words.tip: 比喻義常用the pinnacle of，表示成就的頂峰。

tr: vt. 使服從, 壓制, 減弱, 抑制, 剋制
def: v put down by force or intimidation
v to put down by force or authority
v hold within limits and control

tr: n. 鐘擺, 搖錘, 搖擺不定的事態(或局面)
def: n. an apparatus consisting of an object mounted so that it swings freely under the influence of gravity

tr: n. 控訴者, 指責者
[法] 原告, 指控人, 控告者
def: n. someone who imputes guilt or blame

tr: a. 錯誤的, 不正確的
[法] 錯誤的, 不正確的
def: s. containing or characterized by error
n. a surface-active chemical widely used in industry and laundering
n. a cleansing agent that differs from soap but can also emulsify oils and hold dirt in suspension
s. having cleansing power

ex.en: I added detergent before starting the washing machine.
ex.zh: 我在啟動洗衣機之前加入了洗滌劑。

ex.en: Using excessive detergent wastes money and may increase the amount of chemicals entering local waterways.
ex.zh: 使用過量洗滌劑既浪費錢，也可能增加進入當地水道的化學物質。

words.tip: 泛指洗滌劑時通常不可數；指種類時可數。

tr: a. 不適當的, 過度的, 未到期的
def: a. not yet payable
a. not appropriate or proper (or even legal) in the circumstances
s. lacking justification or authorization

tr: vt. 簽名於下, 給...保險
def: v. guarantee financial support of

tr: n. 裡弗斯（人名）；河流州（尼日利亞州名）；河水鑽
def: n a large natural stream of water (larger than a creek)

tr: n. 沒收物, 罰金, 喪失
def: n. something that is lost or surrendered as a penalty;
n. a penalty for a fault or mistake that involves losing or giving up something
n. the act of losing or surrendering something as a penalty for a mistake or fault or failure to perform etc.

ex.en: If you cancel now, you will forfeit your deposit.
ex.zh: 如果你現在取消，押金就不退了。

ex.en: Companies that repeatedly violate environmental regulations should forfeit their right to operate until they meet the required standards.
ex.zh: 反覆違反環境法規的企業應被取消經營資格，直至達到規定標準。

col: forfeit the right to｜喪失……的權利
forfeit a match｜被判比賽失利
words.tip: 主語通常是失去財物者，而非執行沒收的一方。

tr: a. 重大的, 重要的
def: s. of very great significance

tr: a. 奮發的, 費勁的, 艱苦的
def: s. characterized by or performed with much energy or force

tr: vt. 使實體化, 證實
def: v. solidify, firm, or strengthen
to provide evidence showing that something is true

ex.en: She kept the receipts to substantiate her insurance claim.
ex.zh: 她保留了收據，以證明保險索賠有據可依。

ex.en: Researchers must substantiate claims about new treatments with reliable evidence from carefully designed clinical trials.
ex.zh: 研究人員必須用精心設計的臨床試驗所提供的可靠證據，來證實有關新療法的論斷。

col: substantiate a claim｜證實一項主張
substantiate an allegation｜證實一項指控
words.tip: 正式及物動詞；後接claim等，強調拿出證據。

tr: a. 世界主義的, 世界性的, 全世界的, 遍生的, 不偏狹的, 卓有見識的
n. 世界主義者, 世界性
多國文化交融的；國際化的
見多識廣的；具有國際視野的
def: n. a sophisticated person who has travelled in many countries
a. growing or occurring in many parts of the world
a. composed of people from or at home in many parts of the world; especially not provincial in attitudes or interests

ex.en: Our cosmopolitan neighbourhood has restaurants serving food from many countries.
ex.zh: 我們這個國際化社區有供應各國美食的餐館。

ex.en: Cosmopolitan cities can encourage cultural exchange by creating shared spaces where residents from different backgrounds regularly interact.
ex.zh: 國際化城市可以通過創建共享空間，讓不同背景的居民經常交流，從而促進文化交流。

col: cosmopolitan population｜來自世界各地的居民
words.tip: 常形容城市或人，強調多元文化，而非單指全球範圍。

tr: a. 匆匆的, 輕率的, 性怠的
def: s. excessively quick
s. done with very great haste and without due deliberation

tr: n. 悲觀, 悲觀情緒, 悲觀主義
def: n. the feeling that things will turn out badly
n. a general disposition to look on the dark side and to expect the worst in all things

tr: vi. 變動, 起伏, 動搖
vt. 使波動, 使動搖
def: v. cause to fluctuate or move in a wavelike pattern
v. move or sway in a rising and falling or wavelike pattern
v. be unstable

ex.en: Vegetable prices fluctuate sharply at our local market.
ex.zh: 我們當地市場的蔬菜價格波動很大。

ex.en: Demand for electricity tends to fluctuate throughout the day, creating challenges for energy suppliers.
ex.zh: 電力需求往往在一天之內不斷波動，給能源供應商帶來挑戰。

words.tip: 通常是不及物動詞；在兩值間波動用between。

tr: n. 審查, 鑑定, 健康檢查
def: n. a thorough physical examination; includes a variety of tests depending on the age and sex and health of the person

tr: n. 傾斜, 斜坡, 斜面
vt. 使傾向於, 使傾斜
vi. 傾向, 傾斜, 愛好, 易於
def: v. bend or turn (one's ear) towards a speaker in order to listen well
v. lower or bend (the head or upper body), as in a nod or bow
v. feel favorably disposed or willing

ex.en: I incline towards the cheaper option for our holiday.
ex.zh: 對於我們的假期，我傾向於選擇更便宜的方案。

ex.en: Rising housing costs may incline young adults to remain in their parents' homes longer.
ex.zh: 不斷上漲的住房成本可能使年輕人更傾向於延長與父母同住的時間。

col: incline towards a view｜傾向於某種觀點
be inclined to agree｜傾向於贊同
words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞讀/ˈɪnklaɪn/。

def: n. an inability to sleep; chronic sleeplessness
a condition involving difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep

ex.en: His insomnia left him awake long after midnight again.
ex.zh: 失眠讓他又一次到了深夜仍然清醒著。

ex.en: Persistent insomnia can affect concentration at work and may require advice from a healthcare professional.
ex.zh: 持續失眠會影響工作時的注意力，可能需要諮詢醫療專業人員。

words.tip: insomnia是不可數名詞，常與suffer from連用。

tr: a. 巨大的, 巨像似的
def: s. so great in size or force or extent as to elicit awe
n an angular or rounded shape made by folding
n a slight depression in the smoothness of a surface
n a Malayan dagger with a wavy blade

tr: vt. 設要塞於, 加強, 使堅強, 增加
def: v. enclose by or as if by a fortification
v. add nutrients to
to strengthen a place or structure against attack or damage

ex.en: We used sandbags to fortify the wall before the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，我們用沙袋加固了那道牆。

ex.en: Manufacturers can fortify staple foods with essential vitamins to help prevent nutritional deficiencies in vulnerable populations.
ex.zh: 生產商可以在主食中添加必需維生素，幫助預防易受影響人群的營養缺乏問題。

col: fortify coastal defences｜加強海岸防禦
fortify food with vitamins｜給食品添加維生素
fortify yourself against｜增強自身力量以抵禦
words.tip: fortify A with B：用B增強A。

tr: n. 淺水, 淺灘, 沙洲, 魚群, 暗礁, 潛在危險
vi. 魚成群而遊, 變淺
def: n. a sandbank in a stretch of water that is visible at low tide
n. a stretch of shallow water
n. an imaginary line around the Earth forming the great circle that is equidistant from the north and south poles
n. a circle dividing a sphere or other surface into two usually equal and symmetrical parts
An imaginary line around Earth's middle, equally distant from both poles.

ex.en: Our guide explained why it stays warm near the equator.
ex.zh: 導遊解釋了為什麼赤道附近一直很暖和。

ex.en: Regions near the equator receive intense sunlight throughout the year, contributing to consistently high temperatures.
ex.zh: 赤道附近的地區全年受到強烈的陽光照射，因此氣溫持續偏高。

col: north of the equator｜赤道以北
words.tip: 赤道前通常加the；形容詞是equatorial。

tr: n. 閃爍, 閃耀, 瞬息
def: n. a rapid change in brightness; a brief spark or flash
v. emit or reflect light in a flickering manner
To shine with small, quick changes in brightness.

ex.en: Tiny lights twinkled around the window as we ate.
ex.zh: 我們吃飯時，窗邊的小燈閃閃發亮。

ex.en: Although stars twinkle beautifully, atmospheric disturbances that cause this effect can limit the accuracy of astronomical observations.
ex.zh: 雖然星光閃爍十分美麗，但造成這一現象的大氣擾動會限制天文觀測的精確度。

col: a twinkle in someone's eye｜某人眼中愉快的神采
words.tip: 作動詞通常不及物，也可形容眼睛閃著笑意。

tr: a. 可允許的, 可容許程度的
def: a. that may be permitted especially as according to rule
s. that may be accepted or conceded
Allowed by a rule, law, or accepted standard

ex.en: Is it permissible to take photographs inside this museum?
ex.zh: 可以在這家博物館內拍照嗎？

ex.en: Governments should establish clear limits on permissible emissions to protect public health in industrial areas.
ex.zh: 政府應明確規定允許的排放限值，以保護工業區的公眾健康。

words.tip: 常用句型：It is permissible to do sth.。

tr: n. 新紀元, 時代, 時期
def: n. (astronomy) an arbitrarily fixed date that is the point in time relative to which information (as coordinates of a celestial body) is recorded
n. a unit of geological time that is a subdivision of a period and is itself divided into ages
a period of history marked by distinctive events or changes

ex.en: These old photographs capture an epoch of rapid change.
ex.zh: 這些老照片記錄了一個迅速變革的時代。

ex.en: The development of agriculture marked a new epoch in human history, transforming settlement patterns and social organisation.
ex.zh: 農業的發展標誌著人類歷史進入了一個新時代，改變了聚居模式和社會組織形式。

col: mark an epoch｜標誌一個時代的開啟
words.tip: 比 period 更強調時代特徵；地質學中譯為“世”。

tr: n. 軟木塞, 軟木樹, 軟木
def: n. outer bark of the cork oak; used for stoppers for bottles etc.
n. a port city in southern Ireland
n. the plug in the mouth of a bottle (especially a wine bottle)

ex.en: The cork popped out and rolled under the table.
ex.zh: 軟木塞砰地彈出，滾到了桌子底下。

ex.en: Cork is a renewable material that can be harvested without cutting down the entire tree.
ex.zh: 軟木是一種可再生材料，採收時無需砍倒整棵樹。

words.tip: 表示軟木材料時不可數；表示軟木塞時可數。

tr: vt. 使驚駭, 使大驚
def: v affect with wonder

tr: a. 狡猾的, 巧妙的, 可愛的
[法] 狡猾的的, 狡詐的, 熟練的
def: n. crafty artfulness (especially in deception)
s. attractive especially by means of smallness or prettiness or quaintness
Clever at getting what you want by deceiving others.

ex.en: The cunning fox waited until the dog fell asleep.
ex.zh: 那隻狡猾的狐狸一直等到狗睡著了。

ex.en: Cunning advertising tactics can persuade consumers to purchase products they neither need nor can afford.
ex.zh: 狡猾的廣告手段可能誘使消費者購買既不需要也負擔不起的產品。

words.tip: 形容人時通常含貶義，不等於單純的聰明。

def: s lacking in liveliness or charm or surprise
s causing dejection

tr: n. 合計, 總計, 聚集體
a. 合計的, 聚集的
v. 聚集, 集合, 合計達
def: n. material such as sand or gravel used with cement and water to make concrete, mortar, or plaster
n. a sum total of many heterogenous things taken together
v. amount in the aggregate to

tr: n. 釋義, 解述, 改寫
def: n. rewording for the purpose of clarification
v. express the same message in different words
Express the same meaning using different words.

ex.en: Could you paraphrase that explanation so I can understand?
ex.zh: 你能換種說法解釋一下，讓我聽懂嗎？

ex.en: Students should learn to paraphrase sources accurately while acknowledging the original authors in their academic writing.
ex.zh: 學生應學會在學術寫作中準確改述資料內容，同時註明原作者。

col: paraphrase a passage｜改述一段文字
paraphrase in your own words｜用自己的話改述
words.tip: 改述須保留原意；summarize則側重概括要點。

tr: n. 年金, 年金保險, 年金領受權
def: n. income from capital investment paid in a series of regular payments
An investment providing regular payments, often throughout retirement.

ex.en: My grandfather receives an annuity to cover his living costs.
ex.zh: 我祖父領取年金來支付生活開銷。

ex.en: An annuity can provide retirees with a predictable income, although inflation may reduce its purchasing power.
ex.zh: 年金可以為退休者提供可預期的收入，但通貨膨脹可能降低其購買力。

col: buy an annuity｜購買年金保險
words.tip: 年金可按月等定期支付，並非只能一年領一次。

tr: n. 旁觀者, 袖手旁觀者
def: n. someone who looks on

tr: a. 有益健康的, 合乎衛生的, 健全的, 有益的, 有生氣的, 審慎的
def: a. conducive to or characteristic of physical or moral well-being
s. sound or exhibiting soundness in body or mind

tr: n. 福布斯（美國出版及媒體集團）；福布斯（美國著名財經雜誌）；福布斯（姓氏）
vt. 迫害, 虐待, 困擾, 同...搗亂
[法] 迫害, 虐待, 煩擾
def: v. cause to suffer
To treat people cruelly because of their beliefs or identity.
To repeatedly trouble someone or treat them unfairly.

ex.en: Her grandparents were persecuted because of their religious beliefs.
ex.zh: 她的祖父母曾因宗教信仰受到迫害。

ex.en: Governments must protect minority communities and ensure that nobody is persecuted for peacefully expressing their beliefs.
ex.zh: 政府必須保護少數群體，確保沒有人因和平表達信念而遭受迫害。

col: persecuted for their beliefs｜因信仰而受迫害
words.tip: persecute指迫害；prosecute指依法起訴。

tr: n. 激動, 焦慮, 煽動, 攪動, 搖動
def: n. a mental state of extreme emotional disturbance
n. a state of agitation or turbulent change or development
n. the feeling of being agitated; not calm

ex.en: Her agitation grew as she searched for her missing keys.
ex.zh: 她尋找丟失的鑰匙時，變得越來越焦躁。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise may increase agitation and reduce residents' ability to concentrate at home.
ex.zh: 長期接觸交通噪聲可能加劇居民的煩躁情緒，降低他們在家中的專注力。

col: in a state of agitation｜處於焦躁狀態
words.tip: 通常不可數；既可指情緒不安，也可指攪動。

tr: vt. 使溼透, 使充滿
n. 滂沱大雨, 弄溼
def: v. force to drink
v. cover with liquid; pour liquid onto
To make someone or something completely wet

ex.en: A sudden downpour drenched us on the way home.
ex.zh: 回家途中，一場突如其來的大雨把我們淋透了。

ex.en: Intense storms can drench farmland within minutes, increasing surface runoff and carrying valuable topsoil into nearby rivers.
ex.zh: 猛烈的暴風雨能在幾分鐘內浸透農田，增加地表逕流，並將寶貴的表土衝入附近河流。

col: drench someone with water｜用水把某人澆透
words.tip: 強調完全溼透；常用被動形式be drenched。

tr: [計] 先後次序; 優先規定
def: n. status established in order of importance or urgency
Greater importance that gives someone or something priority over others.

ex.en: At home, homework takes precedence over video games.
ex.zh: 在家裡，做作業優先於玩電子遊戲。

ex.en: Public safety should take precedence over commercial interests when governments develop regulations for new transport technologies.
ex.zh: 政府為新的交通技術制定法規時，應將公共安全置於商業利益之上。

words.tip: 常用take precedence over，表示優先於。

tr: a. 無數的, 數不清的
def: s too numerous to be counted
Too many to count.

ex.en: Innumerable stars filled the sky above our quiet campsite.
ex.zh: 無數星星佈滿了我們寧靜營地上方的夜空。

ex.en: Coastal wetlands support innumerable organisms and provide essential protection against storms for nearby communities.
ex.zh: 沿海溼地養育著無數生物，併為附近社區提供抵禦風暴的重要屏障。

words.tip: 後接可數名詞複數，語氣比many強，較正式。

def: n. the act of lodging

tr: n. 慣性, 惰性, 遲鈍
def: n. (physics) the tendency of a body to maintain its state of rest or uniform motion unless acted upon by an external force
A tendency to remain inactive or resist change.
Matter's tendency to resist changes in its speed or direction.

ex.en: After weeks of inertia, I finally cleaned the garage.
ex.zh: 拖了幾個星期後，我終於動手清理了車庫。

ex.en: Institutional inertia can prevent schools from adopting teaching methods that better meet students' needs.
ex.zh: 制度上的惰性可能使學校無法採用更符合學生需求的教學方法。

col: the inertia of an object｜物體的慣性
words.tip: 不可數名詞：既指物理慣性，也指不願改變的惰性。

tr: a. 多餘的, 過多的, 冗長的
def: s more than is needed, desired, or required
s repetition of same sense in different words
unnecessary because it is no longer needed or repeats something

ex.en: This spare cable is redundant now we use wireless speakers.
ex.zh: 既然我們用無線音箱了，這根備用線就多餘了。

ex.en: Factory workers may be made redundant when automated systems take over tasks previously performed by people.
ex.zh: 當自動化系統接手原先由人完成的任務時，工廠工人可能會被裁員。

words.tip: 英式英語中be made redundant指崗位取消而被裁員。

tr: n. 約會, 約會地點
v. 集合, 集結, 在約定場所會面
def: n. a meeting planned at a certain time and place
n. a place where people meet
v. meet at a rendezvous

tr: n. 兒童照管；兒童保育
def: n. a service involving care for other people's children

tr: a. 定期出版的, (有關)期刊的, 間歇(性的), 週期的, 定期的
def: n. a publication that appears at fixed intervals
A publication released regularly, containing articles on particular subjects.
Happening or appearing repeatedly at intervals.

ex.en: The library keeps that periodical beside the newspapers.
ex.zh: 圖書館把那種期刊放在報紙旁邊。

ex.en: Academic periodicals allow researchers to share findings, although subscription costs can limit access for smaller institutions.
ex.zh: 學術期刊讓研究人員能夠分享成果，但訂閱費用可能限制小型機構獲取這些資源。

words.tip: 名詞指期刊；表示定期發生時，periodic更常用。

tr: a. 松的, 不嚴格的, 腹瀉的, 鬆弛的
def: s. lacking in rigor or strictness
a. pronounced with muscles of the tongue and jaw relatively relaxed (e.g., the vowel sound in `bet')
a. lacking in strength or firmness or resilience

ex.en: The club is lax about checking membership cards.
ex.zh: 這傢俱樂部對會員卡的檢查很鬆懈。

ex.en: Lax enforcement of environmental regulations allows some factories to discharge untreated waste into nearby rivers.
ex.zh: 環境法規執行不嚴，使一些工廠得以向附近河流排放未經處理的廢物。

col: lax about rules｜對規則要求不嚴
words.tip: 常指規則執行不嚴；不要用它表示日常的腹瀉。

tr: n. 辛苦, 苦工, 網, 羅網, 圈套
def: n productive work (especially physical work done for wages)
v work hard

tr: vt. 壓迫, 壓抑, 使煩惱
def: v. come down on or keep down by unjust use of one's authority
n. a concise reference book providing specific information about a subject or location
A book giving practical information or instructions about a subject

ex.en: I checked the gardening handbook before pruning the rose.
ex.zh: 修剪玫瑰之前，我查閱了園藝手冊。

ex.en: A comprehensive employee handbook helps new staff understand workplace procedures and reduces confusion about their responsibilities.
ex.zh: 一本全面的員工手冊有助於新員工瞭解工作流程，減少他們對自身職責的困惑。

words.tip: 指便於查閱的實用指南，不是普通課本。

tr: vt. 浸水, 氾濫, 淹沒, 使充滿
def: v. fill or cover completely, usually with water

tr: a. 刺激性的, 尖刻的, 苦痛的
[醫] 衝味的, 刺激味的
def: s. strong and sharp
n. a semiconductor device capable of amplification
An electronic component that amplifies signals or switches electrical current.

ex.en: She carefully replaced the damaged transistor inside the old radio.
ex.zh: 她小心地更換了舊收音機裡損壞的晶體管。

ex.en: The development of smaller transistors has enabled computers to process information faster while consuming less power.
ex.zh: 更小型晶體管的研發讓計算機能夠更快地處理信息，同時減少耗電。

words.tip: 指電子元件；transistor radio才是晶體管收音機。

tr: n. 全景, 全貌, 概論, 範圍
def: n. a picture (or series of pictures) representing a continuous scene

tr: a. 未說過的, 未透露的, 未加敘述的, 數不清的, 無限的, 不可計量的, 無數的
[法] 未說明的, 未方露的, 未說出的
def: s. of an incalculable amount

tr: n. 失敗, 誤送, 流產
def: n. failure of a plan

tr: n. 替罪羔羊, 替人頂罪者, 替身
[法] 替罪羊, 代人受過者
def: n. someone who is punished for the errors of others

tr: vt. 使陷於泥濘, 使陷入困境
def: n. a soft wet area of low-lying land that sinks underfoot
n. a difficulty or embarrassment that is hard to extricate yourself from
v. cause to get stuck as if in a mire

tr: [法] 可信任的, 可靠的, 可信賴的
def: a. worthy of trust or belief
s. taking responsibility for one's conduct and obligations

tr: n. 送快信的人, 伴遊服務員
def: n a person who carries a message

tr: n. 熱烈歡迎, 大喝采, 小凱旋式
def: n. enthusiastic recognition (especially one accompanied by loud applause)
enthusiastic applause from an audience to show strong approval

ex.en: The young pianist received an ovation after her performance.
ex.zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家演奏後贏得了熱烈掌聲。

ex.en: The orchestra received a standing ovation, demonstrating how live performances can create a powerful sense of community.
ex.zh: 管弦樂團贏得了全場起立鼓掌，展現出現場演出如何營造強烈的群體歸屬感。

col: receive an ovation｜獲得熱烈掌聲
words.tip: 可數名詞；standing ovation指觀眾起立鼓掌。

tr: a. 古體的, 過時的, 古老的, 古代的
def: s. little evolved from or characteristic of an earlier ancestral type

tr: vt. 辯護, 證明...無辜, 維護
[法] 辯護, 辯解, 辯明
def: v. maintain, uphold, or defend
v. clear of accusation, blame, suspicion, or doubt with supporting proof
To prove someone innocent or show that something was justified.

ex.en: The security footage vindicated the cleaner accused of stealing.
ex.zh: 監控錄像證明了那位被指控偷竊的清潔工是無辜的。

ex.en: The significant decline in road accidents appears to vindicate the council's decision to introduce lower speed limits.
ex.zh: 交通事故顯著減少，似乎證明市政委員會降低限速的決定是正確的。

col: vindicate a decision｜證明決定正確
vindicate an approach｜證明方法正確
feel vindicated｜感到自己得到證明
words.tip: 強調證據或結果證明正確，不只是口頭辯護。

tr: v. 絮絮不休地說, 喧鬧
def: v. instill (into a person) by constant repetition
A loud, unpleasant mixture of continuing noises.

ex.en: We could barely hear each other above the din.
ex.zh: 嘈雜聲太大，我們幾乎聽不清彼此說話。

ex.en: The constant din of traffic can reduce residents' quality of life and disturb their sleep.
ex.zh: 持續不斷的交通噪聲會降低居民的生活質量，干擾他們的睡眠。

col: a deafening din｜震耳欲聾的嘈雜聲
the din of traffic｜交通的嘈雜聲
words.tip: 通常作單數名詞，強調持續且令人不適的嘈雜聲。

tr: n. 外表, 偽裝, 假象, 少量
def: n. an outward or token appearance or form that is deliberately misleading
An outward appearance or slight degree of a particular quality

ex.en: I tidied the cushions to restore some semblance of order.
ex.zh: 我整理了靠墊，讓屋裡多少顯得整齊一些。

ex.en: After severe flooding, reopening schools can help communities regain a semblance of normality while essential infrastructure is repaired.
ex.zh: 嚴重洪災後，在必要的基礎設施修復期間，重新開學可以幫助社區恢復些許正常生活的樣貌。

col: a semblance of normality｜些許正常的樣貌
a semblance of order｜表面上的秩序
maintain a semblance of｜維持…的表象
words.tip: 常用 a semblance of，表示表面上或些許的某種狀態。

tr: n. 連接, 會合處, 交叉點
[醫] 接[合]處, 接點.[接]界
def: n. the place where two or more things come together
n. the state of being joined together
n. something that joins or connects

ex.en: Turn left at the junction beside the bakery.
ex.zh: 在麵包店旁的路口左轉。

ex.en: Installing better lighting at busy junctions could reduce accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians.
ex.zh: 在繁忙路口安裝更好的照明設施，可以減少涉及騎行者和行人的事故。

words.tip: 英式常用junction，美式路口常說intersection。

tr: vi. 失策, 跌跌撞撞地走, 犯錯
def: n. an embarrassing mistake
A serious mistake caused by carelessness or poor judgment.
To make a serious or careless mistake.

ex.en: I made a blunder and booked the wrong date.
ex.zh: 我犯了個大錯，把日期訂錯了。

ex.en: A major planning blunder can leave communities without adequate transport links for many years.
ex.zh: 重大的規劃失誤可能使社區多年缺乏完善的交通連接。

words.tip: 比mistake語氣更重，強調因粗心或判斷差犯錯。

tr: vt. 分配, 分攤指定
[經] (按股或按規定)分配, 配(撥)給, 規(派)定
def: v give out
v allow to have
v administer or bestow, as in small portions

tr: n. 紀念物, 令人回憶的東西
def: n. a reminder of past events

tr: n. 醫療保健；衛生保健；健康護理, 健康服務
def: n. the preservation of mental and physical health by preventing or treating illness through services offered by the health profession

tr: n. 增加, 增值, 盈餘
def: n a process of becoming larger or longer or more numerous or more important
n the amount by which something increases

n. a unit of heat equal to the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of one kilogram of water by one degree at one atmosphere pressure; used by nutritionists to characterize the energy-producing potential in food
n. unit of heat defined as the quantity of heat required to raise the temperature of 1 gram of water by 1 degree centigrade at atmospheric pressure
A unit measuring energy, especially energy in food.

ex.en: This walking app estimates how many calories I burn.
ex.zh: 這個步行應用會估算我消耗了多少卡路里。

ex.en: Although calorie information can guide food choices, a balanced diet also depends on nutrient quality.
ex.zh: 雖然熱量信息可以指導食物選擇，但均衡飲食也取決於營養質量。

words.tip: 食品語境的calorie通常指千卡；物理學中指卡。

tr: n. 救濟品, 失業救濟金
def: n. a share of money or food or clothing that has been charitably given
n. money received from the state

tr: n. 電學家, 電氣技師, 電工
def: n. a person who installs or repairs electrical or telephone lines
Someone trained to install and repair electrical systems.

ex.en: The electrician fixed the broken light in our kitchen.
ex.zh: 電工修好了我們廚房裡壞掉的燈。

ex.en: Training more qualified electricians is essential as households increasingly adopt solar panels and electric vehicle charging equipment.
ex.zh: 隨著越來越多家庭安裝太陽能板和電動汽車充電設備，培養更多合格電工至關重要。

words.tip: electrician指電工；電氣工程師是electrical engineer。

tr: n. 觀察, 遵守, 儀式, 風俗習慣
[法] 遵守, 奉行, 慣例
def: n the act of observing; taking a patient look
n a formal event performed on a special occasion
n the act of noticing or paying attention

ex.en: Strict observance of kitchen hygiene keeps our food safe.
ex.zh: 嚴格遵守廚房衛生規範能保障我們的食品安全。

ex.en: Consistent observance of workplace safety regulations can prevent accidents and improve employees' confidence in their employers.
ex.zh: 始終遵守工作場所安全規定能夠預防事故，並增強員工對僱主的信心。

words.tip: observance指遵守或儀式；observation指觀察。

tr: n. 序, 緒言, 前言
vt. 給...作序, 以...開始
def: n a short introductory essay preceding the text of a book
v furnish with a preface or introduction
An introductory section explaining a book's purpose or background.

ex.en: The author explains her inspiration in the book's preface.
ex.zh: 作者在這本書的前言中解釋了她的創作靈感。

ex.en: In the preface, the researchers explain how their personal experiences influenced the questions explored throughout the book.
ex.zh: 研究人員在前言中解釋了個人經歷如何影響全書探討的問題。

col: preface remarks with｜以…作為講話的開場白
words.tip: 書的preface通常由作者寫；foreword常由他人撰寫。

tr: n. 即席演出, 即興曲
def: n. an extemporaneous speech or remark
n. a short musical passage that seems to have been made spontaneously without advance preparation

tr: [法] 推斷, 推出, 演繹
def: v. reason by deduction; establish by deduction
v. conclude by reasoning; in logic

tr: vt. 放縱, 使吃飽, 使過量
def: v. treat with excessive indulgence
To give someone special care, comfort, or excessive attention

ex.en: I pamper myself with a warm bath on Sundays.
ex.zh: 每到星期天，我都會泡個熱水澡犒勞自己。

ex.en: Parents who constantly pamper their children may unintentionally limit opportunities for them to develop independence.
ex.zh: 總是嬌慣孩子的父母可能會無意中限制孩子培養獨立性的機會。

col: pamper someone with gifts｜用禮物寵愛某人
words.tip: 不一定含貶義；pamper yourself常指犒勞自己。

tr: n. 稅款, 所徵的人數, 徵收
vt. 徵收, 強求, 召集
def: n. a charge imposed and collected
n. the act of drafting into military service
v. impose and collect

tr: n. 活塞, 活塞閥鍵
def: n. United States neoclassical composer (1894-1976)
n. mechanical device that has a plunging or thrusting motion
a part that moves inside a cylinder in engines or pumps

ex.en: The mechanic removed a damaged piston from the engine.
ex.zh: 機修工從發動機中拆下了一個損壞的活塞。

ex.en: In a conventional engine, expanding gases push each piston, converting energy from fuel into mechanical motion.
ex.zh: 在傳統發動機中，膨脹的氣體推動每個活塞，將燃料的能量轉化為機械運動。

words.tip: 活塞在 cylinder（氣缸）內往復運動。

tr: vt. 獲得, 取得, 導致
def: v. get by special effort
to obtain something, especially through effort or careful arrangements

ex.en: We finally procured a spare part for the oven.
ex.zh: 我們終於為烤箱弄到了一個備用零件。

ex.en: Local authorities must procure reliable equipment to ensure that drinking water remains safe during emergencies.
ex.zh: 地方政府必須採購可靠的設備，確保緊急情況下飲用水仍然安全。

words.tip: 正式及物動詞，直接接所獲得的物品或資源。

tr: n. 暫停, 間歇, 稍息, 使人安靜的東西
vt. 使平靜, 哄騙, 使安靜
def: n. a period of calm weather
v. calm by deception
v. become quiet or less intensive

ex.en: We stepped outside during a lull in the rain.
ex.zh: 趁雨暫時停歇，我們走到了外面。

ex.en: A temporary lull in economic activity may give businesses time to review their long-term strategies.
ex.zh: 經濟活動的暫時放緩可能讓企業有時間重新審視其長期戰略。

col: a lull in activity｜活動的暫時停歇
lull someone to sleep｜哄某人入睡
lull someone into a false sense of security｜使某人產生虛假的安全感
words.tip: lull強調暫時平靜，不表示徹底結束。

tr: n. 疑慮, 不安, 害怕, 擔擾, 疑懼
def: n. doubt about someone's honesty

tr: [化] 蒸汽發生器; 蒸汽機
def: n. a cooking utensil that can be used to cook food by steaming it
n. a ship powered by one or more steam engines
v. travel by means of steam power

ex.en: Put the dumplings in the steamer for ten minutes.
ex.zh: 把餃子放進蒸鍋裡蒸十分鐘。

ex.en: The arrival of the steamer transformed river trade by allowing goods to travel more reliably over long distances.
ex.zh: 蒸汽輪船的出現使貨物能夠更可靠地進行長距離運輸，從而改變了內河貿易。

words.tip: 既可指蒸食物的器具，也可指蒸汽動力船。

def: n. the act of displaying something ostentatiously
v. display proudly; act ostentatiously or pretentiously
To show something proudly to attract attention or admiration.

ex.en: He flaunted his new watch at dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚吃飯時，他炫耀了自己的新手錶。

ex.en: Social media encourages some users to flaunt their wealth, potentially increasing feelings of inadequacy among viewers.
ex.zh: 社交媒體促使一些用戶炫富，這可能加重觀看者的自卑感。

words.tip: flaunt指炫耀；flout指公然無視規則，勿混。

def: n. overly eager speed (and possible carelessness)
n. the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner
Speed in acting, often without enough care or thought.

ex.en: In my haste, I left my keys on the table.
ex.zh: 我匆忙之中把鑰匙落在了桌上。

ex.en: Policies developed in haste may overlook the needs of vulnerable groups and create additional social problems.
ex.zh: 倉促制定的政策可能忽視弱勢群體的需求，並引發更多社會問題。

words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞；in haste意為匆忙地。

tr: vt. 圍繞, 使苦惱, 鑲嵌
def: v. assail or attack on all sides: "The zebra was beset by leopards"

tr: n. 主動表示, 事件的開端, 序言, 提議, 提案, 初步交涉
vt. 提議, 為...奏前奏曲
def: n. orchestral music played at the beginning of an opera or oratorio
n. a tentative suggestion designed to elicit the reactions of others

tr: a. 年代學的, 按時間順序的, 按照年月順序的
[計] 編年的, 按年月日順序的
def: a. relating to or arranged according to temporal order
Arranged in the order in which events happened.

ex.en: We arranged the family photographs in chronological order.
ex.zh: 我們按時間先後排列了這些家庭照片。

ex.en: Presenting historical events in chronological order helps students understand how earlier developments influenced later social changes.
ex.zh: 按時間順序呈現歷史事件，有助於學生理解早期發展如何影響後來的社會變遷。

col: chronological account｜按時間順序的敘述
words.tip: 強調事件發生的先後，不是重要性或邏輯順序。

def: n. a deep opening in the earth's surface
A deep, wide opening in rock or the ground.
A major difference separating people, ideas, or situations.

ex.en: We crossed the deep chasm on a narrow bridge.
ex.zh: 我們沿著一座窄橋跨過了深深的峽谷。

ex.en: Unequal access to digital technology has widened the chasm between wealthy and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 獲取數字技術的機會不平等，擴大了富裕社區與弱勢社區之間的差距。

col: a widening chasm｜不斷擴大的鴻溝
bridge the chasm｜彌合巨大差距
words.tip: ch讀/k/；比喻巨大差距時常用chasm between。

def: n. something serving to conceal plans; a fictitious reason that is concocted in order to conceal the real reason
A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.

ex.en: He used a headache as a pretext to leave.
ex.zh: 他以頭痛為藉口離開了。

ex.en: Companies should not use economic uncertainty as a pretext for abandoning their environmental commitments.
ex.zh: 企業不應以經濟不確定性為藉口，放棄其環保承諾。

col: under the pretext of｜以……為藉口
a pretext for doing something｜做某事的藉口
words.tip: 強調掩蓋真實目的的藉口；常接for或of。

def: n. a rapid active commotion
n. a framework worn at the back below the waist for giving fullness to a woman's skirt
v. move or cause to move energetically or busily

tr: n. 挖苦, 諷刺, 諷刺話, 諷刺性
def: n. witty language used to convey insults or scorn

tr: n. 皺褶, 波紋, 生氣, 混亂
vt. 弄皺, 觸怒, 洗(牌), 連續輕擂(鼓)
vi. 起皺, 發脾氣, 連續輕擂
def: v. trouble or vex
v. discompose
v. erect or fluff up

tr: n. 澱粉, 漿糊, 刻板
def: n. a complex carbohydrate found chiefly in seeds, fruits, tubers, roots and stem pith of plants, notably in corn, potatoes, wheat, and rice; an important foodstuff and used otherwise especially in adhesives and as fillers and stiffeners for paper and textiles
n. a commercial preparation of starch that is used to stiffen textile fabrics in laundering
v. stiffen with starch

ex.en: Mix the corn starch with water before adding it.
ex.zh: 先將玉米澱粉和水混合，再加進去。

ex.en: Foods rich in starch provide energy, but their nutritional value also depends on fibre content and processing methods.
ex.zh: 富含澱粉的食物提供能量，但其營養價值也取決於纖維含量和加工方式。

words.tip: 作“澱粉”通常不可數；starchy意為富含澱粉的。

def: n. an expression of sympathy with another's grief
Sympathy expressed to someone whose relative or friend has died.

ex.en: Our neighbours sent a heartfelt message of condolence.
ex.zh: 鄰居們送來了真摯的慰問。

ex.en: Public expressions of condolence can help bereaved families feel supported by their wider community.
ex.zh: 公開表達哀思可以讓喪親家庭感受到整個社區的支持。

col: a message of condolence｜慰問信息
words.tip: 常用複數：offer condolences to someone。

tr: a. 多孔的, 有氣孔的, 多孔性的, 能滲透的
def: s. able to absorb fluids
a. full of pores or vessels or holes

tr: n. 惡意, 蓄意害人, 怨恨
[法] 預謀, 蓄意, 惡意
def: n. feeling a need to see others suffer
a desire to hurt someone or cause them trouble

ex.en: There was no malice in his teasing smile.
ex.zh: 他打趣的笑容裡並沒有惡意。

ex.en: Schools should distinguish between careless remarks and comments made with malice when addressing conflicts among students.
ex.zh: 學校在處理學生之間的衝突時，應區分無心之言和惡意評論。

words.tip: 通常不可數；with malice 表示“懷著惡意”。

tr: n. 自動化, 自動操作
def: n. the act of implementing the control of equipment with advanced technology; usually involving electronic hardware
n. the condition of being automatically operated or controlled
n. equipment used to achieve automatic control or operation

tr: n. 憂鬱, 悲哀, 愁思
a. 憂鬱的, 使人悲傷的, 愁思的
def: n. a feeling of thoughtful sadness
n. a constitutional tendency to be gloomy and depressed
s. characterized by or causing or expressing sadness
n. part of a compound leaf
A small printed sheet giving information or advertising something.

ex.en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about the new library.
ex.zh: 一位志願者遞給我一張介紹新圖書館的傳單。

ex.en: Health centres can distribute a leaflet explaining how regular exercise helps prevent several common diseases.
ex.zh: 醫療中心可以發放宣傳單，解釋規律運動如何幫助預防幾種常見疾病。

words.tip: leaflet通常是單頁或摺頁；brochure通常為小冊子。

tr: n. 海盜行為, 海上劫掠, 剽竊, 著作權侵害, 非法翻印
[法] 海盜行為, 海上掠奪, 海盜罪
def: n. hijacking on the high seas or in similar contexts; taking a ship or plane away from the control of those who are legally entitled to it

tr: vt. 放氣, 抽出空氣, 使縮小
def: v. collapse by releasing contained air or gas
v. release contained air or gas from
v. reduce or lessen the size or importance of
n. a long narrow depression in a surface

tr: n. 失澤, 失澤膜, 汙點
vt. 使失去光澤, 玷汙
vi. 失去光澤, 被玷汙
def: n. discoloration of metal surface caused by oxidation
v. make dirty or spotty, as by exposure to air; also used metaphorically

tr: a. 沉默寡言的, 不苟言笑的, 緘默的
def: s implied by or inferred from actions or statements
Understood or accepted without being directly stated.

ex.en: Her smile gave me tacit permission to continue.
ex.zh: 她的微笑默許了我繼續下去。

ex.en: Public silence should not be interpreted as tacit approval of policies that restrict access to essential services.
ex.zh: 不應把公眾的沉默理解為對限制基本服務獲取的政策的默許。

words.tip: tacit指未明說但已理解，並非明確表達的同意。

tr: a. 令人愉快的, 同意的
def: a. conforming to your own liking or feelings or nature
s. prepared to agree or consent
pleasant and enjoyable

ex.en: We spent an agreeable afternoon chatting in the garden.
ex.zh: 我們在花園裡聊天，度過了一個愉快的下午。

ex.en: Employees may be more agreeable to organisational changes when managers explain the benefits and address their concerns.
ex.zh: 如果管理者解釋好處並回應員工的顧慮，員工可能會更願意接受組織變革。

col: agreeable to a proposal｜贊同某項提議
words.tip: be agreeable to sth表示願意接受某事，語氣較正式。

tr: n. 禮貌, 規矩, 適當
def: n. correct or appropriate behavior

tr: vt. 使濃縮, 使壓縮, 縮短
def: v. undergo condensation; change from a gaseous to a liquid state and fall in drops
v. remove water from
v. cause a gas or vapor to change into a liquid

tr: v. 辱罵, 用俚語說
def: n. informal language consisting of words and expressions that are not considered appropriate for formal occasions; often vituperative or vulgar
n. a characteristic language of a particular group (as among thieves)
v. use slang or vulgar language

ex.en: My younger cousin uses slang I cannot understand.
ex.zh: 我年紀較小的表弟會用一些我聽不懂的俚語。

ex.en: Although slang can strengthen group identity, excessive use may create barriers between speakers from different generations.
ex.zh: 雖然俚語能增強群體認同，但過度使用可能造成不同代際說話者之間的溝通障礙。

words.tip: 通常不可數；一個俚語表達用a slang term。

def: a. free from filth and pathogens
v. turn aside; turn away from
v. be at variance with; be out of line with
v. cause to turn away from a previous or expected course

ex.en: We deviated from our usual route to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 為了避開擁堵，我們沒有走平時的路線。

ex.en: Researchers must explain why they deviate from agreed procedures, as unexpected changes may affect the reliability of results.
ex.zh: 研究人員必須解釋為何偏離約定程序，因為意外變動可能影響結果的可靠性。

col: deviate from a plan｜偏離計劃
deviate from the norm｜偏離常規
deviate from a route｜偏離路線
words.tip: 通常為不及物動詞，用deviate from表示偏離。

tr: vi. 堅持, 孜孜不倦, 不屈不撓, (辯論中)固執己見
def: v. be persistent, refuse to stop

tr: n. 旅行, 旅行隊, 科學考察
def: n an overland journey by hunters (especially in Africa)

tr: a. 世襲的, 遺傳的
def: s occurring among members of a family usually by heredity
s inherited or inheritable by established rules (usually legal rules) of descent
Passed from parents to children through genes.

ex.en: The doctor asked whether the condition might be hereditary.
ex.zh: 醫生詢問這種病是否可能具有遺傳性。

ex.en: Genetic counselling can help families understand hereditary conditions and make informed decisions about their healthcare.
ex.zh: 遺傳諮詢可以幫助家庭瞭解遺傳性疾病，並對醫療保健作出知情決定。

words.tip: 可指基因遺傳，也可指頭銜世襲；遺傳不等於傳染。

tr: a. 玉蜀黍色的, 黃色的
def: n tall annual cereal grass bearing kernels on large ears: widely cultivated in America in many varieties; the principal cereal in Mexico and Central and South America since pre-Columbian times
n a strong yellow color
n. constitution of the human body
The size, shape, and strength of a person's body.

ex.en: Regular swimming helped Lena develop a strong physique.
ex.zh: 經常游泳幫助莉娜練就了強健的體格。

ex.en: Although physique can influence athletic performance, consistent training and mental preparation are equally important.
ex.zh: 雖然體格會影響運動表現，但持續訓練和心理準備同樣重要。

words.tip: 可用於任何性別，常與描述體形的形容詞搭配。

tr: a. 可憎的, 使人不愉快的, 令人討厭的
def: s causing disapproval or protest
extremely unpleasant or offensive

ex.en: An obnoxious passenger played loud music throughout the journey.
ex.zh: 一個討厭的乘客一路都在大聲播放音樂。

ex.en: Obnoxious behaviour on public transport can discourage commuters from using otherwise convenient and affordable services.
ex.zh: 公共交通上的惡劣行為可能讓通勤者不願使用原本便捷又實惠的服務。

words.tip: 語氣比annoying強，常形容無禮的人或行為。

tr: n. 反駁, 頂嘴, 蒸餾器, 曲頸甑
vi. 反駁, 回嘴, 反擊
vt. 反擊, 反駁, 蒸餾
def: n. a vessel where substances are distilled or decomposed by heat
v. answer back

tr: n. 營養失調, 營養不良
def: n. a state of poor nutrition; can result from insufficient or excessive or unbalanced diet or from inability to absorb foods
poor health caused by insufficient or unbalanced nutrients

ex.en: The rescued kitten needed special food to treat malnutrition.
ex.zh: 這隻獲救的小貓需要特殊食物來治療營養不良。

ex.en: School meal programmes can reduce childhood malnutrition by providing balanced diets to children from low-income households.
ex.zh: 學校供餐計劃可以為低收入家庭的兒童提供均衡飲食，從而減少兒童營養不良。

words.tip: 不可數；不僅指吃得少，也包括營養攝入失衡。

def: n. the sport of gliding on skates

tr: vt. 使附於, 署名, 粘貼, 蓋印於
def: n. a linguistic element added to a word to produce an inflected or derived form
v. attach to
v. attach or become attached to a stem word

tr: n. 垂直線, 垂直的位置, 直立(姿勢), 剛正, 垂規
a. 垂直的, 直立的, 陡峭的
def: n. a straight line at right angles to another line
n. a Gothic style in 14th and 15th century England; characterized by vertical lines and a four-centered (Tudor) arch and fan vaulting
n. an extremely steep face

ex.en: Keep the drill perpendicular to the wooden board.
ex.zh: 讓電鑽與木板保持垂直。

ex.en: The proposed cycle path runs perpendicular to the main road, creating a crossing that requires careful safety planning.
ex.zh: 擬建自行車道與主幹道垂直相交，形成的交叉口需要周密的安全規劃。

words.tip: 表示與某物垂直用perpendicular to，不用with。

def: n. (biology) growth anew of lost tissue or destroyed parts or organs
n. the activity of spiritual or physical renewal
the process of improving a place or system in decline

ex.en: The neighbourhood's regeneration brought new shops to our street.
ex.zh: 街區改造讓我們這條街有了新商店。

ex.en: Urban regeneration can create employment, but rising rents may force existing residents to leave their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 城市更新能夠創造就業機會，但租金上漲可能迫使原有居民搬離所在街區。

words.tip: 城市話題指更新改造；生物學中指組織再生。

tr: a. 破壞的；荒廢的, 要塌似的
def: v bring into a condition of decay or partial ruin by neglect or misuse
v fall into decay or ruin
s in deplorable condition

tr: a. 惰性的, 遲鈍的, 無活力的, 呆滯的
[醫] 惰性的, 無作用的, 無效的
def: s. unable to move or resist motion
s. having only a limited ability to react chemically; chemically inactive
s. slow and apathetic
n. small flat ring-shaped cake or cookie
v. be all mixed up or jumbled together
v. assemble without order or sense

tr: a. 義務的, 必須的, 強制性的
[法] 有拘束的, 強制的, 必須的
def: a. morally or legally constraining or binding
s. required by obligation or compulsion or convention

tr: n. 敲打, 碰撞, 叩擊, 叩診, 擊發, 打擊, 打擊樂器組
def: n. the act of playing a percussion instrument
n. the act of exploding a percussion cap
n. tapping a part of the body for diagnostic purposes

ex.en: My sister plays percussion in the school band.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在學校樂隊裡演奏打擊樂器。

ex.en: Group percussion lessons can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and creative expression.
ex.zh: 集體打擊樂課程可以幫助兒童發展協調能力，同時促進合作與創造性表達。

words.tip: 總稱時不可數；一件打擊樂器用a percussion instrument。

tr: n. 破裂, 斷裂, 裂開, 決裂, 不和
def: n. state of being torn or burst open
n. a personal or social separation (as between opposing factions)
n. the act of making a sudden noisy break

tr: a. 不適當的, 不理智的, 笨拙的
[法] 不稱職者, 無能的, 不符要求的
def: s. revealing lack of perceptiveness or judgment or finesse

tr: n. 父親身份, 父系血統, 創始人(身份), 來源, 出處
[醫] 父權, 親權; 父系
def: n. the state of being a father

tr: a. 模糊的, 不確定的, 無限的
[法] 不確定的, 無限制的
def: a. vague or not clearly defined or stated
s. not decided or not known

tr: vt. 悲悼, 哀嘆, 對...深感遺憾
def: v. express strong disapproval of
v. regret strongly
To strongly disapprove of something or deeply regret it

ex.en: Our neighbours deplore the dumping of rubbish beside the river.
ex.zh: 鄰居們強烈譴責在河邊傾倒垃圾的行為。

ex.en: Many educators deplore funding cuts that limit access to music and art lessons in public schools.
ex.zh: 許多教育工作者強烈反對削減經費，因為這限制了公立學校學生接受音樂和美術教育的機會。

col: deplore the lack of｜對缺乏……深感遺憾
deplore the decision｜強烈反對該決定
words.tip: 正式及物動詞，後直接接所譴責或痛惜的事。

tr: n. 對立, 敵對, 敵意
[化] 拮抗作用; 消效作用
def: n. the relation between opposing principles or forces or factors
n. an actively expressed feeling of dislike and hostility
n. (biochemistry) interference in or inhibition of the physiological action of a chemical substance by another having a similar structure

tr: n. 輔助者, 輔助物, 附屬機構, 助動詞
a. 輔助的, 備用的
def: s. functioning in a supporting capacity
providing extra help or support when needed
a verb used with another verb to form grammatical structures

ex.en: The boat has an auxiliary engine for emergencies.
ex.zh: 這艘船裝有一臺應急用的備用發動機。

ex.en: Hospitals require auxiliary power systems to maintain essential medical services during unexpected electricity failures.
ex.zh: 醫院需要備用供電系統，以便在意外停電時維持必要的醫療服務。

words.tip: 語法中 auxiliary verb 指助動詞，如 be、have、do。

tr: n. 最後通牒, 基本原理
[法] 最後通牒, 哀的美敦書, 最後結論
def: n. a final peremptory demand
a final demand threatening consequences if it is not accepted

ex.en: The coach gave us an ultimatum: attend practice or leave.
ex.zh: 教練向我們下了最後通牒：參加訓練，否則離隊。

ex.en: The council issued an ultimatum requiring the factory to improve waste treatment or face closure.
ex.zh: 市政委員會下達了最後通牒，要求工廠改善廢物處理，否則將被關閉。

col: issue an ultimatum｜發出最後通牒
give someone an ultimatum｜向某人下最後通牒
reject an ultimatum｜拒絕最後通牒
words.tip: 常用give someone an ultimatum；複數常為ultimatums。

tr: n. 缺乏, 糧食不足, 饑饉
def: n. an acute insufficiency
n. an insufficient quantity or number

tr: a. 共鳴的, 反響的, 洪亮的, 共振的
[醫] 反響的, 叩響的, 共鳴的, 共振的
def: s. characterized by resonance

tr: n. 細頸瓶, 燒瓶, 小水瓶
def: n. bottle that has a narrow neck
n. the quantity a flask will hold

tr: vt. 懷恨, 嫉妒, 吝惜
def: n. a resentment strong enough to justify retaliation
v. accept or admit unwillingly
Lasting anger towards someone because of an earlier wrong

ex.en: She still holds a grudge over the broken vase.
ex.zh: 她仍因花瓶被打碎的事心懷怨恨。

ex.en: Unresolved workplace conflicts can lead employees to hold grudges, reducing cooperation and damaging team morale.
ex.zh: 未解決的職場衝突可能導致員工心懷積怨，削弱合作並損害團隊士氣。

col: bear a grudge against someone｜對某人懷恨在心
words.tip: hold a grudge against sb表示對某人懷恨在心。

def: n. a list of writings with time and place of publication (such as the writings of a single author or the works referred to in preparing a document etc.)
a list of sources used or relevant to a subject

ex.en: I added the missing book to my essay's bibliography.
ex.zh: 我把漏掉的那本書補進了論文的參考書目。

ex.en: A carefully prepared bibliography allows readers to locate sources and examine the evidence supporting an academic argument.
ex.zh: 精心編制的參考書目能讓讀者找到資料來源，並查驗支持學術論點的證據。

col: compile a bibliography｜編制參考書目
annotated bibliography｜附註釋的參考書目
words.tip: bibliography是資料清單；biography是人物傳記。

tr: vt. 亂塗, 使模糊, 吸乾
vi. 弄上墨漬, 吸墨水
def: n. an act that brings discredit to the person who does it
v. dry (ink) with blotting paper

tr: a. 被逐出的, 被遺棄的, 無家可歸的
n. 被驅逐的人, 流浪者
def: n. a person who is rejected (from society or home)
Someone rejected and excluded by a group or society.
Rejected and excluded by other people.

ex.en: After the argument, he felt like an outcast.
ex.zh: 爭吵之後，他覺得自己像個被排斥的人。

ex.en: Schools should ensure that no child becomes an outcast because of their background or appearance.
ex.zh: 學校應確保沒有孩子因背景或外貌而受到排斥。

col: a social outcast｜被社會排斥的人
feel like an outcast｜覺得自己被排斥
treat someone as an outcast｜把某人當作異類排斥
words.tip: 主要作名詞，指被排斥者，並不等於流浪者或流氓。

tr: a. 溫順的, 逆來順受的
def: s. humble in spirit or manner; suggesting retiring mildness or even cowed submissiveness
s. very docile
s. evidencing little spirit or courage; overly submissive or compliant

ex.en: He gave a meek nod and stepped aside.
ex.zh: 他順從地點了點頭，退到一旁。

ex.en: Students who seem meek in class may express strong opinions when given a supportive discussion environment.
ex.zh: 課堂上看似溫順的學生，在得到支持的討論環境中也可能表達堅定的觀點。

words.tip: 常暗含不敢反抗，不等同於褒義的 humble。

tr: n. 不幸之事, 災禍, 惡運
def: n. an instance of misfortune

tr: v. 燒焦, 拷焦, (使)枯萎, 諷刺
def: n. a surface burn
n. a plant disease that produces a browning or scorched appearance of plant tissues
n. a discoloration caused by heat

ex.en: The hot iron scorched my favourite cotton shirt.
ex.zh: 滾燙的熨斗把我最喜歡的棉襯衫燙焦了。

ex.en: Prolonged heatwaves can scorch crops, reducing agricultural yields and threatening food supplies in vulnerable regions.
ex.zh: 持續的熱浪會使莊稼焦枯，降低農業產量，並威脅脆弱地區的糧食供應。

words.tip: 常指表面燒焦，不一定燒燬；太陽也能scorch植物。

tr: n. 預兆, 前兆, 徵兆
vt. 預示, 有...的前兆, 顯出...的預兆
def: n. a sign of something about to happen

tr: a. 腐敗的, 膿毒性的
def: a. containing or resulting from disease-causing organisms
a. of or relating to or caused by putrefaction
infected with harmful bacteria, or relating to such infection

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the septic wound and changed its dressing.
ex.zh: 護士清潔了感染的傷口，並更換了敷料。

ex.en: Prompt treatment of bacterial infections can reduce the risk of septic shock and improve patient outcomes.
ex.zh: 及時治療細菌感染可以降低膿毒性休克的風險，改善患者的治療結果。

words.tip: septic tank 指化糞池；septic 不作“腐爛物”名詞。

tr: a. 朝生暮死的, 短命的, 短暫的
def: s. lasting a very short time

tr: a. 熱的, 炎熱的, 熱心的
def: s. extremely hot
showing very strong and sincere feelings or beliefs

ex.en: She is a fervent supporter of our local football team.
ex.zh: 她是我們當地足球隊的熱情支持者。

ex.en: Fervent supporters of wildlife conservation argue that protecting natural habitats should take priority over commercial development.
ex.zh: 野生動物保護的熱心支持者認為，保護自然棲息地應優先於商業開發。

col: a fervent supporter｜熱情的支持者
a fervent believer｜堅定的信奉者
words.tip: 語氣較正式，常修飾supporter、belief、hope。

def: n drops of fresh water that fall as precipitation from clouds

tr: n. 共和國；聯邦；國民整體
def: n. the official name of some states in the United States (Massachusetts and Pennsylvania and Virginia and Kentucky) and associated territories (Puerto Rico)
n. a world organization of autonomous states that are united in allegiance to a central power but are not subordinate to it or to one another
A politically organised community, especially one governed for public benefit.

ex.en: The islanders established a commonwealth with an elected council.
ex.zh: 島民建立了一個由民選議會治理的政治共同體。

ex.en: Members of the Commonwealth cooperate on education and development while maintaining their own independent governments.
ex.zh: 英聯邦成員在教育和發展領域開展合作，同時保有各自獨立的政府。

words.tip: 指英聯邦時首字母大寫，通常與the連用。

tr: a. 可怕的, 慘白的, 極壞的
adv. 可怖地, 慘白地
def: s. shockingly repellent; inspiring horror

tr: a. 勤勉的, 用功的
def: s. quietly and steadily persevering especially in detail or exactness
a. characterized by care and perseverance in carrying out tasks
Working carefully and consistently with strong effort

ex.en: Our diligent neighbour checks her vegetable plants every morning.
ex.zh: 我們那位勤快的鄰居每天早晨都會查看自己種的蔬菜。

ex.en: Diligent research helps students develop stronger arguments and avoid relying on inaccurate information in academic essays.
ex.zh: 認真細緻的研究有助於學生提出更有力的論點，避免在學術文章中依賴不準確的信息。

col: diligent in one's work｜工作認真盡責
words.tip: 不僅指努力，也強調認真、細緻和持續投入。

tr: n. 生活資料, 生計, 食物, 支持
[法] 營養物, 維持, 支持
def: n. the act of sustaining life by food or providing a means of subsistence

tr: a. 即時的, 瞬間的, 猝發的
def: s. occurring with no delay
Happening immediately, with no noticeable delay.

ex.en: The relief was almost instantaneous when I removed my shoes.
ex.zh: 我一脫下鞋，幾乎立刻就感覺輕鬆了。

ex.en: Modern communication networks allow almost instantaneous exchanges of information between researchers working on different continents.
ex.zh: 現代通信網絡讓不同大洲的研究人員幾乎能夠即時交換信息。

words.tip: 強調幾乎沒有時間間隔，不等於同時發生。

tr: a. 龐大的, 驚人的, 異常的
def: s so great in size or force or extent as to elicit awe
s of momentous or ominous significance
s far beyond what is usual in magnitude or degree

tr: vt. 代替, 取代, 接替
[法] 替代, 替換, 充任
def: v take the place or move into the position of
To replace something older or no longer useful.

ex.en: This new timetable supersedes the one on our fridge.
ex.zh: 這份新時刻表取代了我們冰箱上的舊時刻表。

ex.en: Digital payment systems may eventually supersede cash in many settings, although accessibility concerns must first be addressed.
ex.zh: 數字支付系統最終可能在許多場景中取代現金，但必須先解決使用便利性方面的問題。

col: supersede existing rules｜取代現有規則
supersede earlier versions｜取代早期版本
words.tip: 注意拼寫結尾是-sede，不是-cede；常用被動式。

tr: vt. 使糾纏, 捲入, 使混亂
def: v. entrap
v. twist together or entwine into a confusing mass
n. a means of serving
v. use to one's advantage
v. be of use to, be useful to

tr: a. 易怒的, 急躁的
[醫] 應激性的, 過敏的
def: s. abnormally sensitive to a stimulus

tr: adv. 恰當地, 充分地, 適當地, 及時地
def: r at the proper time

tr: n. 裂口, 張嘴, 打哈欠
vi. 裂開, 張嘴, 打哈欠
def: n. an expression of openmouthed astonishment
n. a stare of amazement (usually with the mouth open)
v. be wide open

tr: [法] 損害, 傷害, 危害
def: n. a damage or loss
Harm or damage caused to someone or something.

ex.en: He works late, often to the detriment of his sleep.
ex.zh: 他工作到很晚，常常因此影響睡眠。

ex.en: Prioritising short-term profits to the detriment of environmental protection can create substantial costs for future generations.
ex.zh: 為了優先追求短期利潤而損害環境保護，可能讓後代付出巨大代價。

col: a detriment to health｜對健康的不利因素
words.tip: 最常見於to the detriment of，表示以損害……為代價。

tr: n. 闡述, 講解, 說明, 博覽會, 展覽會
[經] 展覽會, 集市, 義賣市場
def: n. a systematic interpretation or explanation (usually written) of a specific topic
n. an account that sets forth the meaning or intent of a writing or discourse
n. (music) the section of a movement (especially in sonata form) where the major musical themes first occur

tr: n. 年輕未婚女子, 少女, 處女
a. 未婚的, 處女的, 初次的, 無經驗的
def: n an unmarried girl (especially a virgin)
n (cricket) an over in which no runs are scored
s serving to set in motion

ex.en: The new ferry completed its maiden voyage this morning.
ex.zh: 這艘新渡輪今天上午完成了首航。

ex.en: The aircraft's maiden flight marked an important step towards developing cleaner forms of regional transport.
ex.zh: 這架飛機的首飛標誌著開發更清潔的區域交通方式邁出了重要一步。

words.tip: 形容詞常指首次；名詞指少女時帶文學或古舊色彩。

tr: vt. 訂正, 矯正, 改正, 調正, 校正, 精餾, 整流
def: v. math: determine the length of
v. set straight or right
v. convert into direct current

ex.en: The shop quickly rectified the mistake and refunded me.
ex.zh: 商店很快糾正了錯誤，並給我退款。

ex.en: Local authorities must rectify weaknesses in drainage systems before increasingly heavy rainfall causes further damage.
ex.zh: 地方政府必須在日益強烈的降雨造成更多損害之前，糾正排水系統中的缺陷。

words.tip: 正式用詞，常接error、mistake、situation。

tr: n. 愛好, 素質, 癖性, 天性, 傾向, 易感受性
def: n. an inclination beforehand to interpret statements in a particular way
n. a disposition in advance to react in a particular way
A natural tendency to develop a particular illness or condition.

ex.en: My doctor explained that a predisposition does not guarantee illness.
ex.zh: 醫生向我解釋，有患病傾向並不意味著一定會生病。

ex.en: Although genetic predisposition influences the risk of diabetes, regular exercise and a balanced diet can offer protection.
ex.zh: 雖然遺傳易感性會影響患糖尿病的風險，但規律運動和均衡飲食能起到保護作用。

col: a predisposition to diabetes｜糖尿病易感體質
a predisposition towards anxiety｜焦慮傾向
words.tip: 常接to；表示更易發生，不代表必然發生。

tr: vt. 用鉚釘固定, 敲進去, 注目, 吸引住
def: n. heavy pin having a head at one end and the other end being hammered flat after being passed through holes in the pieces that are fastened together
v. fasten with a rivet or rivets
v. hold (someone's attention)

tr: a. 鹽的, 苦澀的, 由鹼金屬(或含鎂之鹽類)組成的
n. 鹽湖, 鹽田, 鹼鹽瀉藥, 生理鹽水
def: s. containing salt
containing salt or relating to salt
a salt solution, especially one used in medical treatment

ex.en: The nurse gently cleaned the wound with saline.
ex.zh: 護士用生理鹽水輕輕清洗了傷口。

ex.en: Rising sea levels can make coastal groundwater more saline, reducing its suitability for drinking and irrigation.
ex.zh: 海平面上升會使沿海地下水的含鹽量增加，降低其飲用和灌溉適用性。

words.tip: 醫學中saline常指生理鹽水，不指鹽湖。

def: n. a weak and tremulous light
v. shine with a weak or fitful light
v. give off a shimmering reflection, as of silk

tr: n. 點心, 起提神作用的事物, 精神爽快
def: n. snacks and drinks served as a light meal
n. activity that refreshes and recreates; activity that renews your health and spirits by enjoyment and relaxation
small amounts of food and drink, usually served during breaks

ex.en: They served refreshments in the garden after the meeting.
ex.zh: 會後，他們在花園裡提供了茶點。

ex.en: Providing free refreshments during community events can create a welcoming atmosphere and encourage informal conversations among residents.
ex.zh: 在社區活動中免費提供茶點可以營造友好氛圍，促進居民之間的輕鬆交流。

words.tip: 指茶點時通常用複數refreshments；指恢復精神時不可數。

tr: a. 熱忱的, 誠懇的, 有興奮作用的
def: s. politely warm and friendly
s. sincerely or intensely felt
Friendly and polite, often in a formal situation.

ex.en: Our new neighbours gave us a cordial welcome.
ex.zh: 新鄰居熱情地歡迎了我們。

ex.en: Maintaining cordial relations between neighbouring countries can encourage cooperation on trade and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 鄰國之間保持友好關係有助於促進貿易和環境保護方面的合作。

words.tip: 形容友好態度較正式；名詞在英國常指濃縮果飲。

tr: n. 小宇宙, 小世界, 人類
def: n. a miniature model of something
A small system showing the features of a larger one.

ex.en: Our busy kitchen is a microcosm of family life.
ex.zh: 我們忙碌的廚房是家庭生活的一個縮影。

ex.en: A diverse urban neighbourhood can serve as a microcosm of the wider society's opportunities and challenges.
ex.zh: 一個多元化的城市社區可以成為整個社會所面臨的機遇與挑戰的縮影。

col: a microcosm of society｜社會的縮影
serve as a microcosm｜充當縮影
words.tip: 常用a microcosm of，指縮影，不只是微小事物。

tr: n. 辛苦, 苦心, 工夫
a. 辛苦的, 勤勉的, 小心的
極其細緻的；煞費苦心的
def: s characterized by extreme care and great effort
Done with great care, effort, and attention to detail.

ex.en: She made painstaking repairs to her grandmother's old quilt.
ex.zh: 她極其細緻地修補了祖母的舊被子。

ex.en: The preservation of historic buildings requires painstaking research into original materials and traditional construction methods.
ex.zh: 保護歷史建築需要對原有材料和傳統建造方法進行細緻深入的研究。

col: painstaking attention to detail｜對細節的極度關注
words.tip: 是形容詞，強調費心且細緻，不只是辛苦。

def: n. the act of reserving (a place or passage) or engaging the services of (a person or group)
An arrangement to reserve a room, seat, or service.

ex.en: I called the hotel to confirm our booking.
ex.zh: 我打電話給酒店確認我們的預訂。

ex.en: Online booking systems allow tourists to compare accommodation prices and plan their journeys more efficiently.
ex.zh: 在線預訂系統讓遊客能夠比較住宿價格，更高效地規劃行程。

words.tip: booking是可數名詞；預訂某項服務常用booking for。

tr: a. 神經質的, 神經症的
def: n. a person suffering from neurosis
a. characteristic of or affected by neurosis
a. affected with emotional disorder

tr: a. 服從的, 順從的, 孝順的
[法] 服從的, 順從的, 忠順的
def: a. dutifully complying with the commands or instructions of those in authority; the refractory remain unburdened"- Edmund Burke

tr: n. 槳, 槳手, 攪棒
def: n. an implement used to propel or steer a boat
A long pole with a flat blade for rowing boats

ex.en: He lifted one oar and gently pushed the boat away.
ex.zh: 他抬起一支船槳，輕輕把船撐開。

ex.en: Visitors can explore the lake in traditional boats, using oars rather than engines to minimise disturbance to wildlife.
ex.zh: 遊客可以乘傳統小船遊湖，用槳而非發動機推進，以儘量減少對野生動物的干擾。

col: a pair of oars｜一對船槳
pull on the oars｜用力划槳
words.tip: oar通常支在船側划動；paddle通常手持划動。

tr: a. 不顧的, 無關的, 沒關係的
def: r in spite of everything; without regard to drawbacks
Without considering or being affected by something, used with of.

ex.en: Everyone can join the walk, irrespective of their age.
ex.zh: 無論年齡大小，人人都可以參加這次步行活動。

ex.en: Quality education should be available to all children, irrespective of their family income or social background.
ex.zh: 所有兒童都應能獲得優質教育，無論其家庭收入或社會背景如何。

col: irrespective of the outcome｜不論結果如何
words.tip: 通常用irrespective of＋名詞，意為“不論”。

tr: n. 運動員, 冒險家
男運動員；男性運動愛好者
def: n someone who engages in sports
a man who plays sports, especially with skill

ex.en: My uncle was a keen sportsman in his youth.
ex.zh: 我叔叔年輕時非常熱愛運動。

ex.en: A successful sportsman can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop confidence through physical activity.
ex.zh: 成功的男運動員可以鼓勵年輕人經常鍛鍊，並通過體育活動培養自信。

col: talented sportsman｜有天賦的男運動員
words.tip: 特指男性；不強調性別時可用athlete。

def: n. the young of an animal cared for at one time
v. think moodily or anxiously about something
v. hang over, as of something threatening, dark, or menacing

ex.en: The duck led her brood across the quiet pond.
ex.zh: 鴨媽媽領著一窩小鴨遊過平靜的池塘。

ex.en: Students who brood over minor setbacks may find it harder to maintain motivation during demanding courses.
ex.zh: 對小挫折耿耿於懷的學生，可能更難在繁重的課程中保持學習動力。

col: a brood of chicks｜一窩雛鳥
brood over a mistake｜對一個錯誤耿耿於懷
brood on the past｜為往事憂思
words.tip: 作動詞表憂思時常接over或on。

tr: a. 美味的, 好吃的, 可口的
def: a. acceptable to the taste or mind
pleasant enough to eat or drink
acceptable or satisfactory, even if not entirely welcome

ex.en: A little lemon juice made the soup more palatable.
ex.zh: 加了一點檸檬汁後，湯變得更合口味了。

ex.en: Gradual increases in public transport fares may be more palatable to passengers than sudden price rises.
ex.zh: 與突然漲價相比，逐步提高公共交通票價可能更容易讓乘客接受。

col: make something palatable｜使某物可接受
words.tip: 不一定指“美味極了”；也可形容方案可接受。

tr: a. 眼睛的, 視覺的, 光學的
def: n the organ of sight
a of or relating to or resembling the eye
a relating to or using sight

tr: n. 被接見者, 被採訪者, 被面試者
def: n. a person who is interviewed

tr: n. 管理人, 保管人, 監護人
def: n. one having charge of buildings or grounds or animals
A person or organisation responsible for protecting or managing something.
Someone employed to clean and maintain a building, especially in America.

ex.en: The custodian carefully locked the cabinet containing ancient coins.
ex.zh: 保管人小心地鎖好了存放古錢幣的櫃子。

ex.en: Museums act as custodians of cultural heritage, preserving valuable objects for research and future generations.
ex.zh: 博物館充當文化遺產的守護者，為研究和後代保存珍貴物品。

col: custodian of cultural heritage｜文化遺產守護者
words.tip: custodian of後接所保管或守護的對象。

tr: n. 色調, 色彩, 氣味, 氣息
def: v. affect as in thought or feeling
A slight amount of colour, feeling, or another quality
To give something a slight colour or emotional quality

ex.en: The clouds had a pink tinge after sunset.
ex.zh: 日落後，雲朵帶著一抹淡粉色。

ex.en: For many graduates, the excitement of entering employment is tinged with anxiety about financial independence.
ex.zh: 對許多畢業生來說，步入職場的興奮中夾雜著對經濟獨立的焦慮。

col: a tinge of sadness｜一絲悲傷
be tinged with regret｜略帶遺憾
words.tip: a tinge of表示少許；be tinged with表示略帶。

tr: a. 緊握的, 固執的, 不屈不撓的, 黏著力強的
def: a good at remembering
s stubbornly unyielding
s sticking together

ex.en: The tenacious runner kept going despite the steep hill.
ex.zh: 儘管山坡陡峭，那位意志頑強的跑者仍繼續前進。

ex.en: Tenacious researchers often overcome repeated setbacks before producing discoveries that significantly improve public health.
ex.zh: 堅韌不拔的研究人員往往要克服重重挫折，才能取得顯著改善公共健康的發現。

col: a tenacious campaigner｜堅持不懈的倡導者
words.tip: 核心是堅持不放棄；也可形容抓得緊或難消除。

def: n. paper cut to an appropriate size for writing letters; usually with matching envelopes
Materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

ex.en: I bought some stationery for my new evening class.
ex.zh: 我為新報的夜校課程買了些文具。

ex.en: Providing basic stationery can help disadvantaged students participate more fully in classroom activities and complete assignments.
ex.zh: 提供基本文具可以幫助弱勢學生更充分地參與課堂活動並完成作業。

words.tip: 不可數；勿與stationary（靜止的）混淆。

tr: n. 時尚, 時髦, 流行
a. 流行的, 時髦的
def: n. the popular taste at a given time
n. a current state of general acceptance and use
a style or practice popular at a particular time

ex.en: Wide trousers are back in vogue this summer.
ex.zh: 今年夏天，闊腿褲又流行起來了。

ex.en: The current vogue for repairing old furniture may help reduce household waste and encourage more sustainable consumption.
ex.zh: 當前修復舊傢俱的風潮可能有助於減少家庭垃圾，並鼓勵更可持續的消費。

words.tip: 常用in vogue表示“流行”；不是普通的可數物品。

tr: n. 奧德賽(古希臘史詩)
def: n. a long wandering and eventful journey
n. a Greek epic poem (attributed to Homer) describing the journey of Odysseus after the fall of Troy
a long journey involving many difficult or exciting experiences

ex.en: Their cycling odyssey took them across deserts and mountains.
ex.zh: 他們漫長的騎行歷程帶他們穿越了沙漠和群山。

ex.en: The documentary follows one family's odyssey across several continents, exploring how migration reshapes identity and belonging.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片跟隨一個家庭跨越數大洲的漫長旅程，探討遷移如何重塑身份認同與歸屬感。

words.tip: 文學色彩較強，也可比喻人生探索；複數odysseys。

tr: a. 道歉的, 急於認錯的, 辯護的
[法] 辯護的, 辯解的, 道歉的
def: a. offering or expressing apology
Showing that you are sorry for something.

ex.en: She gave an apologetic smile after spilling my tea.
ex.zh: 她打翻我的茶後，露出了歉意的微笑。

ex.en: An apologetic response to customer complaints is helpful, but companies must also address the underlying problems.
ex.zh: 以歉意回應顧客投訴是有幫助的，但企業也必須解決根本問題。

words.tip: 常接about或for說明歉意的緣由。

def: n. the whiteness that results from removing the color from something
n. the act of whitening something by bleaching it (exposing it to sunlight or using a chemical bleaching agent)
v. remove color from

tr: n. 電動扶梯, 自動扶梯
def: n. a stairway whose steps move continuously on a circulating belt
moving stairs that carry people between floors

ex.en: Hold the handrail while you ride the escalator upstairs.
ex.zh: 乘自動扶梯上樓時，請扶好扶手。

ex.en: Although escalators improve passenger flow in stations, lifts are essential for travellers who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 儘管自動扶梯能改善車站的客流通行情況，但對使用輪椅的旅客而言，電梯必不可少。

col: an upward escalator｜上行自動扶梯
words.tip: escalator是自動扶梯；lift是廂式電梯。

tr: n. 滋養品, 養料, 營養
def: n. the act of nourishing
n. lack of agreement or harmony
n. disagreement among those expected to cooperate
n. strife resulting from a lack of agreement

ex.en: Arguments about chores caused discord among the flatmates.
ex.zh: 關於家務的爭吵導致室友之間不和。

ex.en: Unequal access to resources can fuel social discord, particularly when communities feel excluded from political decisions.
ex.zh: 資源獲取不平等會加劇社會紛爭，尤其是在群體感到被排除在政治決策之外時。

col: a source of discord｜紛爭的根源
words.tip: 表示不和時通常不可數，語氣比disagreement正式。

tr: vt. 刺穿, 刺, 揭穿
def: n. loss of air pressure in a tire when a hole is made by some sharp object
n. a small hole made by a sharp object
n. the act of puncturing or perforating

ex.en: A puncture in my bicycle tyre made me late.
ex.zh: 我的自行車輪胎被扎破了，害得我遲到了。

ex.en: Sharp debris on poorly maintained cycle lanes can puncture tyres and discourage residents from cycling to work.
ex.zh: 維護不善的自行車道上的尖銳碎屑可能扎破輪胎，使居民不願騎車上班。

col: repair a puncture｜修補輪胎刺孔
words.tip: 英式英語說get a puncture；美式常說get a flat。

tr: a. 憤怒的, 憤慨的
def: s. angered at something unjust or wrong
Angry because something seems unfair or insulting.

ex.en: She was indignant when someone pushed ahead in the queue.
ex.zh: 有人插隊時，她感到憤憤不平。

ex.en: Residents were indignant about the council's decision to close their only public swimming pool.
ex.zh: 市政委員會決定關閉當地唯一的公共遊泳池，居民對此十分憤慨。

col: indignant at the suggestion｜對這一提議感到憤慨
words.tip: 強調因不公或受辱而生氣，不泛指憤怒。

tr: a. 狂熱的, 發狂的, 瘋的
def: n usually large hard-shelled seed
n Egyptian goddess of the sky
n a small (usually square or hexagonal) metal block with internal screw thread to be fitted onto a bolt

tr: n. 隨後發生的事情, 結果
a. 作為結果的, 合乎邏輯的
def: s following or accompanying as a consequence

tr: a. 敏捷熟練的, 靈巧的
def: s. skillful in physical movements; especially of the hands
Skilful, quick, and controlled in movement or action.

ex.en: With a deft movement, she caught the falling cup.
ex.zh: 她動作敏捷，一把接住了掉落的杯子。

ex.en: Effective classroom management requires deft handling of disagreements between students from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 有效的課堂管理需要巧妙處理不同背景學生之間的分歧。

words.tip: 既可形容手部動作靈巧，也可指處理問題巧妙。

tr: n. 唯利是圖者, 僱傭兵
a. 為錢而工作的, 被僱的, 圖利的
def: n. a person hired to fight for another country than their own
s. serving for wages in a foreign army
Caring mainly about money rather than other considerations

ex.en: His mercenary attitude spoiled our plans for the charity.
ex.zh: 他唯利是圖的態度破壞了我們的慈善計劃。

ex.en: A purely mercenary approach to healthcare risks placing financial returns above the needs of patients.
ex.zh: 對醫療服務採取純粹逐利的做法，可能會使經濟回報凌駕於患者需求之上。

words.tip: 形容詞帶貶義，強調只看重金錢；作名詞指僱傭兵。

tr: v. 破壞, 侵犯, 違反
def: v go against, as of rules and laws
v advance beyond the usual limit

tr: vt. 使成不毛, 使絕育, 殺菌, 使不起作用
[醫] 滅菌, 消毒; 絕育
def: v. make free from bacteria
v. make infertile

tr: n. 家事, 家政, 持家
def: n the work of cleaning and running a house
v maintain a household; take care of all business related to a household

tr: n. 錯誤的觀念(或信念), 謬見, 謬論
[醫] 錯覺, 幻覺, 虛妄
def: n. a misconception resulting from incorrect reasoning
A belief that is commonly accepted but actually false.
An error in reasoning that makes an argument unreliable.

ex.en: It is a fallacy that expensive shoes always last longer.
ex.zh: 認為昂貴的鞋子總是更耐穿，是一種錯誤觀念。

ex.en: The claim that economic growth automatically benefits every citizen rests on a fallacy about how wealth is distributed.
ex.zh: 經濟增長會自動惠及每位公民的說法，建立在對財富分配方式的錯誤認識之上。

words.tip: 不只是事實錯誤，也常指論證中的邏輯錯誤。

tr: a. 不能征服的, 無敵的
def: s. incapable of being overcome or subdued

tr: a. 斜的, 傾斜的, 間接的, 不光明正大的, 躲躲閃閃的
def: n. any grammatical case other than the nominative
a. slanting or inclined in direction or course or position--neither parallel nor perpendicular nor right-angled

tr: a. 暗淡的, 昏暗的, 邋遢的
def: s thickly covered with ingrained dirt or soot
s (of color) discolored by impurities; not bright and clear
s causing dejection

tr: a. 無效力的, 無效的, 無價值的
n. 零, 空, 零位
def: s. lacking any legal or binding force
Having no legal force or effect.
Having a zero value or representing no stored value.

ex.en: The court declared their rental agreement null and void.
ex.zh: 法院宣佈他們的租賃協議無效。

ex.en: A contract may be declared null if one party was forced to accept its terms.
ex.zh: 如果一方被迫接受合同條款，該合同可能被宣佈無效。

words.tip: 法律中常用null and void；編程空值不一定等於零。

tr: a. 俗麗的, 華而不實的
def: n. (Britain) a celebratory reunion feast or entertainment held a college
Too brightly coloured or heavily decorated to look attractive.

ex.en: He wore a gaudy jacket covered in shiny sequins.
ex.zh: 他穿了一件綴滿亮片的花哨夾克。

ex.en: Some residents argue that gaudy decorations in historic districts undermine the visual character of traditional buildings.
ex.zh: 一些居民認為，歷史街區裡俗豔的裝飾破壞了傳統建築的視覺風貌。

words.tip: 含貶義，指顏色或裝飾過分搶眼，不只是鮮豔。

def: n a disposition free from stress or emotion
n an untroubled state; free from disturbances
n a state of peace and quiet

ex.en: We enjoyed the tranquility of the garden at dawn.
ex.zh: 我們享受著黎明時花園裡的寧靜。

ex.en: Urban parks offer residents a sense of tranquility that can help reduce everyday stress.
ex.zh: 城市公園為居民帶來寧靜感，有助於緩解日常壓力。

words.tip: 美式常拼tranquility，英式常拼tranquillity。

tr: a. 發狂的, 癲狂的, 瘋狂的
def: n. a person who has an obsession with or excessive enthusiasm for something
someone behaving in an extremely wild or reckless way
someone extremely enthusiastic about a particular activity

ex.en: That driver is a maniac, speeding around every corner.
ex.zh: 那個司機開車太瘋狂了，每個彎道都飛速駛過。

ex.en: Calling a reckless driver a maniac expresses anger but does little to explain the causes of dangerous driving.
ex.zh: 把魯莽的司機稱為瘋子雖然表達了憤怒，卻無助於解釋危險駕駛的原因。

col: drive like a maniac｜瘋狂地開車
words.tip: 屬非正式用語，可能冒犯他人；勿作精神疾病診斷詞。

tr: vt. 焊接, 使密接, 使結合, 使成整體
def: n. United States abolitionist (1803-1895)
n. a metal joint formed by softening with heat and fusing or hammering together
v. join together by heating

ex.en: Wearing a protective mask, she welded the metal frame.
ex.zh: 她戴著防護面罩，焊接了那個金屬框架。

ex.en: Workers who weld steel structures need proper training and protective equipment to reduce workplace injuries.
ex.zh: 焊接鋼結構的工人需要接受適當培訓並配備防護裝備，以減少工傷。

words.tip: weld A to B表示把A焊接到B上。

tr: 興高采烈的；欣喜若狂的
def: a. exultantly proud and joyful; in high spirits
s. full of high-spirited delight
Extremely happy and excited, especially after success or good news.

ex.en: Lina was elated when she finally passed her driving test.
ex.zh: 莉娜終於通過駕照考試時，欣喜萬分。

ex.en: Graduates may feel elated after securing their first job, although adjusting to workplace expectations can be challenging.
ex.zh: 畢業生找到第一份工作後可能欣喜萬分，儘管適應職場要求並不容易。

col: elated at the news｜聽到消息欣喜萬分
elated by success｜因成功而歡欣鼓舞
words.tip: 比happy語氣更強，常用於成功或獲悉好消息後。

def: n. a thin straight surgical knife used in dissection and surgery
A small, very sharp knife used in surgery or dissection.

ex.en: The surgeon placed the scalpel on a clean tray.
ex.zh: 外科醫生把手術刀放在乾淨的托盤上。

ex.en: Medical students practise using a scalpel on artificial tissue before developing more advanced surgical skills.
ex.zh: 醫學生先在人工組織上練習使用手術刀，再學習更高級的外科技能。

words.tip: 可數名詞，指精細切割用的手術刀或解剖刀。

tr: 全套用具；雜七雜八的物品
def: n equipment consisting of miscellaneous articles needed for a particular operation or sport etc.
The various objects needed for a particular activity.

ex.en: Our camping paraphernalia filled every corner of the garage.
ex.zh: 我們的露營用具塞滿了車庫的每個角落。

ex.en: Schools need adequate storage for sports paraphernalia to keep shared spaces safe and equipment accessible to students.
ex.zh: 學校需要充足的空間存放體育用具，以確保公共區域安全，並方便學生取用器材。

col: all the paraphernalia｜全套雜項用具
words.tip: 通常作不可數名詞，不加a，也不再加複數s。

def: v. be preoccupied with something
to fill someone's mind so they cannot think of anything else
to think about something constantly and excessively

ex.en: Don't obsess over every tiny mark on your shoes.
ex.zh: 別總糾結鞋子上的每一處小汙痕。

ex.en: Some students obsess over examination results, neglecting the broader skills that education should develop.
ex.zh: 一些學生過分關注考試成績，忽視了教育應當培養的更廣泛的能力。

col: obsess over details｜過分糾結細節
be obsessed with success｜痴迷於成功
obsess about appearance｜過分在意外表
words.tip: 常用be obsessed with；主動式常接over或about。

tr: a. 在外的, 邊遠的, 偏僻的, 題外的
def: s. relatively far from a center or middle

tr: n. 大屠殺, 大火災, 毀滅, 大規模燒殺
納粹對猶太人的大屠殺
def: n. an act of mass destruction and loss of life (especially in war or by fire)
n. the mass murder of Jews under the German Nazi regime from 1941 until 1945
Destruction or killing on a very large scale.

ex.en: The film follows a family escaping a nuclear holocaust.
ex.zh: 這部電影講述一個家庭逃離核毀滅的經歷。

ex.en: Teaching students about the Holocaust can encourage critical reflection on prejudice, discrimination, and human rights.
ex.zh: 向學生講授納粹大屠殺的歷史，可以促進他們對偏見、歧視和人權的批判性思考。

col: Holocaust survivors｜納粹大屠殺倖存者
words.tip: 特指納粹大屠殺時用the Holocaust，首字母大寫。

tr: n. 飲劑, 飲料, 一次飲用量, 一服, 一劑
def: n. a medicinal or magical or poisonous beverage
A drink believed to have magical or medicinal effects.

ex.en: In the story, a potion turns the prince invisible.
ex.zh: 故事裡，一種魔法藥水讓王子隱了身。

ex.en: The magical potion remains a familiar device in children's literature, allowing authors to explore transformation and identity.
ex.zh: 魔法藥水仍是兒童文學中常見的敘事手段，讓作者能夠探討變化與身份認同。

words.tip: 常見於奇幻故事；普通藥物的一劑用dose。

tr: a. 明晰的, 清澈的, 透明的, 透徹的
[醫] 清明的, 透明的, 清醒的
def: s. having a clear mind
v spur on or encourage especially by cheers and shouts
v force or impel in an indicated direction
To strongly urge someone to do something.

ex.en: Our coach exhorted us to keep trying until the end.
ex.zh: 教練力勸我們堅持努力到最後。

ex.en: Public health campaigns exhort citizens to exercise regularly, but affordable facilities are also needed to support lasting change.
ex.zh: 公共衛生宣傳敦促市民經常鍛鍊，但要支持持久的改變，也需要價格親民的設施。

col: exhort someone to act｜敦促某人行動
exhort citizens to vote｜敦促公民投票
words.tip: 正式用詞：exhort sb to do，不只是提出忠告。

tr: n. 浮渣, 糟粕, 浮藻, 熔渣, 不起好作用的人
def: n. a film of impurities or vegetation that can form on the surface of a liquid
v. remove the scum from
An unpleasant layer of waste or bubbles on a liquid.

ex.en: He skimmed the scum off the simmering soup.
ex.zh: 他撇去了燉煮中的湯表面的浮沫。

ex.en: A thick layer of scum on a pond may indicate excessive nutrient levels caused by agricultural runoff.
ex.zh: 池塘表面厚厚的浮垢可能表明農業逕流導致了水體營養物質過量。

col: skim off the scum｜撇去浮渣
a layer of scum｜一層浮垢
words.tip: 通常不可數；用來指人時侮辱性很強，應避免。

tr: a. 有浮力的, 心情愉快的
[經] 降而復升的, 保持高價的, 遂之而升的
def: s. tending to float on a liquid or rise in air or gas
s. characterized by liveliness and lightheartedness

tr: n. 摘要, 提綱, 課程表, 教學大綱
def: n an integrated course of academic studies

tr: n. 汙穢, 不潔, 猥褻
[法] 汙穢, 汙物, 淫猥
def: n. any substance considered disgustingly foul or unpleasant
n. a state characterized by foul or disgusting dirt and refuse
thick or disgusting dirt

ex.en: My boots were covered in filth after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步回來後，我的靴子上沾滿了汙物。

ex.en: Without regular waste collection, filth can accumulate in residential areas and create serious public health risks.
ex.zh: 如果不定期收運垃圾，住宅區就可能積聚汙物，造成嚴重的公共衛生風險。

col: live in filth｜生活在汙穢環境中
words.tip: 不可數，比dirt語氣強，常帶厭惡感。

tr: v. 發明, 設計, 圖謀
def: v make or work out a plan for; devise
v come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
v put or send forth

ex.en: We contrived to fit every suitcase into the tiny car.
ex.zh: 我們設法把所有行李箱都塞進了那輛小汽車。

ex.en: Despite limited funding, the research team contrived to develop an affordable device for monitoring water quality.
ex.zh: 儘管資金有限，研究團隊仍設法開發出一種價格低廉的水質監測設備。

col: contrive to do something｜設法做成某事
contrive a plan｜巧妙制定計劃
words.tip: contrive to do表示設法做到；contrived常指刻意不自然。

tr: vt. 使困惑, 使複雜化, 使為難
[法] 困惑, 使複雜化, 使糾纏不清
def: v. be a mystery or bewildering to
To confuse someone because something is difficult to understand.

ex.en: The washing machine's strange noises continue to perplex me.
ex.zh: 洗衣機發出的奇怪聲響一直讓我摸不著頭腦。

ex.en: Conflicting dietary advice can perplex consumers who are trying to make healthier food choices.
ex.zh: 相互矛盾的飲食建議會讓試圖選擇更健康食物的消費者感到困惑。

col: a perplexing problem｜令人費解的問題
words.tip: 及物動詞；人感到困惑用perplexed，事物令人困惑用perplexing。

tr: n. 樞軸, 支點, 旋轉運動, 中樞, 關鍵人物
a. 樞軸的, (如)在樞軸上轉動的
vi. 在樞軸上轉動, 隨著轉移
vt. 裝樞軸於, 以...為中心旋轉
[計] 程序員交互驗證和編制工具, 數據透視表
def: n. the person in a rank around whom the others wheel and maneuver
n. axis consisting of a short shaft that supports something that turns
n. the act of turning on (or as if on) a pivot

ex.en: The seesaw turned smoothly on its central pivot.
ex.zh: 蹺蹺板繞著中央支點平穩地轉動。

ex.en: Small companies may need to pivot towards online services as consumer habits change and operating costs rise.
ex.zh: 隨著消費者習慣改變和運營成本上升，小公司可能需要轉向線上服務。

col: pivot on one foot｜以一隻腳為軸轉身
pivot towards online services｜轉向線上服務
words.tip: pivotal 表示關鍵的；pivot 作動詞也可指策略轉向。

tr: n. 給養；承辦酒席；[醫]提供飲食及服務
def: n. providing food and services

tr: a. 有害的, 有毒的, 使道德敗壞的
def: a. injurious to physical or mental health
harmful or poisonous to people or other living things

ex.en: Noxious fumes from the spill forced everyone to leave.
ex.zh: 洩漏物產生的有毒煙氣迫使所有人離開。

ex.en: Stricter controls on industrial emissions are needed to protect nearby communities from exposure to noxious gases.
ex.zh: 需要更嚴格地控制工業排放，以保護附近社區免受有毒氣體侵害。

words.tip: 常形容氣體或物質；不只是氣味難聞。

def: v kill in large numbers

tr: a. 難以消除的, 不能拭除的, 難忘的
def: s. cannot be removed or erased

tr: a. 瘦削的, 憔悴的, 荒涼的
def: s very thin especially from disease or hunger or cold
n. poor and often mischievous city child

tr: vt. 使同步, 使合拍
def: v. make synchronous and adjust in time or manner
v. happen at the same time
v. make (motion picture sound) exactly simultaneous with the action

tr: n. 公告, 佈告, 小牌, 海報
vt. 公佈, 佈告, 張帖, 貼海報於
def: v. post in a public place
v. publicize or announce by placards
a large notice displayed publicly or carried during a demonstration

ex.en: She carried a handmade placard through the crowded square.
ex.zh: 她舉著一塊手工製作的標語牌穿過擁擠的廣場。

ex.en: Residents held placards outside the town hall to demand safer cycling routes in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 居民們在市政廳外舉著標語牌，要求在社區內設置更安全的騎行路線。

col: hold up a placard｜舉起標語牌
words.tip: 通常指公開展示或遊行時舉著的大幅告示牌。

tr: n. 恐怖病, 恐懼症, 懼怕, 憎惡
def: n. an anxiety disorder characterized by extreme and irrational fear of simple things or social situations

tr: n. 物物交換, 實物交易
v. 物物交換, 交換
def: n. an equal exchange
v. exchange goods without involving money

tr: vt. 交付, 儲蓄, 委託, 寄存
[經] 託賣, 寄存, 寄銷
def: v. commit forever; commit irrevocably
v. give over to another for care or safekeeping
v. send to an address

tr: a. 堅定的, 踏實的, 固定的, 不變的
def: s. firm and dependable especially in loyalty

tr: n. 紅衣主教, 鮮紅色
a. 主要的, 深紅色的
def: n. (Roman Catholic Church) one of a group of more than 100 prominent bishops in the Sacred College who advise the Pope and elect new Popes
n. a variable color averaging a vivid red
n. crested thick-billed North American finch having bright red plumage in the male

ex.en: Our cardinal rule is to leave nobody behind.
ex.zh: 我們的首要原則是不落下任何人。

ex.en: Protecting patient privacy should remain a cardinal principle when hospitals introduce new digital record systems.
ex.zh: 醫院引入新的電子病歷系統時，保護患者隱私應始終是一項基本原則。

words.tip: cardinal number是基數，ordinal number是序數。

tr: a. 部門的, 各部的, 分科的
def: a. of or relating to a department

tr: a. 致病的, 病態的, 疾病的, 可怕的
def: s. suggesting an unhealthy mental state

tr: n. 姓, 別號, 綽號
vt. 呼以姓氏, 起綽號
def: n. the name used to identify the members of a family (as distinguished from each member's given name)
the name shared by members of a family

ex.en: My surname is often difficult for strangers to pronounce.
ex.zh: 陌生人常常覺得我的姓很難念。

ex.en: Naming traditions vary across cultures, and a person's surname may reflect family history or regional origins.
ex.zh: 不同文化的命名傳統各不相同，一個人的姓氏可能反映其家族歷史或地域來源。

words.tip: surname指姓，given name指名；姓不一定在最後。

def: n. the scientific study of language
n. the humanistic study of language and literature
The scientific study of language and how it works.

ex.en: My sister studies linguistics and loves comparing different accents.
ex.zh: 我姐姐學習語言學，喜歡比較不同的口音。

ex.en: Research in linguistics can help teachers develop more effective methods for teaching foreign languages.
ex.zh: 語言學研究可以幫助教師開發更有效的外語教學方法。

words.tip: 雖以s結尾，作為學科名通常接單數謂語。

def: v. separate (substances) into constituent elements or parts
v. break down
to decay naturally into simpler substances

ex.en: Fallen leaves decompose slowly in the damp garden soil.
ex.zh: 落葉在潮溼的花園土壤中慢慢腐爛。

ex.en: Organic waste can decompose into valuable nutrients, reducing the need for artificial fertilisers in agriculture.
ex.zh: 有機廢物可以分解為寶貴的養分，從而減少農業對人工肥料的需求。

words.tip: 既可不及物，也可及物；分解成某物用into。

tr: v. 開發票, 記清單
def: v. send an bill to
a document listing goods or services and the payment required
to send someone a document requesting payment for goods or services

ex.en: The plumber emailed an invoice after fixing our sink.
ex.zh: 水管工修好我們的水槽後，通過電子郵件發來了付款清單。

ex.en: Small businesses benefit from digital systems that track each invoice and remind customers when payments are due.
ex.zh: 小企業可以從追蹤每張發票並提醒客戶按時付款的數字系統中受益。

col: pay an invoice｜支付發票款項
an outstanding invoice｜尚未結清的發票
invoice someone for something｜就某項費用向某人開票
words.tip: invoice 通常用於要求付款；receipt 是已付款的收據。

tr: a. 變幻無常的, 浮燥的, 薄情的
def: s. marked by erratic changeableness in affections or attachments

tr: a. 可容忍的, 可以的
def: a. capable of being borne or endured
unpleasant but possible to endure
acceptable in quality, though not particularly good

ex.en: The heat became tolerable once we opened the windows.
ex.zh: 我們打開窗戶後，炎熱就變得可以忍受了。

ex.en: Improved ventilation can keep classroom temperatures at tolerable levels without relying entirely on air conditioning.
ex.zh: 改善通風可以使教室溫度保持在可忍受的水平，而不必完全依賴空調。

words.tip: tolerable指可忍受；tolerant指人寬容。

tr: n. 圓周, 周緣, 胸圍
def: n. the size of something as given by the distance around it
n. the boundary line encompassing an area or object
n. the length of the closed curve of a circle

tr: n. 地圖集, 圖表集
[計] 自動測試和負載分析系統
def: n. (Greek mythology) a Titan who was forced by Zeus to bear the sky on his shoulders
n. a collection of maps in book form
n. the 1st cervical vertebra

ex.en: We opened the atlas to find a mountain range.
ex.zh: 我們打開地圖冊，尋找一條山脈。

ex.en: Although digital maps are convenient, a printed atlas helps students compare geographical patterns across entire continents.
ex.zh: 雖然電子地圖很方便，紙質地圖冊仍有助於學生比較整個大陸範圍內的地理分佈特徵。

words.tip: atlas是成冊的地圖；複數為atlases。

tr: vi. 靠, 斜倚, 依賴
def: v. cause to recline

tr: n. 企業聯合, 辛迪加, 財團
def: n. a loose affiliation of gangsters in charge of organized criminal activities
n. a news agency that sells features or articles or photographs etc. to newspapers for simultaneous publication
v. join together into a syndicate

tr: vt. 超越, 勝過, 戰勝
def: v. get the better of

tr: n. 回覆, 故態復萌, 復發
vi. 故態復萌, 再陷邪道, 再度墮落
def: v. go back to bad behavior

tr: n. 海市蜃樓, 幻景, 妄想
