ex.zh: 老師解釋了為什麼我們絕不能抄襲文章。

ex.en: Students who plagiarize online material risk disciplinary action and miss opportunities to develop independent thinking.
ex.zh: 抄襲網絡資料的學生不僅可能受到紀律處分，也錯失了培養獨立思考能力的機會。

col: plagiarize someone's work｜剽竊某人的作品
plagiarize from a source｜從某一來源抄襲
words.tip: 英式也拼plagiarise；引用他人內容須註明來源。

def: n. founder of Christian Science in 1866 (1821-1910)
n. a miniature whirlpool or whirlwind resulting when the current of a fluid doubles back on itself
v. flow in a circular current, of liquids

ex.en: A fallen leaf spun in an eddy beside the bridge.
ex.zh: 一片落葉在橋邊的漩渦中打轉。

ex.en: Small eddies behind river barriers can trap floating waste and affect the movement of aquatic organisms.
ex.zh: 河流障礙物後的小漩渦會困住漂浮垃圾，並影響水生生物的移動。

words.tip: 可指水流或氣流打旋；複數為eddies。

tr: a. 平凡的, 單調的, 令人厭煩的
n. 平凡, 單調, 無聊
def: s. tediously repetitious or lacking in variety; all work and no play"
n. address to an absent or imaginary person
n. the mark (') used to indicate the omission of one or more letters from a printed word

tr: n. 最高聲部, 三倍
a. 三倍的, 最高聲部的
def: v. sing treble
s. three times as great or many
To become three times as much, or cause this increase.

ex.en: Our heating bills treble when the weather turns cold.
ex.zh: 天氣變冷時，我們的取暖費會增至原來的三倍。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy could treble over the next decade if governments introduce stronger financial incentives.
ex.zh: 如果政府推出更有力的財政激勵措施，可再生能源投資可能在未來十年增至三倍。

col: treble in size｜擴大到原來的三倍
treble the cost｜使成本增至三倍
words.tip: treble表示變為原來的三倍，即增加兩倍；英式英語常用。

tr: n. 熔渣, 礦渣, 無足輕重的人
def: n. the scum formed by oxidation at the surface of molten metals
v. convert into slag
Waste material separated from metal during smelting

ex.en: Dark heaps of slag stood beside the old factory.
ex.zh: 舊工廠旁堆著一堆堆黑色的爐渣。

ex.en: Reusing slag in road construction can reduce industrial waste and demand for newly quarried materials.
ex.zh: 在道路建設中重新利用礦渣，可以減少工業廢料及對新開採材料的需求。

words.tip: 工業義通常不可數；另有侮辱女性的英式俚語義，勿用。

def: n. someone legally empowered to witness signatures and certify a document's validity and to take depositions
An official authorised to witness signatures and certify documents.

ex.en: We signed the property documents in front of a notary.
ex.zh: 我們在公證人面前簽署了房產文件。

ex.en: A notary can verify signatures on legal documents, helping reduce the risk of fraud in property transactions.
ex.zh: 公證人可以核驗法律文件上的簽名，幫助降低房產交易中的欺詐風險。

col: before a notary｜在公證人面前
words.tip: 也稱notary public；具體職權因國家而異。

tr: a. 樂於施惠的, 體貼的, 有禮貌的
def: v force somebody to do something
v bind by an obligation; cause to be indebted
v provide a service or favor for someone

ex.en: An obliging neighbour watered our plants while we travelled.
ex.zh: 我們旅行時，一位熱心的鄰居幫我們澆了花。

ex.en: Obliging staff can improve patients' experiences by answering questions patiently and responding promptly to reasonable requests.
ex.zh: 樂於助人的工作人員可以通過耐心解答問題、及時回應合理要求來改善患者的體驗。

col: an obliging neighbour｜樂於助人的鄰居
words.tip: obliging 指樂於助人；obliged 常表示被迫或感激。

def: n. timepiece that indicates the daylight hours by the shadow that the gnomon casts on a calibrated dial

tr: vi. 東倒西歪地走, 蹣跚學步, 溜達
n. 東倒西歪的走路, 蹣跚
def: v. walk unsteadily
To walk with short, unsteady steps, especially as a young child.
To walk somewhere casually and without hurrying.

ex.en: The baby toddled across the rug towards her father.
ex.zh: 寶寶搖搖晃晃地走過地毯，朝爸爸走去。

ex.en: As children begin to toddle, safe spaces allow them to develop balance and explore their surroundings independently.
ex.zh: 孩子開始蹣跚學步時，安全的空間能讓他們練習平衡，並獨立探索周圍環境。

col: toddle across the room｜蹣跚著穿過房間
toddle towards someone｜蹣跚走向某人
words.tip: 主要作不及物動詞；學步幼兒叫toddler。

def: n. either of two parallels of latitude about 23.5 degrees to the north and south of the equator representing the points farthest north and south at which the sun can shine directly overhead and constituting the boundaries of the Torrid Zone or tropics
Either of two imaginary circles marking Earth's tropical boundaries.
The hot region between these circles, called the tropics.

ex.en: Our guide pointed to the northern tropic on a globe.
ex.zh: 導遊指了指地球儀上的北迴歸線。

ex.en: Communities in the tropics often depend on seasonal rainfall to sustain agriculture and maintain reliable freshwater supplies.
ex.zh: 熱帶地區的社區往往依賴季節性降雨來維持農業生產和穩定的淡水供應。

words.tip: 迴歸線用單數；熱帶地區固定用the tropics。

def: n. an optical instrument that provides a view of an otherwise obstructed field

tr: n. 床上用品, 床組（bed複數）
def: n a piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep
n a plot of ground in which plants are growing
n a depression forming the ground under a body of water

tr: vt. 縮短, 刪節, 減少, 剝奪
def: v. reduce in scope while retaining essential elements
v. lessen, diminish, or curtail
To shorten a written work while keeping its main content.

ex.en: The publisher abridged the novel for younger readers.
ex.zh: 出版社為較年幼的讀者推出了這部小說的刪節版。

ex.en: Publishers often abridge classic novels to make them more accessible to students with limited reading experience.
ex.zh: 出版社經常刪節經典小說，使閱讀經驗有限的學生更容易讀懂。

words.tip: 刪去部分內容但保留主幹，不等同於寫摘要。

tr: [醫] 花; 昇華製成的藥物; 月經
def: n a plant cultivated for its blooms or blossoms
n reproductive organ of angiosperm plants especially one having showy or colorful parts
n the period of greatest prosperity or productivity

tr: a. 發呆的, 愚笨的
def: s devoid of intelligence
Foolish and unreasonable, often with misplaced confidence

ex.en: His fatuous suggestion was to water plants with lemonade.
ex.zh: 他竟自以為是地提議用檸檬汽水澆花。

ex.en: The fatuous assumption that technology alone can solve poverty ignores the importance of education and effective governance.
ex.zh: 認為單靠技術就能解決貧困的愚蠢假設，忽視了教育和有效治理的重要性。

words.tip: 正式且貶義，常批評言論或想法愚蠢而自滿。

tr: a. 可守的, 站得住(腳)的, 合理的, 成立的
def: s. based on sound reasoning or evidence
Able to be defended or maintained against criticism.

ex.en: His excuse was no longer tenable after we checked.
ex.zh: 我們核實後，他的藉口就再也站不住腳了。

ex.en: The assumption that economic growth always improves public wellbeing is no longer tenable in every context.
ex.zh: 經濟增長總能改善公眾福祉這一假設，已不能在所有情境下成立。

col: a tenable position｜站得住腳的立場
a tenable argument｜經得起推敲的論點
no longer tenable｜不再站得住腳
words.tip: 常形容論點或立場站得住腳，不等於舒適。

tr: a. 很多的, 豐富的, 浪費的, 慷慨的
def: s produced or growing in extreme abundance
Produced or expressed in very large amounts

ex.en: He offered profuse apologies for spilling my tea.
ex.zh: 他打翻了我的茶，連聲道歉。

ex.en: Profuse sweating during outdoor exercise can increase fluid loss, making regular water intake particularly important.
ex.zh: 戶外運動時大量出汗會增加水分流失，因此定期補水尤為重要。

words.tip: 常修飾出汗、道歉或感謝，強調量大或反覆。

tr: n. 懶惰的人, 翫忽職守者, 曠課者
a. 偷懶的, 曠課的, 遊蕩的
def: n. one who is absent from school without permission
s. absent without permission
A pupil who stays away from school without permission

ex.en: The teacher found two truants hiding behind the playground.
ex.zh: 老師發現兩個逃學的學生躲在操場後面。

ex.en: Schools should support persistent truants by addressing bullying and family difficulties rather than relying solely on punishment.
ex.zh: 學校應通過解決欺凌和家庭困難來幫助經常逃學的學生，而不是隻依靠懲罰。

words.tip: 英式英語play truant意為逃學，不是普通的請假缺課。

tr: a. 存在的, 生存的, 現存的
def: a. having existence or being or actuality
v ask for or request earnestly

tr: vi. 蹣跚地走, 搖搖晃晃地走, 搖晃不穩
def: n. walking with a slow dragging motion without lifting your feet
To walk slowly and awkwardly, dragging your feet
A slow, awkward walk with dragging feet

ex.en: Still half asleep, he shambled into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他還半睡半醒，拖著腳走進了廚房。

ex.en: After hours of physical work, exhausted labourers may shamble home rather than walk briskly.
ex.zh: 經過數小時的體力勞動，筋疲力盡的工人回家時可能腳步拖沓，而非步履輕快。

words.tip: 強調腳步拖沓、不利落，不一定是失去平衡。

def: n. a function word that combines with a noun or pronoun or noun phrase to form a prepositional phrase that can have an adverbial or adjectival relation to some other word
n. (linguistics) the placing of one linguistic element before another (as placing a modifier before the word it modifies in a sentence or placing an affix before the base to which it is attached)
a word showing relationships, such as location, direction, or time

ex.en: Our teacher used a toy rabbit to explain each preposition.
ex.zh: 老師用一隻玩具兔來解釋每個介詞。

ex.en: Choosing the correct preposition helps language learners express relationships between ideas more precisely in academic writing.
ex.zh: 選擇正確的介詞有助於語言學習者在學術寫作中更準確地表達觀點之間的關係。

col: a preposition of place｜地點介詞
a preposition of time｜時間介詞
words.tip: 介詞後通常接名詞、代詞或動名詞。

tr: n. 立交橋, 天橋, 立交馬路
def: n. a flight at a low altitude (usually of military aircraft) over spectators on the ground

tr: a. 精明的, 明智的, 策略的
def: a. marked by artful prudence, expedience, and shrewdness
s. smoothly agreeable and courteous with a degree of sophistication
v. grow and flourish
To grow or develop rapidly.

ex.en: Her interest in gardening burgeoned after she moved here.
ex.zh: 搬到這裡後，她對園藝的興趣迅速增長。

ex.en: Demand for online courses has burgeoned as more adults seek flexible opportunities to develop professional skills.
ex.zh: 隨著越來越多成年人尋求靈活提升職業技能的機會，在線課程的需求迅速增長。

col: a burgeoning industry｜蓬勃發展的行業
a burgeoning population｜迅速增長的人口
words.tip: 現代常作不及物動詞；burgeoning常用於名詞前。

def: n. German physicist who invented the mercury thermometer and developed the scale of temperature that bears his name (1686-1736)
a. of or relating to a temperature scale proposed by the inventor of the mercury thermometer
Using a temperature scale where water freezes at thirty-two degrees

ex.en: The recipe says to bake at three hundred degrees Fahrenheit.
ex.zh: 食譜說要在華氏三百度的溫度下烘烤。

ex.en: International weather reports may provide temperatures in both Fahrenheit and Celsius to serve different audiences.
ex.zh: 國際天氣預報可能同時提供華氏和攝氏溫度，以滿足不同受眾的需要。

col: convert Fahrenheit to Celsius｜將華氏溫度換算為攝氏溫度
words.tip: 指華氏溫標，並非溫度計；首字母始終大寫。

tr: a. 粘液的, 粘的, 粘液性的
def: a. of or secreting or covered with or resembling mucus
s. recorded on film; made into a movie
v. cause to expand as it by internal pressure
v. swell from or as if from internal pressure
To swell or become larger because of pressure from inside.

ex.en: Too much gas can distend your stomach after meals.
ex.zh: 飯後過多的氣體會使你的胃脹大。

ex.en: During digestion, excess gas may distend the abdomen, causing discomfort that can affect daily activities.
ex.zh: 消化過程中，多餘氣體可能使腹部脹大，造成影響日常活動的不適。

col: distended with gas｜因氣體而膨脹
words.tip: 多用於醫學，強調內部壓力導致脹大。

tr: vi. 用犁耕田, 開路
vt. 耕, 犁, 開路
def: n a group of seven bright stars in the constellation Ursa Major
n a farm tool having one or more heavy blades to break the soil and cut a furrow prior to sowing
v move in a way resembling that of a plow cutting into or going through the soil

ex.en: The farmer pulled an old plough from the shed.
ex.zh: 農民從棚裡拖出了一把舊犁。

ex.en: Farmers who plough steep slopes too frequently may increase soil erosion and reduce long-term agricultural productivity.
ex.zh: 過於頻繁地耕作陡坡的農民可能會加劇水土流失，並降低長期農業生產力。

col: plough through｜費力地完成或穿過
words.tip: 美式拼作plow；兩種拼寫都讀/plaʊ/。

def: v inquire about
v conduct an inquiry or investigation of
v have a wish or desire to know something

ex.en: I called the hotel to enquire about available rooms.
ex.zh: 我打電話給酒店，詢問是否有空房。

ex.en: Prospective students should enquire about financial support before deciding which university course best suits their needs.
ex.zh: 有意申請的學生應先詢問資助情況，再決定哪門大學課程最適合自己。

col: enquire into a matter｜調查某事
words.tip: 英式常用enquire，美式通常用inquire。

tr: vt. 使隔離, 使孤立, 隔開
def: v. keep away from others
To keep someone away from other people.

ex.en: She secluded herself in the cottage to finish painting.
ex.zh: 她獨自待在小屋裡，不受打擾地完成繪畫。

ex.en: Some writers seclude themselves in remote locations to avoid distractions and concentrate on their work.
ex.zh: 一些作家隱居在偏遠地區，以免受到干擾，專心創作。

col: seclude oneself from others｜與他人隔絕
words.tip: 常用seclude oneself，表示讓自己遠離他人。

tr: n. 執照, 許可證, 特許
vt. 許可, 特許, 認可
def: n excessive freedom; lack of due restraint
n freedom to deviate deliberately from normally applicable rules or practices (especially in behavior or speech)
n a legal document giving official permission to do something

ex.en: I keep my driving licence in my wallet.
ex.zh: 我把駕駛執照放在錢包裡。

ex.en: Requiring a licence to operate tourist boats can help authorities maintain safety standards on busy waterways.
ex.zh: 要求旅遊船持證運營，可以幫助主管部門維持繁忙水道的安全標準。

col: apply for a licence｜申請許可證
words.tip: 英式名詞用licence，動詞用license；美式都用license。

tr: a. 易傳染的, 有魅力的, 吸引人的

n. becoming infected
s. (of disease) capable of being transmitted by infection

ex.en: Her laughter was catching, and soon everyone was smiling.
ex.zh: 她的笑聲很有感染力，很快大家都笑了。

ex.en: Although enthusiasm can be catching, public health campaigns also need clear evidence to encourage lasting behavioural change.
ex.zh: 儘管熱情能夠感染他人，公共衛生宣傳仍需明確證據來促成持久的行為改變。

col: a catching illness｜會傳染的疾病
words.tip: 多作表語；形容曲調朗朗上口用catchy，而非catching。

tr: n. 特權；額外津貼（perk的複數）；特別待遇

The legal right or arrangement to occupy rented property.
The period during which someone rents a property.

ex.zh: 我們的租期下個月結束，所以我們正在收拾行李。

ex.en: Clear tenancy agreements can protect both landlords and tenants by defining their respective rights and responsibilities.
ex.zh: 清晰的租賃協議可以明確雙方各自的權利和責任，從而保護房東與租客。

col: a fixed-term tenancy｜固定期限租賃
words.tip: tenant指租客；tenancy指租賃關係、權利或租期。

tr: vt. 使迷惑, 使不知所措

tr: n. 虛飾, 虛有其表, 賣弄
def: n. a gaudy outward display
n. lack of elegance as a consequence of being pompous and puffed up with vanity
n. pretentious or showy or vulgar display

ex.en: Their wedding was warm and cheerful, without any ostentation.
ex.zh: 他們的婚禮溫馨愉快，沒有絲毫鋪張炫耀。

ex.en: The ostentation associated with luxury consumption can intensify social pressure to display wealth rather than save responsibly.
ex.zh: 奢侈消費中的炫富行為可能加劇社會壓力，促使人們展示財富而非理性儲蓄。

col: an air of ostentation｜炫耀的氣派
words.tip: 不可數名詞，通常含貶義，強調故意展示以引人注目。

tr: n. 努力, 力圖, 盡力
vi. 努力, 力圖, 盡力
def: n a purposeful or industrious undertaking (especially one that requires effort or boldness)
n earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something
v attempt by employing effort

ex.en: Growing vegetables together became our family's latest endeavour.
ex.zh: 一起種菜成了我們全家最近嘗試的新事情。

ex.en: Governments should endeavour to make reliable public transport accessible to people in remote communities.
ex.zh: 政府應努力讓偏遠社區的居民也能使用可靠的公共交通。

col: endeavour to do something｜努力做某事
words.tip: 英式拼寫；美式為endeavor；動詞後接to do。

tr: n. 英國貨幣, 標準純銀
a. 英國貨幣的, 標準純銀的, 含標準成分的
def: n. British money; especially the pound sterling as the basic monetary unit of the UK
the currency of the United Kingdom
excellent in quality and deserving admiration

ex.en: We exchanged our remaining foreign currency for sterling yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我們把剩餘的外幣兌換成了英鎊。

ex.en: A fall in sterling may attract international tourists by making accommodation and local services more affordable.
ex.zh: 英鎊貶值可能使住宿和當地服務更實惠，從而吸引國際遊客。

words.tip: sterling silver通常含銀92.5%，並非百分之百純銀。

def: v. be on the verge of sleeping
To sleep lightly or be almost asleep.
A state of being partly asleep.

ex.en: Grandfather drowsed in his chair beside the sunny window.
ex.zh: 爺爺坐在陽光照進的窗邊，在椅子上打瞌睡。

ex.en: Passengers may drowse during long journeys, making comfortable seating an important consideration for transport providers.
ex.zh: 乘客在長途旅行中可能會打瞌睡，因此舒適的座椅是交通服務商的重要考量。

col: drowse in a chair｜坐在椅子上打瞌睡
in a drowse｜處於半睡狀態
words.tip: 較書面；日常說打瞌睡更常用doze。

tr: n. 樓, 樓層, 層樓
def: n a structure consisting of a room or set of rooms at a single position along a vertical scale
A level of a building.

ex.en: Their new house has two storeys and a small garden.
ex.zh: 他們的新房有兩層，還帶一個小花園。

ex.en: Buildings with many storeys can accommodate more residents without requiring additional land in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在擁擠的城市中，多層建築無需增加用地就能容納更多居民。

words.tip: 英式storey複數為storeys；美式拼作story。

def: v. communicate by telex
n. education of men and women in the same institutions
The education of boys and girls together in the same institution.

ex.en: My grandparents first experienced coeducation at their village school.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母在村裡的學校首次接受了男女同校教育。

ex.en: Supporters of coeducation argue that learning together helps boys and girls develop mutual respect.
ex.zh: 支持男女同校教育的人認為，共同學習有助於男孩和女孩培養相互尊重的態度。

support coeducation｜支持男女同校教育

words.tip: 不可數名詞；形容詞形式為coeducational。

tr: a. 不願意的, 厭惡的

Unwilling or reluctant to do something.

ex.zh: 我不願離開溫暖的廚房。

ex.en: Some residents are loth to support redevelopment because they fear losing their neighbourhood's distinctive character.
ex.zh: 一些居民不願支持重建，因為他們擔心失去社區獨有的特色。

words.tip: loath的較少見變體；常用be loth to do。

tr: n. 關鍵幀；（鋼琴等的）鍵；密鑰（key的複數）

To restrict someone's freedom or ability to act.

ex.en: Don't let fear fetter your plans to travel alone.
ex.zh: 別讓恐懼束縛你獨自旅行的計劃。

ex.en: Excessive administrative requirements can fetter small businesses, preventing them from investing in innovation and creating jobs.
ex.zh: 過多的行政要求可能束縛小企業，使其無法投資創新和創造就業機會。

col: break free from fetters｜掙脫束縛
words.tip: 較正式；名詞通常用複數fetters。

def: n the fraction of radiant energy that is reflected from a surface

v lock up or confine, in or as in a jail

ex.en: We visited the old gaol during our walking tour.
ex.zh: 我們在徒步遊覽時參觀了那座舊監獄。

ex.en: The former gaol now serves as a museum exploring changes in punishment and prison conditions.
ex.zh: 這座昔日的監獄現已成為博物館，展示刑罰和監獄條件的變遷。

words.tip: gaol是jail的舊式英式拼法，讀音相同。

tr: a. 位於...的, 坐落在...的, 處於某種境地的

ex.zh: 我們的酒店坐落在一處寧靜的高山湖泊旁。

ex.en: Schools situated near busy roads may need additional measures to protect pupils from air pollution.
ex.zh: 位於繁忙道路附近的學校可能需要採取額外措施，保護學生免受空氣汙染的影響。

words.tip: 常用be situated in/near，描述位置，較正式。

ex.zh: 老師讓我們說出一個generous的反義詞。

ex.en: Learning an antonym alongside each new adjective can help language students understand contrasts and expand their vocabulary.
ex.zh: 語言學習者每學一個新形容詞時同時學習其反義詞，有助於理解對比關係並擴大詞彙量。

words.tip: 常用an antonym of；synonym表示同義詞。

ex.en: I misconceived her silence as a sign of agreement.
ex.zh: 我誤把她的沉默理解為同意。

ex.en: Policymakers may misconceive local needs if they fail to consult residents before introducing changes.
ex.zh: 政策制定者若不在推行改革前徵求居民意見，就可能誤解當地需求。

words.tip: 較正式；日常表達“誤解”更常用misunderstand。

To oversee and take responsibility for work or an activity.

ex.en: An experienced gardener superintended the planting of our trees.
ex.zh: 一位經驗豐富的園丁監督了我們種樹的過程。

ex.en: Qualified engineers should superintend major construction projects to ensure that safety standards are consistently maintained.
ex.zh: 大型建設項目應由合格工程師監督，以確保始終遵守安全標準。

words.tip: 正式及物動詞，直接接工作或活動；日常多用supervise。

ex.zh: 商店明天早上會寄出你的包裹。

ex.zh: 當嚴重洪災使社區與外界的必需品供應中斷時，應急部門必須迅速派遣救援隊。

ex.zh: 博物館在一面木盾旁展出了一套騎士盔甲。

ex.zh: 現存的中世紀盔甲展示了金屬加工技術如何隨著軍事需求的變化而發展。

ex.zh: 他那個不合時宜的笑話讓用餐的每個人都感到尷尬。

ex.en: Comparing schools solely by examination results is inapt when their students have very different social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 當學生的社會背景差異很大時，僅按考試成績比較學校並不恰當。
